rows.original: This small Oxonium crystal is nearly pure, pitch black yet oddly reflective, like a mirror made of volcanic glass. While some subcultures prize these gems for jewelry and adornment, their main use is industrial; Modern holographic techniques cannot be accomplished without an Oxonium diffraction mirror. Hardlight tech is even more dependant on these inky crystals. Man-portable shield generators would be little more than a dream without Oxonium.
rows.translation: 这块小型奥克索尼姆水晶近乎纯净，漆黑如墨，却又如火山玻璃制成的镜子般反射着诡异光泽。某些亚文化群体珍视这些宝石，将其用于珠宝和饰品，但它们的主要用途仍在工业领域；没有奥克索尼姆衍射镜，现代全息技术便无法实现。硬光技术对这种墨色水晶的依赖甚至更深。若没有奥克索尼姆，便携式护盾发生器不过是一场幻梦。
rows.raw: "This small Oxonium crystal is nearly pure, pitch black yet oddly reflective, like a mirror made of volcanic glass. While some subcultures prize these gems for jewelry and adornment, their main use is industrial; Modern holographic techniques cannot be accomplished without an Oxonium diffraction mirror. Hardlight tech is even more dependant on these inky crystals. Man-portable shield generators would be little more than a dream without Oxonium."

rows.original: “Ah, first time in Treasure Nova?” the genial kitty-rabbit perks up again, sensing your confusion. “The rules are pretty simple if I says so myself!” she flicks out one card to each player in a mere second. “Just plug in your money, tell me your bet, and we’ll start playing! No forfeits, though! Hopefully Colis or Alphonse told you that.” Another card swicks. “Minimum bets are 500 credits, maximum bets 5000,” another, “and if you win a lot, you’ll start earning some super special VIP prizes!” The deep heat in her tone raises an eyebrow. “Haven’t had to give out any lately believe it or not! Luck’s just not been on anyone’s side, sadly...”
rows.translation: “啊，第一次来宝藏新星？”这位亲切的猫兔姑娘察觉到你的困惑，又来了精神。“要我说，规则其实很简单！”她只用一秒就给每位玩家各弹出一张牌。“把钱插进去，告诉我下注多少，我们就开始玩！不过不能弃局！希望科利斯或阿尔方斯已经告诉你了。”又一张牌嗖地飞出。“最低下注500信用点，最高5000，”又一张，“要是赢得够多，你就能开始赢取超级特别的VIP奖品！”她语气中那股炽热令你挑起眉毛。“信不信由你，最近我都没机会发出任何奖品！可惜大家的运气都不怎么样...”

rows.original: Treasure Nova’s sunniest employee is a light-skinned kaithrit who’s replaced her fluffy ears with those of a lop bunny’s. They dangle inflexibly from her head of pristine white and curly hair, beautifully styled and maintained to maximize charm and refinement. rows.translation: 宝藏新星最阳光的员工是一位浅肤色凯斯里特，她把自己毛茸茸的耳朵替换成了垂耳兔的耳朵。那双耳朵僵硬地垂在一头纯白卷发两侧，发型经过精心打理，最大限度展现魅力与优雅。两只樱桃红的竖瞳眼睛如宝石般嵌在她可爱而布满雀斑的脸上；可爱的纽扣鼻下，丰满红唇很容易便绽放出欢快笑容，在柔软可捏的脸颊上挤出皱褶。

rows.translation: 你告诉露自己不需要服务，她点点头。她没有发表惯常长篇介绍，也没有像平日那样离开，而是利用这段珍贵的独处时间绕过桌子拿了什么。再次走近时，她把东西藏在背后。“[pc.name]，我有件东西想交给你，也有句话想说。”
rows.raw: "You tell Roo you’re not in need of service, and she nods. Instead of giving you a spiel, instead of heading off like she usually does, she takes this precious one-on-one time to maneuver around the table and grab something. She holds it behind her back as she approaches you again. “[pc.name], there’s something I want you to have, and something I want to say.”"

rows.original: A degree of worry builds inside, but you wait patiently for her to continue. “You asked me how I came to be here. I can’t answer that.” She kneels down in front of you, a dour smile cresting her features. “But I want you to know that I am not unhappy, that I don’t begrudge any of this. Especially not after meeting you.”
rows.translation: 一丝担忧在心里积聚，可你耐心等她继续。“你问过我是怎么来到这里的。我无法回答。”她跪在你面前，阴郁笑容浮上脸庞。“但我希望你知道，我并不难过，也不怨恨这一切。尤其是在遇见你之后。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA degree of worry builds inside, but you wait patiently for her to continue. “You asked me how I came to be here. I can’t answer that.” She kneels down in front of you, a dour smile cresting her features. “But I want you to know that I am not unhappy, that I don’t begrudge any of this. Especially not after meeting you.”"

rows.original: Her arms weave around and she presents you something... red....
rows.translation: 她的双臂绕回来，向你展示某样东西... 红色的....
rows.raw: "\n\nHer arms weave around and she presents you something... red...."

rows.original: Her bright red panties.
rows.translation: 她鲜红的内裤。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer bright red panties."

rows.original: “I love the game, and I love the job. Nobody else has ever come as close as you have. You could point your finger to the sky, and instead of seeing the moon or the star, they’d only be able to look at your finger.” She grins goofily. “Sorry, it’s just a silly compliment. I don’t want you to get attached to me or anything, if you were asking that question back then because you were worried for me.”
rows.translation: “我爱这场游戏，也爱这份工作。以前从没有人像你这么接近。你可以把手指向天空，他们不会去看月亮或星星，只会看着你的手指。”她傻傻一笑。“抱歉，只是个傻乎乎的恭维。如果你当时问那个问题是因为担心我，我并不想让你依恋我之类的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love the game, and I love the job. Nobody else has ever come as close as you have. You could point your finger to the sky, and instead of seeing the moon or the star, they’d only be able to look at your finger.” She grins goofily. “Sorry, it’s just a silly compliment. I don’t want you to get attached to me or anything, if you were asking that question back then because you were worried for me.”"

rows.original: You were, and you emphasize that. All you get out of her is a shrug of the shoulders.
rows.translation: 你的确担心她，并强调了这一点。她只是耸耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou were, and you emphasize that. All you get out of her is a shrug of the shoulders."

rows.original: You nod lightly, not committing to an answer.
rows.translation: 你轻轻点头，没有给出明确回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod lightly, not committing to an answer."

rows.original: “As long as you’re happy, then I’m happy. It’s how I feel for anyone who comes here,” she smiles as you take her underwear. “When I first saw you I didn’t see a pirate, a killer... I don’t see anything of this place or the usual clientele in you. That’s why I was even happier when you began to win.”
rows.translation: “只要你开心，我就开心。我对每个来这里的人都这样想。”她看着你接过内裤，微笑道。“第一次看到你时，我没看见海盗，也没看见杀手... 我在你身上看不到这个地方和普通顾客的任何东西。所以你开始获胜时，我才会更加高兴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As long as you’re happy, then I’m happy. It’s how I feel for anyone who comes here,” she smiles as you take her underwear. “When I first saw you I didn’t see a pirate, a killer... I don’t see anything of this place or the usual clientele in you. That’s why I was even happier when you began to win.”"

rows.original: She stands finally, refulgent in splendid nudity. “Any time you come back, I’ll treat you to a show. So long as you win!” She wags a playful finger. “And don’t go thinking I didn’t appreciate the sentiment either way. I’ll be alright, you’ve got my word on that!”
rows.translation: 她终于站起，壮丽裸体熠熠生辉。“你无论什么时候回来，我都会表演给你看。只要你能赢！”她顽皮地摇摇手指。“也别以为我不领你的情。不管怎样，我都会没事的，我向你保证！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stands finally, refulgent in splendid nudity. “Any time you come back, I’ll treat you to a show. So long as you win!” She wags a playful finger. “And don’t go thinking I didn’t appreciate the sentiment either way. I’ll be alright, you’ve got my word on that!”"

rows.original: Roo turns to gather her things while you hastily pocket her lingerie, lest security take it from you. “Just see me as I am: a funny-looking kaithrit.” A blown kiss and a heartful wave later, she’s gone.
rows.translation: 露转身收拾东西，你则赶紧把她的内衣塞进口袋，以免被保安拿走。“就把我看成本来的样子，一只长得滑稽的凯斯里特。”一个飞吻和一次真心挥手后，她离开了。
rows.raw: "\n\nRoo turns to gather her things while you hastily pocket her lingerie, lest security take it from you. “Just see me as I am: a funny-looking kaithrit.” A blown kiss and a heartful wave later, she’s gone."

rows.original: Her clarity still lingers, overriding the effect of the free drink you’re given. You wander off with your earnings and your fragrant bonus
rows.translation: 她清醒的形象仍挥之不去，甚至盖过免费饮料的效果。你带着赢款和芬芳赠品走开
rows.raw: "\n\nHer clarity still lingers, overriding the effect of the free drink you’re given. You wander off with your earnings and your fragrant bonus"

rows.original: , thinking her situation a little morose. You doubt you’ll learn anything more of that cat, but if she has that attitude every day, she’ll surely be alright
rows.translation: ，觉得她的处境有些悲凉。你怀疑自己是否还能进一步了解那只猫，不过若她每天都有这种心态，肯定会没事
rows.raw: ", thinking her situation a little morose. You doubt you’ll learn anything more of that cat, but if she has that attitude every day, she’ll surely be alright"

rows.original: , thinking little of her situation. You didn’t learn much in the end, but you’re still happy to accept her graces, wondering when next you should try to earn them
rows.translation: ，没有多想她的处境。最终没了解到多少，可你仍乐意接受她的恩惠，并想知道下次何时该努力赢得这些
rows.raw: ", thinking little of her situation. You didn’t learn much in the end, but you’re still happy to accept her graces, wondering when next you should try to earn them"

rows.translation: （获得关键物品：内裤，露的）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Gained: Panties - Roo’s)"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: “What’s the story of the cute kitty cat with bunny’s ears?” You lean forward, holding your smiling head up by the palms on your cheeks, looking super adorable.
rows.translation: “长着兔耳朵的可爱猫咪有什么故事？”你向前倾身，双掌托住脸颊，撑起微笑的脑袋，显得超级可爱。
rows.raw: "“What’s the story of the cute kitty cat with bunny’s ears?” You lean forward, holding your smiling head up by the palms on your cheeks, looking super adorable."

rows.original: “Anything more I can learn about the kitten under the dress?” you ask bluntly, drumming the table with your fingers.
rows.translation: “关于裙子下面的小猫咪，还有什么能让我了解的吗？”你直截了当地问，手指敲着桌面。
rows.raw: "“Anything more I can learn about the kitten under the dress?” you ask bluntly, drumming the table with your fingers."

rows.original: “I know your name, but I want to know more,” you ask simply, flashing her a winning smile.
rows.translation: “我知道你的名字，但还想知道更多。”你简单地问，向她露出制胜微笑。
rows.raw: "“I know your name, but I want to know more,” you ask simply, flashing her a winning smile."

rows.original: Sly grin on your face, you ask, “I’d like to be spoiled. Tell me something about yourself, I like getting to know the cute girls,” finishing by propping your nose on your knuckle.
rows.translation: 你脸上带着狡黠笑容，问道：“我想被宠一宠。说点自己的事吧，我喜欢了解可爱的姑娘。”最后把鼻子搁在指关节上。
rows.raw: "Sly grin on your face, you ask, “I’d like to be spoiled. Tell me something about yourself, I like getting to know the cute girls,” finishing by propping your nose on your knuckle."

rows.original: “Your clothes are one thing, but I’m interested in you. What’s there to really know about the bunny-eared cat?” you ask sharply.
rows.translation: “你的衣服是一回事，但我对你本人感兴趣。这只兔耳猫究竟有什么值得了解的？”你尖锐地问。
rows.raw: "“Your clothes are one thing, but I’m interested in you. What’s there to really know about the bunny-eared cat?” you ask sharply."

rows.original: Her ears perk up halfway before slumping down. “Oh-ho,” Roo hums, flicking out cards at indiscernible speeds. “Well, this girl’s got a lotta secrets. Not the kind you go telling anyone who just asks,” she winks; out goes another card. “Certainly not when she’s working hard!” She giggles, dealing your hand. “How about this,
rows.translation: 她的耳朵竖起一半，随后垂落。“哦吼。”露哼道，以难以分辨的速度甩出纸牌。“嗯，这姑娘有很多秘密，可不是有人随口一问就会说的那种。”她眨眨眼，又打出一张牌。“尤其不能在她努力工作的时候问！”她咯咯笑着，为你发牌。“不如这样，
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ears perk up halfway before slumping down. “Oh-ho,” Roo hums, flicking out cards at indiscernible speeds. “Well, this girl’s got a lotta secrets. Not the kind you go telling anyone who just asks,” she winks; out goes another card. “Certainly not when she’s working hard!” She giggles, dealing your hand. “How about this, "

rows.translation: ，每当你连胜时，我就告诉你一件事！成交？”
rows.raw: ", I’ll tell ‘ya something whenever you’re on a streak! Deal?”"

rows.original: Deal.
rows.translation: 成交。
rows.raw: "\n\nDeal."

rows.original: “That’s all the time for now, though!”
rows.translation: “不过这次聊天时间到此为止！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s all the time for now, though!”"

rows.original: Aw what?
rows.translation: 啊，什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nAw what?"

rows.original: “The game awaits, [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: “游戏在等着呢，[pc.name]！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The game awaits, [pc.name]!”"

rows.original: So it does...
rows.translation: 的确如此...
rows.raw: "\n\nSo it does..."

rows.original: You ask your bubbly dealer for another Roo-mination. Roo’s ears flop upwards and a wide grin breaks her mask; a yelp slips up her throat and she snickers uncontrollably.
rows.translation: 你请活泼的荷官再来一段露之沉思。露的耳朵向上弹起，灿烂笑容冲破面具；她喉间逸出尖叫，无法自控地窃笑。
rows.raw: "You ask your bubbly dealer for another Roo-mination. Roo’s ears flop upwards and a wide grin breaks her mask; a yelp slips up her throat and she snickers uncontrollably."

rows.original: “D’aw, sure!” she stammers through her chuckling.
rows.translation: “啊，当然！”她在轻笑中结巴着说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“D’aw, sure!” she stammers through her chuckling."

rows.original: “A lotta people ask about my ears, and the answer’s not the most exciting,” she simpers, “my boss - and he’s the best! - really liked the idea when I asked to get ‘em! Saw him watching an old story. There’s something that terrans really liked, or like really, about cuties with bunny ears. Says it gives a place a’ business a reeeaal...” she finishes dealing, “...hoppy feeling!”
rows.translation: “很多人都问我的耳朵，答案却没那么有趣。”她傻笑着说，“我的老板，他是最棒的！我问能不能装上它们时，他特别喜欢这个主意！当时看到他在看一个老故事。泰拉人过去很喜欢，或者现在也很喜欢兔耳朵的可爱姑娘。他说这样会让一个地方，一家店，变得真的很...”她发完牌，“...有跳跃感！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A lotta people ask about my ears, and the answer’s not the most exciting,” she simpers, “my boss - and he’s the best! - really liked the idea when I asked to get ‘em! Saw him watching an old story. There’s something that terrans really liked, or like really, about cuties with bunny ears. Says it gives a place a’ business a reeeaal...” she finishes dealing, “...hoppy feeling!”"

rows.original: You sigh, and she wags a finger. “Hehe, I’m a little spoiled. Let’s play, now!”
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，她摇摇手指。“嘿嘿，我有点被宠坏了。现在玩牌吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh, and she wags a finger. “Hehe, I’m a little spoiled. Let’s play, now!”"

rows.original: Back to the game then.
rows.translation: 那就回到游戏。
rows.raw: "\n\nBack to the game then."

rows.original: For a second, her smile turns lopsided, face lost in thought. It rights itself when she speaks. “Here’s something, I actually have two siblings! Now I won’t go giving names, but if you ever see my face with green eyes...” She pauses to make a silly gesture, sticking her tongue out in a playful manner. “...you probably just met my sister. If you ask me, she’s nowhere near as fun as I!”
rows.translation: 有那么一瞬，她的笑容歪向一边，神情陷入沉思。开口时又恢复正常。“告诉你一件事，其实我有两个兄弟姐妹！我不会透露名字，但如果你看到一张和我一样、却长着绿眼睛的脸...”她停下来做了个滑稽手势，顽皮地吐出舌头。“...那你可能刚遇到我姐姐。要我说，她可远不如我有趣！”
rows.raw: "\n\nFor a second, her smile turns lopsided, face lost in thought. It rights itself when she speaks. “Here’s something, I actually have two siblings! Now I won’t go giving names, but if you ever see my face with green eyes...” She pauses to make a silly gesture, sticking her tongue out in a playful manner. “...you probably just met my sister. If you ask me, she’s nowhere near as fun as I!”"

rows.original: “Anyway!” She sets her deck down. “Let’s keep going!”
rows.translation: “总之！”她放下牌堆。“我们继续！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway!” She sets her deck down. “Let’s keep going!”"

rows.original: “Mmm,” Roo hums, casually working her wrists. She stops to inspect you for no more than two seconds, tilting her head and finishing the job. “I gotta say, I can’t quite tell what your preference is! See, everyone’s got their own likes and dislikes, and you can sometimes tell by a little look in their eye. The kinda people I prefer...” She pats the deck, “I like guys that look at me, and I like girls that get... really wet,” she smiles, chewing her lower lip to stifle a laugh.
rows.translation: “嗯。”露哼着，随意活动手腕。她停下来打量你，不超过两秒，歪歪头便完成工作。“我得说，我不太能看出你喜欢哪一种！你看，每个人都有自己的好恶，有时从眼神就能看出来。我喜欢的那种人...”她拍了拍牌堆，“我喜欢看着我的男人，也喜欢会变得... 特别湿的女人。”她咬住下唇忍笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm,” Roo hums, casually working her wrists. She stops to inspect you for no more than two seconds, tilting her head and finishing the job. “I gotta say, I can’t quite tell what your preference is! See, everyone’s got their own likes and dislikes, and you can sometimes tell by a little look in their eye. The kinda people I prefer...” She pats the deck, “I like guys that look at me, and I like girls that get... really wet,” she smiles, chewing her lower lip to stifle a laugh."

rows.original: You would ask her to go into more detail, but the game calls.
rows.translation: 你本想让她说得更详细，可游戏在召唤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou would ask her to go into more detail, but the game calls."

rows.original: “The best thing to eat, in my opinion... are cookies!” The impish expression she wears nearly drags you into silly laughter. “Aw, but I’m serious! You might not think it, but we’ve got an awesome kitchen and an incredible team! When my day’s over, there’s really nothing better than falling into bed with chocolate melting in my mouth...”
rows.translation: “在我看来，最好吃的东西... 是饼干！”她淘气的表情差点让你傻笑起来。“啊，但我是认真的！你也许想不到，我们有很棒的厨房和难以置信的团队！一天结束后，没有什么比倒在床上、嘴里含着融化的巧克力更美好了...”
rows.raw: "“The best thing to eat, in my opinion... are cookies!” The impish expression she wears nearly drags you into silly laughter. “Aw, but I’m serious! You might not think it, but we’ve got an awesome kitchen and an incredible team! When my day’s over, there’s really nothing better than falling into bed with chocolate melting in my mouth...”"

rows.original: For a second, Roo stares out into the casino, vacant eyed with confectionery awe. “I shouldn’t have said that, I want another sooo bad!” A shake of the head and she’s back to the game. “I’m jus’ a simple girl with simple wants. Also, I don’t like carrots!”
rows.translation: 有那么一瞬，露双眼失神地望着赌场，眼中满是对甜点的敬畏。“我不该说这个，现在特别想再吃一块！”她摇摇头，回到游戏。“我只是个愿望简单的普通姑娘。另外，我不喜欢胡萝卜！”
rows.raw: "\n\nFor a second, Roo stares out into the casino, vacant eyed with confectionery awe. “I shouldn’t have said that, I want another sooo bad!” A shake of the head and she’s back to the game. “I’m jus’ a simple girl with simple wants. Also, I don’t like carrots!”"

rows.original: “One of my favorite things,” Roo start, ears twitching in thought, “...is, hmm, how to put this...” She sets the deck down, pausing the game in a rare show. “To me, it doesn’t matter who looks at me. Long as they like what they see, and I’ve yet to meet someone who doesn’t!” Her dealing resumes, and she beams, “See, I like knowing that what I’m doin’ is having an effect, this is the best job I’ve ever had!”
rows.translation: “我最喜欢的事情之一，”露开口，耳朵在思考中抽动，“...是，嗯，该怎么说...”她放下牌堆，罕见地暂停游戏。“对我来说，谁看我都无所谓。只要他们喜欢看到的东西就行，而我还没遇见不喜欢的人！”她重新发牌，喜笑颜开。“你看，我喜欢知道自己做的事确实有效果，这是我做过最棒的工作！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of my favorite things,” Roo start, ears twitching in thought, “...is, hmm, how to put this...” She sets the deck down, pausing the game in a rare show. “To me, it doesn’t matter who looks at me. Long as they like what they see, and I’ve yet to meet someone who doesn’t!” Her dealing resumes, and she beams, “See, I like knowing that what I’m doin’ is having an effect, this is the best job I’ve ever had!”"

rows.original: She shrugs her shoulders, bouncing her boobs in the process, clearly enjoying the light smile you give.
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩，也让乳房随之弹动，显然很享受你露出的浅笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs her shoulders, bouncing her boobs in the process, clearly enjoying the light smile you give."

rows.original: Roo doesn’t spend too long talking this time, instead offering up a bunch of random details about herself, such as her measurements, that she used to be a little overweight, and how on her first week of dealing cards she somehow broke the table and later caused a brawl. In her words they weren’t the halcyon days.
rows.translation: 这次露没有聊太久，只提供了一堆关于自己的随机细节，例如三围、以前有点超重，以及发牌第一周不知怎么弄坏桌子，后来还引发一场斗殴。用她的话说，那可不是什么黄金岁月。
rows.raw: "\n\nRoo doesn’t spend too long talking this time, instead offering up a bunch of random details about herself, such as her measurements, that she used to be a little overweight, and how on her first week of dealing cards she somehow broke the table and later caused a brawl. In her words they weren’t the halcyon days."

rows.original: What sticks with you the most are when she lets slip the tiniest details about her personality, how she reacted to what she was doing - willfully, responsibly. Unfortunately, you can’t get her to tell you anything more personal.
rows.translation: 最令你印象深刻的是她偶然泄露的细微性格，以及她如何主动、负责地对待自己的行为。可惜你无法让她说出更私人的事情。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat sticks with you the most are when she lets slip the tiniest details about her personality, how she reacted to what she was doing - willfully, responsibly. Unfortunately, you can’t get her to tell you anything more personal."

rows.original: “You look great doing this job ‘ya know!” you bat your eyes, “so how’d you get it? How’d you get so good at looking cute while doing it?”
rows.translation: “你做这份工作的时候看起来很棒！”你眨着眼，“所以是怎么得到这份工作的？又是怎么做到工作时还这么可爱？”
rows.raw: "“You look great doing this job ‘ya know!” you bat your eyes, “so how’d you get it? How’d you get so good at looking cute while doing it?”"

rows.original: “I can only answer half that question reasonably, you know!” she laughs.
rows.translation: “你知道，我只能合理回答一半的问题！”她笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can only answer half that question reasonably, you know!” she laughs."

rows.original: You fold your arms, asking, “What got you doing this? There’s gotta be something better for a beautiful woman like you.”
rows.translation: 你抱起双臂问：“是什么让你做这份工作？像你这么美的女人一定有更好的选择。”
rows.raw: "You fold your arms, asking, “What got you doing this? There’s gotta be something better for a beautiful woman like you.”"

rows.original: “Aww! True, there may be, but!” She bobs her head once.
rows.translation: “啊！确实，也许有，但是！”她点了一下头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aww! True, there may be, but!” She bobs her head once."

rows.original: “You seem capable of more than dealing cards,” you start politely, “why be a dealer?”
rows.translation: “你看起来不只会发牌。”你礼貌地开口，“为什么要当荷官？”
rows.raw: "“You seem capable of more than dealing cards,” you start politely, “why be a dealer?”"

rows.original: The kaithrit giggles. “Oh, there’s a few things.”
rows.translation: 凯斯里特咯咯直笑。“哦，原因有几个。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kaithrit giggles. “Oh, there’s a few things.”"

rows.original: “Someone with hands like yours, surely there’s something more suitable for a cute, efficient cat like yourself?” you ask.
rows.translation: “有你这样一双手，肯定有更适合你这种可爱又高效猫咪的工作吧？”你问。
rows.raw: "“Someone with hands like yours, surely there’s something more suitable for a cute, efficient cat like yourself?” you ask."

rows.original: “Perhaps,” she winks.
rows.translation: “也许吧。”她眨眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perhaps,” she winks."

rows.original: “Dealing cards must be a step down from what you could be doing,” you say out loud, and she shakes her head.
rows.translation: “发牌肯定比你能做的其他工作低一等。”你大声说，她摇摇头。
rows.raw: "“Dealing cards must be a step down from what you could be doing,” you say out loud, and she shakes her head."

rows.original: “Not so,” she fires back.
rows.translation: “并非如此。”她反驳道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not so,” she fires back."

rows.original: “Luck’s an interesting thing. It has a way of equalizing any contest. Nobody’s a sure winner, everyone’s always thinking, second guessing. The shrewd are as vulnerable as the fools.” Her tongue slicks across her lips. “Not my words, so don’t go quoting me!” She fans out the next card, then the next. “It’s probably weird to say, but I really like seeing how lucky or unlucky someone can be, seeing what they feel, what their faces look like, all when their next hand could break their bank or enrich it.”
rows.translation: “运气是个有趣的东西，它能让任何比赛趋于平等。没人稳操胜券，每个人总在思考、重新猜测。精明人和傻瓜一样脆弱。”她用舌头舔过嘴唇。“不是我说的话，所以别到处引用！”她扇出下一张牌，然后又一张。“也许这么说很奇怪，但我真的喜欢看一个人能有多幸运或倒霉，看他们的感受和表情，而下一手牌可能让他们破产，也可能让他们发财。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Luck’s an interesting thing. It has a way of equalizing any contest. Nobody’s a sure winner, everyone’s always thinking, second guessing. The shrewd are as vulnerable as the fools.” Her tongue slicks across her lips. “Not my words, so don’t go quoting me!” She fans out the next card, then the next. “It’s probably weird to say, but I really like seeing how lucky or unlucky someone can be, seeing what they feel, what their faces look like, all when their next hand could break their bank or enrich it.”"

rows.original: Her motions flag for a microsecond. “Watching stony faced people plan so hard, then getting to see if it pans out! I see hundreds, maybe thousands of people a day applying their experiences, learning just a bit about them from the way they play... the way they decide on the next action...”
rows.translation: 她的动作停滞了一刹那。“看那些面无表情的人那么努力计划，然后看看是否奏效！每天我都会看到几百、也许几千个人运用自己的经验，从他们打牌的方式了解一点他们的事情... 看他们如何决定下一步行动...”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer motions flag for a microsecond. “Watching stony faced people plan so hard, then getting to see if it pans out! I see hundreds, maybe thousands of people a day applying their experiences, learning just a bit about them from the way they play... the way they decide on the next action...”"

rows.original: Cards placed, she gives you a briefly timid look. “That, and other things... oh, I think I’m where I want to be for as long as possible.”
rows.translation: 放下牌后，她短暂而羞怯地看你一眼。“那些，还有别的事... 哦，我想自己会尽可能久地待在想待的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCards placed, she gives you a briefly timid look. “That, and other things... oh, I think I’m where I want to be for as long as possible.”"

rows.original: That’s it?
rows.translation: 就这些？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s it?"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: “This place sure is pretty,” you muse, eyelashes fluttering. “But not as pretty as you! What’s it like, how’d you get here?”
rows.translation: “这里真漂亮。”你睫毛轻颤着感叹。“但没你漂亮！这里是什么样的，你又怎么来到这里？”
rows.raw: "“This place sure is pretty,” you muse, eyelashes fluttering. “But not as pretty as you! What’s it like, how’d you get here?”"

rows.original: “Tell me about this casino, how you ended up being one of its stars,” you gesture meaningfully.
rows.translation: “说说这家赌场吧，还有你是怎么成为这里的明星之一的。”你意味深长地比划。
rows.raw: "“Tell me about this casino, how you ended up being one of its stars,” you gesture meaningfully."

rows.original: “What got you working in a place like this? Tell me about this casino,” you prompt.
rows.translation: “是什么让你来这种地方工作？和我说说这家赌场。”你提示道。
rows.raw: "“What got you working in a place like this? Tell me about this casino,” you prompt."

rows.original: “What’s the skinny on this place? You’re like the gem in its crown, after all.” You give her a silly wink. “What put you there?”
rows.translation: “这地方有什么内幕？毕竟你就像王冠上的宝石。”你傻傻眨眼。“是什么把你放到这个位置的？”
rows.raw: "“What’s the skinny on this place? You’re like the gem in its crown, after all.” You give her a silly wink. “What put you there?”"

rows.original: “What should I watch out for around here? You must have been here a while.”
rows.translation: “我在这里该提防什么？你肯定已经待很久了。”
rows.raw: "“What should I watch out for around here? You must have been here a while.”"

rows.original: “It’s the best!” Roo nearly shouts. Her tone tells you that she isn’t making that claim under duress. “Games of chance have a way of bringing so many people together, even if it’s not usually for niceties. Our boss is the most amazing guy, too! He’s great at handling rowdy folks. Also, we’re the most reputable casino you’ll ever find outside the U.G.C, and not even those nasty Black Void types can say that!”
rows.translation: “这里最棒了！”露几乎喊了出来。她的语气说明这话不是受胁迫才说的。“机会游戏能把这么多人聚在一起，哪怕通常不是为了友好相处。我们的老板也是最了不起的人！他非常善于应付闹事的人。而且我们是银河联合邦联境外最信誉卓著的赌场，就连那些讨厌的黑色虚空分子也不敢这么说！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s the best!” Roo nearly shouts. Her tone tells you that she isn’t making that claim under duress. “Games of chance have a way of bringing so many people together, even if it’s not usually for niceties. Our boss is the most amazing guy, too! He’s great at handling rowdy folks. Also, we’re the most reputable casino you’ll ever find outside the U.G.C, and not even those nasty Black Void types can say that!”"

rows.original: She throws out the first cards. “It must be really hard to believe. Even I didn’t at first. But we’ve got the best food, and the best staff! Strictly speaking, most of our players leave with a little more. Not everyone can experience a windfall, Lady Luck being the fickle entity she is, but that’s why we offer more than just games. There’s a little something for everyone here, always a chance to make connections, and plenty to learn!”
rows.translation: 她发出第一批牌。“这一定很难相信，我最初也不相信。但我们有最好的食物和最好的员工！严格来说，大多数玩家离开时都会比来时多拥有一点。幸运女神反复无常，不是每个人都能发横财，但这就是我们不只提供赌博的原因。这里每个人都能找到一些东西，总有建立关系的机会，还有很多可以学习的事！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe throws out the first cards. “It must be really hard to believe. Even I didn’t at first. But we’ve got the best food, and the best staff! Strictly speaking, most of our players leave with a little more. Not everyone can experience a windfall, Lady Luck being the fickle entity she is, but that’s why we offer more than just games. There’s a little something for everyone here, always a chance to make connections, and plenty to learn!”"

rows.original: Roo gives herself one card, and suddenly squirms. “Oh, and we have the best drink in the galaxy. Nobody else could ever copy it. Our signature and most expensive beverage, reserved for only top earners, VIPs and staff alike: the Ruby Tether! It is, oh, [pc.name],” her balled fists wave wildly, “if the heavens of old religions exist in this universe, if it lies beyond the celestial ether at its unknowable edges, then what we provide is a taste of divinity!” She speaks with a conviction that nobody could diplomatically criticize.
rows.translation: 露给自己发了一张牌，突然扭动起来。“哦，我们还有银河最棒的饮料，其他人绝对复制不了。我们的招牌，也是最昂贵的饮品，只留给收入最高的人、贵宾和员工：红宝系带！它，哦，[pc.name]，”她紧握的拳头疯狂挥动，“如果古老宗教的天堂存在于这个宇宙，如果它位于无法知晓的天界以太边缘之外，那么我们提供的就是神性的滋味！”她语气坚定，让人无法委婉地批评。
rows.raw: "\n\nRoo gives herself one card, and suddenly squirms. “Oh, and we have the best drink in the galaxy. Nobody else could ever copy it. Our signature and most expensive beverage, reserved for only top earners, VIPs and staff alike: the Ruby Tether! It is, oh, [pc.name],” her balled fists wave wildly, “if the heavens of old religions exist in this universe, if it lies beyond the celestial ether at its unknowable edges, then what we provide is a taste of divinity!” She speaks with a conviction that nobody could diplomatically criticize. "

rows.original: “But you know that already! And I bet you can’t wait to have it again, right?”
rows.translation: “不过你已经知道了！我敢说你等不及想再喝一次，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“But you know that already! And I bet you can’t wait to have it again, right?”"

rows.original: “A single drop would prove it. I hope you will earn a taste of our finest treasure soon.”
rows.translation: “一滴就足以证明。希望你很快就能赢得品尝我们最珍贵宝藏的资格。”
rows.raw: "“A single drop would prove it. I hope you will earn a taste of our finest treasure soon.”"

rows.original: Well, you wouldn’t mind, but you note that she did ignore your question. The game is set, however, so you’ll have to earn another opportunity to ask.
rows.translation: 嗯，你并不介意，但注意到她确实忽略了你的问题。不过牌局已经摆好，你得再赢一次提问机会。
rows.raw: "Well, you wouldn’t mind, but you note that she did ignore your question. The game is set, however, so you’ll have to earn another opportunity to ask."

rows.original: No matter how vehemently she describes it, what you tasted can’t be praised enough.
rows.translation: 不管她说得多么激烈，你尝过的东西都怎么称赞也不为过。
rows.raw: "No matter how vehemently she describes it, what you tasted can’t be praised enough."

rows.original: Sure, but you can’t help but realize she dodged your question.
rows.translation: 当然，可你忍不住意识到她回避了问题。
rows.raw: "Sure, but you can’t help but realize she dodged your question."

rows.original: Unfortunately, the game is set, and you’ll have to earn another opportunity.
rows.translation: 可惜牌局已摆好，你得再赢一次提问机会。
rows.raw: " Unfortunately, the game is set, and you’ll have to earn another opportunity."

rows.original: Roo neglected to answer you the first time. A conscientious woman like her doesn’t make that kind of mistake easy, so you ask her again: how did she become an employee of the casino?
rows.translation: 露第一次没有回答。像她这么尽责的女人不会轻易犯这种错误，于是你再次询问：她是怎么成为赌场员工的？
rows.raw: "Roo neglected to answer you the first time. A conscientious woman like her doesn’t make that kind of mistake easy, so you ask her again: how did she become an employee of the casino?"

rows.original: Pressing the matter dims her face ever so slightly, something you were beginning to think was impossible.
rows.translation: 继续追问让她的脸色略微黯淡，你此前都快认为这是不可能的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nPressing the matter dims her face ever so slightly, something you were beginning to think was impossible."

rows.original: “Not on the best terms.” She shakes her head and hits the table. “No, no, that’s not what I said. Let’s... [pc.name],” Roo smiles, raising one fuzzy finger, speaking in an uncompromising tone, “not everyone has the freedom to choose what they do. And that’s alright! It’s what you make of your situation, never about what gets you there.”
rows.translation: “不是在最好的情况下。”她摇摇头，拍了一下桌面。“不，不，我不是这么说的。我们... [pc.name]，”露微笑着竖起一根毛茸茸手指，用不容妥协的语气说道，“不是每个人都有选择自己做什么的自由。这没关系！重要的是你如何应对处境，而不是如何落入其中。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not on the best terms.” She shakes her head and hits the table. “No, no, that’s not what I said. Let’s... [pc.name],” Roo smiles, raising one fuzzy finger, speaking in an uncompromising tone, “not everyone has the freedom to choose what they do. And that’s alright! It’s what you make of your situation, never about what gets you there.”"

rows.original: For a second you consider responding, but that answer is likely the best one you’ll get, and so you let the matter go. You can see when the questioning is going too far.
rows.translation: 你一度考虑回应，但这大概是能得到的最好答案，于是放过这个话题。你看得出什么时候已经追问得太过头。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor a second you consider responding, but that answer is likely the best one you’ll get, and so you let the matter go. You can see when the questioning is going too far."

rows.original: ROO_NOVA_TALK
rows.raw: "ROO_NOVA_TALK"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: “What’s the boss like around here? Looks like everyone’s treated right!”
rows.translation: “这里的老板是什么样？看来每个人都受到公正对待！”
rows.raw: "“What’s the boss like around here? Looks like everyone’s treated right!”"

rows.original: “You have a high opinion of your boss. Hopefully he does for everyone under him.”
rows.translation: “你对老板评价很高。希望他对手下每个人都同样好。”
rows.raw: "“You have a high opinion of your boss. Hopefully he does for everyone under him.”"

rows.original: “Who runs this place, what’s he like? I can tell you have more than a little respect.”
rows.translation: “谁在经营这里，他是什么样的人？看得出你对他非常尊敬。”
rows.raw: "“Who runs this place, what’s he like? I can tell you have more than a little respect.”"

rows.original: “Shame you told me about your boss, I was getting used to thinking you were the most important person here. What’s your opinion?”
rows.translation: “真可惜你提到了老板，我都习惯把你当成这里最重要的人了。你怎么看他？”
rows.raw: "“Shame you told me about your boss, I was getting used to thinking you were the most important person here. What’s your opinion?”"

rows.original: “You said ‘boss’, so, only one person runs the place?”
rows.translation: “你说的是‘老板’，所以这里只由一个人经营？”
rows.raw: "“You said ‘boss’, so, only one person runs the place?”"

rows.original: “Ahh, I can’t give you his name. You probably won’t ever see him either,” she muses with a hint of sadness. “He’s an extremely busy guy, but trust me when I say, [pc.name], I’ve never met anyone who has their head on so right! He... I swear, he sees and hears things before they’ve even happened, that’s the only way I can describe it. He’s amazingly smart, and he’s not a jerk either! That’s why this place runs so smoothly, he doesn’t hire just anyone!”
rows.translation: “啊，我不能告诉你他的名字。你大概也永远见不到他。”她略带伤感地思索。“他忙得要命，但相信我，[pc.name]，我从没遇过头脑这么清醒的人！他... 我发誓，他能在事情发生前就看到、听到它们，我只能这么形容。他聪明得惊人，而且也不是个混蛋！这里正因为他才运转得如此顺畅，他可不是什么人都雇！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh, I can’t give you his name. You probably won’t ever see him either,” she muses with a hint of sadness. “He’s an extremely busy guy, but trust me when I say, [pc.name], I’ve never met anyone who has their head on so right! He... I swear, he sees and hears things before they’ve even happened, that’s the only way I can describe it. He’s amazingly smart, and he’s not a jerk either! That’s why this place runs so smoothly, he doesn’t hire just anyone!”"

rows.original: You can see that in her.
rows.translation: 从她身上确实看得出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see that in her."

rows.original: “Hehe, I don’t get to meet him often. He shows up once or twice a month, since this isn’t our only casino.” The last cards are shunted. “Gets a little lonely without him. Has a way of just lighting up the places he goes. Now!” She claps her hands together, “Let’s continue.”
rows.translation: “嘿嘿，我也不常见到他。他每月只来一两次，因为这不是我们唯一的赌场。”最后几张牌被推出来。“他不在时会有点寂寞。他总能点亮自己去的地方。好了！”她拍起双手，“我们继续。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hehe, I don’t get to meet him often. He shows up once or twice a month, since this isn’t our only casino.” The last cards are shunted. “Gets a little lonely without him. Has a way of just lighting up the places he goes. Now!” She claps her hands together, “Let’s continue.”"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: You’ve seen it enough times to see that Roo enjoys stripping down,
rows.translation: 你已经见过足够多次，知道露很享受脱衣服，
rows.raw: "You’ve seen it enough times to see that Roo enjoys stripping down, "

rows.original: but the reason isn’t very clear.
rows.translation: 但原因并不十分明确。
rows.raw: "but the reason isn’t very clear."

rows.original: and you want a quick reminder of why.
rows.translation: 而你想快速回忆一下原因。
rows.raw: "and you want a quick reminder of why."

rows.original: “You don’t get undressed just ‘cause it’s the job, right? Not complaining! Just noticed you getting more into it, s’all!”
rows.translation: “你脱衣服不只是因为这是工作，对吧？我可不是抱怨！只是注意到你越来越投入，就这样！”
rows.raw: "“You don’t get undressed just ‘cause it’s the job, right? Not complaining! Just noticed you getting more into it, s’all!”"

rows.original: “You get really into it when you strip down. Do you like me that much?”
rows.translation: “你脱衣时真的很投入。你有这么喜欢我吗？”
rows.raw: "“You get really into it when you strip down. Do you like me that much?”"

rows.original: “Something tells me you’re not stripping because you’re obligated. Do you enjoy it that much?”
rows.translation: “有件事告诉我，你脱衣不是因为义务。你真的这么享受吗？”
rows.raw: "“Something tells me you’re not stripping because you’re obligated. Do you enjoy it that much?”"

rows.original: “Now don’t get me wrong, seeing a cute kitty-rabbit like you putting on a show is worth everything, but why exactly? There’s more going on there than obligation.”
rows.translation: “别误会，看你这种可爱的猫兔表演值得付出一切，但到底为什么？这里面不只是义务。”
rows.raw: "“Now don’t get me wrong, seeing a cute kitty-rabbit like you putting on a show is worth everything, but why exactly? There’s more going on there than obligation.”"

rows.original: “You seem to have a thing for putting on a show, but why do you put that much into it for me?”
rows.translation: “看来你特别喜欢表演，可为什么愿意为我投入这么多？”
rows.raw: "“You seem to have a thing for putting on a show, but why do you put that much into it for me?”"

rows.original: An eye-lining blush blossoms across her face and she rapidly doles out the rest of the cards. “The way I look at it, [pc.name]... I’m just a silly girl working in a casino, and I’ve been doing it for a super long time. Just dealing cards would be boring, plus it’s sometimes a little sad not being able to go on vacation, if you catch my drift.”
rows.translation: 如眼线般的红晕在她脸上绽放，她飞快发完剩下的牌。“我是这样看的，[pc.name]... 我只是个在赌场工作的傻姑娘，而且已经做了特别久。只是发牌会很无聊，再说，如果你明白我的暗示，没法去度假有时也会让人有点难过。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAn eye-lining blush blossoms across her face and she rapidly doles out the rest of the cards. “The way I look at it, [pc.name]... I’m just a silly girl working in a casino, and I’ve been doing it for a super long time. Just dealing cards would be boring, plus it’s sometimes a little sad not being able to go on vacation, if you catch my drift.”"

rows.original: Her posture straightens and her tails weave in a pattern behind her chair. “There’s one thing that makes my days better, makes it all worth it, and that’s knowing for any amount of time what I can mean to someone else. Does that make sense?”
rows.translation: 她挺直身姿，双尾在椅后交织出图案。“有一件事能让我的日子更好，让一切变得值得，那就是哪怕只持续片刻，也能知道自己对另一个人意味着什么。这说得通吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer posture straightens and her tails weave in a pattern behind her chair. “There’s one thing that makes my days better, makes it all worth it, and that’s knowing for any amount of time what I can mean to someone else. Does that make sense?”"

rows.original: Your reaction simply makes her laugh. “There’re very few people who don’t like seeing a naked girl, who wouldn’t appreciate her body!” She pokes one of her breasts, and her finger is swallowed to the second joint. “Part of me really likes being a prize for someone, and nobody else has risen to the occasion quite like you.”
rows.translation: 你的反应只让她笑了。“很少有人不喜欢看裸体女孩，也很少有人不欣赏她的身体！”她戳了一下自己的乳房，手指陷到第二个指节。“我的一部分真的很喜欢成为某个人的奖品，而其他人没有谁像你这样不负期待。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour reaction simply makes her laugh. “There’re very few people who don’t like seeing a naked girl, who wouldn’t appreciate her body!” She pokes one of her breasts, and her finger is swallowed to the second joint. “Part of me really likes being a prize for someone, and nobody else has risen to the occasion quite like you.”"

rows.original: In that sentence you identified with a hint of melancholy. Dispelling it, she winks. “There’s nothin’ special about it.” Roo exhales quietly, and shrugs her shoulders. “Let’s see where your luck stands this time, sweetie!”
rows.translation: 你从那句话中听出一丝忧郁。她眨眨眼，将其驱散。“没什么特别的。”露轻轻呼气，耸了耸肩。“看看这次你的运气如何吧，甜心！”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn that sentence you identified with a hint of melancholy. Dispelling it, she winks. “There’s nothin’ special about it.” Roo exhales quietly, and shrugs her shoulders. “Let’s see where your luck stands this time, sweetie!”"

rows.original: Eventually, you both find yourself on the bridge of the ship. The laquine gives an odd salute to the captain, but nobody regards you with much interest as they banter back and forth on matters unimportant to you. It makes you feel worried just being here, it’s clearly an important place. You walk down the ramp to the panels and other sensitive electronics that manage the ship and all its functions, a giant window giving sight to the infinite space beyond. rows.translation: 艰苦的日子变成痛苦折磨的数周。没人告诉你，也没有任何迹象说明过去了多久；迷乱大脑每天劳作时只知道自己必须完成工作... 然后服侍[enemy.furColor]毛皮的女主人。没有纵欲跳帮者的气味逼迫你做清醒淫梦，你便无法入睡。吃饭、休息或只是等待时，都无法逃离她对你的影响。
rows.raw: "The arduous days turn to bitter, torturous weeks. You aren’t told or given any indication of how much time has passed, but all your bewildered brain is aware of on the daily grind is that you are to do your job... and then service your [enemy.furColor]-furred mistress. You don’t go to sleep without the smell of oversexed jumper forcing lucid, smutty dreams on you. When you eat, when you rest, when you merely wait, there is no escaping the effect she has on you."

rows.original: Even to this day, you aren’t sure if you like it, and that only gets you more turned on somehow.
rows.translation: 直到今天，你仍不确定自己是否喜欢，而这不知为何只会令你更兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven to this day, you aren’t sure if you like it, and that only gets you more turned on somehow."

rows.original: You’ve fallen in with the crowd, and you line up as is your given task. The gates to the pen open, but rather than be led like a chain gang to the mines, you’re faced with many new, unrecognizable, and perturbing figures. Frightening figures. Pirates you’ve never seen before, not part of Zhèng Shi’s operations, are there, and many more armed for subdual tower behind them. A new voice comes over the raspy loudspeaker. “Your work here’s over, rabble. You’re being moved on to greener pastures. Thanks for everything,” the girlish voice snickers at the end before it clicks off with an ear-scraping whistle.
rows.translation: 你已经融入人群，按分配的任务排队。囚栏大门打开，可你们没像锁链帮般被带去矿井，而是面对许多陌生、无法辨认、令人不安的身影。可怕的身影。那里站着你从未见过、不属于郑石行动的海盗，身后还有更多手持制服武器的高大身影。沙哑扩音器传来新的声音。“你们在这里的工作结束了，乌合之众。现在要把你们送去更肥沃的牧场。感谢各位付出，”少女般的声音最后窃笑起来，接着在刺耳啸叫中断线。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve fallen in with the crowd, and you line up as is your given task. The gates to the pen open, but rather than be led like a chain gang to the mines, you’re faced with many new, unrecognizable, and perturbing figures. Frightening figures. Pirates you’ve never seen before, not part of Zhèng Shi’s operations, are there, and many more armed for subdual tower behind them. A new voice comes over the raspy loudspeaker. “Your work here’s over, rabble. You’re being moved on to greener pastures. Thanks for everything,” the girlish voice snickers at the end before it clicks off with an ear-scraping whistle."

rows.original: All of the slaves before you are being rounded up in groups and caged, being taken elsewhere to continue their servitude. Staying in the back only delays the inevitable. The jumper who’s used you since the beginning comes to find you personally. She takes one last wistful whiff of you and shrugs her shoulders. “I’m not interested in keeping you, cutie, I don’t need the baggage. But you’ll do fine wherever it is you’re going. I will miss your mouth, that’s for sure...”
rows.translation: 你前面的奴隶全被分组围拢、关进笼子，带往别处继续服役。留在后方只会推迟不可避免的结局。从一开始便使用你的跳帮者亲自来找你。她最后依依不舍地闻了闻你，耸耸肩。“我没兴趣留着你，小可爱，不需要这个包袱。不过不管要去哪里，你都会过得不错。我肯定会怀念你的嘴...”
rows.raw: "\n\nAll of the slaves before you are being rounded up in groups and caged, being taken elsewhere to continue their servitude. Staying in the back only delays the inevitable. The jumper who’s used you since the beginning comes to find you personally. She takes one last wistful whiff of you and shrugs her shoulders. “I’m not interested in keeping you, cutie, I don’t need the baggage. But you’ll do fine wherever it is you’re going. I will miss your mouth, that’s for sure...”"

rows.original: She gives you a condescending pat on the head and trots off, her plump hips and floppy ears vanishing into the anarchic crowd. You don’t have time to even take all of this in before two bruisers approach you menacingly, crackling prods sizzling in their hands. They strike you on either shoulder and you fall instantly in a midden heap, already robbed of your senses.
rows.translation: 她居高临下地拍了拍你的头，随后小跑离开，丰满髋部和耷拉长耳消失在混乱人群中。你甚至没时间消化这一切，两个壮汉便气势汹汹地逼近，手中电棍噼啪作响。他们分别击中你两侧肩膀，你立刻倒进污秽的一堆，感官已被夺走。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a condescending pat on the head and trots off, her plump hips and floppy ears vanishing into the anarchic crowd. You don’t have time to even take all of this in before two bruisers approach you menacingly, crackling prods sizzling in their hands. They strike you on either shoulder and you fall instantly in a midden heap, already robbed of your senses."

rows.original: Before you completely black out, you hold on to one final thought: The memory of your old life. A memory that will soon be as distant as the field of stars you once traversed in search of your father’s legacy.
rows.translation: 彻底昏迷前，你紧抓最后一个念头：昔日生活的记忆。这段记忆很快会像你曾为寻找父亲遗产而穿越的星海那样遥远。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you completely black out, you hold on to one final thought: The memory of your old life. A memory that will soon be as distant as the field of stars you once traversed in search of your father’s legacy."

rows.original: Wherever you’re going, your new owners will see to it that you are thoroughly broken...
rows.translation: 无论将去往哪里，新主人都会确保你被彻底驯服...
rows.raw: "\n\nWherever you’re going, your new owners will see to it that you are thoroughly broken..."

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: You stagger awake with a gasp. Surprisingly, you have a clear mind but not clear sight. Chill nips at your [pc.skinFurScales] as you look around to find two faint bars of light on the slits of a door. You hurry over and look out but can’t find any way to open it. You curse and pound at your prison, trying to digest your predicament.
rows.translation: 你喘息着摇晃醒来。令人惊讶的是，头脑清醒，视线却不清晰。寒意啃咬[pc.skinFurScales]；环顾四周时，你发现门缝透进两道微弱光条。你赶过去向外看，却找不到开门方法。你咒骂着捶打牢笼，试图消化自己的处境。
rows.raw: "You stagger awake with a gasp. Surprisingly, you have a clear mind but not clear sight. Chill nips at your [pc.skinFurScales] as you look around to find two faint bars of light on the slits of a door. You hurry over and look out but can’t find any way to open it. You curse and pound at your prison, trying to digest your predicament."

rows.original: A heavy rattling followed by an electronic DING signals the sliding of the door. You shield your [pc.eyes] from the bright glare, but adjust quick enough to see a laquine standing there with a hand on her hip. She twirls a pair of grav cuffs around her finger and says, “Sorry cutie, procedure on board. Put ‘em on or you’re gonna have to stay here. And that’d make someone very mad.”
rows.translation: 一阵沉重咔哒声后，电子叮声宣告门正在滑开。你用[pc.eyes]遮挡强光，却很快适应，看见一个拉奎因单手叉腰站在那里。她把一副重力手铐绕在指间转动，说道：“抱歉，小可爱，船上规矩。戴上，不然只能继续待在这里。那会让某个人非常生气。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA heavy rattling followed by an electronic DING signals the sliding of the door. You shield your [pc.eyes] from the bright glare, but adjust quick enough to see a laquine standing there with a hand on her hip. She twirls a pair of grav cuffs around her finger and says, “Sorry cutie, procedure on board. Put ‘em on or you’re gonna have to stay here. And that’d make someone very mad.”"

rows.original: You catch the cuffs as they’re tossed at you, staring at them with trepidation. Her voice comes again, “I could just march you through the ship but this’ll make things easier. Also, don’t try to run. I went through a lot of trouble and I’d rather you not get yourself killed.” Swallowing slowly, you attach the cuffs to your wrists at the front and meet the pirate’s grin as she points you into the hall.
rows.translation: 手铐被扔过来，你接住后惶恐地盯着。她再次开口：“我也可以直接押着你穿过飞船，不过这样更省事。另外别想逃。我费了很大功夫，可不希望你把自己害死。”你缓缓吞咽，把手铐扣在身前双腕上；海盗咧嘴一笑，指示你走进走廊。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou catch the cuffs as they’re tossed at you, staring at them with trepidation. Her voice comes again, “I could just march you through the ship but this’ll make things easier. Also, don’t try to run. I went through a lot of trouble and I’d rather you not get yourself killed.” Swallowing slowly, you attach the cuffs to your wrists at the front and meet the pirate’s grin as she points you into the hall."

rows.original: Groaning from the cool air, you’re led through the corridors of a ship, the circuits and machinery vibrating the floor under your [pc.feet]. Embarrassingly, you’re taken through a large break room and ogled by other horny rabbits at rest, but they, thankfully, keep it short. You’re brought into a lift - the laquine hits a button and your stomach sinks momentarily as you ride to the upper deck, labeled ‘Command’ on the flecked green panel.
rows.translation: 你因冷空气而呻吟，被带着穿过飞船走廊；电路与机械令[pc.feet]下的地板振动。令人尴尬的是，你被带过一间大休息室，受到正在休息的淫荡兔子们打量；幸好她们很快便收回目光。你被带进升降梯，拉奎因按下按钮，升往上层甲板时胃短暂下沉；斑驳绿色面板把那里标为“指挥层”。
rows.raw: "\n\nGroaning from the cool air, you’re led through the corridors of a ship, the circuits and machinery vibrating the floor under your [pc.feet]. Embarrassingly, you’re taken through a large break room and ogled by other horny rabbits at rest, but they, thankfully, keep it short. You’re brought into a lift - the laquine hits a button and your stomach sinks momentarily as you ride to the upper deck, labeled ‘Command’ on the flecked green panel."

rows.original: Thankfully, on this floor, it’s a little warmer. It makes you a little more aware of your laquine guide’s pheromonal sweat, though you, oddly, don’t feel very aroused considering past experiences...
rows.translation: 幸好这一层稍微暖和些。你因此更能察觉拉奎因向导汗水里的信息素，不过奇怪的是，考虑到过去经历，你并没有非常兴奋...
rows.raw: "\n\nThankfully, on this floor, it’s a little warmer. It makes you a little more aware of your laquine guide’s pheromonal sweat, though you, oddly, don’t feel very aroused considering past experiences..."

rows.original: The jumper stops at one of the doors at the end of a hall, a strip reading ‘Captain’ on the panel next to it. Instead of typing in anything, she bangs on it four times with her [enemy.furColor] paw. Just like that, it opens, and she has you walk in first. There’s a heady perfume-like smell to the room, some cheap brand or, perhaps, an expensive one that only smells good because it was priced higher than everything else. It’s a rather cozy room, all told. Insignias and emblems of the jumpers are positioned around the room and a large flag hangs behind a desk and chair where a tall, rabbit-eared woman is sitting.
rows.translation: 跳帮者停在走廊尽头的一扇门前，旁边面板条写着“船长”。她没有输入任何东西，而是用[enemy.furColor]爪子敲了四下。门就这样打开，她让你先走进去。房间里有股浓郁香水味，可能是廉价品牌，也可能昂贵到只因价格高过其他东西便闻起来不错。总的来说，这房间相当舒适。跳帮者的徽章与标志摆放各处；一面大旗挂在桌椅后方，那里坐着一个高挑兔耳女人。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe jumper stops at one of the doors at the end of a hall, a strip reading ‘Captain’ on the panel next to it. Instead of typing in anything, she bangs on it four times with her [enemy.furColor] paw. Just like that, it opens, and she has you walk in first. There’s a heady perfume-like smell to the room, some cheap brand or, perhaps, an expensive one that only smells good because it was priced higher than everything else. It’s a rather cozy room, all told. Insignias and emblems of the jumpers are positioned around the room and a large flag hangs behind a desk and chair where a tall, rabbit-eared woman is sitting."

rows.original: That is a pretty neat flag though, crossbones under a skull with rabbit ears...
rows.translation: 不过那旗子确实很酷，兔耳骷髅下方交叉着两根骨头...
rows.raw: "\n\nThat is a pretty neat flag though, crossbones under a skull with rabbit ears..."

rows.original: The woman looks up to you under the brim of a wide hat with a stern look in her dark eyes. She’s dressed a little ostentatiously, not something someone could get away with lest they were in charge of a large ship and crew. Both of her tawny ears flick, she glowers at you with stoic authority. Shutting the book she was reading, she brushes her side plait hair as she stands.
rows.translation: 女人从宽大帽檐下抬眼看你，深色眼睛神情严厉。她衣着略显招摇，除非掌管着大型飞船和船员，否则没人能这样穿。两只黄褐长耳同时抽动；她带着沉着权威怒视你。合上正在阅读的书后，她站起来，拂过侧边辫发。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman looks up to you under the brim of a wide hat with a stern look in her dark eyes. She’s dressed a little ostentatiously, not something someone could get away with lest they were in charge of a large ship and crew. Both of her tawny ears flick, she glowers at you with stoic authority. Shutting the book she was reading, she brushes her side plait hair as she stands."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele.” She rasps, clearing her throat. “The sire of a shitheel company traipsing around frontier space for whatever inane reason.” She raises her hand, “Don’t tell me why. I don’t care, and it doesn’t matter. That’s not why you’re here in front of me.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”她声音沙哑，清了清嗓子。“一家混账公司的继承人，不知为何在边疆太空四处闲逛。”她抬起手，“别告诉我原因。我不在乎，也不重要。你站在我面前并不是为这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele.” She rasps, clearing her throat. “The sire of a shitheel company traipsing around frontier space for whatever inane reason.” She raises her hand, “Don’t tell me why. I don’t care, and it doesn’t matter. That’s not why you’re here in front of me.”"

rows.original: “Then why ooohhh why am I here? To get a taste of the captain’s log?” You lick your [pc.lips] seductively.
rows.translation: “那我究——竟为什么在这里？为了尝尝船长的航海日志吗？”你诱人地舔过[pc.lips]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then why ooohhh why am I here? To get a taste of the captain’s log?” You lick your [pc.lips] seductively."

rows.original: “If that’s not why I’m here, clearly it’s for a good time, right?” You grin like a fool, enjoying the annoyed expression on her face.
rows.translation: “如果我来这里不是为那件事，显然就是来享乐的，对吧？”你像傻瓜般咧嘴笑，欣赏她恼怒的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If that’s not why I’m here, clearly it’s for a good time, right?” You grin like a fool, enjoying the annoyed expression on her face."

rows.original: “Whatever the case, I don’t suppose it involves giving me a chance to leave?” You ask tacitly.
rows.translation: “不论如何，想必这不会包括给我一个离开的机会吧？”你含蓄地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whatever the case, I don’t suppose it involves giving me a chance to leave?” You ask tacitly."

rows.original: “If it doesn’t matter, then why am I here?” You scowl, tapping your foot petulantly at the pirate.
rows.translation: “如果不重要，那我为什么会在这里？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If it doesn’t matter, then why am I here?” You scowl, tapping your foot petulantly at the pirate."

rows.original: “Then you should shoot me now.” You growl at her.
rows.translation: “那你现在就该开枪打死我。”你朝她低吼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then you should shoot me now.” You growl at her."

rows.original: The woman walks out from behind her desk and approaches you with a menacing march-like walk, her pert chest jiggling under her light raiments. Her voice is a low, husky bellow almost. “You are here because of an infantile bet that your presence caused in my crew. My subordinate, who incidentally won that insipid wager, decided that her prize - you - should be my prize. With that in mind, I looked up exactly who you were.”
rows.translation: 女人从桌后走出，以威胁性的行军步伐逼近；挺翘胸脯在轻薄服饰下晃动。她的声音近似低沉沙哑的吼声。“你会在这里，是因为你的出现导致船员间打了一场幼稚赌局。我的下属碰巧赢下那场愚蠢赌约，并决定她的奖品——你——应该成为我的奖品。鉴于此，我查清了你的身份。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman walks out from behind her desk and approaches you with a menacing march-like walk, her pert chest jiggling under her light raiments. Her voice is a low, husky bellow almost. “You are here because of an infantile bet that your presence caused in my crew. My subordinate, who incidentally won that insipid wager, decided that her prize - you - should be my prize. With that in mind, I looked up exactly who you were.”"

rows.original: She looks over you with a discerning stare. “You were trained as a soldier. Curiously, I learned that you were and still are a skilled mercenary. At least, that’s what the records I could find state. I like that in a person.”
rows.translation: 她用审视目光打量你。“你受过士兵训练。奇怪的是，我了解到你过去是、现在仍是一个技艺娴熟的雇佣兵。至少我能找到的记录如此记载。我喜欢这样的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks over you with a discerning stare. “You were trained as a soldier. Curiously, I learned that you were and still are a skilled mercenary. At least, that’s what the records I could find state. I like that in a person.”"

rows.original: She looks over you with a strangely respectful nod. “You were a smuggler in your youth as I understand it. I was able to get in touch with one of your old contacts. According to them, you’re an elusive, wily person. Not unlike us. But not a match for us, apparently.”
rows.translation: 她带着异常尊重的点头打量你。“据我所知，你年轻时是个走私者。我联系到了你的一个旧联系人。据对方说，你行踪隐秘又足智多谋，和我们颇为相似。不过显然仍不是我们的对手。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks over you with a strangely respectful nod. “You were a smuggler in your youth as I understand it. I was able to get in touch with one of your old contacts. According to them, you’re an elusive, wily person. Not unlike us. But not a match for us, apparently.”"

rows.original: She looks over you with a befuddled expression. “You were a psyker. Mind powers, the whole shebang. I was able to get in touch with an old acquaintance of yours from your academy days. According to them, you’re quite the threat - not unlike us. But not a match for us, apparently.”
rows.translation: 她神情困惑地打量你。“你曾是灵能者。心灵力量，整套本事。我联系到了你学院时代的一位旧识。据对方说，你是个相当大的威胁，和我们很像。不过显然仍不是我们的对手。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks over you with a befuddled expression. “You were a psyker. Mind powers, the whole shebang. I was able to get in touch with an old acquaintance of yours from your academy days. According to them, you’re quite the threat - not unlike us. But not a match for us, apparently.”"

rows.original: She eyes you with a thoughtful grin. “You are a talented specialist, I’ve learned. Graduated top of an illustrious academy, learning a lot about engineering, hardware, software... Things useful to know when working on a ship. As I understand it, you’re very reliable.”
rows.translation: 她若有所思地笑着注视你。“据我了解，你是个有天赋的专家。以首名毕业于著名学院，学了许多工程、硬件、软件... 都是在飞船上工作时很有用的知识。据我所知，你非常可靠。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe eyes you with a thoughtful grin. “You are a talented specialist, I’ve learned. Graduated top of an illustrious academy, learning a lot about engineering, hardware, software... Things useful to know when working on a ship. As I understand it, you’re very reliable.”"

rows.original: “I can be very reliable in other ways, too...” you murmur.
rows.translation: “我在其他方面也可以非常可靠...”你低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can be very reliable in other ways, too...” you murmur."

rows.original: “Get to the point, please,” you shake your head.
rows.translation: “请直接说重点，”你摇头道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Get to the point, please,” you shake your head."

rows.original: “Beating around the bush, huh?” you grin.
rows.translation: “拐弯抹角，是吧？”你咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Beating around the bush, huh?” you grin."

rows.original: “What is the point of this questioning?” You ask curtly.
rows.translation: “这些盘问究竟有什么意义？”你简短地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What is the point of this questioning?” You ask curtly."

rows.original: “Look at this,” she barks, pointing you towards a screen on the left side of the room before hitting a button on the remote.
rows.translation: “看看这个，”她厉声说道，先把你指向房间左侧屏幕，随后按下遥控器按钮。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look at this,” she barks, pointing you towards a screen on the left side of the room before hitting a button on the remote."

rows.original: A video feed blinks to life on the flat screen, showing your ship still in Zhèng Shi hangar, and surrounded by the station’s inhabitants.
rows.translation: 平面屏幕上的视频信号闪亮起来，显示你的飞船仍停在郑石机库，被空间站居民团团围住。
rows.raw: "\n\nA video feed blinks to life on the flat screen, showing your ship still in Zhèng Shi hangar, and surrounded by the station’s inhabitants. "

rows.original: Another video feed pops up picture-in-picture style, showing
rows.translation: 另一个视频画面以画中画形式弹出，显示
rows.raw: "Another video feed pops up picture-in-picture style, showing "

rows.original: your crewmate
rows.translation: 你的船员
rows.raw: "your crewmate"

rows.original: members of your crew
rows.translation: 你的多名船员
rows.raw: "members of your crew"

rows.original: being held up. The sight of it makes you jump, but the grav cuffs lighten your frame ever so slightly...
rows.translation: 被扣押。这幅景象让你浑身一跳，但重力手铐让身体稍稍变轻...
rows.raw: " being held up. The sight of it makes you jump, but the grav cuffs lighten your frame ever so slightly..."

rows.original: “I’m going to make you an offer. rows.original: True to her word, your new captain prepared a thorough mod treatment to change you into a laquine. In less than a day, you became one of them: a lop-eared laquine dressed in the same, skin-tight uniform they all wear. It took some getting used to the fur, your new legs, and especially your equine genitals. You’ve inherited the insatiable laquine sex drive as well as their sultry work ethos.

rows.original: You remain on Zhèng Shi for a while, living and training with the other jumpers, and managing the slaves. It irks you at first, but you remind yourself that you could have been in their position... or even worse. You wander the mines and the halls like they do, working up an awful sweat that is frustrating to get used to when your spongy fur and suit bake you alive everywhere you go. But you manage, thanks to the help of the others. Curiously, you’re aided most by the one who brought you aboard in the first place.
rows.translation: 你在郑石停留了一段时间，与其他跳帮者共同生活训练，并管理奴隶。起初这令你烦躁，但你提醒自己，本来可能沦落到他们的位置... 甚至更糟。你像她们一样游荡于矿井和走廊，浑身冒出大量汗水；海绵般绒毛和制服走到哪里都把你烤得难以适应。不过在其他人的帮助下，你还是应付了下来。奇怪的是，最常帮助你的正是最初把你带上船的那个人。

rows.original: On the ship, you are given your own room on the upper decks, three doors from the captain’s quarters, and are allowed to roam freely. Despite their overactive behaviors, you make easy conversation and plenty of friends among the crew who each lead their own remarkably ‘normal’ lives. You decide it’s best to build bridges early, in case you ever get free of your illegal obligations. The captain is rarely seen, though you do catch sight of her bickering and fighting with the other VIPs aboard the station. Even now, you still have little idea of what their plan entails.
rows.translation: 在飞船上，你获得上层甲板的独立房间，与船长舱室相隔三扇门，并获准自由活动。尽管行为过度活跃，你仍能轻松与船员交谈并结交许多朋友；每个人都过着格外“正常”的生活。你决定尽早建立关系，以备未来摆脱非法义务。船长很少露面，不过你确实看见她和空间站上的其他重要人物争吵打斗。即使现在，你仍不太明白她们的计划是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn the ship, you are given your own room on the upper decks, three doors from the captain’s quarters, and are allowed to roam freely. Despite their overactive behaviors, you make easy conversation and plenty of friends among the crew who each lead their own remarkably ‘normal’ lives. You decide it’s best to build bridges early, in case you ever get free of your illegal obligations. The captain is rarely seen, though you do catch sight of her bickering and fighting with the other VIPs aboard the station. Even now, you still have little idea of what their plan entails."

rows.original: As the weeks turn into months, you settle into a few distinct roles in the crew.
rows.translation: 数周变成数月，你逐渐适应船员中的几个明确职责。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the weeks turn into months, you settle into a few distinct roles in the crew."

rows.original: Your skills as a soldier make you the drill instructor your captain always needed. Whilst the laquines are reactive and flexible, they aren’t the most well trained bunch in the galaxy. You put your experience and practice to the test, conjuring up your past strengths and teaching them the finer points of a hand-to-hand brawl, and how best to use their bodies when the going gets tough.
rows.translation: 士兵技能让你成为船长一直需要的训练教官。拉奎因反应迅速、适应力强，却称不上银河中训练最有素的一群。你把经验与实践投入考验，唤回过去的长处，教导她们近身搏斗的精妙之处，以及形势严峻时如何最好地运用身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour skills as a soldier make you the drill instructor your captain always needed. Whilst the laquines are reactive and flexible, they aren’t the most well trained bunch in the galaxy. You put your experience and practice to the test, conjuring up your past strengths and teaching them the finer points of a hand-to-hand brawl, and how best to use their bodies when the going gets tough."

rows.original: Even among skilled thieves, you have a few tricks and secrets of your own to impart to the jumpers. You help them better understand the finer points of infiltration, teamwork, and special tactics when outnumbered. They each become more accurate, more aware, and far more effective under fire thanks to your charmed tutelage, though you’re not sure if that’s something to be proud of yet.
rows.translation: 即使在技术高超的盗贼中，你也有一些自己的技巧与秘密可以传授给跳帮者。你帮助她们更好理解潜入、团队合作，以及寡不敌众时的特殊战术。得益于你充满魅力的指导，她们每个人都变得更准确、更警觉，交火时也有效得多，不过你还不确定这是否值得自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven among skilled thieves, you have a few tricks and secrets of your own to impart to the jumpers. You help them better understand the finer points of infiltration, teamwork, and special tactics when outnumbered. They each become more accurate, more aware, and far more effective under fire thanks to your charmed tutelage, though you’re not sure if that’s something to be proud of yet."

rows.original: Your skills as a psyker make you an invaluable asset to your captain. Whilst the laquines are impressive specimens on their own, having a kinetic powerhouse at their beck and call is an impressive force multiplier.
rows.translation: 身为灵能者，你的才能使你成为船长手下不可估量的资产。拉奎因本身就是令人印象深刻的种族，而拥有一位听候差遣的动能强者，更能让她们的力量成倍增长。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour skills as a psyker make you an invaluable asset to your captain. Whilst the laquines are impressive specimens on their own, having a kinetic powerhouse at their beck and call is an impressive force multiplier."

rows.original: You become a valued quartermaster, assistant engineer, and are named a navigator, although the latter role is yet to be needed. You are given access to the armory and storage room where you maintain and modify the crew’s arsenal as needed. Other days, you work with the chief engineer and markedly improve the state of the ship, feeling a little pride getting the place cleaned up bit by bit.
rows.translation: 你成为备受重视的军需官兼助理工程师，还获任领航员，尽管最后一项职责尚未派上用场。你可以进出军械库和储藏室，根据需要维护并改装船员的武器装备。另一些日子，你会和总工程师一起工作，显著改善飞船的状况，看着这里一点点被收拾干净，心中不禁生出几分自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou become a valued quartermaster, assistant engineer, and are named a navigator, although the latter role is yet to be needed. You are given access to the armory and storage room where you maintain and modify the crew’s arsenal as needed. Other days, you work with the chief engineer and markedly improve the state of the ship, feeling a little pride getting the place cleaned up bit by bit."

rows.original: Despite being a pirate yourself now, the work is smooth and rewarding. It’s a rhythmic routine that has slowly taken you out of your path as a business magnate in the making. Although you still pine for your old life, you aren’t unhappy with your position. You’re treated close to a first mate by the captain, and she watches out for you when others question your talents. Your friends ask you often about your old life, what you were like growing up, and even what your goal was. As you open up, they do too, and you feel an odd peace when you sympathize with them and why they chose their path.
rows.translation: 尽管你如今自己也是海盗，这份工作却顺利而有成就感。规律的节奏逐渐将你带离那条成为商业巨头的道路。虽然你仍怀念过去的生活，却并不厌恶如今的位置。船长几乎把你当作大副对待，别人质疑你的才干时，她也会替你撑腰。朋友们常常问起你的旧生活，问你成长时是什么模样，甚至问你曾有怎样的目标。随着你向她们敞开心扉，她们也对你坦诚相待；当你理解她们以及她们选择这条道路的原因时，内心竟感到一种奇异的平静。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite being a pirate yourself now, the work is smooth and rewarding. It’s a rhythmic routine that has slowly taken you out of your path as a business magnate in the making. Although you still pine for your old life, you aren’t unhappy with your position. You’re treated close to a first mate by the captain, and she watches out for you when others question your talents. Your friends ask you often about your old life, what you were like growing up, and even what your goal was. As you open up, they do too, and you feel an odd peace when you sympathize with them and why they chose their path."

rows.original: But all of this is besides one unique perk to being a jumper: the ship-wide orgies. When the monotony is too great to bear, when the dull ache of patrolling a run down station frays at the edges of the crew’s minds, you can relax in the best way possible by coming together. Quite literally. Your favorite nights are when the captain asks for your company. Each of those is a night to remember thanks to the hours of wanton sex, sex enabled by laquine biology.
rows.translation: 不过，这一切都比不上身为跳帮者的一项独特福利：全船大乱交。当单调乏味变得难以忍受，当巡逻破败空间站的沉闷痛楚磨损着船员们的精神边缘时，大家可以聚在一起，用最美妙的方式放松。名副其实地结合在一起。你最喜欢船长邀请你作陪的夜晚。凭借拉奎因的生理构造带来的数小时放纵性爱，每一次都成为难忘之夜。

rows.original: As operations on Zhèng Shi come to a close, you’re often on patrol in proximity to the station. One day, a lone, intruding ship is picked up on sensor. Not part of the U.G.C, it’s a sizeable ship nonetheless. With orders to take it, the captain leads you into an ambush, launching you and others in a surprise boarding raid from around the asteroids. Their weapons don’t even have time to fire up before the other pirates set upon it like predators.

Not part of the U.G.C, it’s a sizeable ship nonetheless. With orders to take it, the captain leads you into an ambush, launching you and others in a surprise boarding raid from around the asteroids. rows.original: “And I don’t suppose you’re going to let me through, are you?” you reply. “Nope!” she says, grinning savagely as she sets her feet apart and readies her flamethrower. “I’m gonna light you up!”
rows.translation: “我猜你不会放我过去，对吧？”你回答。 “不会！”她狞笑着分开双脚，架好喷火器。“我要把你点燃！”
rows.raw: " “And I don’t suppose you’re going to let me through, are you?” you reply. “Nope!” she says, grinning savagely as she sets her feet apart and readies her flamethrower. “I’m gonna light you up!”"

rows.original: “You sure? I got a permit and everything,” you mutter uncertainly, looking down and patting your [pc.thighs]. “Oh shit, I must have left it back on my ship.” “Funny,” she says, grinning savagely as she sets her feet apart and readies her flamethrower. “But it’s not gonna stop me from lighting you up!”
rows.translation: “你确定？我有许可证什么的，”你不安地嘟囔着，低头拍了拍自己的[pc.thighs]。“糟糕，我肯定把它落在飞船上了。” “真好笑，”她狞笑着分开双脚，架好喷火器。“不过这可阻止不了我把你点燃！”
rows.raw: " “You sure? I got a permit and everything,” you mutter uncertainly, looking down and patting your [pc.thighs]. “Oh shit, I must have left it back on my ship.” “Funny,” she says, grinning savagely as she sets her feet apart and readies her flamethrower. “But it’s not gonna stop me from lighting you up!”"

rows.original: “Huh,” you grunt, checking your [pc.weapon]. “Guess I’ll just have to go through you.” “Ooh, I like a confident [pc.man],” she growls, grinning savagely as she sets her feet apart and readies her flamethrower. “But it’s not gonna stop me from lighting you up!”
rows.translation: “哼，”你检查着自己的[pc.weapon]，哼了一声。“看来我只能从你身上闯过去了。” “哦，我喜欢自信的[pc.man]，”她咆哮着狞笑起来，分开双脚，架好喷火器。“不过这可阻止不了我把你点燃！”
rows.raw: " “Huh,” you grunt, checking your [pc.weapon]. “Guess I’ll just have to go through you.” “Ooh, I like a confident [pc.man],” she growls, grinning savagely as she sets her feet apart and readies her flamethrower. “But it’s not gonna stop me from lighting you up!”"

rows.original: “Oh? Look who it is,” a familiar voice calls, and you turn to see the flamer huskar stalking towards you with her heavy weapon at the ready. “The best fuck I’ve ever had, just walking around like you want me to find you.”
rows.translation: “哦？看看是谁来了，”一个熟悉的声音呼喊着，你转过身，看见那名喷火器赫斯卡端着重武器大步逼近。“我这辈子遇过最棒的一炮，就这么四处闲逛，仿佛你想让我找到你似的。”
rows.raw: "“Oh? Look who it is,” a familiar voice calls, and you turn to see the flamer huskar stalking towards you with her heavy weapon at the ready. “The best fuck I’ve ever had, just walking around like you want me to find you.”"

rows.original: “You really want to fight again?” you say, smirking at her as she licks her lips.
rows.translation: “你真想再打一场？”你冷笑着说道，她则舔了舔嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You really want to fight again?” you say, smirking at her as she licks her lips."

rows.original: “Of course I do, [pc.daddy],” she says excitedly, lifting her flamethrower up. “The fire gets me all revved up and ready for you to ride!”
rows.translation: “当然了，[pc.daddy]，”她兴奋地说着，举起喷火器。“火焰会让我兴奋起来，准备好让你骑！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course I do, [pc.daddy],” she says excitedly, lifting her flamethrower up. “The fire gets me all revved up and ready for you to ride!”"

rows.original: Well, you already knew the fire excited her. If that’s what it takes to get this bitch going, you’ll indulge her for the moment.
rows.translation: 好吧，你早就知道火焰会让她兴奋。既然非得这样才能让这个婊子进入状态，你暂时就满足她吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you already knew the fire excited her. If that’s what it takes to get this bitch going, you’ll indulge her for the moment."

rows.original: “Hey! You!” a familiar voice calls, and you turn to see the flamer huskar stalking towards you with her heavy weapon at the ready. “Thought I told you to keep out of here the last time.”
rows.translation: “嘿！你！”一个熟悉的声音呼喊着，你转过身，看见那名喷火器赫斯卡端着重武器大步逼近。“我记得上次已经叫你别来这里了。”
rows.raw: "“Hey! You!” a familiar voice calls, and you turn to see the flamer huskar stalking towards you with her heavy weapon at the ready. “Thought I told you to keep out of here the last time.”"

rows.original: “Guess I didn’t get the message,” you reply, eyeing her warily.
rows.translation: “看来我没听进去，”你警惕地打量着她，回答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guess I didn’t get the message,” you reply, eyeing her warily."

rows.original: “You’re making my job difficult,” she sighs theatrically, a finger lightly tapping the side of her gun. “I wish you’d just stay away...”
rows.translation: “你让我的工作变得很难办，”她夸张地叹息，一根手指轻轻敲着枪身。“真希望你能离远点...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re making my job difficult,” she sighs theatrically, a finger lightly tapping the side of her gun. “I wish you’d just stay away...”"

rows.original: “No you don’t,” you say, turning to face her with your [pc.weapon] at the ready. “I can see you trembling in excitement. You’re just itching to use that flamethrower on me, aren’t you?”
rows.translation: “你才不希望呢，”你转身面对她，架好[pc.weapon]。“我看得出你正兴奋得发抖。你已经迫不及待想拿喷火器烧我了，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No you don’t,” you say, turning to face her with your [pc.weapon] at the ready. “I can see you trembling in excitement. You’re just itching to use that flamethrower on me, aren’t you?”"

rows.original: “Heh heh,” she chuckles, the facade cracking, then crumbling away. “Hahahaha! I can’t believe you came back for more! I can’t believe how lucky I am!”
rows.translation: “嘿嘿，”她轻笑着，伪装开始破裂，随后彻底崩塌。“哈哈哈哈！真不敢相信你居然回来讨打！真不敢相信我竟然这么走运！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heh heh,” she chuckles, the facade cracking, then crumbling away. “Hahahaha! I can’t believe you came back for more! I can’t believe how lucky I am!”"

rows.original: She splits her face with a toothy grin that you’d swear stretches up to her ears, her arms shaking as she lifts her flamethrower. “Time to turn up the heat!”
rows.translation: 她咧开一张露齿大笑的脸，嘴角仿佛一直扯到耳根；双臂颤抖着举起喷火器。“该升温了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe splits her face with a toothy grin that you’d swear stretches up to her ears, her arms shaking as she lifts her flamethrower. “Time to turn up the heat!”"

rows.original: It’s a fight!
rows.translation: 开打了！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a fight!"

rows.raw: "FIREPUP_ENCOUNTERS"

rows.raw: "FIREBITCH"

rows.raw: "CORONAFLAMER"

rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.raw: "Flirt"
