rows.translation: 取悦他
rows.raw: "Please Him"

rows.original: Please Him
rows.translation: 取悦他
rows.raw: "Please Him"

rows.original: Dane’s going to take charge if you want to sleep with him, but that’s what you want, isn’t it?
rows.translation: 如果你想和戴恩上床，他会掌握主动权，不过这不正是你想要的吗？
rows.raw: "Dane’s going to take charge if you want to sleep with him, but that’s what you want, isn’t it?"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: You turned down Dane so hard that flirting isn’t really an option any more.
rows.translation: 你狠狠拒绝过戴恩，如今已经不太可能再跟他调情了。
rows.raw: "You turned down Dane so hard that flirting isn’t really an option any more."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You step a little closer, sizing the ausar up to verify that you are indeed approaching Dane, your cousin’s former bodyguard, and there’s no other conclusion to come to: it’s him. He’s even wearing the same armor he wore on Mhen’ga, right down to the glowing shield booster nestled into his pecs.
rows.translation: 你走近几步，仔细打量这名奥萨人，确认自己接近的确实是戴恩——你表亲的前保镖，除此之外不可能有其他结论：就是他。他甚至还穿着在门加时的同一套盔甲，连嵌在胸肌间、闪闪发光的护盾增强器都一模一样。
rows.raw: "You step a little closer, sizing the ausar up to verify that you are indeed approaching Dane, your cousin’s former bodyguard, and there’s no other conclusion to come to: it’s him. He’s even wearing the same armor he wore on Mhen’ga, right down to the glowing shield booster nestled into his pecs."

rows.original: With the din of dozens of clamoring voices filling the air, Dane hasn’t noticed your approach just yet. You have the opportunity to choose how to handle this. Do you want to go for some cheap revenge and lay him out with a sucker punch or see if the mercenary is down to talk now that he’s lost his job?
rows.translation: 几十道喧闹声充斥空气，戴恩还没有注意到你的接近。你可以选择如何处理此事。你想来点卑鄙的报复，用偷袭一拳把他放倒，还是看看这名失业佣兵如今是否愿意谈谈？
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the din of dozens of clamoring voices filling the air, Dane hasn’t noticed your approach just yet. You have the opportunity to choose how to handle this. Do you want to go for some cheap revenge and lay him out with a sucker punch or see if the mercenary is down to talk now that he’s lost his job?"

rows.original: Punch
rows.translation: 挥拳
rows.raw: "Punch"

rows.original: Greet
rows.translation: 打招呼
rows.raw: "Greet"

rows.original: Dane sits in companionable silence for the moment.
rows.translation: 戴恩暂时以友善的沉默陪伴着你。
rows.raw: "Dane sits in companionable silence for the moment."

rows.original: You pull up a seat next to Dane, and the albino bruiser shifts position to better regard you. “Back again, I see. Here for a stiff drink, or just looking to pry some dirt on your cousin out of me?”
rows.translation: 你在戴恩旁边拉来一张座位，白化壮汉调整姿势，以便更好地看着你。“又回来了啊。是来喝杯烈酒，还是只想从我这里挖出你表亲的黑料？”
rows.raw: "You pull up a seat next to Dane, and the albino bruiser shifts position to better regard you. “Back again, I see. Here for a stiff drink, or just looking to pry some dirt on your cousin out of me?”"

rows.original: You greet Dane as you slide yourself onto one of the stools. “Take some time off from your quest to join my little pity party, huh?” Dane swirls his glass before taking a discrete sip. “Hearing you out’s the least I can do, I guess. What’s up?”
rows.translation: 你滑上一张高脚凳，同时向戴恩打了声招呼。 “特意从寻找探针的任务里抽空，来参加我的小型自怜派对，嗯？”戴恩晃了晃酒杯，谨慎地抿了一口。“我想，我至少该听你说说。怎么了？”
rows.raw: "You greet Dane as you slide yourself onto one of the stools.\n\n“Take some time off from your quest to join my little pity party, huh?” Dane swirls his glass before taking a discrete sip. “Hearing you out’s the least I can do, I guess. What’s up?”"

rows.original: Dane lifts his glass. “Welcome back, [pc.name]. I see the pirates haven’t broken you yet. Best keep your wits about you, though. This lot isn’t exactly known for their honor.” He gestures at a Jumper down the bar who is, at this very moment, slipping a pill into her neighbor’s drink. “Guard your drinks if you don’t wanna be somebody else’s carnival ride.” He snorts derisively. “You got an intent look in your eye. Something you need?”
rows.translation: 戴恩举起酒杯。“欢迎回来，[pc.name]。看来海盗还没击垮你。不过最好保持警惕，这群人可不以讲荣誉闻名。”他指向吧台另一头的一名跳帮者，而她此刻正把一颗药丸偷偷放进邻座的酒里。“不想变成别人的游乐设施，就看好自己的酒。”他不屑地哼了一声。“你眼神很认真。有什么事吗？”
rows.raw: "Dane lifts his glass. “Welcome back, [pc.name]. I see the pirates haven’t broken you yet. Best keep your wits about you, though. This lot isn’t exactly known for their honor.” He gestures at a Jumper down the bar who is, at this very moment, slipping a pill into her neighbor’s drink. “Guard your drinks if you don’t wanna be somebody else’s carnival ride.” He snorts derisively. “You got an intent look in your eye. Something you need?”"

rows.original: Dane nods quietly in your direction. “[pc.name]. What brings you my way?”
rows.translation: 戴恩朝你默默点头。“[pc.name]。什么风把你吹来了？”
rows.raw: "Dane nods quietly in your direction. “[pc.name]. What brings you my way?”"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You close the rest of the distance at a brisk pace, winding up as you go. The second your shadow falls across the merc mutt’s view, your fist is there to follow it straight into his cheekbone. Your suckerpunch takes Dane completely off guard
rows.translation: 你快步走完剩余距离，一边前进一边蓄力。你的影子刚落入佣兵狗的视野，拳头便紧随其后，直击他的颧骨。这记偷袭完全打了戴恩一个措手不及
rows.raw: "You close the rest of the distance at a brisk pace, winding up as you go. The second your shadow falls across the merc mutt’s view, your fist is there to follow it straight into his cheekbone. Your suckerpunch takes Dane completely off guard"

rows.original: , and with all your power and frustrations poured into it, it knocks the fluffy albino completely out of his chair. He spins halfway around on his way down, falling on his back. Acrid-smelling booze splashes over him when his cup shatters on the deck next to him.
rows.translation: ，而你把全部力量与怨气都灌进了这一拳，直接将毛茸茸的白化奥萨人从椅子上打飞。他倒下时转了半圈，仰面摔倒。酒杯在身旁的甲板上摔得粉碎，气味刺鼻的酒液溅了他一身。
rows.raw: ", and with all your power and frustrations poured into it, it knocks the fluffy albino completely out of his chair. He spins halfway around on his way down, falling on his back. Acrid-smelling booze splashes over him when his cup shatters on the deck next to him."

rows.original: A fitting place for him.
rows.translation: 这是个适合他的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nA fitting place for him."

rows.original: “Who the f-” Dane starts, rubbing his jaw and blinking a bit of sense back into his blearing eyes. “Oh shit, it’s you!” He springs up onto his feet with surprising swiftness, three fists upraised while the fourth extends outward, open-palmed.
rows.translation: “谁他——”戴恩揉着下巴开口，眨着迷蒙的眼睛，恢复了几分神志。“我操，是你！”他以惊人的速度一跃而起，三只拳头高高举起，第四只手则掌心张开地向外伸出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who the f-” Dane starts, rubbing his jaw and blinking a bit of sense back into his blearing eyes. “Oh shit, it’s you!” He springs up onto his feet with surprising swiftness, three fists upraised while the fourth extends outward, open-palmed."

rows.original: , and with all your frustrations and strength poured into it, it knocks the fluffy albino halfway out of his chair. He saves himself at the last minute with a desperate grab for the bar, barely pulling himself back up while the tinkling shards of glass that were once his cup explode across the deck below.
rows.translation: ，而你把全部怨气与力量都灌进了这一拳，将毛茸茸的白化奥萨人打得半边身子飞出椅子。最后关头，他绝望地抓住吧台，勉强把自己拉了回来，而原本是酒杯的叮当碎片则在下方甲板上四散炸开。
rows.raw: ", and with all your frustrations and strength poured into it, it knocks the fluffy albino halfway out of his chair. He saves himself at the last minute with a desperate grab for the bar, barely pulling himself back up while the tinkling shards of glass that were once his cup explode across the deck below."

rows.original: “Who the f-” Dane starts, rubbing his jaw and instinctively lifting two of his arms defensively. “Oh shit, it’s you!” A third fist joins the first two while his free hand extends outward, open-palmed.
rows.translation: “谁他——”戴恩揉着下巴开口，本能地举起两条手臂防御。“我操，是你！”第三只拳头也加入前两只，空着的手则掌心张开地向外伸出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who the f-” Dane starts, rubbing his jaw and instinctively lifting two of his arms defensively. “Oh shit, it’s you!” A third fist joins the first two while his free hand extends outward, open-palmed."

rows.original: , and with all your frustrations behind it, it staggers the fluffy albino, though not quite violently enough to roust him from his barside throne.
rows.translation: ，而你把全部怨气都灌进了这一拳，打得毛茸茸的白化奥萨人踉跄后退，不过还没猛烈到足以把他从吧台旁的王座上掀下去。
rows.raw: ", and with all your frustrations behind it, it staggers the fluffy albino, though not quite violently enough to roust him from his barside throne."

rows.original: “Who the f-” Dane starts, rubbing his jaw in annoyance and whipping around. “Oh fuck. It’s you!” He puts two of his fists up into blocking position while the other two extend outward, placatingly.
rows.translation: “谁他——”戴恩恼火地揉着下巴开口，猛然转身。“操。是你！”他把两只拳头举到格挡位置，另外两只手则安抚地向外伸出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who the f-” Dane starts, rubbing his jaw in annoyance and whipping around. “Oh fuck. It’s you!” He puts two of his fists up into blocking position while the other two extend outward, placatingly."

rows.original: , and despite the healthy load of frustration and anger behind it, the albino barely reacts. He sets his drink down and sighs heavily, turning with deliberate slowness. “Look, buddy, do you really want to have a go, be-” Crimson eyes widen in recognition. “Fuck, it’s you!” He chuckles, putting a hand up palm-first, trying to be disarming.
rows.translation: ，而尽管这一拳里装满了怨气与怒火，白化奥萨人却几乎毫无反应。他放下酒杯，重重叹了口气，故意缓慢地转过身。“听着，伙计，你真想来一场吗，因——”猩红双眼因认出你而睁大。“操，是你！”他轻笑一声，抬起一只手，掌心朝前，试图缓和局面。
rows.raw: ", and despite the healthy load of frustration and anger behind it, the albino barely reacts. He sets his drink down and sighs heavily, turning with deliberate slowness. “Look, buddy, do you really want to have a go, be-” Crimson eyes widen in recognition. “Fuck, it’s you!” He chuckles, putting a hand up palm-first, trying to be disarming."

rows.original: “Never did learn how to throw a punch,” he chuckles.
rows.translation: “你从来就没学会怎么出拳，”他轻笑道。
rows.raw: " “Never did learn how to throw a punch,” he chuckles."

rows.original: <i>“Look Steele, I
rows.translation: <i>“听着，斯蒂尔，我
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Look Steele, I "

rows.original: probably
rows.translation: 大概
rows.raw: "probably"

rows.original: definitely
rows.translation: 肯定
rows.raw: "definitely"

rows.original: deserved that, but I don’t think you wanna take this much further.” He gestures over his shoulder at the casino’s security. “They tend to take a real sour view on people who fuck up their establishments, and tangling with me? We’d tear up half the Rec Deck.”
rows.translation: 确实活该挨这一拳，但我觉得你不会想把事情闹得更大。”他越过肩膀指向赌场保安。“他们通常很讨厌有人毁坏自己的场子，而跟我打起来？我们会拆掉半个娱乐甲板。”
rows.raw: " deserved that, but I don’t think you wanna take this much further.” He gestures over his shoulder at the casino’s security. “They tend to take a real sour view on people who fuck up their establishments, and tangling with me? We’d tear up half the Rec Deck.”"

rows.original: Dane pauses, crimson eyes flickering with barely suppressed irritation. “It’s not my job to fight you anymore, dipshit.”
rows.translation: 戴恩停顿片刻，猩红双眼中闪烁着勉强压住的恼火。“我的工作已经不是跟你打架了，蠢货。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane pauses, crimson eyes flickering with barely suppressed irritation. “It’s not my job to fight you anymore, dipshit.” "

rows.original: He eases himself back toward his chair, eyeing you warily.
rows.translation: 他小心翼翼地退回椅子旁，警惕地盯着你。
rows.raw: "He eases himself back toward his chair, eyeing you warily."

rows.original: He eases himself the rest of the way back into his chair, eyeing you warily.
rows.translation: 他一路退回椅子里坐好，警惕地盯着你。
rows.raw: "He eases himself the rest of the way back into his chair, eyeing you warily."

rows.original: He relaxes somewhat, still eyeing you warily.
rows.translation: 他稍微放松了一些，仍警惕地打量着你。
rows.raw: "He relaxes somewhat, still eyeing you warily."

rows.original: He leans back, a cocky smirk on his features.
rows.translation: 他向后靠去，脸上挂着自负的坏笑。
rows.raw: "He leans back, a cocky smirk on his features."

rows.original: <i>“If I’m gonna throw down, I want to be paid for it.
rows.translation: <i>“我要动手，就得有人付钱。
rows.raw: " <i>“If I’m gonna throw down, I want to be paid for it."

I’ve been through enough shit to turn my fur white, if it wasn’t already.” Dane pauses, tapping his chin while his spare arms fidget with his glass. “Not all of ‘em strictly legal either. See my last one, pre-shitbag, seemed like it was a simple job: guard a trader while he closes an important deal with his associate. Of course it wasn’t.”
rows.translation: 佣兵起伏的腹肌中爆发出洪亮笑声。“好，好。我经历过的破事足以让毛发变白——如果它原本不是白色的话。”戴恩停下来敲着下巴，空着的几只手臂则摆弄酒杯。“那些事也不全都严格合法。就说我在那个混蛋之前接的最后一份工作吧，看起来很简单：保护一名商人，让他跟同伙完成一笔重要交易。当然，事情没那么简单。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA booming laugh echoes out of the mercenary’s rippling abdominals. “Sure, sure. I’ve been through enough shit to turn my fur white, if it wasn’t already.” Dane pauses, tapping his chin while his spare arms fidget with his glass. “Not all of ‘em strictly legal either. See my last one, pre-shitbag, seemed like it was a simple job: guard a trader while he closes an important deal with his associate. Of course it wasn’t.”"

rows.original: “It wasn’t?” You gasp. “Oh no!”
rows.translation: “不简单？”你倒抽一口气。“哦，不！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It wasn’t?” You gasp. “Oh no!”"

rows.original: “They never are,” you add.
rows.translation: “向来如此，”你补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They never are,” you add."

rows.original: Bobbing his head in a slow nod, Dane says, “See, as it turns out, sometimes a trader isn’t just a trader, and sometimes the business deal is actually a massive drug deal. I’m not talking small potatoes. This isn’t some guy getting Throbb for his frat brothers. I’m talking bonafide drug kingpin moving enough Dumbfuck to turn half a planet into sex-crazed sluts. They had tanks of the stuff hyper-concentrated in cryonic suspension.” Shaking his head, Dane explains, “Never seen the point of the stuff myself. You don’t need to drug a girl to get in her panties, just walk and take charge. She’ll be eating out of your hand in no time or run off. No point in wasting time with half-measures.”
rows.translation: 戴恩缓缓点头，说道：“事实证明，有时候商人并不只是商人，有时候商业交易其实是一笔巨额毒品交易。我说的可不是小打小闹。这不是某个家伙给兄弟会成员弄点悸动药。我说的是货真价实的毒枭，运送的降智药足以把半个星球都变成性爱成瘾的骚货。他们把高度浓缩的药物装在罐里低温悬浮保存。”戴恩摇着头解释道：“我自己从来不明白这种东西有什么用。想钻进女孩内裤里，根本不必给她下药，只要走过去掌握主动。她转眼间就会对你言听计从，否则便会跑掉。没必要把时间浪费在这种半吊子手段上。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBobbing his head in a slow nod, Dane says, “See, as it turns out, sometimes a trader isn’t just a trader, and sometimes the business deal is actually a massive drug deal. I’m not talking small potatoes. This isn’t some guy getting Throbb for his frat brothers. I’m talking bonafide drug kingpin moving enough Dumbfuck to turn half a planet into sex-crazed sluts. They had tanks of the stuff hyper-concentrated in cryonic suspension.” Shaking his head, Dane explains, “Never seen the point of the stuff myself. You don’t need to drug a girl to get in her panties, just walk and take charge. She’ll be eating out of your hand in no time or run off. No point in wasting time with half-measures.”"

rows.original: “What’d you do?”
rows.translation: “你做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’d you do?”"

rows.original: Dane leans back. “Do I look like an amateur? I did my fuckin’ job, and I did it like a pro.” His ears swivel around as he recounts the details. “I kept my eyes open because I’m not just hired muscle - I’m the total package,” Dane says, clapping his chest boastfully. “And sure enough, I spotted movement where there shouldn’t be movement. Something big creeping around outside a window: quadrupedal and scaling the outside of the building like a slug on a spire.”
rows.translation: 戴恩向后靠去。“我看起来像个业余选手吗？我他妈完成了工作，而且完成得像个专业人士。”他回忆细节时，双耳向四周转动。“我一直睁大眼睛，因为我可不只是受雇的肌肉——我是全能选手，”戴恩夸耀地拍着胸口说道。“果不其然，我发现了本不该出现的动静。有个大家伙正在窗外爬动：四足，像尖塔上的鼻涕虫一样攀爬建筑外墙。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane leans back. “Do I look like an amateur? I did my fuckin’ job, and I did it like a pro.” His ears swivel around as he recounts the details. “I kept my eyes open because I’m not just hired muscle - I’m the total package,” Dane says, clapping his chest boastfully. “And sure enough, I spotted movement where there shouldn’t be movement. Something big creeping around outside a window: quadrupedal and scaling the outside of the building like a slug on a spire.”"

rows.original: You ask what it was.
rows.translation: 你问那是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what it was."

rows.original: “Never got to find out exactly. I went to radio it in to the other guards and got static. Realized we were being jammed and raised a ruckus about it.” He laughs, “I’ve never seen so many toughs in suits shit bricks at once. Right away, it was obvious the seller didn’t know what was going on either. His goons took a second longer than ours to start racking slides and prepping for a fight. I slid into cover behind one of the canisters - not my brightest move, I know - and just stuck there, waiting.”
rows.translation: “一直没机会弄清楚。我刚想用无线电通知其他守卫，却只收到杂音。我意识到信号遭到干扰，于是大声示警。”他笑道，“我从没见过那么多穿西装的硬汉一起吓得屁滚尿流。很快就能看出，卖家也不知道出了什么事。他的打手比我们晚了一秒才开始给武器上膛、准备战斗。我滑进一个储罐后面躲好——我知道，这不是最聪明的做法——然后一直守在那里等待。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Never got to find out exactly. I went to radio it in to the other guards and got static. Realized we were being jammed and raised a ruckus about it.” He laughs, “I’ve never seen so many toughs in suits shit bricks at once. Right away, it was obvious the seller didn’t know what was going on either. His goons took a second longer than ours to start racking slides and prepping for a fight. I slid into cover behind one of the canisters - not my brightest move, I know - and just stuck there, waiting.”"

rows.original: Too late you realize that you’re leaning closer now that you’re invested in the tale. “And?”
rows.translation: 等你意识到自己因为沉浸在故事中而凑得更近时，已经太迟了。“然后呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nToo late you realize that you’re leaning closer now that you’re invested in the tale. “And?”"

rows.original: “And everything went to hell in a handbasket. Virtually every window in the place shattered at once.”
rows.translation: “然后一切都以最快速度彻底失控。那里几乎每一扇窗户都在同一时间碎裂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And everything went to hell in a handbasket. Virtually every window in the place shattered at once.”"

rows.original: “Cops?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cops?”"

rows.original: “Cops.” Dane nods. “Smart ones. They didn’t come through the windows - not with everyone and their grandsire spraying lead like a teenager with his first powder banger. No, they came through the floor. You shoulda seen it. One second, empty space. The next? A spike tipped piston rips open a hole right next to you and spits out a local attempt at a Peacekeeper.” The ausar mutters. “I got lucky. One of the other mercs, a new kid, was in the wrong place at the wrong time. I don’t envy his next of kin or the cop that had to step out into that mess.” He shudders.
rows.translation: “警察。”戴恩点头。“而且是聪明的警察。他们没从窗户进来——毕竟每个人和他们的老祖宗都在像第一次拿到火药枪的青少年一样疯狂扫射。不，他们是从地板下进来的。你真该亲眼看看。前一秒还空无一物，下一秒呢？一根尖头活塞就在你身旁撕开一个洞，吐出当地版本的和平卫士。”这名奥萨人嘟囔道。“我很走运。另一名佣兵是个新人，在错误的时间站在了错误的位置。我一点也不羡慕他的近亲，也不羡慕那个必须踏进那堆烂摊子的警察。”他打了个寒战。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cops.” Dane nods. “Smart ones. They didn’t come through the windows - not with everyone and their grandsire spraying lead like a teenager with his first powder banger. No, they came through the floor. You shoulda seen it. One second, empty space. The next? A spike tipped piston rips open a hole right next to you and spits out a local attempt at a Peacekeeper.” The ausar mutters. “I got lucky. One of the other mercs, a new kid, was in the wrong place at the wrong time. I don’t envy his next of kin or the cop that had to step out into that mess.” He shudders."

rows.original: You ask him how he got out.
rows.translation: 你问他是怎么脱身的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him how he got out."

rows.original: “Almost didn’t. The lead was really flying by that point, but my boss was right next to me, and I still needed to get paid.” Grinning at the remembered thrill of battle, Dane continues, “I dragged the creep into cover with me. The idiot tried to gouge my eyes out. Guess he thought I was one of the Peacekeeper wannabes at first. Lucky for me, I already had all four arms - plenty enough to pin up down with two to spare.” The smug mercenary takes a drink. “I knew the fuzz was all over our level and the level below judging by their insertion method. I also knew they had something outside and above, so heading for the roof for a pickup by ship was out of the question. We only had one option: the elevator shaft.”
rows.translation: “差点没逃出去。那时子弹已经满天飞，不过老板就在我身旁，而且我仍得拿到报酬。”戴恩回忆起战斗的刺激，咧嘴继续说道，“我把那个混蛋拖进掩体。他个蠢货还试图挖掉我的眼睛。我猜他一开始以为我是那些冒牌和平卫士之一。幸好我当时已经有四条手臂——两条足以把他按住，另外两条还有富余。”这名得意的佣兵喝了一口。“根据他们的突入方式，我知道条子已经布满我们这一层和下面一层。我还知道他们在外面和上方部署了某种东西，所以去屋顶等飞船接应根本不可能。我们只剩一个选择：电梯井。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Almost didn’t. The lead was really flying by that point, but my boss was right next to me, and I still needed to get paid.” Grinning at the remembered thrill of battle, Dane continues, “I dragged the creep into cover with me. The idiot tried to gouge my eyes out. Guess he thought I was one of the Peacekeeper wannabes at first. Lucky for me, I already had all four arms - plenty enough to pin up down with two to spare.” The smug mercenary takes a drink. “I knew the fuzz was all over our level and the level below judging by their insertion method. I also knew they had something outside and above, so heading for the roof for a pickup by ship was out of the question. We only had one option: the elevator shaft.”"

rows.original: “So you escaped the police by calling an elevator?”
rows.translation: “所以你按了电梯，就这样躲过警察？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you escaped the police by calling an elevator?”"

rows.original: “Hardly.” Dane scowls. “They were locked down already. No, I pried open the doors - still holding drugfuck mcgee - and climbed down like my life depended on it. Thirteen floors,” he recounts. “Thirteen floors I carried that humanoid sphincter down, all the way into the sub basement - below the cops. Then I just had to break into a utility access corridor and escape to the streets.”
rows.translation: “当然不是。”戴恩皱起眉头。“电梯早已被锁死。不，我撬开门——同时仍抓着那个毒品混蛋——然后像是性命攸关般一路向下爬。十三层，”他回忆道。“我抱着那个人形屁眼爬了十三层，一直下到警察下方的地下二层。之后只要闯进一条公用通道，再逃到街上就行了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hardly.” Dane scowls. “They were locked down already. No, I pried open the doors - still holding drugfuck mcgee - and climbed down like my life depended on it. Thirteen floors,” he recounts. “Thirteen floors I carried that humanoid sphincter down, all the way into the sub basement - below the cops. Then I just had to break into a utility access corridor and escape to the streets.”"

rows.original: You question if he’s really comfortable saving somebody like that.
rows.translation: 你问他，自己是否真的能心安理得地救下那种人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou question if he’s really comfortable saving somebody like that."

rows.original: Dane stares at you for a few seconds, crimson eyes narrowed. “Comfort has nothing to do with it. A man’s gotta put food on the table, and if I betray a client, even an awful one, I’ll never get a legit job again.” He leans closer. “Besides, I had a harem to feed back then. Whole other story, that one.” He waves dismissively. “Nah, I didn’t like saving somebody like that, but the cops were already on to him. I thought they’d have him in cuffs in no time.”
rows.translation: 戴恩眯起猩红双眼，盯着你看了几秒。“这跟心不心安毫无关系。男人总得赚钱养家；而且如果我背叛客户，哪怕对方是个混蛋，我也永远接不到正经工作了。”他凑近过来。“再说，我当时还有一个后宫要养。那就是另一个故事了。”他不屑地挥挥手。“不，我并不喜欢救那种人，但警察已经盯上他了。我以为他们很快就会给他戴上手铐。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane stares at you for a few seconds, crimson eyes narrowed. “Comfort has nothing to do with it. A man’s gotta put food on the table, and if I betray a client, even an awful one, I’ll never get a legit job again.” He leans closer. “Besides, I had a harem to feed back then. Whole other story, that one.” He waves dismissively. “Nah, I didn’t like saving somebody like that, but the cops were already on to him. I thought they’d have him in cuffs in no time.”"

rows.original: A harem huh? You might have to ask about that.
rows.translation: 后宫，是吗？你或许得问问这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\nA harem huh? You might have to ask about that."

rows.original: The albino ausar sips a bit of whiskey, grimacing from the aftertaste. “‘Course I was wrong. The weaselly little snake hooked up with the Black Void. Can’t touch him now.” He cracks his knuckles. “Who knows. Maybe I’ll bump into him in my next job and get the chance to play at being a lawman myself. That’s the nice part about being a mercenary - you get to do a little bit of everything.” Glancing your way, the hound for hire remarks, “A bit like being a Rusher, I suppose.”
rows.translation: 白化奥萨人抿了一口威士忌，因余味而皱起脸。“当然，我猜错了。那条油滑的小蛇后来搭上了黑色虚空。如今谁也动不了他。”他掰响指关节。“谁知道呢。也许下一份工作里我会碰见他，得到亲自扮演执法者的机会。这就是当佣兵的好处——什么事都能体验一点。”受雇猎犬瞥向你，说道：“我想，这有点像当星球探险者。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe albino ausar sips a bit of whiskey, grimacing from the aftertaste. “‘Course I was wrong. The weaselly little snake hooked up with the Black Void. Can’t touch him now.” He cracks his knuckles. “Who knows. Maybe I’ll bump into him in my next job and get the chance to play at being a lawman myself. That’s the nice part about being a mercenary - you get to do a little bit of everything.” Glancing your way, the hound for hire remarks, “A bit like being a Rusher, I suppose.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: “So where’s that harem you mentioned?”
rows.translation: “那你提到的后宫在哪里？”
rows.raw: "“So where’s that harem you mentioned?”"

rows.original: “You had a harem?”
rows.translation: “你有过后宫？”
rows.raw: "“You had a harem?”"

rows.original: Dane scratches the back of his head. “Guess I did mention that, didn’t I?”
rows.translation: 戴恩挠着后脑勺。“看来我的确提过这件事，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane scratches the back of his head. “Guess I did mention that, didn’t I?”"

rows.original: “Uh-huh!” You wiggle closer, leaning into the big galoot. “Sounds hot.”
rows.translation: “嗯哼！”你扭动着靠近这个大块头，贴上他的身体。“听起来真火辣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh-huh!” You wiggle closer, leaning into the big galoot. “Sounds hot.”"

rows.original: You nod, deciding to add a verbal ‘yep’ after it becomes clear that Dane wasn’t looking.
rows.translation: 你点点头，发现戴恩根本没在看后，又口头补上一句“对”。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, deciding to add a verbal ‘yep’ after it becomes clear that Dane wasn’t looking."

rows.original: “Yep!” You give the burly ausar an encouraging pat on the back. “Come on. You can’t drop a detail like that and not talk about it!”
rows.translation: “对！”你鼓励地拍了拍魁梧奥萨人的后背。“快说。你不能抛出这种细节，却又不继续讲下去！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep!” You give the burly ausar an encouraging pat on the back. “Come on. You can’t drop a detail like that and not talk about it!”"

rows.original: You elbow him in the side of the ribs. “Damn right you did. Don’t even think about holding back on the details either.”
rows.translation: 你用手肘撞了撞他的肋侧。“你当然说过。也别想隐瞒任何细节。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou elbow him in the side of the ribs. “Damn right you did. Don’t even think about holding back on the details either.”"

rows.original: “Fuck yes you did.” You lean hard on the bar, saying, “And not telling me all about it could be considered an act of war by some cultures.”
rows.translation: “你他妈当然说过。”你用力靠在吧台上，说道：“在某些文化里，不把这件事全部告诉我，可能会被视为战争行为。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck yes you did.” You lean hard on the bar, saying, “And not telling me all about it could be considered an act of war by some cultures.”"

rows.original: Dane raises an eyebrow. “Which cultures?”
rows.translation: 戴恩挑起眉毛。“哪些文化？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane raises an eyebrow. “Which cultures?”"

rows.original: “Doesn’t matter. Dish.”
rows.translation: “不重要。快说。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Doesn’t matter. Dish.”"

rows.original: Dane shrugs all four of his shoulders at once. “Guess I might as well start at the beginning. Didn’t set out to put together a harem or nothing. I was just a normal guy doing normal things - working out, making credits, and trying to find hot pieces of tail to bang on the weekends, you know?” He shakes his head in amusement. “Sure was a fuck of a lot simpler back then. ‘Course you can’t really beat having three cuties in your bed, even if it does get complicated quick.”
rows.translation: 戴恩同时耸起四个肩膀。“看来我最好从头说起。我本来没打算组建后宫什么的。我只是个过着普通生活的普通男人——锻炼、赚信用点，再设法找些性感美人周末狠狠干上一顿，明白吧？”他觉得好笑地摇头。“那时候生活确实他妈简单多了。当然，床上有三个可爱姑娘的感觉实在无可挑剔，哪怕事情很快会变得复杂。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane shrugs all four of his shoulders at once. “Guess I might as well start at the beginning. Didn’t set out to put together a harem or nothing. I was just a normal guy doing normal things - working out, making credits, and trying to find hot pieces of tail to bang on the weekends, you know?” He shakes his head in amusement. “Sure was a fuck of a lot simpler back then. ‘Course you can’t really beat having three cuties in your bed, even if it does get complicated quick.”"

rows.original: You ask how it started.
rows.translation: 你问事情是怎么开始的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask how it started."

rows.original: “Chydi’s how it started,” Dane grumbles. “Lithe little piece of ausar tail. She worked out at my gym, so I saw a fair amount of her with my own comings and goings. I didn’t even know she was into me at first.” He snorts. “I was so busy worrying about my own workout that I didn’t spare more than a glance at anyone else. Physique like this doesn’t just happen - even with mods helping. It still takes work, and lots of it, to sculpt yourself into a work of art.” The grinning ausar flexes an arm and plants a kiss upon his own bulging bicep. “Chydi understood that. She liked these beauties almost as much as I do.”
rows.translation: “事情是从琪迪开始的，”戴恩嘟囔道。“一只身材纤细的奥萨小美人。她也在我的健身房锻炼，所以我进进出出时经常看见她。一开始我甚至不知道她对我有意思。”他哼了一声。“我忙着操心自己的训练，根本没空多看其他人几眼。这样的体格不是凭空出现的——即使有改造帮助也一样。想把自己雕琢成艺术品，仍需付出努力，大量努力。”咧嘴笑着的奥萨人绷紧一条手臂，亲吻自己隆起的肱二头肌。“琪迪明白这一点。她喜欢这些宝贝，几乎和我一样喜欢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Chydi’s how it started,” Dane grumbles. “Lithe little piece of ausar tail. She worked out at my gym, so I saw a fair amount of her with my own comings and goings. I didn’t even know she was into me at first.” He snorts. “I was so busy worrying about my own workout that I didn’t spare more than a glance at anyone else. Physique like this doesn’t just happen - even with mods helping. It still takes work, and lots of it, to sculpt yourself into a work of art.” The grinning ausar flexes an arm and plants a kiss upon his own bulging bicep. “Chydi understood that. She liked these beauties almost as much as I do.”"

rows.original: You coo adoringly, eyes riveted to male’s bulging slab of muscle.
rows.translation: 你爱慕地轻呼，双眼牢牢盯着男子隆起的厚实肌肉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou coo adoringly, eyes riveted to male’s bulging slab of muscle."

rows.original: You grunt in acknowledgement.
rows.translation: 你哼了一声表示知道了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grunt in acknowledgement."

rows.original: You nod in understanding.
rows.translation: 你理解地点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in understanding."

rows.original: “Anyway, one day my usual errant glance noticed her full-on leering at me. rows.original: the woman growls. The weapon in her hand hums with a surge of power as the forks at the barrel crackle with electricity. “Remember those reports of more fights breakin’ out?”
rows.translation: 女人咆哮。她手中的武器伴随能量涌动发出嗡鸣，枪管前端的双叉噼啪闪烁电光。“还记得那些关于更多战斗爆发的报告吗？”
rows.raw: " the woman growls. The weapon in her hand hums with a surge of power as the forks at the barrel crackle with electricity. “Remember those reports of more fights breakin’ out?”"

rows.original: “Nah, too busy fuckin’,” the black-furred boy laughs, pushing the ausar girl down his rod with a firm hand. “Welp! You wandered into the wrong neighborhood, fucker. Take care of [pc.himHer], will ya, beautiful?”
rows.translation: “不记得，忙着操人呢，”黑毛男孩笑道，用一只手将奥萨女孩牢牢压在肉棒上。“好吧！你走错地盘了，混蛋。替我收拾[pc.himHer]，好吗，美人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah, too busy fuckin’,” the black-furred boy laughs, pushing the ausar girl down his rod with a firm hand. “Welp! You wandered into the wrong neighborhood, fucker. Take care of [pc.himHer], will ya, beautiful?”"

rows.original: The suited-up bun rolls her shoulders and grins. “As long as I get to keep [pc.himHer] after!”
rows.translation: 穿紧身服的兔子转了转肩膀，咧嘴一笑。“只要结束后能把[pc.himHer]留下！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe suited-up bun rolls her shoulders and grins. “As long as I get to keep [pc.himHer] after!”"

rows.original: Yeah, you’ve got something to say about - oh fuck!
rows.translation: 没错，你正有话要说。哦操！
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, you’ve got something to say about - oh fuck!"

rows.original: You jump backwards as her lightning gun discharges, sending a solid beam of crackling electricity out that hits the metal deck and arcs across the floor. Every hair you have stands on end as a powerful charge surges through you. Ow ow ow!
rows.translation: 她的闪电枪开火时，你向后跳开；一道噼啪作响的实心电束射出，击中金属甲板，沿地面形成电弧。强大电荷涌过身体，令每根毛发都竖了起来。疼疼疼！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou jump backwards as her lightning gun discharges, sending a solid beam of crackling electricity out that hits the metal deck and arcs across the floor. Every hair you have stands on end as a powerful charge surges through you. Ow ow ow!"

rows.original: You’ve gotten wetter since this all started, but something’s just happened that redefines your concept of being drenched. You place a protective hand to your belly, and note for the first time that the distension has begun to abate. You’re flooding between the legs... Oh shit...
rows.translation: 自从这一切开始，你变得更加湿润，可刚刚发生的事情重新定义了“湿透”这个概念。你把一只保护性的手放在腹部，第一次注意到膨胀已经开始消退。双腿之间正在被液体淹没...哦，糟了...
rows.raw: "You’ve gotten wetter since this all started, but something’s just happened that redefines your concept of being drenched. You place a protective hand to your belly, and note for the first time that the distension has begun to abate. You’re flooding between the legs... Oh shit..."

rows.original: At least you’re safe on your ship. You’d like to have the support of a doctor, but it’s just not possible right now.
rows.translation: 至少你在自己的飞船上很安全。你希望得到医生支持，可现在根本不可能。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least you’re safe on your ship. You’d like to have the support of a doctor, but it’s just not possible right now."

rows.original: You’re afraid and angry, suddenly realizing that you’re nowhere near professional medical care. There’s no helping it... you must give birth alone.
rows.translation: 你既害怕又愤怒，突然意识到附近根本没有专业医疗。没办法了...你必须独自生产。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re afraid and angry, suddenly realizing that you’re nowhere near professional medical care. There’s no helping it... you must give birth alone."

rows.original: At least you won’t be giving birth unassisted. Perhaps rationality, in the end, won out against the thought-depriving effects of your changed biology?
rows.translation: 至少你并非无人协助地生产。也许到了最后，理性战胜了改变后生理结构那剥夺思考能力的影响？
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least you won’t be giving birth unassisted. Perhaps rationality, in the end, won out against the thought-depriving effects of your changed biology?"

rows.original: The moment you scream, everyone nearby turns to you, rushing over to see what they can do to help. You needn’t explain yourself to the Peacekeepers in the group, they’re already acting on training. Emergency responders are on the scene in less than a minute, escorting you to their vehicle and hauling you off to the station’s hospital amid an applause filled with congratulatory smiles.
rows.translation: 你一尖叫，附近所有人便转身冲过来，看看能做些什么。你无需向人群中的维和人员解释，他们已经按训练开始行动。不到一分钟，急救人员便赶到现场，将你护送上车辆，在充满祝贺笑容的掌声中送往空间站医院。
rows.raw: "The moment you scream, everyone nearby turns to you, rushing over to see what they can do to help. You needn’t explain yourself to the Peacekeepers in the group, they’re already acting on training. rows.original: an alien royalty has its perks. Namely, being able to command the assistance of the resident nyreans and their queen on your final step through pregnancy. You’re taken to Taivra’s bedchamber and afforded all the care you could possibly need to make this birthing much less painful than it needs to be. All the water and blankets they can find are brought to your bedside

rows.translation: 几名行星开拓者与你擦肩而过。你解释了正在发生的事，他们便焦急地催促你前往大升降梯，下降到有救援等候的金米尔城市。
rows.raw: "A few rushers cross your path. You explain what’s going on before they anxiously hurry you to the great elevator and down to the gold myr city where help awaits."

rows.raw: "To your delight, a gold myr squad on patrol are at your side when you cry out for help."

rows.original: The sprawling Gildenmere hospital welcomes you immediately, and a team of professionals is assigned right away to your imminent birthing. A cozy bed is prepared and all possible amenities are provided
rows.translation: 广阔的吉尔登米尔医院立即接纳你，一支专业团队马上被指派处理迫在眉睫的分娩。一张舒适床铺准备妥当，所有可能用到的设施也一应俱全
rows.raw: " The sprawling Gildenmere hospital welcomes you immediately, and a team of professionals is assigned right away to your imminent birthing. A cozy bed is prepared and all possible amenities are provided"

rows.original: It could be worse. For instance, you could be somewhere far away from this insulated bunker and the fierce warrior lady who resides within. “Steele... you’re not...” she starts, “You’re giving birth, here!?” Krym looks flabbergasted, but wastes no time bringing you in from the cold and straight to her bed. She’s storming around the cozy little hideaway for anything that might be useful
rows.translation: 情况本可能更糟。比如，你可能身在离这座保温掩体和住在里面的勇猛女战士很远的地方。“斯蒂尔...你不会...”她开口道，“你要在这里生孩子！？”克里姆目瞪口呆，却没有浪费时间，立刻把你从寒冷中带进来，径直送上床。她在舒适的小藏身处里四处疾走，寻找一切可能派上用场的东西

You’re given the last bed and left in the capable hands of the tribe’s healer

rows.original: Pain consumes you almost immediately, and on a libertine paradise like New Texas nobody could miss your discomfort. Certainly, wherever two very bubbly cowgirls are hustling you now will be a safe enough place to give birth to your kids, far away from the easily excitable bulls that have cocked their heads in your direction. The two bosomy babes get you settled in their home,
