rows.translation: 并脱掉衣服后
rows.raw: " and your clothes are ditched"

rows.original: , you’re prepared to give birth on a rather comfy bed.
rows.translation: ，你便在一张相当舒适的床上做好了分娩准备。
rows.raw: ", you’re prepared to give birth on a rather comfy bed."

rows.original: zhèng shi station
rows.raw: "zhèng shi station"

rows.original: zhèng shi station
rows.raw: "zhèng shi station"

rows.original: Fuck... This is perhaps the worst possible place you can bring a child into the galaxy, but you won’t make the walk back to the hangar. Fortunately, there are a few dead ends in these mines that the pirates have long lost interest in. They’ll have to do. At least it’s a little cooler here than the network at large.
rows.translation: 操...这里也许是整个银河中最糟糕的生孩子地点，但你走不到机库了。幸好这些矿井里有几个海盗早已失去兴趣的死胡同。只能在那里生产。至少这里比整个矿道网络稍微凉快一点。
rows.raw: "Fuck... This is perhaps the worst possible place you can bring a child into the galaxy, but you won’t make the walk back to the hangar. Fortunately, there are a few dead ends in these mines that the pirates have long lost interest in. They’ll have to do. At least it’s a little cooler here than the network at large."

rows.original: zhèng shi station
rows.raw: "zhèng shi station"

rows.original: You keep your voice down lest any pirates on patrol catch wind of it. There are plenty of unused, prefab extensions to this floor, perfect for hiding away. On the way to such a secluded room, you’re at least able to find a crummy looking medkit with the barest essentials inside. It’ll have to do.
rows.translation: 你压低声音，免得任何巡逻海盗听见。这个楼层有大量闲置的预制扩建区，非常适合藏身。前往这种隐蔽房间途中，你至少找到了一只外观破烂的医疗包，里面有最基本的必需品。只能靠它了。
rows.raw: "You keep your voice down lest any pirates on patrol catch wind of it. There are plenty of unused, prefab extensions to this floor, perfect for hiding away. On the way to such a secluded room, you’re at least able to find a crummy looking medkit with the barest essentials inside. It’ll have to do."

rows.original: zhèng shi station
rows.raw: "zhèng shi station"

rows.original: It takes much too long to find a place safe enough, but you do. It’s going to hurt like hell, of that you have no doubt, but you remind yourself that these are the kinds of conditions people in history endured. If they can do it, why can’t you with all of today’s advancements marking you as a product of your time? You try to keep your mind off the dangers, breathing in rhythm, ready to go through this
rows.translation: 你花了太久才找到足够安全的地方，但终究找到了。你毫不怀疑这会疼得要命，不过仍提醒自己，历史上的人就是在这种条件下生产。如果他们能做到，身上带着当今种种进步、身为这个时代产物的你又为什么不行？你努力不去想那些危险，有节奏地呼吸，准备经历这件事
rows.raw: "It takes much too long to find a place safe enough, but you do. It’s going to hurt like hell, of that you have no doubt, but you remind yourself that these are the kinds of conditions people in history endured. If they can do it, why can’t you with all of today’s advancements marking you as a product of your time? You try to keep your mind off the dangers, breathing in rhythm, ready to go through this"

rows.original: after shucking your kit
rows.translation: ，在卸下装备以后
rows.raw: " after shucking your kit"

rows.original: A local
rows.translation: 一名当地
rows.raw: "A local "

rows.original: man
rows.translation: 男子
rows.raw: "man"

rows.original: woman
rows.translation: 女人
rows.raw: "woman"

rows.original: comes running at your distress. When the adrenaline runs its course, they have you in the hands of medical staff on your way to the local clinic. Once there, you’re given the coziest bed and prepared for birthing
rows.translation: 听见你的痛苦呼救便跑了过来。肾上腺素作用消退时，他们已经把你交到医疗人员手中，正在前往当地诊所。抵达后，你被安排到最舒适的床上，准备分娩
rows.raw: " comes running at your distress. When the adrenaline runs its course, they have you in the hands of medical staff on your way to the local clinic. Once there, you’re given the coziest bed and prepared for birthing"

rows.original: , your clothes having been removed on the way
rows.translation: ，衣服已在路上被脱掉
rows.raw: ", your clothes having been removed on the way"

rows.original: The heat of the mines mixes with your weakness, makes the gush of cream at your loins all the more noticeable. A cold rush of adrenaline flows when you hear hasty footsteps.
rows.translation: 矿井的热量混合着你的虚弱，让腰间涌出的乳白液体更加明显。听见急促脚步声时，一股冰冷的肾上腺素流遍全身。
rows.raw: "The heat of the mines mixes with your weakness, makes the gush of cream at your loins all the more noticeable. A cold rush of adrenaline flows when you hear hasty footsteps."

rows.original: Whilst you search for a safe place, a cold rush of adrenaline flows when the rapid ‘taptaptap’ of footsteps catches you off guard.
rows.translation: 你寻找安全地点时，急促的“嗒嗒嗒”脚步声令你措手不及，一股冰冷的肾上腺素流遍全身。
rows.raw: "Whilst you search for a safe place, a cold rush of adrenaline flows when the rapid ‘taptaptap’ of footsteps catches you off guard."

rows.original: You brace yourself for the worst, until three rats, decked out in their usual gear, stop short of you with worried looks on their faces. “[pc.Mister] CEO! What are you doing walking around like that? You can’t stay here! Come on, we know all the good hiding spots!”
rows.translation: 你做好最坏的准备，直到三只穿着惯常装备的老鼠在面前猛然停住，脸上满是担忧。“[pc.Mister]CEO！你这样还到处走什么？不能继续待在这里！快来，我们知道所有好藏身处！”
rows.raw: "You brace yourself for the worst, until three rats, decked out in their usual gear, stop short of you with worried looks on their faces. “[pc.Mister] CEO! What are you doing walking around like that? You can’t stay here! Come on, we know all the good hiding spots!”"

rows.original: The pink-furred rodenian and her entourage take you by the arms, lending you their oh-so small shoulders as they usher you into a maintenance room of sorts. It’s surprisingly cool and spacious; it’s perfect for your needs. The rascals set about scooping up whatever they could need to help, finding cloths, fabrics, water, anything that might help.
rows.translation: 粉毛罗德尼安人与随从挽住你的手臂，借出她们小得可怜的肩膀，将你送进一间类似维修室的地方。这里出乎意料地凉爽宽敞，完全适合你的需要。淘气鬼们开始搜集一切可能有用的东西，找来布料、织物、水，以及任何能帮上忙的物品。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pink-furred rodenian and her entourage take you by the arms, lending you their oh-so small shoulders as they usher you into a maintenance room of sorts. It’s surprisingly cool and spacious; it’s perfect for your needs. The rascals set about scooping up whatever they could need to help, finding cloths, fabrics, water, anything that might help."

rows.original: The last thing they do is help you out of your gear.
rows.translation: 她们做的最后一件事，是帮你卸下装备。
rows.raw: " The last thing they do is help you out of your gear."

rows.original: The worst possible thing to be right now is cold, and the chill of Uveto is biting deeply. Fortunately, Irestead is home to many people, and those many hardy folk are already at your side, helping you to your feet and barking orders at others while they carry you to safety. Inside a local care center you’re waited on by two doctors who get you into the warmest corner they can find before
rows.translation: 此刻最糟糕的情况就是受寒，而乌维托的严寒正深深刺入身体。幸好伊尔斯泰德住着许多人，这些坚韧居民已经赶到你身边；他们扶你起身，一边向其他人发号施令，一边将你送往安全处。在当地护理中心，两名医生照料着你，将你安置到他们所能找到的最温暖角落，然后
rows.raw: "The worst possible thing to be right now is cold, and the chill of Uveto is biting deeply. Fortunately, Irestead is home to many people, and those many hardy folk are already at your side, helping you to your feet and barking orders at others while they carry you to safety. Inside a local care center you’re waited on by two doctors who get you into the warmest corner they can find before"

rows.original: disrobing you and
rows.translation: 脱去你的衣服并
rows.raw: " disrobing you and"

rows.original: prepping you for birth.
rows.translation: 为分娩作准备。
rows.raw: " prepping you for birth."

rows.original: Novahome being what it is, you don’t expect there to be a med-station quite up to galactic standards, but there should be plenty of quiet places and even more breed-hungry raskvel to aid you. Sure enough, when you double over and show the tell-tale signs of birthing, a large group of wide-hipped kobold-bunnies usher you to safety, drawing you into a nice little hideaway much quieter than imagined.
rows.translation: 考虑到诺瓦之家的情况，你本就没指望这里会有符合银河标准的医疗站，但安静地点应该很多，渴望繁殖、愿意帮你的拉斯克维尔人则更多。果然，当你弯下身，表现出分娩的明显征兆时，一大群臀部宽阔的狗头人兔女将你送往安全处，带你进入一处比想象中安静得多的舒适藏身地。
rows.raw: "Novahome being what it is, you don’t expect there to be a med-station quite up to galactic standards, but there should be plenty of quiet places and even more breed-hungry raskvel to aid you. Sure enough, when you double over and show the tell-tale signs of birthing, a large group of wide-hipped kobold-bunnies usher you to safety, drawing you into a nice little hideaway much quieter than imagined."

rows.original: They have your clothes off in a jiffy.
rows.translation: 她们眨眼间便脱掉你的衣服。
rows.raw: " They have your clothes off in a jiffy."

rows.original: When you slump to your knees, the nearest rusher, a brawny
rows.translation: 当你跪倒在地时，最近的一名行星开拓者，一个强壮的
rows.raw: "When you slump to your knees, the nearest rusher, a brawny"

rows.original: Saurmorians
rows.raw: "Saurmorians"

rows.original: saurmorian
rows.translation: 索莫里安
rows.raw: " saurmorian"

rows.original: lizard-man
rows.translation: 蜥蜴人
rows.raw: " lizard-man"

rows.original: charges over. Your pants and groans, and your swollen belly, tell him all he needs to know. You’re scooped up into the giant dino-man’s warm arms - belly facing skyward - and rushed to the local clinic. Once inside, a doctor is all over you by the bedside with a squawking V-Ko droid opposite him
rows.translation: 冲了过来。你的喘息呻吟和肿胀腹部已告诉他需要知道的一切。巨型恐龙男将你抱进温暖双臂，腹部朝天，迅速送往当地诊所。进入后，一名医生立刻在床边照料你，对面还有一台嘎嘎叫的V-KO机器人
rows.raw: " charges over. Your pants and groans, and your swollen belly, tell him all he needs to know. You’re scooped up into the giant dino-man’s warm arms - belly facing skyward - and rushed to the local clinic. Once inside, a doctor is all over you by the bedside with a squawking V-Ko droid opposite him"

rows.original: removing your clothes
rows.translation: 脱去你的衣服
rows.raw: " removing your clothes"

rows.original: ESBETH MEDICAL OFFICE
rows.raw: "ESBETH MEDICAL OFFICE"

rows.original: Zil are no strangers to procreation, and when they notice you in the throes of childbirth, you are rushed to the healer’s hut. As an honored guest of Quinn’s, all possible anodynes are made available, including the soft hands that tend you at your weakest. The gentle handmaidens
rows.translation: 兹尔人对繁衍并不陌生；当他们发现你正经历分娩阵痛，便迅速将你送往治疗师的小屋。作为奎恩的贵客，所有可能的止痛手段都向你开放，包括在你最虚弱时照料你的温柔双手。温柔侍女们
rows.raw: "Zil are no strangers to procreation, and when they notice you in the throes of childbirth, you are rushed to the healer’s hut. As an honored guest of Quinn’s, all possible anodynes are made available, including the soft hands that tend you at your weakest. The gentle handmaidens"

rows.original: disrobe you and
rows.translation: 替你脱衣并
rows.raw: " disrobe you and"

rows.original: begin to guide you through the arduous process to come.
rows.translation: 开始引导你度过接下来艰苦的过程。
rows.raw: " begin to guide you through the arduous process to come."

rows.original: Spreading your legs is the only easy part of this tribulation. Labor aches tear through your body, overwriting all unpained nerves with the sensation before surging downward to your vagina
rows.translation: 分开双腿是这场磨难中唯一轻松的部分。分娩疼痛撕裂身体，以这种感觉覆盖所有尚未疼痛的神经，随后一路向下涌向你的阴道
rows.raw: "\n\nSpreading your legs is the only easy part of this tribulation. Labor aches tear through your body, overwriting all unpained nerves with the sensation before surging downward to your vagina"

rows.original: s
rows.translation: 们

rows.original: You’re on autopilot; your triumvirate of wombs soften and your cervixes dilate as your bundles of joy enter the galaxy.
rows.translation: 你全凭本能行动；三座子宫变得柔软，宫颈扩张，喜悦的结晶就此进入银河。
rows.raw: " You’re on autopilot; your triumvirate of wombs soften and your cervixes dilate as your bundles of joy enter the galaxy."

rows.original: You’re on autopilot; your gemini of wombs soften and your cervixes dilate as your bundles of joy enter the galaxy.
rows.translation: 你全凭本能行动；两座子宫变得柔软，宫颈扩张，喜悦的结晶就此进入银河。
rows.raw: " You’re on autopilot; your gemini of wombs soften and your cervixes dilate as your bundles of joy enter the galaxy."

rows.original: You’re on autopilot; your womb softens and your cervix dilates as your bundles of joy enter the galaxy.
rows.translation: 你全凭本能行动；子宫变得柔软，宫颈扩张，喜悦的结晶就此进入银河。
rows.raw: " You’re on autopilot; your womb softens and your cervix dilates as your bundles of joy enter the galaxy."

rows.original: You can feel the weight, the width, the diameter, the everything of the first little munchkin spreading your straining birthing canal wide between your body’s organ-clenching contractions.
rows.translation: 你能感觉到第一个小家伙的重量、宽度、直径，以及它的一切；在身体令器官绞紧的收缩之间，它将你吃力的产道撑得大大张开。
rows.raw: " You can feel the weight, the width, the diameter, the everything of the first little munchkin spreading your straining birthing canal wide between your body’s organ-clenching contractions."

rows.original: Considering how loose you are, it could be much worse
rows.translation: 考虑到你如此松弛，情况本可能糟糕得多
rows.raw: " Considering how loose you are, it could be much worse"

rows.original: , particularly as your pelvic structure widens to handle the process
rows.translation: ，尤其是骨盆结构也在拓宽，以承受这个过程
rows.raw: ", particularly as your pelvic structure widens to handle the process"

rows.original: Your tightness only makes this harder
rows.translation: 你的紧致只会令这一切更加艰难
rows.raw: " Your tightness only makes this harder"

rows.original: , not to mention it’s a pain on top of your reshaping pelvic structure
rows.translation: ，更别提正在重塑的骨盆结构又增添了一重痛苦
rows.raw: ", not to mention it’s a pain on top of your reshaping pelvic structure"

rows.original: The first laquine’s head emerges from your snug tunnel. Or rather, the <b>
rows.translation: 第一只拉奎因幼崽的脑袋从紧密通道中探出。或者更准确地说，先探出来的是<b>
rows.raw: "\n\nThe first laquine’s head emerges from your snug tunnel. Or rather, the <b>"

rows.original: upraised ears
rows.translation: 竖起的耳朵
rows.raw: "upraised ears"

rows.original: lop ears
rows.translation: 垂耳
rows.raw: "lop ears"

rows.original: do. You push, screaming with tears in your eyes until your first laquine baby pops out unceremoniously. You can’t focus on it at all, head thrown back in dissipating agony as the next one moves through. Another pair of floppy ears emerges, and another small rabbit squirms out
rows.translation: 。你不断用力，泪流满面地尖叫，直到第一只拉奎因宝宝毫无仪式感地弹了出来。你根本无法关注它；随着下一个孩子开始移动，脑袋因逐渐消散的剧痛而向后仰去。又一对软垂耳朵探出，又一只小兔子扭动着滑出
rows.raw: " do. You push, screaming with tears in your eyes until your first laquine baby pops out unceremoniously. You can’t focus on it at all, head thrown back in dissipating agony as the next one moves through. Another pair of floppy ears emerges, and another small rabbit squirms out"

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the quiet zil maidens.
rows.translation: ，被安静的兹尔侍女包裹起来并擦洗干净。
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the quiet zil maidens."

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the attending raskvel.
rows.translation: ，被在场的拉斯克维尔人包裹起来并擦洗干净。
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the attending raskvel."

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the healer-pup.
rows.translation: ，被治疗师幼犬包裹起来并擦洗干净。
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the healer-pup."

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the humming cowgirl.
rows.translation: ，被哼着小调的牛女包裹起来并擦洗干净。
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the humming cowgirl."

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the red-headed nurse.
rows.translation: ，被红发护士包裹起来并擦洗干净。
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the red-headed nurse."

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the rodenian and her friends. “Ohh, you’re doing fine, [pc.mister] CEO!” she chirps
rows.translation: ，被罗德尼安人和她的朋友包裹起来并擦洗干净。“哦，你做得很好，[pc.mister]CEO！”她清脆地说道
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the rodenian and her friends. “Ohh, you’re doing fine, [pc.mister] CEO!” she chirps"

rows.original: to be wrapped up and cleaned by the nurses at your side.
rows.translation: ，被你身边的护士包裹起来并擦洗干净。
rows.raw: " to be wrapped up and cleaned by the nurses at your side."

rows.original: After taking on both the oversexed rabbits in charge of a gang of bunny-pirates the way you did, pregnancy was as assured as continued cosmic expansion. While L.D.C. could only fill one womb, his bottom bitch filled the other
rows.translation: 你曾以那种方式一同承受两个性欲过剩的兔女；她们掌管着一群兔子海盗，所以怀孕就像宇宙继续膨胀一样不可避免。L.D.C.只能填满一座子宫，而他的头号婊子则填满了另外
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter taking on both the oversexed rabbits in charge of a gang of bunny-pirates the way you did, pregnancy was as assured as continued cosmic expansion. While L.D.C. could only fill one womb, his bottom bitch filled the other"

rows.original: two
rows.translation: 两座
rows.raw: " two"

rows.original: one
rows.translation: 其中一根
rows.raw: " one"

rows.original: so well that you can still remember the weight of her spunk. Well, now all you’ve been burdened with are their children, and you’re having them right now!
rows.translation: ，填得如此彻底，以至于你至今仍记得她精液的重量。好吧，如今压在你身上的只剩她们的孩子，而且你正在把他们生出来！
rows.raw: " so well that you can still remember the weight of her spunk. Well, now all you’ve been burdened with are their children, and you’re having them right now!"

rows.original: You idly fantasize about which color might pop out first, the blue or the black. Turns out,
rows.translation: 你心不在焉地幻想着哪种颜色会先冒出来，蓝色还是黑色。结果，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou idly fantasize about which color might pop out first, the blue or the black. Turns out,"

rows.original: to your surprise, it’s the black. Your first born child is a jet-black bunny with upright ears. How fitting!
rows.translation: 出乎意料，是黑色。第一个出生的孩子是一只长着竖耳、漆黑如墨的兔子。真合适！
rows.raw: " to your surprise, it’s the black. Your first born child is a jet-black bunny with upright ears. How fitting!"

rows.original: it’s the blue. No surprise! The Hopper was the one who seemed to be on top of things! Why wouldn’t her kids take precedence?
rows.translation: 是蓝色。毫不意外！跳虫当时显然才是掌控局面的那个！她的孩子为什么不该优先？
rows.raw: " it’s the blue. No surprise! The Hopper was the one who seemed to be on top of things! Why wouldn’t her kids take precedence?"

rows.original: The pain you feel between your waist-expanding contractions is nothing compared to the sensations of when you drained Zhèng Shi’s top buns, when your sexual prowess put them in their rightful places.
rows.translation: 腰间因收缩而扩张时带来的疼痛，和你榨干郑石空间站顶级兔女时的感觉根本无法相比；那时你的性能力让她们回到了应有的位置。
rows.raw: " The pain you feel between your waist-expanding contractions is nothing compared to the sensations of when you drained Zhèng Shi’s top buns, when your sexual prowess put them in their rightful places."

rows.original: And of course, their buns in your oven!
rows.translation: 当然，她们的兔崽子也进了你的烤箱！
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd of course, their buns in your oven!"

rows.original: The next one to flop out is
rows.translation: 下一只瘫软滑出的宝宝
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next one to flop out is"

rows.original: all blue and creamy white like the Hopper!
rows.translation: 全身蓝色与乳白色，和跳虫一模一样！
rows.raw: " all blue and creamy white like the Hopper!"

rows.original: midnight-black. L.D.C.’s kids are like little soot sprites rather than bunnies!
rows.translation: 漆黑如午夜。L.D.C.的孩子与其说是兔子，不如说像小煤灰精灵！
rows.raw: " midnight-black. L.D.C.’s kids are like little soot sprites rather than bunnies!"

rows.original: Bearing the fruits of two powerful breeders is a pleasure all on its own. You can’t wait to hold them in your arms, to raise them right, to take from such criminals like those two and make wonderful children all on your own! Maybe you can go back and ‘redeem’ those tricksy rabbits when you’re done?
rows.translation: 孕育两个强大繁殖者的成果本身就是一种快乐。你等不及要将他们抱进怀里，好好抚养；从那两个罪犯手中取得孩子，再凭自己将他们养成出色的人！也许结束以后，你还能回去“感化”那两只狡猾兔子？
rows.raw: " Bearing the fruits of two powerful breeders is a pleasure all on its own. You can’t wait to hold them in your arms, to raise them right, to take from such criminals like those two and make wonderful children all on your own! Maybe you can go back and ‘redeem’ those tricksy rabbits when you’re done?"

rows.original: For now though, you’ve gotta tough this out.
rows.translation: 不过眼下，你必须咬牙撑过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor now though, you’ve gotta tough this out."

rows.original: No big deal! If you could handle those two with your body, then giving birth is nothing!
rows.translation: 没什么大不了！如果身体能够承受那两个家伙，生孩子就根本不算什么！
rows.raw: " No big deal! If you could handle those two with your body, then giving birth is nothing!"

rows.original: Which is easy. You were able to handle those two at their best and shrug it off like it was nothing. You’re too strong to be put down by a few aches and pains.
rows.translation: 这很容易。你曾承受处于最佳状态的那两个家伙，还像什么都没发生般挺了过来。你太强大，不可能被区区几阵酸痛击倒。
rows.raw: " Which is easy. You were able to handle those two at their best and shrug it off like it was nothing. You’re too strong to be put down by a few aches and pains."

rows.original: You’ve got your eyes wide open, though you can’t really put voice to anything. There’s a deep excitement whenever you see a pair of ears part your vaginal lips and flop out into the universe, covered in a sheen of you.
rows.translation: 你睁大双眼，却几乎发不出任何声音。每当看见一对耳朵分开阴唇、浑身覆着你的体液掉进这个宇宙，内心都会升起一股深深的兴奋。
rows.raw: " You’ve got your eyes wide open, though you can’t really put voice to anything. There’s a deep excitement whenever you see a pair of ears part your vaginal lips and flop out into the universe, covered in a sheen of you."

rows.original: You’re not sure where it started and how it’s going to end, but you’ve given birth to several kids already.
rows.translation: 你不知道这一切从何开始，又会如何结束，但已经生下了好几个孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure where it started and how it’s going to end, but you’ve given birth to several kids already."

rows.original: Three
rows.translation: 三
rows.raw: " Three"

rows.original: Two
rows.translation: 两
rows.raw: " Two"

rows.original: whole litters are piled up in a sprawling pool of mewling munchkins,
rows.translation: 整窝幼崽堆积在一大片喵喵叫的小家伙中，
rows.raw: " whole litters are piled up in a sprawling pool of mewling munchkins, "

rows.original: laquine boys, girls, hermaphrodites, there’s every combination you could imagine! Some with little fur, some totally coated in it, but they’re all the offspring of your piratical tryst. All-black and blue and vanilla coats or limbs shimmer; eyes not even opened yet, they cry out quietly for you.
rows.translation: 有拉奎因男孩、女孩和双性人，各种能想象到的组合应有尽有！有些毛发稀疏，有些全身覆满毛皮，但他们都是你与海盗苟合后留下的后代。漆黑、蓝色、香草色的毛皮或肢体闪烁着光泽；他们甚至还没睁眼，便轻声呼唤着你。
rows.raw: " laquine boys, girls, hermaphrodites, there’s every combination you could imagine! Some with little fur, some totally coated in it, but they’re all the offspring of your piratical tryst. All-black and blue and vanilla coats or limbs shimmer; eyes not even opened yet, they cry out quietly for you."

rows.original: You giggle happily, not even realizing the pain has passed. No sense in wasting any more time: you reach over and pull them all into your arms, a positively delightful and bubbly heat blossoming throughout your soul.
rows.translation: 你快乐地咯咯笑着，甚至没有意识到疼痛已经过去。没必要继续浪费时间：你伸手将所有孩子都搂进怀里，一股无比愉快活泼的热意在灵魂中绽放。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou giggle happily, not even realizing the pain has passed. No sense in wasting any more time: you reach over and pull them all into your arms, a positively delightful and bubbly heat blossoming throughout your soul."

rows.original: Curiously, it ends there. The hormonal weight on your mind lifts, and a cold sweat washes over your body between the fading spasmic pains. There are faint little squeals that bring your brain back to reality between the waves of endorphins. The reality being that you’ve safely given birth to two laquines,
rows.translation: 奇怪的是，到这里便结束了。压在脑海中的激素重量消退；痉挛疼痛逐渐淡去时，冷汗冲刷全身。内啡肽浪潮之间，微弱尖叫令你的大脑回归现实。现实就是，你已经安全生下了两个拉奎因宝宝，
rows.raw: "\n\nCuriously, it ends there. The hormonal weight on your mind lifts, and a cold sweat washes over your body between the fading spasmic pains. There are faint little squeals that bring your brain back to reality between the waves of endorphins. The reality being that you’ve safely given birth to two laquines,"

rows.original: with mixed colors, one part of the palette containing your [pc.hairColor] hair for fur up and down their tiny sizes.
rows.translation: 他们颜色混杂，其中一部分色彩以你的[pc.hairColor]头发作为覆盖幼小身体的毛皮。
rows.raw: " with mixed colors, one part of the palette containing your [pc.hairColor] hair for fur up and down their tiny sizes."

rows.original: You lean over and scoop the twins into your [pc.arms], gently wiping the ‘you’ off of their faces while their tiny hands reach out for their mother. You just want to hold them close forever, to always remember how wonderful this moment right here, right now, is, and will always be. A warmth as fuzzy as your offspring dominates your recovering form...
rows.translation: 你俯身将双胞胎抱进[pc.arms]，轻柔擦掉他们脸上的“你”，而他们的小手则朝母亲伸来。你只想永远紧紧抱住他们，永远记得此时此刻有多么美妙，现在如此，将来也永远如此。一股如同后代毛皮般柔软的温暖占据你逐渐恢复的身体...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean over and scoop the twins into your [pc.arms], gently wiping the ‘you’ off of their faces while their tiny hands reach out for their mother. You just want to hold them close forever, to always remember how wonderful this moment right here, right now, is, and will always be. A warmth as fuzzy as your offspring dominates your recovering form..."

rows.original: You’ve got more coming, but it does get noticeably easier. Your neck muscles dry up as your grunts and moans dissolve into gravelly rasps of relenting anguish.
rows.translation: 还有更多孩子即将出生，但过程确实明显变得容易。你的颈部肌肉渐渐无力，闷哼与呻吟化成沙哑嘶声，透露出逐渐缓解的痛苦。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve got more coming, but it does get noticeably easier. Your neck muscles dry up as your grunts and moans dissolve into gravelly rasps of relenting anguish."

rows.original: One more rabbit falls from your hole, landing next to its siblings.
rows.translation: 又一只兔子从洞口落下，掉在兄弟姐妹身旁。
rows.raw: " One more rabbit falls from your hole, landing next to its siblings."

rows.original: Another rabbit falls out closely tailed by another, flopping into the world next to their siblings.
rows.translation: 另一只兔子滑出，后面又紧跟着一只，一同软软落进这个世界，来到兄弟姐妹身边。
rows.raw: " Another rabbit falls out closely tailed by another, flopping into the world next to their siblings."

rows.original: It’s hard to believe, but you can feel three rabbits in your hole
rows.translation: 难以置信，但你能感觉三只兔子此刻正在你的洞口中
rows.raw: " It’s hard to believe, but you can feel three rabbits in your hole"

rows.original: s
rows.translation: 们

rows.original: right now, emerging at roughly the same time from your capable body and flopping out next to their siblings.
rows.translation: ，它们几乎同时从你能干的身体里探出，软软落在兄弟姐妹身边。
rows.raw: " right now, emerging at roughly the same time from your capable body and flopping out next to their siblings."

rows.original: Your bloated belly noticeable compresses when two rabbits flop out in front of you, followed closely by two others from
rows.translation: 两只兔子掉到面前时，你臃肿的腹部明显瘪下，紧接着又有两只从
rows.raw: " Your bloated belly noticeable compresses when two rabbits flop out in front of you, followed closely by two others from"

rows.original: separate holes.
rows.translation: 不同洞口滑出。
rows.raw: " separate holes."

rows.original: the same hole.
rows.translation: 同一个洞口滑出。
rows.raw: " the same hole."

rows.original: Undoubtedly, you’re carrying a full litter; you loose an animalistic growl, immersed in some twisted gestalt of euphoria as you feel all of them pushing through your stretching tunnel. Ears, hands, and digitigrade feet emerge from your overstretched cavern; your last screams carry them the rest of the way through
rows.translation: 毫无疑问，你怀着完整一窝孩子；感受它们全部挤过不断扩张的通道时，你发出野兽般低吼，沉浸在某种扭曲融合的狂喜中。耳朵、双手与趾行脚从过度拉伸的洞穴探出；你最后的尖叫将它们送完余下路程，穿过
rows.raw: " Undoubtedly, you’re carrying a full litter; you loose an animalistic growl, immersed in some twisted gestalt of euphoria as you feel all of them pushing through your stretching tunnel. Ears, hands, and digitigrade feet emerge from your overstretched cavern; your last screams carry them the rest of the way through"

rows.original: separate holes
rows.translation: 不同洞口
rows.raw: " separate holes"

rows.original: the same hole
rows.translation: 同一个洞口
rows.raw: " the same hole"

rows.original: until they’re all flopping out into a pile of weighty, mewling bunnies, some with little fur and others totally coated.
rows.translation: ，直到它们全部瘫软滑出，堆成一团沉甸甸、喵喵叫的兔宝宝；有些毛发稀疏，另一些则全身覆满毛皮。
rows.raw: " until they’re all flopping out into a pile of weighty, mewling bunnies, some with little fur and others totally coated."

rows.original: The pain clears up; endorphins and adrenaline are chucking through your system at record levels. A weight on your mind eases and vanishes, leaving you feeling cold and relieved -- sucking for air is the most you manage. You can now clearly hear the squeals of your children, waiting for their first meal. Once your vision realigns, you take in their features, leaning up and over to bring them into your [pc.arms].
rows.translation: 疼痛消退；内啡肽与肾上腺素正以创纪录水平冲过身体。压在心头的重量减轻并消失，留下寒冷与释然，你最多只能拼命吸气。现在已能清楚听见孩子们尖叫，等待第一顿饭。视野重新对焦后，你端详他们的特征，俯身将他们抱进[pc.arms]。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pain clears up; endorphins and adrenaline are chucking through your system at record levels. A weight on your mind eases and vanishes, leaving you feeling cold and relieved -- sucking for air is the most you manage. You can now clearly hear the squeals of your children, waiting for their first meal. Once your vision realigns, you take in their features, leaning up and over to bring them into your [pc.arms]."

rows.original: You’ve given birth to
rows.translation: 你生下了
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve given birth to "

rows.original: laquines, a variety of girls, boys, and natural hermaphrodites. Each one is painted with varying amounts of fur, pelts of mixed colors including your [pc.hairColor] hair!
rows.translation: 个拉奎因宝宝，包括各种女孩、男孩与天生双性人。每个孩子身上都分布着不同程度的毛发，混合色毛皮中甚至包括你的[pc.hairColor]头发！
rows.raw: " laquines, a variety of girls, boys, and natural hermaphrodites. Each one is painted with varying amounts of fur, pelts of mixed colors including your [pc.hairColor] hair!"

rows.original: Scooping them up into your arms is one of the most enjoyable things you can say you’ve ever done. Joyfulness buzzes throughout your body with a rich, creamy texture. There’s something all too intoxicating about the way they grasp cutely at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Brief, ecstatic fantasies about who and what they might become fill your mind too.
rows.translation: 将他们捧进怀里，是你可以称作此生最愉快的经历之一。快乐以浓郁乳脂般的质感在全身嗡鸣。他们可爱地抓住你的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]，这种感觉实在令人陶醉。关于他们会长成怎样、成为何人的短暂狂喜幻想也充满脑海。
rows.raw: "\n\nScooping them up into your arms is one of the most enjoyable things you can say you’ve ever done. Joyfulness buzzes throughout your body with a rich, creamy texture. There’s something all too intoxicating about the way they grasp cutely at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Brief, ecstatic fantasies about who and what they might become fill your mind too."

rows.original: If you thought it was going to get any easier, you were dead wrong --
rows.translation: 如果以为过程会变得更轻松，那你就大错特错了；
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you thought it was going to get any easier, you were dead wrong -- "

rows.original: all
rows.translation: 所有
rows.raw: "all"

rows.original: both
rows.translation: 两者
rows.raw: "both"

rows.original: of your holes stretch and squirm against each other with the weight and form of multiple laquines squishing through them. Lop and upright ears poke through your widening slits, the contractions not enough to push them out, needing your aid to do it. And provide it you do, squealing yourself hoarse as several children pop out, followed by more, more...
rows.translation: 你的洞口在多只拉奎因幼崽挤过时，承受着它们的重量与形状，彼此拉伸扭动。垂耳与竖耳从不断扩张的裂口探出；宫缩不足以把他们推出，需要你的帮助。而你确实提供了帮助，尖叫到嗓音沙哑，几个孩子弹出，接着又是更多、更多...
rows.raw: " of your holes stretch and squirm against each other with the weight and form of multiple laquines squishing through them. Lop and upright ears poke through your widening slits, the contractions not enough to push them out, needing your aid to do it. And provide it you do, squealing yourself hoarse as several children pop out, followed by more, more..."

rows.original: Distracting yourself with idle, pain-fragmented fantasies is the best you can do. It’ll be over soon, you think to yourself; your kids sound and look so healthy! you mentally utter. Sure, you only caught the briefest glimpse before another hip-extending contraction slipped another laquine through, but the growing volume of hungry babies tells you that you’re doing just fine
rows.translation: 你所能做的最好办法，就是用闲散而被疼痛撕碎的幻想分散注意。很快就会结束，你心想；孩子们听起来、看起来都很健康！你在脑中低语。没错，在下一次扩开臀胯的宫缩又送出一个拉奎因宝宝前，你只匆匆看了一眼，但饥饿婴儿越来越响亮的声音告诉你，一切进展顺利
rows.raw: "\n\nDistracting yourself with idle, pain-fragmented fantasies is the best you can do. It’ll be over soon, you think to yourself; your kids sound and look so healthy! you mentally utter. Sure, you only caught the briefest glimpse before another hip-extending contraction slipped another laquine through, but the growing volume of hungry babies tells you that you’re doing just fine"

rows.original: , the encouragements of your attendants notwithstanding
rows.translation: ，且不论身边照料者的鼓励
rows.raw: ", the encouragements of your attendants notwithstanding"

rows.original: Adrenaline, endorphins, and a little serotonin have you slowly deflating your stomach one neonate critter at a time.
rows.translation: 肾上腺素、内啡肽与少量血清素，让你的肚子随着新生小家伙一个接一个出生而慢慢瘪下。
rows.raw: "\n\nAdrenaline, endorphins, and a little serotonin have you slowly deflating your stomach one neonate critter at a time."

rows.original: Your sizeable litter continues to swell in size. So many yous, unable to open their eyes, are huddling together with twitching noses and soft squeals. The final bun flops out into the galaxy when you’re on the verge of slipping into unconsciousness.
rows.translation: 你那规模可观的一窝孩子继续增加。如此多个微小的你尚且睁不开眼，正挤在一起，鼻子抽动，发出柔软尖叫。你快要陷入昏迷时，最后一只兔宝宝软软掉进银河。
rows.raw: " Your sizeable litter continues to swell in size. So many yous, unable to open their eyes, are huddling together with twitching noses and soft squeals. The final bun flops out into the galaxy when you’re on the verge of slipping into unconsciousness."

rows.original: You’ve given birth to a sizeable litter, and to your great relief, the pain begins to fade away when the last little bun flops out into the galaxy.
rows.translation: 你生下了规模可观的一窝孩子；令你极其宽慰的是，最后一只小兔宝宝软软掉进银河后，疼痛终于开始消退。
rows.raw: " You’ve given birth to a sizeable litter, and to your great relief, the pain begins to fade away when the last little bun flops out into the galaxy."

rows.original: You pant, heave, and pant some more, finally able to sit up and take stock of your children.
rows.translation: 你喘息、深呼吸，又继续喘息，终于能够坐起身，查看自己的孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pant, heave, and pant some more, finally able to sit up and take stock of your children. "

rows.original: laquines are huddled in a pile. Girls, boys, natural hermaphrodites, you’ve given birth to just about every combination of space-rabbit there is. Their furs are shimmery, if a little reddened with your innards. Some have full coats, others only have it on their limbs. The colors are all similar though;
rows.translation: 个拉奎因宝宝挤成一团。有女孩、男孩、天生双性人，你几乎生下了太空兔的每种组合。他们的毛皮闪闪发亮，尽管被你体内的东西染得有些发红。有些全身覆毛，另一些只有肢体长毛。不过颜色都很相似；
rows.raw: " laquines are huddled in a pile. Girls, boys, natural hermaphrodites, you’ve given birth to just about every combination of space-rabbit there is. Their furs are shimmery, if a little reddened with your innards. Some have full coats, others only have it on their limbs. The colors are all similar though;"

rows.original: they have wildly contrasting colors, the majority of the palette containing your [pc.hairColor]!
rows.translation: 他们带有对比强烈的各种颜色，其中大部分色彩都是你的[pc.hairColor]！
rows.raw: " they have wildly contrasting colors, the majority of the palette containing your [pc.hairColor]!"

rows.original: You let out a soft huff as you slump forward, bringing the first few into your [pc.arms]. There’s something undeniably magical about the act. Seeing them is one thing, but holding them... the inner jubilation you feel is a delight you wish never to end. Your mind drifts to thoughts of their futures, gleefully imagining them as happy as you are right now.
rows.translation: 你轻轻呼出一口气，身体向前瘫去，将最前面的几个孩子抱进[pc.arms]。这种行为无疑带有某种魔力。看见他们是一回事，但亲手抱住他们...内心的欢腾是一种你希望永不结束的喜悦。思绪飘向他们的未来，兴高采烈地想象他们也像此刻的你一样幸福。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let out a soft huff as you slump forward, bringing the first few into your [pc.arms]. There’s something undeniably magical about the act. Seeing them is one thing, but holding them... the inner jubilation you feel is a delight you wish never to end. Your mind drifts to thoughts of their futures, gleefully imagining them as happy as you are right now."

rows.original: The sheer amount of pain you’re in is indescribable. Excruciating is the understatement of the year, the century, the fucking millennium. It hurts. And it’s all worth it just to feel one, two, three little critters all wiggling their way down your snug passages. You were filled to the brim with a laquine’s seed, and now you’re bearing the fruits of coitus with a gifted breeder. You could not be happier, but you could not be in any more agony than you are. Certainly, nothing will ever compare to this, mothering three litters all at once.
rows.translation: 你所承受的痛苦根本无法形容。说是极度痛苦，都堪称本年度、本世纪、甚至他妈整个千年以来最轻描淡写的说法。疼死了。但只要能感觉一只、两只、三只小家伙全都沿紧密通道扭动前进，一切便值得。你曾被拉奎因人的种子灌得满满当当，如今正孕育与天赋异禀的繁殖者交配后结出的果实。你不可能更加幸福，也不可能比此刻承受更深的痛苦。世上肯定没有任何事能与此相比，一次成为整整三窝孩子的母亲。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sheer amount of pain you’re in is indescribable. Excruciating is the understatement of the year, the century, the fucking millennium. It hurts. And it’s all worth it just to feel one, two, three little critters all wiggling their way down your snug passages. You were filled to the brim with a laquine’s seed, and now you’re bearing the fruits of coitus with a gifted breeder. You could not be happier, but you could not be in any more agony than you are. Certainly, nothing will ever compare to this, mothering three litters all at once. "

rows.original: Saving your strength for your rippling loins somehow keeps you conscious during this ordeal. Were you ranting or grousing, you might not have as much a hold on reality as you do. Indeed, some part of you thinks that being anesthetized for this would be a cowardly way out...
rows.translation: 把力气留给不断起伏的腰胯，不知为何竟让你在这场磨难中保持清醒。如果一直咆哮抱怨，你对现实的把握或许不会像现在这样牢固。事实上，你内心某个部分认为，为此接受麻醉是懦弱的逃避方式...
rows.raw: "\n\nSaving your strength for your rippling loins somehow keeps you conscious during this ordeal. Were you ranting or grousing, you might not have as much a hold on reality as you do. Indeed, some part of you thinks that being anesthetized for this would be a cowardly way out..."

rows.original: Fantasies of how they will look, the sounds they make when they add themselves to the fuzzy pile of newborn runts, it all keeps you going. You can’t pass out. You must not pass out. You’re the mother of three entire laquine litters. They need you, and you need to be there for them. And so, you push. You scream yourself into hoarseness, barely keeping your thighs down and spread, making sure your distending waistline aims the rapidly squirming bundles next to their siblings.
rows.translation: 想象他们会长成什么模样，想象他们加入毛茸茸的新生幼崽堆时发出的声音，这一切都支撑着你。不能昏过去。绝对不能昏过去。你是整整三窝拉奎因宝宝的母亲。他们需要你，你也必须陪在身边。于是你继续用力。你尖叫到嗓音沙哑，勉强让双腿保持放下并分开的姿势，确保不断扩张的腰围把迅速扭动的宝宝送到兄弟姐妹身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nFantasies of how they will look, the sounds they make when they add themselves to the fuzzy pile of newborn runts, it all keeps you going. You can’t pass out. You must not pass out. You’re the mother of three entire laquine litters. They need you, and you need to be there for them. And so, you push. You scream yourself into hoarseness, barely keeping your thighs down and spread, making sure your distending waistline aims the rapidly squirming bundles next to their siblings."

rows.original: Every time you feel a pair of lips spread and a fuzzy boulder pass, another takes its place, and then two more beside it. You grit your teeth and play back in your mind whatever you think might help. A funny movie you watched in your younger years. A book you read a dozen times. That weird gift you got during a holiday. It doesn’t matter, just... you just need something to hold on to.
rows.translation: 每当感觉一对唇瓣分开、一个毛茸茸的巨石经过，另一个就会取代其位置，旁边还会再来两个。你咬紧牙关，在脑海中回放一切可能帮上忙的东西。年轻时看过的搞笑电影。读过十几遍的书。某个节日收到的古怪礼物。什么都无所谓，只是...你需要某样能够抓住不放的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvery time you feel a pair of lips spread and a fuzzy boulder pass, another takes its place, and then two more beside it. You grit your teeth and play back in your mind whatever you think might help. A funny movie you watched in your younger years. A book you read a dozen times. That weird gift you got during a holiday. It doesn’t matter, just... you just need something to hold on to."

rows.original: You’re inhaling so hard that your ribcage shows through your [pc.skinFurScales]. Color drains from your cheeks and lips, spread wide and strained just as badly as your vaginal trio. Lop and upraised ears both stick out then flip over adorably, more, more... you have no idea what the count is, only that you’re a mother who’s bringing so many kids into this galaxy.
rows.translation: 你如此用力吸气，肋骨轮廓都透过[pc.skinFurScales]显现。脸颊和嘴唇失去血色；三条阴道也同样大张着，承受不堪。垂耳与竖耳一同伸出，随后可爱地翻倒；更多、更多...你根本不知道数量，只知道自己是个正把许多孩子带进银河的母亲。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re inhaling so hard that your ribcage shows through your [pc.skinFurScales]. Color drains from your cheeks and lips, spread wide and strained just as badly as your vaginal trio. Lop and upraised ears both stick out then flip over adorably, more, more... you have no idea what the count is, only that you’re a mother who’s bringing so many kids into this galaxy."

rows.original: And then... it just ends. You didn’t even feel the last one shirk your internal protection, only the relieving weight of adrenaline and endorphins beginning the slow cleanse of your body. There’s only a tiny lurch in your [pc.fingers], a little thrum in your [pc.legsNoun]. There’s a hollow gasp before you can finally sit up, an exceedingly difficult thing to do. But so, so worth it...
rows.translation: 接着...一切就这样结束了。你甚至没感觉最后一个孩子脱离体内保护，只感觉肾上腺素与内啡肽带来的舒缓重量开始慢慢洗净身体。[pc.fingers]只轻微抽动，[pc.legsNoun]也只是轻轻悸动。你空洞地喘息一声，终于能够坐起来，尽管这是极其困难的动作。但一切实在太、太值得了...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd then... it just ends. You didn’t even feel the last one shirk your internal protection, only the relieving weight of adrenaline and endorphins beginning the slow cleanse of your body. There’s only a tiny lurch in your [pc.fingers], a little thrum in your [pc.legsNoun]. There’s a hollow gasp before you can finally sit up, an exceedingly difficult thing to do. But so, so worth it..."

rows.original: When you look down to the mound of squeals and twitching ears, your heart flutters. It feels so light that it might just be floating away to heaven, enraptured by the sight. Your
rows.translation: 低头看向那堆尖叫与抽动的耳朵时，你的心脏随之悸动。它感觉轻得仿佛会直接飘上天堂，被眼前景象迷得神魂颠倒。你的
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you look down to the mound of squeals and twitching ears, your heart flutters. It feels so light that it might just be floating away to heaven, enraptured by the sight. Your "

rows.original: children all huddle together for warmth, each covered in a little bit of you. It’s no surprise you’ve just spawned every conceivable combination of laquine there is: boys, girls, hermaphrodites, lop-ears, upraised ears, furry limbs, totally furry, there’s almost too much to take in. Despite being marred by a little internal sheen,
rows.translation: 个孩子全都依偎在一起取暖，每个身上都覆盖着少许来自你的东西。你刚刚生出了能想象到的每一种拉奎因组合，这毫不奇怪：男孩、女孩、双性人、垂耳、竖耳、肢体覆毛、全身覆毛，几乎多得让人看不过来。尽管沾染了一点体内的光泽，
rows.raw: " children all huddle together for warmth, each covered in a little bit of you. It’s no surprise you’ve just spawned every conceivable combination of laquine there is: boys, girls, hermaphrodites, lop-ears, upraised ears, furry limbs, totally furry, there’s almost too much to take in. Despite being marred by a little internal sheen,"

rows.original: the contrasting colors of their pelts - the majority of it being your [pc.hairColor] - is beautiful.
rows.translation: 他们毛皮上对比鲜明的色彩仍十分美丽，其中大部分都是你的[pc.hairColor]。
rows.raw: " the contrasting colors of their pelts - the majority of it being your [pc.hairColor] - is beautiful."

rows.original: Scooping up the first of your sons and daughters for the first time is a feeling utterly indescribable. They’re your kids. You made this possible. You gave them life. You’re overcome with empathy and happiness, feeling like all that matters is right here, right now. The maternal feelings running through your mind are dominant, suppressing all other thoughts and emotions to allow you this hypnotic reprieve.
rows.translation: 第一次抱起最先出生的儿女，是完全无法形容的感觉。他们是你的孩子。你促成了这一切。你赋予了他们生命。强烈的共情与幸福淹没了你，仿佛此时此地就是一切。母性情感支配脑海，压下所有其他思想与情绪，让你享受这段催眠般的喘息。
rows.raw: "\n\nScooping up the first of your sons and daughters for the first time is a feeling utterly indescribable. They’re your kids. You made this possible. You gave them life. You’re overcome with empathy and happiness, feeling like all that matters is right here, right now. The maternal feelings running through your mind are dominant, suppressing all other thoughts and emotions to allow you this hypnotic reprieve."

rows.original: You give birth to
rows.translation: 你生下了
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give birth to "

rows.original: kids!
rows.translation: 个孩子！
rows.raw: " kids!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Birthing!
rows.translation: 分娩！
rows.raw: "Birthing!"

rows.original: You can feel your [pc.breasts]
rows.translation: 你能感觉[pc.breasts]
rows.raw: "You can feel your [pc.breasts]"

rows.original: straining
rows.translation: 因要喂养这么多孩子的想法而紧绷
rows.raw: " straining"

rows.original: sloshing
rows.translation: 因要喂养这么多孩子的想法而晃荡
rows.raw: " sloshing"

rows.original: at the idea of feeding this many children, but feed them you must.
rows.translation: ，但无论如何都必须喂饱他们。
rows.raw: " at the idea of feeding this many children, but feed them you must."

rows.original: at the idea of feeding your children.
rows.translation: 因要喂养孩子的想法而反应。
rows.raw: " at the idea of feeding your children."

rows.original: A little wince and grunt is nothing compared to the
rows.translation: 小小的畏缩和闷哼，与你已经忍受的
rows.raw: " A little wince and grunt is nothing compared to the "

rows.original: weeks
rows.translation: 几周前
rows.raw: "weeks"

rows.original: time
rows.translation: 时间
rows.raw: "time"

rows.original: you’ve endured, and as you get yourself ready you let out a happy, bubbly sigh.
rows.translation: 根本无法相比；你一边准备，一边发出快乐活泼的叹息。
rows.raw: " you’ve endured, and as you get yourself ready you let out a happy, bubbly sigh."

rows.original: The twins feed from each [pc.milkNoun] dripping nipple while you cradle their heads with profound gentleness.
rows.translation: 双胞胎分别含住一颗滴淌[pc.milkNoun]的乳头进食，而你极其温柔地托着他们的脑袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe twins feed from each [pc.milkNoun] dripping nipple while you cradle their heads with profound gentleness."

rows.original: You guide the mouths of your newborns to your [pc.milkNoun] dripping nipples
rows.translation: 你引导新生儿的嘴巴含住滴淌[pc.milkNoun]的乳头
rows.raw: "\n\nYou guide the mouths of your newborns to your [pc.milkNoun] dripping nipples"

rows.original: , glad that you have extra jugs to satisfy a litter of this size
rows.translation: ；你很庆幸自己有额外乳房，足以满足这么大一窝孩子
rows.raw: ", glad that you have extra jugs to satisfy a litter of this size"

rows.original: Soft wet noises are all you hear
rows.translation: 你能听见的只有柔软湿润的声响
rows.raw: " Soft wet noises are all you hear"

rows.original: between the congratulating coos of your bedside assistant
rows.translation: ，其中夹杂着床边助手祝贺般的轻声咕哝
rows.raw: " between the congratulating coos of your bedside assistant"

rows.original: When the quiet suckles stop, you bring the next hungry mouth
rows.translation: 安静的吸吮停止后，你把下一张饥饿小嘴带到
rows.raw: " When the quiet suckles stop, you bring the next hungry mouth"

rows.original: s
rows.translation: 们

rows.original: to your chest
rows.translation: 你的胸前
rows.raw: " to your chest"

rows.original: When the quiet suckles stop, you set the two siblings down and hold them close to your neck
rows.translation: 安静的吸吮停止后，你放下两个孩子，让他们贴近你的脖子
rows.raw: " When the quiet suckles stop, you set the two siblings down and hold them close to your neck"

rows.original: . Relief floods through you with the same unceasingness your [pc.milkyNipples] dribble their rich treat, as eager for its recipients as they are for it.
rows.translation: 。宽慰以永不止息的势头涌遍全身，就像[pc.milkyNipples]不断滴下浓郁点心一样；乳头和孩子们一样渴望彼此。
rows.raw: ". Relief floods through you with the same unceasingness your [pc.milkyNipples] dribble their rich treat, as eager for its recipients as they are for it."

rows.original: You don’t have any milk, not in you or on you, and that thought brings you some amount of discomfort. They’re expecting their first meal, but you can’t provide.
rows.translation: 你没有任何乳汁，体内没有，身上也没有；这个念头令你有些不安。他们正等着第一顿饭，可你无法提供。
rows.raw: "You don’t have any milk, not in you or on you, and that thought brings you some amount of discomfort. They’re expecting their first meal, but you can’t provide."

rows.original: Fortunately, your bedside attendant has things covered.
rows.translation: 幸好床边的照料者已经准备妥当。
rows.raw: " Fortunately, your bedside attendant has things covered."

rows.original: What kind of universe would you be living in if there wasn’t any milk on New Texas?
rows.translation: 如果新德州没有任何牛奶，那会是怎样的宇宙？
rows.raw: " What kind of universe would you be living in if there wasn’t any milk on New Texas?"

rows.original: There’s nothing for it but to keep your kids safe while waiting for their taxi to come by.
rows.translation: 除了保护孩子安全，等待接送他们的交通工具到来外，别无他法。
rows.raw: " There’s nothing for it but to keep your kids safe while waiting for their taxi to come by."

rows.original: For your part, all you do is lie there in total relaxation, delighting in the feel of twitching whiskers against your [pc.skinFurScales]. When you focus hard enough, their tiny lungs and the little airs they breathe can be heard. Craning ears pulse against your body, a much more pleasant sensation than a kick to your placenta! You curl into a fetal position yourself; whatever keeps the fuzzy pile of rabbits close to you, that’s what you’re doing. Their shared body heat and the low vibrations in their bodies keep you company.
rows.translation: 至于你，只是完全放松地躺在那里，享受抽动胡须摩擦[pc.skinFurScales]的感觉。只要足够专心，便能听见他们小小的肺部与轻柔呼吸。竖起的耳朵贴着身体搏动，这感觉可比踢中胎盘舒服多了！你也蜷缩成胎儿姿势；凡是能让这堆毛茸茸的兔宝宝贴紧自己，你都会去做。他们共同的体温与体内低微振动陪伴着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor your part, all you do is lie there in total relaxation, delighting in the feel of twitching whiskers against your [pc.skinFurScales]. When you focus hard enough, their tiny lungs and the little airs they breathe can be heard. Craning ears pulse against your body, a much more pleasant sensation than a kick to your placenta! You curl into a fetal position yourself; whatever keeps the fuzzy pile of rabbits close to you, that’s what you’re doing. Their shared body heat and the low vibrations in their bodies keep you company."

rows.original: You would drift off to a nap, but you can’t. You know better than anyone that you can’t leave them here, and you can’t stay like this. There’ll be time for enjoying their company later, but their safety and needs cannot be guaranteed in this place.
rows.translation: 你本想打个盹，却不能睡。你比任何人都清楚，不能把他们留在这里，也不能继续这样待着。以后还有时间享受陪伴，但他们的安全与需求在这个地方无法得到保障。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou would drift off to a nap, but you can’t. You know better than anyone that you can’t leave them here, and you can’t stay like this. There’ll be time for enjoying their company later, but their safety and needs cannot be guaranteed in this place."

rows.original: Your kids belong in your nursery, and you alert the medical staff to that fact. Once you tell them your name, you need not say anything more.
rows.translation: 你的孩子属于育儿室，你向医疗人员说明了这一事实。只要告诉他们姓名，便不必再多说什么。
rows.raw: " Your kids belong in your nursery, and you alert the medical staff to that fact. Once you tell them your name, you need not say anything more."

rows.original: When you can finally stand again, thanks in part to the wonders of medical science, you help the doctors prepare your kids for transfer. Once they’re all safe, you watch with some amount of discomfort as they’re taken away. Sure, you know where they’re going, and you trust them fully... but something about it fills you with sadness.
rows.translation: 部分得益于医学奇迹，你终于能重新站立；随后帮助医生准备转移孩子。等他们全部安全后，你带着些许不安，看着孩子被带走。没错，你知道他们要去哪里，也完全信任相关人员...可这件事仍令内心充满悲伤。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you can finally stand again, thanks in part to the wonders of medical science, you help the doctors prepare your kids for transfer. Once they’re all safe, you watch with some amount of discomfort as they’re taken away. Sure, you know where they’re going, and you trust them fully... but something about it fills you with sadness."

rows.original: That sadness, however, will evaporate when you go and visit them later!
rows.translation: 不过，等稍后前去探望他们，那份悲伤就会烟消云散！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sadness, however, will evaporate when you go and visit them later!"

rows.original: A mechanical chirp from your codex alerts you to the incoming nursery probes.
rows.translation: 法典发出的机械提示声告知你，育儿室探测器即将抵达。
rows.raw: " A mechanical chirp from your codex alerts you to the incoming nursery probes."

rows.original: The retrieval shuttles zero in on your location, and there are many of them. Good thing your codex is on top of things!.
rows.translation: 接送穿梭机锁定你的位置，而且数量很多。幸好法典把一切处理得井井有条！。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe retrieval shuttles zero in on your location, and there are many of them. Good thing your codex is on top of things!."

rows.original: The retrieval shuttles zero in on your location.
rows.translation: 接送穿梭机锁定你的位置。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe retrieval shuttles zero in on your location."

rows.original: The retrieval shuttle zeroes in on your location.
rows.translation: 接送穿梭机锁定你的位置。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe retrieval shuttle zeroes in on your location."

rows.original: Shaken but not stirred, you rise to your feet and, with the utmost caution, load your children into its warm confines
rows.translation: 身体虽受震动却完好无损；你站起身，以最谨慎的动作将孩子装入温暖的机舱
rows.raw: " Shaken but not stirred, you rise to your feet and, with the utmost caution, load your children into its warm confines"

rows.original: , one after the other
rows.translation: ，一个接着一个
rows.raw: ", one after the other"

rows.original: . When they’re all filled, you watch the humming taxis whirl back into space on a one way trip to your nursery. You can’t help but think about something going wrong, about never seeing one or all of your kids again.
rows.translation: 。等它们全部装满后，你看着嗡鸣的交通艇旋转升空，踏上前往育儿室的单程旅途。你忍不住担心会出什么差错，担心再也见不到其中一个或全部孩子。
rows.raw: ". When they’re all filled, you watch the humming taxis whirl back into space on a one way trip to your nursery. You can’t help but think about something going wrong, about never seeing one or all of your kids again."

rows.original: Most of all, you simply feel sad letting them all go. Still, that sadness evaporates when you think about visiting them as soon as possible. Yeah. They’ll be there when you get there, and they’ll all be fine!
rows.translation: 最重要的是，放所有孩子离开令你感到悲伤。不过，一想到要尽快探望他们，那份悲伤便烟消云散。没错。等你抵达时，他们都会在那里，也都会安然无恙！
rows.raw: "\n\nMost of all, you simply feel sad letting them all go. Still, that sadness evaporates when you think about visiting them as soon as possible. Yeah. They’ll be there when you get there, and they’ll all be fine!"

rows.original: For now, though, it’s time to get going...
rows.translation: 但眼下，该继续出发了...
rows.raw: "\n\nFor now, though, it’s time to get going..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: <b>Minuet has taken
rows.translation: <b>米纽埃特拿走了你
rows.raw: "\n\n<b>Minuet has taken "

rows.original: of your credits
rows.translation: 的信用点
rows.raw: " of your credits"

rows.original: , and she’s taken
rows.translation: ，她还拿走了
rows.raw: ", and she’s taken "

rows.original: your
rows.translation: 你的
rows.raw: "your "

rows.original: You tell Minuet that you don’t want to be hurt. You’re just here for the probe. She’s welcome to whatever she wants if it means getting out without any trouble.
rows.translation: 你告诉米纽埃特，自己不想受伤，只是来寻找探针。只要能不惹麻烦地脱身，她想要什么都可以。
rows.raw: "You tell Minuet that you don’t want to be hurt. You’re just here for the probe. She’s welcome to whatever she wants if it means getting out without any trouble."

rows.original: Minuet clicks her tongue in disappointment. “I can tell you, [pc.name], with an attitude like that, in a place like this, there certainly will be an awful lot of ‘probing’ in your future. The heir to something like Steele Tech should be a little harder to break than just a prick in the neck.”
rows.translation: 米纽埃特失望地咂舌。“我得告诉你，[pc.name]，在这样的地方抱着这种态度，未来肯定会遭遇许许多多的‘探查’。斯蒂尔科技这类企业的继承人，不该只被针尖扎一下脖子就如此轻易地击垮。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMinuet clicks her tongue in disappointment. “I can tell you, [pc.name], with an attitude like that, in a place like this, there certainly will be an awful lot of ‘probing’ in your future. The heir to something like Steele Tech should be a little harder to break than just a prick in the neck.”"

rows.original: The needle against your neck is withdrawn, but before you can react, you feel her press her finger against the same spot – followed by a quick, but powerful, shock of electricity coursing through your body. It’s enough to stun and disable you, but not enough to leave any lasting damage.
rows.translation: 抵在脖子上的针被移开，但你还没来得及反应，她便将手指按在同一位置，紧接着一道短促而强劲的电击流遍身体。它足以令你眩晕瘫痪，却不足以留下任何永久伤害。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe needle against your neck is withdrawn, but before you can react, you feel her press her finger against the same spot – followed by a quick, but powerful, shock of electricity coursing through your body. It’s enough to stun and disable you, but not enough to leave any lasting damage."

rows.original: You crumple to the dirty floor of the mine, but, as you fall, you feel two extremely practiced, dexterous hands work across your body, pilfering your belongings before you finally hit the ground with a thump. She moved so fast, and with such efficiency, you’d think she had four hands, if not more. Hell, for all you know, maybe she does.
rows.translation: 你瘫倒在矿井肮脏地面，但倒下过程中，两只极其熟练灵巧的手已经扫过全身，在你终于砰然落地前偷走随身物品。她动作如此迅速高效，简直让人以为她有四只甚至更多手。妈的，就你所知，也许她真有。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou crumple to the dirty floor of the mine, but, as you fall, you feel two extremely practiced, dexterous hands work across your body, pilfering your belongings before you finally hit the ground with a thump. She moved so fast, and with such efficiency, you’d think she had four hands, if not more. Hell, for all you know, maybe she does."

rows.original: “I don’t think you made the wrong decision, darling,” she says. “Few things are as precious as a life... but, fewer still are things as beautiful as money.”
rows.translation: “我不认为你作了错误决定，亲爱的，”她说道。“很少有东西像生命一样珍贵...但比金钱更加美丽的东西还要更少。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t think you made the wrong decision, darling,” she says. “Few things are as precious as a life... but, fewer still are things as beautiful as money.”"

rows.original: You see a black shoe, or perhaps some kind of boot, enter your vision as she steps in front of you. “I’ll be rooting for you, honey,” she continues, and you can hear her blow you a kiss. “Be sure to find that probe. We could both use the float.”
rows.translation: 她走到面前时，一只黑鞋或者某种靴子进入视野。“我会为你加油的，甜心，”她继续说，你还能听见她送来一个飞吻。“一定要找到那个探针。我们都用得上那笔钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see a black shoe, or perhaps some kind of boot, enter your vision as she steps in front of you. “I’ll be rooting for you, honey,” she continues, and you can hear her blow you a kiss. “Be sure to find that probe. We could both use the float.”"

rows.original: You blink – and she’s disappeared into the shadows completely. You didn’t even hear her start running. It takes you a moment to regain the motor skills to turn your head and lift yourself up; when you do, you inspect the area. Minuet didn’t even leave any footprints in the dust other than when she had you in her arm lock.
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼，她已经彻底消失在阴影中。你甚至没听见她开始奔跑。过了一会儿，你才恢复足以转头和撑起身体的行动能力；随后检查周围。除了先前用擒拿锁住你时留下的痕迹，米纽埃特甚至没在灰尘上留下任何脚印。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink – and she’s disappeared into the shadows completely. You didn’t even hear her start running. rows.original: Was this whole confrontation a test of some sort? “Of some sort, yes,” she confirms, winking at you. “I can tell you more if you’re interested, but not here. This isn’t the most... accommodating place for a couple of darlings like ourselves, [pc.name]. Have you been to the recreational deck yet?”
rows.translation: 这整场对峙是某种测试吗？“某种意义上，是的，”她朝你眨眼确认。“如果你有兴趣，我可以告诉你更多，但不是在这里。这地方对我们这样的可人儿来说，并不算最...舒适，[pc.name]。你去过娱乐甲板吗？”

This isn’t the most... accommodating place for a couple of darlings like ourselves, [pc.name]. Have you been to the recreational deck yet?”"

rows.translation: 你告诉她去过。<i>“好，完美。

rows.translation: 你告诉她自己不熟悉。<i>“它在这块肮脏岩石的上层甲板之一。即使一群海盗也需要放松休息的地方。那里相当喧闹，酒和性爱应有尽有，不过也禁止武器。

rows.original: I can meet you up there, if you want to meet under some more... neutral terms.” She lifts her hand up, showing you her palm, and her other hand goes over her heart. “No tricks; no weapons; no fights. You have my word.”
rows.translation: 我可以在那里见你，如果你想以更加...中立的条件会面。”她举起一只手，向你展示掌心，另一只手则放在心口。“没有诡计，没有武器，也不打架。我向你保证。”
rows.raw: " I can meet you up there, if you want to meet under some more... neutral terms.” She lifts her hand up, showing you her palm, and her other hand goes over her heart. “No tricks; no weapons; no fights. You have my word.”"

rows.original: You loudly wonder to yourself if you’re in the business of taking thieves at their word. “You took one at their word when they said they wouldn’t blast your ship to pieces when you docked, didn’t you?” She winks again, and smirks – a more mischievous expression than before. She knows she wasn’t supposed to know that. “Believe what you want to believe, honey.”
rows.translation: 你大声自言自语，是否该相信小偷的话。“你停靠时，对方说不会把飞船炸成碎片，你不是也相信了一名小偷吗？”她再次眨眼并露出坏笑，比先前更加调皮。她知道自己本不该知道这件事。“你想相信什么就信什么，亲爱的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou loudly wonder to yourself if you’re in the business of taking thieves at their word. “You took one at their word when they said they wouldn’t blast your ship to pieces when you docked, didn’t you?” She winks again, and smirks – a more mischievous expression than before. She knows she wasn’t supposed to know that. “Believe what you want to believe, honey.”"

rows.original: Minuet keeps to her battle stance staunchly, at first refusing to show that your displays and efforts are having an effect on her – but, after that last one, she’s giving you all the signals, even if they’re subtler than most others. Her nostrils flare and she takes a deep, stuttering breath through her nose while her knees buckle and shake. Her eyes keep fidgeting between your own and your [pc.legOrLegs]; to the untrained eye, she’s perhaps just a bit indecisive and nervous about your fight, but she is no rookie.
rows.translation: 米纽特起初坚定保持战斗架势，拒绝表现出你的展示与努力正在影响她；可最后那一次过后，她已经给出所有信号，即使比大多数人更隐晦。她鼻孔张开，用鼻子深深吸入一口断续的气，膝盖弯曲发抖。双眼不停在你的目光与[pc.legOrLegs]之间游移；未经训练的人看来，她也许只是对战斗略显犹豫紧张，但她绝非新手。
rows.raw: "Minuet keeps to her battle stance staunchly, at first refusing to show that your displays and efforts are having an effect on her – but, after that last one, she’s giving you all the signals, even if they’re subtler than most others. Her nostrils flare and she takes a deep, stuttering breath through her nose while her knees buckle and shake. Her eyes keep fidgeting between your own and your [pc.legOrLegs]; to the untrained eye, she’s perhaps just a bit indecisive and nervous about your fight, but she is no rookie."

rows.original: “Damn it,” she whispers to herself. Her hands clench into fists, snuffing the electricity crackling between her fingers. “Looks like you’ve outplayed me at my own game, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “该死，”她对自己低语。双手握拳，熄灭指间噼啪作响的电流。“看来你在我的游戏里胜过我了，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn it,” she whispers to herself. Her hands clench into fists, snuffing the electricity crackling between her fingers. “Looks like you’ve outplayed me at my own game, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: She relaxes her battle-stance into something a bit more casual, and she withdraws her needle. When she stands upright, you can clearly make out the outlines of her nipples through her suit. It must be taking everything she has to not degrade herself to something a little more... base.
rows.translation: 她从战斗架势放松成更加随意的姿态，并收起针筒。站直后，你能清楚看见乳头透过制服显出的轮廓。她一定竭尽全力，才没有把自己贬低成更...原始的状态。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe relaxes her battle-stance into something a bit more casual, and she withdraws her needle. When she stands upright, you can clearly make out the outlines of her nipples through her suit. It must be taking everything she has to not degrade herself to something a little more... base."

rows.original: “If there’s any one thing I can still take away from this exchange, darling, is that I was wrong about you. I had lumped you in with those brutes running Zhèng Shi, but no pirate here would have been able to get me so excited that I felt I couldn’t put up a fight anymore,” she says, drawing a finger up the side of her thigh.
rows.translation: “如果这场交锋还能让我获得什么，那就是我看错了你。我把你和统治郑石的野兽归为一类，但这里没有哪个海盗能让我如此兴奋，以至于觉得再也无法战斗，”她说，一根手指沿大腿侧面向上划过。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If there’s any one thing I can still take away from this exchange, darling, is that I was wrong about you. I had lumped you in with those brutes running Zhèng Shi, but no pirate here would have been able to get me so excited that I felt I couldn’t put up a fight anymore,” she says, drawing a finger up the side of her thigh."

rows.translation: “这整场对峙是某种测试吗？”你问。

rows.original: At first, you wonder if you should take Minuet’s word to heart. She’s a thief, and thieves tend to not be the most honest folk. But, you have her at a vulnerable point, and, you’re sure, you could probably push your luck and get her to fuck you on the spot.
rows.translation: 起初，你犹豫是否该把米纽特的话放在心上。她是个小偷，而小偷往往不是最诚实的人。可她正处于脆弱时刻，而且你确信，自己大概可以得寸进尺，让她当场与你做爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt first, you wonder if you should take Minuet’s word to heart. She’s a thief, and thieves tend to not be the most honest folk. But, you have her at a vulnerable point, and, you’re sure, you could probably push your luck and get her to fuck you on the spot."

rows.original: You saw for yourself that she had removed her weapons; only someone so honestly horny would have made themselves that vulnerable!
rows.translation: 你亲眼见她卸下武器；只有发情得真心实意的人，才会让自己如此脆弱！
rows.raw: " You saw for yourself that she had removed her weapons; only someone so honestly horny would have made themselves that vulnerable!"

rows.original: You know better than to believe that she is completely defenseless, but no dishonest thief would allow themselves to fall into such a vulnerable state like she has. It’s hard to assume that she isn’t being sincere.
rows.translation: 你很清楚不能相信她已彻底失去反抗能力，可没有哪个不诚实的小偷会允许自己陷入她这样的脆弱状态。很难断定她并非真心。
rows.raw: " You know better than to believe that she is completely defenseless, but no dishonest thief would allow themselves to fall into such a vulnerable state like she has. It’s hard to assume that she isn’t being sincere."

rows.original: You tell her that you’ll consider it. And maybe, when you two are somewhere a little more private, you can continue where you’ve left off.
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己会考虑。也许，当你们来到更加私密的地方，可以继续未完的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’ll consider it. And maybe, when you two are somewhere a little more private, you can continue where you’ve left off."

rows.original: Minuet smiles, almost sweetly, at you. “You’d be a natural scallywag, you know,” she coos. “I’m supposed to be trying to ensnare you with a good time. But here you’ve got me fantasizing.” She winks. “Don’t let my dreams be dreams, sweetie.”
rows.translation: 米纽特几乎甜美地对你微笑。“你天生适合当无赖，你知道吗，”她柔声说道。“本该由我用美好时光诱捕你。可现在你却让我开始幻想。”她眨眨眼。“别让我的梦想只停留在梦里，甜心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMinuet smiles, almost sweetly, at you. “You’d be a natural scallywag, you know,” she coos. “I’m supposed to be trying to ensnare you with a good time. But here you’ve got me fantasizing.” She winks. “Don’t let my dreams be dreams, sweetie.”"

rows.original: And with that, having decided that the confrontation is over, she taps at the back of her ankle with her shoe, and a white cloud of smoke blooms from underneath her. It dissolves in a matter of seconds, but when it does, Minuet is nowhere to be found – she’s vanished completely. She didn’t even leave any footprints in the dust to tell you how she might have vanished. The only thing she left behind is
rows.translation: 说完，她认定对峙已经结束，用鞋尖敲了敲脚踝后方，一团白烟从身下绽开。烟雾数秒便消散，可米纽特也已无影无踪，彻底消失。她甚至没有在灰尘里留下任何脚印，告诉你究竟如何离去。唯一留下的是
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd with that, having decided that the confrontation is over, she taps at the back of her ankle with her shoe, and a white cloud of smoke blooms from underneath her. It dissolves in a matter of seconds, but when it does, Minuet is nowhere to be found – she’s vanished completely. She didn’t even leave any footprints in the dust to tell you how she might have vanished. The only thing she left behind is"

rows.original: a credit chit, containing a... very specific amount of credits.
rows.translation: 一张信用点卡，里面装着...一个非常具体的信用点数额。
rows.raw: " a credit chit, containing a... very specific amount of credits."

rows.original: a beautiful gemstone. Perhaps as a calling card of some kind? But you don’t think Minuet is generous enough to be leaving beautiful gems just anywhere. Maybe she likes you.
rows.translation: 一颗漂亮宝石。也许是某种名片？可你不觉得米纽特慷慨到会把漂亮宝石随处乱放。也许她喜欢你。
rows.raw: " a beautiful gemstone. Perhaps as a calling card of some kind? But you don’t think Minuet is generous enough to be leaving beautiful gems just anywhere. Maybe she likes you."

rows.original: You remain on guard for another moment, but nothing seems out of the ordinary. You don’t hear anything, and you don’t have that feeling in your gut that you’re being watched. Minuet is gone.
rows.translation: 你又警戒了片刻，可没有任何异常。你没听见什么，也没有那种直觉中被人监视的感觉。米纽特已经离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remain on guard for another moment, but nothing seems out of the ordinary. You don’t hear anything, and you don’t have that feeling in your gut that you’re being watched. Minuet is gone."

rows.original: The recreational deck, she said? You’ll have to keep that in mind....
rows.translation: 她说的是娱乐甲板？你得记住这件事....
rows.raw:
"

The recreational deck, she said? You’ll have to keep that in mind....

"

rows.original: The door hisses shut behind you. Minuet’s room is rather opulent, even by normal standards and especially by Zhèng Shi’s standards: gems of various colors and glitters line the walls, the floor, and the sheets of the bed in the corner, and a glass-diamond chandelier hangs from the ceiling. The light of the room is dark-purple, muting the effect of the glitters from the gems without diminishing their lustre, while also giving the room a very intimate atmosphere. The room is soundproof: the ruckus from the Recreational Deck doesn’t reach into Minuet’s room at all, and you doubt any noise made inside it will make it out.
rows.translation: 身后的门嘶嘶关闭。米纽特的房间相当奢华，即使按照正常标准，更别说郑石的标准：各种颜色、闪闪发亮的宝石排列在墙上、地板上和角落床铺的床单上，玻璃钻石吊灯悬在天花板。房间灯光呈深紫色，削弱宝石闪光的效果，却不减少光泽，同时营造出非常亲密的氛围。这里完全隔音：娱乐甲板的喧闹丝毫无法传进米纽特房间，你也怀疑里面产生的任何声响能否传出去。
rows.raw: "The door hisses shut behind you. Minuet’s room is rather opulent, even by normal standards and especially by Zhèng Shi’s standards: gems of various colors and glitters line the walls, the floor, and the sheets of the bed in the corner, and a glass-diamond chandelier hangs from the ceiling. The light of the room is dark-purple, muting the effect of the glitters from the gems without diminishing their lustre, while also giving the room a very intimate atmosphere. The room is soundproof: the ruckus from the Recreational Deck doesn’t reach into Minuet’s room at all, and you doubt any noise made inside it will make it out."

rows.original: Minuet’s piece of heaven is fully stocked with its own bar: a long, chest-high counter goes from the far wall and curves in a semi-circle around the corner with an opening on the opposite side, and the wall behind it is lined with bottles from every reach of the civilized universe. You don’t recognize a lot of the labels or the words on them, but you understand that there isn’t a single drop of booze among them – it’s all wines. The labels you do recognize are from Terra, including Rieslings, Merlots, and Pinot Noirs.
rows.translation: 米纽特的天堂还配备独立酒吧：一道齐胸长柜台从远墙延伸，并沿角落弯成半圆，对侧留有开口；后方墙壁摆满来自文明宇宙各处的酒瓶。你不认识许多标签或上面的文字，但明白其中没有一滴烈酒，全都是葡萄酒。你确实认得的标签来自泰拉，包括雷司令、梅洛与黑皮诺。
rows.raw: "\n\nMinuet’s piece of heaven is fully stocked with its own bar: a long, chest-high counter goes from the far wall and curves in a semi-circle around the corner with an opening on the opposite side, and the wall behind it is lined with bottles from every reach of the civilized universe. You don’t recognize a lot of the labels or the words on them, but you understand that there isn’t a single drop of booze among them – it’s all wines. The labels you do recognize are from Terra, including Rieslings, Merlots, and Pinot Noirs."

rows.original: There are two stools at the bar’s deck, and sitting in one of them is Minuet. She’s not wearing her black spysuit, though: she’s wearing a backless black dress, its strings forming a criss-cross pattern along her shoulders. The dress hangs from her legs loosely, waving in the air with every idle, playful kick of her leg. Her arms are completely exposed, as is her entire stomach, the dress having an open diamond shape going from the underside of her breasts to a few inches below her navel. The dress forms an X over her breasts, exposing her cleavage while remaining not only decent, but classy and tasteful. Her legs are crossed, exposing her ankles, and you can see a pair of black high-heels on her feet, the heel tapping occasionally against the metal of her stool.
rows.translation: 吧台前有两张凳子，米纽特正坐在其中一张。她没有穿黑色间谍服，而是一条露背黑裙，肩膀处的细带交叉成十字图案。裙摆宽松垂过双腿，每次悠闲俏皮地踢腿都会在空气中飘动。双臂完全裸露，腹部也同样暴露；裙子从乳房下侧直到肚脐下方数英寸处留出一道开放菱形。裙身在乳房上交叉成X形，露出乳沟，却不仅端庄，还优雅得体。她翘着腿，露出脚踝；脚上穿着一双黑色高跟鞋，鞋跟偶尔敲击凳子的金属。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are two stools at the bar’s deck, and sitting in one of them is Minuet. She’s not wearing her black spysuit, though: she’s wearing a backless black dress, its strings forming a criss-cross pattern along her shoulders. The dress hangs from her legs loosely, waving in the air with every idle, playful kick of her leg. Her arms are completely exposed, as is her entire stomach, the dress having an open diamond shape going from the underside of her breasts to a few inches below her navel. The dress forms an X over her breasts, exposing her cleavage while remaining not only decent, but classy and tasteful. Her legs are crossed, exposing her ankles, and you can see a pair of black high-heels on her feet, the heel tapping occasionally against the metal of her stool."

rows.original: She was busy watching something on her own codex when you entered, but as soon as she turns her head and sees you, she smiles and puts it down, forgetting about it entirely.
rows.translation: 你进入时，她正忙着在自己的Codex上观看什么；可一转头看见你，便微笑着把它放下，彻底忘在脑后。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe was busy watching something on her own codex when you entered, but as soon as she turns her head and sees you, she smiles and puts it down, forgetting about it entirely."

rows.original: She grins wryly at you, and beckons to you with her finger: you obey and approach, and once you’re within arm’s distance, she shows you the back of her fingers: she’s wearing a diamond ring, and she wants you to kiss it. You gently take her hand, and you do.
rows.translation: 她狡黠地朝你微笑，用手指勾了勾：你服从地靠近，来到一臂范围内时，她向你展示手背。她戴着一枚钻戒，希望你亲吻它。你轻轻托住她的手，照做了。
rows.raw: " She grins wryly at you, and beckons to you with her finger: you obey and approach, and once you’re within arm’s distance, she shows you the back of her fingers: she’s wearing a diamond ring, and she wants you to kiss it. You gently take her hand, and you do."

rows.original: She smiles and stands, taking two steps toward you with her hands outstretched, wordlessly asking for an embrace. You step into her arms, and once you do, she gives you a quick kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste], letting you know just how warmly you’re welcomed in her privacy.
rows.translation: 她微笑着站起，向前走两步，双手张开，无声索求拥抱。你走进她怀中，她随即迅速亲吻你的[pc.lipsChaste]，让你知道自己在她的私密空间受到何等热烈欢迎。
rows.raw: " She smiles and stands, taking two steps toward you with her hands outstretched, wordlessly asking for an embrace. You step into her arms, and once you do, she gives you a quick kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste], letting you know just how warmly you’re welcomed in her privacy."

rows.original: “I’m glad you could make it,” she says,
rows.translation: “很高兴你能来，”她说，
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m glad you could make it,” she says,"

rows.original: drawing her foot up your side, rubbing her calf against your body.
rows.translation: 抬脚沿你身侧向上，让小腿摩擦身体。
rows.raw: " drawing her foot up your side, rubbing her calf against your body."

rows.original: hooking her arms around your neck, lazily hugging you against her.
rows.translation: 双臂环住你的脖子，懒洋洋地把你抱向她。
rows.raw: " hooking her arms around your neck, lazily hugging you against her."

rows.original: “Did you have any problems finding my room?”
rows.translation: “找我的房间时遇到麻烦了吗？”
rows.raw: " “Did you have any problems finding my room?”"

rows.original: You tell Minuet that it wasn’t ‘difficult,’ but it was certainly... surprising. The Recreational Deck was full of ornery thugs getting drunk and trying to get laid all over the place. You cast your eyes around the room: this is certainly a step in a different direction from that.
rows.translation: 你告诉米纽特，找到这里并不“困难”，但确实...令人意外。娱乐甲板到处都是脾气暴躁的恶棍，四处喝醉并想方设法找人上床。你环顾房间，这里的方向显然与外面完全不同。
