rows.original: You tell Lorelei that, if there’s a better person in the same business as her, you haven’t met them. Her skills are the stuff of storybook legends. Every time she disappeared into the shadows, you’d look for her footprints, and she didn’t even leave any of those – even now, you still can’t figure out how she does it.
rows.translation: 你告诉洛蕾莱，如果有谁在这一行比她更出色，那你还从未遇见过。她的技艺堪称故事书中的传奇。每当她消失在阴影里，你都会寻找她留下的脚印，可她连一枚都没留下——即使现在，你仍想不通她是怎么做到的。
rows.raw: "You tell Lorelei that, if there’s a better person in the same business as her, you haven’t met them. Her skills are the stuff of storybook legends. Every time she disappeared into the shadows, you’d look for her footprints, and she didn’t even leave any of those – even now, you still can’t figure out how she does it."

rows.original: Lorelei leans into the bar, smiling at your compliments, but she says nothing. She takes a sip of her wine and bathes in your praise.
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱倚向吧台，听着你的赞美微笑不语。她抿了一口酒，尽情沐浴在你的称赞中。
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei leans into the bar, smiling at your compliments, but she says nothing. She takes a sip of her wine and bathes in your praise."

rows.original: Your compliments, naturally, lead into your follow-up question: how did she get into the ‘business?’ With skills like hers, you can’t imagine her wanting to do anything else, but everyone has to start somewhere.
rows.translation: 你的恭维自然而然引出了后续问题：她是怎样进入这一“行”的？以她这般本领，你很难想象她会愿意做其他事，但每个人总得有个起点。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour compliments, naturally, lead into your follow-up question: how did she get into the ‘business?’ With skills like hers, you can’t imagine her wanting to do anything else, but everyone has to start somewhere."

rows.original: “Hmm,” she hums casually, swirling her wine glass. Her eyes watch the liquid sway with her hand, and her smile hasn’t left her face. “I’m afraid my ‘start’ isn’t any more original than my storybook skills, darling. I was born to a middleclass family – we had our wants, certainly, but our needs were met, and we lived comfortably.” She traces her finger along the rim of her glass. “But I wanted more than to live comfortably. I wanted more.”
rows.translation: “嗯，”她随意哼道，轻晃酒杯。她的眼睛随着手势注视着杯中摇曳的液体，脸上的笑容始终未退。“恐怕我的‘起点’并不比故事书般的本领更有新意，亲爱的。我出生在一个中产家庭——我们当然有想要却得不到的东西，但生活所需从不匮乏，日子也很舒适。”她用手指沿杯沿滑过。“但我想要的不只是舒适生活。我想要更多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm,” she hums casually, swirling her wine glass. Her eyes watch the liquid sway with her hand, and her smile hasn’t left her face. “I’m afraid my ‘start’ isn’t any more original than my storybook skills, darling. I was born to a middleclass family – we had our wants, certainly, but our needs were met, and we lived comfortably.” She traces her finger along the rim of her glass. “But I wanted more than to live comfortably. I wanted more.”"

rows.original: “Towards the end of my senior year in high school, I found a pair of the most adorable red high-heels on display. They were decorated with the brightest jewels I had ever seen. I wanted more than anything to have them for my prom night. But the price was far too exorbitant for a family like mine. I didn’t bother asking my folks for the cash; they were Vernon Strauss, and you don’t wear a Vernon Strauss product unless you’re somebody. And me and my family,” she sighs, “we were nobodies.”
rows.translation: “高中毕业班临近结束时，我在橱窗里看见了一双最可爱的红色高跟鞋。上面装饰着我见过最耀眼的宝石。我做梦都想穿着它们参加毕业舞会。可那价格对于我们这样的家庭实在太离谱了。我根本没向父母开口要钱；那可是弗农·施特劳斯的作品，除非你是个大人物，否则根本不会穿弗农·施特劳斯的产品。至于我和家人，”她叹道，“我们都是无名小卒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Towards the end of my senior year in high school, I found a pair of the most adorable red high-heels on display. They were decorated with the brightest jewels I had ever seen. I wanted more than anything to have them for my prom night. But the price was far too exorbitant for a family like mine. I didn’t bother asking my folks for the cash; they were Vernon Strauss, and you don’t wear a Vernon Strauss product unless you’re somebody. And me and my family,” she sighs, “we were nobodies.”"

rows.original: You sit and wait patiently for Lorelei to continue her story. You have a guess as to where she’s taking it, but you wouldn’t want to interrupt her. “I didn’t steal the heels,”
rows.translation: 你耐心坐着，等洛蕾莱继续讲述。你大概猜得到故事会往哪里发展，但不想打断她。“我没有偷那双高跟鞋，”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit and wait patiently for Lorelei to continue her story. You have a guess as to where she’s taking it, but you wouldn’t want to interrupt her. “I didn’t steal the heels,”"

rows.original: Out of turn, you ask if she stole the shoes. “I didn’t,”
rows.translation: 你插嘴问她是不是偷了鞋。“没有，”
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of turn, you ask if she stole the shoes. “I didn’t,”"

rows.original: she says, a mischievous glint in her eye. “I stole the money to buy the shoes. From anywhere I could. From people; from purses; from wallets; from credit registers that were left unattended for just a moment too long. Sometimes I’d nearly get caught.” She winks. “But I never did.”
rows.translation: 她眼中闪着恶作剧般的光。“我偷了买鞋的钱。哪里能偷就从哪里偷：从别人身上、从手提包里、从钱包里、从无人看管得稍微久了一点的收银机里。有几次我差点被抓住。”她朝你眨眼。“但从来没人真正抓到过我。”
rows.raw: " she says, a mischievous glint in her eye. “I stole the money to buy the shoes. From anywhere I could. From people; from purses; from wallets; from credit registers that were left unattended for just a moment too long. Sometimes I’d nearly get caught.” She winks. “But I never did.”"

rows.original: You ask her how her prom night went. “My date pre-gamed the booze with his friends a little too hard. By the time he showed up to the dance, he was wasted – and a total waste of my time.”
rows.translation: 你问她毕业舞会过得怎么样。“我的舞伴事先跟朋友喝得太过火了。等他来到舞会时，已经烂醉如泥——纯粹是在浪费我的时间。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how her prom night went. “My date pre-gamed the booze with his friends a little too hard. By the time he showed up to the dance, he was wasted – and a total waste of my time.”"

rows.original: She sighs again, through her nose. Her eyes travel around the room lazily, half-lidded, and her smile maintains, as she remembers the night fondly. “I was stunning, [pc.name], oh, you should have seen me. Nobody could keep their eyes off me, the boys or the girls. That’s what they were, compared to me – they were boys and girls. I had commanded such attention, such authority that night. I had felt powerful. I felt like a woman.”
rows.translation: 她又用鼻子叹了口气。半眯的眼睛懒洋洋地环顾房间，笑容依旧，满怀眷恋地回忆着那个夜晚。“我那晚美极了，[pc.name]，哦，你真该看看我。无论男孩还是女孩，谁都无法把目光从我身上移开。和我相比，他们确实只是男孩和女孩。那一晚，我掌控着那样的关注、那样的权威。我感到自己无比强大。我觉得自己成了一个真正的女人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs again, through her nose. Her eyes travel around the room lazily, half-lidded, and her smile maintains, as she remembers the night fondly. “I was stunning, [pc.name], oh, you should have seen me. Nobody could keep their eyes off me, the boys or the girls. That’s what they were, compared to me – they were boys and girls. I had commanded such attention, such authority that night. I had felt powerful. I felt like a woman.”"

rows.original: “Since then, it established something of a... pattern, within me,” she continues, taking a sip of her wine. “Get the money. Buy beautiful things. Feel powerful. It wasn’t long until I needed more money. So I started stealing more things, from more people, from larger and more important institutions. Every time I take something, darling,” she says, looking into your eyes
rows.translation: “从那以后，我心中逐渐形成了某种...模式，”她继续说道，抿了一口酒。“弄到钱。买漂亮东西。感受力量。没多久，我就需要更多钱。于是我开始从更多人、更庞大也更重要的机构手中偷取更多东西。亲爱的，每当我拿走什么，”她望进你的眼睛说道
rows.raw: "\n\n“Since then, it established something of a... pattern, within me,” she continues, taking a sip of her wine. “Get the money. Buy beautiful things. Feel powerful. It wasn’t long until I needed more money. So I started stealing more things, from more people, from larger and more important institutions. Every time I take something, darling,” she says, looking into your eyes"

rows.original: and running her fingers along your collar
rows.translation: ，同时用手指沿你的项圈轻抚
rows.raw: " and running her fingers along your collar"

rows.original: , “I feel like... like I’m in control. Like I’m a queen. And everything belongs to the queen.”
rows.translation: ，“我就觉得...仿佛一切都在我的掌控中。仿佛我是女王，而一切都属于女王。”
rows.raw: ", “I feel like... like I’m in control. Like I’m a queen. And everything belongs to the queen.”"

rows.original: Concurring in a way you know she’ll appreciate, you take her hand from your collar and kiss it, like you had before. Lorelei, understanding your meaning, nibbles into her lower lip and inhales. Every kiss you give makes her feel just a little more powerful, and if she wants to feel like a queen, you know there’s no better way to do it.
rows.translation: 你用她必定会欣赏的方式表示赞同：像之前那样，把她的手从项圈上牵下来，轻吻手背。洛蕾莱明白你的意思，咬住下唇，深吸一口气。你每献上一吻，都会让她感到更强大一点；如果她想感受女王般的尊崇，你知道没有比这更好的做法。
rows.raw: "\n\nConcurring in a way you know she’ll appreciate, you take her hand from your collar and kiss it, like you had before. Lorelei, understanding your meaning, nibbles into her lower lip and inhales. Every kiss you give makes her feel just a little more powerful, and if she wants to feel like a queen, you know there’s no better way to do it."

rows.original: “Over time, though, I found something more important than money,” she says.
rows.translation: “不过，随着时间流逝，我发现了比金钱更重要的东西，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Over time, though, I found something more important than money,” she says."

rows.original: You take a chance: jewels? Or simply the thrill of it?
rows.translation: 你试着猜测：珠宝？还是单纯享受那份刺激？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a chance: jewels? Or simply the thrill of it?"

rows.original: “I got pregnant, actually,” she says. “I... this is embarrassing to admit, but I celebrated one hit with a little too much wine at an upscale bar in Terra. I met a handsome kui-tan, and, well, I wanted to know if the rumors were true.” She blushes – uncharacteristically, for someone as in-control as her at all times. “Turns out, they were, and the condom we used didn’t stand a chance. I was halfway across the galaxy by the time I realized. We understood it to be a fling, so I never got his name or his number.”
rows.translation: “其实，我怀孕了，”她说道。“我...承认这件事很难为情，但有一票得手后，我在泰拉一家高档酒吧喝了太多酒庆祝。我遇到一位英俊的狸猫族，然后，嗯，我想知道传闻是不是真的。”她脸红了——对于一个始终掌控一切的人而言，这很不寻常。“结果传闻确实是真的，而我们用的安全套根本撑不住。等我意识到时，已经横跨了半个银河系。我们都明白那只是一夜风流，所以我没问他的名字，也没留联系方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I got pregnant, actually,” she says. “I... this is embarrassing to admit, but I celebrated one hit with a little too much wine at an upscale bar in Terra. I met a handsome kui-tan, and, well, I wanted to know if the rumors were true.” She blushes – uncharacteristically, for someone as in-control as her at all times. “Turns out, they were, and the condom we used didn’t stand a chance. I was halfway across the galaxy by the time I realized. We understood it to be a fling, so I never got his name or his number.”"

rows.original: Lorelei, for the first time, sets down her drink and stares at it forlornly for a moment. Then, she stands, and makes for the nightstand beside her bed. From its single drawer, she pulls out a framed photo – of her and a young half kui-tan boy that couldn’t be older than four.
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱第一次放下酒杯，神情落寞地凝视片刻。随后她站起身，走向床边的床头柜。从唯一的抽屉中取出一张装裱好的照片——照片上是她和一个不满四岁的半狸猫族男孩。
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei, for the first time, sets down her drink and stares at it forlornly for a moment. Then, she stands, and makes for the nightstand beside her bed. From its single drawer, she pulls out a framed photo – of her and a young half kui-tan boy that couldn’t be older than four."

rows.original: “You had it right, you know. It put me in such a difficult spot. I wouldn’t call my skills ‘marketable,’ and I... I’ve come to relish the thrill too much to stop. It would have been irresponsible of me to keep going with my baby Vernon being dependent on me, but I didn’t know what else I could do. So, I,” she continues, her smile coming back to her once more, “I opened an adoption agency.”
rows.translation: “你说得没错。那让我陷入了极其艰难的境地。我的本事称不上‘有就业市场’，而且我...我已经太沉迷那份刺激，根本停不下来。如果让小弗农依赖着我，我却继续这样生活，那太不负责任了；可我又不知道还能做什么。所以，”她继续说着，笑容再度回到脸上，“我开了一家收养机构。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You had it right, you know. It put me in such a difficult spot. I wouldn’t call my skills ‘marketable,’ and I... I’ve come to relish the thrill too much to stop. It would have been irresponsible of me to keep going with my baby Vernon being dependent on me, but I didn’t know what else I could do. So, I,” she continues, her smile coming back to her once more, “I opened an adoption agency.”"

rows.original: You reel. Lorelei runs an adoption agency?
rows.translation: 你惊得身体后仰。洛蕾莱经营着一家收养机构？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reel. Lorelei runs an adoption agency?"

rows.original: “Having Vernon taught me a valuable lesson: that there are things worth cherishing more than just jewels or credits. When I first held him, it was like... I knew what I should do with my skills. With all those credits that I bring in. Look around us, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “生下弗农让我明白了宝贵的一课：世上有些事物比珠宝或信用点更值得珍惜。第一次抱住他时，就像...我知道自己该用这些本领做什么，也知道该怎样使用赚来的信用点。看看我们周围，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Having Vernon taught me a valuable lesson: that there are things worth cherishing more than just jewels or credits. When I first held him, it was like... I knew what I should do with my skills. With all those credits that I bring in. Look around us, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: She spreads her arms and motions to the opulent room: from the plush rugs, to the gem-studded walls, to the rack full of expensive wines, to the large bed with the thick covers.
rows.translation: 她张开双臂，示意这间奢华的房间：柔软的地毯、镶满宝石的墙壁、摆满昂贵葡萄酒的酒架，以及铺着厚实被褥的大床。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe spreads her arms and motions to the opulent room: from the plush rugs, to the gem-studded walls, to the rack full of expensive wines, to the large bed with the thick covers."

rows.original: “What more do I need to spend my money on? What’s building up my own fortune worth at this point? This is one room in a dusty asteroid run by degenerate pirates; I think you get the idea of how much excess I have in my life. I don’t need more.”
rows.translation: “我还需要把钱花在什么地方？事到如今，继续积累自己的财富还有什么意义？这只是一间房，位于一颗由堕落海盗统治的尘土飞扬的小行星上；你应该明白我的生活有多么奢侈了。我不需要更多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What more do I need to spend my money on? What’s building up my own fortune worth at this point? This is one room in a dusty asteroid run by degenerate pirates; I think you get the idea of how much excess I have in my life. I don’t need more.”"

rows.original: Her hand gently runs down the framed photo.
rows.translation: 她的手轻轻抚过装裱好的照片。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer hand gently runs down the framed photo."

rows.original: “Vernon does.”
rows.translation: “弗农需要。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Vernon does.”"

rows.original: That’s very touching, but you still have to ask... why an adoption agency, of all things?
rows.translation: 这很感人，但你还是得问...为什么偏偏是收养机构？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s very touching, but you still have to ask... why an adoption agency, of all things?"

rows.original: “As you can guess, most of my work is done away from home,” she laughs. “I spend far less time with Vernon than I’d like, and I wasn’t about to put him up for adoption myself. I thought that opening my own would give him a place to be, if anything should happen to me; it’d give him lots of friends; and I’d be doing a good thing for all the less fortunate kids in this universe. Half of every credit I make goes to the agency; one third goes to Vernon’s trust fund; and I keep the rest for myself.”
rows.translation: “你也猜得到，我大部分工作都得离家在外，”她笑道。“我陪伴弗农的时间远比自己希望的少，而我又不可能把他送去给别人收养。我想，如果开设自己的机构，万一我出了什么事，他也能有个去处；他会有许多朋友；同时我还能帮助宇宙中所有较为不幸的孩子，做一件好事。我赚到的每一信用点，一半归机构，三分之一存入弗农的信托基金，剩下的才留给自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As you can guess, most of my work is done away from home,” she laughs. “I spend far less time with Vernon than I’d like, and I wasn’t about to put him up for adoption myself. I thought that opening my own would give him a place to be, if anything should happen to me; it’d give him lots of friends; and I’d be doing a good thing for all the less fortunate kids in this universe. Half of every credit I make goes to the agency; one third goes to Vernon’s trust fund; and I keep the rest for myself.”"

rows.original: It’s a lot to absorb. You sip on your own wine, trying to process everything – Lorelei, this cutthroat thief, one of the best rogue’s you’ve ever met – has found a higher calling for all her credits. It almost makes you forget that what she’s doing is illegal.
rows.translation: 这一切很难一下子消化。你抿了一口自己的酒，试图理清头绪——洛蕾莱，这个冷酷无情的窃贼、你见过最出色的盗贼之一，竟为自己所有的收入找到了更崇高的使命。这几乎让你忘记她做的事是违法的。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a lot to absorb. You sip on your own wine, trying to process everything – Lorelei, this cutthroat thief, one of the best rogue’s you’ve ever met – has found a higher calling for all her credits. It almost makes you forget that what she’s doing is illegal."

rows.original: “‘Higher calling’ is a good way of putting it, I think,” she says, taking another drink out of her own glass. “I named my son Vernon to remind me of how I got here in the first place, and what I’d be using my skills for going forward.” Lorelei winks at you. “You’d never guess how liberating it feels to be doing something for a greater good, even if it’s something as base as thievery. After all, what good is a pretty face if you have an ugly heart?”
rows.translation: “我觉得，‘更崇高的使命’这个说法很贴切，”她又喝了一口自己的酒。“我给儿子取名弗农，是为了提醒自己最初如何走到今天，又会为了什么继续使用自己的本领。”洛蕾莱朝你眨眼。“你绝想不到，为更伟大的善行做事是多么令人解脱，即便手段只是偷盗这种卑劣勾当。毕竟，若有一颗丑陋的心，漂亮的脸蛋又有什么用？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Higher calling’ is a good way of putting it, I think,” she says, taking another drink out of her own glass. “I named my son Vernon to remind me of how I got here in the first place, and what I’d be using my skills for going forward.” Lorelei winks at you. “You’d never guess how liberating it feels to be doing something for a greater good, even if it’s something as base as thievery. After all, what good is a pretty face if you have an ugly heart?”"

rows.original: You toast to that, and refill your drinks.
rows.translation: 你为此举杯，然后为你们重新斟酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou toast to that, and refill your drinks."

rows.original: You do have one last question, though. Why all the gems and jewels? She clearly isn’t pawning them.
rows.translation: 不过，你确实还有最后一个问题。为什么要收藏所有那些宝石和珠宝？她显然没有拿它们去销赃。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do have one last question, though. Why all the gems and jewels? She clearly isn’t pawning them."

rows.original: “Those are for momma,” she says. “Like I told you, all the universe’s most beautiful things belong with me.”
rows.translation: “那些是留给妈妈的，”她说道。“我告诉过你，宇宙中一切最美丽的东西都该属于我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Those are for momma,” she says. “Like I told you, all the universe’s most beautiful things belong with me.”"

rows.original: Her eyes scan the collar you’re wearing. “All of them.”
rows.translation: 她的目光扫过你戴着的项圈。“一切。”
rows.raw: " Her eyes scan the collar you’re wearing. “All of them.”"

rows.original: You eye the photo of her and her son and put that statement to the image of her adoption agency. It might be best not to think about it too hard.
rows.translation: 你看着她和儿子的照片，又想起她那家收养机构，把两者与这番宣言联系起来。也许最好别深究。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou eye the photo of her and her son and put that statement to the image of her adoption agency. It might be best not to think about it too hard."

rows.original: Thievery
rows.translation: 偷盗
rows.raw: "Thievery"

rows.original: DRESS
rows.raw: "DRESS"

rows.original: You ask Lorelei, if it isn’t too forward of you to, about her suit. You’ve seen her do all kinds of tricks with it: it clung to her like it was taut rubber, but it breathed like it was silk. She could channel electricity through her hands with it.
rows.translation: 你颇为谨慎地向洛蕾莱问起她的战衣。你见过它使出各种花样：它像绷紧的橡胶一样贴身，却又像丝绸般透气。她还能借它让电流通过双手。
rows.raw: "You ask Lorelei, if it isn’t too forward of you to, about her suit. You’ve seen her do all kinds of tricks with it: it clung to her like it was taut rubber, but it breathed like it was silk. She could channel electricity through her hands with it."

rows.original: And, how could you forget, it parted on command when she ‘inaugurated’ you as her possession.
rows.translation: 还有，你怎么可能忘记，在她“正式接纳”你成为所有物时，战衣会遵照命令自行分开。
rows.raw: " And, how could you forget, it parted on command when she ‘inaugurated’ you as her possession."

rows.original: You’re unfamiliar with whatever technology it’s using.
rows.translation: 你不了解它采用的究竟是什么技术。
rows.raw: " You’re unfamiliar with whatever technology it’s using."

rows.original: “That’s because it isn’t technology,” she says, grinning like a boy with a dirty secret to tell.
rows.translation: “因为它根本不是科技，”她咧嘴笑道，像个急着分享肮脏秘密的男孩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s because it isn’t technology,” she says, grinning like a boy with a dirty secret to tell."

rows.original: “It’s a type of amorphous, inorganic, multicellular symbiote created by a deity known as Gnull, to assist him in destroying other higher-beings known as Stellars. All symbiotes, like my own, bond to their host and amplify their physiques and characteristics, turning them into something they wouldn’t be capable of otherwise.”
rows.translation: “它是一种无定形、无机、多细胞的共生体，由名为格努尔的神祇创造，用来协助他摧毁被称作星辰者的其他高等存在。所有这类共生体都会与宿主结合，强化宿主的体格与特性，使其做到原本绝不可能做到的事。”
rows.raw: " “It’s a type of amorphous, inorganic, multicellular symbiote created by a deity known as Gnull, to assist him in destroying other higher-beings known as Stellars. All symbiotes, like my own, bond to their host and amplify their physiques and characteristics, turning them into something they wouldn’t be capable of otherwise.”"

rows.original: “It’s a type of semi-sentient tar that had been enchanted by the indigenous Naleen tribes of Mhen’ga. By cutting out the heart of a virgin on the first blue moon of the year and submerging it into the tar, it takes on the heart’s memories and personalities, and it can be taught to bond with a host and be subject to their every whim and desire.”
rows.translation: “它是一种半智能焦油，曾受明加本土纳琳部落的附魔。只要在一年中第一次蓝月之夜挖出一名处女的心脏，再将其浸入焦油，它就会继承那颗心的记忆与人格，并能被教导着与宿主结合，服从宿主的每一道心意和欲望。”
rows.raw: " “It’s a type of semi-sentient tar that had been enchanted by the indigenous Naleen tribes of Mhen’ga. By cutting out the heart of a virgin on the first blue moon of the year and submerging it into the tar, it takes on the heart’s memories and personalities, and it can be taught to bond with a host and be subject to their every whim and desire.”"

rows.original: You sit, listening to Lorelei’s explanation attentively
rows.translation: 你坐在那里，专心听着洛蕾莱的解释
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit, listening to Lorelei’s explanation attentively"

rows.original: , raptured by every word. Eventually, she bursts into laughter.
rows.translation: ，被她的每句话深深吸引。最终，她突然大笑起来。
rows.raw: ", raptured by every word. Eventually, she bursts into laughter."

rows.original: – but you aren’t buying a single word. Eventually, you both burst into laughter.
rows.translation: ——但你一个字都不信。最后，你们两人都放声大笑起来。
rows.raw: " – but you aren’t buying a single word. Eventually, you both burst into laughter."

rows.original: “Could you imagine?” she asks, wiping a tear from her eye with a single finger.
rows.translation: “你能想象吗？”她问道，用一根手指擦去眼角笑出的泪水。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Could you imagine?” she asks, wiping a tear from her eye with a single finger."

rows.original: “Who could even make up something so silly? As if anyone would think something like a ‘symbiote’ made by some God could ever exist in reality!”
rows.translation: “谁能编出这么荒唐的东西？难道真有人会相信某个神造出的‘共生体’会真实存在！”
rows.raw: " “Who could even make up something so silly? As if anyone would think something like a ‘symbiote’ made by some God could ever exist in reality!”"

rows.original: “I’ve taken my share of mudbaths before, but tar? You’d catch me dead and cold before I’d ever put muck like that on my body!”
rows.translation: “我以前也泡过泥浴，可焦油？除非我已经冰冷地死去，否则绝不会把那种污泥涂到身上！”
rows.raw: " “I’ve taken my share of mudbaths before, but tar? You’d catch me dead and cold before I’d ever put muck like that on my body!”"

rows.original: Both of you chuckle through the last of your dying laughter. “Ah, but seriously,” she continues, taking another drink of her wine. “You’ll have to forgive the technical jargon, but my suit is comprised of a lattice of microsurgeons woven into high-strength polymer, which is connected to me neurologically to give it shape and consistency. Have you heard of a company named Reaper Armaments?”
rows.translation: 你们两人在渐息的笑声中又轻笑几下。“啊，不过说正经的，”她继续说道，又喝了一口酒。“请原谅这些技术术语，我的战衣由织入高强度聚合物中的微型外科机器人晶格构成，并通过神经连接与我相连，让我能赋予它形状和质地。你听说过一家名叫死神军工的公司吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBoth of you chuckle through the last of your dying laughter. “Ah, but seriously,” she continues, taking another drink of her wine. “You’ll have to forgive the technical jargon, but my suit is comprised of a lattice of microsurgeons woven into high-strength polymer, which is connected to me neurologically to give it shape and consistency. Have you heard of a company named Reaper Armaments?”"

rows.original: Reaper
rows.raw: "Reaper"

rows.original: You say that you’re familiar with the brand. <i>“Good; then you know what it is that they specialize in.
rows.translation: 你说自己熟悉这个品牌。<i>“很好；那你就知道他们专精于什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say that you’re familiar with the brand. <i>“Good; then you know what it is that they specialize in. "

rows.original: You can’t say that you’ve ever heard that brand before. “The short of it, darling, is that they’re a weapons manufacturer. Not every weapon shoots projectiles or slices objects – my suit was designed for espionage, which is just warfare with a prettier name and fewer noises.” She laughs. “
rows.translation: 你表示从未听过这个品牌。“简而言之，亲爱的，他们是一家武器制造商。并非所有武器都会发射弹丸或切割物体——我的战衣专为间谍活动设计，而间谍活动不过是名称更漂亮、噪音更少的战争。”她笑道。“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t say that you’ve ever heard that brand before. “The short of it, darling, is that they’re a weapons manufacturer. Not every weapon shoots projectiles or slices objects – my suit was designed for espionage, which is just warfare with a prettier name and fewer noises.” She laughs. “"

rows.original: My suit is... fresh from their research team, let’s say. The first of its kind.”
rows.translation: 我的战衣算是...刚从他们的研发团队手里出炉吧。史上第一件。”
rows.raw: "My suit is... fresh from their research team, let’s say. The first of its kind.”"

rows.original: She lifts her hand, showing you her palm – and, suddenly, her black dress shifts, melds, and transforms, taking material from the bottom line of her wavy dress and crawling along her body as black tendrils, over her exposed belly, between her cleavage, up to her shoulder, and down her arm, until it forms an inky black glove around her hand and extended fingers.
rows.translation: 她抬起手，向你展示掌心——忽然间，她的黑裙开始移位、融合、变形，从波浪般裙摆的底缘抽取材料，化作黑色触须沿身体爬行，越过裸露的腹部，穿过乳沟，攀上肩膀，再沿手臂向下，最终在手掌和伸展的手指周围形成一只墨黑手套。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lifts her hand, showing you her palm – and, suddenly, her black dress shifts, melds, and transforms, taking material from the bottom line of her wavy dress and crawling along her body as black tendrils, over her exposed belly, between her cleavage, up to her shoulder, and down her arm, until it forms an inky black glove around her hand and extended fingers."

rows.original: <i>“It can be anything at all that I want it to be. Any shape, form, or consistency. It also keeps my body clean at all times
rows.translation: <i>“它能变成我想要的任何东西。任何形状、形态或质地。它还会时刻保持我的身体清洁
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“It can be anything at all that I want it to be. Any shape, form, or consistency. It also keeps my body clean at all times"

rows.original: – I’m sure you noticed a difference when we made our relationship official
rows.translation: ——我相信，在我们正式确定关系时，你已经注意到差别了
rows.raw: " – I’m sure you noticed a difference when we made our relationship official"

rows.original: As an example, more of the dress’s material makes the same journey, adding to her black glove, until it’s twice as large as her hand is. Her massive hand flexes and wiggles its fingers as naturally as her ungloved hand would.
rows.translation: 作为示范，更多裙装材料沿同一路径汇聚到黑色手套上，直到那只手变成她正常手掌的两倍大。硕大的手掌屈伸着，手指灵活摆动，与没戴手套的手一样自然。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs an example, more of the dress’s material makes the same journey, adding to her black glove, until it’s twice as large as her hand is. Her massive hand flexes and wiggles its fingers as naturally as her ungloved hand would."

rows.original: “I can’t change its color, though. It’s pitch black, through and through. Which works out pretty well for me; I’m not leaving the shadows when I work anyway, and when it’s time to play, black is always in season.”
rows.translation: “不过我没法改变它的颜色。它从里到外都是漆黑的。这倒很适合我；工作时我本来就不会离开阴影，而到了玩乐时间，黑色永远都不过时。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t change its color, though. It’s pitch black, through and through. Which works out pretty well for me; I’m not leaving the shadows when I work anyway, and when it’s time to play, black is always in season.”"

rows.original: Her enormous hand shrinks back down as the material crawls back up her arm and towards her shoulder. Like before, the tendrils slip down into her cleavage – but, evidently feeling frisky, she has the material collect around each breast, boosting their size from her already-enviable D-cups straight up to E’s. They’re pitch black, making her look like’s wearing a tube-top under her dress, and she’s stuffing it rather shamelessly.
rows.translation: 她那只巨手缩回原状，材料沿手臂向肩头爬回。和之前一样，触须滑入乳沟——但她显然来了兴致，让材料聚拢在两只乳房周围，将本就令人艳羡的D罩杯直接增大到E罩杯。它们漆黑一片，让她看起来像在裙子下面穿了件抹胸，而且毫不羞涩地把它撑得满满当当。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer enormous hand shrinks back down as the material crawls back up her arm and towards her shoulder. Like before, the tendrils slip down into her cleavage – but, evidently feeling frisky, she has the material collect around each breast, boosting their size from her already-enviable D-cups straight up to E’s. They’re pitch black, making her look like’s wearing a tube-top under her dress, and she’s stuffing it rather shamelessly."

rows.original: “Imagine how fun it could be if I could,” she says, winking at you, lifting one arm and stretching over her head. The motion even makes her breasts jiggle realistically. Before you say another word, the material disperses around her body, until her dress was exactly as she had it before.
rows.translation: “想想看，如果我真能改变颜色，会有多好玩，”她朝你眨眼，抬起一条手臂伸过头顶。这个动作甚至让她的乳房逼真地颤动。你还没来得及说话，材料便重新散布全身，裙子恢复成先前一模一样的样子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Imagine how fun it could be if I could,” she says, winking at you, lifting one arm and stretching over her head. The motion even makes her breasts jiggle realistically. Before you say another word, the material disperses around her body, until her dress was exactly as she had it before."

rows.original: You ask her how she ‘communicates’ with the dress. She mentioned that she’s connected to it ‘neurologically.’ Does she mean, like... on an intellectual level, or something?
rows.translation: 你问她怎样与战衣“交流”。她说自己通过“神经”与它连接。她是说，类似于...在思想层面上，或者别的什么吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how she ‘communicates’ with the dress. She mentioned that she’s connected to it ‘neurologically.’ Does she mean, like... on an intellectual level, or something?"

rows.original: “Something like that,” she answers cheerily. Pushing on the bar, she spins on her stool, showing you her back, and points to a small spot on the back of her neck. There is a small, emerald-green piece of plastic, no larger than a fingernail, nestled into her skin, at the base of her skull. “The suit is connected to me through this. When I want less material, it all goes right into this little receiver, and when I want more, this is where it comes from.” She turns back toward you, a downright giddy smile on her face. “You see in those old-timey classic movies, about thieves breaking into banks or museums, and they’re wearing belts and heavy backpacks full of all the tools they need... I can’t imagine working like that.”
rows.translation: “差不多吧，”她愉快地回答。她撑住吧台，在凳子上转身，把后背展示给你，并指向后颈的一小块区域。那里嵌着一小片祖母绿色塑料，尺寸不比指甲大，正位于颅骨底端。“战衣就是通过这个与我相连。需要减少材料时，它们全都会进入这个小接收器；需要更多材料时，也会从这里出来。”她转回你这边，脸上挂着兴奋至极的笑容。“你看那些老式经典电影，窃贼闯进银行或博物馆时，总要穿着腰带、背着装满所需工具的沉重背包...我简直无法想象那样工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something like that,” she answers cheerily. Pushing on the bar, she spins on her stool, showing you her back, and points to a small spot on the back of her neck. There is a small, emerald-green piece of plastic, no larger than a fingernail, nestled into her skin, at the base of her skull. “The suit is connected to me through this. When I want less material, it all goes right into this little receiver, and when I want more, this is where it comes from.” She turns back toward you, a downright giddy smile on her face. “You see in those old-timey classic movies, about thieves breaking into banks or museums, and they’re wearing belts and heavy backpacks full of all the tools they need... I can’t imagine working like that.”"

rows.original: If she’s connected with the suit neurologically, does that mean she can ‘feel’ it? If the suit is damaged, would it hurt her?
rows.translation: 既然她通过神经与战衣连接，是不是意味着她能“感觉”到它？如果战衣受损，她会痛吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIf she’s connected with the suit neurologically, does that mean she can ‘feel’ it? If the suit is damaged, would it hurt her?"

rows.original: The question seems to catch Lorelei off-guard, and she doesn’t know how to answer it at first. “Yyy,” she drones, trying to piece together the sentence in her head, “yes, close enough. It’s sort of like a second skin, and I feel anything that touches it just as well as if it touches my bare skin, but at the same time, I don’t think that saying I ‘feel’ it really does it justice. You can’t command your own skin to change shape or to flow like water, and I’m afraid I can’t explain all the nuances to it adequately, but I can tell you that I can feel when something touches it, or tries to damage it.” She smiles. “Luckily, though, it can’t be damaged. After all, how are you going to ‘damage’ something that has no shape?”
rows.translation: 这个问题似乎让洛蕾莱措手不及，一开始她不知道该怎样回答。“是——”她拖长声音，在脑中努力组织句子，“是，差不多。它有点像第二层皮肤，任何东西碰到它时，我都能像裸露的皮肤被触碰一样清楚地感觉到；但与此同时，我觉得仅用‘感觉’来形容并不准确。你无法命令自己的皮肤改变形状或像水一样流动，而我恐怕也无法充分解释其中所有细微差别；不过，我可以告诉你，当有什么碰到它或试图损坏它时，我都能感觉到。”她微笑道。“幸运的是，它不可能受损。毕竟，要怎样‘损坏’一种没有固定形状的东西？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe question seems to catch Lorelei off-guard, and she doesn’t know how to answer it at first. “Yyy,” she drones, trying to piece together the sentence in her head, “yes, close enough. It’s sort of like a second skin, and I feel anything that touches it just as well as if it touches my bare skin, but at the same time, I don’t think that saying I ‘feel’ it really does it justice. You can’t command your own skin to change shape or to flow like water, and I’m afraid I can’t explain all the nuances to it adequately, but I can tell you that I can feel when something touches it, or tries to damage it.” She smiles. “Luckily, though, it can’t be damaged. After all, how are you going to ‘damage’ something that has no shape?”"

rows.original: Can it not be burnt, or frozen? You imagine it’s insulated against electricity.
rows.translation: 它不能被烧毁或冻住吗？你猜它应该能绝缘电流。
rows.raw: "\n\nCan it not be burnt, or frozen? You imagine it’s insulated against electricity."

rows.original: “It can be burnt and frozen, yes. As useful a tool as it is,” she says, before running her hand down the leg of her dress and swishing it against you, “and as fashionable, you still need to remember that it’s billions of tiny machines all working to my every whim
rows.translation: “它确实会被烧灼和冻结。尽管这是件非常实用的工具，”她说着，用手顺着裙腿滑下，让裙摆扫过你，“也同样时髦，但你依旧得记住，它本质上是数十亿台微型机器，共同服从我的每一个念头
rows.raw: "\n\n“It can be burnt and frozen, yes. As useful a tool as it is,” she says, before running her hand down the leg of her dress and swishing it against you, “and as fashionable, you still need to remember that it’s billions of tiny machines all working to my every whim"

rows.original: , like all the most useful and fashionable things should
rows.translation: ，就像一切最实用又最时髦的东西本来都该如此
rows.raw: ", like all the most useful and fashionable things should"

rows.original: . They obey nature as much as the rest of us.”
rows.translation: 。它们和我们其他人一样，都必须遵守自然规律。”
rows.raw: ". They obey nature as much as the rest of us.”"

rows.original: You get the feeling that this conversation is starting to get a little too complex for what is supposed to be a relaxed, casual atmosphere. You take a drink of your wine and tell her that you have one last question about it; Lorelei sits with a patient smile, ready to answer. You ask her how she got it.
rows.translation: 你觉得，这场谈话对于本应轻松随意的氛围来说开始变得太复杂了。你喝了一口酒，告诉她自己还有最后一个关于战衣的问题；洛蕾莱耐心微笑着坐好，准备回答。你问她是怎么得到它的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the feeling that this conversation is starting to get a little too complex for what is supposed to be a relaxed, casual atmosphere. You take a drink of your wine and tell her that you have one last question about it; Lorelei sits with a patient smile, ready to answer. You ask her how she got it."

rows.original: “It was a gift,” she says with a coy smile, putting her hand over her chest. “Straight from Reaper Armaments themselves. It was a very thoughtful one.”
rows.translation: “一份礼物，”她露出矜持的微笑，将手放在胸口。“直接来自死神军工。真是一份体贴的礼物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a gift,” she says with a coy smile, putting her hand over her chest. “Straight from Reaper Armaments themselves. It was a very thoughtful one.”"

rows.original: You turn your head in disbelief. Why would Reaper Armaments hand such an impressive piece of technology to her? Did they not know what she would be capable of with it?
rows.translation: 你难以置信地歪过头。死神军工为什么会把如此惊人的技术交给她？难道他们不知道她能用它做到什么吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn your head in disbelief. Why would Reaper Armaments hand such an impressive piece of technology to her? Did they not know what she would be capable of with it?"

rows.original: “Oh, the gift wasn’t addressed to me, darling.”
rows.translation: “哦，那份礼物并不是写给我的，亲爱的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, the gift wasn’t addressed to me, darling.”"

rows.original: ... that answers that.
rows.translation: ...那就说得通了。
rows.raw: "\n\n... that answers that."

rows.original: Her Suit
rows.translation: 她的战衣
rows.raw: "Her Suit"

rows.original: DRESS
rows.raw: "DRESS"

rows.original: You ask Lorelei what brings her to Zhèng Shi. She’s a woman of finer tastes and standards; Zhèng Shi is hot, dirty, stuffy, and is filled to the brim with a bunch of deplorables that, if they had their way, wouldn’t hesitate to debase her to their level. And yet, she’s not only stayed her long enough to fully furnish her own little pocket of paradise, but she has a loyal doorman. What’s her history here?
rows.translation: 你问洛蕾莱是什么把她带到了郑石。她是个品味与标准都很高的女人；郑石炎热、肮脏、憋闷，挤满了一群卑劣之徒，只要有机会便会毫不犹豫地把她拉低到同样层次。然而，她不仅在这里待了足够久，把属于自己的小天堂布置得一应俱全，甚至还有一名忠诚的门卫。她和这里究竟有什么渊源？
rows.raw: "You ask Lorelei what brings her to Zhèng Shi. She’s a woman of finer tastes and standards; Zhèng Shi is hot, dirty, stuffy, and is filled to the brim with a bunch of deplorables that, if they had their way, wouldn’t hesitate to debase her to their level. And yet, she’s not only stayed her long enough to fully furnish her own little pocket of paradise, but she has a loyal doorman. What’s her history here?"

rows.original: Lorelei has her wine to her mouth by the time you finish speaking, and take a moment to breathe before answering. “Goodness,” she says, “that’s so many questions all at once, darling.” She smiles that sweet, charming, disarming smile of hers. “I don’t mind answering, of course. I’d want to know all about me, too. I am fascinating, after all.”
rows.translation: 你说完后，洛蕾莱已经把酒杯送到唇边。她先花了一会儿喘口气，才开始回答。“天哪，”她说道，“一下子问了这么多问题，亲爱的。”她露出那种甜美、迷人、令人卸下防备的微笑。“当然，我不介意回答。换作是我，也会想了解关于我的一切。毕竟，我确实魅力非凡。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei has her wine to her mouth by the time you finish speaking, and take a moment to breathe before answering. “Goodness,” she says, “that’s so many questions all at once, darling.” She smiles that sweet, charming, disarming smile of hers. “I don’t mind answering, of course. I’d want to know all about me, too. I am fascinating, after all.”"

rows.original: You share a laugh at that, and you wait respectfully for her to pick a question and start answering. “Well,” she starts, sliding her finger along the rim of her wine glass, “The truth is, I’m actually here on hired business. Care to guess by whom?”
rows.translation: 你也为此一笑，并礼貌地等她挑一个问题开始回答。“那么，”她用手指沿着酒杯边缘滑动，开口说道，“事实上，我是受雇来这里办事的。猜猜雇主是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou share a laugh at that, and you wait respectfully for her to pick a question and start answering. “Well,” she starts, sliding her finger along the rim of her wine glass, “The truth is, I’m actually here on hired business. Care to guess by whom?”"

rows.original: A mining company, like RhenWorld, Pyrite Heavy Industries, or even Steele Tech? The base has a mining operation; surely one of them would like to stake their claim to something as mineral-rich as Zhèng Shi.
rows.translation: 某家采矿公司，比如仁世、黄铁重工，甚至斯蒂尔科技？基地里有采矿业务；如此矿产丰富的郑石，肯定会有公司想来分一杯羹。
rows.raw: "\n\nA mining company, like RhenWorld, Pyrite Heavy Industries, or even Steele Tech? The base has a mining operation; surely one of them would like to stake their claim to something as mineral-rich as Zhèng Shi."

rows.original: “An interesting, and well-reasoned guess, darling, but no, I was not hired by any mining company.”
rows.translation: “很有意思，而且推理得很周全，亲爱的；但不，我并非受任何采矿公司雇用。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“An interesting, and well-reasoned guess, darling, but no, I was not hired by any mining company.”"

rows.original: Perhaps a rival ne’er-do-well gang, looking to try and encroach on the Zhèng Shi pirate’s turf? Like, the Black Void, maybe?
rows.translation: 也许是某个敌对的不法帮派，想要侵占郑石海盗的地盘？例如黑色虚空？
rows.raw: "\n\nPerhaps a rival ne’er-do-well gang, looking to try and encroach on the Zhèng Shi pirate’s turf? Like, the Black Void, maybe?"

rows.original: Lorelei frowns at the suggestion. “The Black Void are thugs, brutes, and murderers. They operate too differently from how I do, and besides, they’re beneath me.” However, she winks at you. “You’re getting closer, though.”
rows.translation: 听到这个猜测，洛蕾莱皱起眉。“黑色虚空是一群暴徒、蛮人和杀人犯。他们的行事方式与我差异太大，更何况，他们不配与我相提并论。”不过，她还是朝你眨眼。“但你已经更接近答案了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei frowns at the suggestion. “The Black Void are thugs, brutes, and murderers. They operate too differently from how I do, and besides, they’re beneath me.” However, she winks at you. “You’re getting closer, though.”"

rows.original: You rack your brain for a moment, trying to think of anyone else that might want to take advantage of Lorelei’s skillset. Exasperated, you suggest she’s working for the Zhèng Shi pirates themselves, knowing that it would make no sense. Why would she be hired to steal from her own employer’s people?
rows.translation: 你绞尽脑汁片刻，试图想出还有谁会想利用洛蕾莱的本领。最后你有些不耐烦地猜她是为郑石海盗本身效力，尽管你知道这毫无道理。她为什么会受雇去偷自己雇主手下的东西？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rack your brain for a moment, trying to think of anyone else that might want to take advantage of Lorelei’s skillset. Exasperated, you suggest she’s working for the Zhèng Shi pirates themselves, knowing that it would make no sense. Why would she be hired to steal from her own employer’s people?"

rows.original: Lorelei laughs at the suggestion. “It would be a unique twist, wouldn’t it? Maybe someone up in the chain of command is trying to keep their team on their toes! But no, that’s a little too fantastic of a suggestion, I’m afraid.”
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱听见这个猜测后笑了。“这会是个独特的转折，不是吗？也许指挥链上某个人只是想让队伍保持警惕！不过恐怕，这个猜测还是有点太异想天开了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei laughs at the suggestion. “It would be a unique twist, wouldn’t it? Maybe someone up in the chain of command is trying to keep their team on their toes! But no, that’s a little too fantastic of a suggestion, I’m afraid.”"

rows.original: You tell her that you give up.
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己放弃了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you give up."

rows.original: “I’m here on behalf of the United Galactic Confederacy.”
rows.translation: “我是代表星系联合邦联来这里的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m here on behalf of the United Galactic Confederacy.”"

rows.original: You’re surprised – you’d have thought she’d want to stay as far away from the law as she could. You ask how they even got into contact with her.
rows.translation: 你很惊讶——你原以为她会想尽可能远离法律。你问他们到底是怎样联系上她的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re surprised – you’d have thought she’d want to stay as far away from the law as she could. You ask how they even got into contact with her."

rows.original: A couple of suggestions immediately come to mind, but you reason away all of them – whoever hired Lorelei must have quite a bit of power and resources to not only contact her, but convince her in the first place. Off the top of your head, that leaves only two major possibilities: Nova Securities, and the United Galactic Confederacy.
rows.translation: 几个答案立刻浮上脑海，但你又逐一排除——雇用洛蕾莱的人必定拥有相当强大的权力与资源，才能联系到她，更别说先说服她。你一时能想到的主要可能只剩两个：新星安保，以及星系联合邦联。
rows.raw: "\n\nA couple of suggestions immediately come to mind, but you reason away all of them – whoever hired Lorelei must have quite a bit of power and resources to not only contact her, but convince her in the first place. Off the top of your head, that leaves only two major possibilities: Nova Securities, and the United Galactic Confederacy."

rows.original: If it’s one of those two, you ask yourself: what would either of them want with Zhèng Shi? You figure that Nova Securities would be on neutral terms with the pirate base, if anything, so if she were hired by them, it’d be to keep tabs on the base, nothing more.
rows.translation: 如果是这两者之一，你不禁自问：他们会想从郑石得到什么？你猜新星安保与海盗基地至少应当保持中立关系，所以若是他们雇了她，最多只是为了监视基地。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf it’s one of those two, you ask yourself: what would either of them want with Zhèng Shi? You figure that Nova Securities would be on neutral terms with the pirate base, if anything, so if she were hired by them, it’d be to keep tabs on the base, nothing more."

rows.original: Whereas the U.G.C., being the governing body of most of the known universe, would have every incentive to want to crack down on something as illicit as a pirate base in an asteroid, performing illegal mining operations and running a slave trade. Lorelei would naturally want to stay away from the law – but, at the same time, the law could be a very powerful ally for a criminal.
rows.translation: 反观U.G.C.，作为已知宇宙大部分地区的统治机构，当然有充分理由取缔一座藏在小行星里、从事非法采矿和奴隶贸易的海盗基地。洛蕾莱自然会想远离法律——但与此同时，法律也可能成为罪犯极其强大的盟友。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhereas the U.G.C., being the governing body of most of the known universe, would have every incentive to want to crack down on something as illicit as a pirate base in an asteroid, performing illegal mining operations and running a slave trade. Lorelei would naturally want to stay away from the law – but, at the same time, the law could be a very powerful ally for a criminal."

rows.original: Still, all this inner monologuing does nothing to humor Lorelei
rows.translation: 然而，这一番内心独白完全逗不乐洛蕾莱
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, all this inner monologuing does nothing to humor Lorelei"

rows.original: , which is why you’re here in the first place
rows.translation: ，而这本来正是你来到这里的目的
rows.raw: ", which is why you’re here in the first place"

rows.original: . You decide to make your guess: she’s here on behalf of the United Galactic Confederacy.
rows.translation: 。你决定说出自己的猜测：她是代表星系联合邦联来到这里的。
rows.raw: ". You decide to make your guess: she’s here on behalf of the United Galactic Confederacy."

rows.original: Lorelei blinks in surprise. “Uh, yes,” she says haltingly. “That’s... that’s correct.” Her eyes fall from yours to the floor, totally unsure of how she should process your completely correct guess. “Wow.”
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱惊讶地眨了眨眼。“呃，是的，”她结结巴巴地说。“那...那是正确答案。”她的视线从你身上落到地板上，完全不知道该如何消化你这次全然正确的猜测。“哇。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei blinks in surprise. “Uh, yes,” she says haltingly. “That’s... that’s correct.” Her eyes fall from yours to the floor, totally unsure of how she should process your completely correct guess. “Wow.”"

rows.original: You ask the first obvious question that comes to mind: how did they even come into contact with her?
rows.translation: 你问出脑中最先浮现的显而易见的问题：他们究竟如何联系到她？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask the first obvious question that comes to mind: how did they even come into contact with her?"

rows.original: “That’s actually a whole story for another time, I’m afraid,” she says. “What’s important is that they did, and we... worked out a deal.”
rows.translation: “恐怕那是个得留到下次再讲的完整故事，”她说道。“重要的是，他们确实联系上了我，而我们...谈成了一笔交易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s actually a whole story for another time, I’m afraid,” she says. “What’s important is that they did, and we... worked out a deal.”"

rows.original: You ask if she can tell you what the deal was, or if that’s too confidential to share with
rows.translation: 你问她能否透露交易内容，还是说这对
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if she can tell you what the deal was, or if that’s too confidential to share with"

rows.original: a pet like
rows.translation: 像你这样的宠物
rows.raw: " a pet like"

rows.original: yourself.
rows.translation: 而言太过机密。
rows.raw: " yourself."

rows.original: Lorelei takes a drink of her wine; when she pulls the glass away, she savors what’s in her mouth, a coy grin on her face, as she recollects her meeting with the confederacy. Then, she swallows. “They offered me two of the things I coveted the most; and they only wanted one.” She winks at you, her teeth snidely poking from her curling lips. “I give them information, and they give me amnesty... and all the jewels a lady could want.”
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱喝了一口酒；移开酒杯后，她细细品味着口中的酒液，脸上带着矜持笑容，回忆起自己与邦联的会面。随后她咽下酒液。“他们给了我最渴望的两样东西，而只想从我这里得到一样。”她朝你眨眼，弯起的唇间露出带着讥诮意味的牙齿。“我给他们情报，他们给我赦免...还有一位淑女想要的全部珠宝。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei takes a drink of her wine; when she pulls the glass away, she savors what’s in her mouth, a coy grin on her face, as she recollects her meeting with the confederacy. Then, she swallows. “They offered me two of the things I coveted the most; and they only wanted one.” She winks at you, her teeth snidely poking from her curling lips. “I give them information, and they give me amnesty... and all the jewels a lady could want.”"

rows.original: Why would the pirates of Zhèng Shi give her the information she’s after? Hell, why would they give her a private room, allow her to decorate it, and let her hire a doorman?
rows.translation: 郑石的海盗为什么会把她想要的情报告诉她？见鬼，他们为什么还要给她一间私人房间，允许她随意装饰，甚至让她雇用门卫？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhy would the pirates of Zhèng Shi give her the information she’s after? Hell, why would they give her a private room, allow her to decorate it, and let her hire a doorman?"

rows.original: She hums, staring into her wine glass on the counter as she considers her response to your question. “Tell me, darling... if information is the most powerful weapon in an arsenal, what weapon is potent enough to destabilize it?”
rows.translation: 她轻哼着，盯着吧台上的酒杯，思考怎样回答你的问题。“告诉我，亲爱的...如果情报是军火库中最强大的武器，又有什么武器足以瓦解它？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hums, staring into her wine glass on the counter as she considers her response to your question. “Tell me, darling... if information is the most powerful weapon in an arsenal, what weapon is potent enough to destabilize it?”"

rows.original: You think on it, but you don’t know. Information isn’t physical, and once it’s obtained, it can’t be destroyed. You don’t know what could be more powerful than that.
rows.translation: 你认真想了想，却不知道答案。情报不是实体，一旦获得就无法销毁。你想不出什么能比它更强大。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think on it, but you don’t know. Information isn’t physical, and once it’s obtained, it can’t be destroyed. You don’t know what could be more powerful than that."

rows.original: “Misinformation, honey.”
rows.translation: “虚假情报，亲爱的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Misinformation, honey.”"

rows.original: If information is so highly coveted because of its potency, then the only thing that could beat it is sabotage. Misinformation. Lies.
rows.translation: 如果情报因其威力而备受追捧，那么唯一能击败它的就是破坏。虚假情报。谎言。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf information is so highly coveted because of its potency, then the only thing that could beat it is sabotage. Misinformation. Lies."

rows.original: <i>“Correct.
rows.translation: <i>“正确。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Correct."

rows.original: Very good.
rows.translation: 很好。
rows.raw: " Very good."

rows.original: Lorelei brings her wine to her mouth and takes another drink.
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱将酒杯送到嘴边，又喝了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei brings her wine to her mouth and takes another drink."

rows.original: “Ask anyone on Zhèng Shi why I’m here, and you’ll get anything from me being hired help from Nova Securities, sent to test their patrols and their systems from exploits; to me being one of Maike’s personal concubines; to me being a fencer for their mining operations, selling the jewels for credits and helping them fund their plans....”
rows.translation: “随便问郑石上的任何人我为什么在这里，你得到的答案可能无所不包：有人说我是新星安保雇来的帮手，专门寻找巡逻和系统中的漏洞以测试他们；有人说我是麦克的私人情妇之一；还有人说我是他们采矿业务的销赃人，替他们把珠宝换成信用点，资助他们的计划....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ask anyone on Zhèng Shi why I’m here, and you’ll get anything from me being hired help from Nova Securities, sent to test their patrols and their systems from exploits; to me being one of Maike’s personal concubines; to me being a fencer for their mining operations, selling the jewels for credits and helping them fund their plans....”"

rows.original: She looks around the room, to all the gems she has studded into the walls and floors. “Maybe not so much that last one,” she laughs. “But if there’s any one thing any of them will tell you, it’s that I am not to be questioned.”
rows.translation: 她环顾房间里镶嵌在墙壁与地板上的所有宝石。“也许最后那个说法没那么可信，”她笑道。“不过有一点，任何人都会告诉你：我不该受到质疑。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks around the room, to all the gems she has studded into the walls and floors. “Maybe not so much that last one,” she laughs. “But if there’s any one thing any of them will tell you, it’s that I am not to be questioned.”"

rows.original: She runs her finger along your collar. “I reward the ones that do as they’re told, you know.”
rows.translation: 她用手指沿你的项圈滑过。“你知道，我会奖赏那些听话的人。”
rows.raw: " She runs her finger along your collar. “I reward the ones that do as they’re told, you know.”"

rows.original: You hastily ask her why she’s telling you all this. Isn’t she worried you might try to snitch on her?
rows.translation: 你赶紧问她为什么要把这些全告诉你。她不担心你去告密吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hastily ask her why she’s telling you all this. Isn’t she worried you might try to snitch on her?"

rows.original: She smirks.
rows.translation: 她得意一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smirks."

rows.original: “No.” And that’s that.
rows.translation: “不担心。”就这么简单。
rows.raw: " “No.” And that’s that."

rows.original: “And tell them what? That I’m a spy working for the Confederation?” She huffs once. “And what do you expect them to do if they believed you? An execution would point the Confederation here faster than a neon sign. Would they... ask me to leave?” She smiles – the same smile, but with something a little darker to the glint of her eye. “They know better. And,” she whispers, “so should you.”
rows.translation: “而且你能告诉他们什么？说我是替邦联效力的间谍？”她哼了一声。“即便他们相信，你又指望他们怎么做？处决我只会像霓虹招牌一样，更快把邦联引到这里。他们难道会...请我离开？”她微笑着——还是同样的笑容，但眼神中的光芒多了几分阴暗。“他们最好明白这一点。而且，”她低声说道，“你也一样。”
rows.raw: " “And tell them what? That I’m a spy working for the Confederation?” She huffs once. “And what do you expect them to do if they believed you? An execution would point the Confederation here faster than a neon sign. Would they... ask me to leave?” She smiles – the same smile, but with something a little darker to the glint of her eye. “They know better. And,” she whispers, “so should you.”"

rows.original: You have one last question for her, on the topic. Why did she attack you? A woman as well-informed as herself should have known who you were.
rows.translation: 关于这个话题，你还有最后一个问题。她为什么攻击你？像她这样消息灵通的女人，应该早就知道你是谁。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have one last question for her, on the topic. Why did she attack you? A woman as well-informed as herself should have known who you were."

rows.original: “Indeed,” she says, bringing her wine to her lips and finishing her glass off. “Be a gentle[pc.man] and pour me another, would you?” You take her glass and do as she asks. “There’s no long-winded secret, darling; I wanted to know if you were worth my time. If you weren’t, you would be free money for the taking.
rows.translation: “确实，”她把酒杯送到唇边，一饮而尽。“做个体贴的[pc.man]，再替我倒一杯，好吗？”你接过她的杯子，依言照办。“没什么冗长的秘密，亲爱的；我只是想知道你是否值得我花时间。如果不值得，你就只是任我取用的白送钱财。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Indeed,” she says, bringing her wine to her lips and finishing her glass off. “Be a gentle[pc.man] and pour me another, would you?” You take her glass and do as she asks. “There’s no long-winded secret, darling; I wanted to know if you were worth my time. If you weren’t, you would be free money for the taking."

rows.original: Imagine my surprise when you would be so much more, waiting to be taken.
rows.translation: 想象一下，当我发现等待着被夺走的你还远不止如此时，我有多惊喜。
rows.raw: " Imagine my surprise when you would be so much more, waiting to be taken."

rows.original: And if you were....”
rows.translation: 而如果你值得....”
rows.raw: " And if you were....”"

rows.original: When you hand her glass back to her, she touches your hand with hers, lingering her fingers along the back of your wrist. <i>“Well... here you’d be
rows.translation: 你把酒杯递回给她时，她用手触碰你的手，手指在你的腕背上流连。<i>“那么...你现在就会在这里
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you hand her glass back to her, she touches your hand with hers, lingering her fingers along the back of your wrist. <i>“Well... here you’d be"

rows.original: either way
rows.translation: ，无论如何
rows.raw: " either way"

rows.original: Why Here?
rows.translation: 为什么在这？
rows.raw: "Why Here?"

rows.original: DRESS
rows.raw: "DRESS"

rows.original: Knowing her line of work, Lorelei must be well acquainted with the rest of the peoples of Zhèng Shi (whether they want her to or not). You ask her what her opinion is on the groups and factions wandering the asteroid with her.
rows.translation: 以洛蕾莱的行当，她必定对郑石上的其他居民非常熟悉（无论他们是否乐意）。你问她如何看待与她一同在小行星上活动的各个群体与派系。
rows.raw: "Knowing her line of work, Lorelei must be well acquainted with the rest of the peoples of Zhèng Shi (whether they want her to or not). You ask her what her opinion is on the groups and factions wandering the asteroid with her."

rows.original: She lowers her wine glass from her mouth and frowns in thought at the question. “Pirates,” she whispers to herself disdainfully. You can tell that she doesn’t like thinking about most of them. “Brutes; thugs; deviants; the lot of them.” She sets down her wine glass and grasps your hand, looking you in the eye. “I’m sure this will be rich to hear, but there’s a certain finesse to theft as a craft. If thievery were like baking, I would consider myself a world-class artiste, and I make the finest cakes, fit for royalty, and those pirates are little more than meat butchers.”
rows.translation: 她从唇边放下酒杯，听见问题后若有所思地皱起眉。“海盗，”她轻蔑地低声自语。看得出来，她不喜欢去想其中大多数人。“蛮人、暴徒、变态，全都是。”她放下酒杯，握住你的手，注视着你的双眼。“我知道这话从我嘴里说出来很有意思，但偷盗这门手艺讲究一种精妙。如果偷盗好比烘焙，我就是世界级的大师，制作的都是足以献给王室的顶级蛋糕；而那些海盗不过是宰肉的屠夫。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lowers her wine glass from her mouth and frowns in thought at the question. “Pirates,” she whispers to herself disdainfully. You can tell that she doesn’t like thinking about most of them. “Brutes; thugs; deviants; the lot of them.” She sets down her wine glass and grasps your hand, looking you in the eye. “I’m sure this will be rich to hear, but there’s a certain finesse to theft as a craft. If thievery were like baking, I would consider myself a world-class artiste, and I make the finest cakes, fit for royalty, and those pirates are little more than meat butchers.”"

rows.original: You take it to mean that she isn’t fond of any of them, and that she’d prefer to interact with them as little as possible.
rows.translation: 你理解为她对其中任何人都没有好感，而且希望尽量少与他们打交道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take it to mean that she isn’t fond of any of them, and that she’d prefer to interact with them as little as possible."

rows.original: “It’s difficult to find a diamond in the rough in a place as coarse as Zhèng Shi, darling, and I am neither vain, nor,” she continues, raising her wine glass and toasting it to you, “drunk enough to exclude myself.” She takes a swig – a full, hearty one, unlike the ladylike sips she had been taking up to that point. “I can at least consider myself to be a finely-sanded pebble compared to their droppings-covered-in-cat-litter.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，在郑石这样粗鄙的地方，很难从砂砾中找到钻石；而我既没有自负到，也没有，”她继续说道，举起酒杯向你致意，“醉到把自己排除在外。”她大喝一口——不同于此前淑女般的浅抿，这一口喝得畅快而豪爽。“不过，和他们那些裹着猫砂的粪便相比，我至少能算一颗精心打磨过的鹅卵石。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s difficult to find a diamond in the rough in a place as coarse as Zhèng Shi, darling, and I am neither vain, nor,” she continues, raising her wine glass and toasting it to you, “drunk enough to exclude myself.” She takes a swig – a full, hearty one, unlike the ladylike sips she had been taking up to that point. “I can at least consider myself to be a finely-sanded pebble compared to their droppings-covered-in-cat-litter.”"

rows.original: She clearly doesn’t hold them in a high regard, but, perhaps, you can work with that; it’ll at least give her something to talk about, and Lorelei isn’t one to pass up the opportunity to talk about things. You ask her to start with who or what she likes the most, and then work her way down from there.
rows.translation: 她显然对他们评价不高，但也许你可以利用这一点；至少这能给她一个话题，而洛蕾莱从不会放过谈论事情的机会。你请她从自己最喜欢的人或事物开始，再一路往下说。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe clearly doesn’t hold them in a high regard, but, perhaps, you can work with that; it’ll at least give her something to talk about, and Lorelei isn’t one to pass up the opportunity to talk about things. You ask her to start with who or what she likes the most, and then work her way down from there."

rows.original: She hums, and swirls the wine in her glass as she considers it. “Perhaps it might be best to start light. If I start with the truly deplorable, I’ll be too worked up and too sauced to say a good thing about anyone!” She looks at you, and her hand
rows.translation: 她哼了一声，一边思索一边晃动杯中的酒。“也许最好先从轻松的说起。要是先讲那些真正可悲的家伙，我肯定会气昏头、醉过头，最后谁的好话都说不出来！”她看向你，手
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hums, and swirls the wine in her glass as she considers it. “Perhaps it might be best to start light. If I start with the truly deplorable, I’ll be too worked up and too sauced to say a good thing about anyone!” She looks at you, and her hand"

rows.original: draws a finger along your collar.
rows.translation: 用一根手指沿着你的项圈划过。
rows.raw: " draws a finger along your collar."

rows.original: squeezes yours.
rows.translation: 握紧了你的手。
rows.raw: " squeezes yours."

rows.original: She smiles at you affectionately. “Almost anyone. There aren’t too many bad things to say about you, darling.”
rows.translation: 她深情地对你微笑。“几乎所有人。关于你倒没多少坏话可说，亲爱的。”
rows.raw: " She smiles at you affectionately. “Almost anyone. There aren’t too many bad things to say about you, darling.”"

rows.original: Lorelei takes a sip of her wine before getting started. “Easily, the best crowd in Zhèng Shi are the Rodenians. Have you met them?” She continues before you can respond either way. “Adorable little rat boys and rat girls. I was never one for rodents as pets, growing up – we were more of a dog and cat family,
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱抿了一口酒，开始说道：“郑石上最好相处的无疑是罗德尼安人。你见过他们吗？”没等你回答，她便继续说道：“那些可爱的小鼠男孩和鼠女孩。我从小就不喜欢把啮齿动物当宠物——我家更喜欢猫狗，
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei takes a sip of her wine before getting started. “Easily, the best crowd in Zhèng Shi are the Rodenians. Have you met them?” She continues before you can respond either way. “Adorable little rat boys and rat girls. I was never one for rodents as pets, growing up – we were more of a dog and cat family,"

rows.original: ” she says, then pauses, her eyes subtly scanning your body. She continues, “
rows.translation: ”她说道，接着停了一下，目光不动声色地扫过你的身体。她继续说道：“
rows.raw: "” she says, then pauses, her eyes subtly scanning your body. She continues, “"

rows.original: but if I were the type, I’d
rows.translation: 不过如果我是那种人，我会
rows.raw: "but if I were the type, I’d"

rows.original: slap one of my collars on them and make them mine.
rows.translation: 给他们中的一个戴上我的项圈，让其归我所有。
rows.raw: " slap one of my collars on them and make them mine."

rows.original: snatch one of them up for myself in a heartbeat.
rows.translation: 毫不犹豫地抓一个回来归我所有。
rows.raw: " snatch one of them up for myself in a heartbeat."

rows.original: Her eyes wander the room momentarily, taking in the décor. “They’re harmless when you learn more about them; they’re cute as could be; and really, if any person or persons in Zhèng Shi could say they had a noble cause, it would be them.” She takes another sip, her tongue gliding along the rim of her wine glass. “Apart from myself, naturally. The only ‘problem’ I have with them is their... penchant for jewels and gems, and I’m not overly fond of competition, but so long as no jewel leaves this room, I can learn to coexist with them.”
rows.translation: 她的目光在房间里游移片刻，打量着装潢。“深入了解后，你会发现他们毫无威胁；他们可爱得不得了；而且说真的，要说郑石上有谁的事业堪称高尚，那就是他们。”她又抿了一口，舌尖沿酒杯边缘滑过。“当然，除了我以外。我对他们唯一的‘意见’就是他们对珠宝和宝石的……偏爱，而我不太喜欢竞争。不过只要这房间里一颗宝石都不少，我就能学着跟他们和平共处。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes wander the room momentarily, taking in the décor. “They’re harmless when you learn more about them; they’re cute as could be; and really, if any person or persons in Zhèng Shi could say they had a noble cause, it would be them.” She takes another sip, her tongue gliding along the rim of her wine glass. “Apart from myself, naturally. The only ‘problem’ I have with them is their... penchant for jewels and gems, and I’m not overly fond of competition, but so long as no jewel leaves this room, I can learn to coexist with them.”"

rows.original: You ask her who’s next on the list. She puts her chin between her thumb and index finger and rubs as she considers the question. “I suppose the next in line would be that fluffy butch Korgonne mechanic, Urbolg, in the hangar. He’s the sort that prefers to be left alone to his work. I rarely intrude on him for anything, and, so far as I know, he hasn’t done anything terribly unbecoming.”
rows.translation: 你问她名单上的下一位是谁。她用拇指和食指托住下巴，一边摩挲一边思考。“下一位大概是机库里那个毛茸茸、很有男子气概的科尔贡机械师乌尔博格。他喜欢别人别打扰他工作。我很少因为什么事去烦他，而且据我所知，他没做过什么特别不得体的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her who’s next on the list. She puts her chin between her thumb and index finger and rubs as she considers the question. “I suppose the next in line would be that fluffy butch Korgonne mechanic, Urbolg, in the hangar. He’s the sort that prefers to be left alone to his work. I rarely intrude on him for anything, and, so far as I know, he hasn’t done anything terribly unbecoming.”"

rows.original: She frowns as she recalls the mechanic. “Let me prelude what I’m about to say by saying that I don’t find him attractive – too much grease and oil, and his fur is coarse and unwashed. I’m not one to appreciate the ‘short-and-stout’ body-types, either.” She leans in close, her voice becoming quiet, as she shares her dirty secret with you: “But by Gods, [pc.name], I could damn-near fold in half for that accent of his.
rows.translation: 回想起那个机械师，她皱起眉。“先声明一下，我接下来说的话并不代表我觉得他有吸引力——他身上油污太多，毛发粗糙又没洗过。我也不喜欢‘矮壮型’身材。”她凑近过来，压低声音，与你分享她肮脏的小秘密：“可诸神在上，[pc.name]，单凭他那口音，我几乎就愿意为他把自己对折。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe frowns as she recalls the mechanic. “Let me prelude what I’m about to say by saying that I don’t find him attractive – too much grease and oil, and his fur is coarse and unwashed. I’m not one to appreciate the ‘short-and-stout’ body-types, either.” She leans in close, her voice becoming quiet, as she shares her dirty secret with you: “But by Gods, [pc.name], I could damn-near fold in half for that accent of his."

rows.original: And only sometimes, [pc.name], I wonder if he’d be okay if I called him ‘daddy,’ too.
rows.translation: 而且只是偶尔，[pc.name]，我会想他介不介意我也叫他‘爸爸’。
rows.raw: " And only sometimes, [pc.name], I wonder if he’d be okay if I called him ‘daddy,’ too."

rows.original: Lorelei sits up straight, grasps the stem of her wine glass, and slams back the rest of the drink, before
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱挺直身子，抓住酒杯杯脚，一口喝光剩下的酒，随后
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei sits up straight, grasps the stem of her wine glass, and slams back the rest of the drink, before"

rows.original: handing it to you and wordlessly demanding you refill it for her.
rows.translation: 把杯子递给你，无声地要求你替她续杯。
rows.raw: " handing it to you and wordlessly demanding you refill it for her."

rows.original: reaching for the open bottle and pouring herself some more.
rows.translation: 伸手拿过开着的酒瓶，又给自己倒了一些。
rows.raw: " reaching for the open bottle and pouring herself some more."

rows.original: “But that’s about all the leniency I have for the fools in this cesspit.” She points one finger at you, almost accusatorily. “The Laquine Jumpers? Ditzy, aimless, rutting beasts, the lot of them. They each have endowments so large, it’s a wonder they have the focus to do any piracy, much less the function to press themselves into those skintight suits of theirs.”
rows.translation: “不过，我对这个粪坑里的蠢货也就宽容到这种程度了。”她伸出一根手指指着你，几乎像是在指控你。“那些拉奎因跳帮者？全都是些没头没脑、漫无目的、只会发情的野兽。他们个个天赋异禀得夸张，真不知道怎么还能集中精神去当海盗，更别提怎么把自己塞进那身紧身衣里了。”
rows.raw: " “But that’s about all the leniency I have for the fools in this cesspit.” She points one finger at you, almost accusatorily. “The Laquine Jumpers? Ditzy, aimless, rutting beasts, the lot of them. They each have endowments so large, it’s a wonder they have the focus to do any piracy, much less the function to press themselves into those skintight suits of theirs.”"

rows.original: She extends a second finger towards you. “The Slyveren ‘Slavebreakers,’ they call them? They’re unprofessional; they lack drive; and, worst of all, they cheat! They use psionics to wear down their prey and ‘break’ them, when any self-respecting seductress wouldn’t need to put their fingers into their target’s brain and start pulling at the wires. After all,” she continues,
rows.translation: 她朝你伸出第二根手指。“那些斯莱维伦人自称‘奴隶破坏者’？他们不专业、没干劲，而且最糟的是，他们作弊！他们用灵能削弱猎物并‘击垮’对方，可任何有自尊的诱惑者都不需要把手指伸进目标脑子里乱扯线路。毕竟，”她继续说着，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe extends a second finger towards you. “The Slyveren ‘Slavebreakers,’ they call them? They’re unprofessional; they lack drive; and, worst of all, they cheat! They use psionics to wear down their prey and ‘break’ them, when any self-respecting seductress wouldn’t need to put their fingers into their target’s brain and start pulling at the wires. After all,” she continues,"

rows.original: reaching forward to grip onto your collar, <i>“I got this on you
rows.translation: 伸手抓住你的项圈，<i>“我可是让你戴上了这个
rows.raw: " reaching forward to grip onto your collar, <i>“I got this on you"

rows.original: motioning to you, <i>“I got you in here
rows.translation: 朝你示意，<i>“我可是让你进了这里
rows.raw: " motioning to you, <i>“I got you in here"

rows.original: fair and square, didn’t I?”
rows.translation: ，全都光明正大，不是吗？”
rows.raw: " fair and square, didn’t I?”"

rows.original: “And those... ‘Sex Op’ Kaithrits, or whatever they call themselves,” she continues, extending a third finger. “They are somehow simultaneously the best of the bunch, and the worst. They put on the facade of having discipline, and they’re charged with keeping ‘the peace’ on Zhèng Shi, but their constitution is as weak as their superior’s. I could consider forgiving a band of mercenaries just doing their job, but flash them a few times and they’ll be too lustful to even do them! If there’s any one thing that isn’t sexy, [pc.name], it’s a lack of discipline.”
rows.translation: “还有那些……‘性爱特勤’凯瑟里特，还是他们自称什么来着，”她继续说道，同时伸出第三根手指。“他们不知怎么既是这群人里最好的，也是最差的。他们装出一副纪律严明的样子，受命维持郑石的‘和平’，可意志跟他们上司一样薄弱。我可以原谅一群只是在干活的雇佣兵，可只要在他们面前露几下，他们就会欲火焚身，连工作都做不了！[pc.name]，要说有什么东西绝对不性感，那就是毫无纪律。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And those... ‘Sex Op’ Kaithrits, or whatever they call themselves,” she continues, extending a third finger. “They are somehow simultaneously the best of the bunch, and the worst. They put on the facade of having discipline, and they’re charged with keeping ‘the peace’ on Zhèng Shi, but their constitution is as weak as their superior’s. I could consider forgiving a band of mercenaries just doing their job, but flash them a few times and they’ll be too lustful to even do them! If there’s any one thing that isn’t sexy, [pc.name], it’s a lack of discipline.”"

rows.original: She raises her wine glass to her lips, but, just as her lips touch the glass, she hesitates and reconsiders. She had been pounding down the wine as she went; maybe, in the heat of the moment, she had realized how intense she was being and decided to hold back.
rows.translation: 她把酒杯举到唇边，可就在双唇触到杯沿时，她犹豫了一下，改变了主意。她刚才一直在猛灌；也许激动之下，她终于意识到自己有多上头，决定稍微克制一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe raises her wine glass to her lips, but, just as her lips touch the glass, she hesitates and reconsiders. She had been pounding down the wine as she went; maybe, in the heat of the moment, she had realized how intense she was being and decided to hold back."

rows.original: “But the absolute worst of them all are the management.” She lowers her glass and traces the rim with her finger, making the wine glass sing a low, wailing note for you both. “Maike, the Overseer, whom I’m sure you’ve met by now, and two of her cohorts: one Laquine they call the Shock Hopper, and another Laquine they call,” she groans, “‘Large Dick Collider.’” She forces out every word in the Laquine’s name, struggling with them like they were rubber in her mouth. “To this day, still easily the most ridiculous name I’ve ever heard.”
rows.translation: “但其中最糟糕的绝对是管理层。”她放下杯子，用手指摩挲杯沿，让酒杯为你们发出低沉哀鸣。“监工迈克，我相信你已经见过她了，还有她的两个同伙：一个是被称为电击跳虫的拉奎因，另一个拉奎因则叫，”她呻吟道，“‘巨根对撞机’。”她费劲地挤出那个拉奎因名字里的每个词，仿佛它们是嘴里的橡胶。“直到今天，这仍然是我听过最荒唐的名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But the absolute worst of them all are the management.” She lowers her glass and traces the rim with her finger, making the wine glass sing a low, wailing note for you both. “Maike, the Overseer, whom I’m sure you’ve met by now, and two of her cohorts: one Laquine they call the Shock Hopper, and another Laquine they call,” she groans, “‘Large Dick Collider.’” She forces out every word in the Laquine’s name, struggling with them like they were rubber in her mouth. “To this day, still easily the most ridiculous name I’ve ever heard.”"

rows.original: Lorelei’s eyes meet yours, and you sense an unusual serenity within them: her emotions about the management in Zhèng Shi are pure and unfiltered, for better or worse.
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱与你四目相对，你从她眼中感受到一种异样的平静：无论好坏，她对郑石管理层的情绪都纯粹而毫无掩饰。
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei’s eyes meet yours, and you sense an unusual serenity within them: her emotions about the management in Zhèng Shi are pure and unfiltered, for better or worse."

rows.original: “It has nothing to do with their work ethic. They run the asteroid with an iron fist, and for good reason: nobody else is as qualified to run this place as they are. It has to do with their slave trade.”
rows.translation: “这跟他们的工作态度无关。他们以铁腕统治这颗小行星，而且理由充分：没有人比他们更有资格管理这里。问题在于他们的奴隶贸易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It has nothing to do with their work ethic. They run the asteroid with an iron fist, and for good reason: nobody else is as qualified to run this place as they are. It has to do with their slave trade.”"

rows.original: She pauses and tilts her head down, her lips curling into themselves again and again, as she considers how she wants to phrase what she’s about to say next.
rows.translation: 她停下来，低下头，嘴唇一次又一次地向内抿起，思考该如何措辞。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses and tilts her head down, her lips curling into themselves again and again, as she considers how she wants to phrase what she’s about to say next."

rows.original: “Credits and gems are one thing. Equipment is one thing. The parts to build an enormous spaceship... that’s one thing.” Without lifting her head, her eyes lock back onto yours, with a steely determination that wasn’t there before. “This may be because I’m a single mother running an orphanage, but stealing a life and making them your slave isn’t something I can look past. They’re the worst, most vile creatures in this universe, [pc.name], and the sooner Zhèng Shi is dismantled, the better.”
rows.translation: “信用点和宝石是一回事。装备是一回事。建造一艘巨型飞船的零件……也是一回事。”她没有抬头，眼神却重新锁定你，带着方才没有的钢铁般决心。“也许是因为我是经营孤儿院的单亲母亲，可夺走一条生命、把人变成奴隶，是我无法视而不见的。他们是这个宇宙里最卑劣、最邪恶的生物，[pc.name]，郑石越早被拆毁越好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Credits and gems are one thing. Equipment is one thing. The parts to build an enormous spaceship... that’s one thing.” Without lifting her head, her eyes lock back onto yours, with a steely determination that wasn’t there before. “This may be because I’m a single mother running an orphanage, but stealing a life and making them your slave isn’t something I can look past. They’re the worst, most vile creatures in this universe, [pc.name], and the sooner Zhèng Shi is dismantled, the better.”"

rows.original: You ask her if that’s a part of her personal agenda.
rows.translation: 你问她这是否属于她的个人目标。

rows.original: “With any luck.”
rows.translation: “但愿如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“With any luck.”"

rows.original: It’s safe to say that she’s done with this conversation.
rows.translation: 显然，她不想再谈这件事了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s safe to say that she’s done with this conversation."

rows.original: You get up to excuse yourself. It was nice meeting Lorelei in her little pocket of paradise in Zhèng Shi, but unfortunately, duty calls.
rows.translation: 你起身告辞。能在郑石这片小小的世外桃源里认识洛蕾莱很不错，但很遗憾，职责在召唤你。
rows.raw: "You get up to excuse yourself. It was nice meeting Lorelei in her little pocket of paradise in Zhèng Shi, but unfortunately, duty calls."

rows.original: Lorelei hums, then smiles sweetly. “I understand,” she says, one hand gently trailing down the side of your face, cupping your cheek. “We both have our vices and our responsibilities that we must abide by.” She blows you a kiss. “Don’t leave your mistress waiting too long, [pc.name]. I have a bar and a bed that’s in desperate need of warming nowadays.”
rows.translation: 洛蕾莱哼了一声，随即甜甜地微笑。“我理解，”她说道，一只手轻柔地滑过你的脸侧，托住你的脸颊。“我们都有必须遵从的嗜好和责任。”她给了你一个飞吻。“别让你的女主人等太久，[pc.name]。如今，我的酒吧和床都急需有人来暖。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorelei hums, then smiles sweetly. “I understand,” she says, one hand gently trailing down the side of your face, cupping your cheek. “We both have our vices and our responsibilities that we must abide by.” She blows you a kiss. “Don’t leave your mistress waiting too long, [pc.name]. I have a bar and a bed that’s in desperate need of warming nowadays.”"

rows.original: Before you leave, you take your wine glass, and Lorelei’s, and wash and dry them in the sink she has installed behind the countertop, then replace them and the bottle of wine just where you found them. She watches you with amused patience – it seems to earn you points with her. She smiles as you leave, and her smile is the last thing on your mind as you shut the door to her room behind you.
rows.translation: 离开前，你拿起自己和洛蕾莱的酒杯，在她装于柜台后的水槽中洗净擦干，再将杯子与酒瓶原样放回。她饶有兴致而耐心地看着你——这似乎让你在她心中加了分。你离开时她面带微笑，而当你关上她房门时，脑海中最后浮现的仍是她的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you leave, you take your wine glass, and Lorelei’s, and wash and dry them in the sink she has installed behind the countertop, then replace them and the bottle of wine just where you found them. She watches you with amused patience – it seems to earn you points with her. She smiles as you leave, and her smile is the last thing on your mind as you shut the door to her room behind you."

rows.original: “I understand,” Lorelei says, before blowing you a kiss. “I’m sure someone of your upbringing is quite the outgoing entrepreneur. Get out there and make your mark on this station for us both, darling.”

rows.raw: "\n\n“I understand,” Lorelei says, before blowing you a kiss. “I’m sure someone of your upbringing is quite the outgoing entrepreneur. Get out there and make your mark on this station for us both, darling.”"

rows.original: You do Lorelei the courtesy of placing your wine glass in the sink behind the countertop and re-corking and replacing the bottle before you show yourself out. Lorelei sees you off with a smile – and her smile is the last thing you see before you shut the door behind you.
rows.translation: 你礼貌地把酒杯放进柜台后的水槽，又把酒瓶重新塞好放回原处，才自行离开。洛蕾莱微笑着为你送行——关门前，你最后看到的就是她的笑容。
