rows.translation: ，”她抬起两根手指抵住额头，对你眨眼。她左右摇了几次腰胯，为你们都知道即将发生的事活动身体。“这次愿意让我轻松点吗？”
rows.raw: ",” she says, bringing two fingers up to her forehead and winking at you. She sways her hips from side to side a few times, loosening herself up for what you both know is about to come next. “Feel like making it easy for me, this time?”"

rows.original: You’d laugh if you weren’t dealing with someone as capable as her. Any misstep could be disastrous.
rows.translation: 如果面对的不是她这样有能力的人，你一定会笑出声。任何失误都可能带来灾难。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d laugh if you weren’t dealing with someone as capable as her. Any misstep could be disastrous."

rows.original: She scoffs, then gets into her own battle-ready stance, her fingers splaying and electricity crackling between her fingers. “I have to admit, darling, as much as you’d make such a lovely prize, I rarely deal with anyone as capable as you. You make for an exhilarating challenge!”
rows.translation: 她嗤之以鼻，随后摆好自己的战斗姿态，手指张开，电流在指间噼啪跳跃。“不得不承认，亲爱的，尽管你会是一份如此美丽的战利品，我很少与像你这么能干的人交手。你带来了一场令人振奋的挑战！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe scoffs, then gets into her own battle-ready stance, her fingers splaying and electricity crackling between her fingers. “I have to admit, darling, as much as you’d make such a lovely prize, I rarely deal with anyone as capable as you. You make for an exhilarating challenge!”"

rows.original: You’re fighting Minuet!
rows.translation: 你正在与米纽埃特战斗！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re fighting Minuet!"

rows.original: You make your way through Zhèng Shi–
rows.translation: 你继续穿过郑石。
rows.raw: "You make your way through Zhèng Shi–"

rows.original: With sudden, surprising ferocity, a pair of hands grab you by the shoulders, then pull you into the shadows of a nearby crevice – likely a service tunnel of some kind, forgotten and dilapidated. The motion is so fast that you’re disoriented for a short time, and when you finally gain your bearings, the place is too dark to make out a lot of the finer details. The light of where you came from shines through a small opening a few feet away from you.
rows.translation: 两只手突然以惊人的凶猛抓住你肩膀，将你拖进附近缝隙的阴影，那里可能是某种被遗忘且破败的维修通道。动作快得令你短暂失去方向；等终于回过神，周围又过于黑暗，无法辨认许多细节。几英尺外有一道小开口，身后原处的灯光正从那里照入。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith sudden, surprising ferocity, a pair of hands grab you by the shoulders, then pull you into the shadows of a nearby crevice – likely a service tunnel of some kind, forgotten and dilapidated. The motion is so fast that you’re disoriented for a short time, and when you finally gain your bearings, the place is too dark to make out a lot of the finer details. The light of where you came from shines through a small opening a few feet away from you."

rows.original: A strong, familiar grip has your hand behind your back. Unlike every encounter before, however, there’s a sense of... excitement, or perhaps urgency, to Minuet’s actions. The familiar needle from before is against your neck once again, but, before, it merely grazed your [pc.skinFurScales], applying pressure but never leaving any marks: now, the point is thoroughly trained on you, and even pressing into you: again, not enough to leave a mark, but enough to hurt slightly. It seems she’s got something in particular on her mind.
rows.translation: 一股熟悉的有力抓握将你的手别在背后。不过，与先前每次遭遇不同，米纽埃特的动作带着某种...兴奋，也可能是急迫。此前那根熟悉的针再次抵住脖子；过去，它只是擦过[pc.skinFurScales]，施加压力，却从未留下痕迹；如今针尖牢牢对准你，甚至压进身体，依然不足以留下伤口，却足以带来轻微疼痛。看来她心里有件特别的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nA strong, familiar grip has your hand behind your back. Unlike every encounter before, however, there’s a sense of... excitement, or perhaps urgency, to Minuet’s actions. The familiar needle from before is against your neck once again, but, before, it merely grazed your [pc.skinFurScales], applying pressure but never leaving any marks: now, the point is thoroughly trained on you, and even pressing into you: again, not enough to leave a mark, but enough to hurt slightly. It seems she’s got something in particular on her mind."

rows.raw: " to you again, [pc.name] Steele,” Minuet says, her voice the same, sensual, flirty tone as ever."

rows.original: You’re getting mixed signals, and you aren’t positive how you should react, if at all.
rows.translation: 你收到的信号相互矛盾，无法确定该如何反应，甚至是否应该反应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re getting mixed signals, and you aren’t positive how you should react, if at all."

rows.original: “Kaithrit got your tongue, is that it, darling?” she asks. “Perhaps my approach this time is a little more forward than usual. It’s just... I had an idea, and I got overexcited to share it with you.”
rows.translation: “凯斯瑞特叼走你的舌头了吗，亲爱的？”她问。“也许我这次的接近方式确实比平时更直接一点。只是...我有了个想法，太兴奋了，迫不及待想和你分享。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kaithrit got your tongue, is that it, darling?” she asks. “Perhaps my approach this time is a little more forward than usual. It’s just... I had an idea, and I got overexcited to share it with you.”"

rows.original: She presses her body into yours softly, but the trained point of her needle does not waver. “Ever since our last encounter, I’ve gotten to thinking. About us, and how our relationship is going to proceed. We’ve been seeing an awful lot of each other lately; I’ll be the first to say that I’ve developed a bit of a soft spot for you, gorgeous.”
rows.translation: 她柔软地把身体贴上来，可对准你的针尖没有丝毫动摇。“自从上次见面，我一直在思考。关于我们，以及这段关系将如何发展。最近我们经常见面；我会第一个承认，自己已经对你产生了一点温柔感情，美人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe presses her body into yours softly, but the trained point of her needle does not waver. “Ever since our last encounter, I’ve gotten to thinking. About us, and how our relationship is going to proceed. We’ve been seeing an awful lot of each other lately; I’ll be the first to say that I’ve developed a bit of a soft spot for you, gorgeous.”"

rows.original: Suddenly, the needle pressing into you withdraws, and she twirls it between her fingers skillfully and playfully as she continues. “I know all about your little adventure to find your daddy’s beacons, so I knew you were here for it. The effort you went through to keep it a secret was commendable, but I do so love a challenge: once you and your cousin logged in with the harbormaster at Tarkus
rows.translation: 抵住身体的针突然撤回，她熟练又俏皮地用手指旋转它，同时继续说。“我知道你寻找父亲信标的小冒险，所以也知道你是为它而来。你努力保守秘密的表现值得赞赏，但我确实非常喜欢挑战：你和表亲在塔库斯的港务长那里登记后
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, the needle pressing into you withdraws, and she twirls it between her fingers skillfully and playfully as she continues. “I know all about your little adventure to find your daddy’s beacons, so I knew you were here for it. The effort you went through to keep it a secret was commendable, but I do so love a challenge: once you and your cousin logged in with the harbormaster at Tarkus"

rows.original: , and you happened to sell the probe to that adorable raskvel woman
rows.translation: ，而且你碰巧把探针卖给那个可爱的拉斯克维尔女人
rows.raw: ", and you happened to sell the probe to that adorable raskvel woman"

rows.original: , it wasn’t difficult to connect the dots from there. I just didn’t think you were foolish enough to come in and try and steal it from a base full of thieves. It was clear, shortly after our first little liaison together, that you weren’t here as part of any of the local gangs, or that you were a pirate yourself.”
rows.translation: ，要从那里把线索串起来并不困难。我只是没想到你会蠢到闯进一座满是窃贼的基地，试图把它偷回来。我们第一次小小幽会之后没多久，我就确定你不属于本地任何帮派，也不是海盗。”
rows.raw: ", it wasn’t difficult to connect the dots from there. I just didn’t think you were foolish enough to come in and try and steal it from a base full of thieves. It was clear, shortly after our first little liaison together, that you weren’t here as part of any of the local gangs, or that you were a pirate yourself.”"

rows.original: Her needle returns, drawing slight, circular patterns into your neck, as she speaks. Her performance with something so small, light, and deadly, is truly impressive. “I got to thinking that, if you were the type to submit to myself so easily, then you would be little more than fresh meat for the other pirates. It wouldn’t do if you were inducted into their ranks. No, it wouldn’t do at all, [pc.name]! I can’t allow someone as precious as yourself to succumb to those brutes.”
rows.translation: 说话时，她的针再次回来，在你颈间画着细小圆圈。她操纵如此细小、轻盈又致命的东西，表现确实令人惊叹。“我开始想到，如果你是那种如此轻易便会向我臣服的人，对其他海盗而言，就不过是一块鲜肉。要是你被吸纳进他们的队伍，那可不行。不，绝对不行，[pc.name]！我不能允许你这样珍贵的人落入那些野蛮人手中。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer needle returns, drawing slight, circular patterns into your neck, as she speaks. Her performance with something so small, light, and deadly, is truly impressive. “I got to thinking that, if you were the type to submit to myself so easily, then you would be little more than fresh meat for the other pirates. It wouldn’t do if you were inducted into their ranks. No, it wouldn’t do at all, [pc.name]! I can’t allow someone as precious as yourself to succumb to those brutes.”"

rows.translation: 她狠狠抬脚
rows.raw: "\n\nShe jabs her foot harshly"

rows.translation: 踢进[pc.knee]后方，让你单膝跪下。明白她的意思，你也放低另一边膝盖
rows.raw: " into the back of your [pc.knee], bringing you down to one side. Understanding the notion, you shift your other knee down with it"

rows.translation: 踢向脊柱底部，也就是身体与[pc.lowerBody]相连之处
rows.raw: " into the base of your spine, where your body meets your [pc.lowerBody]"

rows.original: , dropping you down into a kneeling position.
rows.translation: ，让你落入跪姿。
rows.raw: ", dropping you down into a kneeling position."

rows.original: “Everyone on Zhèng Shi, apart from yourself, is either a pirate of some factor among their ranks... or, they’re a slave.”
rows.translation: “郑石上的每个人，除了你，不是某个级别的海盗...就是奴隶。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everyone on Zhèng Shi, apart from yourself, is either a pirate of some factor among their ranks... or, they’re a slave.”"

rows.original: For the first time, she steps around you, towards your front. It’s too dark for you to make out her details, however, and, not helping things, her suit is pitch black all over. The most you can make out is her silhouette: she’s a shapely woman, with a matronly hourglass figure, but you can’t make out her sizes or her facial features in this light.
rows.translation: 她第一次绕过你，走到前方。不过周围太暗，无法辨认她的细节，而那套从头到脚漆黑的衣服更是雪上加霜。你最多只能看见轮廓：她是个曲线优美的女人，有着成熟女性般的沙漏身材，却无法在这种光线下判断尺寸或面部特征。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor the first time, she steps around you, towards your front. It’s too dark for you to make out her details, however, and, not helping things, her suit is pitch black all over. The most you can make out is her silhouette: she’s a shapely woman, with a matronly hourglass figure, but you can’t make out her sizes or her facial features in this light."

rows.original: . But, all of our meetings together,” she sighs, drawing one gloved hand up the side of her thigh slowly, “you’ve proven that you’re simply... too easy to take advantage of.”
rows.translation: 。不过，我们每一次见面，”她叹息着，让一只戴手套的手缓缓沿大腿侧面向上，“都证明你实在...太容易被人利用。”
rows.raw: ". But, all of our meetings together,” she sighs, drawing one gloved hand up the side of her thigh slowly, “you’ve proven that you’re simply... too easy to take advantage of.”"

rows.original: She bends at the waist to reach the same hand towards you. It draws a lazy, gentle circle around your jaw, before coming to a rest just beneath your chin. “So, I decided... if you’re no pirate, and you’re on Zhèng Shi, then I might as well make you my slave. Why bother taking your credits, darling, when I can just snatch you up, as my greatest prize?”
rows.translation: 她弯下腰，将同一只手伸向你。手指懒洋洋而温柔地绕着下颌画圈，最终停在下巴下方。“所以，我决定...既然你不是海盗，却又身在郑石，那我不妨让你成为我的奴隶。亲爱的，既然能直接把你抢走，成为我最伟大的战利品，我又何必只拿你的信用点？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe bends at the waist to reach the same hand towards you. It draws a lazy, gentle circle around your jaw, before coming to a rest just beneath your chin. “So, I decided... if you’re no pirate, and you’re on Zhèng Shi, then I might as well make you my slave. Why bother taking your credits, darling, when I can just snatch you up, as my greatest prize?”"

rows.original: The words leave her mouth as a stutter; she’s so excited by the idea that she can barely contain it. She continues, her hand coming back up and rubbing her fingers languidly through your [pc.hair]. “Think about it. You wouldn’t have to worry about any of the other undesirables on the base trying to take you for their own if they know you’re owned property. And, best of all,” she hisses, her voice quaking in barely-contained excitement at the thought, “you’d belong to me. Like all the universe’s most beautiful things should.”
rows.translation: 这些话结结巴巴地离开她嘴唇；这个想法令她如此兴奋，几乎无法克制。她继续说，手掌再次抬起，手指慵懒穿过[pc.hair]。“想想吧。如果基地上的其他讨厌家伙知道你是有主财产，你就再也不用担心他们试图把你据为己有。而最棒的是，”她嘶声说道，想到这里，声音因几乎无法压抑的兴奋而颤抖，“你会属于我。正如宇宙中所有最美丽的东西都理应如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe words leave her mouth as a stutter; she’s so excited by the idea that she can barely contain it. She continues, her hand coming back up and rubbing her fingers languidly through your [pc.hair]. “Think about it. You wouldn’t have to worry about any of the other undesirables on the base trying to take you for their own if they know you’re owned property. And, best of all,” she hisses, her voice quaking in barely-contained excitement at the thought, “you’d belong to me. Like all the universe’s most beautiful things should.”"

rows.original: You note that, from the way she’s talking, she’s making it sound like you have a choice in the matter. “Oh, of course you do, darling,” she assures you, rubbing your scalp like you were a kid and you just said something silly. “I could slap one of that Urbolg’s collars on you and call it a day, I could. But for you to give me control like that would mean that I’ve stolen your heart – and, any woman would tell you, there is nothing more valuable in this world than that.”
rows.translation: 你指出，她的说法听起来仿佛你还有选择。“哦，当然有，亲爱的，”她向你保证，像抚摸说了傻话的孩子一样揉着头皮。“我完全可以把那个乌尔博格的项圈扣到你身上，就此了事。但如果你主动把这种控制权交给我，就意味着我偷走了你的心。而任何女人都会告诉你，这世界上没有比它更加宝贵的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou note that, from the way she’s talking, she’s making it sound like you have a choice in the matter. “Oh, of course you do, darling,” she assures you, rubbing your scalp like you were a kid and you just said something silly. “I could slap one of that Urbolg’s collars on you and call it a day, I could. But for you to give me control like that would mean that I’ve stolen your heart – and, any woman would tell you, there is nothing more valuable in this world than that.”"

rows.original: “Come, [pc.name],” Minuet says, her palm coming down to rest against your cheek, caressing it as if she were about to lean in and give you your first kiss. “Enough with the games. No more threats; no more stealing. You’ve never put up a fight before. Why start now?” She leans over you, her breath washing against your ear; her tongue snakes out and gives your earlobe a thorough, but teasingly-quick, pass. “If you’re a good [pc.boyGirl] and give me what I want without a fuss, I’m willing to... shall we say, celebrate your inauguration. To make things more enticing.”
rows.translation: “来吧，[pc.name]，”米纽埃特说道，手掌落在你脸颊上轻抚，仿佛即将俯身献上初吻。“游戏玩够了。不再威胁，不再偷窃。你以前从未反抗，为什么现在才开始？”她俯身罩住你，呼吸拂过耳边；舌头蜿蜒伸出，彻底舔过耳垂，却又快得故意吊人胃口。“如果你做个好[pc.boyGirl]，毫不抱怨地把我想要的东西交出来，我愿意...可以说，庆祝你的就职。让这件事变得更有诱惑力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come, [pc.name],” Minuet says, her palm coming down to rest against your cheek, caressing it as if she were about to lean in and give you your first kiss. “Enough with the games. No more threats; no more stealing. You’ve never put up a fight before. Why start now?” She leans over you, her breath washing against your ear; her tongue snakes out and gives your earlobe a thorough, but teasingly-quick, pass. “If you’re a good [pc.boyGirl] and give me what I want without a fuss, I’m willing to... shall we say, celebrate your inauguration. To make things more enticing.”"

rows.original: Minuet’s words ring heavily in your ears. You’re in some forgotten service hallway – if it’s even that long, it could very well be some kind of closet – on your [pc.knees], facing a woman you’ve met, but never seen, before, and she’s asking you to wilfully become her slave. And she’s promising you a very good time if you accept.
rows.translation: 米纽埃特的话在耳边沉重回响。你身处某条被遗忘的维修走廊，甚至可能短得只是某种储物柜；你用[pc.knees]跪着，面对一个曾经遇见、却从未见过真容的女人，而她正要求你自愿成为奴隶，并承诺一旦接受，就会让你度过一段非常美妙的时光。
rows.raw: "\n\nMinuet’s words ring heavily in your ears. You’re in some forgotten service hallway – if it’s even that long, it could very well be some kind of closet – on your [pc.knees], facing a woman you’ve met, but never seen, before, and she’s asking you to wilfully become her slave. And she’s promising you a very good time if you accept."

rows.original: My, darling, but what brings you to this rank pit? Don’t tell me someone of your stature has thrown their lot in with some petty thieves.”
rows.translation: 天啊，亲爱的，是什么把你带到这个恶臭坑洞？别告诉我，以你的身份，居然和一群小偷混在一起。”
rows.raw: "My, darling, but what brings you to this rank pit? Don’t tell me someone of your stature has thrown their lot in with some petty thieves.”"

rows.original: A few responses come to mind, but every time you think you’re about to say something, her needle keeps you in check. Noting the risk, you take the less-risky option and ask whom you’re speaking with.
rows.translation: 脑中浮现几种回答，可每当准备开口，她的针都会提醒你克制。注意到风险，你选择更安全的办法，询问正在与谁交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few responses come to mind, but every time you think you’re about to say something, her needle keeps you in check. Noting the risk, you take the less-risky option and ask whom you’re speaking with."

rows.original: “You’ll forgive me if we’re not quite on a first-name basis yet, cutie,” she teases. “You can call me Minuet for now. Just for now, hun.”
rows.translation: “请原谅，我们还没有亲近到互称名字的程度，小可爱，”她戏弄道。“现在可以叫我米纽埃特。只是暂时如此，亲爱的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll forgive me if we’re not quite on a first-name basis yet, cutie,” she teases. “You can call me Minuet for now. Just for now, hun.”"

rows.original: You try and flex a bit, to turn and see Minuet, but she keeps you held fast, and her needle grazes against you. “Ah ah,” she trills playfully. “I prefer you where you are, right here.” Seems you’ll need her permission before you can get a look at her.
rows.translation: 你试着稍微用力，转身看看米纽埃特，可她依然将你牢牢固定，针尖擦过身体。“啊、啊，”她俏皮地唱道。“我更喜欢你留在原处，就在这里。”看来必须得到允许，才能看她一眼。

rows.original: “Mmmm,” she hums as she leans back. You can feel her eyes roam across your body, towards your waist. “Credit chits are unwieldy, cumbersome things, aren’t they?” she asks, her voice light, like she’s making schoolyard conversation. “Why don’t you let me take them off your hands, darling? They must weigh so much on you.”
rows.translation: “嗯嗯，”她向后仰去轻哼。你能感觉她的目光沿身体游移，落向腰间。“信用点筹码既不灵活又很笨重，对吧？”她语气轻松，仿佛在校园里闲聊。“何不让我从你手中拿走呢，亲爱的？它们一定压得你很沉。”

They must weigh so much on you.”"

rows.original: She rummages around behind you some more, taking inventory of your belongings. “Goodness,” you hear her mutter to herself. “And you’re carrying some awfully pretty stones around. Pretty things like that belong to a pretty girl like me, don’t you think?”
rows.translation: 她继续在你身后翻找，清点物品。“天啊，”你听见她自言自语。“而且你还带着一些漂亮得惊人的石头。这种漂亮东西理应属于我这样的漂亮女孩，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rummages around behind you some more, taking inventory of your belongings. “Goodness,” you hear her mutter to herself. “And you’re carrying some awfully pretty stones around. Pretty things like that belong to a pretty girl like me, don’t you think?”"

rows.original: You tell her that if she looks half as ugly as her personality, she should consider it a blessing. “Ooh, feisty,” she hisses. The pinch of her needle presses into your [pc.skinFurScales]. Maybe you should shut up. “I’ll be sure to keep that temper of yours in mind next time, darling.”

You initially struggle, but then relax, when you feel her grip on your wrist and the way her body softly presses against your backside. She even takes her time bringing her needle up to your neck, as if it were a formality rather than a threat.
rows.translation: 你的胳膊又一次被反剪到身后——你已经开始非常熟悉米纽埃特向你打招呼的方式了。起初你还挣扎了几下，但感觉到她扣住你手腕的力道，以及她的身体轻柔地贴上你的后背后，你便放松下来。她甚至不紧不慢地把针头举到你的脖子旁，仿佛那只是一道例行程序，而非威胁。

rows.original: You note that you two are getting awfully comfortable with each other, as of late. “And it’s terribly unprofessional of me, I know,” she sighs, “but you’ve just been such a wonderful target, [pc.name] Steele. I oh-so love it when people just give me what I want without having to make things difficult, and, given our business record, so do you.”
rows.translation: 你指出，你们俩最近似乎越来越亲昵了。“我知道，这实在很不专业，”她叹道，“可你实在是个太棒的目标了，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。别人不刁难、乖乖给我想要的东西时，我可是喜欢得不得了；而从咱们以往的交易来看，你也一样喜欢。”

rows.original: She leans into your body once more, pressing her own softly against yours. “I don’t normally do this, honey, but I’ve been thinking of maybe... giving you a ‘loyalty reward.’ For being such an easy target all this time.” Boldly, she rests her cheek against your shoulder and dips her needle away, kissing the spot it had just been practiced on. “You’ve been such a fountain of fortune for me – the least I could do is share the fun a bit, don’t you think?”
rows.translation: 她再次向你贴来，柔软的身体压在你身上。“我通常不会这么做，甜心，但我一直在想，也许...该给你一份‘忠诚奖励’。毕竟你一直都是这么容易得手的目标。”她大胆地把脸颊靠在你肩上，将针尖移开，吻了吻刚才抵着针的地方。“你一直都是我的幸运喷泉——我至少也该把乐趣分给你一点，你说是不是？”

rows.original: “Fancy seeing you again, darling,” she muses. Last time, she handled you rather roughly, though this time, while her grip is just as strong, she’s rather lax on her treatment on you. “Still on your best behavior, I trust?”
rows.translation: “又见到你了，亲爱的，”她若有所思地说道。上次她对你可相当粗暴，但这一次，尽管手上的力道依旧强劲，态度却放松了许多。“我相信你还在乖乖听话，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fancy seeing you again, darling,” she muses. Last time, she handled you rather roughly, though this time, while her grip is just as strong, she’s rather lax on her treatment on you. “Still on your best behavior, I trust?”"

rows.original: You respond that you wouldn’t dream of acting out, with her and her needlepoint as they are. “Good [pc.boyGirl],” she purrs, her body pressing gently against your back. “Been keeping the bad guys at bay?”
rows.translation: 你回答说，有她和她的针尖在，你做梦也不敢胡来。“乖[pc.boyGirl]，”她娇声说道，身体轻轻贴上你的后背。“最近有把那些坏家伙挡在外面吗？”

rows.original: “I’m hurt!” she pouts. “I’m as angelic as they come, darling. You just haven’t gotten to know the good side of me.” She laughs to herself. “Or... any side, now that I think about it.” Her lips pull in, against your ear, and she licks her lips; she’s close enough to you that you can hear her tongue run over them. “We don’t have to be enemies, you know. Maybe I can show you a friendlier side of me someday.” Her voice drops to a whisper; you feel her hot breath against your ear as she mouths, “maybe more than just one side.”
rows.translation: “我可伤心了！”她噘嘴道。“我可是天使中的天使，亲爱的。你只是还没见识过我好的一面。”她自顾自笑了起来。“或者...仔细想想，你哪一面都还没见识过。”她把嘴唇贴到你耳边，舔了舔唇；她离得如此之近，你甚至能听见舌头掠过嘴唇的声音。“我们没必要做敌人，你知道的。也许有一天，我可以让你看看我更友善的一面。”她压低声音；当她无声般呢喃道“也许还不止一面”时，炽热的吐息拂过你的耳朵。

rows.original: The Saurmorian doorman recognizes you as you approach, and steps aside, allowing you into Lorelei’s abode once more. It’s like stepping into a completely different world: the Recreational Deck is a dirty, lawless place, but Lorelei’s room is extravagant, opulent, personal, and highly intimate. It’s almost enough to make you dizzy. “Ah,” Lorelei says when she sees you. She’s wearing the same black dress with high heels as the first time you had met her here. “I was just thinking of you, [pc.name]. [var0 |It gets so lonely sometimes, knowing that my collection remains incomplete when you’re out and about.” |It’s always good to see you again. All the gems in the universe can’t compare to company like yours.” ] Familiar with her wants[var0 | you retrieve Lorelei’s collar from your effects and slip it around your neck; then ], you take your position behind the bar and pull out two wine glasses, followed by a bottle from her personal rack. Her eyes are on you; when you withdraw a bottle, she smiles in both acknowledgment and appreciation, and says nothing when you pour the wine into the glasses. “Come,” she says[var0 |, motioning to the empty stool next to her. “Sit with me. Talk with me.” |, her inflection almost-but-not-quite making it sound like a command. “Entertain me.” ] You take your seat next to her. What do you do next?

rows.original: DRESS
rows.raw: "DRESS"

rows.original: Minuet
rows.raw: "Minuet"

rows.original: Saurmorian Doorman
rows.translation: 索莫里安守门人
rows.raw: "Saurmorian Doorman"

rows.original: B

As you explore and familiarize yourself with the Recreational Deck, you come to what appears to be a doorman of sorts: a large, imposing Saurmorian, wearing mostly leather with metallic inseams, protecting the entrance to a room. You’ve noticed that there aren’t a lot of individual rooms in the recreational deck, so whatever’s in there must be worth protecting. He doesn’t carry himself like the rest of the riffraff about the deck, and in fact, most others wandering the place seem to try and avoid him.
rows.translation: 在探索并熟悉娱乐甲板时，你遇到了一个似乎是守门人的家伙：一名身材魁梧、气势逼人的索莫里安，身上主要穿着带有金属嵌缝的皮革，守着一间房的入口。你注意到娱乐甲板上几乎没有独立房间，所以里面的东西必然值得保护。他的举止不像甲板上的其他乌合之众；事实上，大多数在附近游荡的人似乎都在刻意避开他。
rows.raw: "As you explore and familiarize yourself with the Recreational Deck, you come to what appears to be a doorman of sorts: a large, imposing Saurmorian, wearing mostly leather with metallic inseams, protecting the entrance to a room. You’ve noticed that there aren’t a lot of individual rooms in the recreational deck, so whatever’s in there must be worth protecting. He doesn’t carry himself like the rest of the riffraff about the deck, and in fact, most others wandering the place seem to try and avoid him."

rows.original: The Saurmorian gets a good look at you, too, and smiles to himself as soon as he sees the collar around your neck.
rows.translation: 那个索莫里安也仔细打量了你，一看到你脖子上的项圈，便露出了会心的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Saurmorian gets a good look at you, too, and smiles to himself as soon as he sees the collar around your neck."

rows.original: “You must be the ‘darling,’” the doorman says, beckoning to you with his finger to approach. “Minuet spoke highly of you. She’s been expecting you.” He steps to one side and allows you to enter the door. “Consider yourself lucky.”
rows.translation: “你一定就是那个‘亲爱的’了，”守门人说着，用手指招呼你上前。“米纽埃特对你评价很高。她一直在等你。”他侧身让开，准许你进门。“你该庆幸。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must be the ‘darling,’” the doorman says, beckoning to you with his finger to approach. “Minuet spoke highly of you. She’s been expecting you.” He steps to one side and allows you to enter the door. “Consider yourself lucky.”"

rows.original: Before you take his invitation, you ask the doorman what to expect.
rows.translation: 在接受邀请之前，你问守门人该期待些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you take his invitation, you ask the doorman what to expect."

rows.original: “Dunno. I’ve never had the... pleasure of having a one-on-one sitdown with her. She just pays me to watch the door, so I watch the door.” The Saurmorian sizes you up, likely comparing you to someone or something – perhaps himself. “She’s damn fine, though, and I wouldn’t mind wearing a collar if it meant I got a piece of her.”
rows.translation: “不知道。我从来没有...享受过和她单独坐谈的乐趣。她付钱让我看门，所以我就看门。”索莫里安上下打量着你，似乎在拿你与某个人或某件东西比较——也许是他自己。“不过她确实美得要命。要是戴上项圈就能尝到她的滋味，我一点也不介意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dunno. I’ve never had the... pleasure of having a one-on-one sitdown with her. She just pays me to watch the door, so I watch the door.” The Saurmorian sizes you up, likely comparing you to someone or something – perhaps himself. “She’s damn fine, though, and I wouldn’t mind wearing a collar if it meant I got a piece of her.”"

rows.original: You suppose you’ll have to see what Minuet is like through closed doors yourself.
rows.translation: 看来，你只能亲自看看关起门来的米纽埃特是什么样了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose you’ll have to see what Minuet is like through closed doors yourself."

rows.original: You tell the Saurmorian that you don’t know how good of a lay she is, but is she’s half as good as she tastes, you’ll be in for a wild night. He grins, and extends his fist for you to bump.
rows.translation: 你告诉索莫里安，你不清楚她床上功夫怎么样，但只要她的技术有她的味道一半好，今晚就一定会疯狂无比。他咧嘴一笑，伸出拳头与你碰拳。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell the Saurmorian that you don’t know how good of a lay she is, but is she’s half as good as she tastes, you’ll be in for a wild night. He grins, and extends his fist for you to bump."

rows.original: You show yourself into Minuet’s room, closing the door behind you.
rows.translation: 你自行走进米纽埃特的房间，随手关上身后的门。
rows.raw: " You show yourself into Minuet’s room, closing the door behind you."

rows.original: You try and peer over the Saurmorian’s shoulder and see if there’s a nameplate or something on the door, to try and glean what it is he’s protecting, but he steps up to you – not in an imposing manner, but specifically to keep you from trying to look past him.
rows.translation: 你试图越过索莫里安的肩膀，看看门上是否有名牌之类的东西，好弄清楚他到底在守护什么；但他走上前来——并非为了威吓你，而是专门挡住你的视线，不让你朝他身后张望。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try and peer over the Saurmorian’s shoulder and see if there’s a nameplate or something on the door, to try and glean what it is he’s protecting, but he steps up to you – not in an imposing manner, but specifically to keep you from trying to look past him."

rows.original: “This is a private room,” he says, answering your unspoken question. “And the lady of the house is away on business. Get lost.”
rows.translation: “这是私人房间，”他回答了你未曾说出口的问题。“女主人外出办事了。滚吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is a private room,” he says, answering your unspoken question. “And the lady of the house is away on business. Get lost.”"

rows.original: ‘The lady of the house’? Sounds like someone you’ll want to be on their good side – or someone you should avoid entirely. You take the Saurmorian’s advice and turn around.
rows.translation: ‘女主人’？听起来要么是个你该讨好的人——要么是个你该彻底躲开的人。你听从索莫里安的建议，转身离去。
rows.raw: "\n\n‘The lady of the house’? Sounds like someone you’ll want to be on their good side – or someone you should avoid entirely. You take the Saurmorian’s advice and turn around."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: ZSR L31
rows.raw: "ZSR L31"

rows.original: The Saurmorian eyes you up and down, getting a good look at you.
rows.translation: 索莫里安将你从头到脚仔细打量了一番。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Saurmorian eyes you up and down, getting a good look at you."

rows.original: “You [pc.name]?” he asks, and you respond affirmatively. “Minuet told me to expect you. Said to let you in once you made it to the deck.” He steps aside, allowing you past him and to the door. “She spoke highly of you. It’s not often anyone on this rock impresses her.”
rows.translation: “你是[pc.name]？”他问道，你给出了肯定的回答。“米纽埃特叫我等你。说你一到甲板就让你进去。”他侧身让开，让你从他身边走向门口。“她对你评价很高。能给她留下印象的，在这块破石头上可不常见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You [pc.name]?” he asks, and you respond affirmatively. “Minuet told me to expect you. Said to let you in once you made it to the deck.” He steps aside, allowing you past him and to the door. “She spoke highly of you. It’s not often anyone on this rock impresses her.”"

rows.original: Without going into specifics, you recall how you met her, and the whole ordeal it was to earn your ‘good graces’ with her. She’s certainly among the more capable of anyone you’ve met on Zhèng Shi.
rows.translation: 你没有提及细节，只是回想起你们相遇的经过，以及为了赢得她的‘青睐’所经历的整场磨难。她无疑是你在郑石遇到过的最有本事的人之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout going into specifics, you recall how you met her, and the whole ordeal it was to earn your ‘good graces’ with her. She’s certainly among the more capable of anyone you’ve met on Zhèng Shi."

rows.original: “You’ll have to teach me how you did it,” the Saurmorian says, making small-talk with you. “I’ve never had the pleasure of having a one-on-one sitdown with her. She pays me to watch the door, so I watch the door.” He sizes you up, likely comparing you to someone or something – perhaps himself. A grin spreads across his face as he fantasizes about a ‘personal session’ with her. “I’d wear her like a belt if I ever had the opportunity.”
rows.translation: “你得教教我怎么办到的，”索莫里安与你闲聊道。“我从来没有享受过和她单独坐谈的乐趣。她付钱让我看门，所以我就看门。”他上下打量你，似乎在拿你与某个人或某件东西比较——也许是他自己。一想到能与她来一场‘私人会面’，他脸上便浮现出笑容。“要是有机会，我真想把她当腰带一样缠在身上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll have to teach me how you did it,” the Saurmorian says, making small-talk with you. “I’ve never had the pleasure of having a one-on-one sitdown with her. She pays me to watch the door, so I watch the door.” He sizes you up, likely comparing you to someone or something – perhaps himself. A grin spreads across his face as he fantasizes about a ‘personal session’ with her. “I’d wear her like a belt if I ever had the opportunity.”"

rows.original: You keep any further comments to yourself as you pass by the doorman and enter Minuet’s room.
rows.translation: 你没再多说什么，从守门人身旁经过，进入了米纽埃特的房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou keep any further comments to yourself as you pass by the doorman and enter Minuet’s room."

rows.original:
You tell the Saurmorian that you can’t be sure who’s going to be wearing who by the end of tonight - Minuet doesn’t seem like the type to bend to someone very easily. But you’re also not about to complain.

The Saurmorian extends his fist for you to bump as he lets you enter.
rows.translation:
你告诉索莫里安，今晚结束时究竟是谁把谁穿在身上还真说不准——米纽埃特可不像会轻易屈服于谁的那种人。不过你也绝不会抱怨。

索莫里安放你进去时，伸出拳头与你碰了一下。
rows.raw:
"

You tell the Saurmorian that you can’t be sure who’s going to be wearing who by the end of tonight - Minuet doesn’t seem like the type to bend to someone very easily. But you’re also not about to complain.

The Saurmorian extends his fist for you to bump as he lets you enter."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The Saurmorian doorman recognizes you as you approach, and steps aside, allowing you into Lorelei’s abode once more.
rows.translation: 你走近时，索莫里安守门人认出了你，侧身让开，再次放你进入洛蕾莱的住所。
rows.raw: "The Saurmorian doorman recognizes you as you approach, and steps aside, allowing you into Lorelei’s abode once more."

rows.original: It’s like stepping into a completely different world: the Recreational Deck is a dirty, lawless place, but Lorelei’s room is extravagant, opulent, personal, and highly intimate. It’s almost enough to make you dizzy.
rows.translation: 这里仿佛是另一个世界：娱乐甲板肮脏、无法无天，洛蕾莱的房间却奢华、富丽、极具个人色彩，而且极其私密。那反差几乎令你眩晕。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s like stepping into a completely different world: the Recreational Deck is a dirty, lawless place, but Lorelei’s room is extravagant, opulent, personal, and highly intimate. It’s almost enough to make you dizzy."

rows.original: “Ah,” Lorelei says when she sees you. She’s wearing the same black dress with high heels as the first time you had met her here. “I was just thinking of you, [pc.name].
rows.translation: “啊，”洛蕾莱见到你时说道。她穿着与你第一次在这里见面时相同的黑裙和高跟鞋。“我刚才还在想你呢，[pc.name]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah,” Lorelei says when she sees you. She’s wearing the same black dress with high heels as the first time you had met her here. “I was just thinking of you, [pc.name]."

joinAfter.expression:
lorelei.isHerBitch()
                                ? "It gets so lonely sometimes, knowing that my collection remains incomplete when you’re out and about."
                                : "It’s always good to see you again. All the gems in the universe can’t compare to company like yours."

rows.original: It gets so lonely sometimes, knowing that my collection remains incomplete when you’re out and about.
rows.translation: 一想到你在外奔波时，我的收藏仍不完整，有时真是寂寞难耐。
rows.raw: "It gets so lonely sometimes, knowing that my collection remains incomplete when you’re out and about."

rows.original: It’s always good to see you again. All the gems in the universe can’t compare to company like yours.
rows.translation: 能再次见到你总是件好事。宇宙中的所有宝石，都比不上你这样的陪伴。
rows.raw: "It’s always good to see you again. All the gems in the universe can’t compare to company like yours."

rows.original: Familiar with her wants
rows.translation: 你已经熟悉她的需求
rows.raw: "\n\nFamiliar with her wants"

rows.original: you retrieve Lorelei’s collar from your effects and slip it around your neck; then
rows.translation: ，于是从随身物品中取出洛蕾莱的项圈，套到脖子上；接着
rows.raw: " you retrieve Lorelei’s collar from your effects and slip it around your neck; then"

rows.original: , you take your position behind the bar and pull out two wine glasses, followed by a bottle from her personal rack. Her eyes are on you; when you withdraw a bottle, she smiles in both acknowledgment and appreciation, and says nothing when you pour the wine into the glasses.
rows.translation: ，你来到吧台后就位，取出两只酒杯，又从她的私人酒架上拿出一瓶酒。她始终注视着你；当你抽出酒瓶时，她报以心领神会而又赞许的微笑，并在你往杯中斟酒时一言不发。
rows.raw: ", you take your position behind the bar and pull out two wine glasses, followed by a bottle from her personal rack. Her eyes are on you; when you withdraw a bottle, she smiles in both acknowledgment and appreciation, and says nothing when you pour the wine into the glasses."

rows.original: “Come,” she says
rows.translation: “来吧，”她说道
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come,” she says"

rows.original: , motioning to the empty stool next to her. “Sit with me. Talk with me.”
rows.translation: ，示意身旁的空凳。“陪我坐坐。陪我聊聊。”
rows.raw: ", motioning to the empty stool next to her. “Sit with me. Talk with me.”"

rows.original: , her inflection almost-but-not-quite making it sound like a command. “Entertain me.”
rows.translation: ，那语调几乎——但又不完全——像是一道命令。“取悦我。”
rows.raw: ", her inflection almost-but-not-quite making it sound like a command. “Entertain me.”"

rows.original: You take your seat next to her. What do you do next?
rows.translation: 你在她身旁坐下。接下来要做什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your seat next to her. What do you do next?"

rows.original: Overseer Maike
rows.translation: 监督者迈克
rows.raw: "Overseer Maike"

rows.original: overseer
rows.translation: 监工
rows.raw: "overseer"

rows.original: The
rows.raw: "The "

rows.original: the
rows.translation: 这个
rows.raw: "the "

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Aha, you’re back at the big dig pit. Exactly what you’re doing here is your own guess but you can’t help but dwell on some vague, bubbly reason you can’t qui-
rows.translation: 啊哈，你又回到了大矿坑。你自己都不知道来这里究竟要干什么，但脑中总有个模糊又轻快的念头挥之不去，让你怎么也没法彻-
rows.raw: "Aha, you’re back at the big dig pit. Exactly what you’re doing here is your own guess but you can’t help but dwell on some vague, bubbly reason you can’t qui-"

rows.original: THNK, THNKK
rows.raw: "\n\nTHNK, THNKK"

rows.original: Oh crap.
rows.translation: 哦，糟了。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh crap."

rows.original: Two metal rods crash into the ground at your feet and the all-too-familiar flutter of insectoid wings drones closer and closer!
rows.translation: 两根金属杆砸在你脚边，熟悉得不能再熟悉的昆虫振翅声也越来越近！
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo metal rods crash into the ground at your feet and the all-too-familiar flutter of insectoid wings drones closer and closer!"

rows.original: Feeling the deja vu kick in, you instinctively back away from the impact zone
rows.translation: 似曾相识的感觉涌上来，你本能地退出撞击区域
rows.raw: "\n\nFeeling the deja vu kick in, you instinctively back away from the impact zone "

rows.original: and ready your [pc.weapon]. You’ve got a new way of getting around her now
rows.translation: ，举起[pc.weapon]做好准备。现在你有了摆脱她的新办法
rows.raw: " and ready your [pc.weapon]. You’ve got a new way of getting around her now"

rows.original: . The Overseer lands as dramatically as her first entrance and wastes no time in reeling her grapples in, cycling the ammo with a flick of the wrist and firing a hefty bolas shot towards your middle!
rows.translation: 。监工如初次登场般气势十足地落地，立刻收回抓钩，手腕一甩完成换弹，朝你的腰腹射出一发沉重的流星锤弹！
rows.raw: ". The Overseer lands as dramatically as her first entrance and wastes no time in reeling her grapples in, cycling the ammo with a flick of the wrist and firing a hefty bolas shot towards your middle!"

rows.original: At such short range, there’s no way it can miss and the energy-threaded weights swing around your middle.
rows.translation: 距离这么近，根本不可能射偏，缠绕着能量丝线的重锤旋即绕住你的腰。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt such short range, there’s no way it can miss and the energy-threaded weights swing around your middle."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Out from the twisting gloom of the mineshafts and twinkling minerals, a grand pit comes into your view. ‘Grand’ doesn’t quite do it justice: it must be at least 60 feet in diameter but what takes you back is the depth.
rows.translation: 穿过矿道扭曲的幽暗与闪烁的矿物，一座巨大的深坑映入眼帘。仅用‘巨大’根本不足以形容它：坑口直径至少有六十英尺，但真正令你震撼的是它的深度。
rows.raw: "Out from the twisting gloom of the mineshafts and twinkling minerals, a grand pit comes into your view. ‘Grand’ doesn’t quite do it justice: it must be at least 60 feet in diameter but what takes you back is the depth. "

rows.original: It’s even deeper than all the fanfiction in the world.
rows.translation: 它甚至比全世界所有同人小说加起来还要深。
rows.raw: "It’s even deeper than all the fanfiction in the world."

rows.original: Starting from the walkway you’re planted on, a wide path twists around the inside of the pit and presumably to the bottom.
rows.translation: 从你所在的步道开始，一条宽阔的道路沿坑壁盘旋而下，大概一直通往坑底。
rows.raw: "Starting from the walkway you’re planted on, a wide path twists around the inside of the pit and presumably to the bottom."

rows.original: There’s enough nearby artificial lighting to help you make out where to go: bluish white lamps and lights that cover the walkway and freshly chartered ore veins show you where you would go... but not where you’d go to.
rows.translation: 附近的人工照明足以让你看清道路：蓝白色的灯具照亮步道和刚勘定的矿脉，告诉你该往哪里走...却没告诉你会走到什么地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s enough nearby artificial lighting to help you make out where to go: bluish white lamps and lights that cover the walkway and freshly chartered ore veins show you where you would go... but not where you’d go to."

rows.original: There’s a constant tnk-tnk coming from below, a whole chorus of metal-on-rock that resonates upwards. You can barely make out hunched over slaves and machines hacking and grinding away at the rock along the lower pathways. With a cautious [pc.walk], you get close to the edge of the walkway and peer into the near-black below...
rows.translation: 下方不断传来叮—叮声，金属敲击岩石的大合奏向上回荡。你勉强能看见弯腰劳作的奴隶和机器，在下层道路上不停凿击、研磨岩石。你小心翼翼地[pc.walk]到步道边缘，向下方近乎纯黑的深处窥去...
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a constant tnk-tnk coming from below, a whole chorus of metal-on-rock that resonates upwards. You can barely make out hunched over slaves and machines hacking and grinding away at the rock along the lower pathways. With a cautious [pc.walk], you get close to the edge of the walkway and peer into the near-black below..."

rows.original: Yep, that’s deep.
rows.translation: 没错，真够深的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYep, that’s deep."

rows.original: Pretty deep.
rows.translation: 非常深。
rows.raw: "\n\nPretty deep."

rows.original: Deep enough that the lights are merely dots on the grayish ground below.
rows.translation: 深到下方的灯光只剩灰色地面上的点点微光。
rows.raw: "\n\nDeep enough that the lights are merely dots on the grayish ground below."

rows.original: Nerves get the better of you and you can’t help but shuffle backwards to the wall. The footpath is comfortably wide, perhaps a good ten-or-so feet. Enough for a chain gang... and with a huff through the nose, you get back to examining the rest of this cavernous pit.
rows.translation: 紧张感压倒了你，你不由得退向墙边。步道宽得令人安心，大约有十英尺左右，足以容纳一队锁链囚犯...你从鼻子里呼出一口气，重新观察起这座洞窟般的深坑。
rows.raw: "\n\nNerves get the better of you and you can’t help but shuffle backwards to the wall. The footpath is comfortably wide, perhaps a good ten-or-so feet. Enough for a chain gang... and with a huff through the nose, you get back to examining the rest of this cavernous pit."

rows.original: Your eyes are drawn to the lighting fixtures and you’re a little taken aback by just how high up they are. Must be at least as high as the pit is wide!
rows.translation: 你的目光被照明装置吸引，它们所在的高度令你有些吃惊。至少和坑口的宽度一样高！
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes are drawn to the lighting fixtures and you’re a little taken aback by just how high up they are. Must be at least as high as the pit is wide!"

rows.original: One of the lights shines over your [pc.leg] and is unerringly hot against your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: 其中一盏灯照在你的[pc.leg]上，灼热的光线毫不偏移地烘烤着你的[pc.skinFurScales]。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the lights shines over your [pc.leg] and is unerringly hot against your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: Your codex beeps with an alert: perhaps it’s best not to stand under them for long. No wonder they’re up so high...
rows.translation: 你的终端发出警报：也许最好别在灯下站太久。难怪它们装得这么高...
rows.raw: "\n\nYour codex beeps with an alert: perhaps it’s best not to stand under them for long. No wonder they’re up so high..."

rows.original: You’re about to move out of the light when-
rows.translation: 你正要离开灯光，突然——
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re about to move out of the light when-"

rows.original: TNGG, TNNGGG
rows.translation: 铛，铛铛铛
rows.raw: "\n\nTNGG, TNNGGG"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Two heavy metal bolts hammer into the ground near your [pc.feet], the sheer heft of the impact almost enough to crumble the ground!
rows.translation: 两根沉重的金属栓砸进你[pc.feet]附近的地面，其冲击之猛烈，几乎足以震碎地面！
rows.raw: "Two heavy metal bolts hammer into the ground near your [pc.feet], the sheer heft of the impact almost enough to crumble the ground!"

rows.original: You jump back on instinct and draw out your [pc.weapon], readying up for a fight.
rows.translation: 你本能地向后跃开，抽出[pc.weapon]，准备战斗。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou jump back on instinct and draw out your [pc.weapon], readying up for a fight."

rows.original: You scramble backwards until you hit some solid surface, unsure of what this moment might hold.
rows.translation: 你慌忙后退，直到撞上某个坚实的表面，完全不知道接下来会发生什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scramble backwards until you hit some solid surface, unsure of what this moment might hold."

rows.original: Large bands of energy form like chains from the tops of the bolts and the unnerving echo of what could be a hundred pairs of wings comes closer and closer!
rows.translation: 粗大的能量带如锁链般从金属栓顶端形成，仿佛上百对翅膀一同拍打的骇人回响也越来越近！
rows.raw: "\n\nLarge bands of energy form like chains from the tops of the bolts and the unnerving echo of what could be a hundred pairs of wings comes closer and closer!"

rows.original: With a harsh billow of ore dust and warm air, a massive specter of a figure lands against the walkway. The blue glow of personal-repulsors shines faintly in the dark. Large, colorful wings flutter and flicker under the sporadic lighting and some snake-like limb circles behind the shadow-cloaked figure.
rows.translation: 矿尘与热风猛烈翻涌，一个魁梧如幽灵般的身影落到步道上。个人反重力装置的蓝光在黑暗中隐约闪耀。宽大而色彩斑斓的翅膀在断续的灯光下扇动、闪烁，某条蛇一般的肢体则在被阴影笼罩的身影后方盘旋。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a harsh billow of ore dust and warm air, a massive specter of a figure lands against the walkway. The blue glow of personal-repulsors shines faintly in the dark. Large, colorful wings flutter and flicker under the sporadic lighting and some snake-like limb circles behind the shadow-cloaked figure."

rows.original: You keep your weapon close and readied, unsure of who this could be.
rows.translation: 你握紧武器，保持戒备，不知道对方究竟是谁。
rows.raw: " You keep your weapon close and readied, unsure of who this could be."

rows.original: Almost immediately, it lurches to its feet and a coiling, purplish energy whip unfurls from a darkness-sheathed arm. In alarm, you brace yourself and rush under one of the lights as it strides up to you with terrifying intent. The wide light merely casts another shadow of the creature as it leaps several metres into the air!
rows.translation: 它几乎立刻一跃而起，一条盘曲的紫色能量鞭从被黑暗包裹的手臂中舒展开来。你惊慌地稳住身体，在它带着骇人敌意大步逼近时冲进一盏灯下。宽广的灯光却只为这生物投下另一片阴影，它随即跃到数米高的空中！
rows.raw: "\n\nAlmost immediately, it lurches to its feet and a coiling, purplish energy whip unfurls from a darkness-sheathed arm. In alarm, you brace yourself and rush under one of the lights as it strides up to you with terrifying intent. The wide light merely casts another shadow of the creature as it leaps several metres into the air!"

rows.original: It comes down as dramatically and as heavily as it entered, right on top of you!
rows.translation: 它以与登场时同样夸张、同样沉重的气势落下，正中你的身体！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt comes down as dramatically and as heavily as it entered, right on top of you!"

rows.original: You cry out as the pain of getting flattened to your back takes hold. The creature regains its composure all too quickly and leans over your prone form.
rows.translation: 你被压倒在地，剧痛令你失声惨叫。那生物却转瞬间便恢复从容，俯身看向倒地的你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cry out as the pain of getting flattened to your back takes hold. The creature regains its composure all too quickly and leans over your prone form."

rows.original: Under the light, you can make out a face.
rows.translation: 借着灯光，你看清了一张脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnder the light, you can make out a face."

rows.original: Feminine and angular. Soft, royal-blue skin forms her features with a proud, straight nose and plush, purple lips to add to the picture. What completes it are the slanted eyes: blazing orange with three slits for pupils. Alien instinct toils underneath the predatory stare as she stands over you.
rows.translation: 女性化而棱角分明。柔软的宝蓝色皮肤勾勒出她的面容，高挺笔直的鼻梁与丰润紫唇点缀其间。真正令整张脸完整的是那双斜挑的眼睛：炽烈的橙色眼眸里，各有三道裂缝般的瞳孔。她站在你上方，以捕食者般的目光盯着你，某种异星本能在其中翻涌。
rows.raw: "\n\nFeminine and angular. Soft, royal-blue skin forms her features with a proud, straight nose and plush, purple lips to add to the picture. What completes it are the slanted eyes: blazing orange with three slits for pupils. Alien instinct toils underneath the predatory stare as she stands over you."

rows.original: “And what do we have here, I wonder?” croons the rich, sophisticated voice. Your eyes adjust to the lighting and you take quick note of the entirety of this creature. One word that comes to mind is ‘moth.’ Three massive wings, six in all, on either side of her waft and waver in gentle accord while casting their wide shadows. The light passes through the membranous wings and the gentle tones of red and orange mingle with the shadows. From above even that, a long and thick tail snakes around. The tip is covered in chitinous, pale-green plates and puts you in mind of a deadly scorpion. What catches your eyes are the jewels studded onto her chest armor, no wait... her chest: exposed, cushion-soft E-cups barely supported by a silver, no-cup corset.
rows.translation: “让我瞧瞧，这是什么东西？”醇厚而老练的声音柔声说道。你的眼睛逐渐适应光线，迅速看清了这生物的全貌。最先浮现在脑海里的词是‘飞蛾’。她身体两侧各有三片巨翼，共计六片，和谐而轻柔地起伏摇曳，同时投下宽阔的阴影。光线穿过膜质翅翼，柔和的红橙色调与阴影交融。更上方，一条粗长的尾巴蜿蜒盘绕。尾端覆盖着淡绿色甲壳板，让你想起致命的蝎子。真正吸引你目光的，是她胸甲上镶嵌的珠宝——等等...那不是胸甲，而是她的胸部：裸露在外、柔软如垫的E罩杯乳房，几乎全靠一件银色无罩杯紧身胸衣托着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what do we have here, I wonder?” croons the rich, sophisticated voice. Your eyes adjust to the lighting and you take quick note of the entirety of this creature. One word that comes to mind is ‘moth.’ Three massive wings, six in all, on either side of her waft and waver in gentle accord while casting their wide shadows. The light passes through the membranous wings and the gentle tones of red and orange mingle with the shadows. From above even that, a long and thick tail snakes around. The tip is covered in chitinous, pale-green plates and puts you in mind of a deadly scorpion. What catches your eyes are the jewels studded onto her chest armor, no wait... her chest: exposed, cushion-soft E-cups barely supported by a silver, no-cup corset."
