rows.original: What takes away from her attention to the aesthetic are the chitinous plates that cover her insectoid frame. The sides of her hips, legs and arms are covered in bony, pale-green plates that glisten under the lights. Said plates are intermingled with softer, smooth-looking scales that blend from pale-green to purple and then to a sensuous blue. You think that there’s some serious mod-work going on: these plates look unnaturally strong. Her feet and hands could be interchanged if not for details: five digits a-piece with the appendages crested with more scales, tapering off into vicious claws. With one splayed foot planted flat against you, you don’t need to guess at its manual dexterity.
rows.translation: 但她对美感的追求，被覆盖昆虫身躯的甲壳板削弱了几分。她臀部、腿部和手臂两侧都覆盖着坚硬的淡绿色骨板，在灯光下闪闪发亮。这些骨板之间夹杂着更柔软、看似光滑的鳞片，色泽从淡绿色渐变为紫色，再过渡到妖娆的蓝色。你觉得她肯定接受过大量改造：这些甲板强韧得不自然。若非一些细节，她的手脚几乎可以互换：每一只都有五根趾指，附肢上覆盖着更多鳞片，末端逐渐收尖成凶狠的利爪。她一只张开的脚掌正平踩在你身上，因此你根本不必猜测它的灵活程度。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat takes away from her attention to the aesthetic are the chitinous plates that cover her insectoid frame. The sides of her hips, legs and arms are covered in bony, pale-green plates that glisten under the lights. Said plates are intermingled with softer, smooth-looking scales that blend from pale-green to purple and then to a sensuous blue. You think that there’s some serious mod-work going on: these plates look unnaturally strong. Her feet and hands could be interchanged if not for details: five digits a-piece with the appendages crested with more scales, tapering off into vicious claws. With one splayed foot planted flat against you, you don’t need to guess at its manual dexterity."

rows.original: A long and thick tail swings and slithers around the air like a spectral snake. It’s easily the length of the slaver herself and the tip is covered in four pale-green plates that jitter and flap with some unknown intent. What could be hidden within there is anyone’s guess...
rows.translation: 一条粗长的尾巴像幽灵般的蛇一样在空中摆动、蜿蜒。它轻易就有奴隶主本人那么长，尾端覆盖着四块淡绿色甲板，怀着某种未知意图颤动开合。里面究竟藏着什么，谁也说不准...
rows.raw: "\n\nA long and thick tail swings and slithers around the air like a spectral snake. It’s easily the length of the slaver herself and the tip is covered in four pale-green plates that jitter and flap with some unknown intent. What could be hidden within there is anyone’s guess..."

rows.original: Her face is exceedingly feminine but still more alien than human. She has unusually straight and sharp features with slanted, blazing orange eyes. Those eyes bore into you with their 3-slit pupils, attempting to steal your attention in these brief moments. A tight bundle of long, silver quills hangs over her shoulder like something akin to hair but made of something more rigid. It’s all held in place by two long, elfin ears that sweep back much like her horns. Around her neck is a natural ‘scarf’ of downy gray fur, one that conforms to a V shape towards her cleavage and adds another layer of curious sophistication. Two sleek horns of greenish-white curve back from her forehead and add a devilish spin, another alien twist to her evolutionary biology.
rows.translation: 她的脸极其女性化，但依然比人类更显异质。她的五官异常笔直锐利，斜挑的橙色眼眸燃烧般明亮。每只眼睛里都有三道裂缝状瞳孔，仿佛要在这短暂瞬间夺走你的注意。紧束成一绺的银色长刺垂在肩头，像头发，却由某种更坚硬的材质构成。两只向后伸展、如精灵般修长的耳朵将其固定，走向与她的角相仿。颈边天然生着一圈灰色绒毛‘围巾’，朝乳沟收拢成V形，又为她增添了一层令人好奇的优雅。两根光滑的绿白色长角从额头向后弯曲，平添一丝恶魔般的气息，也是其异星进化生物学的又一奇异印记。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer face is exceedingly feminine but still more alien than human. She has unusually straight and sharp features with slanted, blazing orange eyes. Those eyes bore into you with their 3-slit pupils, attempting to steal your attention in these brief moments. A tight bundle of long, silver quills hangs over her shoulder like something akin to hair but made of something more rigid. It’s all held in place by two long, elfin ears that sweep back much like her horns. Around her neck is a natural ‘scarf’ of downy gray fur, one that conforms to a V shape towards her cleavage and adds another layer of curious sophistication. Two sleek horns of greenish-white curve back from her forehead and add a devilish spin, another alien twist to her evolutionary biology. "

rows.original: She wears a complex suit of armor, although ‘armor’ could be stretching the word. An ornate corset of silver and black covers her hourglass middle, giving some minimal support for her exposed bust. The corset fails to cover much else, leaving a thong-like strip below the waist to cover the slaver’s nethers. Flexible, silk-like fabric connects it to her shoulder armor, which itself is quite bulky, almost spherical and made of a similar silver metal to the corset. You wonder what those strange shoulder-parts could be for. On her wrists are rather fetching cuffs that are connected to the shoulders by more loose fabric. The only armor below the hips comes in the form of two silver repulsors that fit seamlessly to the back of her calves. Explains how she was able to fly and land so swiftly and easily...
rows.translation: 她穿着一套复杂的护甲，尽管称其为‘护甲’或许有些勉强。一件银黑相间的华丽紧身胸衣包裹着她的沙漏形腰身，只为裸露的胸部提供最低限度的支撑。胸衣没能遮住多少其他部位，腰下只有一条丁字裤般的布条挡住奴隶主的私处。柔韧如丝的织物将其连接到肩甲，而肩甲本身相当厚重，近乎球形，采用与胸衣类似的银色金属制成。你不禁好奇那些古怪的肩部构件究竟有何用途。她腕上戴着相当漂亮的护腕，通过更多宽松布料与肩部相连。臀部以下唯一的装甲，是两台严丝合缝贴合小腿后侧的银色反重力装置。这就解释了她为何能如此迅捷轻松地飞行和着陆...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wears a complex suit of armor, although ‘armor’ could be stretching the word. An ornate corset of silver and black covers her hourglass middle, giving some minimal support for her exposed bust. The corset fails to cover much else, leaving a thong-like strip below the waist to cover the slaver’s nethers. Flexible, silk-like fabric connects it to her shoulder armor, which itself is quite bulky, almost spherical and made of a similar silver metal to the corset. You wonder what those strange shoulder-parts could be for. On her wrists are rather fetching cuffs that are connected to the shoulders by more loose fabric. The only armor below the hips comes in the form of two silver repulsors that fit seamlessly to the back of her calves. Explains how she was able to fly and land so swiftly and easily..."

rows.original: Around her waist is a wide belt with items of interest: card keys in holsters, a gray rod with some buttons on it, a strange hand cannon with two barrels, some satchel of bulging square objects.
rows.translation: 她腰间系着一条宽腰带，上面挂着几样引人注意的东西：插在套中的钥匙卡、一根带有几个按钮的灰色短棒、一把双管的古怪手炮，以及一个装满鼓胀方形物体的小包。
rows.raw: "\n\nAround her waist is a wide belt with items of interest: card keys in holsters, a gray rod with some buttons on it, a strange hand cannon with two barrels, some satchel of bulging square objects."

rows.original: “Answer me!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Answer me!”"

rows.original: Another whip-strike cracks by your ear.
rows.translation: 又一记鞭击在你耳旁炸响。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother whip-strike cracks by your ear."

rows.original: Uhh, uhhh!
rows.translation: 呃，呃呃！
rows.raw: "\n\nUhh, uhhh!"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: You’re already doing that!
rows.translation: 你已经在这么做了！
rows.raw: "You’re already doing that!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Let’s hope this disguise works!
rows.translation: 希望这身伪装管用！
rows.raw: "Let’s hope this disguise works!"

rows.original: “I’m just a slave. I got lost! I couldn’t see where I was going!” you blurt out as you try to wriggle into a more comfortable breathing position. Damn claws are pressing on your chest!
rows.translation: “我只是个奴隶。我迷路了！我看不清该往哪里走！”你脱口而出，同时扭动身体，试图换个能更顺畅呼吸的姿势。该死的爪子正压在你胸口！
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m just a slave. I got lost! I couldn’t see where I was going!” you blurt out as you try to wriggle into a more comfortable breathing position. Damn claws are pressing on your chest!"

rows.original: “A wriggler, like... bait on a hook. Oo, should I, shouldn’t I?” she says out loud, seeming to disregard your answer. Her clawed foot slides ever closer to your exposed neck while her tail snakes above your gaze. The smooth, pale-green plates jitter and flap like perverse petals caught in unseen winds, and you can’t help but jerk your head from side to side as it ‘nips’ at your cheek and chin.
rows.translation: “扭来扭去，就像...钩上的诱饵。哦，我该不该下手呢？”她自言自语，似乎完全没把你的回答当回事。她带爪的脚掌渐渐滑向你裸露的脖颈，尾巴则在你视线上方蜿蜒。光滑的淡绿色甲板像被无形之风吹动的淫靡花瓣般颤抖开合，而它在你脸颊和下巴旁‘轻咬’时，你忍不住左右摆头躲避。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A wriggler, like... bait on a hook. Oo, should I, shouldn’t I?” she says out loud, seeming to disregard your answer. Her clawed foot slides ever closer to your exposed neck while her tail snakes above your gaze. The smooth, pale-green plates jitter and flap like perverse petals caught in unseen winds, and you can’t help but jerk your head from side to side as it ‘nips’ at your cheek and chin."

rows.original: Suddenly a new tightness grips you by the throat! You panic and grasp at the force on instinct.
rows.translation: 一股新的紧力突然扼住你的喉咙！你惊慌之下本能地抓向那股力量。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly a new tightness grips you by the throat! You panic and grasp at the force on instinct. "

joinAfter.expression: isSillyModeEnabled() ? "Oh no, your most vital area! " : ""

rows.original: Oh no, your most vital area!
rows.translation: 哦不，是你最要害的地方！
rows.raw: "Oh no, your most vital area! "

rows.original: It has to be her foot, and sure enough, you quickly focus on the muscled thigh that very slowly begins lifting you up off of the ground.
rows.translation: 那肯定是她的脚；果然，你迅速看见那条肌肉紧实的大腿正极其缓慢地将你提离地面。
rows.raw: "It has to be her foot, and sure enough, you quickly focus on the muscled thigh that very slowly begins lifting you up off of the ground. "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.tallness >= 84
                  ? "Must be the work of those repulsors, especially with you being on the weighty side! "
                  : ""

rows.original: Must be the work of those repulsors, especially with you being on the weighty side!
rows.translation: 这一定是那些反重力装置的作用，尤其是你的体重还偏重！
rows.raw: "Must be the work of those repulsors, especially with you being on the weighty side! "

rows.original: You try to punch away, smack or knock the limb away but your hands just knock against unfeeling chitin and hardened scales.
rows.translation: 你试着挥拳、拍打或撞开那条肢体，双手却只能敲在毫无知觉的甲壳和硬化鳞片上。
rows.raw: "You try to punch away, smack or knock the limb away but your hands just knock against unfeeling chitin and hardened scales."

rows.original: “Where... is your collar?” comes a question so clear in malice that it blots out even the noise of the mining from below. The grip around your neck loosens just enough for you to blurt out an answer...
rows.translation: “你的项圈...在哪里？”这个问题恶意之清晰，甚至压过了下方采矿的噪声。颈间的钳制稍稍放松，刚好容你脱口作答...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where... is your collar?” comes a question so clear in malice that it blots out even the noise of the mining from below. The grip around your neck loosens just enough for you to blurt out an answer..."

rows.original: It Broke
rows.translation: 坏掉了
rows.raw: "It Broke"

rows.original: It Broke
rows.translation: 坏掉了
rows.raw: "It Broke"

rows.original: Better than nothing, right?
rows.translation: 总比什么都没有好，对吧？
rows.raw: "Better than nothing, right?"

rows.original: Unprocessed
rows.translation: 未处理
rows.raw: "Unprocessed"

rows.original: Unprocessed
rows.translation: 未处理
rows.raw: "Unprocessed"

rows.original: Might not be as convincing. Also might lead to her taking advantage...
rows.translation: 可能没那么可信。还可能导致她占你便宜...
rows.raw: "Might not be as convincing. Also might lead to her taking advantage..."

rows.original: Pen
rows.translation: 围栏
rows.raw: "Pen"

rows.original: Pen
rows.translation: 围栏
rows.raw: "Pen"

rows.original: Probably very convincing. Still might lead to her taking advantage...
rows.translation: 大概很有说服力。还是可能导致她占你便宜...
rows.raw: "Probably very convincing. Still might lead to her taking advantage..."

rows.original: Fuck You
rows.translation: 去你妈的
rows.raw: "Fuck You"

rows.original: Fuck You
rows.translation: 去你妈的
rows.raw: "Fuck You"

rows.original: You’re gonna kick her ass! Or attempt to at least!
rows.translation: 你要狠狠踢她的屁股！至少也得试试看！
rows.raw: "You’re gonna kick her ass! Or attempt to at least!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “It broke! I-I got lost looking for engineering! I really wanted to put it on but it wouldn’t fit!” you force out in a high pitched voice, the strain on your throat relaxing as you sputter.
rows.translation: “它坏了！我、我找工程部时迷路了！我真的很想戴上，可它就是不合适！”你用尖细的声音勉强挤出话来，喉咙上的压力也在你结结巴巴时放松下来。
rows.raw: "“It broke! I-I got lost looking for engineering! I really wanted to put it on but it wouldn’t fit!” you force out in a high pitched voice, the strain on your throat relaxing as you sputter."

rows.original: “Damnable Urbolg, him and his... ‘prototypes’,” she growls, a deep and animalistic secondary tone vibrating through her body like a true apex creature. “And yet all of your middling brain matter led you here. How am I to ease my doubt of your claim, slave?”
rows.translation: “该死的厄博尔格，他和他的...‘原型机’，”她低吼道，一股深沉而野兽般的第二重声调在体内震颤，宛如真正的顶级掠食者。“可你那点平庸的脑浆偏偏把你带到了这里。奴隶，我要怎样才能消除对你这番说辞的怀疑？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damnable Urbolg, him and his... ‘prototypes’,” she growls, a deep and animalistic secondary tone vibrating through her body like a true apex creature. “And yet all of your middling brain matter led you here. How am I to ease my doubt of your claim, slave?”"

rows.original: The grip tightens once again and you whine as your [pc.face] flushes with heat.
rows.translation: 钳制再次收紧，你呜咽着，[pc.face]因充血而涨红。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe grip tightens once again and you whine as your [pc.face] flushes with heat."

rows.original: “Oh, is that hard enough for you, mmm? I can tell you’re new if you’re giving in that easily,” she mocks with a sardonic grin. She even pulls a faux-pout and shakes her head at you. “Mwaaah, the big bad Overseer is putting me in my place, waaah.”
rows.translation: “哦，这样对你来说就够狠了吗，嗯？这么容易就屈服，显然你是个新人，”她挂着嘲讽的笑容奚落道，甚至故意噘嘴摇头。“呜哇，凶巴巴的监工把我收拾得服服帖帖，呜哇。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, is that hard enough for you, mmm? I can tell you’re new if you’re giving in that easily,” she mocks with a sardonic grin. She even pulls a faux-pout and shakes her head at you. “Mwaaah, the big bad Overseer is putting me in my place, waaah.”"

rows.original: You try to kick and flail at her other leg but hit only the bony plates covering the sides. Your efforts are met with the most indulgent and devilish of giggles.
rows.translation: 你试图踢打、挥击她另一条腿，却只能撞上覆盖腿侧的骨板。你的挣扎换来一阵纵容而邪恶至极的咯咯笑声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to kick and flail at her other leg but hit only the bony plates covering the sides. Your efforts are met with the most indulgent and devilish of giggles."

rows.original: “Yesss, there’s fire in you! And here I was thinking to throw you off of the walkway here and now,” she laughs and you’re promptly thrown back to the ground.
rows.translation: “对，就是这样，你身上还有股火气！我刚才还想着现在就把你扔下步道呢，”她大笑着，随即把你摔回地面。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yesss, there’s fire in you! And here I was thinking to throw you off of the walkway here and now,” she laughs and you’re promptly thrown back to the ground."

rows.original: You’re barely given time to breathe as you’re hoisted up to a wobbly standing stance by the scruff of your neck.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及喘息，就被揪住后颈提起，摇摇晃晃地站了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re barely given time to breathe as you’re hoisted up to a wobbly standing stance by the scruff of your neck."

rows.original: “You’re going to go back to where you came and then up to the main elevator. I’ll know if you deviate. There will be nowhere that I can’t find you, nowhere for you to hide and shirk your reason for living,” she growls from behind with her grasp pulling you down by the back of your head. “You will learn that Overseer Maike owns you.”
rows.translation: “你要原路返回，然后上主电梯。如果偏离路线，我会知道。没有任何地方能让我找不到你，也没有任何地方能供你躲藏、逃避你活着的意义，”她从背后低吼，抓住你的后脑将你向下压。“你会明白，监督者迈克拥有你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re going to go back to where you came and then up to the main elevator. I’ll know if you deviate. There will be nowhere that I can’t find you, nowhere for you to hide and shirk your reason for living,” she growls from behind with her grasp pulling you down by the back of your head. “You will learn that Overseer Maike owns you.”"

rows.original: With that, her hand swiftly darts to your neck with some sort of semi-circle in its grip. Maike slams it against your throat and at once, a tight metallic ring snaps around your neck! The laughing slaver pushes you away from her and you stagger forwards on your shaky [pc.footOrFeet].
rows.translation: 说罢，她握着某种半圆形物体，手掌迅速伸向你的脖子。迈克将它狠狠扣在你的喉头，一圈紧绷的金属环顿时咔哒一声锁住脖颈！大笑的奴隶主将你推开，你踩着颤抖的[pc.footOrFeet]踉跄向前。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that, her hand swiftly darts to your neck with some sort of semi-circle in its grip. Maike slams it against your throat and at once, a tight metallic ring snaps around your neck! The laughing slaver pushes you away from her and you stagger forwards on your shaky [pc.footOrFeet]."

rows.original: “Hurry hurry! If you stay on course, the mining bots won’t find you, ahahaha!”
rows.translation: “快点快点！只要沿着路线走，采矿机器人就不会找到你，啊哈哈！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hurry hurry! If you stay on course, the mining bots won’t find you, ahahaha!”"

rows.original: The collar beeps and blurts out something in a synthetic voice: “Signal Received. Collar Configured. Owner: Excavator Overseer Maike Erisu. Addendum: We Hope You Enjoy Your Stay At Zhèng Shi Mines! We’re All a Part of The Plan!”
rows.translation: 项圈发出哔声，随即以合成音播报：“收到信号。项圈配置完毕。主人：挖掘监督者迈克·埃里苏。附录：祝您在郑石矿井居住愉快！我们都是计划的一部分！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe collar beeps and blurts out something in a synthetic voice: “Signal Received. Collar Configured. Owner: Excavator Overseer Maike Erisu. Addendum: We Hope You Enjoy Your Stay At Zhèng Shi Mines! We’re All a Part of The Plan!”"

rows.original: Your breath catches as the cold metal fits to your neck and you can’t help but clutch at it in panic and in vain.
rows.translation: 冰冷的金属贴合脖颈，你呼吸一滞，忍不住惊慌而徒劳地抓住项圈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour breath catches as the cold metal fits to your neck and you can’t help but clutch at it in panic and in vain."

rows.original: “Oh don’t be like that, you’ll love it here! I’ll make sure of it. Or at least, the collar will,” is what the slave-driver says in her most disarming of voices.
rows.translation: “哦，别这样嘛，你会爱上这里的！我会确保这一点。或者至少，项圈会确保的，”奴隶监工用最让人放松警惕的语调说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh don’t be like that, you’ll love it here! I’ll make sure of it. Or at least, the collar will,” is what the slave-driver says in her most disarming of voices."

rows.original: Your hands touch the metal ring all over to get a feel for it: not tight enough to choke but impossible to ignore. You can barely turn your head and if you did, the cold metal snags at your [pc.skinFurScales] sharply enough to discourage it. You prod a little more but hrrrkk-
rows.translation: 你的双手摸遍金属环，试图弄清它的结构：它没有紧到令人窒息，却也无法忽视。你几乎转不了头，即便强行转动，冰冷金属也会狠狠刮住你的[pc.skinFurScales]，让你不敢再试。你又戳弄了几下，可呃啊——
rows.raw: "\n\nYour hands touch the metal ring all over to get a feel for it: not tight enough to choke but impossible to ignore. You can barely turn your head and if you did, the cold metal snags at your [pc.skinFurScales] sharply enough to discourage it. You prod a little more but hrrrkk-"

rows.original: Your throat closes up. Your body stiffens all over. Everything below your neck roils with flesh-sundering pain. You’re on your [pc.knees] before you even know it as if it were a throbbing, overwhelming vertigo.
rows.translation: 你的喉咙猛然闭合。全身僵硬。脖颈以下翻涌着撕裂血肉的剧痛。等你意识到时，自己早已跪倒在[pc.knees]上，仿佛遭遇一阵搏动不休、铺天盖地的眩晕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour throat closes up. Your body stiffens all over. Everything below your neck roils with flesh-sundering pain. You’re on your [pc.knees] before you even know it as if it were a throbbing, overwhelming vertigo."

rows.original: “Curiosity killed the [pc.race], or at least tried to. It never gets old, you know? Every silly creature with ideas like ‘freedom’ and ‘not being a slave’, eugh. I get it, fine, deal with it, just do the job and it’ll be over with,” she quips while pushing your crumpled up form around with her foot.
rows.translation: “好奇害死[pc.race]，至少也差点害死。你知道吗，这永远都看不腻。每个愚蠢生物都抱着‘自由’和‘不当奴隶’之类的念头，呃。好吧，我懂，接受现实，把活干完，一切就结束了，”她调侃着，用脚拨弄你蜷缩的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Curiosity killed the [pc.race], or at least tried to. It never gets old, you know? Every silly creature with ideas like ‘freedom’ and ‘not being a slave’, eugh. I get it, fine, deal with it, just do the job and it’ll be over with,” she quips while pushing your crumpled up form around with her foot."

rows.original: “If you’re curious enough to fiddle with this kind of reinforcement tech then I’m just going to have to remain unconvinced at your mental ability.”
rows.translation: “你要是好奇到连这种管教科技都敢乱摆弄，我就只能继续怀疑你的智力水平了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you’re curious enough to fiddle with this kind of reinforcement tech then I’m just going to have to remain unconvinced at your mental ability.”"

rows.original: Your blood pumps louder than her voice, the inane monologue being nothing but a stab at your mind while the collar stabs at your body.
rows.translation: 你的血流声比她的话音还响。项圈刺痛身体时，那番无聊的独白也只是在刺痛你的思想。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour blood pumps louder than her voice, the inane monologue being nothing but a stab at your mind while the collar stabs at your body."

rows.original: “Time’s a-wasting,” sighs the Overseer as she fiddles with her command rod. The full-body paralysis ends and you immediately fall on your elbows. Your head throbs as if it’s ready to burst with your blood and everything else is awash with sensitivity. Even the very fabric of your clothes weighs heavily against you.
rows.translation: “时间可不等人，”监工一边摆弄指挥棒一边叹气。全身麻痹终于结束，你立刻跌在肘部。脑袋随着血流搏动，仿佛随时会炸开，身体其他部位也被敏感淹没。甚至衣物的每一寸布料都沉重地压在身上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Time’s a-wasting,” sighs the Overseer as she fiddles with her command rod. The full-body paralysis ends and you immediately fall on your elbows. Your head throbs as if it’s ready to burst with your blood and everything else is awash with sensitivity. Even the very fabric of your clothes weighs heavily against you."

rows.original: You’re harshly yanked back to your [pc.feet] with the shakiest footing in recent memory. There’s barely enough endorphin relief to keep you stable but pure inner fire keeps you standing.
rows.translation: 你被粗暴地拽回[pc.feet]上，脚步颤抖得前所未有。内啡肽带来的缓解几乎不足以维持稳定，唯有心底纯粹的火焰支撑你站立。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re harshly yanked back to your [pc.feet] with the shakiest footing in recent memory. There’s barely enough endorphin relief to keep you stable but pure inner fire keeps you standing."

rows.original: “Ah, ah, I’ve remembered: deliver this for me, slave. Another incentive to not wander. If I find you wearing it, I’ll do far worse than crush your back beneath my feet,” she threatens and shoves an old-fashion space-suit helmet into your hands from out of the blue. Closer to a ball of high-grade glass than a proper protective piece, ‘panoramic’ is one word you would use generously to describe it. “Take it to the nearest member of staff when you’ve made the descent or I don’t know, put it on your head and wait for them to beat it off of you, then they’ll know what to do with it.”
rows.translation: “啊，啊，我想起来了：奴隶，替我把这个送过去。这也能让你更不敢乱跑。要是让我发现你把它戴在头上，我会做出比用脚踩断你的背更可怕的事，”她威胁道，不知从哪里取出一顶老式宇航服头盔塞进你手中。与其说是正经防护装备，倒不如说是个高档玻璃球；你会非常慷慨地用‘全景式’来形容它。“下去以后交给最近的工作人员；要不我也不知道，戴在头上等他们把它从你脑袋上揍下来吧，到时候他们自然知道该怎么处理。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, ah, I’ve remembered: deliver this for me, slave. Another incentive to not wander. If I find you wearing it, I’ll do far worse than crush your back beneath my feet,” she threatens and shoves an old-fashion space-suit helmet into your hands from out of the blue. Closer to a ball of high-grade glass than a proper protective piece, ‘panoramic’ is one word you would use generously to describe it. “Take it to the nearest member of staff when you’ve made the descent or I don’t know, put it on your head and wait for them to beat it off of you, then they’ll know what to do with it.”"

rows.original: Well, this could be very useful if you ever wanted to go into the vacuum of space... and if no one specific is missing a helmet, what’s one missing helmet? You’ve acquired the space suit helmet!
rows.translation: 嗯，如果以后想进入太空真空环境，这东西或许很有用...而且既然没有某个特定的人丢了头盔，少一顶又能怎样？你获得了宇航服头盔！
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, this could be very useful if you ever wanted to go into the vacuum of space... and if no one specific is missing a helmet, what’s one missing helmet? You’ve acquired the space suit helmet!"

rows.original: “What are you standing around for? Go, go!”
rows.translation: “你还站在那里干什么？走，快走！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What are you standing around for? Go, go!”"

rows.original: A violently swift whip-crack snaps against your shoulder!
rows.translation: 一记快得凶狠的鞭击抽在你肩上！
rows.raw: "\n\nA violently swift whip-crack snaps against your shoulder!"

rows.original: Taking the hint, you rush back to the mouth of the walkway, watching the moth-like slaver take flight with unnatural, graceful ease into the dark reaches above. You’re not sure you want to hang around...
rows.translation: 你领会了暗示，冲回步道入口，看着那名飞蛾般的奴隶主以超乎自然的优雅轻松飞起，没入上方的黑暗深处。你觉得自己最好别在这里久留...
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking the hint, you rush back to the mouth of the walkway, watching the moth-like slaver take flight with unnatural, graceful ease into the dark reaches above. You’re not sure you want to hang around..."

rows.original: Better get to that elevator!
rows.translation: 最好赶快去电梯！
rows.raw: "\n\nBetter get to that elevator!"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You slipped through the cracks, that’s all!
rows.translation: 你只是从缝隙里溜过来了，仅此而已！
rows.raw: "You slipped through the cracks, that’s all!"

rows.original: “I never made it through processing! Caught up in the queue! I don’t know how I ended up here!” you blurt out. You hope your watery eyes show enough sincerity, even if most of it is from lack of air.
rows.translation: “我还没完成处理！队伍乱成一团！我不知道自己怎么会跑到这里！”你脱口而出。你希望泪汪汪的眼睛显得足够真诚，哪怕眼泪多半只是缺氧所致。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I never made it through processing! Caught up in the queue! I don’t know how I ended up here!” you blurt out. You hope your watery eyes show enough sincerity, even if most of it is from lack of air."

rows.original: “Lies!” growls the slaver with a crack of her energy whip. “You were trying to escape, weren’t you? Hide from the guard or escape the pen? How dare you disrespect the collar we blessed you with! I’ll show you that none escape from me: Excavator Overseer Maike! My slaves, my mines...”
rows.translation: “撒谎！”奴隶主咆哮着，能量鞭啪地炸响。“你想逃跑，对不对？躲开守卫，还是逃出围栏？我们恩赐给你的项圈，你竟敢如此不敬！我会让你明白，谁也别想逃出我的掌心：挖掘监督者迈克！我的奴隶，我的矿井...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lies!” growls the slaver with a crack of her energy whip. “You were trying to escape, weren’t you? Hide from the guard or escape the pen? How dare you disrespect the collar we blessed you with! I’ll show you that none escape from me: Excavator Overseer Maike! My slaves, my mines...”"

rows.original: With an impressive yank upwards, you’re lifted onto your [pc.feet] only to then be thrown against the closest wall of uncomfortably warm minerals.
rows.translation: 她猛地向上一拽，将你提到[pc.feet]上，紧接着又把你扔向最近那面热得令人不适的矿石墙壁。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith an impressive yank upwards, you’re lifted onto your [pc.feet] only to then be thrown against the closest wall of uncomfortably warm minerals."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “I was told to go to the pen after the shift, the collar popped off before I could reach it! I didn’t know what to do!” you blurt out automatically, hoping that it sounds convincing.
rows.translation: “他们让我下工后去围栏，项圈还没到地方就弹开了！我不知道该怎么办！”你不假思索地脱口而出，希望听起来足够可信。
rows.raw: "“I was told to go to the pen after the shift, the collar popped off before I could reach it! I didn’t know what to do!” you blurt out automatically, hoping that it sounds convincing."

rows.original: “Hrmmmjust can’t get the. Fucking. STAFF!” growls the slaver. In a flash, she smacks the ground with her powered whip and a visceral snap pierces through. You clutch at your [pc.ears] as the sharp pain makes your [pc.hair] raise. “Janky, broken, flimsy garbage! If he were on my planet, we’d have skinned him alive as a charlatan!”
rows.translation: “呃嗯嗯就是弄不到。该死的。员工！”奴隶主咆哮道。刹那间，她用充能长鞭猛击地面，令人胆寒的啪声刺穿耳膜。尖锐的疼痛令你[pc.hair]竖起，你连忙捂住[pc.ears]。“卡顿、破烂、脆弱的垃圾！要是在我的星球，我们早把那个骗子活剥了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hrmmmjust can’t get the. Fucking. STAFF!” growls the slaver. In a flash, she smacks the ground with her powered whip and a visceral snap pierces through. You clutch at your [pc.ears] as the sharp pain makes your [pc.hair] raise. “Janky, broken, flimsy garbage! If he were on my planet, we’d have skinned him alive as a charlatan!”"

rows.original: The Overseer cuts her rant short with a twisted snarl as if reminded of a nagging problem. She looks down at you with the light casting a broad, godlike shadow and leans in with all the devilish intent of a queen of venomous snakes.
rows.translation: 监工像是突然想起某个烦人的问题，扭曲地龇牙低吼，截断了自己的咆哮。灯光令她投下宽广如神祇的阴影，她俯视着你，随后带着毒蛇女王般的邪恶意图靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Overseer cuts her rant short with a twisted snarl as if reminded of a nagging problem. She looks down at you with the light casting a broad, godlike shadow and leans in with all the devilish intent of a queen of venomous snakes."

rows.original: “Maybe I’ll take you there. Maybe you’ll trundle along, never poking your head out and avoiding that damned goo in a broken chassis all because I deigned to care. Maybe... or...”
rows.translation: “也许我会带你去那里。也许你会一路蹒跚，再也不敢探头，全程躲着那个装在破烂底盘里的该死黏液怪，只因为我大发慈悲。也许...又或者...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe I’ll take you there. Maybe you’ll trundle along, never poking your head out and avoiding that damned goo in a broken chassis all because I deigned to care. Maybe... or...”"

rows.original: Before finishing her sentence, she yanks you up by the neck, kicks off from the ground with her leg-jets and pins you to the closest wall!
rows.translation: 话还没说完，她便掐住你的脖子向上一提，以腿部喷射器蹬离地面，将你按在最近的墙上！
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore finishing her sentence, she yanks you up by the neck, kicks off from the ground with her leg-jets and pins you to the closest wall!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “Dare I take you here and now? By the neck and off of that walkway? What’s that fitting Terran tale of Icarus flying too high?” mocks the slaver as she holds her coiled whip under your chin. You keep silent through sheer will...
rows.translation: “我该不该现在就在这里收拾你？掐着脖子把你扔下步道？泰伦人那个伊卡洛斯飞得太高的故事怎么说来着？”奴隶主一边嘲弄，一边把盘起的长鞭抵在你下巴下。你凭着纯粹的意志保持沉默...
rows.raw: "“Dare I take you here and now? By the neck and off of that walkway? What’s that fitting Terran tale of Icarus flying too high?” mocks the slaver as she holds her coiled whip under your chin. You keep silent through sheer will..."

rows.original: even if you’re trembling to the bone on the inside.
rows.translation: 尽管内心已经抖得骨头都在打颤。
rows.raw: " even if you’re trembling to the bone on the inside."

rows.original: Those eyes of solar hatred - orange orbs imprinted with claw-like slits - course over your body with equal parts malice and intrigue. A perverse grin forms across her lips as she eyes up your nethers.
rows.translation: 那双充满太阳般憎恨的眼睛——烙着爪痕般裂瞳的橙色眼球——以同等的恶意与兴味扫过你的身体。她盯着你的下体，嘴角勾起淫邪的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nThose eyes of solar hatred - orange orbs imprinted with claw-like slits - course over your body with equal parts malice and intrigue. A perverse grin forms across her lips as she eyes up your nethers."

rows.original: “In this place, what’s yours is mine and what’s mine is mine. And I’m taking what’s mine now, slave,” she hisses. Her free hand darts for your pelvis, a wide net of plated claws that lands just under your [pc.belly]. You tense up in her grasp, too slow to brace for this forced fondling.
rows.translation: “在这里，你的是我的，我的还是我的。现在我要拿走属于我的东西了，奴隶，”她嘶声说道。空着的手猛地抓向你的骨盆，如覆满甲板利爪的宽网落在[pc.belly]正下方。你在她掌中绷紧身体，根本来不及抵挡这场强迫爱抚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“In this place, what’s yours is mine and what’s mine is mine. And I’m taking what’s mine now, slave,” she hisses. Her free hand darts for your pelvis, a wide net of plated claws that lands just under your [pc.belly]. You tense up in her grasp, too slow to brace for this forced fondling."

rows.original: Her hand crawls lower and lower until an errant claw catches on your [pc.clit]. You can’t help but whine as something so harsh flicks against something so sensitive.
rows.translation: 她的手越爬越低，直到一根乱窜的利爪勾到你的[pc.clit]。如此粗糙的东西划过如此敏感的部位，令你忍不住呜咽。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer hand crawls lower and lower until an errant claw catches on your [pc.clit]. You can’t help but whine as something so harsh flicks against something so sensitive."

rows.original: The look of sinister intent sours into a sneer.
rows.translation: 那副邪恶意图满满的表情顿时酸成了冷笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe look of sinister intent sours into a sneer."

rows.original: “That’s no fun. You’re no fun. How disappointing that such a promising [pc.girlBoy] would betray my expectations with a distinct lack of the proper breeding tools. Ohoo, there’s nothing quite like the scream of an anal-whore with a dick ripe for abuse but you just had to disappoint me, didn’t you?” threatens the slaver. The thick appendage of her tail swings over her shoulder, the pale-green plates in full bloom to exposed a fluid-soaked tailcock. Fuck, it’s thick, easily three inches wide and it only gets wider the further down it goes! You don’t need much more of a message than that...
rows.translation: “真没意思。你一点意思都没有。如此有前途的[pc.girlBoy]，却偏偏没有合适的繁殖工具，背叛了我的期待，真叫人失望。哦吼，再也没有什么比阳具等着被蹂躏的肛交骚货发出的尖叫更美妙了，可你偏偏要让我失望，对不对？”奴隶主威胁道。她那粗壮的尾部附肢从肩头摆过，淡绿色甲板完全绽开，露出一根沾满液体的尾阳具。操，真粗，足足有三英寸宽，而且越往根部越粗！不用再多说，你已经完全明白她的意思了...
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s no fun. You’re no fun. How disappointing that such a promising [pc.girlBoy] would betray my expectations with a distinct lack of the proper breeding tools. Ohoo, there’s nothing quite like the scream of an anal-whore with a dick ripe for abuse but you just had to disappoint me, didn’t you?” threatens the slaver. The thick appendage of her tail swings over her shoulder, the pale-green plates in full bloom to exposed a fluid-soaked tailcock. Fuck, it’s thick, easily three inches wide and it only gets wider the further down it goes! You don’t need much more of a message than that..."

rows.original: “What’re you...” you begin, but-
rows.translation: “你要...”你刚开口，可——
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’re you...” you begin, but-"

rows.original: “You’ll be grateful if you even have a mouth left by the time I’m done with it,” snarls the Overseer as she clutches your jaw in her claws. “On your knees.”
rows.translation: “等我用完以后，你还能剩下一张嘴，就该感恩戴德了，”监工咆哮着，用利爪捏住你的下巴。“跪下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll be grateful if you even have a mouth left by the time I’m done with it,” snarls the Overseer as she clutches your jaw in her claws. “On your knees.”"

rows.original: You’ve little recourse but to obey her command. Keep in character, keep in character...!
rows.translation: 你别无选择，只能服从命令。别脱离角色，别脱离角色...！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve little recourse but to obey her command. Keep in character, keep in character...!"

rows.original: She gives you just enough space to be free of the rocky wall, thankfully away from the hot detritus and dirt the coats it in part. You quickly fall to your [pc.knees] and maintain what eye contact you can, wary of the humming whip that brushes and tingles against your chin.
rows.translation: 她给你留出刚好足以脱离岩壁的空间，所幸也让你远离了覆盖部分墙面的滚烫碎屑与泥土。你迅速跪倒在[pc.knees]上，尽可能与她保持目光接触，同时警惕着那条嗡鸣作响、擦过你下巴并带来阵阵刺麻感的鞭子。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you just enough space to be free of the rocky wall, thankfully away from the hot detritus and dirt the coats it in part. You quickly fall to your [pc.knees] and maintain what eye contact you can, wary of the humming whip that brushes and tingles against your chin."

rows.original: “Mouth. Open.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mouth. Open.”"

rows.original: The punctuated command is clear as day. You open your [pc.lipsChaste] and half-close your eyes as you expect the worst, knowing her impossibly long tail is only a thought away from filling your entire gullet.
rows.translation: 这断然的命令再清楚不过。你张开[pc.lipsChaste]，半闭双眼等待最糟糕的事情发生，深知她那长得不可思议的尾巴只消一个念头便能塞满你的整条喉咙。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe punctuated command is clear as day. You open your [pc.lipsChaste] and half-close your eyes as you expect the worst, knowing her impossibly long tail is only a thought away from filling your entire gullet."

rows.original: The slaver merely smiles as he tail flicks into the shadows. Instead, a snap catches you off guard and the thin thong that covered her nethers recedes into the corset. What’s presented is a glistening piece of art, a primed cunt studded with tiny gems and piercings. The curious fleshflower comes closer and closer until-
rows.translation: 奴隶贩子只是微微一笑，尾巴一甩，隐入阴影。紧接着一声啪嗒令你猝不及防，遮住她下体的细薄丁字裤缩回了束身衣里。呈现在你眼前的是一件晶莹欲滴的艺术品：一只蓄势待发、点缀着细小宝石和穿环的蜜穴。那朵奇异的肉花越来越近，直到——
rows.raw: "\n\nThe slaver merely smiles as he tail flicks into the shadows. Instead, a snap catches you off guard and the thin thong that covered her nethers recedes into the corset. What’s presented is a glistening piece of art, a primed cunt studded with tiny gems and piercings. The curious fleshflower comes closer and closer until-"

rows.original: “Mmmuurrfmfophfphf!” is all you force out as the soft labia force themselves upon your lips. Powerful thighs surround your vision and a rough grip holds you by your [pc.hair]. Your mouth is filled with soft, fleshy folds and a worrying wash of feminine fluids but you daren’t do anything without a command. The coiling snake of her tail slips through her legs and wraps itself around your neck, forming a loose noose that catches against your [pc.skinFurScales] with its scale-hide.
rows.translation: “唔呣呜呜呜！”柔软的阴唇压上你的嘴唇，你只能挤出这点声音。强健的大腿占据了你的全部视野，一只粗暴的手揪住你的[pc.hair]。你的嘴里塞满了柔软肥嫩的肉褶，还有一股令人不安的雌性淫液，可没有命令，你丝毫不敢妄动。她蛇一般盘卷的尾巴从双腿间滑过，缠上你的脖子，结成一个松垮的套索，鳞皮摩擦着你的[pc.skinFurScales]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmuurrfmfophfphf!” is all you force out as the soft labia force themselves upon your lips. Powerful thighs surround your vision and a rough grip holds you by your [pc.hair]. Your mouth is filled with soft, fleshy folds and a worrying wash of feminine fluids but you daren’t do anything without a command. The coiling snake of her tail slips through her legs and wraps itself around your neck, forming a loose noose that catches against your [pc.skinFurScales] with its scale-hide."

rows.original: “I needn’t say more, hm? If you do a poor job, well...” threatens the Overseer as she stares you down from on high. A powerful tension tightens around your neck, making you seize up as blood rushes to your head!
rows.translation: “不用我再多说了，对吧？要是你干得不好，那么……”监督者居高临下地瞪着你，威胁道。你颈间骤然收紧，令你浑身僵住，血液直冲脑门！
rows.raw: "\n\n“I needn’t say more, hm? If you do a poor job, well...” threatens the Overseer as she stares you down from on high. A powerful tension tightens around your neck, making you seize up as blood rushes to your head!"

rows.original: “Now get to work. Your life depends on it, slave.”

rows.translation: “哦，别这样嘛，你会爱上这里的！我会保证这一点。或者至少，这个项圈会保证，”奴隶监工用她最能令人放松警惕的声音说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh don’t be like that, you’ll love it here! I’ll make sure of it. Or at least, the collar will,” is what the slave-driver says in her most disarming of voices."

rows.original: Your hands touch the metal ring all over to get a feel for it: not tight enough to choke but impossible to ignore. You can barely turn your head and if you did, the cold metal snags at your [pc.skinFurScales] sharply enough to discourage it. You prod a little more but hrrrkk-
rows.translation: 你的双手在金属环上四处摸索，仔细感受它：不至于紧得令你窒息，却也绝不可能忽视。你几乎无法转头；即使勉强转动，冰冷金属也会勾住你的[pc.skinFurScales]，尖锐的疼痛足以令你打消念头。你又戳弄了几下，可是呃咳——
rows.raw: "\n\nYour hands touch the metal ring all over to get a feel for it: not tight enough to choke but impossible to ignore. You can barely turn your head and if you did, the cold metal snags at your [pc.skinFurScales] sharply enough to discourage it. You prod a little more but hrrrkk-"

rows.original: Your throat closes up. Your body stiffens all over. Everything below your neck roils with flesh-sundering pain. You’re on your [pc.knees] before you even know it as if it were a throbbing, overwhelming vertigo.
rows.translation: 你的喉咙猛然闭合。全身彻底僵住。颈部以下的一切都翻涌着撕裂肉体的剧痛。等你意识到时，自己已经跪在[pc.knees]上，仿佛被一阵搏动不休、压倒一切的眩晕击垮。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour throat closes up. Your body stiffens all over. Everything below your neck roils with flesh-sundering pain. You’re on your [pc.knees] before you even know it as if it were a throbbing, overwhelming vertigo."

rows.original: “Curiosity killed the [pc.race], or at least tried to. It never gets old, you know? Every silly creature with ideas like ‘freedom’ and ‘not being a slave’, eugh. I get it, fine, deal with it, just do the job and it’ll be over with,” she quips while pushing your crumpled up form around with her foot.
rows.translation: “好奇心害死[pc.race]，至少它尝试过。你知道吗，这种事怎么都看不腻。每个蠢货脑子里都装着什么‘自由’、‘不当奴隶’之类的想法，呃。行了，我懂，接受现实吧，干完活一切就结束了，”她一边打趣，一边用脚拨弄你蜷成一团的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Curiosity killed the [pc.race], or at least tried to. It never gets old, you know? Every silly creature with ideas like ‘freedom’ and ‘not being a slave’, eugh. I get it, fine, deal with it, just do the job and it’ll be over with,” she quips while pushing your crumpled up form around with her foot."

rows.original: “If you’re curious enough to fiddle with this kind of reinforcement tech then I’m just going to have to remain unconvinced at your mental ability.”
rows.translation: “既然你好奇到要摆弄这种强化装置，那我只好继续怀疑你的智力了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you’re curious enough to fiddle with this kind of reinforcement tech then I’m just going to have to remain unconvinced at your mental ability.”"

rows.original: Your blood pumps louder than her voice, the inane monologue being nothing but a stab at your mind while the collar stabs at your body.
rows.translation: 血液奔涌的声音压过她的话；项圈刺痛你身体时，那段愚蠢的独白也只是在扎你的心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour blood pumps louder than her voice, the inane monologue being nothing but a stab at your mind while the collar stabs at your body."

rows.original: Oh stop curling up like that, you’ve already had a collar on, remember? Or was that a teensy lie on your part? Suppose it doesn’t even matter now.
rows.translation: 哦，别再那样蜷着了，你以前已经戴过项圈，记得吗？还是说那是你撒的一个小小的谎？反正现在也无所谓了。
rows.raw: " Oh stop curling up like that, you’ve already had a collar on, remember? Or was that a teensy lie on your part? Suppose it doesn’t even matter now."

rows.original: That’s enough from you,” sighs the Overseer as she fiddles with her command rod. The full-body paralysis ends and you immediately fall on your elbows. Your head throbs as if it’s ready to burst with your blood and everything else is awash with sensitivity. Even the very fabric of your clothes weighs heavily against you.
rows.translation: 你闹得够久了，”监督者叹息着摆弄手中的指挥棒。全身麻痹终于结束，你立刻跌倒，用手肘撑住地面。脑袋随着血流搏动，仿佛随时会爆开，身体其余部位也被敏感的浪潮淹没。就连衣物的布料压在身上都重若千钧。
rows.raw: " That’s enough from you,” sighs the Overseer as she fiddles with her command rod. The full-body paralysis ends and you immediately fall on your elbows. Your head throbs as if it’s ready to burst with your blood and everything else is awash with sensitivity. Even the very fabric of your clothes weighs heavily against you."

rows.original: You’re harshly yanked back to your [pc.feet] with the shakiest footing in recent memory. There’s barely enough endorphin relief to keep you stable but pure inner fire keeps you standing.
rows.translation: 你被粗暴地拽回[pc.feet]上，脚步虚浮得前所未有。内啡肽带来的缓解几乎不足以让你站稳，唯有内心纯粹的火焰支撑着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re harshly yanked back to your [pc.feet] with the shakiest footing in recent memory. There’s barely enough endorphin relief to keep you stable but pure inner fire keeps you standing."

rows.original: “Ah, ah, I’ve remembered: deliver this for me, slave. Another incentive to not wander. If I find you wearing it, I’ll do far worse than crush your back beneath my feet,” she threatens and shoves an old-fashion space-suit helmet into your hands from out of the blue. Closer to a ball of high-grade glass than a proper protective piece, ‘panoramic’ is one word you would use generously to describe it. “Take it to the nearest member of staff when you’ve made the descent or I don’t know, put it on your head and wait for them to beat it off of you, then they’ll know what to do with it.”
rows.translation: “啊，啊，我想起来了：替我送个东西，奴隶。这也能多给你一个不乱跑的理由。要是让我发现你戴上了它，我会做出比把你的脊背踩碎更可怕的事，”她威胁道，忽然把一顶老式宇航服头盔塞进你手里。与其说是正经防护装备，它更像一个高档玻璃球；要形容它，你大可慷慨地用上“全景式”一词。“下去以后，把它交给最近的工作人员。要不就戴到头上，等他们把它从你脑袋上揍下来，那样他们自然知道该怎么办。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, ah, I’ve remembered: deliver this for me, slave. Another incentive to not wander. If I find you wearing it, I’ll do far worse than crush your back beneath my feet,” she threatens and shoves an old-fashion space-suit helmet into your hands from out of the blue. Closer to a ball of high-grade glass than a proper protective piece, ‘panoramic’ is one word you would use generously to describe it. “Take it to the nearest member of staff when you’ve made the descent or I don’t know, put it on your head and wait for them to beat it off of you, then they’ll know what to do with it.”"

rows.original: Well, this could be very useful if you ever wanted to go into the vacuum of space... and if no one specific is missing a helmet, what’s one missing helmet? You’ve acquired the space suit helmet!
rows.translation: 嗯，如果你哪天想进入太空真空，这东西或许很有用……既然没有哪个特定的人少了头盔，那么少一顶又有什么关系？你获得了宇航服头盔！
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, this could be very useful if you ever wanted to go into the vacuum of space... and if no one specific is missing a helmet, what’s one missing helmet? You’ve acquired the space suit helmet!"

rows.original: “Now off you go or else I’ll to throw you into the pen with nothing but that collar on. All those broken spirits, so aggressive and horny all in one place... I can only imagine what ravenous minds would do to this body,” she hisses into your ear before pushing you towards the walkways exit.
rows.translation: “现在快滚，不然我就只让你戴着那个项圈，把你扔进围栏里。那里挤满了破碎的灵魂，既凶狠又欲火中烧……我都不敢想象，那些饥渴的家伙会怎样对待这副身体，”她贴着你的耳朵嘶声说道，随后将你推向走道出口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now off you go or else I’ll to throw you into the pen with nothing but that collar on. All those broken spirits, so aggressive and horny all in one place... I can only imagine what ravenous minds would do to this body,” she hisses into your ear before pushing you towards the walkways exit."

rows.original: You hurry your way to the exit while wiping the slavers juices from your [pc.face]. A thought runs through your head that this could’ve been so much worse...
rows.translation: 你擦去[pc.face]上的奴隶贩子汁液，匆忙走向出口。一个念头掠过脑海：事情原本可能糟糕得多……
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hurry your way to the exit while wiping the slavers juices from your [pc.face]. A thought runs through your head that this could’ve been so much worse..."

rows.original: You’re so stiff, used-up and full of alien seed that you can only waddle with a wonky footing towards the exit. You try to keep your sense of shame up by zipping up your slaves uniform.
rows.translation: 你的身体僵硬、被彻底用过，又灌满异星种液，只能步履蹒跚地摇晃着走向出口。你拉好奴隶制服的拉链，竭力维持自己的羞耻心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re so stiff, used-up and full of alien seed that you can only waddle with a wonky footing towards the exit. You try to keep your sense of shame up by zipping up your slaves uniform."

rows.original: If it weren’t the mark of such a brutal and not exactly satisfying conquest, your voyeuristic mind might’ve left such a cum-trophy on full display...
rows.translation: 要不是这份精液战利品象征着一次如此残暴、又算不上满足的征服，你那喜欢被人看见的一面或许真会让它一直暴露在外……
rows.raw: " If it weren’t the mark of such a brutal and not exactly satisfying conquest, your voyeuristic mind might’ve left such a cum-trophy on full display..."

rows.original: Well thank fuck you escaped the worst of it! You make your way over to the walkways exit.
rows.translation: 谢天谢地，你总算逃过了最糟糕的部分！你朝走道出口走去。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell thank fuck you escaped the worst of it! You make your way over to the walkways exit."

rows.original: A new thought crosses your mind: once I’m done with it, how am I getting this collar off...
rows.translation: 一个新的念头浮上心头：等事情办完，我该怎么摘掉这个项圈……
rows.raw: "\n\nA new thought crosses your mind: once I’m done with it, how am I getting this collar off..."

rows.original: She gives you one last whipcrack to see you off.
rows.translation: 她最后又抽来一鞭，为你送行。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you one last whipcrack to see you off."

rows.original: “Quick-ly! One, two, one two, ahaha!” shouts Maike as she snaps her whip at your [pc.feet]. You’re more than happy to keep in line if just to avoid those strikes. Even in your post-collar-pain haze, you jump to formation and rush towards the exit with the moth-domme barely a foot away behind you.
rows.translation: “快——点！一、二，一、二，啊哈哈！”迈克一边大喊，一边朝你的[pc.feet]甩动鞭子。只要能躲过抽打，你非常乐意乖乖听话。即便还笼罩在项圈剧痛后的恍惚中，你也立刻站好队形，冲向出口，而蛾女主人就在身后不到一英尺处紧紧跟随。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quick-ly! One, two, one two, ahaha!” shouts Maike as she snaps her whip at your [pc.feet]. You’re more than happy to keep in line if just to avoid those strikes. Even in your post-collar-pain haze, you jump to formation and rush towards the exit with the moth-domme barely a foot away behind you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: ZS H40
rows.raw: "ZS H40"

rows.original: The march to the pen is quite the effort.
rows.translation: 前往囚禁区的这段路走得相当费劲。
rows.raw: "The march to the pen is quite the effort."

rows.original: Your movements are rigid and alert, constantly wary of the Overseer’s whimsical ‘course corrections’ whenever she lifts her whip. You pass entire chaingangs being held in place or led to other parts of the mine by more pirates, noting that all pay a nod or salute to Maike as you walk past.
rows.translation: 你的动作僵硬而警觉，只要监工扬起鞭子，你就时刻提防着她心血来潮的“路线纠正”。一路上，你经过一整队整队被固定在原地，或由更多海盗押往矿区其他地方的锁链苦工；走过时，你注意到所有人都会向迈克点头或敬礼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour movements are rigid and alert, constantly wary of the Overseer’s whimsical ‘course corrections’ whenever she lifts her whip. You pass entire chaingangs being held in place or led to other parts of the mine by more pirates, noting that all pay a nod or salute to Maike as you walk past."

rows.original: “A runner?” asks one, a snake-like slaver in a silver-green bodysuit.
rows.translation: “逃奴？”一个穿着银绿色紧身衣、蛇一般的奴隶贩子问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A runner?” asks one, a snake-like slaver in a silver-green bodysuit."

rows.original: “Nooo, a little lamb who lost its way. Continue your duties, I’ve got this,” she replies with a sigh, never once looking in the saluting slavers direction. The Overseer keeps your own distracted gaze in line with more and more whip cracks although you’re never actually hit by the coruscating energy lash.
rows.translation: “不——，只是一只迷路的小羊羔。继续履行职责，这里有我处理，”她叹着气回答，连看都没看向敬礼的奴隶贩子。每当你的视线分心，监工就一次又一次甩响鞭子，让你目视前方，不过那道闪烁的能量鞭从未真正打中你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nooo, a little lamb who lost its way. Continue your duties, I’ve got this,” she replies with a sigh, never once looking in the saluting slavers direction. The Overseer keeps your own distracted gaze in line with more and more whip cracks although you’re never actually hit by the coruscating energy lash."

rows.original: All the while, the collar ebbs and pulses a mild ache across your body. When you pass a zone of heavy activity, it relents and settles a little more comfortably against your skin. At all other times, it bites deep into your nerves and even makes [pc.walking] about a different struggle of its own.
rows.translation: 与此同时，项圈不断向你全身送出一阵阵轻微的疼痛。经过活动繁忙的区域时，它会稍稍放松，更舒适地贴在你的皮肤上。其余时候，它都会深深噬咬你的神经，甚至让[pc.walking]本身也变成另一场苦斗。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll the while, the collar ebbs and pulses a mild ache across your body. When you pass a zone of heavy activity, it relents and settles a little more comfortably against your skin. At all other times, it bites deep into your nerves and even makes [pc.walking] about a different struggle of its own."

rows.original: You stay strong but it’s not merely your body under assault as leering, envious eyes of ‘fellow’ slaves look at you with primal hunger. If you weren’t in the same boat as them, it wouldn’t be too far to think that they’d be on you like wolves. Maike sees this too, offering nought but a quick lash from her whip to the chancers amongst the chained slaves.
rows.translation: 你坚持不倒，但遭受侵袭的并不只有身体：那些“同伴”奴隶以充满原始饥渴、又妒又馋的目光盯着你。若不是和他们同病相怜，你很容易认为他们会像狼群一样扑上来。迈克也看到了，只是迅速挥鞭抽向那些锁链奴隶中企图有所行动的家伙。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stay strong but it’s not merely your body under assault as leering, envious eyes of ‘fellow’ slaves look at you with primal hunger. If you weren’t in the same boat as them, it wouldn’t be too far to think that they’d be on you like wolves. Maike sees this too, offering nought but a quick lash from her whip to the chancers amongst the chained slaves."

rows.original: Eventually, you come to familiar tunnels: somewhere near the exit at least.
rows.translation: 最终，你来到熟悉的隧道：至少是出口附近的某处。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, you come to familiar tunnels: somewhere near the exit at least."

rows.original: You’re walked by the Overseer’s office but the Overseer takes a moment to pause. She stares wistfully at the doors as if she were pining for something inside. You stand to attention as she does, mindful to at least appear focused as a timid slave should be. You might be getting too into this role says your nagging conscious.
rows.translation: 监工押着你经过她的办公室，却停顿了片刻。她怅然地凝视着房门，仿佛正渴望里面的某样东西。她驻足时，你也立正站好，留心至少要表现得像个胆怯而专注的奴隶。你脑中挥之不去的良知说，你或许太过入戏了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re walked by the Overseer’s office but the Overseer takes a moment to pause. She stares wistfully at the doors as if she were pining for something inside. You stand to attention as she does, mindful to at least appear focused as a timid slave should be. You might be getting too into this role says your nagging conscious."

rows.original: A short march later and the two of you come up to the large door that blocks access to a holding camp. Maike holds a firm grip to your shoulder as she swipes the card around in the air. Unseen sensors beep and make light pleasantries as they address her as ‘Excavator Overseer Maike’. The door slides apart in no time at all and as soon as there’s enough room, the slaver pushes you straight into the gloom.
rows.translation: 又走了一小段路，你们二人来到封闭拘留营入口的巨门前。迈克牢牢抓着你的肩膀，同时把卡片在空中一挥。看不见的感应器发出哔声，并以“采掘监督者迈克”称呼她、说了几句客套话。大门转眼间便向两边滑开，一出现足够的空隙，奴隶贩子就把你径直推进幽暗之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nA short march later and the two of you come up to the large door that blocks access to a holding camp. Maike holds a firm grip to your shoulder as she swipes the card around in the air. Unseen sensors beep and make light pleasantries as they address her as ‘Excavator Overseer Maike’. The door slides apart in no time at all and as soon as there’s enough room, the slaver pushes you straight into the gloom."

rows.original: The doors close behind.
rows.translation: 门在身后合拢。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe doors close behind."

rows.original: Welp. Now what?
rows.translation: 好吧。现在怎么办？
rows.raw: "\n\nWelp. Now what?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You’ve got a more expedient idea to get what you want.
rows.translation: 你想到了一个更快捷的办法来取得所需之物。
rows.raw: "You’ve got a more expedient idea to get what you want."

rows.original: Hey, if it worked for the front door!
rows.translation: 嘿，既然这招在正门奏效了！
rows.raw: " Hey, if it worked for the front door!"

rows.original: “Ey, FUCK YOU!”
rows.translation: “喂，操你妈！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ey, FUCK YOU!”"

rows.original: You aim your fist at the slaver’s exposed ankle, catch it as the limb weakens from the impact and yank your target to the ground. The unawares moth-alien crumples into a mess of wings and scaled limbs, caught off guard by your dirty play. It hasn’t quite taken her out though for in seconds, she’s already taken flight and hovers several feet above you.
rows.translation: 你一拳瞄准奴隶贩子裸露的脚踝，趁那条腿受创发软时抓住它，把目标拽倒在地。毫无防备的蛾类异族顿时摔成一团歪斜的翅膀与覆鳞肢体，被你的卑鄙招数打了个措手不及。不过这并未彻底放倒她；几秒之内，她就已经飞起，悬停在你上方数英尺处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou aim your fist at the slaver’s exposed ankle, catch it as the limb weakens from the impact and yank your target to the ground. The unawares moth-alien crumples into a mess of wings and scaled limbs, caught off guard by your dirty play. It hasn’t quite taken her out though for in seconds, she’s already taken flight and hovers several feet above you."

rows.original: With keen combat reflex, you quickly get to your [pc.footOrFeet] and draw your
rows.translation: 凭借敏锐的战斗反应，你迅速站稳[pc.footOrFeet]，拔出你的
rows.raw: "\n\nWith keen combat reflex, you quickly get to your [pc.footOrFeet] and draw your"

rows.original: cleverly stowed
rows.translation: 被巧妙地收纳起来
rows.raw: " cleverly stowed"

rows.original: [pc.weapon].
rows.raw: " [pc.weapon]."

rows.original: It’s amazing the space you can find in a slave’s uniform for this kind of gear!
rows.translation: 奴隶制服里竟能腾出这么多地方装这种装备，实在令人惊讶！
rows.raw: " It’s amazing the space you can find in a slave’s uniform for this kind of gear!"

rows.original: With a shimmy of your wrist and fingers, you toss a miniature flashbang towards the slaver’s middle. Although her perception is sharp, her reflexes fail to knock the grenade away and with a quick push, she twists away from the near-instant flash! In seconds, she’s already taken flight and hovers several feet above you with malevolent intent.
rows.translation: 你手腕和手指轻巧一抖，将一枚微型闪光弹掷向奴隶贩子的腰腹。尽管她感知敏锐，反应却没快到能击开手雷；随着闪光几乎瞬间炸开，她猛地发力扭身避让！几秒之内，她已经飞起，怀着恶意悬停在你上方数英尺处。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a shimmy of your wrist and fingers, you toss a miniature flashbang towards the slaver’s middle. Although her perception is sharp, her reflexes fail to knock the grenade away and with a quick push, she twists away from the near-instant flash! In seconds, she’s already taken flight and hovers several feet above you with malevolent intent."

rows.original: You’re already rolling out of the way and with quick, dexterous skill, you get to your [pc.footOrFeet] and draw your
rows.translation: 你早已翻滚躲开，并凭借敏捷的技巧迅速站稳[pc.footOrFeet]，拔出你的
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re already rolling out of the way and with quick, dexterous skill, you get to your [pc.footOrFeet] and draw your"

rows.original: cleverly stowed
rows.translation: 被巧妙地收纳起来
rows.raw: " cleverly stowed"

rows.original: [pc.weapon].

rows.translation: 那些手拉过你瘫软的手腕，用重力手铐把它们铐在一起。愈发模糊的监工毫不费力地将你从前臂处拎起，随意甩到肩上。某个尖锐物刺进你的[pc.skinFurScales]，让那片区域失去知觉。与此同时，“没用的奴隶身体”之类的辱骂与叫喊不断回荡，你那被性欲占据的头脑彻底淹没在自身的生理冲动中。你几乎动弹不得，而思考...也...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hands pull at your limp wrists and clamp them together in grav-cuffs. You’re yanked up by the forearms and casually slung over the shoulder of the increasingly blurry Overseer with minimal effort. Something sharp jabs your [pc.skinFurScales] and numbers the area. All the while, epithets and calls of ‘pathetic slave bodies’ echo around as your sex-addled mind is overwhelmed with your own biological urges. You can barely move and thinking... is..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Faces of all kinds.
rows.translation: 形形色色的面孔。
rows.raw: "Faces of all kinds."

rows.original: Masks, collars, voice comms.
rows.translation: 面具、项圈、语音通讯器。
rows.raw: "\n\nMasks, collars, voice comms."

rows.original: Black and red outfits, silver suits, robotic limbs, generic uniforms.
rows.translation: 黑红相间的服装、银色战衣、机械肢体、千篇一律的制服。
rows.raw: "\n\nBlack and red outfits, silver suits, robotic limbs, generic uniforms."

rows.original: You’re dimly aware of all this that passes you by as you’re taken away by the Overseer to somewhere within the pirate port. The harsh gray of the hallways turns into a surprisingly warm palette of reds and pinks as you’re whisked away into some new realm entirely.
rows.translation: 监工带你穿过海盗港，前往某个地方时，你只能朦胧意识到这一切从身边掠过。走廊冷硬的灰色忽然转为令人意外的温暖红粉色调，你被迅速带进了一个全然不同的新领域。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re dimly aware of all this that passes you by as you’re taken away by the Overseer to somewhere within the pirate port. The harsh gray of the hallways turns into a surprisingly warm palette of reds and pinks as you’re whisked away into some new realm entirely."

rows.original: Another pair of hands joins in the effort, placing you dead in the center of this narrow and mirror-dotted room. All of your possessions are stripped away in a methodical and invasive flurry of dainty fingers and clawed talons. Someone grabs you by the jaw and comments on your glazed, grinning expression while holding a syringe to your arm. There’s the familiar dull ache of a needle jab and nothing more. You’re still so heady from being overstimulated that it’s simply another ‘thing’ that flashes past your eyes, its meaning lost in a haze of self-indulgence and unfulfilled need. You can’t help but rub your [pc.legs] together as deep, deep euphoria sets in the more you dwell on it all. It’s all quite nice, being head over heels with your own body in such a detached way.
rows.translation: 另一双手加入进来，把你直接放到这间狭窄、点缀着镜子的房间中央。一阵纤细手指与利爪有条不紊却又侵犯意味十足的翻动后，你身上的所有物品都被剥走。有人捏住你的下巴，评论着你双眼迷离、咧嘴傻笑的表情，同时把注射器抵在你的手臂上。熟悉的针刺钝痛传来，除此之外什么也没有。过度刺激带来的亢奋仍然笼罩着你，于是这不过又是从眼前一闪而过的某种“东西”，意义消失在自我沉醉与未满足欲望的迷雾中。随着你愈发沉浸其中，深沉至极的快感不断升起，你忍不住摩擦自己的[pc.legs]。如此超然地为自己的身体神魂颠倒，感觉真是相当美妙。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother pair of hands joins in the effort, placing you dead in the center of this narrow and mirror-dotted room. All of your possessions are stripped away in a methodical and invasive flurry of dainty fingers and clawed talons. Someone grabs you by the jaw and comments on your glazed, grinning expression while holding a syringe to your arm. There’s the familiar dull ache of a needle jab and nothing more. You’re still so heady from being overstimulated that it’s simply another ‘thing’ that flashes past your eyes, its meaning lost in a haze of self-indulgence and unfulfilled need. You can’t help but rub your [pc.legs] together as deep, deep euphoria sets in the more you dwell on it all. It’s all quite nice, being head over heels with your own body in such a detached way."

rows.original: You can only laugh.
rows.translation: 你只能大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can only laugh."

rows.original: And touch. And feel. You plant your fingers onto the ground and the soft, strange material teases your tips with plush, airy fabric. Just feels nice across the skin...
rows.translation: 然后触摸。然后感受。你把手指按在地上，柔软而陌生的材料用蓬松轻盈的织物挑逗着指尖。擦过皮肤的感觉真舒服...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd touch. And feel. You plant your fingers onto the ground and the soft, strange material teases your tips with plush, airy fabric. Just feels nice across the skin..."

rows.original: “Uff, look at this filth. Tiffy, cover [pc.himHer] up for me, I can’t bear to look at this scum,” comes a familiar, sophisticated and articulate voice from above you.
rows.translation: “呃，看看这肮脏东西。蒂菲，替我把[pc.himHer]遮起来，我实在不忍直视这个人渣，”头顶传来一个熟悉、老练而口齿清晰的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uff, look at this filth. Tiffy, cover [pc.himHer] up for me, I can’t bear to look at this scum,” comes a familiar, sophisticated and articulate voice from above you."

rows.original: “Of course, Mistress. I’ll make [pc.himHer] thoroughly dreadful, ahehe,” comes a nervous giggle from a softer, male voice. “Would you prefer the ‘the morning after’ or ‘rejected on the dancefloor’?”
rows.translation: “当然，女主人。我会把[pc.himHer]弄得惨不忍睹，啊呵呵，”一个更轻柔的男性声音紧张地笑道。“您喜欢‘宿醉后的早晨’，还是‘舞池惨遭拒绝’？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, Mistress. I’ll make [pc.himHer] thoroughly dreadful, ahehe,” comes a nervous giggle from a softer, male voice. “Would you prefer the ‘the morning after’ or ‘rejected on the dancefloor’?”"

rows.original: “Mm, ‘morning after’. This whore isn’t at all classy, perhaps not even worth the effort. Still, it’s anything goes,” comments the other, female voice. “‘Test run’ and then send [pc.himHer] to the pen, like the last one.”
rows.translation: “嗯，‘宿醉后的早晨’。这婊子一点格调都没有，甚至可能不值得费力。不过，随便怎么弄都行，”另一个女性声音评论道。“先‘试用’，然后像上一个一样把[pc.himHer]送去围栏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm, ‘morning after’. This whore isn’t at all classy, perhaps not even worth the effort. Still, it’s anything goes,” comments the other, female voice. “‘Test run’ and then send [pc.himHer] to the pen, like the last one.”"

rows.original: “Right away,” giggles the male voice.
rows.translation: “马上就办，”男性声音笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right away,” giggles the male voice."

rows.original: A golden, adorable face comes into view as a pair of dainty hands clasp your dopily grinning cheeks.
rows.translation: 一张金灿灿的可爱面孔映入眼帘，一双纤细的手捧住你傻笑的脸颊。
rows.raw: "\n\nA golden, adorable face comes into view as a pair of dainty hands clasp your dopily grinning cheeks."

rows.original: “Let’s get you ready for the slaves.”
rows.translation: “让我们把你准备好，送给奴隶们吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s get you ready for the slaves.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You’re not quite sure of what happens afterwards. It’s a blur of hands massaging, dabbing and poking various parts of your perpetually grinning face. It’s all cold and vaguely wet, as if something was using your face for some slapdash, abstract art piece.
rows.translation: 你不太清楚之后发生了什么。只记得一片模糊的双手在你始终咧嘴笑着的脸上各处按摩、涂抹和戳刺。所有东西都冰凉而隐约湿润，仿佛有人把你的脸当成了某件草率拼凑的抽象艺术品。
rows.raw: "You’re not quite sure of what happens afterwards. It’s a blur of hands massaging, dabbing and poking various parts of your perpetually grinning face. It’s all cold and vaguely wet, as if something was using your face for some slapdash, abstract art piece."

rows.original: At some points, an overhead light is shone into your [pc.face] and overwhelms your vision for a few seconds. Harder, pinpoint lines trace across various parts of your face as if the artist had switched drawing medium halfway through the artwork. You’re just too giggly to care, taken by an unnatural euphoria that fuels your ambient horniness. You just want to fuck something so bad, or get fucked, either, no, both. Anything just to feel like this for longer or even forever.
rows.translation: 有时，头顶的灯光会照向你的[pc.face]，让你的视野被白光淹没数秒。更坚硬、更细窄的线条划过面部各处，仿佛艺术家作画到一半换了种画材。你只顾咯咯傻笑，根本不在乎；一种反常的欣快感攫住了你，为弥漫全身的性欲不断添柴。你好想操什么东西，或是被谁操，随便，不，两样都要。只要能让这种感觉持续更久，甚至永远持续下去，什么都行。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt some points, an overhead light is shone into your [pc.face] and overwhelms your vision for a few seconds. Harder, pinpoint lines trace across various parts of your face as if the artist had switched drawing medium halfway through the artwork. You’re just too giggly to care, taken by an unnatural euphoria that fuels your ambient horniness. You just want to fuck something so bad, or get fucked, either, no, both. Anything just to feel like this for longer or even forever."

rows.original: You’re briefly brought into the real world with a harsh slap the cheek.
rows.translation: 一记凶狠的耳光抽在脸颊上，让你短暂回到现实。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re briefly brought into the real world with a harsh slap the cheek."

rows.original: “Slave, wake up. Do. You. Have. A. Naaaaame?” asks the feminine voice. You can’t see much other than a... hehe, a great big pair of tits. Big and blue. With twinkly bits.
rows.translation: “奴隶，醒醒。你。有。名。字。吗——？”女性声音问道。你什么也看不清，只看见一...嘿嘿，一对硕大无比的乳房。又大又蓝，上面还有闪闪发光的小东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Slave, wake up. Do. You. Have. A. Naaaaame?” asks the feminine voice. You can’t see much other than a... hehe, a great big pair of tits. Big and blue. With twinkly bits."

rows.original: You simply laugh in spite of the sting that’s left across your [pc.face].
rows.translation: 尽管[pc.face]上还留着火辣刺痛，你只是放声大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou simply laugh in spite of the sting that’s left across your [pc.face]."

rows.original: “I think [pc.heShe]’s out for the count, Mistress. Shall I continue?”
rows.translation: “我觉得[pc.heShe]已经彻底不省人事了，女主人。还要继续吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think [pc.heShe]’s out for the count, Mistress. Shall I continue?”"

rows.original: “Oh yes, definitely. I’ll shuffle [pc.himHer] under ‘unclaimed’, not really interested in keeping this one after all. Cuz I’ve got yooooooou, bee boy,” giggles the feminine voice followed by the sounds of a rather aggressive sounding kiss. Your eyes just about make out two fuzzy figures embraced and a very hands-on fondle: one short and yellow, one much taller and bluish purple. Both have wings... if you ever knew who they were, your mind isn’t willing to play along. Maybe you knew their names, maybe you knew... your name...
rows.translation: “哦，当然要。我会把[pc.himHer]归进‘无人认领’，反正我对留下这一个也没什么兴趣。因为我已经有你——了，我的蜜蜂男孩，”女性声音咯咯笑道，紧接着响起一个颇为激烈的亲吻声。你的眼睛勉强辨认出两个模糊身影抱在一起，双手非常不安分地摸索着：一个矮小金黄，一个高大得多，呈蓝紫色。两者都有翅膀...即便你曾经知道他们是谁，此刻脑袋也不愿配合。也许你知道他们的名字，也许你曾知道...自己的名字...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yes, definitely. I’ll shuffle [pc.himHer] under ‘unclaimed’, not really interested in keeping this one after all. Cuz I’ve got yooooooou, bee boy,” giggles the feminine voice followed by the sounds of a rather aggressive sounding kiss. Your eyes just about make out two fuzzy figures embraced and a very hands-on fondle: one short and yellow, one much taller and bluish purple. Both have wings... if you ever knew who they were, your mind isn’t willing to play along. Maybe you knew their names, maybe you knew... your name..."

rows.original: “Mmm, hands here Tiffy, gentle...”
rows.translation: “嗯，手放这里，蒂菲，轻一点...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, hands here Tiffy, gentle...”"

rows.original: “YesmmmMistressmmm...!”
rows.translation: “是嗯嗯女主人嗯嗯...！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“YesmmmMistressmmm...!”"

rows.original: From nowhere, you take another slap to the cheek. It stings much more than before or maybe the cloudy euphoria is weaker. The hands and movements of the two figures appear clearer and more defined, elegant and distracting.
rows.translation: 不知从哪又一巴掌抽在你脸上。这次比之前疼得多，也可能是那层混沌的欣快感减弱了。两个身影的双手与动作变得更清晰、更鲜明，优雅得令人分心。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom nowhere, you take another slap to the cheek. It stings much more than before or maybe the cloudy euphoria is weaker. The hands and movements of the two figures appear clearer and more defined, elegant and distracting."

rows.original: “Focus, slave! How damned weak is that tiny brain of yours?”
rows.translation: “集中注意，奴隶！你那颗小脑袋到底有多不中用？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Focus, slave! How damned weak is that tiny brain of yours?”"

rows.original: The voice suddenly gains a face: blue, feminine and scowling at you with harsh, orange eyes. There’s a name for that face, you’re sure of it... but whatever it is seems like some distant, blurry echo.
rows.translation: 那个声音忽然有了面孔：蓝色、女性，正用严厉的橙色双眼怒视着你。你确信这张脸有个名字...可那名字仿佛遥远而模糊的回声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe voice suddenly gains a face: blue, feminine and scowling at you with harsh, orange eyes. There’s a name for that face, you’re sure of it... but whatever it is seems like some distant, blurry echo."

rows.original: “I swear, these ‘adventure’ types just close up when you just slap them about. Is that you, slave? Some sort of roaming vigilante? Bounty hunter? Potential ruiner-of-my-plans? Whatever. Tiff, the cuffs,” mocks the blue femme, ordering her subordinate to perform with a snap of her claw-like fingers. Wait... claws. Moth. Wings. Boobs... Overseer.
rows.translation: “我发誓，这些‘冒险者’之类的家伙只要随便抽打几下就封闭自我了。你也是吗，奴隶？某种四处游荡的义警？赏金猎人？可能会毁掉我计划的人？随便吧。蒂夫，上镣铐，”蓝色女人讥讽道，利爪般的手指一打响指，命令下属行动。等等...利爪。飞蛾。翅膀。乳房...监工。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I swear, these ‘adventure’ types just close up when you just slap them about. Is that you, slave? Some sort of roaming vigilante? Bounty hunter? Potential ruiner-of-my-plans? Whatever. Tiff, the cuffs,” mocks the blue femme, ordering her subordinate to perform with a snap of her claw-like fingers. Wait... claws. Moth. Wings. Boobs... Overseer."

rows.original: You’re in the clutches of the Overseer. Uh oh. Yeah, something overseen... bad stuff. You shake your head from side to side as the euphoria melts away. Your limbs are still weak and moving anything, even your jaw, feels more like everything is ‘floating’.
rows.translation: 你落进了监工的魔掌。糟糕。对，某种被监视的...坏事。你左右摇头，欣快感渐渐消退。四肢依旧软弱无力，移动任何部位，甚至下巴，都更像是让一切“漂浮”起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re in the clutches of the Overseer. Uh oh. Yeah, something overseen... bad stuff. You shake your head from side to side as the euphoria melts away. Your limbs are still weak and moving anything, even your jaw, feels more like everything is ‘floating’."

rows.original: “Iiiiiiuhhhh...” is all you can slur, making a similar noise when the svelte bee boy pulls your hands into your lap and ties your wrists together. He pulls down on a hitherto unseen rope and binds it to the wrist-tie. He pulls on the makeshift pulley with all his bee-boy strength and manages to get your wrists to dangle far over your head.
rows.translation: “咿——呃啊...”你只能口齿不清地发出这点声音；身材纤细的蜜蜂男孩把你的双手拉到腿上绑住时，你也发出了相似的呻吟。他拉下一根此前没被注意到的绳索，将它系在捆住手腕的绳结上。他使尽蜜蜂男孩的全部力气拉动这副临时滑轮，终于让你的手腕高高悬到头顶上方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Iiiiiiuhhhh...” is all you can slur, making a similar noise when the svelte bee boy pulls your hands into your lap and ties your wrists together. He pulls down on a hitherto unseen rope and binds it to the wrist-tie. He pulls on the makeshift pulley with all his bee-boy strength and manages to get your wrists to dangle far over your head."

rows.original: “Done, Mistress,” he chirps while standing to attention.
rows.translation: “完成了，女主人，”他站得笔直，轻快地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Done, Mistress,” he chirps while standing to attention."

rows.original: The blue femme clears her throat and twirls her finger at your cheek.
rows.translation: 蓝色女人清清嗓子，用手指在你脸颊前打转。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe blue femme clears her throat and twirls her finger at your cheek."

rows.original: “Oo-oohh. Yes...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oo-oohh. Yes...”"

rows.original: The bee-boy timidly pulls his hand over his shoulder, only to let loose and backhand your other cheek. The sharp stab of skin-on-skin hurts more than the actual slap, not even enough to make you wince. He hums in frustration and rubs the back of his hand: apparently it really did hurt him more than it hurt you.
rows.translation: 蜜蜂男孩胆怯地把手拉过肩头，随后猛地放开，反手抽向你的另一侧脸颊。皮肤相撞带来的尖锐刺痛比耳光本身更疼，却还不足以让你皱眉。他沮丧地哼了一声，揉着手背：显然，这一巴掌确实让他比你更疼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bee-boy timidly pulls his hand over his shoulder, only to let loose and backhand your other cheek. The sharp stab of skin-on-skin hurts more than the actual slap, not even enough to make you wince. He hums in frustration and rubs the back of his hand: apparently it really did hurt him more than it hurt you."

rows.original: “Ehhh, it was an attempt, my sweet. Definitely an attempt. Thing is, how are you going to be the Prince of Spanklandia with such a weak form in slapology? You’ve still much to learn from the Queen.”
rows.translation: “呃，也算尝试过了，我的小甜心。绝对算一次尝试。问题是，以你如此软弱的掌掴学造诣，今后怎么成为掌掴王国的王子？你要向女王学习的还多着呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehhh, it was an attempt, my sweet. Definitely an attempt. Thing is, how are you going to be the Prince of Spanklandia with such a weak form in slapology? You’ve still much to learn from the Queen.”"

rows.original: On ‘Queen’, a nasty, quick slap hits you on the same cheek. The sting and heat from the impact flushes your face with endorphin-rich warmth, setting you into a light giggle once again. Pain feels real good right about now...
rows.translation: 说到“女王”时，一记恶毒而迅猛的耳光抽在同一侧脸颊。撞击的刺痛与热意让你面庞泛起富含内啡肽的暖流，再度令你轻声傻笑。此时此刻，疼痛的滋味实在美妙...
rows.raw: "\n\nOn ‘Queen’, a nasty, quick slap hits you on the same cheek. The sting and heat from the impact flushes your face with endorphin-rich warmth, setting you into a light giggle once again. Pain feels real good right about now..."

rows.original: “See? Needs bite and intent. That’s all for another day, however. We’re not allowed to damage these goods. So how do you want to use [pc.himHer]?” comes a direct question for the timid bee.
rows.translation: “看见了吗？需要狠劲和意图。不过那是改天的课程。我们不能损坏这些货物。那么，你想怎样使用[pc.himHer]？”她直接向胆怯的蜜蜂问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“See? Needs bite and intent. That’s all for another day, however. We’re not allowed to damage these goods. So how do you want to use [pc.himHer]?” comes a direct question for the timid bee."

rows.original: “Ummmm...”

The bee boy’s dainty pair of hands prod and poke at your extremities as if testing for something. Tivf. Tivf is... is that the name? You heard Tivf somewhere, you’re sure of it. That thought is quickly derailed as he just keeps poking, especially at your [pc.chest].
rows.translation: 蜜蜂男孩那双纤细小手在你的四肢末端戳戳碰碰，仿佛在测试什么。蒂夫。蒂夫是...是这个名字吗？你确信在哪里听过蒂夫。可这念头很快被他持续不断的戳弄打断，尤其是对你[pc.chest]的戳弄。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bee boy’s dainty pair of hands prod and poke at your extremities as if testing for something. Tivf. Tivf is... is that the name? You heard Tivf somewhere, you’re sure of it. That thought is quickly derailed as he just keeps poking, especially at your [pc.chest]."

rows.original: “Ahehe, soft. Not tough like my chest. Silly starfarer thingies. Ummmm, I would like tooooo use the mouth?” he says after a pause. A finger slips into your agape mouth and runs across the [pc.lip] as if to test it for some other purpose. rows.original: A gut-bending contraction signals that it’s time for you to give birth, and you waste no time in rushing to the nearest medical center, cradling your [pc.belly]. There, you have the full assistance of local medical personnel to help you through a process that’s typically quite painful for patients with terran heritage - like yourself. The birthing itself surprises you with its lack of pain, but the doctors are there to explain why: kaithrit have smaller skulls at birth - and more flexible bone structure that allows for their young to pass through a much smaller opening.
rows.translation: 一阵令肠胃扭曲的宫缩宣告生产时刻已到，你毫不耽搁地抱着[pc.belly]冲向最近的医疗中心。在那里，当地医护人员全力协助你完成对拥有地球人血统的患者——例如你——通常相当痛苦的生产过程。分娩几乎没有疼痛，令你大感意外，医生则解释了原因：凯斯里特出生时头骨较小，骨骼结构也更加柔韧，因此幼崽能够穿过小得多的产道。
