rows.original: Inside the hangar on Zhèng Shi you cast a wary eye over your ship, satisfied that it remains unmolested. Whatever the pirates hanging out here are doing, at least they’re not big on trying to crack your airlock. Before you take your next step, a loud bang breaks your concentration. Goosebumps thrum across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Instinctively, you hunch down, looking in the direction of Urbolg’s workshop, noting that the independent engineer isn’t there.
rows.translation: 在郑石的机库内，你谨慎打量自己的飞船，确认它依旧完好无损。无论聚集于此的海盗在做什么，至少他们不热衷于破解你的气闸。你还未迈出下一步，一声巨大的砰响打断思绪。[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]上瞬间泛起鸡皮疙瘩。你本能地伏低身体，望向乌尔博格的工坊，注意到那名独立工程师并不在那里。
rows.raw: "Inside the hangar on Zhèng Shi you cast a wary eye over your ship, satisfied that it remains unmolested. Whatever the pirates hanging out here are doing, at least they’re not big on trying to crack your airlock. Before you take your next step, a loud bang breaks your concentration. Goosebumps thrum across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Instinctively, you hunch down, looking in the direction of Urbolg’s workshop, noting that the independent engineer isn’t there."

rows.original: A hair-raising crash follows several booming gunshots. A metallic clamor precedes two small figures darting out from around a pile of scrap, short of breath and running past you on all fours - mostly, they stagger like frightened, drunken animals - as they flee from the nerve-fraying gunfire. They move much too fast for you to appraise aside from their all-black getup and mouse-like limbs.
rows.translation: 几声轰鸣枪响后传来令人毛骨悚然的撞击声。金属喧响过后，两个小小身影从一堆废料后冲出；他们上气不接下气，四肢着地从你身旁跑过——多数时候更像受惊醉兽般踉跄——躲避令人神经紧绷的枪火。他们移动得太快，你只看清全黑衣装和鼠类四肢。
rows.raw: "\n\nA hair-raising crash follows several booming gunshots. A metallic clamor precedes two small figures darting out from around a pile of scrap, short of breath and running past you on all fours - mostly, they stagger like frightened, drunken animals - as they flee from the nerve-fraying gunfire. They move much too fast for you to appraise aside from their all-black getup and mouse-like limbs."

rows.original: “Get out, ye fekken’ pests!” you hear Urbolg bellow, and another two rats scream as they dive out of the way of a turret’s shredding salvo. “Ye thought you could steal from Urbolg?” he snarls, firing off another booming shot. Squealing like wounded animals the last two rush past you with the speed of surging lightning, stopping for nothing as the stocky korgonne shuffles out from behind the mounds of discarded metal like a swirling tornado of rage about to touch down on the land.
rows.translation: “滚出去，你们这些该死害虫！”你听见乌尔博格咆哮。炮塔射出撕裂弹幕，另外两只老鼠尖叫着扑向一旁。“你们以为能从乌尔博格手里偷东西？”他怒吼着又开出震耳一枪。最后两只老鼠像受伤动物般尖叫，以涌动闪电般的速度从你身边冲过，什么也无法阻挡；敦实科尔吉人则从废金属堆后挪出，宛如即将落地的愤怒龙卷风。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Get out, ye fekken’ pests!” you hear Urbolg bellow, and another two rats scream as they dive out of the way of a turret’s shredding salvo. “Ye thought you could steal from Urbolg?” he snarls, firing off another booming shot. Squealing like wounded animals the last two rush past you with the speed of surging lightning, stopping for nothing as the stocky korgonne shuffles out from behind the mounds of discarded metal like a swirling tornado of rage about to touch down on the land."

rows.original: “Oi, new [pc.guyGirl], move over,” he says, raising his furry, oil-soaked hand while stomping past you insistently, squeezing off another deafening shot close to your [pc.ears]. He shoots into the dark, and before you mentally quip about his blind firing, you hear a shrill scream and the tell-tale concussive shock of a collapsing shield in the distance. That act of vengeance quells the anger in the fluffy mechanic. He holsters his handcannon before turning to you, frustration etched like a fresh scar on his livid features.
rows.translation: “喂，新来的[pc.guyGirl]，让开。”他说着举起沾满机油的毛手，坚持不懈地跺步经过你身边，又在[pc.ears]附近开出震耳欲聋的一枪。他朝黑暗开火；你还没来得及在心里吐槽盲射，远处便传来尖锐惨叫，以及护盾坍塌时标志性的冲击震响。这次复仇平息了毛茸机械师的怒气。他收起手炮，转向你，挫败如新鲜伤疤般刻在愤怒面孔上。

He shoots into the dark, and before you mentally quip about his blind firing, you hear a shrill scream and the tell-tale concussive shock of a collapsing shield in the distance. That act of vengeance quells the anger in the fluffy mechanic. He holsters his handcannon before turning to you, frustration etched like a fresh scar on his livid features."

rows.original: Chuckling, the self-assured mouse-thief brings the device to her face and acts like she’s presenting on a stage. “Ohh, you know... just a little tip we got from a concerned party a while back,” she quips, clears her throat, and begins narrating with exaggerated enunciation.
rows.translation: 自信满满的鼠族窃贼咯咯笑着，把设备举到面前，装出登台演说的样子。“哦，你知道的...只是我们不久前从一位关心此事的人那里得到的小提示，”她打趣道，清了清嗓子，开始用夸张清晰的发音朗读。

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele!” the cocky rodenian points at you, “Next in line to ownership of the Steele Tech megacorporation! Just our luck that a corporate stooge was walking around Zhèng Shi! Haha! And would you believe it? Not a mere stooge, but the head stooge! It took us a while to figure it out, but who else fits the bill besides you?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔！”那名趾高气扬的罗德尼安人指着你，“斯蒂尔科技巨型企业的下一任所有者！真走运，居然有个企业走狗在郑石四处闲逛！哈哈！而且你敢相信吗？还不只是个普通走狗，而是走狗头子！我们花了好一阵才弄明白，可除了你，还有谁符合这些条件？”

rows.original: They all level their batons at you, faces shining with excitement. Their usual encirclement is again in effect. The air tenses up, and you can sense the effort they exert to not jump you straight away. “Now, [pc.mister] CEO, you’re our primary mark. Now... we have your scent! Don’t worry though, this is just between you and ours, heh, as if we’d give the others a chance to capitalize! You have no idea how long we’ve gone without a score!”
rows.translation: 他们齐刷刷把警棍指向你，脸上兴奋得发亮，照例再次将你团团包围。空气骤然紧绷，你能感觉到他们正竭力克制着立刻扑上来的冲动。“那么，首席执行官[pc.mister]，你就是我们的头号目标。现在...我们记住你的气味了！不过别担心，这只是你和我们之间的事，嘿，我们怎么可能给其他人可乘之机！你根本不知道我们多久没捞到一票了！”

rows.original: A bead of sweat drips down your head looking at these rodents. There’s only small comfort in that, maybe, they won’t give out your name to the other pirates here, but that doesn’t make future encounters any easier. Maybe you can try to fix this situation? It’s something to consider.
rows.translation: 你看着这些啮齿族，额头滑下一滴冷汗。或许他们不会把你的名字透露给这里的其他海盗，这一点多少令人宽慰，但未来再次相遇也不会因此轻松半分。也许你能想办法挽回局面？这值得考虑。

It’s something to consider."

rows.original: RATCOUNTERS
rows.raw: "RATCOUNTERS"

rows.original: The next step you take, something inherently aggravating comes into view. Three black-clad figures are squatting down the corridor, thin tails weaving around hunched feet; they’re happily chatting the time away. Whilst this might be an ordinary sight anywhere else, you know those rodents are affiliated with one of the gangs here on Zhèng Shi. Before you can bail, they spot you and spring to their feet, charging in your direction. In only a few seconds they’re snickering at you, invading your personal space, and prodding for your things all over again. Geez, these runts can move fast...
rows.translation: 你刚迈出下一步，某种天生就令人恼火的景象映入眼帘。三个黑衣身影正蹲在走廊上，细长尾巴绕着蜷起的双脚摆动；他们正愉快地闲聊消磨时间。这在别处或许只是寻常一幕，可你知道这些啮齿族隶属于郑石上的某个帮派。还没来得及溜走，他们便发现你，一跃而起朝这边冲来。短短几秒后，他们已经窃笑着贴到你身边，侵犯你的私人空间，又开始四处戳探你的财物。天啊，这些小矮子跑得真快...

rows.original: From behind you hear a flurry of footfalls. Armored feet stomp against the ground and you spin around with your [pc.weapon] at the ready. You spot three rat thieves sauntering slowly up to you, having shifted gears in that split second of reaction. They lazily handle their stun batons while their long tails slash the air behind them. Just like before, they’re keeping close as they intrude upon your personal space, preventing easy escape. Where the hell do they come from?
rows.translation: 身后传来一阵密集脚步声。披甲的双脚重重踏地，你立刻转身，举起[pc.weapon]戒备。三名鼠族窃贼缓步向你走来，显然在你瞬间作出反应时便换了策略。他们懒洋洋地摆弄着电击警棍，长尾在身后划破空气。和上次一样，他们紧贴着侵入你的私人空间，堵死轻易逃脱的路线。这群家伙到底从哪冒出来的？
rows.raw: "From behind you hear a flurry of footfalls. Armored feet stomp against the ground and you spin around with your [pc.weapon] at the ready. You spot three rat thieves sauntering slowly up to you, having shifted gears in that split second of reaction. They lazily handle their stun batons while their long tails slash the air behind them. Just like before, they’re keeping close as they intrude upon your personal space, preventing easy escape. Where the hell do they come from?"

rows.original: Just before you reach another split, an electrically charged rod is swung out in front of you. You stop on your heels, nearly colliding with it before jumping back, your whole body tensing up as a snickering laughter reverberates off the walls. The hand holding the shock-stick, wearing a shining blue wristband, swells into the diminutive body of a rodent stepping out with two others.
rows.translation: 就在你抵达下一个岔口前，一根带电棍棒突然横扫到面前。你猛然停步，险些撞上它，随后向后一跃；窃笑声在墙壁间回荡，令你全身紧绷。握着电击棍、戴有闪亮蓝色腕带的那只手，连接着一个与另外两人一同现身的矮小啮齿族身体。

rows.raw: "Here you go again..."

rows.original: Not this shit again...
rows.raw: "Not this shit again..."

rows.original: The next step you take brings you into the sight of another group of mouse thieves, huddled together, furtive and vulnerable... Rats in a maze. Your approach startles them from their quiet nap. Shaking the sleepiness off, they hurriedly cut off your means of easy retreat before giving you the usual rundown. Crap.
rows.translation: 你迈出的下一步，让另一群聚在一起、鬼鬼祟祟又毫无防备的鼠族窃贼进入视野...迷宫里的老鼠。你的靠近惊醒了他们安静的小睡。他们甩去睡意，匆忙截断你轻易撤退的路线，随后照例向你念起那套说辞。该死。
rows.raw: "The next step you take brings you into the sight of another group of mouse thieves, huddled together, furtive and vulnerable... Rats in a maze. Your approach startles them from their quiet nap. Shaking the sleepiness off, they hurriedly cut off your means of easy retreat before giving you the usual rundown. Crap."

rows.original: “Rats, we’re rats... weee’rrreee the rats!” A smooth bunch of singing voices break out abruptly. You turn to see just where it’s coming from... “We prey at night, we stalk at night, we’re the rats!” They slither closer to you, punctuating their strange song and dance by smacking their electrical batons against the wall. “We’re the giant rats that make aaalll of the rules!” The rodenian girl smirks at you. Before you know it, they’ve encircled you. “Let’s see what kind of trouble we can get ourselves into!” You sigh loudly and slap a sticky hand away from your waist. God damn it.
rows.translation: “老鼠，我们是老鼠...我——们——是老鼠！”一群悦耳的歌声突然响起。你转身寻找声音究竟从何而来...“我们夜里捕猎，夜里跟踪，我们是老鼠！”他们扭动着靠近，用带电警棍敲击墙壁，为怪异的歌舞打着节拍。“我们是制定所——有规矩的巨鼠！”罗德尼安女孩冲你坏笑。回过神时，他们已经把你团团围住。“来看看咱们能惹出什么乱子！” 你大声叹气，拍开一只伸向腰间的黏手。真该死。
rows.raw: "“Rats, we’re rats... weee’rrreee the rats!” A smooth bunch of singing voices break out abruptly. You turn to see just where it’s coming from... “We prey at night, we stalk at night, we’re the rats!” They slither closer to you, punctuating their strange song and dance by smacking their electrical batons against the wall. “We’re the giant rats that make aaalll of the rules!” The rodenian girl smirks at you. Before you know it, they’ve encircled you. “Let’s see what kind of trouble we can get ourselves into!”\n\nYou sigh loudly and slap a sticky hand away from your waist. God damn it."

rows.original: A throbbing growl takes you off guard. This sound is... it’s not a sound you’d expect to hear on a station. Certainly not where you’re standing! All of a sudden, three motorbikes go racing towards you, indistinguishable helmeted figures astride them. You dive out of the way in shock as they go flying by, their... rat tails!? Whipping in the colors trailing off their bikes. Smoke fills the area as the sound dissipates, making you cough. By the time it clears, three different figures are standing in the clearing, each one a mouse-morph figure dressed in black armor. They walk up to you like nothing had just happened, pointing their batons at you. The fuck..?
rows.translation: 一阵悸动的低吼令你措手不及。这声音...不像会在空间站里听到的，至少绝不该出现在你站着的地方！突然间，三辆摩托车朝你疾驰而来，头戴头盔、难以分辨的身影跨坐其上。你惊慌地扑向一旁，任由他们飞驰而过，而他们的...老鼠尾巴！？正随着车后拖曳的彩光抽打摆动。烟雾充满四周，声响渐渐消失，呛得你咳嗽。等烟尘散去，空地上已经站着三个不同身影，每个都是身穿黑色盔甲的鼠型人。他们仿佛刚才什么也没发生般走向你，用警棍指着你。这他妈什么情况？
rows.raw: "A throbbing growl takes you off guard. This sound is... it’s not a sound you’d expect to hear on a station. Certainly not where you’re standing! All of a sudden, three motorbikes go racing towards you, indistinguishable helmeted figures astride them. You dive out of the way in shock as they go flying by, their... rat tails!? Whipping in the colors trailing off their bikes. Smoke fills the area as the sound dissipates, making you cough. By the time it clears, three different figures are standing in the clearing, each one a mouse-morph figure dressed in black armor. They walk up to you like nothing had just happened, pointing their batons at you. The fuck..?"

rows.original: Something odd up ahead catches your eye. A dapper man in a black suit wearing a strange... creepy mask pirouettes towards you, his dance perfect and rhythm elegant. He stops in front of you with a flourish, and you notice a giant mouse on his shoulder and a fancy cane in his left hand. “Into your sanctum you let them in. This wretched mischief is now coursing through your soul,” he says, tapping you coldly on the shoulder. What? He then points his cane behind you, and when you turn, three mouse-eared pirates lamely walk forward, smiling confidently. “Them filthy rodents are still coming for your soul, never to let go. They’re still coming after you, and there’s nothing y’can do,” the man’s mechanical voice comes again, ending with an AAWOAAAAH not unlike background chorus in a song. You whip around, the hairs on your neck standing, to find that he’s gone. Was he ever there? What the hell was that all about? Shit, now you have to deal with rats again!
rows.translation: 前方某个古怪身影吸引了你的注意。一名身穿黑色西装、戴着奇怪...瘆人面具的体面男子旋转着朝你舞来，舞步完美，节奏优雅。他以一个华丽动作停在面前，你注意到他肩头蹲着一只巨鼠，左手握着精美手杖。“你放任他们进入自己的圣所。这份卑劣恶作剧如今正流淌在你的灵魂里，”他说着，冰冷地用手杖敲了敲你的肩膀。什么？随后他把手杖指向你身后；转头看去，三个长着鼠耳的海盗正自信微笑着，没精打采地向前走来。 “那些肮脏啮齿族仍在追逐你的灵魂，永远不会松手。他们还在追你，而你无计可施，”男子的机械声音再次响起，最后以一声宛如歌曲伴唱的“啊嗷——”收尾。你猛地转回身，后颈汗毛倒竖，却发现他已经消失。他真的来过吗？刚才究竟是什么鬼？ 该死，现在你又得对付老鼠了！

They’re still coming after you, and there’s nothing y’can do,” the man’s mechanical voice comes again, ending with an AAWOAAAAH not unlike background chorus in a song. You whip around, the hairs on your neck standing, to find that he’s gone. Was he ever there? What the hell was that all about? Shit, now you have to deal with rats again!"

rows.original: “Hey, you don’t look like you belong here, but that’s no biggie,” says the lead rodenian girl.
rows.translation: “嘿，你看起来不属于这里，不过没什么大不了的，”领头的罗德尼安女孩说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you don’t look like you belong here, but that’s no biggie,” says the lead rodenian girl."

rows.translation: “你包里装了什么？”一个格外女性化的鼠族男孩用警棍戳了戳你的包。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What have ‘ya got in there?” A particularly femmy mouse boy pokes your bag with his baton."

rows.translation: “独立人士[pc.mister]，你是来捐款的吗？”他们异口同声、花言巧语地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here to make a donation, [pc.mister] Independent?” they all ask in flowery unison."

rows.translation: “一个奴隶为什么独自在外面走？你替谁带着什么东西吗？”其中一人贴过来问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s a slave walking around alone for? You carrying something for someone?” one says as they press into you."

rows.translation: “你是跳帮者？不...不可能。你身上一点也不像那些呆头呆脑的汗巾，”领头的鼠族女孩打趣道，毫不掩饰自己对那个帮派的厌烦。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You a jumper? Nah... you can’t be. You don’t smell like those dopey sweat-rags at all,” the lead rat girl quips, making no effort to hide her annoyance with that gang."

rows.translation: “你不是跳帮者...他们可没有那种装备！”其中一人伸出小小手指，指向你的终端和[pc.weapon]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re no jumper... They don’t have gear like that!” one points a tiny finger to your codex and [pc.weapon]."

rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re dressed like one of those stupid robo cats, but you don’t walk like one and ‘ya don’t look like a doll! Can’t fool us!” the mouse-alien quips."

rows.original: “Gems, credits, or a good scrap. Either way, it only helps us help others!” the rodenian leader proffers. “So what’ll it be, [pc.mister] CEO? Just try us, we’ll prove we mean what we say!”
rows.translation: “宝石、信用点，或者痛快打一架。不管哪种，都只会帮助我们去帮助别人！”罗德尼安首领提议道。“所以你选哪个，首席执行官[pc.mister]？尽管试试看，我们会证明自己说到做到！”

rows.translation: 确实，这次又该怎么办？
rows.raw: "\n\nIndeed, what will it be this time?"

rows.raw: "“You aren’t going anywhere scoundrel! Just pay us and we’ll leave you alone. You don’t need to get your pretty [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] hurt!”"

rows.original: “You’ll have to pay us in gems or creds if you want to go on. Don’t they say it’s better to give than receive?”
rows.translation: “想继续走，就得用宝石或信用点付钱。不是都说施比受更有福吗？”
rows.raw: "“You’ll have to pay us in gems or creds if you want to go on. Don’t they say it’s better to give than receive?”"

rows.original: “Gems or credits are fine, we’re not here to fight. It’s going to a good cause, you know!”
rows.translation: “宝石或信用点都行，我们不是来打架的。你知道，这些钱会用于善事！”
rows.raw: "“Gems or credits are fine, we’re not here to fight. It’s going to a good cause, you know!”"

rows.original: “Please, think about others worse off than you or us! We’re just trying to help people, not hurt them!”

rows.raw: "“Please, think about others worse off than you or us! We’re just trying to help people, not hurt them!”"

rows.original: “If we see you, you’re still fair game, being unaffiliated ‘n all! Least ‘til Mikky meets ‘ya and says to stop!” She points a fearless finger at you, madly blushing through her fur. “You still owe us a lot. A-anyway, if you’re feelin’ combative we could use the practice, you’re no pushover! And you’re... kinda cool I guess...”
rows.translation: “要是见到你，你依然算可以下手的目标，毕竟没有帮派关系！至少在米基见到你并下令停手前如此！”她无所畏惧地伸指指向你，毛发下脸红得厉害。“你还欠我们很多。不——不管怎样，要是你想打架，我们正好需要练习，你可不好对付！而且你...我猜还挺酷的...”

rows.original: The other two rats nod happily. “But as it stands, you’ll still be expected to make a donation if we see you!”

rows.raw: "\n\nThe other two rats nod happily. “But as it stands, you’ll still be expected to make a donation if we see you!”"

rows.original: They fold their arms, looking proud and smug all at once.
rows.translation: 他们抱起双臂，同时显得骄傲又自鸣得意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey fold their arms, looking proud and smug all at once."

rows.original: “Good, that’s settled.” You clap both hands together, then abruptly pat them each on the head. They moan and squeal all at once, louder than some euphoric affirmations you’ve heard in your life, and gladly snuggle against your palm.
rows.translation: “很好，那就说定了。”你双手一拍，随后突然挨个摸了摸他们的头。他们同时呻吟尖叫，声音比你这辈子听过的某些狂喜肯定还要响亮，并开心地依偎着你的手掌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good, that’s settled.” You clap both hands together, then abruptly pat them each on the head. They moan and squeal all at once, louder than some euphoric affirmations you’ve heard in your life, and gladly snuggle against your palm."

rows.original: You don’t linger for more than a few seconds, and when you stop, they dash away as fast as their little feet can carry, telling you in parting that they’ll get things straightened out. One can only hope that a little understanding can be ratified.
rows.translation: 你没有停留超过几秒；等你停手，他们便迈着小短腿飞快跑开，临别时告诉你会把事情理顺。只能希望一点相互理解能让双方正式和解。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t linger for more than a few seconds, and when you stop, they dash away as fast as their little feet can carry, telling you in parting that they’ll get things straightened out. One can only hope that a little understanding can be ratified."

rows.original: On the other hand, you can probably expect them and theirs to be a lot more amicable in the future!

rows.raw: "\n\nOn the other hand, you can probably expect them and theirs to be a lot more amicable in the future!"

rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re not lying, [pc.mister] CEO!” he protests, but you shrug while taking a heavy purse from him."

rows.translation: “尽管笑吧，首席执行官[pc.mister]，但你的贪婪逍遥不了多久！你会为自己的罪行付出代价，不管通过什么方式！”那个半罗德尼安

rows.original: You weigh the prizes you’ve taken, heavy with other people’s money. Satisfied with the weight of your prize, you glance at the defeated trio one last time before heading on.
rows.translation: 你掂量着夺来的奖品，其中装满别人的钱。你对收获的重量颇为满意，最后看了一眼落败的三人，随后继续前进。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou weigh the prizes you’ve taken, heavy with other people’s money. Satisfied with the weight of your prize, you glance at the defeated trio one last time before heading on."

rows.original: “You can’t hide from us, we’ll find you, and when we do you’re gonna give us all of that back and more!” the rodenian shouts, a grunt of frustration bouncing off the wall behind the bluster.
rows.translation: “你躲不过我们的，我们会找到你；到那时，你得把这一切连本带利还给我们！”罗德尼安人高喊道，虚张声势的话音后，一声懊恼闷哼撞在墙上回荡。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can’t hide from us, we’ll find you, and when we do you’re gonna give us all of that back and more!” the rodenian shouts, a grunt of frustration bouncing off the wall behind the bluster."

rows.original: Before you can reach down and claim your material prize, the rats surprise you by tossing three pouches at your feet, huffing in frustration but acting graciously about their loss nonetheless. “Take it. If that’s what you want, we’ll get it back from you one way or the other. It’s no big deal, we’ve learned a lot tangling with you!”
rows.translation: 你还没弯腰领取物质奖品，老鼠们便出人意料地将三个钱袋扔到脚边。他们沮丧地喘着粗气，却仍颇有风度地接受失败。“拿去吧。既然这是你想要的，我们迟早会从你手里夺回来。没什么大不了，跟你交手让我们学到了很多！”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can reach down and claim your material prize, the rats surprise you by tossing three pouches at your feet, huffing in frustration but acting graciously about their loss nonetheless. “Take it. If that’s what you want, we’ll get it back from you one way or the other. It’s no big deal, we’ve learned a lot tangling with you!”"

rows.original: The rodenian grins widely. “We’ve made plenty from others recently, all thanks to you.”
rows.translation: 罗德尼安人咧嘴大笑。“最近我们从别人那里赚了不少，全都多亏你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rodenian grins widely. “We’ve made plenty from others recently, all thanks to you.”"

rows.original: Amused, you take their offerings and stand. The packs are laden with loot, and each one is a financial burden in its own way.
rows.translation: 你觉得有趣，拿起他们献出的东西站起身。袋子里塞满战利品，每一个都有着属于自己的沉重经济分量。
rows.raw: "\n\nAmused, you take their offerings and stand. The packs are laden with loot, and each one is a financial burden in its own way."

rows.translation: “很快再见，首席执行官[pc.mister]！”罗德尼安人吐出舌头，用两根手指比出“V”字。另外两人只是微笑着抱起双臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“See you soon, [pc.mister] CEO!” the rodenian sticks her tongue out, making a ‘V’ sign with two fingers. The other two simply smile, folding their arms now."

rows.raw: "You inhale so deeply that you look several pounds heavier, then let it go. The exhausted and groaning mouse-pirates look up to you nervously, just in time to see you turn and walk away. You’ll have to make up that loss somehow, but dammit they better appreciate this..."

rows.original: They watch you go, not sure what to feel besides lucky.
rows.translation: 他们望着你离去，除了庆幸外，不知道该作何感想。
rows.raw:
"

They watch you go, not sure what to feel besides lucky.

"

rows.original: The rat pirates expect you to take your reward from them the way they would have done to you. Perhaps they’re expecting you to have your way with them and force them into a variety of lewd and lascivious acts.
rows.translation: 鼠族海盗以为你会像他们对你那样，从他们身上拿走报酬。或许他们还以为你会随意玩弄他们，强迫他们做出各种淫荡放纵的行为。
rows.raw: "The rat pirates expect you to take your reward from them the way they would have done to you. Perhaps they’re expecting you to have your way with them and force them into a variety of lewd and lascivious acts."

rows.original: . However, they claim they’re doing what they do to help others. Perhaps they really care about the people they’re helping, perhaps they do give to others what they steal. It’s deplorable, but not something you can’t understand. Since time immemorial and all that...
rows.translation: 。不过，他们声称自己所做的一切都是为了帮助别人。也许他们真的在乎那些受帮助的人，也许他们确实会把偷来的东西交给别人。虽然可耻，却并非完全无法理解。毕竟自古以来都是如此之类的...
rows.raw: ". However, they claim they’re doing what they do to help others. Perhaps they really care about the people they’re helping, perhaps they do give to others what they steal. It’s deplorable, but not something you can’t understand. Since time immemorial and all that..."

rows.original: Shaking your head, you store your [pc.weapon] and turn away from them. Confused and groggy moans soon follow. “W-what are you doing? Are you really just going..?” the rodenian girl asks.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，收起[pc.weapon]，背对他们离开。身后很快传来困惑而昏沉的呻吟。“你——你在做什么？真就这么走了..？”罗德尼安女孩问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShaking your head, you store your [pc.weapon] and turn away from them. Confused and groggy moans soon follow. “W-what are you doing? Are you really just going..?” the rodenian girl asks."

rows.original: “I don’t need what you’ve got, I’ve got things to see and people to do! Later!” you give them a ditzy wave.
rows.translation: “我不需要你们的东西，我还有风景要看，还有人要上！回见！”你傻兮兮地挥手告别。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t need what you’ve got, I’ve got things to see and people to do! Later!” you give them a ditzy wave."

rows.original: “Keep what you have, I don’t need it,” you say, then look over your shoulder. “Besides, there are others who need it, right?”
rows.translation: “东西留着吧，我不需要，”你说着，回头望去。“再说，确实还有其他人需要，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Keep what you have, I don’t need it,” you say, then look over your shoulder. “Besides, there are others who need it, right?”"

rows.original: A chorus of confused and astonished gasps reaches you from behind, and a very faint ‘thank you’ too. Hopefully they’ll remember this!
rows.translation: 身后传来一片困惑惊讶的喘息，其中还有一声极轻的“谢谢”。希望他们能记住这件事！
rows.raw: "\n\nA chorus of confused and astonished gasps reaches you from behind, and a very faint ‘thank you’ too. Hopefully they’ll remember this!"

rows.original: “I’m not in the mood, and besides, I just saw a cute bunny walk by over there. See ‘ya, sweeties!”
rows.translation: “我没兴致，而且刚才还看见一只可爱兔子从那边经过。回见啦，小可爱们！”
rows.raw: "“I’m not in the mood, and besides, I just saw a cute bunny walk by over there. See ‘ya, sweeties!”"

rows.original: “I’m not interested in what you have. Carry on, but know that I’m not going to just give up what I have without a fight.”
rows.translation: “我对你们的东西没兴趣。继续做你们的事吧，但要知道，我不会不经反抗就交出自己的财物。”
rows.raw: "“I’m not interested in what you have. Carry on, but know that I’m not going to just give up what I have without a fight.”"

rows.original: Doubtless having expected worse, they murmur “Huh?”, blinking several times when you look over your shoulder. They slowly rise to their feet, hopefully as thankful as they are confused. Reticent gasps fade into the background noise, and you hear what you’d like to imagine as grateful chatter. Perhaps this is working?
rows.translation: 他们显然以为会遭遇更糟的事；你回头时，他们低声发出“啊？”，连续眨了几次眼。他们慢慢站起，希望心中感激与困惑一样多。迟疑的喘息消失在背景噪声中，你听见了愿意想象成感激交谈的声音。或许这办法正在奏效？
rows.raw: "\n\nDoubtless having expected worse, they murmur “Huh?”, blinking several times when you look over your shoulder. They slowly rise to their feet, hopefully as thankful as they are confused. Reticent gasps fade into the background noise, and you hear what you’d like to imagine as grateful chatter. Perhaps this is working?"

rows.original: Even though they’d made no attempt to turn you on, you crumple to your knees under the debilitating effects of arousal. Mousey rogues jeer, collapsing and holstering their weapons as they saunter towards you. Unabashedly smug, those runts... Your throat rumbles with a rolling groan as you touch yourself shamelessly, making a vain attempt to use your unsated need as distraction from the fact you’re about to be robbed.
rows.translation: 尽管他们根本没想挑起你的欲火，你还是在难以忍受的情欲作用下跪倒在地。那些鼠辈恶棍一边嘲笑，一边收起武器、插回枪套，慢悠悠地朝你走来。真是一群毫不掩饰、得意忘形的小矮子...你喉咙里滚出低沉呻吟，毫无羞耻地抚弄自己，徒劳地试图用未获满足的欲望分散注意，不去想自己马上就要遭到洗劫。

rows.original: You undo the pack where you keep your most valuable finds. The rodents inch closer, standing on their toes, and gaze down into your bag. You give her a kiss, earning a throaty murmur of desire - and feeling her stiffening in her pants, prodding your thigh.

rows.original: “-And she means, um, do you... have like, a place for our kid? Doc Mom sleeps in her lab, and I just rent a capsule when I’m on station. I don’t want to have to bum on Her Eminence Mom for a place to stay and raise little ‘uns, you know? She doesn’t... approve of our career choices.”
rows.translation: “——她的意思是，呃，你...有没有地方安置我们的孩子？医生妈妈睡在实验室里，而我在空间站时只租一间胶囊舱。我不想为了住处和抚养小家伙而去投靠‘尊贵的妈妈’。她不...赞同我们的职业选择，你懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“-And she means, um, do you... have like, a place for our kid? Doc Mom sleeps in her lab, and I just rent a capsule when I’m on station. I don’t want to have to bum on Her Eminence Mom for a place to stay and raise little ‘uns, you know? She doesn’t... approve of our career choices.”"

rows.original: You nod along. “I have a nursery back on Tavros, just for this sort of thing. You can send her there.”
rows.translation: 你点点头。“我在塔夫罗斯有一间育婴室，正是为这种情况准备的。你可以把她送去那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod along. “I have a nursery back on Tavros, just for this sort of thing. You can send her there.”"

rows.original: “Perfect!” Sela smiles. “And Tavros isn’t all that far away. Whenever I’m not busy working for my mom here, I can be there doing... mom things. I guess I’ll have to figure out what those are.”
rows.translation: “太好了！”塞拉笑道。“而且塔夫罗斯也不算太远。只要我没忙着替这里的妈妈工作，就可以去那里做些...妈妈该做的事。我想我得先弄清楚那些事是什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perfect!” Sela smiles. “And Tavros isn’t all that far away. Whenever I’m not busy working for my mom here, I can be there doing... mom things. I guess I’ll have to figure out what those are.”"

rows.original: Dr. Teyaal tuts. “Oh, there’s a Peacekeeper office right on that station. I have so many warrants out for me that I’ll have to be smuggled aboard in a briefcase just to visit my grand-daughter.”
rows.translation: 特娅尔医生啧了一声。“哦，那个空间站上就有一间维和官办公室。我身上背着太多通缉令，想去探望孙女的话，恐怕得装在公文包里偷运上船。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. Teyaal tuts. “Oh, there’s a Peacekeeper office right on that station. I have so many warrants out for me that I’ll have to be smuggled aboard in a briefcase just to visit my grand-daughter.”"

rows.original: Sela grins and takes your hand, leading you back to her favorite little love hotel down the lane. rows.original: Tivf sniggers at some hidden meaning. “Sorry. She’s... exactly what I was told to expect from starfarers: she is cruel and sadistic, loves to take advantage of every slave she can get her wicked hands on. Nothing is too sacred to violate, nor too taboo to indulge in. If she sees someone as attractive as you, I know she’d go for you in a heartbeat! If she does, don’t struggle: she likes it most when she has to work for her play.”

rows.original: The zil shrugs. “Somewhere in the mine, I guess? She’s been ‘working’ so much lately, sometimes for days at a time. She usually works in the deepest parts - at least, that’s what she says, while making me explore hers. If you want to find her, and I can’t imagine why you would, you’re on your own exploring the mines. I’ve never been down there, and from what Mistress Maike tells me, I don’t want to.”
rows.translation: 泽尔人耸了耸肩。“我猜在矿区的某个地方？她最近一直‘工作’得很勤快，有时候一去就是好几天。她通常在最深处工作——至少，她让我探索她的最深处时是这么说的。要是你想找她，虽然我完全想不通你为什么会想，你只能自己探索矿井了。我从没下去过，而且听迈克女主人说完以后，我一点也不想去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil shrugs. “Somewhere in the mine, I guess? She’s been ‘working’ so much lately, sometimes for days at a time. She usually works in the deepest parts - at least, that’s what she says, while making me explore hers. If you want to find her, and I can’t imagine why you would, you’re on your own exploring the mines. I’ve never been down there, and from what Mistress Maike tells me, I don’t want to.”"

rows.original: “The other slaves?” Tivf echoes back at you after your question. “Mistress Maike keeps me separate from them... calls them dirty and barbaric. I say, if that’s so, she should take better care of them... but she never listens to my advice.”

Landed in a snowdrift.” Urbolg holds up his metal arm, flexing the whirring servos in anger. “She was on me in seconds, all teeth and claws. I was fucked, and I knew it.”
rows.translation: “他妈的当然没有。俺压根儿没机会。确实追踪到一只野兽，甚至用长矛把她捅得挺狠。”他模仿着猛烈向下刺击的动作。“可当你与体型十倍于你的东西面对面时，长矛也就跟牙签差不多。俺甚至没能拔出来再刺一下。那畜生只是耸了下身子，就把俺甩出十到十五英尺远。俺落进了雪堆里。”厄博格举起金属手臂，愤怒地弯曲嗡嗡作响的伺服机构。“她几秒内就扑到俺身上，牙齿和爪子全招呼过来。俺完蛋了，自己也清楚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fek no. I never stood a chance. Managed to track one of the beasts, ye, even stuck her pretty good with my spear.” He mimics a violent, downward stabbing motion. “Course when yer face ta face with something ten times your size, your spear might as well be a toothpick. I never managed to pull it out for another strike. The beast threw me a good ten or fifteen feet with a shrug. Landed in a snowdrift.” Urbolg holds up his metal arm, flexing the whirring servos in anger. “She was on me in seconds, all teeth and claws. I was fucked, and I knew it.”"

rows.original: Listening attentively, you ask how he survived.
rows.translation: 你认真听着，问他是如何活下来的。
rows.raw: "\n\nListening attentively, you ask how he survived."

rows.original: “Same way anybody does, swallowing all the terror and pain for a chance to spit in the devil’s eye one last time.” Urbolg punches the air. “I grabbed the beastie by the tongue before she could get her jaws around my head, and I twisted for everything in me little arms. Shoulda heard the pop it made. Sweeter than a suula symphony. Course all that did was piss ‘er off. By that point the left half of my face was a mask of blood, and there’s not much ta do when dagger-sized teeth are sawing your arm in half. I mighta took a couple swings with my other hand, but what’s that gonna do against thousands of pounds of monster?”
rows.translation: “跟所有人一样，把恐惧和痛苦全咽下去，换取最后一次朝魔鬼眼睛吐口水的机会。”厄博格一拳挥向空中。“那小畜生还没用嘴咬住俺的脑袋，俺就抓住了她的舌头，用俺这双小胳膊的全部力量猛扭。你真该听听那声脆响。比苏拉人的交响曲还悦耳。当然，那只让她更生气。那时候俺左半边脸已经成了血面具，而当匕首般大小的牙齿把手臂锯成两半时，你也没什么能做的。俺可能用另一只手挥了几拳，可面对几千磅重的怪物，那又能有什么用？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Same way anybody does, swallowing all the terror and pain for a chance to spit in the devil’s eye one last time.” Urbolg punches the air. “I grabbed the beastie by the tongue before she could get her jaws around my head, and I twisted for everything in me little arms. Shoulda heard the pop it made. Sweeter than a suula symphony. Course all that did was piss ‘er off. By that point the left half of my face was a mask of blood, and there’s not much ta do when dagger-sized teeth are sawing your arm in half. I mighta took a couple swings with my other hand, but what’s that gonna do against thousands of pounds of monster?”"

rows.original: “Nothing,” you admit.
rows.translation: “什么用都没有。”你承认道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nothing,” you admit."

rows.original: Urbolg nods gruffly, pulling his flask for another swig. He doesn’t offer any for you this time. “Twas about halfway bled out and down one hand when that cursed bear slumped over into the snow. I didn’t know what happened. Figured I was already dead or worse. Last thing I saw was a laquine standing over me toting a rifle about twice her size. I didn’t know what the fuck she was saying, but she screamed and hollered up a storm while I lost consciousness.”
rows.translation: 厄博格粗声点头，又拿出酒壶喝了一口。这次他没递给你。“俺大概流掉一半血、也没了一只手时，那头该死的熊突然倒进雪里。俺根本不知道发生了什么。还以为自己已经死了，或是更糟。俺最后看到的是一个拉奎因人站在身旁，扛着一把差不多有她两倍大的步枪。俺听不懂她他妈在说什么，但俺失去意识时，她一直大喊大叫，闹得天翻地覆。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUrbolg nods gruffly, pulling his flask for another swig. He doesn’t offer any for you this time. “Twas about halfway bled out and down one hand when that cursed bear slumped over into the snow. I didn’t know what happened. Figured I was already dead or worse. Last thing I saw was a laquine standing over me toting a rifle about twice her size. I didn’t know what the fuck she was saying, but she screamed and hollered up a storm while I lost consciousness.”"

rows.original: The korgonne smirks at you. “And she hauled my sorry ass in for medical treatment, I guess. Woke up in her ship with a stump below the elbow, one good eye, and a translator strapped around my neck. Tried to fight my way out once, before I passed out. If ye can believe it, I was a bit of a savage back then. Thought the core magics would corrupt me.” He glances to his arm and sighs. “Twas about half right about that, truth be told.”
rows.translation: 科尔贡人冲你坏笑。“然后她大概把俺这条烂命拖回去治疗了。醒来时，俺肘部以下只剩残肢，一只眼睛还能用，脖子上绑着翻译器。俺曾试着一路打出去一次，然后又昏过去了。你要是信得过，俺当年还挺野蛮。以为核心世界的魔法会腐化俺。”他看了看手臂，叹了口气。“说实话，倒也对了一半。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe korgonne smirks at you. “And she hauled my sorry ass in for medical treatment, I guess. Woke up in her ship with a stump below the elbow, one good eye, and a translator strapped around my neck. Tried to fight my way out once, before I passed out. If ye can believe it, I was a bit of a savage back then. Thought the core magics would corrupt me.” He glances to his arm and sighs. “Twas about half right about that, truth be told.”"

rows.original: You ask him why he stayed instead of going home, if he was that worried about corruption.
rows.translation: 你问他，既然如此担心被腐化，为什么不回家，反而留下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him why he stayed instead of going home, if he was that worried about corruption."

rows.original: “Didn’t have much choice.” He barks out a bawdy laugh. “When ye wake up in a pirate cruiser, ye can either chip in and earn a share or get sold off into slavery. Me? I chipped in, and I chipped in hard.” He wiggles his fingers. “Once they calmed me down and stuffed a new hand on me stump, I got put to work cleaning out under the engines, reactors, and anywhere else too small or dirty for a bigger pirate to bother with. It’s how I got me start, bein’ an artificer.”
rows.translation: “没什么选择。”他发出粗俗的大笑。“当你在海盗巡洋舰上醒来时，要么出力赚取自己的份额，要么被卖去当奴隶。俺？俺出了力，而且拼命出力。”他动了动手指。“他们让俺冷静下来，给残肢装上一只新手后，俺便被派去清理引擎、反应堆下方，以及其他对大个子海盗来说太窄或太脏、不值得钻进去的地方。俺就是这样起步，成了一名巧匠。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Didn’t have much choice.” He barks out a bawdy laugh. “When ye wake up in a pirate cruiser, ye can either chip in and earn a share or get sold off into slavery. Me? I chipped in, and I chipped in hard.” He wiggles his fingers. “Once they calmed me down and stuffed a new hand on me stump, I got put to work cleaning out under the engines, reactors, and anywhere else too small or dirty for a bigger pirate to bother with. It’s how I got me start, bein’ an artificer.”"

rows.original: Continue
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Continue"

rows.original: Artificer?
rows.translation: 巧匠？
rows.raw: "Artificer?"

rows.original: “So you’ve just been trapped onboard all this time?”
rows.translation: “所以你一直被困在船上？”
rows.raw: "“So you’ve just been trapped onboard all this time?”"

rows.original: Urbolg nearly doubles over cackling. “Fek no! Besides the whole owing \[REDACTED\] my life thing, I developed a... how do you say... a taste for it. I saw more miracles in my first week in space than our tribe’s wildest legends could’ve prepared me for. The vastness of space. Lethal wounds knitted into healthy flesh in minutes. The feeling of opening a new eye after finally adjusting to the raw, empty socket.” He gestures at the hangar. “Wide open spaces of gleaming metal built to house majestic vessels, each more than capable of leveling a korgonne hold. Once I’d seen... this, I knew I couldn’t ever go back to me old life.”
rows.translation: 厄博格笑得几乎弯下腰。“他妈的当然不是！除了俺欠\[已编辑\]一条命这回事，俺还逐渐...怎么说来着...喜欢上了这种生活。俺在太空的第一个星期见到的奇迹，比部落最狂野的传说所能让俺准备好的还多。太空的浩瀚。致命伤口在几分钟内重新长成健康血肉。终于适应赤裸空洞的眼窝后，睁开新眼睛的感觉。”他朝机库挥手示意。“闪亮金属构成的广阔空间，用来容纳雄伟舰船，每一艘都有能力夷平一座科尔贡要塞。见过...这一切后，俺知道自己再也回不去从前的生活了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUrbolg nearly doubles over cackling. “Fek no! Besides the whole owing \\[REDACTED\\] my life thing, I developed a... how do you say... a taste for it. I saw more miracles in my first week in space than our tribe’s wildest legends could’ve prepared me for. The vastness of space. Lethal wounds knitted into healthy flesh in minutes. The feeling of opening a new eye after finally adjusting to the raw, empty socket.” He gestures at the hangar. “Wide open spaces of gleaming metal built to house majestic vessels, each more than capable of leveling a korgonne hold. Once I’d seen... this, I knew I couldn’t ever go back to me old life.”"

rows.original: You nod understandingly.
rows.translation: 你理解地点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod understandingly."

rows.original: “Course I did try an’ go back to visit once.” Urbolg snorts, ears swiveling back in irritation. “Couldn’t even get into the hold. The guards damn near tried to kill me.” He flashes his fangs. “Called me ‘ghost devil’. I suppose I can’t blame them. The artificial eye I was packin’ back then glowed hot as a sun’s flame, and me hand was a lot more primitive lookin’ - practically skeletal. Hard to believe I used ta be like that.” Another swig of whiskey soothes the korgonne’s anger into sullenness. “Never got ta see me mother or sire. Just tossed a letter and a few trinkets I hand-forged for them on the floor and put it all behind me.”
rows.translation: “当然，俺确实试过回去探望一次。”厄博格哼了一声，耳朵恼火地向后转。“俺甚至进不了要塞。守卫差点想杀了俺。”他露出尖牙。“管俺叫‘幽灵恶魔’。俺也不能怪他们。俺当时装的义眼亮得像太阳火焰，手也比现在原始得多，看起来简直就是骨架。很难相信俺以前是那副模样。”又一口威士忌将科尔贡人的怒火安抚成了阴郁。“没能见到俺的母亲或父亲。只是把一封信和几件亲手锻造给他们的小玩意扔在地上，然后将这一切抛到脑后。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Course I did try an’ go back to visit once.” Urbolg snorts, ears swiveling back in irritation. “Couldn’t even get into the hold. The guards damn near tried to kill me.” He flashes his fangs. “Called me ‘ghost devil’. I suppose I can’t blame them. The artificial eye I was packin’ back then glowed hot as a sun’s flame, and me hand was a lot more primitive lookin’ - practically skeletal. Hard to believe I used ta be like that.” Another swig of whiskey soothes the korgonne’s anger into sullenness. “Never got ta see me mother or sire. Just tossed a letter and a few trinkets I hand-forged for them on the floor and put it all behind me.”"

rows.original: “Awww, that’s so saaad!” You throw your arms around the stout dog-man and squeeze him into a tight hug, uncaring if it makes you smell like grease and sweat. “You poor boy!”
rows.translation: “啊啊啊，太可怜了！”你张开双臂紧紧抱住敦实的犬人，毫不在意自己会因此沾上油脂与汗味。“可怜的孩子！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awww, that’s so saaad!” You throw your arms around the stout dog-man and squeeze him into a tight hug, uncaring if it makes you smell like grease and sweat. “You poor boy!”"

rows.original: “Shit.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit.”"

rows.original: “My condolences,” you say, putting your hand on his shoulder and squeezing reassuringly. “That’s a tough pill to swallow.”
rows.translation: “请节哀。”你说着将手放在他肩上，安慰地捏了捏。“这件事很难接受。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My condolences,” you say, putting your hand on his shoulder and squeezing reassuringly. “That’s a tough pill to swallow.”"

rows.original: “If you forge half as well as you fight, I’m sure your mom and dad were brawling over your gifts later.” You offer, “Besides, I know I’d rather my kid be some kind of demon-blessed immortal than dead. I’m sure they feel the same way.”
rows.translation: “如果你的锻造本领有战斗本领的一半好，我相信你爸妈之后肯定会为争抢礼物打起来。”你接着说，“况且，比起孩子死去，我宁愿自己的孩子成为受恶魔祝福的不死者。我相信他们也会这么想。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you forge half as well as you fight, I’m sure your mom and dad were brawling over your gifts later.” You offer, “Besides, I know I’d rather my kid be some kind of demon-blessed immortal than dead. I’m sure they feel the same way.”"

rows.original: “You tried. That’s more than most.”
rows.translation: “你努力过了。这已经胜过大多数人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You tried. That’s more than most.”"

rows.original: “Right.” The fluffy mechanic clears his throat. “So that’s me story. Did some dumb shit, paid for it, and got handed the keys to the universe. Now I do whatever the fek I want, which for right now means working some of the sweetest mechanical magic you’ll ever see.” He glances around to make sure nobody else is within earshot. “And between you and me, the sex ‘round these parts ain’t bad neither.”
rows.translation: “好吧。”毛茸茸的技师清了清嗓子。“这就是俺的故事。干了蠢事，付出代价，然后拿到了通往宇宙的钥匙。现在俺想干什么就干什么，而眼下就意味着施展你这辈子见过最棒的机械魔法。”他环顾四周，确认没人能听见。“你知俺知，这地方的性爱也不赖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right.” The fluffy mechanic clears his throat. “So that’s me story. Did some dumb shit, paid for it, and got handed the keys to the universe. Now I do whatever the fek I want, which for right now means working some of the sweetest mechanical magic you’ll ever see.” He glances around to make sure nobody else is within earshot. “And between you and me, the sex ‘round these parts ain’t bad neither.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Why do you call yourself an artificer?”
rows.translation: “你为什么称自己为巧匠？”
rows.raw: "“Why do you call yourself an artificer?”"

rows.original: Urbolg leans back cautiously and stares at you out of the corner of his eye. “Ain’t it obvious? That’s what I am!” He slaps himself in the chest. “Your kind... you call all your machines and your magic words like ‘technology’ and ‘science,’ but the truth is, that’s just wizardry by another name. Me? I might not understand every little magical law that governs these wonders, but I’ve learned to work on ‘em, maintain ‘em, and sometimes even squeeze ‘em for a little extra oomph. What better title than artificer is there?”
rows.translation: 厄博格谨慎地向后靠去，用眼角盯着你。“这还不明显吗？因为俺就是！”他拍了拍自己的胸膛。“你们这些人...把所有机器和魔法称作‘技术’和‘科学’之类的词，但事实是，那不过是换了个名字的巫术。俺？或许无法理解支配这些奇迹的每一条细小魔法法则，但俺已经学会修理、维护它们，有时甚至能再挤出一点额外的劲头。还有什么头衔比巧匠更合适？”
rows.raw: "\n\nUrbolg leans back cautiously and stares at you out of the corner of his eye. “Ain’t it obvious? That’s what I am!” He slaps himself in the chest. “Your kind... you call all your machines and your magic words like ‘technology’ and ‘science,’ but the truth is, that’s just wizardry by another name. Me? I might not understand every little magical law that governs these wonders, but I’ve learned to work on ‘em, maintain ‘em, and sometimes even squeeze ‘em for a little extra oomph. What better title than artificer is there?”"

rows.original: You point out that science is hardly magic.
rows.translation: 你指出科学绝不是什么魔法。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou point out that science is hardly magic."

rows.original: “Isn’t it?” The scruffy dog-man tilts his head, eyes twinkling.
rows.translation: “难道不是吗？”蓬乱的犬人歪着脑袋，双眼闪亮。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Isn’t it?” The scruffy dog-man tilts his head, eyes twinkling."

rows.original: “It isn’t.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It isn’t.”"

rows.original: “So yer saying it isn’t magic, but... isn’t magic just understanding those invisible forces that bind together our universe and whatnot, tweaking ‘em in just the right way to accomplish something miraculous?” Urbolg seems to be holding back a giggle.
rows.translation: “所以你说那不是魔法，可是...魔法不就是理解那些将宇宙之类的东西结合在一起的无形力量，再以恰到好处的方式调整它们，完成某种奇迹吗？”厄博格似乎正忍着笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So yer saying it isn’t magic, but... isn’t magic just understanding those invisible forces that bind together our universe and whatnot, tweaking ‘em in just the right way to accomplish something miraculous?” Urbolg seems to be holding back a giggle."

rows.original: Considering how it functions in most fantasy holos, you admit that it seems an apt description.
rows.translation: 考虑到多数奇幻全息作品中的魔法运作方式，你承认这个描述似乎很恰当。
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering how it functions in most fantasy holos, you admit that it seems an apt description."

rows.original: “That description is just as apt for yer science boys and gals, spendin’ all day studying arcane formulae and physics to wring a few extra Watts into a laser pistol. And don’t tell me that the warp gates that stitch this universe together ain’t the product of some black magic. Somebody musta traded their heart to a demon for the keys to that puzzle. Just ‘cause core magic’s a bit more finicky than the stuff of legend don’t make it not be magic.”
rows.translation: “这个描述同样适合你们那些科学男和科学女，他们整天研究玄奥公式与物理，只为了给激光手枪多榨出几瓦功率。别跟俺说把这个宇宙缝在一起的跃迁门不是什么黑魔法。肯定有人把心脏卖给恶魔，才换来解开谜题的钥匙。核心世界的魔法比传说中的东西挑剔一些，并不代表它就不是魔法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That description is just as apt for yer science boys and gals, spendin’ all day studying arcane formulae and physics to wring a few extra Watts into a laser pistol. And don’t tell me that the warp gates that stitch this universe together ain’t the product of some black magic. Somebody musta traded their heart to a demon for the keys to that puzzle. Just ‘cause core magic’s a bit more finicky than the stuff of legend don’t make it not be magic.”"

rows.original: <i>“That’s...
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“That’s... "

rows.original: like, a super smart way to think about it!
rows.translation: 就像是，超级聪明的思考方式！
rows.raw: "like, a super smart way to think about it!"

rows.original: a fair point.
rows.translation: 确实有道理。
rows.raw: "a fair point."

rows.original: ” You concede that discussion but raise another, “What about psionic powers? There seem to be more psychics every year.”
rows.translation: ”你在这个问题上让步，又提出另一点：“灵能力量呢？通灵者似乎一年比一年多。”
rows.raw: "” You concede that discussion but raise another, “What about psionic powers? There seem to be more psychics every year.”"

rows.original: Urbolg winces. “The kind of magic I don’t want to fekken’ be around. Don’t need nobody else rootin’ around in me head or making me feel a certain way just ‘cause they want me to. Scrap that. I got word there’s some designs out there to block that sort of power. You can bet yer ass I’ll be building some as soon as I can get my hands on the components. Just gotta... ya know... get the creds together and find a source who deals in ultra-rare materials. Not real easy.” He waves his hand dismissively. “The important thing is the regular, everyday magic can deal with it.”
rows.translation: 厄博格皱了皱脸。“那种魔法俺他妈一点都不想靠近。俺不需要别人钻进脑袋翻找，或只因为他们想，就让俺产生某种感觉。去他的。俺听说外头有些设计能阻挡那类力量。你尽管赌上屁股，只要俺拿到组件，就会立刻造几个。只需要...你懂的...凑齐信用点，再找到经营超稀有材料的货源。这可不容易。”他不以为意地挥挥手。“重要的是，普通的日常魔法能对付它。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUrbolg winces. “The kind of magic I don’t want to fekken’ be around. Don’t need nobody else rootin’ around in me head or making me feel a certain way just ‘cause they want me to. Scrap that. I got word there’s some designs out there to block that sort of power. You can bet yer ass I’ll be building some as soon as I can get my hands on the components. Just gotta... ya know... get the creds together and find a source who deals in ultra-rare materials. Not real easy.” He waves his hand dismissively. “The important thing is the regular, everyday magic can deal with it.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You glance at Urbolg’s belt.
rows.translation: 你瞥向厄博格的腰带。
rows.raw: "You glance at Urbolg’s belt."

rows.original: “Your shield is really like, super strong, isn’t it?”
rows.translation: “你的护盾真的非常非常强，对吧？”
rows.raw: " “Your shield is really like, super strong, isn’t it?”"

rows.original: “Nice shield.”
rows.translation: “不错的护盾。”
rows.raw: " “Nice shield.”"

rows.original: “You’ve got a really nice shield. Where’d you get it?”
rows.translation: “你的护盾真不错。是从哪里弄来的？”
rows.raw: "“You’ve got a really nice shield. Where’d you get it?”"

rows.original: “So did you make that shield yourself or peel it off some unlucky sap?”
rows.translation: “所以那面护盾是你自己做的，还是从哪个倒霉蛋身上扒下来的？”

rows.original: You make your way over to her. “Did you need something?” You ask, trying your best not to seem confused. She pushes herself away from the wall before responding. “Yeah, your money.” Before you can prepare for a fight, she speaks again. “Wait wait wait, that came out wrong. I mean, I do want your money, but this isn’t a robbery. I have some things that might interest you. I’m trying to sell you stuff. Sorry, I’m still new to all of this.” Is that her idea of a sales pitch: call you over and say she needs your money? She must really be in dire straits if these are her salesmen skills. “Alright, what are you trying to sell me?” You ask, obviously irritated by her little blunder. “Well you are obviously new here, I thought you might want a bit of a boost before going into the mines.” At that she extends one arm outward and shows you the inside of her coat. Under the coat she is wearing a tank top that barely covers her D cup breasts and stops above her belly button, Down below, she is wearing a purple skirt that shows off most of her thighs but keeps her nethers covered. Her legs are slender and adorned with long, pink socks sticking out from beneath black high heels. Her choice in apparel is, however, less eye-catching than the other things she had hidden behind the coat. On the inside of the coat is a variety of syringes, pills, bags of powder, and what looks like an inhaler all held in place by loops sewn into the cloth. “Are- are you trying to sell me drugs?” “Relax, they’re safe. Well, they won’t kill you, usually. Fuck I am bad at this. Ok, so yes, these are drugs, obviously. I have stimulants, boosters, psychedelics, and a fair amount of other stuff that you can’t just buy at a pharmacy.” She thinks for a second before continuing. “Well some of them you can, but it would take a prescription and... Look, you’re new. If you are here to mine, it is backbreaking work. If you are here to fight, that is also backbreaking work. What I am selling can help you. It’s all safe. I test all my stuff thoroughly before I sell it to anyone.” “Alright, do you just offer drugs to anyone who comes by? This seems a bit suspicious. What if you are trying to poison me? Who even are you?” “Oh, right. My name is Vivi. I uhh, well I’m sort of a slave here. Sort of.” She tugs at a thin metallic collar around her neck for emphasis. “My skills are intellectual, so I’m mostly safe from being drugged with anything I didn’t make, or forced to do hard labor. I uhh, look, it’s awful here, just awful, but I have enough freedom to maybe help someone who looks like they might bring it all down. If not then it’s just business and the bosses want money, it’s that simple. I can give you a free sample if you want. Give you a taste of what is on offer.” Well she has pled her case as well as she is able, are you interested in her homebrew meds?

rows.raw: " You make your way over to her. “Did you need something?” You ask, trying your best not to seem confused. She pushes herself away from the wall before responding. “Yeah, your money.” Before you can prepare for a fight, she speaks again. “Wait wait wait, that came out wrong. I mean, I do want your money, but this isn’t a robbery. I have some things that might interest you. I’m trying to sell you stuff. Sorry, I’m still new to all of this.” Is that her idea of a sales pitch: call you over and say she needs your money? She must really be in dire straits if these are her salesmen skills. “Alright, what are you trying to sell me?” You ask, obviously irritated by her little blunder. “Well you are obviously new here, I thought you might want a bit of a boost before going into the mines.” At that she extends one arm outward and shows you the inside of her coat. Under the coat she is wearing a tank top that barely covers her D cup breasts and stops above her belly button, Down below, she is wearing a purple skirt that shows off most of her thighs but keeps her nethers covered. Her legs are slender and adorned with long, pink socks sticking out from beneath black high heels. Her choice in apparel is, however, less eye-catching than the other things she had hidden behind the coat. On the inside of the coat is a variety of syringes, pills, bags of powder, and what looks like an inhaler all held in place by loops sewn into the cloth. “Are- are you trying to sell me drugs?” “Relax, they’re safe. Well, they won’t kill you, usually. Fuck I am bad at this. Ok, so yes, these are drugs, obviously. I have stimulants, boosters, psychedelics, and a fair amount of other stuff that you can’t just buy at a pharmacy.” She thinks for a second before continuing. “Well some of them you can, but it would take a prescription and... Look, you’re new. If you are here to mine, it is backbreaking work. If you are here to fight, that is also backbreaking work. What I am selling can help you. It’s all safe. I test all my stuff thoroughly before I sell it to anyone.” “Alright, do you just offer drugs to anyone who comes by? This seems a bit suspicious. What if you are trying to poison me? Who even are you?” “Oh, right. My name is Vivi. I uhh, well I’m sort of a slave here. Sort of.” She tugs at a thin metallic collar around her neck for emphasis. “My skills are intellectual, so I’m mostly safe from being drugged with anything I didn’t make, or forced to do hard labor. I uhh, look, it’s awful here, just awful, but I have enough freedom to maybe help someone who looks like they might bring it all down. If not then it’s just business and the bosses want money, it’s that simple. I can give you a free sample if you want. Give you a taste of what is on offer.” Well she has pled her case as well as she is able, are you interested in her homebrew meds? "

rows.original: “Where to begin? Well my life started with my birth on New Texas. My mother had me before she had to get the Treatment. She... I don’t talk to her anymore. It’s like looking at a ghost, a very stupid ghost.” Vivi seems irritated. “Anyway I went to school like most kids do. I didn’t have a lot of friends, but I had a knack for science: specifically chemistry. My life was great until the time came for my mom to take the Treatment. We weren’t poor, per se, but couldn’t afford to get off the planet, so she had no choice. We both knew it would change her, but I never could have imagined just how extreme it would be. The day it happened, when she came home... she didn’t come home alone.” She glances away. “It... No one should see their family like that, doing those things with strangers, their mind so totally melted that they think that it’s ok... I’m sorry.” She takes a moment to wipe the tears forming at her eyes. “Anyway I ran away from home. I spent the next few years wandering from place to place, living in the wilds, hiding from authorities, and living off of the kindness of the few willing to shelter me. My luck ran out when I finally managed to get myself off the planet. The ship I was on got hit by pirates, and they found me hiding in the storage. I was able to demonstrate my chemistry skills by detonating the supplies I had. It knocked me and about half of the pirates out. Probably not my smartest decision, but it worked out. The leader was impressed enough with my quick thinking to have me sent here to make drugs for the station. It’s better than dying, or the other awful things they do to people.”

rows.translation: “老实说，我过得还好。生活并不轻松，但总比一无所有强。每天都没什么大事，而我已经很擅长让上层人物别来找麻烦。我有几个可靠的顾客——不能告诉你是谁，不过只要愿意，你大概能自己猜出来。总之，我在这里过得还算舒适，至少和矿工相比是这样。所以，没错，我还好……不算很好，但还好。要是能走，我当然很想离开。”

rows.original: “My plan? Well, my lab here gets restocked regularly, and I’m always tweaking my formulas. Trying to be practical but, I’ll probably keep on as I am until business dries up here. I don’t know if they will ever actually let me go, or if I will need to take some more, drastic actions to get out of here. In any case, the pirate shit aside, I do still have other, more long term plans.” “You know I am originally from New Texas right? Well I want to put an end to this treatment shit. I mean, if it weren’t for that mess I would still be home in New Texas and never have been enslaved by pirates. The problem is, I’m just one person. I don’t think I can upend an entire political system alone. Not without doing something drastic. If I could get a bunch of people to come forward about how awful the Treatment actually is, how many families it has destroyed, the dangers of having to leave your home with nothing... Sorry, rambling. If I can get enough treated people to talk about having to flee the planet, then maybe we could have it stopped with the legal process. If not, well I am a chemist. I haven’t perfected my stuff yet, but I am able to make people smarter, temporarily. If I am able to undo the damage on a large enough scale...” She shakes her head. “Sorry, rambling again. So: save money, get out of here, try to fix my home.”

rows.original: You tell Vivi that you want brain juice. As repulsive as that name might sound when said out loud, Vivi assures you that it’s a good purchase. You pay her and wait for what comes next. “It’s just a simple injection into the back of your head, not into your actual brain. It will probably still hurt, but that just comes with the territory. Just hold still, ok?” You close your eyes and try to relax as Vivi makes her way behind you. You feel a small prick, and then a rush of fluid being forced into your body. It feels strange, like popping and tingling as it spreads out through you. Vivi yanks the syringe back out of you while the juice does its work, making sure to keep a close eye on the injection site. After a few seconds, you open your eyes again, and realize you have a very sour taste in your mouth, and inside your head. It feels like your brain is twisting and contorting. Your eyes go blank for a moment before all at once the sensations stop. You blink a few times and see Vivi standing in front of you with her top pulled down, showing you her big breasts. “Sorry about that... it helps if your eyes have something to focus on. Something your brain can agree deserves attention.” She pulls her top back into place before continuing. “So, you feel ok?” You see a dozen different ways to answer and hundreds of different words in your head, but in an instant you have already chosen one. “Yes, I feel most exquisite. I do believe it worked. Capital breasts by the way.” “Being needlessly verbose and articulate is one of the more common side effects,” she admits. “That should dissipate quickly as your social side catches up to the logical side. You should have about 24 hours of enhanced intellect now. Have fun doing nerd stuff.” She pats you on the shoulder. “Indubitably. I shall endeavor to make the most of my newfound erudition.” You shake your head from side to side and try again. “Thanks Vivi, I’ll try to enjoy it.” Your intelligence has been increased by
rows.translation: 你告诉维维，自己想要“脑汁”。这个名字说出口时听起来实在令人反胃，不过维维向你保证，这笔买卖很划算。你付了钱，等待接下来要做的事。“只是简单地注射到后脑勺，不是真的扎进大脑。大概还是会疼，但这是免不了的。别动，好吗？” 维维走到你身后，你闭上双眼，努力放松。你感觉到轻微刺痛，紧接着一股液体被强行注入体内。它扩散时带来一种奇怪的爆裂和麻刺感。药液开始发挥作用，维维猛地拔出针筒，同时仔细观察注射部位。 几秒后，你再次睁开眼睛，发现嘴里乃至脑海里都泛起一股强烈酸味。你的大脑仿佛正在扭曲变形。双眼短暂失神，随后所有感觉骤然停止。你眨了几次眼，看见维维站在面前，拉下上衣，向你展示她丰满的乳房。 “刚才抱歉了……如果眼睛有东西可以聚焦，情况会好些。某种连大脑也认可值得关注的东西。”她把上衣拉回原位，继续问道：“那么，感觉还好吗？” 脑海中浮现出十几种回答方式和数百个不同词汇，但你转瞬间便已选定一个。“是的，我感觉妙不可言。我确信它奏效了。顺带一提，你的乳房堪称一流。” “毫无必要地变得冗长而善辩，是比较常见的副作用之一，”她承认道。“随着社交能力追上逻辑能力，这种现象很快就会消退。现在你大约能拥有二十四小时的智力强化。好好去做些书呆子才会做的事吧。”她拍了拍你的肩膀。 “确凿无疑。我将竭力充分运用这份新获的博学。”你左右摇了摇头，再试一次。“谢谢你，维维。我会尽量享受它的。” 你的智力提高了
rows.raw: " You tell Vivi that you want brain juice. As repulsive as that name might sound when said out loud, Vivi assures you that it’s a good purchase. You pay her and wait for what comes next. “It’s just a simple injection into the back of your head, not into your actual brain. It will probably still hurt, but that just comes with the territory. Just hold still, ok?” You close your eyes and try to relax as Vivi makes her way behind you. You feel a small prick, and then a rush of fluid being forced into your body. It feels strange, like popping and tingling as it spreads out through you. Vivi yanks the syringe back out of you while the juice does its work, making sure to keep a close eye on the injection site. After a few seconds, you open your eyes again, and realize you have a very sour taste in your mouth, and inside your head. It feels like your brain is twisting and contorting. Your eyes go blank for a moment before all at once the sensations stop. You blink a few times and see Vivi standing in front of you with her top pulled down, showing you her big breasts. “Sorry about that... it helps if your eyes have something to focus on. Something your brain can agree deserves attention.” She pulls her top back into place before continuing. “So, you feel ok?” You see a dozen different ways to answer and hundreds of different words in your head, but in an instant you have already chosen one. “Yes, I feel most exquisite. I do believe it worked. Capital breasts by the way.” “Being needlessly verbose and articulate is one of the more common side effects,” she admits. “That should dissipate quickly as your social side catches up to the logical side. You should have about 24 hours of enhanced intellect now. Have fun doing nerd stuff.” She pats you on the shoulder. “Indubitably. I shall endeavor to make the most of my newfound erudition.” You shake your head from side to side and try again. “Thanks Vivi, I’ll try to enjoy it.” Your intelligence has been increased by "

rows.original: You tell Vivi that you want liquid muscle. You pay her and a moment later you have the red injectable in your grasp. As you are looking it over Vivi gives you a short explanation. “Most people have more strength in their body than they can actually use. We all have natural limits that keep us from hurting ourselves too badly. This, well it doesn’t turn those limits all the way off, but it does suppress them. You won’t actually rapidly grow muscle like the art suggests, you will just get more out of what you already have.” So, more strength, no physical transformation, and it’s temporary. “So, are you ready to take your shot?” You nod and pass the syringe back to Vivi. She holds your arm and injects the red fluid into you. It stings a bit, and you feel a strange warmth filling you. The warmth doesn’t last very long, and after just a few seconds you feel normal again. You flex your arm to inspect and you don’t see any changes, although you quickly realize that you can hold the tension much easier than before. You try with your other arm, and it’s much the same, as if you could hold a pose for hours with no issue. You grab Vivi by the waist and lift her into the air — it’s like she’s weightless in your hands. You feel like you could throw her to the other side of the station if you were so inclined. “Ahem, could you uhh, put me back down?” Ahh right.You lower her back down. “Thank you. So, it seems like that worked. I’m not afraid to admit my own weight, and you lifted me with ease. As exciting as that is, you probably bought this stuff with something specific in mind. So uhh, good luck with your fight, or marathon, or whatever else you wanted to juice up for.” You thank her and head off, flexing on and off as you go. If you were going to go do something reckless, this would be a good time to do so. Your physique has been increased by
rows.translation: 你告诉维维，自己想要液态肌肉。付钱后没多久，那支红色注射剂便落入你手中。你正在端详时，维维简单解释道：“大多数人的身体都拥有比实际能够发挥出来更强的力量。我们天生带有限制，以免把自己伤得太重。这个嘛……不会彻底关闭那些限制，但会压制它们。你不会像图案上那样迅速长出肌肉，只会从现有肌肉中发挥更多力量。”所以，它能增强力量，不会改变身体，而且效果是暂时的。 “那么，准备好注射了吗？”你点点头，把针筒递回维维。她扶住你的手臂，将红色液体注入其中。针口有点刺痛，一股奇异暖流灌满身体。暖意没有持续太久，短短几秒后你便恢复正常。你弯起手臂检查，没有看到任何变化，却很快发现自己能比以前轻松得多地维持肌肉紧绷。你换另一条手臂尝试，结果也一样，仿佛能毫不费力地维持姿势数小时。你搂住维维的腰，把她举到空中——她在你手中轻若无物。只要你愿意，感觉甚至能把她扔到空间站另一端。 “咳，能不能，呃……把我放下来？” 啊，对。你把她放回地面。 “谢谢。看来药效确实发挥了。我不怕承认自己的体重，而你轻而易举就把我举了起来。虽然这很刺激，不过你买这种东西，大概是为了某件具体的事。所以，呃，祝你的战斗、马拉松，或者任何想靠药物强化的事顺利。” 你向她道谢，随后离开，一路上不时绷紧肌肉。如果打算做什么鲁莽的事，现在正是好时机。 你的体格提高了

rows.original: You tell Vivi what you want and after a quick exchange you have the yellow vial in your hand. Upon closer inspection, the yellow substance is a powder. You look over at Vivi and she explains. “You eat that. Just let it dissolve in your mouth. But first, we test your normal reflexes.” With that, she throws a small rock at you. It’s not big enough to do any damage if it hits you, but you dodge it anyway. “Good enough. Now eat the powder.” You uncap the vial and dump all of the powder into your mouth. It has a very mild sweetness to it, almost like a banana. A short while later and it’s all gone. You don’t feel much different, but you see Vivi about to throw something at you, and before she has even finished her backswing, you have moved out of the way. “See, told you this stuff worked.” Well, at least she can be smug in that, if not her pitching ability. “You may be a bit jittery while you adjust to the new reflexes, but other than that you should be good to go.” As she raises her hand to wave at you, you instinctively jerk back from her. She smirks at you, seeming to know that would happen. “Hehe, have fun dodging blaster shots or whatever it is you do out there.” Your reflexes have increased for 24 hours.
rows.translation: 你告诉维维自己想要什么，迅速完成交易后，黄色小瓶落入手中。仔细一看，里面的黄色物质其实是粉末。你望向维维，她解释道：“把它吃下去，让它在嘴里溶解。不过首先，我们得测试你平时的反应速度。” 说完，她向你扔来一块小石头。石头并不大，即使砸中也不会造成伤害，不过你还是躲开了。“足够了。现在吃掉粉末。” 你打开瓶盖，将所有粉末倒入口中。它带有非常淡的甜味，有点像香蕉。没过多久，粉末便全部消失。你没觉得自己有多少变化，却看见维维准备向你扔东西；她甚至还没完成向后挥臂，你就已经闪到一旁。 “看吧，我说过这东西有效。”好吧，至少在这一点上她有资格得意，即使她投掷得并不怎么样。“适应新的反射速度时，你可能会有些神经质，除此之外应该没问题了。” 她举手向你挥别，你却本能地猛然后仰。她朝你坏笑，似乎早料到会这样。“嘿嘿，祝你躲爆能枪弹或者外面那些乱七八糟的东西躲得开心。” 你的反应能力提高了，持续二十四小时。

rows.original: You tell Vivi that you want Aim Assist. Once you give her the credits, she sits on the ground and gestures for you to lay your head on her lap. “No I’m not trying to flirt, these are eye drops, and you will be blinded for a little bit by them. Better to be laying down and comfortable than standing. Besides, it’s easier if I apply them than if you try to do it yourself.” It’s hard to argue with that. You take your place and stare straight up at the ceiling. Vivi holds the vial up so you can see it, dips the dropper into it, holds a bead of fluid over you, and then your vision goes black. You breathe heavily as you struggle to keep your eyes open. Vivi drips more and more of the surprisingly cold liquid into them. It feels like little shards of ice are drilling into your eyes, but it doesn’t hurt. It’s just really really cold and dark. After a few seconds, Vivi speaks again. “Ok, that was the last of it. Blink a few times and tell me what you see.” You close your eyes, holding them shut for a few seconds before opening them again. It still feels cold, but it gets warmer with each blink. The darkness gives way to light, and Vivi’s smiling face looking down at you. “I see you Vivi, I can also see through your eyes and into your skull, I think.” Indeed, it’s like you can see through things that were previously solid. She giggles at your response. “Probably not, but you are seeing an approximation. I won’t bore you with the science of it. In short, aside from helping you focus, this stuff can fill in blanks for you. Finish patterns that you can’t actually see, all of that kind of thing. That’s not all, but yeah, it will help you see, judge distances, and all that good stuff.” You blink a few more times before pulling yourself to your feet. Yes, the world does look much clearer now, and more orderly. You thank Vivi and get ready to face the world, with fresh eyes. Your aim has improved by
rows.translation: 你告诉维维，自己想要“辅助瞄准”。收到信用点后，她坐到地上，示意你把头枕在她腿上。“不，我不是在调情。这是眼药水，用过后你会短暂失明。躺着舒服些总比站着好，而且由我来滴也比你自己动手容易。” 这话很难反驳。你就位后，直直望向天花板。 维维举起小瓶让你看清，把滴管伸进去，然后将一滴液体悬在你眼睛上方——紧接着视野陷入黑暗。你粗重呼吸，努力保持双眼睁开。维维将越来越多冷得出奇的液体滴入其中。感觉像细小冰屑钻进眼球，却并不疼，只是极其、极其寒冷而黑暗。几秒后，维维再次开口。“好了，最后一滴。眨几下眼，告诉我看到了什么。” 你闭上双眼，保持几秒才重新睁开。依然很冷，但每眨一下眼便温暖一些。黑暗逐渐被光明取代，维维微笑的脸庞从上方俯视着你。“我看见你了，维维。我似乎还能透过你的眼睛看到头骨里面。”确实，你仿佛能够看穿过去完全不透明的东西。 她听到回答后咯咯发笑。“大概不能，不过你看到的是一种近似结果。我就不拿科学原理烦你了。简而言之，除了帮助聚焦，这东西还能替你补全空白，完成那些你其实看不见的图案，诸如此类。功能还不止这些，不过，没错，它能帮助你观察、判断距离，以及做好其他类似的事。” 你又眨了几次眼，随后站起身来。没错，如今世界看起来清晰得多，也更有秩序。你向维维道谢，准备以焕然一新的双眼面对世界。 你的瞄准能力提高了

rows.original: You tell Vivi that you want Iron Will. You hand her what you owe, and she pulls out the silvery syringe. “Alright, now this one goes into your chest. Take a deep breath and hold still.” You lay on the ground and brace yourself. Vivi gets into position herself, giving you a good look up her skirt before jamming the metal into your chest. You clench your fists in pain as the silvery liquid spreads through your body. As she pushes more in, the pain becomes more and more numb. Not quite absent, but it bothers you less and less until Vivi pulls the syringe out of you. Well, that wasn’t so bad. Vivi steps aside to let you up. “So, have I earned a tip?” Vivi looks at you with pleading eyes. No, no she has not. All she did was stab you. “Come on, please?” You don’t feel irritated by her insistence, but the answer is still no. “Why not?” You just don’t feel like it, do you need a greater justification? Besides, you don’t even feel that different. Vivi’s eyes start to water. “You hate me don’t you? You hate me.” That came out of nowhere, and you feel yourself starting to relent, before you suddenly snap out of it. “I said no.” Vivi suddenly changes attitude, smirking at you as she speaks. “Excellent, it worked perfectly.” She was testing you. Interesting. Would she have taken the money, if you had failed the test? Well regardless, you do feel like you had an easier time saying no than normal. “I see, well, thank you Vivi. No tips though.” She just chuckles before responding. “Yeah yeah, I won’t pretend to be a great actor here, but if you can say no to a girl starting to cry, I am sure you can refuse the advances of anyone. It should also help against hypnosis or other assaults on your mind. Anyway, good luck.” Your willpower has been increased by
rows.translation: 你告诉维维，自己想要“钢铁意志”。你交出应付的钱，她取出那支银色针筒。“好了，这一针要扎进胸口。深呼吸，别动。”你躺在地上，做好准备。维维也摆好位置，让你饱览裙底风光，随后将金属针头猛然扎进胸膛。银色液体在体内扩散，你因疼痛攥紧双拳。随着更多药液被推入，疼痛越来越麻木，并未完全消失，却越来越无法困扰你，直到维维将针筒拔出。好吧，并没有那么糟。维维退到一旁，让你起身。 “那么，我赚到小费了吗？”维维用恳求的目光看着你。不，她没有。她只是扎了你一针。“拜托，行不行？”她的坚持并未令你烦躁，但答案仍然是否定。“为什么不行？” 你只是不想给，还需要更充分的理由吗？再说，你甚至没觉得自己有什么不同。维维眼中开始泛起泪水。“你讨厌我，对吧？你讨厌我。”这句话毫无来由，你感觉自己正开始心软，却忽然清醒过来。“我说了，不行。” 维维的态度骤然一变，坏笑着说道：“太棒了，药效十分完美。”原来她在测试你。有意思。如果测试失败，她会收下那笔钱吗？不过无论如何，你确实觉得拒绝别人比平时容易。 “明白了。好吧，谢谢你，维维。不过还是没有小费。” 她只是轻笑一声才回答。“好吧好吧，我不会假装自己演技多好；不过，如果连开始哭泣的女孩都能拒绝，我确信你也能拒绝任何人的勾引。它应该也能帮助你抵抗催眠或其他精神攻击。总之，祝你好运。” 你的意志力提高了

rows.original: “No thanks, I uhh, I’m good.” The fact that you were able to speak normally and not shout or have some other kind of outburst as your response is a testament to your resolve. Vivi seems confused for a moment before it clicks in her brain. “Ahh right, yeah probably not a good idea to add anything else into your current state. My bad.” She takes you by the hand and helps you sit against the wall, although she does make sure to wiggle her butt at you once you’re seated. “It shouldn’t take too long for you to get back to normal, just let me know if you need anything.” You just stare off into the distance for a while, once you can fully feel your limbs again you stand up and get your [pc.gear] back on before getting back to your business.
rows.translation: “不了，谢谢，我，呃，我没事。”你能正常说话，没有喊叫或以其他方式失控地回答，足以证明你的意志多么坚定。 维维困惑了一瞬，随即恍然大悟。“啊，对，确实，现在这种状态再加点别的东西大概不是好主意。是我不好。”她牵着你的手，帮你靠墙坐下，不过在你落座后，她还是特意朝你扭了扭屁股。“应该用不了多久就能恢复正常，需要什么就告诉我。” 你只是凝视远方许久；等四肢完全恢复知觉后，你站起身，重新穿上[pc.gear]，继续去忙自己的事。

rows.original: The fine, glittering powder rests in your palm, catching the dim light with a kaleidoscope of colors. You take a breath, lift it to your mouth, and let it dissolve on your tongue. A moment passes before a wave of warmth unfurls from your core, blooming outward to your fingertips. The world tilts ever so slightly, and then color explodes around you. The mundane wall of the station ripples as though dipped in liquid light, each surface bleeding into the next with hues that shimmer and swirl like watercolors on damp paper. Blues melt into purples, yellows dance with greens, and every shadow flickers with bursts of hidden rainbows. Even the air seems to vibrate with iridescence, like you’re seeing particles of light for the first time. You look down and see your hands bathed in pools of luminous pink and gold. The sweat on your skin refracts the light, casting tiny rainbows across your knuckles. You move your fingers, mesmerized as their trails linger behind, fading slowly as if time itself were stretching just to enjoy the spectacle. A puddle nearby glimmers, the once-dull water transformed into a portal of swirling reds, blues, and greens, alive with their own mysterious current. Every step you take is like walking on the edge of a dream, your surroundings both familiar and enchanted, as if you’ve crossed into a painting where each brushstroke cradles an untold story. “Beautiful, isn’t it?” a voice asks, soft and distant. You were sure that it was Vivi speaking, but when you turn back to her, you can see the sound bend, echo, and diffuse into colors you can’t even describe. Following the flow of color back to Vivi, you can see that she is absolutely radiating shards of violet capped with white tips. The whole world breathes and pulses with an artist’s touch, alive in ways you could have never imagined. Even the ordinarily mundane ground seems to whisper secrets, inviting you to linger, to lose yourself in this radiant version of reality where every color tells a story and every shadow hides a rainbow waiting to be found. For the next hour or so you are lost in this world of beauty, where every sensation blends together vibrantly, sound and color interchangeable and all of reality shifts on a whim. Eventually however the trip starts to fade. At first the colors stay vibrant but become static, sounds become clearer, but lose their color, the styles fade away to realism, and eventually everything returns to its mundane self. Still, you have a newfound appreciation for the world around you, and how it looks through a new set of eyes — eyes you could pay to put back on at any time.... Well, that’s enough musing for now. Reality has settled enough that you can operate machinery if you need to, time to get back to the rest of reality. You grab your [pc.gear], say farewell, and head out.
rows.translation: 细腻闪亮的粉末躺在你掌心，在昏暗光线中折射出万花筒般的色彩。你吸了口气，把它送到嘴边，任其在舌上溶解。片刻之后，一股暖流从身体核心舒展开来，向外绽放直至指尖。世界微微倾斜，随后色彩在周围轰然爆发。 空间站平凡的墙壁荡起波纹，仿佛浸入了流动的光，每一处表面都以闪耀旋转的色调向下一处渗透，如同湿纸上的水彩。蓝色融入紫色，黄色与绿色共舞，每一片阴影都闪动着隐藏彩虹的光辉。就连空气也仿佛随着虹彩振动，仿佛你第一次看见组成光的粒子。 你低头看去，双手沐浴在明亮的粉红与金色池泽中。皮肤上的汗水折射光芒，在指节上投下细小彩虹。你活动手指，它们留下的轨迹久久不散，缓慢褪色，仿佛时间本身也在伸展，只为欣赏这场奇景。 附近一滩水闪闪发光；原本暗淡的积水变成由旋转的红、蓝、绿三色组成的入口，沿着自身神秘水流鲜活涌动。每迈出一步都像行走在梦境边缘；周围既熟悉又充满魔力，仿佛你跨进了一幅画，每一道笔触都怀抱着一个未曾讲述的故事。 “很美，对吧？”一个声音柔和而遥远地问道。你确信那是维维的声音，可转头看向她时，却能看见声波弯曲、回荡，散射成连你也无法描述的色彩。沿着色彩流向维维看去，你发现她正迸射出顶端泛白的紫色碎芒。 整个世界在艺术家的笔触下呼吸、脉动，以你从未想象过的方式鲜活起来。就连平日平凡无奇的地面似乎也在低语秘密，邀请你停留，邀请你迷失在这光辉灿烂的现实版本之中；每一种颜色都诉说着故事，每一片阴影都藏着一道等待被发现的彩虹。 接下来一个小时左右，你迷失在这个美丽世界里。所有感官鲜活地交融，声音与色彩可以互换，整个现实随心念而改变。然而，幻游最终开始消退。起初色彩仍然鲜艳，却变得静止；声音变得清晰，却失去了颜色；风格逐渐褪回写实，最终一切恢复成平凡模样。即便如此，你对周遭世界有了全新的欣赏，也体会到通过一双崭新眼睛观察它会是什么模样——而你随时可以付钱，再次戴上这双眼睛.... 好了，感慨到此为止。现实已稳定到足以让你操作机械，该回到其余现实中去了。你拿起[pc.gear]，道别后离开。
