rows.original: [var0 |“Ah... well. Hrm. That’s good stuff, but it takes longer than the others to get going. I don’t think either of us want to be stuck out here for as long as it takes to kick in or wear off. I can’t exactly invite you to my place and if I’m seen getting onto your ship,” she taps her collar meaningfully, “we’d both be in a world of trouble. Let’s say we save this one for another day.” |“Ahh yes, the classic. I have some good stuff, but it takes longer than the other things to get going. I don’t think either of us want to be stuck out here for as long as it takes to kick in or wear off. Let’s go back to my place.” Well, you’re in this deep, might as well. “Sure, just know if this is some kind of trap I can defend myself.” While Vivi doesn’t seem the type to do anything hostile it doesn’t hurt to be clear. Vivi just chuckles. “Relax, I’m a drug dealer not a kidnapper. Come on, it’s not too far away.” She leads you off and after a bit of walking through the complex, she reveals an old hatch. “Down here.” She pulls it open and climbs down the steps under it. Her home is indeed a laboratory. There are a fair amount of partitioned rooms that are set aside for chemistry but she has a section clearly repurposed for regular living. She plops down on a couch and pats the seat next to her, which you take. You take in the room: it’s a nice little living room with an old school TV, a couple game consoles, and a small table that she is now using as a footrest. “Cozy little place you have here.” Not the greatest compliment, but it’s not exactly a luxury hotel — although she could do worse in Zhèng Shi. She chuckles. “Yeah, it’s not much but it’s home to me, at least for now. Anyway, here’s your stuff.” She reaches to the side of the couch and pulls out what looks like a blue cigar. You take it and inspect it. It looks high quality and decently well rolled. Although you can’t really inspect the center of it, you don’t think Vivi would be the type to lace it with anything. Vivi passes you a lighter. “So, is there anything in particular you want to do for the next few hours?” ]
rows.translation: [var0 |“啊...好吧。嗯。这东西确实不错，但起效时间比其他药更长。我想我们都不愿意在外面困上那么久，等它发作又等它消退。我没法邀请你去我家；而且要是有人看见我登上你的飞船，”她意味深长地敲了敲项圈，“我们俩都会惹上天大的麻烦。这个就留到改天吧。” |“啊，没错，经典款。我手里确实有上等货，但起效比其他东西慢。我想我们都不愿意在外面困上那么久，等它发作又等它消退。去我家吧。” 好吧，你都已经陷得这么深，不妨继续。“行，不过先说好，如果这是某种陷阱，我有能力保护自己。”维维看起来不像会做出敌对行为的人，但把话说清楚总没有坏处。 维维只是轻笑。“放松，我是毒贩，不是绑匪。走吧，离这儿不远。”她带你离开，在建筑群中走了一阵后，露出一扇老旧舱门。“从这里下去。”她拉开舱门，沿下方台阶爬下去。她的家确实是一间实验室。这里有相当多隔开的房间用于化学工作，不过她显然也把其中一片区域改造成了普通生活空间。她一屁股坐到沙发上，拍拍身旁座位，你也坐了过去。 你打量房间：这是个舒适的小客厅，摆着一台老式电视、几台游戏机，还有一张小桌子；她现在正把脚架在上面。 “你这小地方挺舒适。”算不上多么高明的称赞，但这里本来也不是什么豪华酒店——不过在郑石空间站，她完全可能住得更糟。 她轻笑道：“是啊，没什么了不起，但至少现在这里就是我的家。总之，这是你的东西。”她伸手摸向沙发一侧，取出一支看似蓝色雪茄的东西。你接过来仔细检查。它看起来品质上乘，卷制得也相当不错。虽说你无法真正检查内部，但你觉得维维不是会在里面掺别的东西的人。维维递给你一只打火机。“那么，接下来几个小时有什么特别想做的事吗？” ]

rows.original: Gaming with your drug dealer isn’t really what you expected to be doing with your life, but supposedly this was fairly common back in the old days. Vivi turns on one of the old consoles while you light up your special cigar. It takes a few seconds for the tip to light, and once it does you inhale deeply. The smoke feels oddly cold as it hits your lungs, almost minty as you hold it in, before letting it back out. “Refreshing. So how long did you say this stuff takes to kick in?” Vivi takes a seat next to you, passing you one of the controllers. “It varies, but probably about ten minutes.” Well, that makes enough sense. With all the shapes and sizes people come in, having an exact number for any given customer would be difficult. You take another drag before resting your purchase in a nearby ashtray. You pick up your controller and take a look at what Vivi has actually put up for you two to play. It’s an old racing game. It looks like a generic ripoff but it seems functional at least. Well, given the situation you can’t really hold it against her for not having the most modern of amenities. Besides, these old games do have nostalgia going for them, even the bad ones. Vivi takes your cigar from the ashtray and takes a drag before putting it back. Seems she wants to enjoy this too. “One more thing before we start: I get a bit pervy when I’m high. Not much I can do about it.” She could have just not smoked your drugs, but ok. Ehh not like having a horny girl next to you is actually a problem. In any case, it’s time to play. Vivi hits the start button and after a short countdown the game starts. The controls are fairly simple and it plays well enough. The graphics are extremely outdated, but the style still works. The game is loosely cyberpunk themed, with the race tracks being in eternal twilight. So far it’s pretty casual, you and Vivi against the primitive AI of the game while you get used to the controls. This gives you plenty of opportunities to smoke rather than having to divert full attention to the game. After a few practice rounds you feel like you’ve gotten the hang of it, but you also feel the drugs kicking in, your movements becoming less precise and your thoughts becoming hazy. The next couple hours pass in a blur, but a few details stick out to you: namely, Vivi’s progressively more insistent snuggling against your side, the heat of her breath against your cheek, and her big, fluffy tail swishing back and forth as she crosses and uncrosses her legs, rubbing her knees together. Seems she’s feeling it too.
rows.translation: 和你的毒贩一起玩游戏，并不是你预想中的人生经历，不过据说在过去相当常见。维维打开一台老式游戏机，你则点燃那支特殊雪茄。烟头过了几秒才亮起；点着后，你深深吸了一口。烟雾进入肺部时出奇地冰凉，憋住时几乎带着薄荷感，随后才被你吐出。“真提神。所以你说这东西多久才会起效？” 维维在你身边坐下，递来一只手柄。“时间因人而异，不过大概十分钟吧。”嗯，这说得通。人们的体型大小千差万别，很难为每位顾客给出精确数字。 你又吸了一口，把买来的雪茄搁进附近的烟灰缸。拿起手柄后，你看看维维到底给你们选了什么游戏。这是一款老赛车游戏。看起来像粗制滥造的仿制品，不过至少能够正常运行。好吧，考虑到她的处境，也不能因为没有最现代化的娱乐设施而责怪她。况且，这些老游戏的怀旧感本身就是优点，就连烂游戏也一样。 维维从烟灰缸拿起你的雪茄，吸了一口后又放回去。看来她也想享受一番。“开始前还有一件事：我嗨起来会有点色。对此我也没什么办法。”她本来可以不抽你的药，不过好吧。呃，身边坐着一个欲火焚身的女孩也不算什么问题。 不管怎样，该开始玩了。维维按下开始键，简短倒计时后游戏开始。操作相当简单，玩起来也还过得去。画面已经严重落伍，不过美术风格仍然奏效。游戏粗略采用赛博朋克主题，赛道永远笼罩在暮色之中。 目前还相当轻松；你和维维一边适应操作，一边对抗游戏里原始的人工智能。这给了你充足机会抽烟，无需把全部注意力都投进游戏。练习几轮后，你觉得自己已经掌握诀窍，但也感觉药效开始发作：动作变得不再精准，思绪也逐渐朦胧。 接下来几个小时模糊地流逝，不过你仍记得几个细节：维维越来越执意贴在你身侧依偎，温热呼吸拂过你的脸颊；她交替翘起和放下双腿，膝盖相互摩擦，蓬松的大尾巴也来回摆动。看来她也感受到了。

rows.translation: 你再次环顾房间里四处散落的容器。“你是商人？”几个敞开的容器里装满了各式各样、大多合法性存疑的杂物。你转回去面对沃尔里克斯。“你卖什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look around the room once more at the containers littering the room. “You’re a merchant?” A few of the open containers are loaded full with various, mostly dubiously legal, odds and ends. You turn back to face Vulriks. “What do you sell?”"

rows.original: The Anat scoffs and waves a single clawed hand in the air, as if shooing away the question. “I do not sell my stock. Not here at least. What is it the Rat said... something about how I do not ‘shit where I eat.’ The expression is lost on me, but I think I understand her meaning. I keep my business here focused.”
rows.translation: 阿纳泰人嗤了一声，用一只利爪手掌在空中挥了挥，仿佛要赶走这个问题。“我不在这里出售库存，至少在这里不卖。那只老鼠是怎么说的来着……好像是我不会‘在吃饭的地方拉屎’。这句俗语令我费解，但我想我明白她的意思。我让这里的生意保持专一。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Anat scoffs and waves a single clawed hand in the air, as if shooing away the question. “I do not sell my stock. Not here at least. What is it the Rat said... something about how I do not ‘shit where I eat.’ The expression is lost on me, but I think I understand her meaning. I keep my business here focused.”"

rows.original: “If you wish to sell, I will buy. And believe me, I will buy whatever it is you would wish to sell.” Vulriks shifts in place, his bright eyes suddenly round and kind. “So, shall we do business, Per?”
rows.translation: “如果你想卖，我就会买。相信我，无论你想卖什么，我都会收购。”沃尔里克斯挪了挪身子，明亮的双眼忽然显得圆润而亲切。“那么，我们来做生意吧，佩尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you wish to sell, I will buy. And believe me, I will buy whatever it is you would wish to sell.” Vulriks shifts in place, his bright eyes suddenly round and kind. “So, shall we do business, Per?”"

rows.translation: 离开

rows.original: Stepping back, you properly take in the sight of the Anat before you.
rows.translation: 退后一步，你仔细打量面前这名阿纳泰人的全貌。
rows.raw: "Stepping back, you properly take in the sight of the Anat before you."

rows.original: Vulriks is tall, even by the standards of his species. You suspect if he was standing straight he’d be well over 7 feet tall, however he is perpetually hunched over, likely a combination of his alien biology and a lifetime of poor posture.. Like the rest of his kind, his face is covered by a natural mask, a plate of bone-white material, covered with intricate etchings. Hidden just behind his face covering, visible through two natural slits, you see he has two bright and expressive blue eyes, which seem to always be watching you closely.
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯即使以其种族的标准来看也很高。你估计他若直起身子，身高会远超七英尺，但他总是弓着背，可能既是异星生理结构所致，也源于一辈子的糟糕体态。与其他同族一样，他的脸被一副天然面具覆盖，那是一块骨白色物质构成的面板，上面刻满复杂纹路。透过面罩上的两道天然狭缝，你看见藏在其后的两只明亮而富有表现力的蓝眼睛，它们似乎始终在仔细观察你。
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks is tall, even by the standards of his species. You suspect if he was standing straight he’d be well over 7 feet tall, however he is perpetually hunched over, likely a combination of his alien biology and a lifetime of poor posture.. Like the rest of his kind, his face is covered by a natural mask, a plate of bone-white material, covered with intricate etchings. Hidden just behind his face covering, visible through two natural slits, you see he has two bright and expressive blue eyes, which seem to always be watching you closely."

rows.original: He keeps his hands on the counter, his flesh rough and dark red, both capped with four white, predatory claws, similar to his mask in composition. The rest of his arms are otherwise covered, long loose sleeves coming down to his wrists. A long black, hooded cloak hides the rest of his hereditary traits, keeping his head plumage well concealed. Just under the shroud, you can tell Vulriks is wearing some sort of armor, which given his line of work and current residence, seems like a smart idea. Despite being mostly covered up, you can tell he has a lithe and muscular body, although you get the impression he may be out of shape by Anatae standards.
rows.translation: 他把双手放在柜台上，皮肤粗糙而暗红，四根白色掠食者般的利爪覆在每只手的末端，其材质看起来与面具相似。除此之外，他的手臂都被遮住，宽松长袖一直垂到手腕。一件黑色带兜帽长斗篷掩盖了其余遗传特征，也把头部羽饰藏得严严实实。透过遮罩，你能看出沃尔里克斯穿着某种护甲；考虑到他的行当和目前的住处，这似乎是明智之举。尽管全身大多被遮住，你仍能看出他身材精瘦而结实，不过按阿纳泰人的标准，你觉得他可能有些疏于锻炼。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe keeps his hands on the counter, his flesh rough and dark red, both capped with four white, predatory claws, similar to his mask in composition. The rest of his arms are otherwise covered, long loose sleeves coming down to his wrists. A long black, hooded cloak hides the rest of his hereditary traits, keeping his head plumage well concealed. Just under the shroud, you can tell Vulriks is wearing some sort of armor, which given his line of work and current residence, seems like a smart idea. Despite being mostly covered up, you can tell he has a lithe and muscular body, although you get the impression he may be out of shape by Anatae standards."

rows.original: His lower half is harder to judge. You can tell he has two digitigrade legs concealed by his cloak, and when he shifts his weight you hear a pair of heavy boots scuff the floor. On his hip you notice a rather odd blaster, unusually modded, and definitely illegal. Just under his pants you spot a noticeable bulge, telling you the Anat is packing some other serious heat.
rows.translation: 他的下半身更难判断。你能看出斗篷下藏着两条趾行腿，而他转移重心时，一双沉重靴子擦过地面的声音随之传来。你注意到他腰间有一把相当奇怪的爆能枪，经过非同寻常的改装，而且绝对违法。他裤子下面还有一道显眼隆起，说明这名阿纳泰人还带着另一件威力十足的“武器”。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis lower half is harder to judge. You can tell he has two digitigrade legs concealed by his cloak, and when he shifts his weight you hear a pair of heavy boots scuff the floor. On his hip you notice a rather odd blaster, unusually modded, and definitely illegal. Just under his pants you spot a noticeable bulge, telling you the Anat is packing some other serious heat."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Vulriks rolls his eyes. “I do not sell things here, Steele.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯翻了个白眼。“我不在这里卖东西，斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "Vulriks rolls his eyes. “I do not sell things here, Steele.”"

rows.original: You look around the room at the various containers, all filled with miscellaneous stuff. “Well what about all this then? Isn’t it for sale?”
rows.translation: 你环顾房间里装满各种杂物的容器。“那这些又是什么？它们不卖吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look around the room at the various containers, all filled with miscellaneous stuff. “Well what about all this then? Isn’t it for sale?” "

rows.original: The Anat taps a clawed digit against the counter, sighing from behind his mask. “Most of this is already spoken for. I merely prepare it here before I move it elsewhere to be transferred.”
rows.translation: 阿纳泰人用一根带爪的手指敲着柜台，在面具后叹了口气。“这里大部分东西都已经有主了。我只是在此进行整理，之后再搬到别处转交。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Anat taps a clawed digit against the counter, sighing from behind his mask. “Most of this is already spoken for. I merely prepare it here before I move it elsewhere to be transferred.”"

rows.original: You eyeball a particularly interesting-looking shoulder mounted rocket launcher sticking out from an open container. Now you can’t help but ask. “So where exactly do I have to go to buy this stuff then?”
rows.translation: 你盯着一个敞开的集装箱，里面伸出一具造型格外惹眼的肩扛式火箭发射器。现在你实在忍不住要问了。“那么，我到底该去哪里才能买到这些东西？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou eyeball a particularly interesting-looking shoulder mounted rocket launcher sticking out from an open container. Now you can’t help but ask. “So where exactly do I have to go to buy this stuff then?”"

rows.original: Vulriks lifts a single finger and waves it in the air. “Tsk, tsk. That I cannot tell you. My clients would be very cross with me if I gave away those particular locations. But I will tell you what...” his blue eyes narrow, and you suspect behind his mask he’s smiling. “If I ever come across something that I think you simply must own, I will hold it for you. Deal?”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯竖起一根手指，在空中摇了摇。“啧，啧。这个我不能告诉你。要是我泄露了那些特定地点，我的客户会非常生气。不过我可以告诉你一件事...”他眯起蓝色双眼，你怀疑面具下的他正在微笑。“如果我哪天碰到某件我认为你非买不可的东西，我会替你留着。成交？”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks lifts a single finger and waves it in the air. “Tsk, tsk. That I cannot tell you. My clients would be very cross with me if I gave away those particular locations. But I will tell you what...” his blue eyes narrow, and you suspect behind his mask he’s smiling. “If I ever come across something that I think you simply must own, I will hold it for you. Deal?”"

rows.original: You suppose that’s the best you’re going to get...
rows.translation: 你觉得这大概已经是你能得到的最好答复了...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose that’s the best you’re going to get..."

rows.original: Buy
rows.translation: 购买
rows.raw: "Buy"

rows.original: The tall Anat lifts one of his dark red hands and shakes it. “I’m going to have to stop you there.” Vulriks lowers his hand, his claws tapping on the counter when it lands. “I apologize for not wanting to get, ehh, familiar with you. Trust should not be cheap around these parts. Let’s keep this strictly business for now.”
rows.translation: 高大的阿纳泰人抬起一只深红色的手，摆了摆。“我得在这里打断你。”沃尔里克斯放下手，落在柜台上时利爪敲出轻响。“抱歉，我暂时不想与你变得，呃，太过熟悉。在这种地方，信任不该来得太廉价。眼下我们还是只谈生意吧。”
rows.raw: "The tall Anat lifts one of his dark red hands and shakes it. “I’m going to have to stop you there.” Vulriks lowers his hand, his claws tapping on the counter when it lands. “I apologize for not wanting to get, ehh, familiar with you. Trust should not be cheap around these parts. Let’s keep this strictly business for now.” "

rows.original: “Oh.” Despite understanding his position, you still feel the urge to inquire if he thinks that will change.
rows.translation: “哦。”尽管理解他的立场，你还是忍不住想问，他觉得以后会不会有所改变。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh.” Despite understanding his position, you still feel the urge to inquire if he thinks that will change. "

rows.original: Vulriks laughs, the sound only slightly muffled by his mask. “Tell you what, Per. Deal with me, and we can talk about whatever you want. Let’s think of it as ‘The price to do business’. Deal?”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯笑了起来，声音只被面具稍稍压低。“这样吧，佩尔。和我做生意，我们就可以聊你想聊的任何事。把它当成‘做生意的代价’吧。成交？”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks laughs, the sound only slightly muffled by his mask. “Tell you what, Per. Deal with me, and we can talk about whatever you want. Let’s think of it as ‘The price to do business’. Deal?”"

rows.original: Sounds reasonable enough.
rows.translation: 听起来还算合理。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds reasonable enough."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: “Hm.” Vulriks squints his bright blue eyes for a moment while he thinks. “I guess there is no harm in talking now that we have dealt with each other. Mutual incrimination, and all that,” he chuckles under his breath. “What do you wish to talk about?”
rows.translation: “嗯。”沃尔里克斯思索片刻，眯起明亮的蓝眼睛。“既然我们已经做过生意，现在聊聊应该也无妨。彼此都有把柄，诸如此类，”他低声轻笑。“你想聊什么？”
rows.raw: "“Hm.” Vulriks squints his bright blue eyes for a moment while he thinks. “I guess there is no harm in talking now that we have dealt with each other. Mutual incrimination, and all that,” he chuckles under his breath. “What do you wish to talk about?”"

rows.original: Buying Only
rows.translation: 只收不卖
rows.raw: "Buying Only"

rows.original: Himself
rows.translation: 他本人
rows.raw: "Himself"

rows.original: Why here?
rows.translation: 为何在此？
rows.raw: "Why here?"

rows.original: Posturing
rows.translation: 摆架子
rows.raw: "Posturing"

rows.original: Posturing
rows.translation: 摆架子
rows.raw: "Posturing"

rows.original: You don’t know him well enough to ask this question.
rows.translation: 你和他还不够熟，不能问这个问题。
rows.raw: "You don’t know him well enough to ask this question."

rows.original: Posturing
rows.translation: 摆架子
rows.raw: "Posturing"

rows.original: His Crime
rows.translation: 他的罪行
rows.raw: "His Crime"

rows.original: Buying Only
rows.translation: 只收不卖
rows.raw: "Buying Only"

rows.original: Himself
rows.translation: 他本人
rows.raw: "Himself"

rows.original: Why here?
rows.translation: 为何在此？
rows.raw: "Why here?"

rows.original: Posturing
rows.translation: 摆架子
rows.raw: "Posturing"

rows.original: His Crime
rows.translation: 他的罪行
rows.raw: "His Crime"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: “So how is it you can get by only buying things?”
rows.translation: “所以，你只靠收购东西是怎么维持下去的？”
rows.raw: "“So how is it you can get by only buying things?”"

rows.original: Vulriks chuckles, seemingly amused by your question. “I promise you, my friend. I sell everything I buy. Just not under the same roof.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯轻笑一声，似乎觉得你的问题颇为有趣。“我向你保证，我的朋友。我买下的每一件东西都会卖出去。只不过不是在同一个屋檐下。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks chuckles, seemingly amused by your question. “I promise you, my friend. I sell everything I buy. Just not under the same roof.”"

rows.original: “Everything?” You turn to regard one of the open containers, regarding a pile of worn out junk, mostly old ship parts, sticking out from the top. “How exactly do you manage that?”
rows.translation: “每一件？”你转头看向一个敞开的集装箱，打量着从顶部伸出的一堆破旧废品，其中大多是老旧飞船零件。“你究竟是怎么办到的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everything?” You turn to regard one of the open containers, regarding a pile of worn out junk, mostly old ship parts, sticking out from the top. “How exactly do you manage that?”"

rows.original: From behind his mask you hear something like lips smacking, but you’re not sure what’s exactly going on behind the damned thing. “I will admit, some things stick around much longer than others. But if I’ve learned one thing in this line of work it’s this: trash and treasure are subjective”
rows.translation: 你从他的面具后听到类似咂嘴的声音，但实在无法确定那该死的面具后面究竟发生了什么。“我承认，有些东西会比其他东西滞留得久得多。但我在这一行学到了一件事：垃圾与珍宝是因人而异的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom behind his mask you hear something like lips smacking, but you’re not sure what’s exactly going on behind the damned thing. “I will admit, some things stick around much longer than others. But if I’ve learned one thing in this line of work it’s this: trash and treasure are subjective”"

rows.original: “I think the expression is ‘One man’s trash is another man’s treasure’.”
rows.translation: “我觉得那句话应该是‘一个人的垃圾，是另一个人的珍宝’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think the expression is ‘One man’s trash is another man’s treasure’.” "

rows.original: Vulriks laughs, smacking the counter in a sign of approval. “I like that! Yes! That’s good. Very true. Now, I will admit sometimes, ehh...” Vulriks positions his hand sideways in the air, wiggling it. “I take a loss on something. But I am not worried about profits.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯笑了起来，拍了拍柜台表示赞许。“我喜欢这句话！没错！说得好。非常正确。现在，我得承认有时候，呃...”沃尔里克斯将一只手横在半空，左右晃了晃。“有些东西会让我亏本。但我并不担心利润。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks laughs, smacking the counter in a sign of approval. “I like that! Yes! That’s good. Very true. Now, I will admit sometimes, ehh...” Vulriks positions his hand sideways in the air, wiggling it. “I take a loss on something. But I am not worried about profits.”"

rows.original: No Profit?
rows.translation: 不求利润？
rows.raw: "No Profit?"

rows.original: No Profit?
rows.translation: 不求利润？
rows.raw: "No Profit?"

rows.original: He doesn’t care about profit?
rows.translation: 他不在乎利润？
rows.raw: "He doesn’t care about profit?"

rows.original: Good For You
rows.translation: 为你叫好
rows.raw: "Good For You"

rows.original: Good For You
rows.translation: 为你叫好
rows.raw: "Good For You"

rows.original: Encourage the man.
rows.translation: 鼓励他。
rows.raw: "Encourage the man."

rows.original: “Wait, you don’t care about profits?” You can’t even pretend to hide your confusion. “How the hell do you even stay in business?”
rows.translation: “等等，你不在乎利润？”你根本掩饰不住自己的困惑。“那你到底是怎么把生意维持下去的？”
rows.raw: "“Wait, you don’t care about profits?” You can’t even pretend to hide your confusion. “How the hell do you even stay in business?”"

rows.original: Vulriks sighs, his blue eyes rolling behind his mask. “I have heard that before.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯叹了口气，面具后的蓝眼睛翻了翻。“这话我以前听过。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks sighs, his blue eyes rolling behind his mask. “I have heard that before.”"

rows.original: “It’s nice to meet somebody who isn’t all about the bottom line.” Although how he keeps his doors open is a mystery to you.
rows.translation: “很高兴遇到一个不只盯着利润的人。”不过他到底如何维持店面运转，对你而言仍是个谜。
rows.raw: "“It’s nice to meet somebody who isn’t all about the bottom line.” Although how he keeps his doors open is a mystery to you."

rows.original: Vulriks taps his finger, nodding slightly. “Not many understand my position.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯轻敲手指，微微点头。“没多少人理解我的立场。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks taps his finger, nodding slightly. “Not many understand my position.”"

rows.original: He continues. “In the Empire, everything we do is for the greater good. Even still, I adhere to that principle; despite my current, situation.” With an outstretched arm, he motions around the room. “Everything I do, all of my dealings, I do for my greater good. For my people, and my Empire.”
rows.translation: 他继续说道：“在帝国，我们所做的一切都是为了更大的福祉。即便如今，我仍坚持这一原则，尽管我目前的，处境有些特殊。”他伸出一条手臂，示意周围的房间。“我所做的一切、经手的所有交易，都是为了我更大的福祉。为了我的人民，也为了我的帝国。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe continues. “In the Empire, everything we do is for the greater good. Even still, I adhere to that principle; despite my current, situation.” With an outstretched arm, he motions around the room. “Everything I do, all of my dealings, I do for my greater good. For my people, and my Empire.”"

rows.original: You chew on his words for a moment. “How does trading with pirates and selling contraband help your people?”
rows.translation: 你咀嚼了一会儿他的话。“和海盗交易、出售违禁品，怎么能帮助你的人民？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chew on his words for a moment. “How does trading with pirates and selling contraband help your people?”"

rows.original: Vulriks drops his arm, remaining silent for a moment. “We can discuss that later. It’s, ehh... not an easy topic without context. So, did you have something else you wished to discuss?”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯放下手臂，沉默片刻。“我们以后可以再谈。这件事，呃...没有背景说明就很难讲清楚。那么，你还有别的事情想谈吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks drops his arm, remaining silent for a moment. “We can discuss that later. It’s, ehh... not an easy topic without context. So, did you have something else you wished to discuss?”"

rows.original: “Why don’t you tell me a bit more about yourself.”
rows.translation: “不如多说说你自己吧。”
rows.raw: "“Why don’t you tell me a bit more about yourself.”"

rows.original: Vulriks makes an odd noise, something between clearing his throat and gagging. “Big question. You might want to narrow it down.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯发出一声古怪的动静，介于清嗓子和干呕之间。“这个问题太大了。你最好缩小一下范围。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks makes an odd noise, something between clearing his throat and gagging. “Big question. You might want to narrow it down.”"

rows.original: You think for a moment. “Well, it’s rare to see Anatae outside of the Empire, isn’t it? Why don’t you start with that?”
rows.translation: 你想了片刻。“在帝国以外很少见到阿纳泰人，对吧？不如从这里说起？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think for a moment. “Well, it’s rare to see Anatae outside of the Empire, isn’t it? Why don’t you start with that?”"

rows.original: Vulriks stares at you, his blue eyes betraying none of his thoughts. “I suppose that is true...” he sighs, then lifts one of his clawed hands to his throat, scratching it absentmindedly. “Well, I am how do you say... unofficially excommunicated.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯凝视着你，那双蓝眼睛丝毫没有泄露他的想法。“我想确实如此...”他叹了口气，随后抬起一只带爪的手，无意识地挠着喉咙。“嗯，我算是，该怎么说呢...非正式地被逐出了教会。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks stares at you, his blue eyes betraying none of his thoughts. “I suppose that is true...” he sighs, then lifts one of his clawed hands to his throat, scratching it absentmindedly. “Well, I am how do you say... unofficially excommunicated.” "

rows.original: You’ve never heard of the Anatae kicking out their own. Although you do admit your knowledge on their culture is, at best, limited due to their insular nature. You decide to keep the line of questioning simple. “So they kicked you out? What for?”
rows.translation: 你从未听说过阿纳泰人会驱逐自己的同胞。不过你也承认，由于他们封闭排外的天性，自己对其文化的了解充其量也十分有限。你决定让问题简单一些。“所以他们把你赶出来了？为什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve never heard of the Anatae kicking out their own. Although you do admit your knowledge on their culture is, at best, limited due to their insular nature. You decide to keep the line of questioning simple. “So they kicked you out? What for?”"

rows.original: Vulriks groans slightly, his claws tapping on the counter. “No. That’s not quite right. As far as they know I am still very much present, albeit preoccupied.” The Anat stops his digits from tapping, sighing from behind his mask. “I was to die, you see. Sentenced to a lifetime breaking rocks as punishment for my crimes.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯轻声呻吟，利爪在柜台上敲击。“不，不完全是那样。据他们所知，我仍然好端端地在那里，只不过正忙于别的事。”阿纳泰人停下敲击的手指，在面具后叹了口气。“你看，我本该死去。作为犯罪的惩罚，我被判终身采石。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks groans slightly, his claws tapping on the counter. “No. That’s not quite right. As far as they know I am still very much present, albeit preoccupied.” The Anat stops his digits from tapping, sighing from behind his mask. “I was to die, you see. Sentenced to a lifetime breaking rocks as punishment for my crimes.”"

rows.original: “Crimes?” You look the tall man up and down.
rows.translation: “犯罪？”你上下打量着这个高大男人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Crimes?” You look the tall man up and down."

rows.original: “You were a prisoner? That’s horrible...”
rows.translation: “你曾是囚犯？太可怕了...”
rows.raw: " “You were a prisoner? That’s horrible...”"

rows.original: “Get caught with your hand in the cookie jar or something?”
rows.translation: “是偷东西时被当场抓住了，还是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: " “Get caught with your hand in the cookie jar or something?”"

rows.original: “You did time? That’s surprising.”
rows.translation: “你坐过牢？真让人意外。”
rows.raw: " “You did time? That’s surprising.”"

rows.original: “Ehh. It was what it was. I managed to escape, clearly, and chose to leave the Empire,” his tone is somber, almost sad. “I keep in contact with some friends I met during my time imprisoned. They chose to stay, despite the possible consequences. They are still to this day my most lucrative customers.”
rows.translation: “呃。事情就是那样。我显然设法逃了出来，并选择离开帝国，”他的语气阴沉，几乎有些悲伤。“我一直和服刑期间结识的一些朋友保持联系。尽管可能面对严重后果，他们仍选择留下。直到今天，他们依然是我最有利可图的客户。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehh. It was what it was. I managed to escape, clearly, and chose to leave the Empire,” his tone is somber, almost sad. “I keep in contact with some friends I met during my time imprisoned. They chose to stay, despite the possible consequences. They are still to this day my most lucrative customers.” "

rows.original: “Wait...” You look at the containers around you, thinking on some of the contents you’ve seen sticking out. “You move contraband into the Empire?”
rows.translation: “等等...”你环顾周围的集装箱，想起自己见过从里面露出的某些东西。“你把违禁品运进帝国？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait...” You look at the containers around you, thinking on some of the contents you’ve seen sticking out. “You move contraband into the Empire?”"

rows.original: You know first hand that isn’t just impressive, it’s nearly impossible.
rows.translation: 你亲身知道，这不只是了不起，根本近乎不可能。
rows.raw: " You know first hand that isn’t just impressive, it’s nearly impossible."

rows.original: Vulriks laughs. “Oh yes. My people have a voracious appetite for many things that are typically, ehh, not available.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯笑了。“哦，当然。我的人民对许多通常，呃，无法获得的东西有着旺盛的胃口。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks laughs. “Oh yes. My people have a voracious appetite for many things that are typically, ehh, not available.” "

rows.original: You can’t hide your surprise at the brazen declaration. Vulriks’ operation is far more impressive than you thought. Smuggling and selling goods in the Anatae Empire is no joke, and one of the most serious crimes you can think of. At least as far as the Empire is concerned...
rows.translation: 你无法掩饰自己对这番大胆宣言的惊讶。沃尔里克斯的生意远比你想象中更厉害。在阿纳泰帝国走私和销售货物绝非儿戏，也是你能想到的最严重罪行之一。至少在帝国眼里是这样...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t hide your surprise at the brazen declaration. Vulriks’ operation is far more impressive than you thought. Smuggling and selling goods in the Anatae Empire is no joke, and one of the most serious crimes you can think of. At least as far as the Empire is concerned..."

rows.original: From behind his mask, Vulriks chuckles softly, clearly sensing your shock. “Surprised? My business started by indulging my people’s vices. I cannot put a price on that, Per. It is the greatest service I can provide for them, despite my current situation.” Vulriks seems content, and if you had to guess you’d say behind his mask he must be smiling.
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯在面具后轻声发笑，显然察觉到了你的震惊。“很惊讶？我的生意始于满足人民的嗜好。佩尔，这件事无法用金钱衡量。尽管我如今处境特殊，这是我能为他们提供的最大帮助。”沃尔里克斯看起来心满意足；若要猜测，你觉得面具后的他一定正在微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom behind his mask, Vulriks chuckles softly, clearly sensing your shock. “Surprised? My business started by indulging my people’s vices. I cannot put a price on that, Per. It is the greatest service I can provide for them, despite my current situation.” Vulriks seems content, and if you had to guess you’d say behind his mask he must be smiling. "

rows.original: Despite being bad business, you understand his motivations. About to let the topic drop, you remember something you didn’t get an answer about. “You never told me, why were you imprisoned in the first place?”
rows.translation: 尽管这并非明智的生意，你仍理解他的动机。正准备结束这个话题时，你想起还有件事没得到答案。“你一直没告诉我，当初为什么会被关起来？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite being bad business, you understand his motivations. About to let the topic drop, you remember something you didn’t get an answer about. “You never told me, why were you imprisoned in the first place?” "

rows.original: Vulriks doesn’t answer at first, his blue eyes narrowing behind his mask. “Ehh, a topic for another time. Another tale that needs, the proper... context. Did you have something else you wanted to discuss?”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯起初没有回答，面具后的蓝眼睛眯了起来。“呃，这个话题改天再谈。又是一个需要适当...背景才能讲清楚的故事。你还有别的事想谈吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks doesn’t answer at first, his blue eyes narrowing behind his mask. “Ehh, a topic for another time. Another tale that needs, the proper... context. Did you have something else you wanted to discuss?”"

rows.original: “So why set up shop in a place like this?”
rows.translation: “那为什么要在这种地方开店？”
rows.raw: "“So why set up shop in a place like this?”"

rows.original: Vulriks rolls his eyes. “Where else could I conduct my business? When dealing with pirates, one must be where the pirates are.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯翻了个白眼。“不然我还能在哪里做生意？要和海盗打交道，就得待在海盗出没的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks rolls his eyes. “Where else could I conduct my business? When dealing with pirates, one must be where the pirates are.”"

rows.original: “Fair enough...” you cede the point, but remain unsatisfied with this answer.
rows.translation: “有道理...”你承认这一点，却仍对这个答案不太满意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fair enough...” you cede the point, but remain unsatisfied with this answer."

rows.original: As if reading your mind, Vulriks offers some clarification. “I realize this place is rather... ehh...” he searches for the correct word a moment, his blue eyes wandering. “Unstable. But it’s the best for my needs. Sure, I live under the constant threat of being stabbed and robbed, but I fear for the fate of the poor soul who does this to me.”
rows.translation: 仿佛读懂了你的心思，沃尔里克斯又作出一些解释。“我知道这个地方相当...呃...”他寻找了片刻合适的词语，蓝色眼睛游移不定。“不稳定。但它最符合我的需要。没错，我一直面临被捅伤和抢劫的威胁，但真有人敢对我动手，我反倒替那个可怜虫的命运担忧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs if reading your mind, Vulriks offers some clarification. “I realize this place is rather... ehh...” he searches for the correct word a moment, his blue eyes wandering. “Unstable. But it’s the best for my needs. Sure, I live under the constant threat of being stabbed and robbed, but I fear for the fate of the poor soul who does this to me.”"

rows.original: You eyeball the blaster on his hip. “You must think pretty highly of yourself.”
rows.translation: 你瞥了一眼他腰间的爆能枪。“你一定很看得起自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou eyeball the blaster on his hip. “You must think pretty highly of yourself.”"

rows.original: Following your gaze, Vulriks chuckles. “You misunderstand, Steele. I am not the danger, the gangs are.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯顺着你的视线看去，轻声笑了。“你误会了，斯蒂尔。危险的不是我，而是那些帮派。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFollowing your gaze, Vulriks chuckles. “You misunderstand, Steele. I am not the danger, the gangs are.”"

rows.original: Vulriks leans in close, elbows on the table. “I am a major source of income for the pirates, you see. Sure, much of their stolen wares they can pawn off anywhere. But whom else would buy a stolen box of pornography or a stretched out well worn pair of panties?” Vulriks raises a hand, waving a single long digit in the air. “Only me. So, the gangs leave me alone. And if any try to bother me, well, let’s just say a few teeth get knocked loose.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯靠近过来，双肘撑在桌上。“你看，我是海盗的一大收入来源。当然，他们抢来的许多货物随处都能销赃。但还有谁会买一箱偷来的色情制品，或是一条被撑松、穿得破旧不堪的内裤？”沃尔里克斯抬起一只手，用一根修长手指在空中摆动。“只有我。所以那些帮派不会打扰我。要是有人想找我麻烦，嗯，就这么说吧，他们会掉几颗牙。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks leans in close, elbows on the table. “I am a major source of income for the pirates, you see. Sure, much of their stolen wares they can pawn off anywhere. But whom else would buy a stolen box of pornography or a stretched out well worn pair of panties?” Vulriks raises a hand, waving a single long digit in the air. “Only me. So, the gangs leave me alone. And if any try to bother me, well, let’s just say a few teeth get knocked loose.”"

rows.original: You nod, understanding the situation. “So... what kind of price do you get for stretched out panties in the Empire?”
rows.translation: 你点点头，理解了其中情形。“所以...在帝国，一条被撑松的内裤能卖多少钱？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, understanding the situation. “So... what kind of price do you get for stretched out panties in the Empire?”"

rows.original: Vulriks chuckles and pulls himself off the counter. “Depends on the musk.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯轻笑着直起身，离开柜台。“得看上面的体味。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks chuckles and pulls himself off the counter. “Depends on the musk.”"

rows.original: “So what was with all the posturing before?”
rows.translation: “所以刚才那番摆架子是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: "“So what was with all the posturing before?”"

rows.original: Vulriks cocks his head. “What do you-” suddenly his blue eyes go wide. “Oh! You mean... ah, yes, well it is a force of habit you see.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯歪起头。“你说什——”他的蓝眼睛突然睁大。“哦！你是说...啊，对，嗯，你看，那是习惯使然。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks cocks his head. “What do you-” suddenly his blue eyes go wide. “Oh! You mean... ah, yes, well it is a force of habit you see.”"

rows.original: “Something from your prison days?” You let out a coy smile, hoping the jest will land.
rows.translation: “监狱生活留下的习惯？”你露出狡黠的笑容，希望这个玩笑能奏效。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something from your prison days?” You let out a coy smile, hoping the jest will land."

rows.original: An eye roll tells you the Anat gets the joke, but doesn’t particularly find it funny. “From my freedom days. Back home, females are in short supply, so males must take what we can get. Not to mention we Anatae are always... passionate lovers.”
rows.translation: 阿纳泰人翻了个白眼，说明他听懂了笑话，只是并不觉得特别好笑。“是自由生活留下的习惯。在故乡，女性十分稀少，所以男性只能尽力争取。更何况，我们阿纳泰人总是...充满激情的情人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAn eye roll tells you the Anat gets the joke, but doesn’t particularly find it funny. “From my freedom days. Back home, females are in short supply, so males must take what we can get. Not to mention we Anatae are always... passionate lovers.”"

rows.original: Vulriks lifts himself up to his full height, reminding you just how much he slouches. “So, a bit of ritual decides the order of things. Since I am so, ehh, gifted, I rarely found occasion to dine on pillow.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯挺直身躯，展现出全部身高，也让你再次意识到他平时驼背得有多厉害。“所以，一点仪式便能决定事情的先后次序。既然我如此，呃，天赋异禀，就很少需要去‘享用枕头’。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks lifts himself up to his full height, reminding you just how much he slouches. “So, a bit of ritual decides the order of things. Since I am so, ehh, gifted, I rarely found occasion to dine on pillow.”"

rows.original: “Dine on what?” You’re almost tempted to check to see if your translator got that right.
rows.translation: “享用什么？”你几乎想检查一下翻译器是不是弄错了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dine on what?” You’re almost tempted to check to see if your translator got that right."

rows.original: Vulriks blinks. “Is that not the phrase?”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯眨了眨眼。“难道不是这个说法吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks blinks. “Is that not the phrase?”"

rows.original: You can’t help but chuckle, understanding what he was trying to say. “It’s close... who taught you that one?”
rows.translation: 你忍不住轻笑，明白了他想表达什么。“差不多...谁教你这么说的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but chuckle, understanding what he was trying to say. “It’s close... who taught you that one?”"

rows.original: “A member of a local gang. She was an enthusiastic pillow eater, despite being quite endowed herself.” Vulriks chuckles and shakes his head. “Truth be told. I think I spend more intimate time with those with pricks than without.”
rows.translation: “当地帮派的一名成员。尽管她自己也相当有料，却是个热衷于‘吃枕头’的人。”沃尔里克斯轻笑着摇了摇头。“说实话，我觉得自己和有肉棒的人亲热的时间，比和没有肉棒的人更多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A member of a local gang. She was an enthusiastic pillow eater, despite being quite endowed herself.” Vulriks chuckles and shakes his head. “Truth be told. I think I spend more intimate time with those with pricks than without.”"

rows.original: You ask the Anat why he thinks that is.
rows.translation: 你问这个阿纳泰人，他觉得这是为什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask the Anat why he thinks that is."

rows.original: Vulriks shrugs. “We have an expression back home. ‘Pussy is costly, but cock is free’. Since I’m not too picky, I think it just so happens that more cock comes to my door than pussy.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯耸了耸肩。“我们故乡有句话：‘小穴代价高昂，肉棒却唾手可得。’既然我不太挑剔，大概只是找上门来的肉棒碰巧比小穴更多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks shrugs. “We have an expression back home. ‘Pussy is costly, but cock is free’. Since I’m not too picky, I think it just so happens that more cock comes to my door than pussy.”"

rows.original: You roll your eyes, but do see some wisdom in the proverb.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼，却也看出这句谚语有些道理。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes, but do see some wisdom in the proverb."

rows.original: “So, you ever gonna tell me what you did to get locked up?”
rows.translation: “所以，你到底会不会告诉我，自己做了什么才被关起来？”
rows.raw: "“So, you ever gonna tell me what you did to get locked up?”"

rows.original: Vulriks considers your question, his clawed digits tapping the counter. “I was left to hard labor, not so much locked up.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯考虑着你的问题，带爪的手指轻敲柜台。“我是被判去做苦役，倒不算被关起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks considers your question, his clawed digits tapping the counter. “I was left to hard labor, not so much locked up.”"

rows.original: You wave you air in the air dismissively. “Right, right. I remember. But you didn’t answer my question.”
rows.translation: 你不以为意地在空中挥了挥手。“对，对。我记得。但你还没回答我的问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wave you air in the air dismissively. “Right, right. I remember. But you didn’t answer my question.”"

rows.original: Silence hangs in the air for a moment.
rows.translation: 空气中沉默了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nSilence hangs in the air for a moment."

rows.original: “Fine. I will tell you, so long as you promise to, ehh, keep an open mind. Can you do this?”
rows.translation: “好吧。我会告诉你，只要你答应，呃，保持开放的心态。你能做到吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine. I will tell you, so long as you promise to, ehh, keep an open mind. Can you do this?”"

rows.original: Promise
rows.translation: 答应
rows.raw: "Promise"

rows.original: Can’t Promise
rows.translation: 无法保证
rows.raw: "Can’t Promise"

rows.original: “Ah, thank you...” Vulriks shifts his weight from one foot to the other. “Well, how do I explain...”
rows.translation: “啊，谢谢你...”沃尔里克斯把身体重心从一只脚移到另一只。“嗯，该怎么解释呢...”
rows.raw: "“Ah, thank you...” Vulriks shifts his weight from one foot to the other. “Well, how do I explain...”"

rows.original: Watching his body language closely, you can tell your tall friend is uncomfortable as he searches for an explanation. He fidgets uncontrollably, scratching the side of his neck absentmindedly with his clawed digits.
rows.translation: 你仔细观察他的肢体动作，看得出这位高大的朋友在寻找解释时十分不自在。他控制不住地动来动去，带爪的手指无意识地挠着颈侧。
rows.raw: "\n\nWatching his body language closely, you can tell your tall friend is uncomfortable as he searches for an explanation. He fidgets uncontrollably, scratching the side of his neck absentmindedly with his clawed digits. "

rows.original: “Back home, in the Empire, there is, ehh, pressure for young...” Vulriks’ blue eyes lock onto yours, forcing him to pause.
rows.translation: “在故乡，在帝国，年轻人会面临，呃，某种压力...”沃尔里克斯的蓝眼睛与你四目相对，迫使他停了下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Back home, in the Empire, there is, ehh, pressure for young...” Vulriks’ blue eyes lock onto yours, forcing him to pause. "

rows.original: A few long heartbeats pass.
rows.translation: 几次漫长的心跳过去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few long heartbeats pass."

rows.original: Suddenly, Vulriks groans and rolls his eyes. “Okay, okay. Plainly then. I was charged with a few things, but the main crime was kidnapping, but!” Vulriks waves his clawed hands in the air. “But! I assure you this was not the case! It was not really kidnapping you see...”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯突然呻吟一声，翻了个白眼。“好吧，好吧。那就直说。我被指控了好几项罪名，但主要罪名是绑架，不过！”沃尔里克斯在空中挥舞着带爪的双手。“不过！我向你保证，事情并不是那样！你看，那其实并不算绑架...”
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, Vulriks groans and rolls his eyes. “Okay, okay. Plainly then. I was charged with a few things, but the main crime was kidnapping, but!” Vulriks waves his clawed hands in the air. “But! I assure you this was not the case! It was not really kidnapping you see...”"

rows.original: “Hm.” As far as you can tell he’s telling the truth, and since you promised not to judge, you let him explain himself.
rows.translation: “嗯。”据你判断，他说的是实话，而且既然答应不会评判，你便让他继续解释。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm.” As far as you can tell he’s telling the truth, and since you promised not to judge, you let him explain himself."

rows.original: Vulriks clears his throat, and behind his mask you hear an odd smacking sound. “It was my daughter, you see.”
rows.translation: 沃尔里克斯清了清嗓子，你听见他的面具后传来一声古怪的咂嘴声。“你看，那是我的女儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\nVulriks clears his throat, and behind his mask you hear an odd smacking sound. “It was my daughter, you see.”"

rows.original: You can’t hide your surprise. “You have a kid? How come you never mentioned it before?”
rows.translation: 你掩饰不住自己的惊讶。“你有孩子？以前怎么从没提过？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t hide your surprise. “You have a kid? How come you never mentioned it before?”"

rows.original: The tall Anat chuckles half heartedly. “I have many children. A stud like me? Families lined their daughters up for even a chance at my genes.” Vulriks shakes his head and continues. “Falia was... different from my other children. She was bright, wise in ways adults nary are. While the rest of the clutch she was born with were still wetting themselves, she was already learning to read. She was... not meant for the life she was to live.”

rows.original: She rubs the back of her neck thoughtfully. “It’s actually getting to be kind of a problem! I should probably start giving away some of my duplicates. Maybe have a promotional give-away day at the Tap-Hall.”
rows.translation: 她若有所思地揉着后颈。“其实这都快成问题了！我也许该把一些重复收藏送出去。说不定可以在龙头大厅办一次宣传赠送日。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rubs the back of her neck thoughtfully. “It’s actually getting to be kind of a problem! I should probably start giving away some of my duplicates. Maybe have a promotional give-away day at the Tap-Hall.”"

rows.original: “How’s this: ‘Cherry’ isn’t my real name. Shocking, I know. I chose it when I became a pirate because I wanted something that sounded sweet and unassuming but could also be deadly and poisoned by, like, an evil queen.” She gives a wicked grin and wiggles her toxic fingers menacingly.
rows.translation: “这样如何：‘切莉’并不是我的真名。很震惊吧。我当上海盗时选了这个名字，因为我想要一个听起来甜美无害，却也可能致命、还会被邪恶女王之类的人下毒的名字。”她邪恶地咧嘴笑着，威胁般晃动有毒的手指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’s this: ‘Cherry’ isn’t my real name. Shocking, I know. I chose it when I became a pirate because I wanted something that sounded sweet and unassuming but could also be deadly and poisoned by, like, an evil queen.” She gives a wicked grin and wiggles her toxic fingers menacingly."

rows.original: You’re pretty sure she was thinking of a poisoned apple, but no sense in bringing it up this late in the game.
rows.translation: 你几乎可以肯定她想到的是毒苹果，不过事到如今也没必要指出来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re pretty sure she was thinking of a poisoned apple, but no sense in bringing it up this late in the game."

rows.original: “This is kind of embarrassing, but my first crime was breaking and entering. Not to steal anything, really. See, the home belonged to this kui-tan couple and, well, let’s just say they’d installed the extra large pipes for their private milking station. I basically lived there for a month until one of them heard me making yummy noises one day.”
rows.translation: “这事有点丢脸，但我犯下的第一桩罪是非法入室。其实不是为了偷东西。那栋房子属于一对狸猫夫妇，而且，这么说吧，他们给私人挤奶站装了特大号管道。我基本上在那里住了一个月，直到有一天，其中一人听见我发出好吃得要命的声音。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is kind of embarrassing, but my first crime was breaking and entering. Not to steal anything, really. See, the home belonged to this kui-tan couple and, well, let’s just say they’d installed the extra large pipes for their private milking station. I basically lived there for a month until one of them heard me making yummy noises one day.”"

rows.original: You’d almost swear she’s blushing through all the red. “Yeah, yeah, I was a dummy alright. I still hold that it’s inexcusably wasteful. That’s why I’ve got galotians on staff to clean up around here. Waste not, want not.”
rows.translation: 你几乎敢说，透过满身红色都能看出她在脸红。“好啦好啦，我当时确实是个傻瓜。我仍然认为那样浪费实在不可原谅。所以我才雇了加洛提安人负责这里的清洁。物尽其用，才不会匮乏。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d almost swear she’s blushing through all the red. “Yeah, yeah, I was a dummy alright. I still hold that it’s inexcusably wasteful. That’s why I’ve got galotians on staff to clean up around here. Waste not, want not.”"

rows.original: “This might seem weird, but I kinda think the whole slaving thing we do is actually good for the people we capture. Sure, some of the people around here are a bit excessive, but it’s better we grab them then somebody like the Black Void, or one of those psychopathic mad scientists you hear about.”
rows.translation: “这听起来可能很怪，但我多少觉得，我们做的奴隶生意其实对被抓的人有好处。当然，这里有些人确实过火了点，但由我们抓走，总比落到黑暗虚空，或者传闻里那些精神变态的疯狂科学家手里强。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This might seem weird, but I kinda think the whole slaving thing we do is actually good for the people we capture. Sure, some of the people around here are a bit excessive, but it’s better we grab them then somebody like the Black Void, or one of those psychopathic mad scientists you hear about.”"

rows.original: “Besides, there’s always plenty of folk eager to make sure the slaves get three square meals a day,” she adds, pulling one of the cum bubbles from her belt and popping it into her mouth.
rows.translation: “而且，总有很多人热衷于确保奴隶一日三餐吃得饱饱的，”她补充道，从腰带上摘下一枚精液泡，塞进嘴里。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Besides, there’s always plenty of folk eager to make sure the slaves get three square meals a day,” she adds, pulling one of the cum bubbles from her belt and popping it into her mouth."

rows.original: “Don’t get me wrong, it’s mighty handy having a body that generates its own weapon, but sometimes the whole toxic part of being a zel’rahn is more trouble than it’s worth. One little mistake and the erotic tingle you meant to go for turns into a narcoleptic coma. Never got a call back after THAT date.”
rows.translation: “别误会，拥有一具能自行制造武器的身体确实非常方便，但身为泽尔·拉恩，有时候这份毒性带来的麻烦比好处还多。只要犯个小错，本想制造的色情酥麻就会变成嗜睡性昏迷。那次约会之后，对方再也没联系过我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t get me wrong, it’s mighty handy having a body that generates its own weapon, but sometimes the whole toxic part of being a zel’rahn is more trouble than it’s worth. One little mistake and the erotic tingle you meant to go for turns into a narcoleptic coma. Never got a call back after THAT date.”"

rows.original: She taps her chin thoughtfully. “I’ve always thought it would’ve been sweet to be a loo’rahn with their super fast body sculpting. Give yourself a different face for every day of the week,” she muses, trailing off.
rows.translation: 她若有所思地点着下巴。“我一直觉得，如果能成为拥有超高速塑形能力的鲁·拉恩，一定很棒。一周七天，每天给自己换一张脸，”她沉思着，声音渐渐低了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps her chin thoughtfully. “I’ve always thought it would’ve been sweet to be a loo’rahn with their super fast body sculpting. Give yourself a different face for every day of the week,” she muses, trailing off."

rows.original: “Obviously cum is my jam,” she notes, adjusting her filled-condom belt, “but you know rahn can eat pretty much anything organic, yeah? If it’s got DNA, it’s A-OK, or something along those lines.”
rows.translation: “精液显然是我的最爱，”她一边整理装满避孕套的腰带一边说道，“不过你知道，拉恩几乎什么有机物都能吃，对吧？只要有DNA，就完全没问题，大概是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Obviously cum is my jam,” she notes, adjusting her filled-condom belt, “but you know rahn can eat pretty much anything organic, yeah? If it’s got DNA, it’s A-OK, or something along those lines.”"

rows.original: “Anyway, this may seem weird, but I actually can’t stand fruits. Yet, if you turn them into a wine, I like that just fine. I don’t know why! The best though, is a good, hard liquor. I don’t generally get a chance to go off-duty, but plenty of the gangers get pretty sauced before coming here, so I get a little second-hand enjoyment from time to time.”
rows.translation: “总之，这可能听起来很怪，但我真的受不了水果。可要是把水果酿成酒，我就很喜欢。我也不知道为什么！不过最棒的还是烈酒。我通常没什么机会下班，但很多帮派成员来这里前都会喝得烂醉，所以偶尔也能让我间接享受一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, this may seem weird, but I actually can’t stand fruits. Yet, if you turn them into a wine, I like that just fine. I don’t know why! The best though, is a good, hard liquor. I don’t generally get a chance to go off-duty, but plenty of the gangers get pretty sauced before coming here, so I get a little second-hand enjoyment from time to time.”"

rows.original: “Before I signed up with the Cyber Punks, I used to pull jobs with the cutest little go’rahn you’ve ever seen. She was a master at putting people off guard long enough for me to get in there and neutralize any threats. And you wouldn’t believe how much she jizzed when you got her riled up! I swear that girl was hiding an ocean somewhere inside her.”
rows.translation: “加入赛博朋克之前，我曾和你见过的最可爱的小戈·拉恩一起干活。她很会让人放松警惕，给我时间上前排除所有威胁。你绝对想不到她兴奋起来时能喷出多少精液！我发誓，那姑娘身体里一定藏着一片海。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Before I signed up with the Cyber Punks, I used to pull jobs with the cutest little go’rahn you’ve ever seen. She was a master at putting people off guard long enough for me to get in there and neutralize any threats. And you wouldn’t believe how much she jizzed when you got her riled up! I swear that girl was hiding an ocean somewhere inside her.”"

rows.original: Cherry laughs in her reminisce, absently fingering the thick loop serving as a hair band for her ponytail. “Anyway, that partnership ended and I came to Zhèng Shi soon after. Still fond of the color white, though.”
rows.translation: 切莉回忆着笑了起来，漫不经心地摆弄着绑住马尾的粗环。“总之，那段搭档关系结束后不久，我就来到了郑石。不过我到现在还是很喜欢白色。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCherry laughs in her reminisce, absently fingering the thick loop serving as a hair band for her ponytail. “Anyway, that partnership ended and I came to Zhèng Shi soon after. Still fond of the color white, though.”"

rows.original: “Don’t judge me too harshly, but when I first set this thing up, I was the only one in the wall. Greedy of me, I know! Anyway, I got fed plenty and it was loads of fun, but all these damned pirates kept skimping on the whole ‘payment’ part of the deal. More innocent times.”
rows.translation: “别太严厉地评判我，但我刚开这地方的时候，墙里只有我一个。是挺贪心的，我知道！总之，我吃得很饱，也玩得很开心，可这些该死的海盗总在‘付费’这件事上偷工减料。那真是段纯真的时光。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t judge me too harshly, but when I first set this thing up, I was the only one in the wall. Greedy of me, I know! Anyway, I got fed plenty and it was loads of fun, but all these damned pirates kept skimping on the whole ‘payment’ part of the deal. More innocent times.”"

rows.original: “So, I invested everything I had in a camera equipment and used the recordings to track down the cheapskates. It turns out that I enjoyed watching myself getting fucked nearly as much as actually being there in the first place. The things we learn about ourselves,” she laughs, staring a bit too intensely at one of the in-use booths.
rows.translation: “于是，我把全部家当都投进摄像设备里，用录像追查那些占便宜的家伙。结果发现，比起亲自在墙里挨操，我看自己被操的录像几乎同样享受。人总会发现自己不为人知的一面，”她笑道，过分专注地盯着一个正在使用的隔间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, I invested everything I had in a camera equipment and used the recordings to track down the cheapskates. It turns out that I enjoyed watching myself getting fucked nearly as much as actually being there in the first place. The things we learn about ourselves,” she laughs, staring a bit too intensely at one of the in-use booths."

rows.original: “If I’m being really, REALLY honest? I had a bit of a bias against non-amorphs in my youth. I kinda treated them like walking dinner plates. You’ve probably heard how solid races see Rahn and galotians as sort of cum-hungry sluts? From our side of it, that’s usually just the only thing we see other races as being good for. Cultural misunderstandings, I guess. Anyway, I’m past that.”
rows.translation: “要我真的、真的坦白吗？年轻时，我对非无定形种族多少有点偏见。我有点把他们当作会走路的餐盘。你大概听说过，固态种族总觉得拉恩和加洛提安人是一群渴求精液的荡妇吧？从我们的角度看，通常也只觉得其他种族在这方面有用。我猜这就是文化误解。总之，我已经改了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If I’m being really, REALLY honest? I had a bit of a bias against non-amorphs in my youth. I kinda treated them like walking dinner plates. You’ve probably heard how solid races see Rahn and galotians as sort of cum-hungry sluts? From our side of it, that’s usually just the only thing we see other races as being good for. Cultural misunderstandings, I guess. Anyway, I’m past that.”"

rows.original: You’re tempted to point out that her entire hall here is entirely devoted to treating people like meat, but you’re not sure she’d appreciate the irony of it. Maybe she’ll get there on her own one day.
rows.translation: 你很想指出，她整座大厅存在的目的，就是把人当成肉来对待，但你不确定她能否欣赏其中的讽刺。也许总有一天她会自己想明白。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re tempted to point out that her entire hall here is entirely devoted to treating people like meat, but you’re not sure she’d appreciate the irony of it. Maybe she’ll get there on her own one day."

rows.original: “You know what’s fucked up? I could sit here watching people rutting all day long - and, in fact, that’s exactly what I do - but porn does nothing for me. There’s just something different about knowing the fucking is done right here, instead of on some sound stage in some studio.”
rows.translation: “你知道最操蛋的是什么吗？我可以整天坐在这里看人交配——事实上，我确实就是这么干的——可色情影片却完全提不起我的兴趣。知道这些性爱就发生在这里，而不是某间摄影棚的布景上，感觉就是不一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know what’s fucked up? I could sit here watching people rutting all day long - and, in fact, that’s exactly what I do - but porn does nothing for me. There’s just something different about knowing the fucking is done right here, instead of on some sound stage in some studio.”"

rows.original: She taps her VR glasses and lowers her voice. “Pretty much everything I watch with these puppies are recordings from surveillance systems on the station.” She glances down, then back up at you, raising her eyebrows meaningfully.
rows.translation: 她敲敲自己的VR眼镜，压低声音。“我用这对宝贝看的，基本上全是空间站监控系统的录像。”她低头看了一眼，又抬头望向你，意味深长地挑起眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps her VR glasses and lowers her voice. “Pretty much everything I watch with these puppies are recordings from surveillance systems on the station.” She glances down, then back up at you, raising her eyebrows meaningfully."

rows.original: Cherry shares a brief snippet of her life, talking about raids she’s been on, partners she’s worked with, and interesting patrons who’ve visited her Tap-Hall. Though affable, you’re struck by how she legitimately doesn’t seem to feel bad about any of the criminal things she’s done over the years.
rows.translation: 切莉简短分享了一些人生片段，谈到自己参加过的劫掠、合作过的搭档，以及造访过龙头大厅的有趣顾客。她虽然和蔼可亲，但你惊讶地发现，她似乎真的丝毫不为这些年来犯下的罪行感到愧疚。
rows.raw: "\n\nCherry shares a brief snippet of her life, talking about raids she’s been on, partners she’s worked with, and interesting patrons who’ve visited her Tap-Hall. Though affable, you’re struck by how she legitimately doesn’t seem to feel bad about any of the criminal things she’s done over the years."

rows.original: The only things she never mentions is why she went into piracy in the first place, and how she originally lost her legs.
rows.translation: 她唯一从未提及的，是自己当初为何成为海盗，以及最开始是怎样失去双腿的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe only things she never mentions is why she went into piracy in the first place, and how she originally lost her legs."

rows.translation: 你问她，除了观看之外，她整天究竟在做些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what exactly she does all day, other than watch."

rows.original: “The fiddly bits of the business don’t really take all that much time. I’ll check in new arrivals and get them plugged in sometimes, or release people whose contracts have run their course. Boring stuff like that.”
rows.translation: “生意里那些琐碎事务其实花不了多少时间。有时我会给新到的人办理手续，把他们接进设备；或者释放合约已经到期的人。都是这种无聊的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The fiddly bits of the business don’t really take all that much time. I’ll check in new arrivals and get them plugged in sometimes, or release people whose contracts have run their course. Boring stuff like that.”"

rows.original: She holds a hand out, studying her perpetually wet fingertips. “Oh, there are rare cases where somebody feels like getting a free sample, damaging the equipment, or attempting to make off with merchandise itself.”
rows.translation: 她伸出一只手，端详永远湿漉漉的指尖。“哦，偶尔也有人想尝免费样品、损坏设备，或者试图直接把商品带走。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe holds a hand out, studying her perpetually wet fingertips. “Oh, there are rare cases where somebody feels like getting a free sample, damaging the equipment, or attempting to make off with merchandise itself.”"

rows.original: Her expression hardens for a moment. “I find a tap on the shoulder tends to discourage repeat offenders. And, of course, they can always pay off their debt with a contract of their own.”
rows.translation: 她的表情一瞬间冷了下来。“我发现，在肩膀上轻拍一下，通常就能阻止他们再犯。当然，他们也总能签下自己的合约，用来偿清债务。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer expression hardens for a moment. “I find a tap on the shoulder tends to discourage repeat offenders. And, of course, they can always pay off their debt with a contract of their own.”"

rows.original: Her easy smile returns, though her ponytail sways like the tail of a venomous predator.
rows.translation: 她轻松的笑容重新浮现，只是那条马尾像剧毒捕食者的尾巴一样摆动着。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer easy smile returns, though her ponytail sways like the tail of a venomous predator."

rows.translation: “嗯，手术风险很高，但我觉得很值得。”切莉拍了拍双腿，认同地点头。“这对坏家伙里面能塞下好多拉恩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, it was a risky operation, but I think it was worth it.” Cherry gives them a slap and nods to herself. “These bad boys can fit so much rahn in them.”"

rows.original: Cherry catches you looking her mechanical legs and folds her arms under her breasts. “Hey. Goo’s up here,” she teases.
rows.translation: 切莉发现你在看她的机械腿，便把双臂交叉在乳房下。“嘿。黏液在上面呢，”她调侃道。
rows.raw: "Cherry catches you looking her mechanical legs and folds her arms under her breasts. “Hey. Goo’s up here,” she teases."

rows.original: You thought rahn could regenerate just about any injury, so you’re not really sure why one would be using cybernetics.
rows.translation: 你原以为拉恩几乎什么伤都能再生，所以不太明白为什么会有拉恩使用义体。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thought rahn could regenerate just about any injury, so you’re not really sure why one would be using cybernetics."

rows.original: “Don’t tell the Cyber Punks that, or they might kick me out,” she whispers, a finger pressed to her glossy black lips.
rows.translation: “别把这话告诉赛博朋克，不然他们可能会把我踢出去，”她把一根手指按在闪亮的黑唇上，低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t tell the Cyber Punks that, or they might kick me out,” she whispers, a finger pressed to her glossy black lips."

rows.original: You admit it does seem like it’d be helpful to have something metallic on hand. Or on-foot, rather.
rows.translation: 你承认，手边有点金属似乎确实很有用。或者该说，脚边。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admit it does seem like it’d be helpful to have something metallic on hand. Or on-foot, rather."

rows.original: “You mean when I need to put my size 20s up somebody’s ass? Yeah. Or when I really need to scoot. These gams got some get up and go,” she brags, lifting her knees like she’s stretching for a runner’s start, sending booming clangs through the hall with each footfall. rows.raw: "\n\n“You mean when I need to put my size 20s up somebody’s ass? Yeah. Or when I really need to scoot. These gams got some get up and go,” she brags, lifting her knees like she’s stretching for a runner’s start, sending booming clangs through the hall with each footfall. A few patrons turn to look, but most of them seem accustomed to the ruckus."

rows.original: If only it were that easy for everybody to get cybernetics, you lament.
rows.translation: 你感叹，要是每个人都能这么轻松获得义体就好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf only it were that easy for everybody to get cybernetics, you lament."

rows.original: “Amorph privilege,” she brags, jiggling her hips in their socketed seats.
rows.translation: “无定形种族特权，”她一边吹嘘，一边在腿部承座中扭动臀部。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Amorph privilege,” she brags, jiggling her hips in their socketed seats."

rows.original: “Though mostly,” she confides with a sly glance, “it’s a question of concentration. If I’m using my own legs, my surface area increases. The bigger I am, the less of an effect my toxin has. rows.original:
You move in closer to the white woman. Even though you’re only a few feet away, she still hasn’t spotted you, the ambient noise masking your approach. It’s not until you’re standing right next to her does she turn to face you.
	
	Tessa’s eyes go wide, like a kid with her hand caught in the cookie jar, then quickly flutter back into a more natural state. Clearing her throat, she speaks so low you can hardly hear her over the din. "Are you fucking serious? What the fuck are you doing here?" 
	
	Slightly taken aback, you examine her a bit more closely. Her body language is closed off, almost like she’s trying to shy away. You can tell she wants you to leave.
	
	"This asshole bothering you, babe?" An unfamiliar voice hisses, quite literally, over your shoulder.
	
	Turning slightly, you match the voice to a new face. A tall, red-scaled slyveren is standing just behind you, scowling. Running your eyes up and down her impressive figure, you’re not sure whether to try and take a guess at her height, or stare at the massive set of tits she’s got hanging off her. Instead, your eyes hone in on what she’s holding in her hands: two glasses of beer.
	
	"It’s fine, Ahsh." Tessa cuts in, her voice betraying nothing. "This is... [pc.name]. An... acquaintance of mine."
	
	"Hm," the tall slyveren’s face softens, although you can still tell she’s not exactly impressed. Her eyes scan you up and down, perhaps sizing you up, or maybe just taking her first real look at you. Glancing over at the smaller woman, she cracks a half smile. "Let me guess: You two’re fucking."
	
	Tessa winces, which elicits a small snort from the red-scaled woman. "Well, this is awkward." She moves to the seat across from Tessa, swinging her heavy tail out as she sits. "Why don’t you join us... [pc.name], was it?" She slides one of the two glasses across to Tessa, whose jaw is twitching noticeably. "Come on, take a load off. I insist."
	
	"Ahsh..." Tessa starts, her voice laced with both annoyance and concern. "But... the thing."
	
	"It’s fine," the taller woman leans back in her chair slightly. "We’ve got to wait for Tinhead anyways. For now I want to get to know more about the kind of company you keep."
	
	Tessa scoops up the glass and immediately brings it to her lips, appearing as if she’s trying to crawl into it and escape. Over the rim, her bright red eyes motion down to the seat beside you. 
	
	The tall slyveren smiles wide, then motions for you to sit. "Don’t be shy."

你走近那个白色女人。尽管只隔几英尺，她仍没发现你，环境噪音掩盖了你的接近。直到你站到她身旁，她才转身面对你。
	
	泰莎双眼睁大，像个把手伸进饼干罐时被抓住的孩子，随后迅速恢复自然。她清清嗓子，声音低得几乎被喧嚣淹没。“你他妈在开玩笑吗？你他妈来这里干什么？”
	
	你略感吃惊，更仔细地打量她。她的肢体语言封闭，几乎像在躲避。你看得出她希望你离开。
	
	“这个混蛋在烦你吗，宝贝？”一个陌生声音从你肩后嘶声问道，字面意义上的嘶声。
	
	你微微转身，将声音与一张新面孔对应起来。一名高挑的红鳞斯莱弗伦人站在你身后，满脸不悦。视线扫过她令人印象深刻的身材，你不知该猜测身高，还是盯着那对沉甸甸垂在身前的巨乳。最终，你的目光锁定她手里拿着的东西：两杯啤酒。
	
	“没事，阿莎。”泰莎插话，声音不露任何情绪。“这是...[pc.name]。我的一个...熟人。”
	
	“嗯。”高挑斯莱弗伦人的脸色柔和下来，虽然你仍看得出她并不怎么满意。她上下扫视你，也许在衡量你，或许只是第一次真正打量。她瞥向矮小些的女人，露出半边笑容。“让我猜猜：你们俩上过床。”
	
	泰莎畏缩了一下，引得红鳞女人轻哼。“这下尴尬了。”她走到泰莎对面的座位，坐下时把沉重尾巴甩开。“不如加入我们吧...[pc.name]，对吗？”她把两杯中的一杯推给泰莎，后者的下巴明显抽动。“来吧，坐下来歇歇。我坚持。”
	
	“阿莎...”泰莎开口，声音里既有烦躁又有担忧。“可是...那件事。”
	
	“没关系，”高挑女人稍稍靠向椅背。“反正得等铁皮脑袋。现在我想多了解一下你平时交往的都是什么人。”
	
	泰莎抓起酒杯立刻送到唇边，仿佛想钻进杯里逃走。越过杯沿，她鲜红的眼睛示意你身旁的座位。
	
	高挑斯莱弗伦人灿烂一笑，随后示意你坐下。“别害羞。”

rows.original: “I’d love a drink.” You say, turning to Tessa and giving her a smile. The white woman blinks, her puffy lips pressing tightly together. After a beat, she smacks her lips and stands. “Alright. I’ll be RIGHT back.” In a huff, Tessa departs for the bar, fast-walking the whole way. “She’s cute when she’s mad,” Ahsha remarks, taking a sip from her drink. “And gods know she’s always mad.” You can’t help but let out a soft chuckle, finding the moment of levity refreshing. “So, tell me, and be honest...” Ahsha leans in close, her bright eyes shining. “Are you here with Tessa?” Suddenly your head feels lighter, the gleam of her eyes putting you at ease, as if everything weighing down your mind is just melting away. Ahsha giggles slightly, reeling in your attention. Fuck, her eyes are really pretty. Something about her is making your [pc.skinFurScales] suddenly feel flushed... Something you can’t quite put your finger on. “Well?” Her voice is low, and suddenly oh so sultry. “Tell me the truth now. Are you with her?”

rows.original: You ask Tessa what she’s doing on Zhèng Shi. Shifting her gaze to you, the white woman lets out a resigned sigh. “Work, of course. Why else would I be in a shithole like this?” Ahsha lets out a small huff, the slyveren giving Tessa a noticeable stink eye. “Why else indeed...” Frowning, Tessa rolls her eyes and continues. “Fucking turns out, pirates and scoundrels are willing to pay good money for other pirates and scoundrels to disappear.” She flicks her eyes back to Ahsha. Ahsha sips her drink, a knowing smirk curling the corners of her mouth. After a beat, she lowers it. “For the record, [pc.name], if I wanted somebody to disappear, I’d do it myself.” Looking at her, you believe it.
rows.translation: 你问泰莎在郑石做什么。 白色女人把目光移向你，无奈地叹了口气。“当然是工作。不然我为什么会待在这种鬼地方？” 阿莎轻哼一声，明显不满地瞪了泰莎一眼。“还能为什么呢...” 泰莎皱眉翻了个白眼，继续说道：“事实他妈证明，海盗和恶棍很愿意花大价钱让其他海盗和恶棍消失。”她又瞥向阿莎。 阿莎喝了一口酒，嘴角勾起心照不宣的坏笑。片刻后，她放下杯子。“郑重声明，[pc.name]，我要是想让谁消失，会自己动手。” 看着她，你相信这句话。
rows.raw: " You ask Tessa what she’s doing on Zhèng Shi. Shifting her gaze to you, the white woman lets out a resigned sigh. “Work, of course. Why else would I be in a shithole like this?” Ahsha lets out a small huff, the slyveren giving Tessa a noticeable stink eye. “Why else indeed...” Frowning, Tessa rolls her eyes and continues. “Fucking turns out, pirates and scoundrels are willing to pay good money for other pirates and scoundrels to disappear.” She flicks her eyes back to Ahsha. Ahsha sips her drink, a knowing smirk curling the corners of her mouth. After a beat, she lowers it. “For the record, [pc.name], if I wanted somebody to disappear, I’d do it myself.” Looking at her, you believe it. "

rows.raw: "Here?"

rows.original: You ask Tessa how she knows Ahsha. The white woman looks at you for a moment, considering the question. “We used to work together,” she answers, shifting her eyes back to the red slyveren. “Years ago, I was on a job that needed some muscle and,” she nods towards Ahsha, “meet the muscle. Anyways, when the job was done we ran together for a few months.” Ahsha smirks. “Oh, don’t be so coy.” She turns to you, her eyes gleaming. “You’re skipping over the best parts.” You notice a vein in Tessa’s forehead twitch, the white-haired woman clearly trying to keep herself in check. “So, [pc.name].” The red-scaled woman turns herself more to face you, blocking out the white woman. “How did you and Tessa meet?” “At a bar on Tarkus.” Tessa answers before you, cutting straight to the truth. “There were beers, a blaster got pointed at somebody’s crotch, and we ended up hitting it off. That’s it.” Ahsha nods, but keeps her eyes on you. “Sounds about right.”

rows.original: You ask Ahsha what she does on Zhèng Shi. “Hm,” her eyes narrow, scrutinizing you. After a long pause she answers. “I guess I’m what you would call an enforcer.” Tessa snorts. “‘Enforcer? Is that what they call what you do?” Ahsha turns her gaze to the white woman, glaring daggers at her for an instant before returning her eyes to you. “I run with a pretty strong crew. We’re sort of a big deal around here.” You notice Tessa frowning as she lifts her glass to her lips. “So,” Ahsha leans in closer to you, her lips curling into a smirk. “Are you like us?” Tessa lowers her glass slowly. “Ahsha...” “Tessa,” Ahsha, glances over at the white woman. “I just want to know how freely we can talk.” “[pc.Name] is here.” Tessa motions around the room. “A literal, fucking pirate base. I’m pretty sure that answers your question.” “Hm.” Ahsha gives you a musing smile, dropping the question.
rows.translation: 你问阿莎在郑石做什么。 “嗯，”她眯起眼审视你。长久沉默后，她回答：“我想，你们会把我叫作执法者。” 泰莎哼了一声。“‘执法者？’你们管你做的事叫这个？” 阿莎把目光转向白色女人，短暂地用刀锋般的眼神瞪她，随后重新看向你。“我跟着一支相当强大的队伍。我们在这一带算得上大人物。” 你注意到泰莎举杯凑向嘴唇时正皱着眉。 “那么，”阿莎更靠近你，唇边卷起坏笑。“你和我们一样吗？” 泰莎慢慢放下杯子。“阿莎...” “泰莎，”阿莎瞥向白色女人。“我只是想知道我们能说得多坦白。” “[pc.Name]就在这里。”泰莎示意整个房间。“一个货真价实、他妈的海盗基地。我想这已经回答你的问题了。” “嗯。”阿莎若有所思地朝你一笑，放弃追问。

rows.original: You ask Ahsha how she knows Tessa. “Oh, well...” Ahsha licks her lips slightly, only the very tip of her tongue poking out from her smiling mouth. “I don’t know if there is a label for it, but Tessa and I spent a few very stimulating months together...” You watch Tessa take a long sip from her drink, glaring over the rim at the red woman. “Hm, tell me...” Ahsha nods towards the pale ovir. “She ever gone down on you?” Tessa chokes slightly, beer running down her cheeks and chin. Ahsha giggles, her eyes gleaming bright. “That tongue stud of hers? She really knows how to use it, don’t you agree?” Coughing, Tessa growls “Can you fucking not?” Throwing up her hands in surrender, Ahsha leans back, dropping the topic. Although, you think you’ve a slightly better understanding about their past regardless.
rows.translation: 你问阿莎怎么认识泰莎。 “噢，这个嘛...”阿莎微微舔唇，只有舌尖从微笑的嘴里探出。“我不知道该用什么关系来定义，不过泰莎和我一起度过了非常刺激的几个月...” 你看着泰莎长饮一口，越过杯沿瞪着红色女人。 “嗯，告诉我...”阿莎朝苍白的奥维尔人点头。“她给你口过吗？” 泰莎呛了一下，啤酒沿脸颊和下巴流淌。 阿莎咯咯笑着，双眼明亮闪耀。“她舌头上的钉饰？她很懂得怎么用，对吧？” 泰莎咳嗽着低吼：“能他妈别说了吗？” 阿莎举手投降，靠回椅背，不再谈这个话题。不过，你觉得自己无论如何都对她们的过去多了几分了解。

rows.raw: "Tessa?"

rows.original: Shifting, Ahsha reaches to her hip, her eyes rolling. Producing a compact codex, you notice a small light on it blinking between her fingers. “That must be Tinhead.” “Tinhead?” you ask, recalling hearing it before. “An associate of ours,” Tessa explains, putting an odd emphasis on the last word. “We call him that because he always wears this ridiculous helmet.” “Always.” Ahsha smirks, her eyes down on her codex. “Even when he’s... not coming...” Tessa raises a brow. “I think you fucked up your punchline.” Ahsha lifts her eyes up from the codex, her mouth curling into a scowl. “No. I mean he’s not fucking coming.” “What?” Tessa’s eyes flutter, genuinely taken aback by the declaration. “Why?” “Another job...” Ahsha checks her codex again, eyes running back and forth. “Duty bound, blah blah blah, made an oath, more blah blah, something about a green bitch... I don’t know. It’s fucking bullshit.” She stuffs the codex away, seething. “He was suppose to be our fucking pointman. Now what the fuck are we supposed to do?” Breathing deep, Tessa crosses her arms over her chest, taking in the bad news. “We’re literally sitting in a pirate den. We can find a replacement.” Snorting, Ansha leans so far back in her seat she tilts it. “Half the shitheads in this place would fuck it up, and the other half would stab us in the fucking back.” Seething, she closes her eyes, plunging herself in thought. “Only dependable contacts I have are too far out to make our window.” Tessa stays quiet for a moment, processing the predicament. Her eyes flick over to you, taking you in with a sidelong glance. “[pc.Name] can fill in.” “What?” You feel your spine straighten, the declaration catching you off guard. You tell the white woman you don’t have any clue what they’re even talking about. Ahsha’s eyes narrow, darting between you and the albino ovir. “Well that’s suspicious.” “What is?” Tessa frowns. Ahsha leans in, her heavy chest pressing against the table slightly. “Tinhead drops out and you just so happen to have a fucking replacement hanging around?” She shoots you a sideways glance.[var0|| “I don’t fucking trust liars.”| “And a tricky one at that.”] Uncrossing her arms, Tessa shrugs. “Then the job is off.” The two women stare at each other for a few long heartbeats. Eventually, Ahsha throws her hands up. “Right. So you’re vouching for them?” Tessa turns to you, her red eyes gleaming. “I am.” Ahsha chews on that for a moment, then relents. “Fine. If your friend wants in, then they’re in.” “Um...” you cut in, drawing the full attention of both women. “Mind telling me what this is about? I haven’t actually agreed to anything.” Tessa and Ahsha look at each other, engaging in a silent conversation with just their looks. Eventually, it’s your albino companion who explains. “If it wasn’t already obvious... We’re teaming up for a job...” You figured that much.[var1| You’re not THAT dense.] What you don’t know is what sort of job they are trying to sign you up for. Tossing a glance at Tessa, you’re pretty sure if she’s involved, it likely involves somebody dying. Ahsha sighs, tapping the table impatiently. “Before you agree to anything, shall we explain?”
rows.translation: 阿莎换了换姿势，翻着眼伸手摸向腰间。她取出一台小型宝典，你注意到夹在手指间的设备上有盏小灯正在闪烁。“一定是铁皮脑袋。” “铁皮脑袋？”你问道，想起之前听过这个称呼。 “我们的一个同伴，”泰莎解释，对最后一个词施加了古怪重音。“我们这么叫他，是因为他永远戴着那顶荒唐的头盔。” “永远。”阿莎坏笑着低头看宝典。“即使他...没来时也是...” 泰莎扬起眉毛。“我想你把笑点说砸了。” 阿莎从宝典上抬眼，嘴角卷成怒容。“不，我是说他他妈不来了。” “什么？”泰莎眨着眼，真被这个消息吓了一跳。“为什么？” “另一个任务...”阿莎再次检查宝典，双眼来回扫动。“职责所系，叭啦叭啦，立过誓，更多叭啦叭啦，好像还提到一个绿色贱人...我不知道。都是他妈的屁话。”她气冲冲地收起宝典。“他本来该当我们他妈的尖兵。现在我们他妈该怎么办？” 泰莎深吸一口气，双臂抱胸，消化这个坏消息。“我们就坐在海盗窝里。可以找个替代者。” 阿莎哼了一声，向后靠得太远，连椅子都翘了起来。“这里一半的蠢货会把事情搞砸，另一半会他妈从背后捅我们。”她怒气未消，闭上双眼陷入沉思。“我手头可靠的联系人都离得太远，赶不上时机。” 泰莎安静片刻，思考困境。她的眼睛转向你，从侧面打量。“[pc.Name]可以补位。” “什么？”你的脊背顿时挺直，这句话令你猝不及防。你告诉白色女人，自己连她们在谈什么都完全不知道。 阿莎眯起眼，视线在你和白化奥维尔人之间跳动。“这就可疑了。” “哪里可疑？”泰莎皱眉。 阿莎向前倾身，沉重胸部略微压上桌面。“铁皮脑袋退出，而你恰好有个他妈的替代者在附近晃荡？”她斜眼看你。[var0||“我他妈不信任骗子。”|“而且还是个狡猾家伙。”] 泰莎放开抱胸的双臂，耸耸肩。“那就取消任务。” 两个女人彼此凝视了好几个漫长心跳。最终，阿莎举起双手。“好吧。所以你愿意替他们担保？” 泰莎转向你，红眼闪耀。“愿意。” 阿莎思索片刻，随后让步。“行。如果你的朋友想加入，那就让他们加入。” “呃...”你插话，将两个女人的全部注意引向自己。“介意告诉我这是怎么回事吗？我其实什么都还没答应。” 泰莎与阿莎对视，仅凭眼神进行无声交谈。最终，还是你的白化同伴开口解释。“要是这还不够明显...我们要组队干一票...” 这点你已经猜到了。[var1|你还没迟钝到那个地步。]你不知道的是，她们想拉你加入什么任务。你瞥了泰莎一眼，觉得既然她参与其中，很可能会有人丧命。 阿莎叹气，不耐烦地敲着桌面。“在你同意任何事情之前，要不要让我们先说明？”
