rows.original: Ahsha leans in close, her voice’s volume dropping, barely audible over the din of the room. “Ever heard of The Eternal Reverie?” To your side you can see Tessa eyeing you closely, gauging your response. You contemplate the question for a moment. Truth be told, the name does sound familiar, but you can’t seem to say why... Not waiting for an answer, Ahsha continues. “Couple centuries ago, this bigwig investor, Chuckie Sears, got into quite a bit of trouble. He had certain...” Ahsha crinkles her snout, searching for a word. “Proclivities. Since he was filthy stinking rich, he had the resources to make it all go away, but the near miss made him rethink how to partake in his chosen vices. So he built himself a little getaway...” Tessa snorts, pulling your attention to her. “Little?” She shifts around in her chair, facing you directly. “It’s a fucking space station.” “A moving space station,” Ahsha cuts in, forcing your eyes back to her. “Despite its age, it’s an impressive feat of engineering even today. Quite the expensive project as well... The old man blew his fortune, and dipped into a few he didn’t own, to build it. But, like a true entrepreneur, he saw opportunity...” Your memory jogs slightly. You definitely heard of this before, but your recollection is failing you. You motion for her to continue, wanting to hear where this goes. Tessa picks up where Ahsha left off. “Sears turned it into a sex resort, and a fucking exclusive one at that. Only assholes he let in were the one percent of the one percent types. Kings, pirate lords... Shitty capitalists like himself. You know. Those types. If we believe the rumors, the price of admission per visit was enough to hurt even their bank accounts.” Frowning, you ask why they would go if it was so expensive then. “Because,” Ahsha smirks, swirling her drink. “The allure was irresistible. A secret space station, hidden away from prying eyes and the lowly masses, constantly moving and untraceable. Law enforcement couldn’t even find it if they wanted. Loaded full with a veritable menagerie of depraved pleasures...” Ahsha shrugs. “Rich assholes love that kinda shit.” Sighing, you do see where she’s coming from. “So, is Sears the target?” Tessa snorts, while Ahsha just smiles and answers your question. “He’s dead. Murdered, actually.” Instinctively, you turn to Tessa, raising a questioning brow. You’re pretty sure, even without asking aloud, your face is pretty much yelling the question ‘did you kill him?’. Scoffing, Tessa rolls her eyes. “He died a decade ago. Got killed by one of his procurers.” “Procurers?” You look between the two women. “Of what?” Ahsha shrugs. “Slaves.” “Ah...” You rock back slightly. “The man ran an illegal sex club in the middle of nowhere that catered to the rich and the powerful. He needed a near constant supply of holes and poles. He enlisted the services of many organizations over the years, always on the lookout for who could replenish his stock with the best supply at the best prices.” Cringing, Tessa lets out something akin to a hiss. “Can you not say it like he was buying fucking fruit?” Turning to the white woman, the slyveren frowns. “I’ll try.” Her deadpan expression doesn’t give you confidence she will. Turning to you again, she continues. “Eventually, he made the mistake of going with a group that was a little too good to be true. They staged a hostile takeover, killing the old man and taking the operation for themselves.” “The Eternal Reverie is under new management.” Tessa clicks her tongue. “And they’re fucking stupid. More concrete information about the operation has leaked in the last few years than the past two centuries.” You puzzle the question for a few seconds before asking the pale ovir why. “They made it less exclusive.” Tessa shakes her head, as if in utter gall. “Still kept it for rich shits only, but instead of just bringing in people who can afford their own star systems, they started bringing in celebrities and assholes like that. The kinda folks who don’t understand the point of a secret sex club is ruined when you post selfies from the bathroom.” Ahsha chuckles. “Say what you want about the old pervert, the guy ran a tight ship. The new boss is greedy, and yes,” she nods to Tessa, “fucking stupid.” “Okay, they’re the target then?” You ask, thinking you’ve finally got to the bottom of this. “Yes...” Tessa answers, her voice trailing. “And no...” Ahsha takes a breath. “That’s part of it, yes. At least the part Tessa is here for. The Eternal Reverie has become something of a... nexus of opportunity.” “Getting on that station has become sort of a dream job.” Tessa chimes. “A bunch of different assholes with very different interests are willing to pay stupid amounts of money for all sorts of shit. But, basically, it boils down to five jobs.” “Five jobs?” The words come out of your lips with a bit more volume than intended, your surprise getting the better of you. “Shhh,” Tessa puts a finger to her lips, her eyes suddenly angry. Smirking, amused at your outburst and Tessa’s response, Ahsha explains. “Reclamation. Rescue. Emancipation. Blackmail. Assassination” She leans back, her chair straining under her hefty ass. “Five jobs. Five payouts.”
rows.translation: 阿莎靠近，压低音量，在房间喧闹声中几乎无法听见。“听说过永恒遐想号吗？” 你能看见身旁的泰莎正密切观察，判断你的反应。 你思考片刻。说实话，这个名字确实耳熟，可你想不起原因... 阿莎不等回答便继续。“几个世纪前，一位名叫查基·西尔斯的投资界大人物惹上了不少麻烦。他有某些...”阿莎皱起吻部，寻找合适的词。“癖好。因为他富得流油，有资源让一切消失，不过那次险些出事，让他重新考虑该怎样满足自己选择的恶习。于是他给自己建了一处小小的度假地...” 泰莎哼了一声，把你的注意拉向她。“小小的？”她在椅子上换了个姿势，正面看你。“那是个他妈的空间站。” “会移动的空间站，”阿莎插话，迫使你重新看向她。“尽管年代久远，即使放到今天也仍是惊人的工程壮举，而且项目成本极其高昂...老头为建造它耗尽自己的财富，还动用了几笔不属于自己的钱。不过，像真正的企业家一样，他看见了商机...” 你的记忆微微受到触动。你肯定以前听过这件事，却怎么也回想不起来。你示意她继续，想听听事情会如何发展。 泰莎接着阿莎的话说下去。“西尔斯把它变成性爱度假地，而且是他妈极其排外的那种。他只放行最顶端百分之一里的百分之一。国王、海盗领主...还有像他一样的垃圾资本家。你知道，就是那类人。如果传闻可信，每次入场的价格高到连他们的银行账户都会肉疼。” 你皱眉问，既然这么贵，他们为什么还要去。 “因为，”阿莎坏笑着晃动酒杯。“诱惑无法抵挡。一座秘密空间站，躲开窥探目光和卑微大众，不断移动，无法追踪。就算执法部门想找也找不到。里面塞满了名副其实的堕落享乐动物园...”阿莎耸肩。“富有的混蛋就喜欢这种东西。” 你叹气，确实明白她的意思。“所以，西尔斯是目标？” 泰莎哼了一声，阿莎只是微笑并回答。“他死了，实际上是被谋杀的。” 你本能地转向泰莎，疑问地扬起眉毛。你很确定，即使不问出口，脸上也几乎在大喊‘是你杀的吗？’。 泰莎嗤笑着翻眼。“他十年前就死了，被一个供应商杀的。” “供应商？”你来回看着两个女人。“供应什么？” 阿莎耸肩。“奴隶。” “啊...”你稍稍后仰。 “那人在荒无人烟之地经营非法性爱俱乐部，服务富人和权贵。他几乎一直需要新的洞穴与肉棒。多年来，他雇用过许多组织，始终寻找能以最优惠价格提供最好货源、补充库存的人。” 泰莎畏缩，发出近似嘶声的声音。“能别说得像他在买他妈的水果吗？” 斯莱弗伦人转向白色女人，皱起眉。“我尽量。”她面无表情，让你完全不相信她会照做。她重新转向你，继续说道：“最终，他犯了个错误，选择了一个好得不真实的团伙。对方发动敌意接管，杀死老头，把业务夺为己有。” “永恒遐想号现在换了管理层。”泰莎咂舌。“而且他们他妈很蠢。过去几年泄漏的具体情报，比此前两个世纪加起来还多。” 你思考几秒，问苍白的奥维尔人原因。 “他们降低了排他性。”泰莎摇头，仿佛觉得不可思议。“仍然只接待有钱的混蛋，但不再只请买得起自己星系的人，而是开始接纳名人之类的混蛋。那种不明白秘密性爱俱乐部一旦有人从浴室发自拍就毁了的人。” 阿莎轻笑。“随你怎么评价那个老变态，他确实把这里管得滴水不漏。新老板很贪婪，而且没错，”她朝泰莎点头，“他妈很蠢。” “好吧，那他们就是目标？”你问，觉得自己终于弄明白了。 “是...”泰莎回答，尾音拖长。 “也不是...”阿莎吸了口气。“这是其中一部分，没错。至少是泰莎来这里要做的部分。永恒遐想号已经变成某种...机遇枢纽。” “登上那座空间站已经成了一种梦幻工作。”泰莎插话。“一群兴趣完全不同的混蛋，愿意为各种破事付出蠢得离谱的价码。不过基本上，可以归结为五项任务。” “五项任务？”这句话从唇间脱口而出，音量比预想更大，惊讶占了上风。 “嘘，”泰莎把手指放到唇边，眼神忽然愤怒。 阿莎因你的惊呼和泰莎的反应而坏笑，解释道：“收复、营救、解放、勒索、刺杀。”她向后靠去，沉重屁股压得椅子吱呀作响。“五项任务，五份报酬。”
rows.raw: " Ahsha leans in close, her voice’s volume dropping, barely audible over the din of the room. “Ever heard of The Eternal Reverie?” To your side you can see Tessa eyeing you closely, gauging your response. You contemplate the question for a moment. Truth be told, the name does sound familiar, but you can’t seem to say why... Not waiting for an answer, Ahsha continues. “Couple centuries ago, this bigwig investor, Chuckie Sears, got into quite a bit of trouble. He had certain...” Ahsha crinkles her snout, searching for a word. “Proclivities. Since he was filthy stinking rich, he had the resources to make it all go away, but the near miss made him rethink how to partake in his chosen vices. So he built himself a little getaway...” Tessa snorts, pulling your attention to her. “Little?” She shifts around in her chair, facing you directly. “It’s a fucking space station.” “A moving space station,” Ahsha cuts in, forcing your eyes back to her. “Despite its age, it’s an impressive feat of engineering even today. Quite the expensive project as well... The old man blew his fortune, and dipped into a few he didn’t own, to build it. But, like a true entrepreneur, he saw opportunity...” Your memory jogs slightly. You definitely heard of this before, but your recollection is failing you. You motion for her to continue, wanting to hear where this goes. Tessa picks up where Ahsha left off. “Sears turned it into a sex resort, and a fucking exclusive one at that. Only assholes he let in were the one percent of the one percent types. Kings, pirate lords... Shitty capitalists like himself. You know. Those types. If we believe the rumors, the price of admission per visit was enough to hurt even their bank accounts.” Frowning, you ask why they would go if it was so expensive then. “Because,” Ahsha smirks, swirling her drink. “The allure was irresistible. A secret space station, hidden away from prying eyes and the lowly masses, constantly moving and untraceable. Law enforcement couldn’t even find it if they wanted. Loaded full with a veritable menagerie of depraved pleasures...” Ahsha shrugs. “Rich assholes love that kinda shit.” Sighing, you do see where she’s coming from. “So, is Sears the target?” Tessa snorts, while Ahsha just smiles and answers your question. “He’s dead. Murdered, actually.” Instinctively, you turn to Tessa, raising a questioning brow. You’re pretty sure, even without asking aloud, your face is pretty much yelling the question ‘did you kill him?’. Scoffing, Tessa rolls her eyes. “He died a decade ago. Got killed by one of his procurers.” “Procurers?” You look between the two women. “Of what?” Ahsha shrugs. “Slaves.” “Ah...” You rock back slightly. “The man ran an illegal sex club in the middle of nowhere that catered to the rich and the powerful. He needed a near constant supply of holes and poles. He enlisted the services of many organizations over the years, always on the lookout for who could replenish his stock with the best supply at the best prices.” Cringing, Tessa lets out something akin to a hiss. “Can you not say it like he was buying fucking fruit?” Turning to the white woman, the slyveren frowns. “I’ll try.” Her deadpan expression doesn’t give you confidence she will. Turning to you again, she continues. “Eventually, he made the mistake of going with a group that was a little too good to be true. They staged a hostile takeover, killing the old man and taking the operation for themselves.” “The Eternal Reverie is under new management.” Tessa clicks her tongue. “And they’re fucking stupid. More concrete information about the operation has leaked in the last few years than the past two centuries.” You puzzle the question for a few seconds before asking the pale ovir why. “They made it less exclusive.” Tessa shakes her head, as if in utter gall. “Still kept it for rich shits only, but instead of just bringing in people who can afford their own star systems, they started bringing in celebrities and assholes like that. The kinda folks who don’t understand the point of a secret sex club is ruined when you post selfies from the bathroom.” Ahsha chuckles. “Say what you want about the old pervert, the guy ran a tight ship. The new boss is greedy, and yes,” she nods to Tessa, “fucking stupid.” “Okay, they’re the target then?” You ask, thinking you’ve finally got to the bottom of this. “Yes...” Tessa answers, her voice trailing. “And no...” Ahsha takes a breath. “That’s part of it, yes. At least the part Tessa is here for. The Eternal Reverie has become something of a... nexus of opportunity.” “Getting on that station has become sort of a dream job.” Tessa chimes. “A bunch of different assholes with very different interests are willing to pay stupid amounts of money for all sorts of shit. But, basically, it boils down to five jobs.” “Five jobs?” The words come out of your lips with a bit more volume than intended, your surprise getting the better of you. “Shhh,” Tessa puts a finger to her lips, her eyes suddenly angry. Smirking, amused at your outburst and Tessa’s response, Ahsha explains. “Reclamation. Rescue. Emancipation. Blackmail. Assassination” She leans back, her chair straining under her hefty ass. “Five jobs. Five payouts.” "

rows.original: “Reclamation?” You ask, wondering what she means. “Of the station.” Tessa answers, letting out an annoyed sigh. “The old fucker’s family wants it back.” “Despite its... dubious origins and use, the station is technically their property.” Ahsha shrugs. “I mean, you’d think it being used as an illegal sex haven for degenerate rich assholes would sort of compromise that, but alas...” Cutting her off, Tessa groans. “Without it, they’re fucked. They don’t own anything else, and most of their money was either tied up in the station, or is being used to prop up their fucking insane lifestyles. They want it back, and they’re willing to pay, but they’re that bullshit sort of ‘rich person broke’, where they don’t have any liquid credits.” Clearing her throat, Ahsha nods. “It’s still a tidy sum, but not the sort of money you’d expect from such an... established family.” “So, let me get this straight...” You take a moment then recap the job. “The job is to take back control of the station, and give it back to its rightful owners?” “Yeah,” Tessa clucks her tongue. “Or we could, yanno, not...” Frowning, Ahsha ignores her and looks at you. “We have no idea how much trouble it would be to wrestle back control of the station. I’d mark this down as a ‘maybe’ objective-wise, but since we’re planning on decapitating the leadership anyways...” she shrugs. “Why not?”
rows.translation: “收复？”你问，不明白她指什么。 “空间站。”泰莎不耐烦地叹气回答。“那个老混蛋的家族想把它要回去。” “尽管它的...来历和用途都很可疑，但这座空间站严格来说仍是他们的财产。”阿莎耸肩。“我是说，你会以为它被用作堕落富豪混蛋的非法性爱天堂，多少会影响这项权利，可惜...” 泰莎呻吟着打断她。“没有它，他们就完了。他们没有其他产业，大部分钱要么套在空间站里，要么正拿去支撑他们他妈疯狂的生活方式。他们想要回来，也愿意付钱，可他们是那种狗屁的‘富人式破产’，手头根本没有流动信用点。” 阿莎清清嗓子，点了点头。“仍是一笔可观数目，但不像你会期待这样一个...根基深厚的家族给出的价码。” “所以，让我确认一下...”你花片刻总结任务。“任务是夺回空间站控制权，把它交还合法所有者？” “对，”泰莎咂舌。“或者我们也可以，你知道的，不交...” 阿莎皱眉无视她，看向你。“我们不知道夺回空间站控制权会有多麻烦。我会把这项目标标成‘视情况而定’，不过既然我们反正打算斩首领导层...”她耸肩。“为什么不呢？”

rows.original: “Rescue?” You ask, wondering who’s in trouble. “Ahh,” Ahsha’s eyes gleam. “A very interesting situation...” The pale woman lets out a huff and cuts to the chase. “Some fucking princess went missing.” “Princess?” You do admit that does sound interesting... “No, no.” Ahsha swats at the air, dismissing the notion. “An heiress. A socialite, really. Princess is such a...” she sighs. “Misleading title.” Rolling her eyes, Tessa clarifies. “Some rich girl, Chiaki Hinamori, went to the station and didn’t come back. Went with a few of her ‘socialite’ friends who didn’t notice she was gone until after they were home and sober.” “Her father assumes it was a kidnapping.” Ahsha smiles, her grin so wide she could bite your head off. “And is willing to pay very handsomely for her safe return.” “Assumes?” Something about that word sits in your stomach like a rock. “No ransom. No nothing.” Tessa leans back, her expression betraying her disinterest. “She’s likely so hopped up on stims that she’s still partying, or ran off with some rich assfucker with a fat dick.” “Her father is quite convinced she is still on the station.” Ahsha shifts in her seat, tossing Tessa a glare. “He has considerable resources, and has exhausted all other avenues of inquiry.” “Avenues of inquiry?” Tessa gives Ahsha an incredulous look. “What, you got a word of the day calendar or something going on?” While the two scowl at each other, you consider the job. If the father is convinced she’s there, maybe she is. It could be worth a look. Curious, you ask Ahsha more about the ‘princess’. “Socialite. Well, she’s terran, ‘asian’ apparently, whatever that means. Young. Nineteen, maybe twenty now...” Ahsha strokes her chin, recalling the details. “Short, but I’m not an expert on female terran standards. Quite a beauty I’m told... She went missing a few weeks ago. In fact, it was her disappearance that sparked the tip that provided the lead we have to get aboa-” With a roll of her eyes and groan of exasperation, Tessa butts in. “Her name’s Chiaki and she’s a fucking princess. I think she’ll stick out.” Ahsha mutters ‘socialite’ under her breath for good measure.
rows.translation: “营救？”你问，不知谁遇到了麻烦。 “啊，”阿莎双眼闪亮。“非常有趣的情况...” 苍白女人哼了一声，直奔主题。“某个他妈的公主失踪了。” “公主？”你承认，这听起来确实有趣... “不，不。”阿莎挥手否定这个说法。“是一位继承人。其实就是社交名媛。公主这个称呼太...”她叹气。“容易误导。” 泰莎翻着眼解释。“一个富家女孩，日森千秋，去了空间站便没回来。她和几个‘社交名媛’朋友一起去的，那些人直到回家醒酒后才发现她不见了。” “她父亲认定这是绑架。”阿莎笑得嘴角大张，几乎能一口咬掉你的脑袋。“而且愿意为她平安归来支付非常丰厚的报酬。” “认定？”这个词像石头一样沉进你的胃。 “没有赎金，什么都没有。”泰莎向后靠去，满脸不感兴趣。“她可能嗑兴奋剂嗑得太猛，到现在还在狂欢；也可能跟某个有肥肉棒的富豪混蛋跑了。” “她父亲非常确信她还在空间站上。”阿莎换了换坐姿，瞪了泰莎一眼。“他资源雄厚，而且已经穷尽其他一切调查途径。” “调查途径？”泰莎难以置信地看着阿莎。“怎么，你在用每日一词日历吗？” 两人彼此怒视时，你思考着任务。如果父亲确信她在那里，也许确实如此。值得找找看。出于好奇，你向阿莎询问更多关于这位‘公主’的情况。 “社交名媛。嗯，她是地球人，据说是‘亚洲人’，不管那是什么意思。很年轻。十九岁，也许现在二十了...”阿莎抚着下巴回忆细节。“身材矮小，不过我不熟悉地球女性的标准。听说是个大美人...她几周前失踪。事实上，正是她的失踪促成了那条线报，为我们提供了登船的门——” 泰莎翻眼、恼火呻吟着插话。“她叫千秋，是个他妈的公主。我想她会很显眼。” 阿莎又低声嘟囔了一遍‘社交名媛’，以作补充。

rows.original: “Emancipation?” You assume they mean the slaves. “Yeah,” Tessa crosses her arms over her full chest, her expression serious. “The Reverie is packed with slaves. An anti-slavery non-profit has collected a reward purse for anybody who can help liberate them.” Ahsha slowly blinks a few times, her lips a flat line. “Current management seems to have plucked their stock from the wrong places, in the wrong ways. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have garnered this sort of response. The purse is a decent sum, but not worth the time or effort.” She huffs, frustration obvious. “This really is a waste of time. I only brought it up because Tessa here dragged out her soapbox about it earlier.” You can see the vein in Tessa’s forehead bulge. “Seriously?” Ahsha frowns. “You DO realize where we are, right?” She motions around the room with dramatic flair. “You know what I do here. You’ve always known. rows.original: Assassination. This is what you’d expected, given Tessa’s occupation. Still, you ask for more details. Tessa shrugs. “Contract is for the leader of the group that took possession of the station.” A pause. You look between the two women, expecting a better answer than that. Tessa looks serious. Not mad, just serious. Ahsha, on the other hand, is smiling ear to ear. Sensing your thoughts, Tessa sighs and continues. “Private contract. Not open.” She gives Ahsha a glance, frowning at her smile. “Information on the target is limited, both because they haven’t left the station in years, and before they weren’t a big enough fish to matter.” Following along, you nod, but the last thing she said sticks with you. “And why do they matter now?” “They...” Ahsha thinks for a moment, measuring her words. “Pissed off the wrong people. Taking control of the station was a bold move, and not offensive on its own, but the way they’ve conducted their business... Well that earned them the sort of underworld attention few walk away from.” Tessa shrugs. “That’s about the long and short of it. I’ll be taking care of this job personally. You guys don’t need to get involved.” Her words are so cold a shiver runs down your spine.

The red woman does, but tosses you a curious look as she stands. “See you soon.” The two women stalk off, leaving you alone. You’re not sure exactly what you’re in for, but you’d better take the time to prepare.

rows.original: As you move towards her, Ahsha notices your approach, stuffing away her file. “You’re late,” she playfully smirks, seemingly untroubled by your alleged tardiness. “But we’ve got time still. Follow me, Tessa’s parked over here.” Following, the two of you make your way through the hangar. While looking around, trying to spot Tessa’s ship, your eyes can’t help but fall on the shapely figure of the woman in front of you. Slyverens are typically curvy, and Ahsha is definitely no exception. Her walk is more of a sashay, her hips and ass swaying side to side with each step, highlighting her pronounced, hourglass figure. Trying not to stare, but failing miserably, you snap to attention when she grinds to a halt, almost causing you to bump into her shapely rear. “Here,” she points to Tessa’s ship, the sleek, black vessel tucked away in a dark corner. “Tessa’s waiting. And I think we both know how irritable she gets when she’s left waiting.” Ahsha lets out a hissing laugh, leading you up the ramp and onto the waiting ship. While still messy, Tessa’s ship has been tidied since you were last on board, with nary a beer can to be seen. You start to ponder why Tessa would clean up (marginally) when she’s usually fine with the place being cluttered. Before you can think on it too hard, you hear Tessa’s voice yell from the cockpit. “You asshats are late. I’m setting a course now. We’ll brief [pc.name] on the way there.” Before you can sit down, the ship comes alive, rumbling as the engines ignite. You sway, staggering as the ship starts to shake, only for Ahsha to brace you, a firm hand on your shoulder. Looking back at her, she gives you a sly grin, her eyes gleaming. You thank her, slipping from her grip, and take a seat, the ship’s shaking making it hard to be upright. Ahsha pulls up a seat across from you, crossing her legs and reclining, all while never letting her stare break. Slightly unnerved, you wait out the rough liftoff, sitting in silence with the red woman. A few minutes later the ship settles, and Tessa stalks into the room from the cockpit. She tosses a look at you and then Ahsha in turn, her lips pressed into a fine line. “Sorry about that. Stabilizers are fucked.” She sighs, moving towards a vacant seat. “Did you start without me?” “No,” Ahsha gives you a coy smile. “Just enjoying each other’s company.” “Right...” if skepticism was tangible, Tessa was oozing it from every pore. Sitting now, she brushes her hair back, running her fingers through that snow white mane. “Got a bit before we arrive. Should we start?”
rows.translation: 你向她走去时，阿莎注意到你的接近，收起手里的档案。“你迟到了，”她顽皮坏笑，似乎一点也不在意你所谓的迟到。“不过我们还有时间。跟我来，泰莎把船停在这边。” 你跟着她，两人穿过机库。环顾四周寻找泰莎的飞船时，你的视线忍不住落在前方女人曲线优美的身影上。斯莱弗伦人通常都很丰满，阿莎当然也不例外。她走起路来更像扭腰摆臀，每一步都让胯部与屁股左右摇摆，凸显醒目的沙漏身材。你试图不盯着看，却彻底失败；直到她骤然停步，你才猛地回神，差点撞上那曲线动人的后臀。 “这里，”她指向泰莎的飞船，那艘流线型黑色船只藏在阴暗角落。“泰莎在等。而且我想我们都知道，让她久等会有多暴躁。”阿莎发出嘶嘶的笑声，带你沿舷梯登上等待中的飞船。 泰莎的船仍很凌乱，但比你上次登船时整洁，几乎看不见啤酒罐。你开始猜想泰莎为什么会收拾这里，哪怕只稍微整理了一点；她平常可完全不介意杂乱。还没来得及深想，泰莎的声音便从驾驶舱喊来。“你们这些蠢货迟到了。我现在设定航线，路上再给[pc.name]简报。” 你还没坐下，飞船便苏醒过来，发动机点火，船体隆隆震动。飞船开始摇晃，你身体一歪、踉跄起来，阿莎却扶住了你，一只有力的手按上肩膀。你回头望去，她狡黠一笑，双眼闪亮。你向她道谢，脱离扶持，找座位坐下；船体震动让站立变得困难。阿莎在对面拉来椅子，交叠双腿向后靠去，始终没有移开凝视。 你略感不安，和红色女人默默坐着，熬过颠簸的起飞。 几分钟后飞船稳定下来，泰莎从驾驶舱大步走进房间。她先看你，再看阿莎，嘴唇抿成细线。“抱歉。稳定器坏了。”她叹气，走向空座。“你们没等我就开始了？” “没有，”阿莎暧昧地朝你微笑。“只是在享受彼此陪伴。” “是吗...”如果怀疑能变成实物，泰莎全身每个毛孔都在向外渗。坐下后，她向后拢起雪白长发。“到达前还有一点时间。我们开始吧？”
rows.raw: " As you move towards her, Ahsha notices your approach, stuffing away her file. “You’re late,” she playfully smirks, seemingly untroubled by your alleged tardiness. “But we’ve got time still. Follow me, Tessa’s parked over here.” Following, the two of you make your way through the hangar. While looking around, trying to spot Tessa’s ship, your eyes can’t help but fall on the shapely figure of the woman in front of you. Slyverens are typically curvy, and Ahsha is definitely no exception. Her walk is more of a sashay, her hips and ass swaying side to side with each step, highlighting her pronounced, hourglass figure. Trying not to stare, but failing miserably, you snap to attention when she grinds to a halt, almost causing you to bump into her shapely rear. “Here,” she points to Tessa’s ship, the sleek, black vessel tucked away in a dark corner. “Tessa’s waiting. And I think we both know how irritable she gets when she’s left waiting.” Ahsha lets out a hissing laugh, leading you up the ramp and onto the waiting ship. While still messy, Tessa’s ship has been tidied since you were last on board, with nary a beer can to be seen. You start to ponder why Tessa would clean up (marginally) when she’s usually fine with the place being cluttered. Before you can think on it too hard, you hear Tessa’s voice yell from the cockpit. “You asshats are late. I’m setting a course now. We’ll brief [pc.name] on the way there.” Before you can sit down, the ship comes alive, rumbling as the engines ignite. You sway, staggering as the ship starts to shake, only for Ahsha to brace you, a firm hand on your shoulder. Looking back at her, she gives you a sly grin, her eyes gleaming. You thank her, slipping from her grip, and take a seat, the ship’s shaking making it hard to be upright. Ahsha pulls up a seat across from you, crossing her legs and reclining, all while never letting her stare break. Slightly unnerved, you wait out the rough liftoff, sitting in silence with the red woman. A few minutes later the ship settles, and Tessa stalks into the room from the cockpit. She tosses a look at you and then Ahsha in turn, her lips pressed into a fine line. “Sorry about that. Stabilizers are fucked.” She sighs, moving towards a vacant seat. “Did you start without me?” “No,” Ahsha gives you a coy smile. “Just enjoying each other’s company.” “Right...” if skepticism was tangible, Tessa was oozing it from every pore. Sitting now, she brushes her hair back, running her fingers through that snow white mane. “Got a bit before we arrive. Should we start?” "

rows.original: “Alright,” Ahsha uncrosses her legs, leaning in. “Me and Tess have already talked this over, so this is mostly just for your benefit.” Leaning in yourself, you nod, figuring as much. Ahsha continues. “The Reverie is going to be in a fixed location for ten hours, then it’s going to jump to some somewhere. During that ten hour period, guests are going to be boarding and departing. We’ll be crashing during that turnover.” “Most of those ten hours are already up.” Tessa adds, clicking her tongue. “We were hoping to try and board during the initial shuffle, but...” she motions towards you, “Obviously, our change of plans has compromised a few things.” The way she emphasized the words ‘a few things’ makes you think you’re going to hear about more than a few revisions to the plan. “Either way, based on intel, there is no guest list or check in.” Ahsha scratches her cheek, pushing forward with the explanation. “So long as you have the coordinates, you’re in.” “There is a weapons check, however.” Tessa frowns, her fingers flexing, as if begging to hold one of dangerous tools strapped to her hips. “First order of business is to find a way to bypass it. Or arm ourselves on the other side of it.” Looking at your [pc.weaponMain], you like the idea of bypassing the checkpoint more. Using unfamiliar weapons sounds like a bad idea. “We’ll figure that one out. You,” she points at you with a snap of her finger, “are going to try and find a terminal connected to their network. Any interface will do, really. The goal is to scout out information. Floor plans. Guard movements. Crew quarters. Anything.” “Okay,” you nod. [pc.clMulti engineer |The plan makes sense, given your area of expertise. |While it’s not your area of expertise, it sounds easy enough. ] “After that, we need to get into the VIP section.” Ahsha continues, dropping her finger. “Unlike the rest of the place, there is a list for that, so we can’t waltz in.” “Why do we need to get in there?” you ask, wondering how it ties into the objectives. Tessa answers. “We think that might be where the princess is.” “Socialite.” “Fuck off. Even if she isn’t, an exclusive area like that might yield us an advantage.” “Any staff-only area really does.” Ahsha leans back slightly. “Keep an eye out for offices. That’s a likely place to find the blackmail. Or...” she glances at Tessa. “Certain individuals.” Ignoring the red woman, Tessa keeps her eyes on you. “The bridge is what we really want to find. We’d be able to stop the station dead in its tracks from there.” Ahsha nods. “We’ll have to improvise a bit, to be sure. The main idea is: we board as if we’re normal guests. After splitting up, you’ll progress throughout the general area and try to find a terminal to scout ahead. While you do that, we’ll figure out how to bypass the weapons check and access the VIP area.” “Does that make sense?” Tessa tilts her head.
rows.translation: “好吧，”阿莎放下交叠的双腿，向前倾身。“我和泰丝已经讨论过了，所以这主要是说给你听的。” 你也向前倾，点了点头，早就猜到如此。 阿莎继续。“永恒遐想号会在固定位置停留十小时，然后跃迁到某个地方。在这十小时内，客人会登船和离开。我们会在人员轮换时混进去。” “十小时已经过去大半。”泰莎补充，咂了咂舌。“我们本想在最初的混乱期尝试登船，可是...”她朝你示意，“显然，计划变化已经打乱了几件事。” 她特意强调‘几件事’，让你觉得接下来听到的计划修改绝不止几项。 “无论如何，根据情报，那里没有宾客名单，也不办理登记。”阿莎挠着脸颊，继续解释。“只要有坐标，就能进去。” “不过会检查武器。”泰莎皱眉，手指屈伸，仿佛渴望握住腰间的危险工具。“首要任务是想办法绕过检查，或者在检查点另一侧重新武装。” 看着你的[pc.weaponMain]，你更喜欢绕过检查点。使用陌生武器听起来不是好主意。 “这一点我们会解决。你，”她猛地伸指指向你，“要想办法找到连接他们网络的终端。任何界面都行，目标是侦察情报。楼层图、守卫动向、船员舱室，什么都可以。” “明白，”你点头。[pc.clMulti engineer |鉴于你的专业领域，这项计划很合理。 |虽然这不是你的专长，但听起来足够简单。 ] “之后，我们需要进入贵宾区。”阿莎继续，放下手指。“那里和其他地方不同，确实有名单，所以不能大摇大摆走进去。” “我们为什么要进去？”你问，不明白这和目标有什么关系。 泰莎回答。“我们认为公主可能在那里。” “社交名媛。” “滚开。就算她不在那里，这种专属区域也可能带给我们优势。” “其实任何仅限员工的区域都可以。”阿莎稍稍后靠。“留意办公室，那里最有可能找到勒索资料。或者...”她看向泰莎。“某些人。” 泰莎无视红色女人，继续盯着你。“舰桥才是我们真正想找的地方。从那里可以让空间站完全停下来。” 阿莎点头。“当然，我们得随机应变。大体思路是：像普通客人一样登船。分开之后，你在普通区域活动，寻找终端，提前侦察；与此同时，我们想办法绕过武器检查，进入贵宾区。” “明白了吗？”泰莎歪着头。

rows.original: It wouldn’t hurt to check on the only couch that isn’t loaded with inebriated pirates or dogpiled by moaning slaves. As you approach the furry duo, [pc.cl kineticist |a telepathic field seeps over your gifted mind |you feel a creepy aura sneaking into your mind ]; not enough to collect vital data but going far too deep for your taste. You place a hand on your weapon, ready to fight if they don’t stop. Fortunately, the cold, sneaky tentacles leave your brain without anything valuable.[pc.hasAirtightSuit | | You don’t have much respite though; not a second later, the brute’s potent musk assaults your nostrils, filling your lungs with his entrancing scent. ] The amber-furred vulpatra pours two glasses of sparkling, golden liquor then sits on his partner’s big, muscular thigh. He’s wearing a Reaper Armaments branded power armor and large amounts of savicite jewelry adorn his noticeable ears. The collared other one is a mix of a bat and a werewolf with sharp fangs, leathery wings, very dense fur, dagger-like claws and talons, and a bodybuilder’s physique. A bony crown and large, perky ears give his head a cursed king’s allure — an impression reinforced by the ornate slave collar adorning his maned neck. “Good day, [pc.race]. Please, be my guest,” the short one says invitingly. His honeyed words contrast his prior mental onslaught. Since they don’t seem to be dangerous, at least for now, you take a seat across them and respectfully take a sip. A bouquet of vanilla and nutmeg flavors dance on your tongue as you savor the champagne-like drink, planning your next move. “I think we haven’t met before. My name is-” “[pc.name]. Oh! Permit me to apologize for looking into your mind. You wouldn’t believe how often I’m accosted by [var0 |bratty slaves |cocky pirates ] with dubious intent. Don’t worry, I love mystery too much to dig too deep into someone’s memories — unless they want to earn my favor, of course. Isn’t that right, Yuri?” “Yes,” the humongous chimera groans in a cavernous voice. His red, slitted eyes go from his master to you a couple of times, unsure about what to do with you. A wicked fire burns in his sharp pupils, drool trickles down his chops, and dirty juices ooze from his exposed, half-hard cock. [pc.kmhbb |One word from his master and he’ll jump you. |You wonder how you’d fare against him. His brawns and dick aren’t just for show. |How cute, he thinks he has a chance against you. |Gosh, it looks so big and girthy! If you are a good girl, maybe he’ll let you play with him. |He looks big and tough. Fighting him will be a challenge, even for you. ] “Fine... and you are?” The vulpatra steadies his flat torso. “I go by the name Zarduk[var0 |- that should be enough for you, pet. [silly |This tiny lad can store so many telepathic power inside him |It’s almost terrifying ].” “I admit my savicite-enhanced abilities are surprisingly potent,” the shortstack boasts before taking another sip of kui-tan wine. “Casually projecting this dampening aura of mine saved us a lot of trouble. You wouldn’t believe how often pirates try to double cross each other or how often slaves try to overpower me. These naughty kittens don’t know how hard it is to snag the good stuff from Megacorps and unearth the experimental wonders of standalone workers. People never realize how much work there is behind a suit of armor or a fancy weapon, let alone cybernetics that are supposed to fit anyone, regardless of race and gender.” So he’s a smuggler, interesting. Is it possible to see his wares? “Me, a lowly smuggler? No no no no! I consider myself a trader, a trader that got his hands on premium merchandise fresh from the product lines and research facilities. Could you imagine, for example, that this piece of Reaper Armaments power armor could be acquired by a sneaky thief? That the company that insists on how controlled their manufacturing and shipping processes are could let just a big enough gap in their defenses to allow a mean-spirited scoundrel in? If anybody discovered that, their reputation would be in shambles, their products’ value would immediately plummet, and most of the arms dealing industry with it.” You think for a couple of seconds. “Maybe you have some legally acquired stuff and you are using them to falsely cover the other theft claims.[pc.cl smuggler | That’s what I’d do. ]” The furry monster groans. “[pc.HeShe]’s a clever one.” “Indeed,” Zarduk replies before pouring himself another drink. “It’s rare to find such a high quality [var0 |servant |guest ] in this den of depravity. I used to be a rather mundane citizen of Satio, my species’ homeworld. Few on this rock would believe me if I told them I used to be a dentist not so long ago — a pretty good one, at that,” he smiles, sipping some more sweet, sparkling alcohol. “I wasn’t even that much of a telepath.” “You’re pulling my leg on this one.” “Not this time, no. One day, I had enough of being a useful member of society and decided to follow my dreams. I invested all my money into opening a traditional vulpatra restaurant on Jitafore, the kui-tan’s moon. rows.original: You blink, your eyes doing their best to get used to the throne room’s chromed walls. Master brought you with him for his diplomatic meeting with the Cog Empress. He’s quite stunning today, wrapped in a translucent mantle. Since this is a very important mission, he let you etch gold runes all over his gilded, living-metal skin. His three legs move quick, almost too quick for your six, feathered limbs to follow as he presents himself to the entity controlling this spiraled arm of the galaxy. She’s a living statue of bronze, brass, and copper clad in opulent silks and the hides of titanic creatures that thrive on the same kind of primal worlds you came from. You can see a mix of disdain and fascination for your organic limbs in her glowing red eyes, as if she were in front of a monster rather than your master’s [silly |number one cuddleslut |favored treasure ]. Your robotic overlord bows respectively in front of his host, its rich garb shining with iridescent lights as it dangles all over his bent form. You mimic him the best you can, lowering your muzzled head and deploying your wingspans in an orgy of shimmering colors. The gravity is so intense you can’t stand upright, forcing you to prowl close to the floor like your ancestors did before they adapted to your synthetics-ruled alliance – you aren’t sure if she’s doing it on purpose or not, but you sincerely hope she isn’t a sadistic dictator. “My respects, Cog Empress. I, Lord Rhy’nor Sketheyth, current ruler of the Synchronic Coalescence, am honored to be your guest. I’m sure our people will benefit a lot from our cooperation.” The varnished, curvy queen slowly rises from her powered throne — an artifact that links all the energy inside her ship to its owner, citizens and soldiers included. She hovers down to Master’s level, her feet floating a few inches above her palace’s damascus-patterned ground. Her velvety dress and bestial cloak gently flow in front of you, giving her otherworldly stillness an even more menacing aura. Sapphires, lapides, pearls, and agates adorn her neck, wrists, fingers, and ankles — their refined, exquisite facture a striking contrast with the carved skulls and furred hides covering her shoulders and back. “I’m honored by your visit. This vessel is the fusion of our kin’s technology and essence: a token of power and beauty. When you address me, be aware that you are discussing with the Galvanic Empire itself, so weigh your words carefully,” she says, her proud and caring voice at odds with her apparent emotionlessness. “Please, follow me to my quarters. It will be more comfortable to your more individually-inclined minds.” Without further ado, the regal empress floats out of the room, her frontal rack and cushioned rear bouncing in the artificial winds carrying her. Master places you on his shoulder then follows in the bronze droid’s stead. You cross hundreds of featureless guards wielding heavy weapons that look nothing like harmless, ceremonial gear as you visit the labyrinthic rooms. Tesla coils and intricate pylons carry bright red energy across the palace, its sun-like glow both lighting the place and powering the machines, guns, and creatures inside. It takes you all your willpower to stay still — they wouldn’t take it well if an outsider hissed or shook in their holy sanctum, no matter how much it makes your exotic skin and hollow bones crawl. After a long, contemplative journey through the magnificent complex, you finally enter a large room filled with cushions, silks, and couches surrounding a shimmering, holo-table. The Cog Empress takes her place on a red, velvety sofa, crossing her legs a second too late to hide her welcoming midsection from your extra sensitive eyes. Your master, too focused on her folk’s technology and architecture, doesn’t notice her maneuver and casually sits amidst blue cushions. Catapulted by the impact, you nimbly perform a winged somersault and land on a fine, latex-like pillow on the squab’s edge, far too close to your hostess than you’d like. She looks at your tails’ tips, intrigued by the flared, veiny girths topping your spine-lined anatomy. “P-Permit me to apologize for the PX3-78K incident. We didn’t expect other forms of peaceful sapient life to exist.” Master shrugs. “Admiral Fak’hardt and his crew are safe. Things would have been far messier if you didn’t understand his greeting hail at the last second. Those antimatter beamers of yours are quite powerful.” The Cog Empress sighs in relief, releasing a small cloud of steam. Now that her antigravity systems are off, you can clearly hear the clockwork mechanism animating her core. Slowly, you glare at your master, silently asking for his approval. He raises a finger, the only incentive you need to continue. You face the local leader and close your eyes. “I beg your pardon, empress, but you look far more archaic than your people. Is there a reason for this?” you ask. “How is that possible? Your pet speaks directly to our mind!” Master reaches for your back and smoothly caresses your colorful feathers and small, gleaming spines. “Oht’ak is my bodyguard and lover. Don’t let her feline demeanor fool you, her species is famous for their loyalty and psionic abilities. I saved her life decades ago from a Ragidan warlord and she’s been my companion since.” “Ragidan? I remember them. We lost many beautiful sparks to wipe their third armada,” she says, her voice laced with sadness, regrets, and shame. Feeling distress tainting her aura, you deftly leap on her sofa. You rub your sides and face against her middle before claiming her warm, yielding lap. The Cog Empress shudders, her initial unease palpable until her brass fingers run along your head. Immediately soothed by your presence, her ticking core slowly steadies to a calmer state. “I heard you circumvented them to their homeworld; you have my thanks for doing so.” Master nods. “It was a difficult choice, but we couldn’t bear to annihilate them. They too deserve a place in the Coalescence, someday. Anyway, could you please answer my companion’s question?” “Yes. I’m the first vessel created by our kin. We are all linked together but this body of bronze, copper, and brass possess great historical value to us. It might be updated and equipped with our newest technologies, but its antique steam generator still runs just fine. It was also designed to be pleasing to biological lifeforms,” she says, running a finger along her brownish boobs, hips, and thighs. “I’ve been told my ancient assets are considered alluring by the galaxy’s sapient denizens,” she adds, wordlessly for your approval. You simply purr. The old machine tilts her head, confused by your answer. “A-Anyway, let’s go back to the matter at hand: trade, scientific collaboration, and common development of unclaimed worlds.”

rows.original: “It was a pleasure doing business with you.” “Now, we can go down to the real business,” Yuri smirks, licking [yuri.mf |his |her ] lips. The amber-furred psionic frowns. Maybe a sudden burst of jealousy. He doesn’t punish his goon, but you can feel the tension rise as he serves himself another glass of kui-tan liquor. “Anyway. What else can we do for you?”
rows.translation: “很高兴和你做生意。” “现在，我们可以谈真正的正事了，”尤里坏笑着舔了舔[yuri.mf |他的 |她的 ]嘴唇。 琥珀色毛发的灵能者皱起眉，也许是突然涌起一阵嫉妒。他没有惩罚自己的打手，但你能感觉到气氛变得紧张，因为他又给自己倒了一杯狸猫酒。 “总之，我们还能为你做什么？”

rows.original:
Psi-noise generators use an array of carefully cut and tuned psi-reactive crystals to generate a telepathically-perceptive field of soothing vibrations. Psionically-attuned individuals - like human kineticists - often carry such devices to aid in recovering from the rigors of intense psychic activity. This one appears to be of slyveren make - possibly forgotten in the aftermath of disciplining a particularly stubborn slave.

(Energy Recovery +25% when equipped)
rows.translation:
灵能噪声发生器利用一组经过精密切割和调谐的灵能反应晶体，产生一片能被心灵感应感知到的舒缓振动场。具有灵能感知能力的人——例如人类动能术士——经常携带此类装置，以帮助自己从高强度灵能活动造成的疲劳中恢复。这一台似乎由斯莱弗伦制造——或许是在管教某个特别顽固的奴隶后遗忘的。

（装备时能量恢复+25%）

rows.original: The massive cargo elevator here was clearly made to haul starship parts -- maybe even small ships like a starfighter in its entirety. Right now its loaded down with boxes full of engine parts, by the looks of things, though there’s just enough room for you to squeeze in amongst the cargo.
rows.translation: 这里的大型货运电梯显然用于运送星舰部件——甚至可以把星际战斗机之类的小型飞船整个装进去。目前电梯上堆满了看起来装着引擎零件的箱子，不过货物之间刚好还留有足够空间让你挤进去。

rows.original: An unattended uniform catches your eye in an opened locker. From the colors alone, you can tell it’s the same kind of outfit the collared workforce is wearing. It doesn’t take long to put two and two together: this is a slave’s getup. In the middle distance, a number of unzipped slaves dutifully fellate their masters before getting faced against the wall and rigorously pounded. A fresh injection of lust clouds your mind. Should you choose to disguise yourself, then maintaining it will likely only be possible through unthinking sexual obedience.

rows.original:
Walking along the outside of Zhèng Shi is beautiful but slow. Fortunately, there’s nobody around to bother a lone astronaut going for a stroll. Ships float by, loaded with illicit cargo and inattentive crews. You may as well not exist.

There’s the hangar! And you have plenty of oxygen to spare.
rows.translation:
走在郑石星外部很美，但速度缓慢。幸运的是，附近没有人来打扰一个独自散步的宇航员。满载非法货物、船员又漫不经心的飞船从旁飘过。你仿佛根本不存在。

机库就在那里！而且你的氧气绰绰有余。
rows.raw: "Walking along the outside of Zhèng Shi is beautiful but slow. Fortunately, there’s nobody around to bother a lone astronaut going for a stroll. Ships float by, loaded with illicit cargo and inattentive crews. You may as well not exist.\n\nThere’s the hangar! And you have plenty of oxygen to spare."

rows.original: As you wander through the byzantine sprawl of mine tunnels, you hear a thunderous stomp... stomp... stomp... coming towards you from one of the side passages. You turn to face it, just in time to see a lumbering black mass of metal, cables, and flickering digital readouts. A robot, shoddily built and probably a thousand years out of date besides... but it’s got a massive drill in place of one of its arms, and you can see where several lasers have been bolted onto the droid’s head and shoulders.
rows.translation: 当你在错综复杂的矿道中穿行时，一条侧通道里传来雷鸣般的咚……咚……咚……声，正朝你靠近。你转身面对声源，正好看见一团由金属、电缆和闪烁数字读数构成的笨重黑影。那是一台做工粗糙、恐怕也已经过时一千年的机器人……但它一条手臂的位置装着巨型钻头，头部和肩膀上还粗暴焊接了数门激光炮。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you wander through the byzantine sprawl of mine tunnels, you hear a thunderous stomp... stomp... stomp... coming towards you from one of the side passages. You turn to face it, just in time to see a lumbering black mass of metal, cables, and flickering digital readouts. A robot, shoddily built and probably a thousand years out of date besides... but it’s got a massive drill in place of one of its arms, and you can see where several lasers have been bolted onto the droid’s head and shoulders."

rows.original: The robot shudders, stumbles backwards, and with a shrieking howl, collapses on its back and starts flailing its legs like a capsized turtle. As it goes down, a compartment on its chest bursts open and spews a handful of small gemstones across the ground.
rows.translation: 机器人浑身颤抖，踉跄后退，伴随刺耳嚎叫仰面倒下，像翻倒的乌龟一样乱蹬双腿。它倒地时，胸口的一处舱门猛然弹开，将一小把宝石喷洒到地面。
rows.raw: "The robot shudders, stumbles backwards, and with a shrieking howl, collapses on its back and starts flailing its legs like a capsized turtle. As it goes down, a compartment on its chest bursts open and spews a handful of small gemstones across the ground."

rows.original: It’s like a big metal piñata!

rows.raw: "Defeat!"

rows.original: The droid stomps forward, bashing you in the face before rearing back with its mighty drill arm.
rows.translation: 机器人重踏向前，一拳砸在你脸上，随后举起强大的钻头手臂。
rows.raw: "The droid stomps forward, bashing you in the face before rearing back with its mighty drill arm."

rows.original: The last thing you ever see is the tip whirring, spinning up.
rows.translation: 你此生最后看见的景象，是钻尖嗡鸣着旋转加速。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe last thing you ever see is the tip whirring, spinning up."

rows.original: The droid backhands you, sending you sprawling back on your ass. Rather than immediately driving its drill into your guts to harvest you, the droid stomps forward and activates its scanners again. A wave of light passes over you, stem to stern, before the robot’s great big hand reaches down and grabs your pack. It brusquely rips your pack open and reaches in, yanking out the gemstone
rows.translation: 机器人反手一击，把你打得仰面摔倒。它没有立刻把钻头捅进你的内脏进行采收，而是重踏上前，再次启动扫描器。一道光从头到脚扫过你，随后机器人巨大的手掌向下抓住你的背包。它粗暴地撕开背包，把手伸进去，扯出里面的宝石
rows.raw: "The droid backhands you, sending you sprawling back on your ass. Rather than immediately driving its drill into your guts to harvest you, the droid stomps forward and activates its scanners again. A wave of light passes over you, stem to stern, before the robot’s great big hand reaches down and grabs your pack. It brusquely rips your pack open and reaches in, yanking out the gemstone"

inside and lifting them up to be analyzed.

rows.translation: “检测到高价值矿物。效率协议已启动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Valuable minerals detected. Efficiency protocols activated.”"

rows.original: The robot dumps your gems into a cabinet in its chest and turns, stomping off down another tunnel.
rows.translation: 机器人把你的宝石倒进胸口的储藏舱，随后转身，重踏着走向另一条矿道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robot dumps your gems into a cabinet in its chest and turns, stomping off down another tunnel."

rows.original: Good thing you had something to distract it, you guess...
rows.translation: 你想，幸好自己有东西能转移它的注意力……
rows.raw: "\n\nGood thing you had something to distract it, you guess..."

rows.original: You quiver with the impact of the droid’s last punch, splattering yourself against the nearby wall. The droid advances, drill whirring, until its scanner fixates on your [pc.chest]. You stare doe-eyed up at the monumental mountain of metal while it bathes you with a wave of searching light. It seems to find something it likes, because the drill powers down, and its more humanoid hand reaches down to you. You try and squirm away, but the bastard’s backed you up into a corner, and soon its hand is sinking into your chest, pushing into your gooey body and wrapping its metal fingers around your core!
rows.translation: 你随着机器人最后一拳的冲击而颤抖，整个人溅在附近墙壁上。机器人逼近，钻头嗡嗡旋转，直到扫描器锁定你的[pc.chest]。你睁大无辜双眼，仰望这座巍峨的金属山峰，同时一道搜索光波沐浴全身。它似乎找到了喜欢的东西，因为钻头停了下来，另一只更像人手的手掌朝你伸来。你试图挣扎逃开，但这混蛋已经把你逼进角落，很快，那只手便沉入你的胸膛，推入黏软身体，用金属手指紧紧包住你的核心！
rows.raw: "You quiver with the impact of the droid’s last punch, splattering yourself against the nearby wall. The droid advances, drill whirring, until its scanner fixates on your [pc.chest]. You stare doe-eyed up at the monumental mountain of metal while it bathes you with a wave of searching light. It seems to find something it likes, because the drill powers down, and its more humanoid hand reaches down to you. You try and squirm away, but the bastard’s backed you up into a corner, and soon its hand is sinking into your chest, pushing into your gooey body and wrapping its metal fingers around your core!"

rows.original: “No!” you yelp, flailing helplessly as the robot yanks on your core. There’s a pulling sensation deep inside, like he’s grabbing at your formerly-fleshy heart, and then it’s out! You watch in horror as the droid rips your core out and chucks it into a cabinet in its chest - and as it does so, you can almost immediately feel your mind becoming hazy, your thoughts getting... hungrier!
rows.translation: “不！”你尖叫着无助挣扎，机器人则用力拉扯核心。身体深处传来一股牵扯感，仿佛它抓住了你曾经由血肉构成的心脏，随后核心便被拔了出来！你惊恐地看着机器人扯出核心，把它扔进胸口的储藏舱——就在这一刻，你几乎立刻感觉思维变得朦胧，念头也越来越……饥饿！
rows.raw: "\n\n“No!” you yelp, flailing helplessly as the robot yanks on your core. There’s a pulling sensation deep inside, like he’s grabbing at your formerly-fleshy heart, and then it’s out! You watch in horror as the droid rips your core out and chucks it into a cabinet in its chest - and as it does so, you can almost immediately feel your mind becoming hazy, your thoughts getting... hungrier!"

rows.original: Too bad this big guy doesn’t have a dick you can suck while he takes your pretty core stone.
rows.translation: 可惜这个大家伙没有肉棒，让你能在它拿走漂亮核心石时含在嘴里。
rows.raw: "\n\nToo bad this big guy doesn’t have a dick you can suck while he takes your pretty core stone."

rows.original: The robot stalks off, leaving you to recongeal yourself and try to find your gear.
rows.translation: 机器人迈步离开，留下你重新凝聚身体，并试着寻找自己的装备。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robot stalks off, leaving you to recongeal yourself and try to find your gear."

rows.original: ZHENG_SHI
rows.raw: "ZHENG_SHI"

rows.original: Zhèng Shi
rows.translation: 郑石星
rows.raw: "Zhèng Shi"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: As you approach the docking bay, a direct-beam transmission comes across your communications display. That’s old tech, no use of standard quantum entanglement: just straight radio waves directed at your antennae. You furrow your brow and go down into your ship’s emergency S.O.S. beacon, pulling out the old-style handheld from its cradle. Something buzzes and crackles, and then you hear a voice come across:
rows.translation: 当你接近停靠湾时，通讯显示器收到一束定向传输。那可是老古董技术，没有使用标准量子纠缠，只是把普通无线电波直接射向天线。你皱起眉，打开飞船的紧急求救信标，从支架上取下老式手持设备。装置嗡鸣、噼啪作响，随后一个声音传来：
rows.raw: "As you approach the docking bay, a direct-beam transmission comes across your communications display. That’s old tech, no use of standard quantum entanglement: just straight radio waves directed at your antennae. You furrow your brow and go down into your ship’s emergency S.O.S. beacon, pulling out the old-style handheld from its cradle. Something buzzes and crackles, and then you hear a voice come across:"

rows.original: “This is Zhèng Shi Docking to... whoever the fuck you are. This ship’s not on the roster. Cough up the password or you’re gonna get blown to space dust.”
rows.translation: “这里是郑石星停靠管制，呼叫……管你他妈是谁。这艘船不在名册上。交出口令，不然就把你炸成太空尘埃。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is Zhèng Shi Docking to... whoever the fuck you are. This ship’s not on the roster. Cough up the password or you’re gonna get blown to space dust.”"

rows.original: Well, you knew this wasn’t going to be easy....
rows.translation: 好吧，你早知道事情不会这么容易....
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you knew this wasn’t going to be easy...."

rows.original: Password
rows.raw: "Password"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Several hours later...
rows.translation: 几小时后……
rows.raw: "Several hours later..."

rows.original: You’re snapped to wakefulness by a rhythmic beeping from your ship’s sensor suite. You don’t remember having fallen asleep, only the passage of hours waiting for your sensors to fully scan an entire solar system.
rows.translation: 飞船传感器组有节奏的哔哔声将你猛然惊醒。你不记得自己何时睡着，只记得花了几个小时等待传感器彻底扫描整个恒星系。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re snapped to wakefulness by a rhythmic beeping from your ship’s sensor suite. You don’t remember having fallen asleep, only the passage of hours waiting for your sensors to fully scan an entire solar system."

rows.original: They haven’t found the probe, but as you wipe the sleep from your eyes, you see that your sensors have locked onto a ship puttering through the debris field on impulse power. She’s a big girl, too, practically bursting at the seams with hemispherical laser batteries and grappling cannons. She’s not flying any colors and her ID’s not pinging any databases you can access, so if you had to take a wild guess, you’d say she’s a pirate ship.
rows.translation: 它们没找到探针，但当你揉掉眼中睡意时，发现传感器锁定了一艘正靠脉冲动力在残骸区缓慢航行的飞船。她也是个大家伙，半球形激光炮台和抓钩炮几乎挤满整个船体。她没有悬挂任何旗帜，识别码也未匹配你能访问的任何数据库，所以如果非要大胆猜测，你会说这是一艘海盗船。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey haven’t found the probe, but as you wipe the sleep from your eyes, you see that your sensors have locked onto a ship puttering through the debris field on impulse power. She’s a big girl, too, practically bursting at the seams with hemispherical laser batteries and grappling cannons. She’s not flying any colors and her ID’s not pinging any databases you can access, so if you had to take a wild guess, you’d say she’s a pirate ship."

rows.original: And she’s making good speed somewhere. Curious, you ease yourself into the field after her, taking it nice and slow to avoid detection.
rows.translation: 而且她正在迅速赶往某处。出于好奇，你缓缓跟进残骸区，保持低速以免被发现。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd she’s making good speed somewhere. Curious, you ease yourself into the field after her, taking it nice and slow to avoid detection. "

rows.original: It’s no sweat for you, given you previous occupation. You know all the tricks a ship like this might use to cover her tracks; following her is child’s play.
rows.translation: 考虑到你以前的职业，这对你毫无压力。你知道这种飞船用来掩盖踪迹的所有手段；跟踪她简直是小菜一碟。
rows.raw: "It’s no sweat for you, given you previous occupation. You know all the tricks a ship like this might use to cover her tracks; following her is child’s play."

rows.original: You monitor the sensors closely, refusing to let any amount of interference from the massive debris field around you distract you from your quarry.
rows.translation: 你密切监控传感器，绝不允许周围庞大残骸区的任何干扰分散自己对目标的注意。
rows.raw: "You monitor the sensors closely, refusing to let any amount of interference from the massive debris field around you distract you from your quarry."

rows.original: You’ve flown more dangerous combat missions than this. It’s easy to pretend the asteroids are big, slow missiles, and you dodge and weave between then while staying just out of view.
rows.translation: 你执行过比这危险得多的战斗任务。只需把小行星想象成巨大而缓慢的导弹，在它们之间闪转穿梭，同时保持在视野之外，一切便轻而易举。
rows.raw: "You’ve flown more dangerous combat missions than this. It’s easy to pretend the asteroids are big, slow missiles, and you dodge and weave between then while staying just out of view."

rows.original: After about an hour, the ship seems confident it isn’t being followed and takes a sharp turn towards one of the largest asteroids - indeed, the largest - in the field. You follow from a safe distance, watching the ship approach a structure you instantly recognize: a spacedock! The same kind as back on Tavros, with a huge metal opening, wide enough for a cruiser to slip through, projecting a permeable force field to keep the air in.
rows.translation: 大约一小时后，那艘船似乎确信没人跟踪，突然转向残骸区最大的小行星之一——事实上，就是最大的那一颗。你从安全距离跟随，注视飞船接近一座立刻就能认出的设施：太空港！和塔夫罗斯上的同类一样，拥有巨大的金属开口，宽到足以让巡洋舰通过，并投射可穿透力场，将空气封在内部。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter about an hour, the ship seems confident it isn’t being followed and takes a sharp turn towards one of the largest asteroids - indeed, the largest - in the field. You follow from a safe distance, watching the ship approach a structure you instantly recognize: a spacedock! The same kind as back on Tavros, with a huge metal opening, wide enough for a cruiser to slip through, projecting a permeable force field to keep the air in."

rows.original: And it’s not the only ship.
rows.translation: 而且那不是唯一一艘船。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd it’s not the only ship."

rows.original: Indeed, several other ships are coming and going from the hidden port, all of different models but armed and painted in gregarious colors that suggest more pirates than you’ve ever seen gathered in one place before. This must be some kind of pirate base!
rows.translation: 事实上，还有几艘不同型号的飞船进出这座隐秘港口。它们全副武装，涂着张扬的色彩，让你感觉聚集在这里的海盗比过去任何地方都多。这一定是某种海盗基地！
rows.raw: "\n\nIndeed, several other ships are coming and going from the hidden port, all of different models but armed and painted in gregarious colors that suggest more pirates than you’ve ever seen gathered in one place before. This must be some kind of pirate base!"

rows.original: Well shit, that makes finding your probe in this system a lot more challenging. Especially if it’s ended up in the pirates’ possession... and considering how many credi-hungry opportunists appear to be using this chunk of crust as a port of call, you wouldn’t be surprised. You wait until the ship’s gone in before easing forward again, trying to come up with a plan...
rows.translation: 好吧，该死，这让你在这个星系寻找探针变得困难多了。尤其是假如它已经落入海盗手中……而考虑到有多少渴求信用点的机会主义者把这块地壳残片当成停靠港，你一点也不会惊讶。你等那艘船进去后才再次缓缓靠近，同时思考计划……
rows.raw: "\n\nWell shit, that makes finding your probe in this system a lot more challenging. Especially if it’s ended up in the pirates’ possession... and considering how many credi-hungry opportunists appear to be using this chunk of crust as a port of call, you wouldn’t be surprised. You wait until the ship’s gone in before easing forward again, trying to come up with a plan..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: There are so many ships, each more ostentatious than the last. There’s no way they all belong to the same pirate group. Not the Black Void, certainly. No, the longer you watch, the more you become convinced that this is some kind of gathering place for underworld scum.
rows.translation: 飞船多得惊人，而且一艘比一艘招摇。它们不可能全属于同一个海盗集团，肯定不是黑色虚空。观察得越久，你越确信这里是某种地下世界渣滓的聚集地。
rows.raw: "There are so many ships, each more ostentatious than the last. There’s no way they all belong to the same pirate group. Not the Black Void, certainly. No, the longer you watch, the more you become convinced that this is some kind of gathering place for underworld scum. "

rows.original: At last, you’ve found your people!
rows.translation: 终于，你找到了自己的同类！
rows.raw: " At last, you’ve found your people!"

rows.original: Indeed, now that you’ve found the base, your cursory scans show that there’s quite a vast complex in there, and you can visually identify some exterior structures on the asteroid’s surface, all nice and powered but without any obvious means of ingress for your ship.
rows.translation: 的确，既然已经发现基地，粗略扫描显示内部有一座相当庞大的综合设施；你还能目视辨认小行星表面的一些外部结构，它们都正常供能，却没有明显可供飞船进入的入口。
rows.raw: " Indeed, now that you’ve found the base, your cursory scans show that there’s quite a vast complex in there, and you can visually identify some exterior structures on the asteroid’s surface, all nice and powered but without any obvious means of ingress for your ship."

rows.original: The only way you’re getting in is, well... the front door.
rows.translation: 想进去只有一个办法，那就是……走正门。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe only way you’re getting in is, well... the front door."

rows.original: Alright, time to put that Steele charm to work. You strap in, divert all power to the shields, and begin your approach.
rows.translation: 好吧，该让斯蒂尔的魅力派上用场了。你系好安全带，将全部能量转入护盾，开始靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright, time to put that Steele charm to work. You strap in, divert all power to the shields, and begin your approach."

rows.original: What could go wrong?
rows.translation: 能出什么问题呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat could go wrong?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You stretch out and slap the main breaker, listening to the headset and nearly everything else go dead as you feign a power failure. Hopefully that’ll buy you a few seconds to phone a friend...
rows.translation: 你伸手拍下主断路器，听着耳机和几乎所有设备一起断电，伪装出电力故障。希望这样能争取几秒钟，让你打电话向朋友求助……
rows.raw: "You stretch out and slap the main breaker, listening to the headset and nearly everything else go dead as you feign a power failure. Hopefully that’ll buy you a few seconds to phone a friend..."

rows.original: The Codex’s warm light bathes the inside of your now-dark cockpit in its familiar glow as you tap into the system’s surviving comm buoy and make a high-priority holocall to your big-balled
rows.translation: 你接入系统仍在工作的通讯浮标，向那位巨蛋
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Codex’s warm light bathes the inside of your now-dark cockpit in its familiar glow as you tap into the system’s surviving comm buoy and make a high-priority holocall to your big-balled "

rows.original: girlfriend
rows.translation: 女朋友
rows.raw: "girlfriend"

rows.original: tanuki-buddy
rows.translation: 狸猫伙伴
rows.raw: "tanuki-buddy"

rows.original: “Heya, Angel,” Kiro drunkenly slurs. Her holographic image wobbles unsteadily. Judging by the background noise, she’s deep into her drinks in some scummy space bar. “Usually I’m one the one in charge of makin’ booty calls! You wanna hook up?” She props her head up on her arm and licks her lips.
rows.translation: “嗨呀，小天使，”姬萝醉醺醺地含混说道。她的全息影像不稳地晃动。根据背景噪声判断，她正在某个肮脏太空酒吧里喝得酩酊大醉。“一般都是我负责打炮电话！你想约炮吗？”她用手臂撑住脑袋，舔了舔嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heya, Angel,” Kiro drunkenly slurs. Her holographic image wobbles unsteadily. Judging by the background noise, she’s deep into her drinks in some scummy space bar. “Usually I’m one the one in charge of makin’ booty calls! You wanna hook up?” She props her head up on her arm and licks her lips."

rows.original: Ooooh, you so like, totally do, but maybe after you land your ship. “Ummm, actually Kiro I’m at some pirate base, and they want a password or something. I think they might like, blow me up if I don’t give the right one! Ugh. Anyways, it’s called Zhèng Shi. You ever been there?”
rows.translation: 哦哦哦，你当然超级想，不过也许得等飞船着陆之后。“呃，其实呢，姬萝，我在某个海盗基地，他们要口令还是什么东西。我猜如果答错，他们大概会把我炸飞！真烦。总之，这里叫郑石星。你来过吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nOoooh, you so like, totally do, but maybe after you land your ship. “Ummm, actually Kiro I’m at some pirate base, and they want a password or something. I think they might like, blow me up if I don’t give the right one! Ugh. Anyways, it’s called Zhèng Shi. You ever been there?”"

rows.original: “Bitch, please!” You sigh. “You know Zhèng Shi? They want a password that I don’t have.”
rows.translation: “少来这套，婊子！”你叹了口气。“你知道郑石星吗？他们要一个我不知道的口令。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bitch, please!” You sigh. “You know Zhèng Shi? They want a password that I don’t have.”"

rows.original: “Maybe later,” you answer with a shake of your head, “I’m at a pirate base that goes by the name of Zhèng Shi. Ever been there? I could really use the password.”
rows.translation: “以后再说吧，”你摇头回答，“我正在一个叫郑石星的海盗基地。你来过吗？我真的很需要那个口令。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe later,” you answer with a shake of your head, “I’m at a pirate base that goes by the name of Zhèng Shi. Ever been there? I could really use the password.”"

rows.original: “Assuming the pirates at Zhèng Shi don’t paste me in space-dust, I might look into it.” You say, “I’m in a tight spot here, and if I don’t get them the right password in a minute or two, this is going to be a real short Rush for me.”
rows.translation: “假如郑石星的海盗没把我炸成太空尘埃，我或许会考虑。”你说道，“我现在处境很糟，如果一两分钟内不给他们正确口令，这次星球大淘金对我来说就会短得可怜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Assuming the pirates at Zhèng Shi don’t paste me in space-dust, I might look into it.” You say, “I’m in a tight spot here, and if I don’t get them the right password in a minute or two, this is going to be a real short Rush for me.”"

rows.original: “Focus up, Kiro.” You slam your fist into the console. “These pirate assholes at Zhèng Shi want a password, and if I don’t guess the right one, I’m going to have to fight my way in. I’d rather not kill any of your friends.”
rows.translation: “集中精神，姬萝。”你一拳砸在控制台上。“郑石星那群海盗混蛋要口令，如果猜不对，我就得一路打进去。我可不想杀掉你的任何朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Focus up, Kiro.” You slam your fist into the console. “These pirate assholes at Zhèng Shi want a password, and if I don’t guess the right one, I’m going to have to fight my way in. I’d rather not kill any of your friends.”"

rows.original: Kiro facepalms and airily giggles, “Fuck you!”
rows.translation: 姬萝捂住脸，轻飘飘地笑道：“操你！”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro facepalms and airily giggles, “Fuck you!”"

rows.original: Wha-?
rows.raw: "\n\nWha-?"

rows.original: “No, no, no! The password. Just tell ‘em to go fuck themselves.” She takes a swig of a mystery drink that doesn’t quite render in. “That’s the thing about us pirates - the only thing we hate more than being ordered around is dealing with red tape and regulation. Fuck, you’re so naive sometimes, Angel.”
rows.translation: “不，不，不！是口令。直接叫他们滚去操自己。”她喝了一口无法在影像中正确显示的神秘饮品。“我们海盗就是这样——比起被人呼来喝去，我们更讨厌繁文缛节和规章制度。妈的，你有时候真是天真得可爱，小天使。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no, no! The password. Just tell ‘em to go fuck themselves.” She takes a swig of a mystery drink that doesn’t quite render in. “That’s the thing about us pirates - the only thing we hate more than being ordered around is dealing with red tape and regulation. Fuck, you’re so naive sometimes, Angel.”"

rows.original: You thank her for the help and end the call, watching Kiro’s smirking lips fade away into nothing.
rows.translation: 你感谢她的帮助并结束通话，看着姬萝坏笑的嘴唇逐渐消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank her for the help and end the call, watching Kiro’s smirking lips fade away into nothing."

rows.original: A few presses on your Codex are all it takes to summon Kiro to the cockpit.
rows.translation: 只需在资料库上点按几下，就能把姬萝叫到驾驶舱。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few presses on your Codex are all it takes to summon Kiro to the cockpit."

rows.original: “Heya, Angel,” Kiro says, yawning. She rubs a bit of sleep out of her eyes. “Usually I’m one the one in charge of makin’ booty calls! Why’re the lights off? You wanted hook up or something? Fuck, you’re dirty.” She leans against a bulkhead licks her lips.
rows.translation: “嗨呀，小天使，”姬萝打着哈欠说道。她揉去眼中的一点睡意。“一般都是我负责打炮电话！为什么灯关着？你想约炮还是什么？妈的，你真淫荡。”她靠在舱壁上舔了舔嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heya, Angel,” Kiro says, yawning. She rubs a bit of sleep out of her eyes. “Usually I’m one the one in charge of makin’ booty calls! Why’re the lights off? You wanted hook up or something? Fuck, you’re dirty.” She leans against a bulkhead licks her lips."

rows.original: Ooooh, you so like, totally do, but maybe after you land your ship. “Ummm, actually Kiro I’m at some pirate base, and they want a password or something. I think they might like, blow us up if I don’t give the right one! Ugh. Anyways, it’s called Zhèng Shi. You ever been here?”
rows.translation: 哦哦哦，你当然超级想，不过也许得等飞船着陆之后。“呃，其实呢，姬萝，我在某个海盗基地，他们要口令还是什么东西。我猜如果答错，他们大概会把我们炸飞！真烦。总之，这里叫郑石星。你来过吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nOoooh, you so like, totally do, but maybe after you land your ship. “Ummm, actually Kiro I’m at some pirate base, and they want a password or something. I think they might like, blow us up if I don’t give the right one! Ugh. Anyways, it’s called Zhèng Shi. You ever been here?”"

rows.original: “Bitch, please!” You sigh. “You know Zhèng Shi? They want a password that I don’t have.”
rows.translation: “少来这套，婊子！”你叹了口气。“你知道郑石星吗？他们要一个我不知道的口令。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bitch, please!” You sigh. “You know Zhèng Shi? They want a password that I don’t have.”"

rows.original: “Maybe later,” you answer with a shake of your head, “We’re at a pirate base - Zhèng Shi. Ever been there? I could really use the password.”
rows.translation: “以后再说吧，”你摇头回答，“我们在一个海盗基地——郑石星。你来过吗？我真的很需要那个口令。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe later,” you answer with a shake of your head, “We’re at a pirate base - Zhèng Shi. Ever been there? I could really use the password.”"

rows.original: “Assuming the pirates here don’t paste us in space-dust, I might look into it.” You say, “We’re in a tight spot here, and if I don’t get Zhèng Shi the right password in a minute or two, this is going to be a real short Rush for us.”
rows.translation: “假如这里的海盗没把我们炸成太空尘埃，我或许会考虑。”你说道，“我们现在处境很糟，如果一两分钟内不给郑石星正确口令，这次星球大淘金对我们来说就会短得可怜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Assuming the pirates here don’t paste us in space-dust, I might look into it.” You say, “We’re in a tight spot here, and if I don’t get Zhèng Shi the right password in a minute or two, this is going to be a real short Rush for us.”"

rows.original: “Focus up, Kiro.” You slam your fist into the console. “These pirate assholes at Zhèng Shi want a password, and if I don’t guess the right one, we’re going to have to fight our way in. I’d rather not kill any of your friends.”
rows.translation: “集中精神，姬萝。”你一拳砸在控制台上。“郑石星那群海盗混蛋要口令，如果猜不对，我们就得一路打进去。我可不想杀掉你的任何朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Focus up, Kiro.” You slam your fist into the console. “These pirate assholes at Zhèng Shi want a password, and if I don’t guess the right one, we’re going to have to fight our way in. I’d rather not kill any of your friends.”"

rows.original: Kiro facepalms. “Fuck you!”
rows.translation: 姬萝捂住脸。“操你！”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro facepalms. “Fuck you!”"

rows.original: Wha-?
rows.raw: "\n\nWha-?"

rows.original: “No, no, no! The password. Just tell ‘em to go fuck themselves.” She casually belches. “That’s the thing about us pirates - the only thing we hate more than being ordered around is dealing with red tape and regulation. Fuck, you’re so naive sometimes, Angel.”
rows.translation: “不，不，不！是口令。直接叫他们滚去操自己。”她随意打了个嗝。“我们海盗就是这样——比起被人呼来喝去，我们更讨厌繁文缛节和规章制度。妈的，你有时候真是天真得可爱，小天使。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no, no! The password. Just tell ‘em to go fuck themselves.” She casually belches. “That’s the thing about us pirates - the only thing we hate more than being ordered around is dealing with red tape and regulation. Fuck, you’re so naive sometimes, Angel.”"

rows.original: You thank her for the help and dismiss her with a promise that you can play later.
rows.translation: 你感谢她的帮助，让她离开，并答应之后可以一起玩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank her for the help and dismiss her with a promise that you can play later."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A few button presses later, power hums back through your ship, and the crackling communication channel snaps back open. “Can you hear me, asshole? Pony up with the password or join the debris field. Your call.”
rows.translation: 按下几个按钮后，电力重新嗡鸣着流过飞船，噼啪作响的通讯频道也重新接通。“听得见吗，混蛋？交出口令，不然就加入那片残骸。你自己选。”
rows.raw: "A few button presses later, power hums back through your ship, and the crackling communication channel snaps back open. “Can you hear me, asshole? Pony up with the password or join the debris field. Your call.”"

rows.original: Pirates: not the most patient bunch.
rows.translation: 海盗可不是最有耐心的一群人。
rows.raw: "\n\nPirates: not the most patient bunch."

rows.raw: "Fuck You"

rows.raw: "Submit"

rows.translation: 快跑！
rows.raw: "Run!"

rows.translation: 斯蒂尔撤退！
rows.raw: "Steele Out!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: That’s a lot of target lock alerts you just got, and you have no idea what the password is, so...
rows.translation: 你刚刚收到了多得惊人的目标锁定警报，又完全不知道口令，所以……
rows.raw: "That’s a lot of target lock alerts you just got, and you have no idea what the password is, so..."

rows.original: Steele out!
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔撤退！
rows.raw: "\n\nSteele out!"

rows.original: You reverse the throttle and book it back into the cover of the asteroid belt. The station takes a couple parting shots at you, but nothing gets through the shields before you’re covered by another half-moon of broken planet.
rows.translation: 你反向推动节流阀，飞快退回小行星带的掩护中。空间站临别前朝你开了几炮，但在另一块半月形破碎行星残骸将你遮住前，没有任何攻击穿透护盾。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reverse the throttle and book it back into the cover of the asteroid belt. The station takes a couple parting shots at you, but nothing gets through the shields before you’re covered by another half-moon of broken planet."

rows.original: Well, now you need to find a pirate to coax the answer out of... one way or another.
rows.translation: 好吧，现在你得找个海盗套出答案……不管用什么办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, now you need to find a pirate to coax the answer out of... one way or another."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "Tarkus"

rows.raw: "cock"

rows.raw: "cunt"

rows.raw: "screw you"

rows.original: bastard
rows.raw: "bastard"

rows.original: “Yeah, alright, alright,” the station controller’s voice says over your short wave, followed by a surprisingly girlish laugh. “You sure sound like a pirate. Guns are down... for now. Don’t make trouble, fresh meat.”
rows.translation: “行吧，行吧，”空间站管制员的声音从短波通讯中传来，随后是一阵出乎意料的少女笑声。“听起来倒真像个海盗。炮火已经关闭……暂时的。别惹事，新来的。”
rows.raw: "“Yeah, alright, alright,” the station controller’s voice says over your short wave, followed by a surprisingly girlish laugh. “You sure sound like a pirate. Guns are down... for now. Don’t make trouble, fresh meat.”"

rows.original: The target locks from the asteroid subside, and you’re able to bring your ship forward into the bay unmolested. You pass through the force field and into a sweeping hangar bay, big enough for twenty or so large ships - and countless little tramp freighters and scout ships like the old Z14.
rows.translation: 来自小行星的目标锁定消失了，你得以安然驾驶飞船进入机库。你穿过力场，进入一座宽阔的机库，足以容纳二十艘左右的大型飞船——以及无数像老旧Z14那样的小型流浪货船和侦察艇。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe target locks from the asteroid subside, and you’re able to bring your ship forward into the bay unmolested. You pass through the force field and into a sweeping hangar bay, big enough for twenty or so large ships - and countless little tramp freighters and scout ships like the old Z14."

rows.original: Nobody’s paying you much mind now that you’re docked. Indeed, you manage to find a relatively isolated spot at the back of the hangar to land. The ship settles with a resounding thud, and you make your way to the airlock. Time to see where your probe’s gotten off to... assuming it’s really here.
rows.translation: 停靠之后，没人太在意你。事实上，你在机库后方找到了一处相对僻静的着陆点。飞船伴着一声震耳的砰响落稳，你随即走向气闸。该看看你的探针跑到哪里去了……前提是它真的在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nNobody’s paying you much mind now that you’re docked. Indeed, you manage to find a relatively isolated spot at the back of the hangar to land. The ship settles with a resounding thud, and you make your way to the airlock. Time to see where your probe’s gotten off to... assuming it’s really here."

rows.original: HERISIOD.ZHENG SHI STATION.ZS L50
rows.raw: "HERISIOD.ZHENG SHI STATION.ZS L50"

rows.raw: "HERISIOD.ZHENG SHI STATION.ZS L50"

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Yeah, nice try,” the voice says over the radio, suddenly with a dangerous edge. “Only gate you’re crashing is the afterlife’s!” Ships buzz out of Zhèng Shi’s hangar like bees from a hive you just accidentally kicked... Shit.
rows.translation: “想得美，”无线电里的声音忽然透出危险意味。“你唯一能闯进去的门，就是来世的大门！” 飞船像被你不小心踹了一脚的蜂巢中涌出的蜜蜂一样，从郑石星机库蜂拥而出……该死。
rows.raw: "“Yeah, nice try,” the voice says over the radio, suddenly with a dangerous edge. “Only gate you’re crashing is the afterlife’s!”\n\nShips buzz out of Zhèng Shi’s hangar like bees from a hive you just accidentally kicked... Shit."

rows.original: Zhèng Shi houses numerous EM turrets across its rocky surface, perfect for gunning down anybody who wanders too close. It’ll be hard to escape while they’re still online.
rows.translation: 郑石星岩石表面遍布电磁炮塔，非常适合击落任何靠得太近的人。只要它们仍在运转，逃出去就会非常困难。
rows.raw: "Zhèng Shi houses numerous EM turrets across its rocky surface, perfect for gunning down anybody who wanders too close. It’ll be hard to escape while they’re still online."

rows.translation: 海盗
rows.raw: "Pirates"

rows.original: PIRATES
rows.raw: "PIRATES"

rows.original: The modified, “Corona Lords”-affiliated Casstech Z7s are equipped to run down vulnerable Rushers and unload on them with standard-issue machine guns and short-ranged energy weapons.
rows.translation: 这些经过改装、隶属“日冕领主”的卡斯泰克Z7，专门用于追逐脆弱的淘金者，再以制式机枪和短程能量武器向他们倾泻火力。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe modified, “Corona Lords”-affiliated Casstech Z7s are equipped to run down vulnerable Rushers and unload on them with standard-issue machine guns and short-ranged energy weapons."
