rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Despite trying to resolve the situation on a peaceful note, that does not play well with Zhèng Shi’s rules at all. Your plea for surrender is ignored as the remaining scanners pick up hot projectiles being launched in your direction. The impact is audible and wakes up your ship’s emergency power sources, but that is not the end...
rows.translation: 尽管你试图以和平方式解决局面，但这完全不符合郑石星的规矩。你投降的请求无人理会，剩余的扫描仪反而侦测到炽热弹体正朝你飞来。撞击声清晰可闻，也唤醒了飞船的应急电源，但这还不是结束……
rows.raw: "Despite trying to resolve the situation on a peaceful note, that does not play well with Zhèng Shi’s rules at all. Your plea for surrender is ignored as the remaining scanners pick up hot projectiles being launched in your direction. The impact is audible and wakes up your ship’s emergency power sources, but that is not the end..."

rows.original: While core system after core system fails, the bombardment continues. Simply disabling your ship isn’t enough for these pirates. Alarms blare as thunderous vibrations rattle through the deck beneath your [pc.legOrLegs]. You close your eyes, awaiting the inevitab-
rows.translation: 一个又一个核心系统接连失效，炮击却仍在继续。仅仅让你的飞船瘫痪并不能满足这些海盗。警报尖啸，雷鸣般的震动穿过[pc.legOrLegs]下方的甲板。你闭上眼睛，等待那不可避——
rows.raw: "While core system after core system fails, the bombardment continues. Simply disabling your ship isn’t enough for these pirates. Alarms blare as thunderous vibrations rattle through the deck beneath your [pc.legOrLegs]. You close your eyes, awaiting the inevitab-"

rows.original: Victory!
rows.translation: 胜利！
rows.raw: "Victory!"

rows.original: Fen & Savin
rows.raw: "Fen & Savin"

rows.original: The comm crackles to life. “Huh. I guess you got what it takes to hang in Zhèng Shi after all. Here, since you freed up some hangar space down on Cargo Deck, I’ve allocated you a parking slot. To the victor go the spoils and all that rot. Oh, and for future reference, when pirates ask you for a password, you ask them to fuck off. Nobody uses passcodes but corp-sluts and Peacekeeper corp-sluts.” The girl on the other side of the line cuts it before you can reply.
rows.translation: 通讯器噼啪一响，恢复了连接。“哈。看来你终究有本事在郑石星混下去。既然你腾出了货运甲板的一些机库空间，我给你分配了一个停泊位。战利品归胜者之类的废话。哦，顺便说一句，以后海盗问你要口令时，就叫他们滚去操自己。除了公司婊子和维和官公司的婊子，没人会用通行码。”线路另一端的女孩没等你回答便切断通讯。
rows.raw: "The comm crackles to life. “Huh. I guess you got what it takes to hang in Zhèng Shi after all. Here, since you freed up some hangar space down on Cargo Deck, I’ve allocated you a parking slot. To the victor go the spoils and all that rot. Oh, and for future reference, when pirates ask you for a password, you ask them to fuck off. Nobody uses passcodes but corp-sluts and Peacekeeper corp-sluts.” The girl on the other side of the line cuts it before you can reply."

rows.original: The target locks from the asteroid subside, and you’re able to bring your ship forward into the bay unmolested. You pass through the force field and into a sweeping hangar bay, big enough for twenty or so large ships - and countless little tramp freighters and scout ships like the old Z14.
rows.translation: 来自小行星的目标锁定消失了，你得以安然驾驶飞船进入机库。你穿过力场，进入一座宽阔的机库，足以容纳二十艘左右的大型飞船——以及无数像老旧Z14那样的小型流浪货船和侦察艇。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe target locks from the asteroid subside, and you’re able to bring your ship forward into the bay unmolested. You pass through the force field and into a sweeping hangar bay, big enough for twenty or so large ships - and countless little tramp freighters and scout ships like the old Z14."

rows.original: Nobody’s paying you much mind now that you’re docked. Indeed, you manage to find a relatively isolated spot at the back of the hangar to land. The ship settles with a resounding thud, and you make your way to the airlock. Time to see where your probe’s gotten off to... assuming it’s really here.
rows.translation: 停靠之后，没人太在意你。事实上，你在机库后方找到了一处相对僻静的着陆点。飞船伴着一声震耳的砰响落稳，你随即走向气闸。该看看你的探针跑到哪里去了……前提是它真的在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nNobody’s paying you much mind now that you’re docked. Indeed, you manage to find a relatively isolated spot at the back of the hangar to land. The ship settles with a resounding thud, and you make your way to the airlock. Time to see where your probe’s gotten off to... assuming it’s really here."

rows.translation: 已锁定

rows.translation: 已锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: You haven’t met a character you could call in a favor from...
rows.translation: 你还没遇到可以请来帮忙的角色……
rows.raw: "You haven’t met a character you could call in a favor from..."

rows.original: Call Paige
rows.translation: 呼叫佩姬
rows.raw: "Call Paige"

rows.original: B
You stretch out and slap the main breaker, listening to the headset and nearly everything else go dead as you feign a power failure. Hopefully that’ll buy you a few seconds to phone a friend...
rows.translation: 你伸手拍下主断路器，耳机和几乎所有设备都随之断电，伪装出电力故障。希望这样能争取几秒钟，让你打电话向朋友求助……
rows.raw: "You stretch out and slap the main breaker, listening to the headset and nearly everything else go dead as you feign a power failure. Hopefully that’ll buy you a few seconds to phone a friend..."

rows.original: Using your systems emergency power, you dial into your ship’s intercom. “Paige to the bridge,” you say, “and quickly.”
rows.translation: 你利用系统的应急电源接通飞船内部通讯。“佩姬，到舰桥来，”你说道，“要快。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUsing your systems emergency power, you dial into your ship’s intercom. “Paige to the bridge,” you say, “and quickly.”"

rows.original: Seconds later, you hear the hurried tap-tap of Paige’s footsteps approaching the bridge of your ship. She bursts into the room, out of breath from rushing as quickly as she could. “Yes, captain?” she asks.
rows.translation: 几秒后，佩姬急促的嗒嗒脚步声从飞船舰桥方向传来。她冲进房间，因为一路飞奔而气喘吁吁。“什么事，船长？”她问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeconds later, you hear the hurried tap-tap of Paige’s footsteps approaching the bridge of your ship. She bursts into the room, out of breath from rushing as quickly as she could. “Yes, captain?” she asks."

rows.original: You direct her to the asteroid base in front of your ship, and you tell her that it’s apparently a pirate base. You want to dock, but the harbormaster that responded to your hail asked you for a password. You figured, since Paige was a pirate at one point, maybe she knows what it is?
rows.translation: 你指向飞船前方的小行星基地，告诉她那里显然是一座海盗基地。你想要停靠，但回应呼叫的港务长向你索要口令。佩姬以前当过海盗，所以你想她或许知道答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou direct her to the asteroid base in front of your ship, and you tell her that it’s apparently a pirate base. You want to dock, but the harbormaster that responded to your hail asked you for a password. You figured, since Paige was a pirate at one point, maybe she knows what it is?"

rows.original: Paige straightens her back and starts to laugh at the question. “That’s easy. Do you still have them on call?” You tell her that you do, as soon as you flip the breaker back on. “Do it. I’ll handle it, sweet thing.”
rows.translation: 佩姬挺直腰背，听见问题便笑了起来。“这很简单。他们还在线吗？”你告诉她，只要重新合上断路器就能联系。“照做吧，甜心。我来处理。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige straightens her back and starts to laugh at the question. “That’s easy. Do you still have them on call?” You tell her that you do, as soon as you flip the breaker back on. “Do it. I’ll handle it, sweet thing.”"

rows.original: You do as she asks, as she steps up to the communicator’s receiver. A few button presses later, power hums back through your ship, and the crackling communication channel snaps back open. “Can you hear me, asshole? Pony up with the password or join the debris field. Your call.”
rows.translation: 你照她说的做，她则走到通讯器的接收端前。按下几个按钮后，电力重新嗡鸣着流过飞船，噼啪作响的通讯频道也重新接通。“听得见吗，混蛋？交出口令，不然就加入那片残骸。你自己选。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do as she asks, as she steps up to the communicator’s receiver. A few button presses later, power hums back through your ship, and the crackling communication channel snaps back open. “Can you hear me, asshole? Pony up with the password or join the debris field. Your call.”"

rows.original: Paige wets her lips before responding.
rows.translation: 佩姬润了润嘴唇，随后作出回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige wets her lips before responding."

rows.original: “Hey, go fuck yourself, dipshit!” she hollers into the receiver. “The fuck is this, about some ‘password’ horseshit? We got business on the base, so lower your fucking weapons before I tell you what your safeword is!”
rows.translation: “嘿，滚去操你自己吧，蠢货！”她朝接收器大吼。“什么狗屁‘口令’？我们在基地有正事要办，所以赶紧把你们的破武器放下，不然就由我来告诉你，你的安全词是什么！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, go fuck yourself, dipshit!” she hollers into the receiver. “The fuck is this, about some ‘password’ horseshit? We got business on the base, so lower your fucking weapons before I tell you what your safeword is!”"

rows.original: “Alright, jeez!” the station controller’s voice says. “Guns are down. We’ll see how long that attitude keeps up, fresh meat.”
rows.translation: “好吧，真是的！”空间站管制员说道。“炮火关闭了。看看你这态度还能撑多久吧，新来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, jeez!” the station controller’s voice says. “Guns are down. We’ll see how long that attitude keeps up, fresh meat.”"

rows.original: True to the harbormaster’s word, the target locks from the asteroid release, and you’re free to bring your ship into the bay unmolested.
rows.translation: 正如港务长所说，小行星上的目标锁定随即解除，你可以安然驾驶飞船进入机库。
rows.raw: "\n\nTrue to the harbormaster’s word, the target locks from the asteroid release, and you’re free to bring your ship into the bay unmolested."

rows.original: “Those dumb fuck-bunnies are worse at running this place than they are at taking showers.” The sour mechanic sighs. “Look, I might be an asshole, but I’m not gonna let you get yourself killed on your way out of here.” She digs deep into her toolbox, spilling a few tiny screwdrivers into the cut-open diggerbot. “Ah, here it is!” A small alligator clip with skull and crossbones appears in her fuzzy hand. “Pin this on somewhere, and they’ll leave you alone.” It sails through the air into your hand.
rows.translation: “那群蠢透了的兔崽子管理这里的本事，比洗澡还差。”脾气暴躁的机械师叹了口气。“听着，我也许是个混蛋，但不会眼睁睁看着你在离开这里的路上送命。”她把手伸进工具箱深处，几把微型螺丝刀掉进被拆开的采矿机器人。“啊，在这里！”她毛茸茸的手里出现一个带骷髅与交叉骨图案的小鳄鱼夹。“把这个别在身上某处，它们就不会理你了。”东西划过空中，落入你手中。

I’m already behind on this repair job, and I am not going to waste anymore time in this hell-pit than I have to. Bad enough the other Raiders sent me down here in the first place.”

rows.translation: 某种近似笑容的表情在她尖尖的口鼻上展开。“那当然。不过单凭我们自己，还没有强大到足以狠狠教训那些真正要紧的人。所以我们才不得不忍受混蛋毒蛇、淫荡跳帮者、机器恋物癖，还有那群自命不凡、吸食日冕的家伙。”她耸耸肩。“总之，我还有工作要做，而你……”她用尾巴指向你，甚至懒得看上一眼。“……正在烦我。”

rows.original: Slaves chip away at the bountiful wealth of Zhèng Shi, held in place by chains hooked to collars and waists alike. Robotic loaders follow behind them to gather the samples they deposit and whisk them away to be refined. They spare no time to look at you or react in any way, leaving you with the distinct impression that they’re completely broken. You could cut them out of their collars, and they’d probably just keep digging...
rows.translation: 奴隶们凿取郑石空间站丰饶的财富，颈圈与腰间都钩着锁链，将他们牢牢固定。机器人装载机紧随其后，收集他们放下的矿样并迅速运走精炼。他们根本无暇看你一眼，也没有任何反应，让你强烈感觉到他们已经彻底崩溃。就算你把他们从颈圈里解放出来，他们大概也只会继续挖掘...

rows.original: “Finally! Who the FUCK let’s that schizo moth run this place? Can’t drop a single fucking thing off herself and can’t run a tight ship. Not only was I stuck down here all fucking WEEK, but now I have to fix the damn elevator? Who or what did I piss off...” The woman yanks the space helmet from your hands, the final component of her heavy-duty attire. “Not your problem, slave, so run along. Or don’t, if you’re a slut for punishment who’s into kinky shit. I’ll ‘punish’ you when I get back, but it’ll be a few hours.” She winks behind the visor. “Bet you can’t stand working for that cunt either.” A pneumatic blast door seals shut as she stomp-stomp-stomps through to the other side. A blinking panel to the right indicates depressurization, and a safe entry into vacuum. If she’s fixing ‘the elevator’, chances are it’s the big one you saw in the hangar. By the time you get back, it might be functional again. The probe is nowhere in the mine shafts, so higher you must go...
rows.translation: “终于来了！到底是哪个混蛋让那个精神分裂的蛾子管理这里？她自己连一件破东西都送不来，也管不好这艘破船。我不但他妈在下面困了整整一周，现在还得由我去修那该死的电梯？我到底招惹了谁还是招惹了什么...” 女人从你手中一把夺过太空头盔，这是她重型装备的最后一个部件。“不关你的事，奴隶，赶紧滚吧。或者别滚，如果你是个喜欢变态玩意、渴望受罚的骚货。等我回来就‘惩罚’你，不过得过几个小时。” 她在面罩后朝你眨了眨眼。“我赌你也受不了给那个婊子干活。” 她咚、咚、咚地走到另一边，一扇气动防爆门随即密封。右侧闪烁的面板显示正在减压，之后即可安全进入真空。 如果她要修‘电梯’，十有八九就是你在机库见过的那部大电梯。等你回去时，它也许已经恢复运转。探针不在矿井里，所以你必须往更高处走...

Or don’t, if you’re a slut for punishment who’s into kinky shit. A blinking panel to the right indicates depressurization, and a safe entry into vacuum. If she’s fixing ‘the elevator’, chances are it’s the big one you saw in the hangar. By the time you get back, it might be functional again. The probe is nowhere in the mine shafts, so higher you must go... "

rows.original: Stepping into space without protection is a one-way ticket to a real quick death. You aren’t feeling particularly suicidal today.
rows.translation: 毫无防护地踏入太空，就是买了一张通往迅速死亡的单程票。你今天没什么自杀冲动。
rows.raw: "Stepping into space without protection is a one-way ticket to a real quick death. You aren’t feeling particularly suicidal today."

rows.original: With the elevator getting power again, you have no need to perform a repair out in the void.
rows.translation: 电梯已经恢复供电，你不需要再到虚空中维修了。
rows.raw: " With the elevator getting power again, you have no need to perform a repair out in the void."

rows.original: Good thing you’ve already repaired the power outside.
rows.translation: 好在你已经修好了外部电源。
rows.raw: " Good thing you’ve already repaired the power outside."

rows.original: While your current choice of armor is airtight, without pressurization, magnetic boots or thrusters, you’ll be helpless in the void.
rows.translation: 虽然你当前选择的护甲密不透气，但没有加压、磁力靴或推进器，你在虚空中将毫无办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile your current choice of armor is airtight, without pressurization, magnetic boots or thrusters, you’ll be helpless in the void."

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: Bad idea.
rows.translation: 馊主意。
rows.raw: "Bad idea."

rows.original: You could walk around the outside of the station to get back to the hangar without enemy interference....
rows.translation: 你可以从空间站外侧步行回机库，避开敌人的干扰....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou could walk around the outside of the station to get back to the hangar without enemy interference...."

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: Take a jaunt in the vacuum back to the hangar.
rows.translation: 在真空中溜达回机库。
rows.raw: "Take a jaunt in the vacuum back to the hangar."

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: Stepping into space without protection is a one-way ticket to a real quick death. You aren’t feeling particularly suicidal today.
rows.translation: 毫无防护地踏入太空，就是买了一张通往迅速死亡的单程票。你今天没什么自杀冲动。
rows.raw: "Stepping into space without protection is a one-way ticket to a real quick death. You aren’t feeling particularly suicidal today."

rows.original: SPAAAAAACE!
rows.translation: 太——空！
rows.raw: "SPAAAAAACE!"

rows.original: Spacewalk
rows.translation: 太空行走
rows.raw: "Spacewalk"

rows.original: The trip back into the raw void should be fraught with peril... but it’s safer than bumbling around in the mines. You walk carefully for what feels like a half hour until you reach the airlock door. The trip barely put a dent in your oxygen reserves!
rows.translation: 这次重返赤裸虚空的旅途本该险象环生...但总比在矿井里乱闯安全。你小心翼翼地走了感觉足有半个小时，终于抵达气闸门。这趟路甚至没怎么消耗你的氧气储备！
rows.raw: "The trip back into the raw void should be fraught with peril... but it’s safer than bumbling around in the mines. You walk carefully for what feels like a half hour until you reach the airlock door. The trip barely put a dent in your oxygen reserves!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: HERISIOD.ZHENG SHI STATION.ZSM YY18
rows.raw: "HERISIOD.ZHENG SHI STATION.ZSM YY18"

rows.original: Stepping around a support column, you’re confronted by a serious mining effort.
rows.translation: 绕过一根支撑柱，眼前出现了一片规模可观的采矿作业区。
rows.raw: "Stepping around a support column, you’re confronted by a serious mining effort. "

rows.original: Dozens of slaves in plain jumpsuits and metallic obedience collars work at the walls with sweat-soaked determination while
rows.translation: 数十名穿着朴素连身服、戴着金属服从项圈的奴隶，汗流浃背却意志坚定地凿击墙壁，而
rows.raw: "Dozens of slaves in plain jumpsuits and metallic obedience collars work at the walls with sweat-soaked determination while"

rows.original: Dozens of crude robots, hastily assembled to replace the rebelling slave workers, toil endlessly at the walls while
rows.translation: 数十台为替代叛乱奴工而仓促组装的粗糙机器人，不知疲倦地凿击墙壁，而
rows.raw: "Dozens of crude robots, hastily assembled to replace the rebelling slave workers, toil endlessly at the walls while"

rows.original: a bigger, rumbling device bores straight into the eastern wall, spraying fist-sized chunks of stone of ore into a cart tethered behind. The reddish stone must be rich in geddanium - a material prized for both jewelry and the alloys used for starship armor.
rows.translation: 一台更大、隆隆作响的设备径直钻入东墙，把拳头大小的矿石碎块喷进后方拴着的矿车。泛红的石头想必富含格达尼姆，这种材料既适合制作珠宝，也能用于星舰装甲合金，因而备受珍视。
rows.raw: " a bigger, rumbling device bores straight into the eastern wall, spraying fist-sized chunks of stone of ore into a cart tethered behind. The reddish stone must be rich in geddanium - a material prized for both jewelry and the alloys used for starship armor."

rows.original: Indeed, you can see several dozen shadowy figures shuffling around inside, trying to avoid your sight.
rows.translation: 果然，你能看到几十个模糊身影在里面拖着步子走动，努力躲开你的视线。
rows.raw: "\n\nIndeed, you can see several dozen shadowy figures shuffling around inside, trying to avoid your sight."

rows.original: You can’t get inside thanks to a massive metal bar running across the door. It’s electronically locked and hardened against hacking; you can’t even see a seam or a plug to abuse. You’ll have to find the right keycard for this one.
rows.translation: 门上横着一根巨大的金属闩，你进不去。它由电子锁控制，并经过加固，能抵御黑客入侵；你甚至找不到可以利用的缝隙或接口。这扇门只能用正确的钥匙卡打开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t get inside thanks to a massive metal bar running across the door. It’s electronically locked and hardened against hacking; you can’t even see a seam or a plug to abuse. You’ll have to find the right keycard for this one."

rows.original: Maike’s Keycard
rows.raw: "Maike’s Keycard"

rows.original: Free Slaves
rows.translation: 释放奴隶
rows.raw: "Free Slaves"

rows.original: Free Slaves
rows.translation: 释放奴隶
rows.raw: "Free Slaves"

rows.original: Throw open the doors and let loose the men and women held captive by the pirates. Cry havoc, and let loose the slaves of... a giant rebellion!
rows.translation: 猛地敞开大门，放出被海盗囚禁的男女。大喊浩劫将至，放出奴隶们...掀起一场大叛乱！
rows.raw: "Throw open the doors and let loose the men and women held captive by the pirates. Cry havoc, and let loose the slaves of... a giant rebellion!"

rows.original: Free Slaves
rows.translation: 释放奴隶
rows.raw: "Free Slaves"

rows.original: Free Slaves
rows.translation: 释放奴隶
rows.raw: "Free Slaves"

rows.original: You don’t have any way to get the door open right now.
rows.translation: 你现在没有任何办法打开这扇门。
rows.raw: "You don’t have any way to get the door open right now."

rows.original: The door is hanging open, almost ripped off its hinges in the stampede of freed slaves. There’s nothing here for you anymore.
rows.translation: 门敞开着，获释奴隶蜂拥而出时几乎把它从铰链上扯了下来。这里已经没有你能做的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe door is hanging open, almost ripped off its hinges in the stampede of freed slaves. There’s nothing here for you anymore."

rows.original: An old slave jumpsuit is discarded here.
rows.translation: 一件旧奴隶连身服被丢弃在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nAn old slave jumpsuit is discarded here."

rows.original: Jumpsuit
rows.translation: 连身服
rows.raw: "Jumpsuit"

rows.original: Locked...
rows.translation: 已上锁...
rows.raw: "Locked..."

rows.original: You try to open the door to Overseer Maike’s quarters, but find the door locked down tight. There’s a security lock in place next to it with a card reader in place. Looks like the Overseer values her privacy.
rows.translation: 你试图打开监察官迈克的住处，却发现门锁得严严实实。旁边装着一道带读卡器的安全锁。看来监察官非常重视隐私。
rows.raw: "You try to open the door to Overseer Maike’s quarters, but find the door locked down tight. There’s a security lock in place next to it with a card reader in place. Looks like the Overseer values her privacy."

rows.original: Maike’s Keycard
rows.raw: "Maike’s Keycard"

rows.original: Use Card
rows.translation: 使用卡片
rows.raw: "Use Card"

rows.original: CLICK!
rows.translation: 咔哒！
rows.raw: "CLICK!"

rows.original: You slide Maike’s card through the reader, and are rewarded with a high-pitched beep and a flashing green light. It’s open!
rows.translation: 你把迈克的卡片划过读卡器，随即听到一声尖锐的哔响，绿灯开始闪烁。门开了！
rows.raw: "You slide Maike’s card through the reader, and are rewarded with a high-pitched beep and a flashing green light. It’s open!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Use Card
rows.translation: 使用卡片
rows.raw: "Use Card"

rows.original: You already have the overseer’s access card. Go ahead and use it.
rows.translation: 你已经拿到监察官的门禁卡了。用它吧。
rows.raw: "You already have the overseer’s access card. Go ahead and use it."

rows.original: Use Card
rows.translation: 使用卡片
rows.raw: "Use Card"

rows.original: Use Card
rows.translation: 使用卡片
rows.raw: "Use Card"

rows.original: You’d need the overseer’s card for that!
rows.translation: 你得有监察官的卡片才能打开！
rows.raw: "You’d need the overseer’s card for that!"

rows.original: Bypass
rows.translation: 绕过
rows.raw: "Bypass"

rows.original: Hacking!
rows.translation: 黑进去！
rows.raw: "Hacking!"

rows.original: Well, you should be able to take care of this no problem. You wrench off the protective plastic casing and start dicking with the wiring inside...
rows.translation: 嗯，这应该难不倒你。你扯掉防护塑料外壳，开始摆弄里面的线路...
rows.raw: "Well, you should be able to take care of this no problem. You wrench off the protective plastic casing and start dicking with the wiring inside..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Bypass
rows.translation: 绕过
rows.raw: "Bypass"

rows.original: Embrace your inner Hackerman.
rows.translation: 唤醒你内心的黑客侠。
rows.raw: "Embrace your inner Hackerman."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Tivf is lounging on the bed, and perks up at your approach.
rows.translation: 蒂芙正懒洋洋地躺在床上，见你走近便精神起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nTivf is lounging on the bed, and perks up at your approach."

rows.original: Tivf
rows.translation: 蒂芙
rows.raw: "Tivf"

rows.original: Tivf
rows.translation: 蒂芙
rows.raw: "Tivf"

rows.original: Go talk to the zil boy slave.
rows.translation: 去和那个充当奴隶的齐尔男孩谈谈。
rows.raw: "Go talk to the zil boy slave."

rows.original: Sleep
rows.translation: 睡觉
rows.raw: "Sleep"

rows.original: i
g
s
g
s
l
l
Failure
rows.translation: 失败
rows.raw: "Failure"

rows.original: Shit! You stumble back as sparks fly from a miss-crossed wire. You’ll have to give that another try.
rows.translation: 该死！接错的电线迸出火花，你踉跄着后退。你得再试一次。
rows.raw: "Shit! You stumble back as sparks fly from a miss-crossed wire. You’ll have to give that another try."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Success
rows.translation: 成功
rows.raw: "Success"

rows.original: A little finesse, a little skill, and a little determination is all it takes to slice through the security box and unlock the Overseer’s door. After a few minutes’ work, the lock beeps and flashes green: you’re in!
rows.translation: 只需要一点技巧、一点本领和一点决心，就足以破解安全箱并打开监察官的门。忙活几分钟后，门锁发出哔声并亮起绿灯：你进去了！
rows.raw: "A little finesse, a little skill, and a little determination is all it takes to slice through the security box and unlock the Overseer’s door. After a few minutes’ work, the lock beeps and flashes green: you’re in!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: energy
rows.raw: "energy"

rows.original: You’re surprised it doesn’t have a combination as well.
rows.translation: 你很惊讶它居然没有组合密码。
rows.raw: " You’re surprised it doesn’t have a combination as well."

rows.original: The brown safe Urbolg mentioned is in fact under his desk. If you remember correctly, the combination is 7-8-9. You could pop it open, if you wanted to.
rows.translation: 厄博格提到的棕色保险箱确实就在他的桌子下面。如果你没记错，密码是7-8-9。只要你愿意，就能把它打开。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe brown safe Urbolg mentioned is in fact under his desk. If you remember correctly, the combination is 7-8-9. You could pop it open, if you wanted to."

rows.original: Open Safe
rows.translation: 打开保险箱
rows.raw: "Open Safe"

rows.original: Urbolg’s brown safe is open and empty, like you left it. How nice of him to let you use his extra shield belt!
rows.translation: 厄博格的棕色保险箱敞开着，里面空空如也，正如你离开时一样。他居然愿意让你使用备用护盾腰带，真贴心！
rows.raw: "\n\nUrbolg’s brown safe is open and empty, like you left it. How nice of him to let you use his extra shield belt!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You punch the coordinates you got from Dad’s last probe into the local Warp Gate. In short order, your ship is hurtling through the stars, one step closer to your inheritance. The moment the ship pops out of the far gate, though, all thoughts of a cushiony life of leisure are swept away in an instant: you’re assaulted by a cacophony of warning lights and klaxons from every sensor on the ship. The forward viewscreen is dominated by huge, tumbling chunks of rock careening towards you at deadly speeds.
rows.translation: 你把从父亲最后一枚探针中获得的坐标输入当地跃迁门。没过多久，你的飞船便划过群星，离继承遗产又近了一步。然而，飞船刚从远端跃迁门冲出，对安逸闲适生活的一切幻想便瞬间烟消云散：全舰每一台传感器都亮起警示灯，警报声此起彼伏。前方视窗被巨大翻滚的岩块占满，它们以致命速度朝你猛冲而来。
rows.raw: "You punch the coordinates you got from Dad’s last probe into the local Warp Gate. In short order, your ship is hurtling through the stars, one step closer to your inheritance. The moment the ship pops out of the far gate, though, all thoughts of a cushiony life of leisure are swept away in an instant: you’re assaulted by a cacophony of warning lights and klaxons from every sensor on the ship. The forward viewscreen is dominated by huge, tumbling chunks of rock careening towards you at deadly speeds."

rows.original: Luckily your shields come up, deflecting the worst of the impacts, but the ship’s deck still rattles under your [pc.feet]. You grip the arm rests of your captain’s seat tight, trying to keep from being thrown across the bridge with the rapid impacts. Eventually, the meteor storm subsides, leaving you floating in space with your shields barely holding up and several breakers flipped all throughout the ship. But you’re alive, so there’s that.
rows.translation: 好在护盾及时升起，挡开了最猛烈的撞击，但飞船甲板仍在[pc.feet]下震颤。你紧紧抓住舰长座椅的扶手，避免在连续撞击中被甩过舰桥。流星风暴终于平息，你漂浮在太空中，护盾勉强维持，全舰各处还有几处断路器跳闸。不过你还活着，也算好事。
rows.raw: "\n\nLuckily your shields come up, deflecting the worst of the impacts, but the ship’s deck still rattles under your [pc.feet]. You grip the arm rests of your captain’s seat tight, trying to keep from being thrown across the bridge with the rapid impacts. Eventually, the meteor storm subsides, leaving you floating in space with your shields barely holding up and several breakers flipped all throughout the ship. But you’re alive, so there’s that."

rows.original: With the immediate catastrophe dealt with, you send out a scanner ping to try and figure out where the hell you are - and where you’re supposed to go. According to the coordinates you received, the Warp Gate should have been orbiting your destination, but all you see are the tumbling brown hulks of shattered...
rows.translation: 眼前的灾难处理完后，你发出扫描脉冲，试图弄清这里到底是什么鬼地方，又该去哪里。根据收到的坐标，跃迁门本该环绕目的地运行，可你看到的只有翻滚着的棕色巨块，那是破碎的...
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the immediate catastrophe dealt with, you send out a scanner ping to try and figure out where the hell you are - and where you’re supposed to go. According to the coordinates you received, the Warp Gate should have been orbiting your destination, but all you see are the tumbling brown hulks of shattered..."

rows.original: ...hey, that asteroid has a building on it!
rows.translation: ...嘿，那颗小行星上有建筑！
rows.raw: "\n\n...hey, that asteroid has a building on it!"

rows.original: You squint out the forward screen, commanding it to zoom in as far as possible on a meandering chunk of earth about the size of Australia. That definitely is what’s left of a city, blasted and airless. Guess this was the planet you were sent to explore, but it clearly had an accident between the Warp Gates being launched and the Rush starting. There’s nothing left but debris.
rows.translation: 你眯眼望向前方屏幕，命令它尽可能放大一块约有澳大利亚大小、缓缓漂移的陆块。那无疑是一座城市的残骸，已经被炸毁并失去空气。看来这就是你奉命探索的星球，但它显然在跃迁门发射后、星球大淘金开始前出了事故。如今只剩残骸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squint out the forward screen, commanding it to zoom in as far as possible on a meandering chunk of earth about the size of Australia. That definitely is what’s left of a city, blasted and airless. Guess this was the planet you were sent to explore, but it clearly had an accident between the Warp Gates being launched and the Rush starting. There’s nothing left but debris."

rows.original: Shit. Now what?
rows.translation: 该死。现在怎么办？
rows.raw: "\n\nShit. Now what?"

rows.original: The probe’s gotta be in the field somewhere.
rows.translation: 探针肯定在这片区域的某个地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe probe’s gotta be in the field somewhere."

rows.original: The probes you’ve seen so far are rated to survive just about anything, hardened against impact and electronic tampering alike. No matter what happened to the planet, you’re pretty sure your objective remains the same - unless it drifted off into the binary stars flickering in the distance, anyway. Time to run some scans; try and find what happened to it...
rows.translation: 你此前见过的探针都能承受几乎任何灾难，既抗冲击，也能抵御电子篡改。不管这颗星球发生过什么，你相当确定目标仍然不变，除非它漂进了远处闪烁的双星之中。该开始扫描，查清它出了什么事了...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe probes you’ve seen so far are rated to survive just about anything, hardened against impact and electronic tampering alike. No matter what happened to the planet, you’re pretty sure your objective remains the same - unless it drifted off into the binary stars flickering in the distance, anyway. Time to run some scans; try and find what happened to it..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Alright, maybe this time will go smoother. You take yourself back towards that shattered world the pirate outpost uses to shield itself from prying eyes. It’s easy enough to find it again now that you know what you’re looking for, and in short order you’re cruising towards the heavily-armed docking bay.
rows.translation: 好吧，也许这次会顺利些。你返回那颗破碎世界，海盗前哨站正利用它躲避窥探。既然已经知道目标，重新找到它轻而易举；很快，你就驶向了重兵把守的停泊区。
rows.raw: "Alright, maybe this time will go smoother. You take yourself back towards that shattered world the pirate outpost uses to shield itself from prying eyes. It’s easy enough to find it again now that you know what you’re looking for, and in short order you’re cruising towards the heavily-armed docking bay."

rows.original: A bored voice comes over the short-wave radio once again: “This is Zhèng Shi Docking to... whoever the fuck you are. This ship’s not on the roster. Cough up the password or get blown to space dust.”
rows.translation: 短波无线电中再次传来一个百无聊赖的声音：“这里是郑石停泊处，呼叫...管你他妈是谁。这艘船不在名单上。报上口令，不然就把你轰成太空尘埃。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA bored voice comes over the short-wave radio once again: “This is Zhèng Shi Docking to... whoever the fuck you are. This ship’s not on the roster. Cough up the password or get blown to space dust.”"

rows.original: Looks like whoever’s on the other end doesn’t remember you, at least...
rows.translation: 看来另一端的人至少不记得你了...
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like whoever’s on the other end doesn’t remember you, at least..."

rows.original: Password
rows.raw: "Password"

rows.original: You set course for the pirate base at Zhèng Shi. Now that you know where it is, and have solidified your right to be there as far as its gate guards are concerned, it’s easy going. The heavy cannons surrounding the docking bay entrance follow you in, but hold their fire while you slide your ship in through the force field and into your parking spot at the back of the massive hangar. Looks like you’re on the roster now!
rows.translation: 你设定航线前往郑石海盗基地。既然已经知道位置，而且门卫也认可你有权进入，一路相当顺利。停泊区入口周围的重炮一路追踪着你，却没有开火；你驾驶飞船穿过力场，停进巨大机库后方的泊位。看来你现在已经在名单上了！
rows.raw: "You set course for the pirate base at Zhèng Shi. Now that you know where it is, and have solidified your right to be there as far as its gate guards are concerned, it’s easy going. The heavy cannons surrounding the docking bay entrance follow you in, but hold their fire while you slide your ship in through the force field and into your parking spot at the back of the massive hangar. Looks like you’re on the roster now!"

rows.original: You grab your gear
rows.translation: 你拿起装备
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grab your gear"

rows.original: and head onto the station.
rows.translation: ，走进空间站。
rows.raw: " and head onto the station."

rows.original: SnekOnboard
rows.raw: "SnekOnboard"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

A squat box with an onahole-like entrance lends further credence to that theory. The stained nameplate labels it as a TamaniCorp Hora Series 69 Dong Designer."

rows.translation: 你对这种设备再熟悉不过了。也许可以试一下？

rows.original: You tap in the access code, and the door pops open. You flick the lights on and step in, taking a quick glance around.

rows.original: A high vaulted ceiling confirms that you’ve entered the Sidewinder’s cargohold (one of them, anyway). Still, it isn’t quite as roomy as you would expect from such a large vessel - only a little bigger than your old Casstech’s. The engines don’t just look big from the outside: they take up the majority of the ship’s volume. Even now, you can feel the idle thrum of its enormous power plants churning in a low-power state, ready to launch you past a Galactic Guard blockade like a ballistic missile.
rows.translation: 高耸的拱形天花板证实你进入了响尾蛇号的货舱，至少是其中之一。不过这里没有你想象中那般宽敞，只比你的旧卡斯泰克飞船稍大一点。引擎不只是从外面看起来巨大，它们占据了飞船绝大部分空间。即便此刻，你仍能感到庞大动力装置在低功率状态下空转的震颤，随时准备让你像弹道导弹般冲破银河护卫队的封锁。
rows.raw: "A high vaulted ceiling confirms that you’ve entered the Sidewinder’s cargohold (one of them, anyway). Still, it isn’t quite as roomy as you would expect from such a large vessel - only a little bigger than your old Casstech’s. The engines don’t just look big from the outside: they take up the majority of the ship’s volume. Even now, you can feel the idle thrum of its enormous power plants churning in a low-power state, ready to launch you past a Galactic Guard blockade like a ballistic missile."

rows.original: Tucked into the corner is your father’s probe. It’s scuffed to all hell and scored from laser blasts where someone used it for target practice. The keypad is intact, though. It flickers to life when you approach, and when you make contact, a new set of coordinates download onto your Codex.
rows.translation: 你父亲的探针被塞在角落。它被磨得不成样子，表面还有人拿它练习射击留下的激光灼痕。不过键盘完好无损。你走近时它闪烁着启动；接触后，一组新坐标下载到了你的终端上。
rows.raw: "\n\nTucked into the corner is your father’s probe. It’s scuffed to all hell and scored from laser blasts where someone used it for target practice. The keypad is intact, though. It flickers to life when you approach, and when you make contact, a new set of coordinates download onto your Codex."

rows.original:
While the elevator obediently takes you to your destination, the doors stubbornly refuse to open no matter how fervently you jab at the console’s control buttons. It keeps flashing something about an unresolved security breach and recreation being temporarily suspended.

Maybe you can come back here later, once the proverbial heat has died down.
rows.translation:
电梯顺从地把你送到目的地，但无论你多用力地戳控制台按钮，门都顽固地拒绝打开。屏幕反复闪烁，提示安全漏洞尚未解决，娱乐活动暂时中止。

也许等风头过去后，你可以再来。
rows.raw: "While the elevator obediently takes you to your destination, the doors stubbornly refuse to open no matter how fervently you jab at the console’s control buttons. It keeps flashing something about an unresolved security breach and recreation being temporarily suspended.\n\nMaybe you can come back here later, once the proverbial heat has died down."

rows.original: This time, you notice, there’s no software lock on the door controls. It would seem the Shock Hopper and L.D.C. gave up on pursuing you and let their crews go back to ‘recreation.’ As for what kinds of recreation they partake in... well, you’re about to find out.
rows.translation: 这一次，你注意到门控系统上没有软件锁。看来电击跳虫和大型阴茎对撞机已经放弃追捕你，让手下恢复了‘娱乐’。至于他们会进行什么娱乐...嗯，你马上就知道了。
rows.raw: "This time, you notice, there’s no software lock on the door controls. It would seem the Shock Hopper and L.D.C. gave up on pursuing you and let their crews go back to ‘recreation.’ As for what kinds of recreation they partake in... well, you’re about to find out.\n\n"

rows.original: Once the elevator’s doors grind and rattle aside, you’re blasted with a cacophony of noise and light the likes of which never expected to see beyond the digitized walls of a virtual reality simulation. It’s overwhelming, even to a hardened explorer like yourself. Everywhere you look there are blinking lights, gleaming hardlight barriers, and acts of debauchery wanton enough to shock a purer soul into unconsciousness.
rows.translation: 电梯门嘎吱作响地滑开，你立刻被喧嚣和光芒的洪流轰击。这般景象，你从没想过会在虚拟现实的数字化墙壁之外看到。即便对你这样的老练探索者而言，也让人不知所措。放眼望去，闪烁灯光、耀眼硬光屏障无处不在，放荡行为之肆无忌惮，足以让更纯洁的灵魂当场昏厥。
rows.raw: "Once the elevator’s doors grind and rattle aside, you’re blasted with a cacophony of noise and light the likes of which never expected to see beyond the digitized walls of a virtual reality simulation. It’s overwhelming, even to a hardened explorer like yourself. Everywhere you look there are blinking lights, gleaming hardlight barriers, and acts of debauchery wanton enough to shock a purer soul into unconsciousness."

rows.original: You blink and look again, determined to take in this new locale.
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼再度望去，决心看清这个新地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink and look again, determined to take in this new locale."

rows.original:
This time, you’re prepared to puzzle out the deck’s unique geography: that of a hollow sphere. The shape allows you to see everything at once: shops, kiosks, pirates, scantily clad slaves, and even the glitz and glam of a packed casino. Looking up is a dizzying experience made all the more nauseating by the floating forms of dancing slaves, pirouetting in zero G around the center of the elevator shaft. All bound with gleaming, silvery collars, they are without a doubt the most attractive creatures you’ve seen on this entire station, chosen for their task on the sole basis of peerless bone structure and flawless skin. One favors you with a wink and a sensuously blown kiss.

You half-heartedly wave back but turn your attention aside, determined to get a feel for this place before indulging in its basest forms of entertainment.
rows.translation:
这一次，你做好准备，要弄清这一层独特的地形：一个空心球体。这样的形状让你能同时看到一切：商店、摊位、海盗、衣着暴露的奴隶，甚至还有挤满人群、纸醉金迷的赌场。抬头看令人头晕目眩，而电梯井中央环绕着零重力旋舞的奴隶，更让人恶心。她们无一例外都戴着闪亮银色项圈，毫无疑问是你在整座空间站见过最迷人的生物，仅凭无与伦比的骨相和完美肌肤被选中执行这项任务。其中一人朝你眨眼，性感地送来飞吻。

你心不在焉地挥手回应，却把注意力转向别处，决定先熟悉这里，再沉溺于最原始的娱乐。
rows.raw:
"

This time, you’re prepared to puzzle out the deck’s unique geography: that of a hollow sphere. The shape allows you to see everything at once: shops, kiosks, pirates, scantily clad slaves, and even the glitz and glam of a packed casino. Looking up is a dizzying experience made all the more nauseating by the floating forms of dancing slaves, pirouetting in zero G around the center of the elevator shaft. All bound with gleaming, silvery collars, they are without a doubt the most attractive creatures you’ve seen on this entire station, chosen for their task on the sole basis of peerless bone structure and flawless skin. One favors you with a wink and a sensuously blown kiss.

You half-heartedly wave back but turn your attention aside, determined to get a feel for this place before indulging in its basest forms of entertainment."

rows.original: You aren’t sure what history lead to the creation of this place - whether the pirates built it, or indeed, if they found it amongst the planet’s rubble, but you are sure that they’ve done a decent job of organizing the mind-boggling topography. Colorized paths drill through the chaotic mess of hedonistic pleasure-seeking and pure, unregulated capitalism. A gleaming green trail climbs straight up the wall that your Codex’s compass has chosen to designate as ‘north,’ mirrored by a crimson path to the south. Both come together at the apex of the chamber, forming a tight ring around the elevator shaft. Meanwhile, a luminous gold-floored alley winds east and west, reaching for the deck’s equator without quite reaching it. Where it meets with the brighter routes, it slides beneath into the caustic glow of simulated neon projections and dangerously dark corners only to emerge on the other side, brighter for the contrast.
rows.translation: 你不知道什么历史导致这里诞生，不知道是海盗建造了它，还是从行星残骸里发现了它；但你确信，他们把这令人难以置信的地形组织得相当不错。彩色路径穿过追逐享乐与纯粹无监管资本主义组成的混乱迷宫。闪耀绿色路线沿着终端罗盘指定为‘北方’的墙壁笔直攀升，南边则有一条深红路线与之对应。二者在舱室顶点汇合，围绕电梯井形成紧密圆环。同时，一条铺着发光金色地板的小巷向东西蜿蜒，朝甲板赤道延伸，却未完全抵达。它与更明亮路线相交时，会潜入模拟霓虹投影的刺目辉光和危险暗角下方，再从另一侧出现，在反差中显得更加明亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou aren’t sure what history lead to the creation of this place - whether the pirates built it, or indeed, if they found it amongst the planet’s rubble, but you are sure that they’ve done a decent job of organizing the mind-boggling topography. Colorized paths drill through the chaotic mess of hedonistic pleasure-seeking and pure, unregulated capitalism. A gleaming green trail climbs straight up the wall that your Codex’s compass has chosen to designate as ‘north,’ mirrored by a crimson path to the south. Both come together at the apex of the chamber, forming a tight ring around the elevator shaft. Meanwhile, a luminous gold-floored alley winds east and west, reaching for the deck’s equator without quite reaching it. Where it meets with the brighter routes, it slides beneath into the caustic glow of simulated neon projections and dangerously dark corners only to emerge on the other side, brighter for the contrast."

rows.original: You’d best watch yourself. While the crowds of pirates range from amicable-looking to indifferent, it’s best to remember that these are all wanted men (and women) - every last one of them.
rows.translation: 你最好当心。这里的海盗有些看起来友善，有些漠不关心，但最好记住，他们全都是通缉犯，无一例外。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d best watch yourself. While the crowds of pirates range from amicable-looking to indifferent, it’s best to remember that these are all wanted men (and women) - every last one of them."

rows.original: The elevator doors hang open, exposing the interior to the glaring cacophony that is Zhèng Shi’s recreation deck. The familiar colored paths stretch on in the four cardinal directions - or what your Codex approximates as them. Should you want to return to the rest of the station, it’s as simple as stepping inside and pressing the down arrow.
rows.translation: 电梯门敞开着，内部直接暴露于郑石娱乐层刺眼而喧嚣的景象。熟悉的彩色路线向四个基本方向延伸，至少终端近似如此判断。如果想回到空间站其他区域，只需走进电梯按下向下箭头。
rows.raw: "The elevator doors hang open, exposing the interior to the glaring cacophony that is Zhèng Shi’s recreation deck. The familiar colored paths stretch on in the four cardinal directions - or what your Codex approximates as them. Should you want to return to the rest of the station, it’s as simple as stepping inside and pressing the down arrow."

rows.original: It takes a second to remember you picked up something extra from the Shock Hopper[silly | (HA HA! Don’t you just love retroactive continuity?) ], and you can’t imagine it being used anywhere else. After showing the software lock who’s in charge (now), the emerald-hued panel fizzes out with a keening beep. Silence is broken by the growling and hissing split of a large gate; fluorescent light beams penetrate the seam and stab your retinas. To be honest, you expected something more climactic. What you see [pc.moving] to the other side throws you for a loop. The spacious, brightly-lit pale cyan hallways, with ovaltine curves, sundry decorations, and the semi-professional -Operations- label, are spotless and sanitary... immaculate and yet not entirely sterile, if the raucous ambience of sex and booze are anything to go by. That’s all part of the magic, though. It feels, looks, and smells like civilization, weirdly enough. Disorientation overcomes you. It takes a bit too long to realize you’re not in civilization; the sneering faces of heavily armed laquines and kaithrits balance your moment of bewilderment. The others you see, mostly nude, are tightly-collared pleasure slaves not unlike those dancing the recreation deck’s never-ending nights away. It dawns on you, seeing a chatty group of rat-eared imps scampering past, catching a whiff of some unsweated herm-rabbits[flags.MET_SLAVEBREAKERS| even glimpsing a slutty titty-snake far down the deck]... that this area belongs exclusively to the powerful gangs whom run Zhèng Shi — to all those who’ve gotten in your way thus far. Laughter and revelry riots in the north while an eerie quiet lingers in the south. Nobody’s drawing weapons on you, and you’re in no hurry to give them a reason. This is the beating heart of Zhèng Shi, where every crime is planned out, where every plan is drawn up. [pc.Walk] softly.
rows.translation: 你过了一会儿才想起，自己从电击跳虫那里额外拿了件东西[silly |（哈哈！你难道不喜欢这种追溯性连续性吗？） ]，而你无法想象它还能用在别处。你向软件锁展示了（现在）谁说了算，翠绿色面板发出尖锐哔声，随后嗞地熄灭。一扇大门咆哮着、嘶鸣着裂开，打破寂静；荧光从缝隙射入，刺痛你的视网膜。 说实话，你原本期待更高潮迭起的场面。你[pc.moving]到另一边后看到的景象令你措手不及。宽敞明亮的浅青走廊有着椭圆曲线、各式装饰，以及半专业的-行动区-标牌，整洁卫生...一尘不染，却并非完全无菌，毕竟性爱与酒水的喧嚣氛围可不是假的。不过，这也正是魔力所在。这里的感觉、外观乃至气味竟然都像文明社会。 迷失方向的感觉席卷而来。你过了太久才意识到自己并不在文明社会；全副武装的拉奎因人和凯斯里特人脸上的冷笑平衡了你短暂的困惑。你看到的其他人大多赤身裸体，都是戴着紧箍项圈的慰安奴隶，与那些在娱乐层永无止境的夜晚里跳舞的人相差无几。看见一群健谈的鼠耳小妖飞奔而过，闻到一些没出汗的双性兔子气味[flags.MET_SLAVEBREAKERS|，甚至瞥见甲板远处一条淫荡巨乳蛇女]，你恍然大悟...这片区域完全属于统治郑石空间站的强大帮派，属于迄今为止所有挡过你路的人。 北边笑声与狂欢沸腾，南边却萦绕着诡异寂静。没人对你拔枪，你也不急着给他们理由。这里是郑石空间站跳动的心脏，每一项罪行都在此策划，每一个计划都在此拟定。[pc.Walk]轻点。
rows.raw: " It takes a second to remember you picked up something extra from the Shock Hopper[silly | (HA HA! Don’t you just love retroactive continuity?) ], and you can’t imagine it being used anywhere else. After showing the software lock who’s in charge (now), the emerald-hued panel fizzes out with a keening beep. Silence is broken by the growling and hissing split of a large gate; fluorescent light beams penetrate the seam and stab your retinas. To be honest, you expected something more climactic. What you see [pc.moving] to the other side throws you for a loop. The spacious, brightly-lit pale cyan hallways, with ovaltine curves, sundry decorations, and the semi-professional -Operations- label, are spotless and sanitary... immaculate and yet not entirely sterile, if the raucous ambience of sex and booze are anything to go by. That’s all part of the magic, though. It feels, looks, and smells like civilization, weirdly enough. Disorientation overcomes you. It takes a bit too long to realize you’re not in civilization; the sneering faces of heavily armed laquines and kaithrits balance your moment of bewilderment. The others you see, mostly nude, are tightly-collared pleasure slaves not unlike those dancing the recreation deck’s never-ending nights away. It dawns on you, seeing a chatty group of rat-eared imps scampering past, catching a whiff of some unsweated herm-rabbits[flags.MET_SLAVEBREAKERS| even glimpsing a slutty titty-snake far down the deck]... that this area belongs exclusively to the powerful gangs whom run Zhèng Shi — to all those who’ve gotten in your way thus far. Laughter and revelry riots in the north while an eerie quiet lingers in the south. Nobody’s drawing weapons on you, and you’re in no hurry to give them a reason. This is the beating heart of Zhèng Shi, where every crime is planned out, where every plan is drawn up. [pc.Walk] softly. "

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"
