rows.original: It takes you by surprise just how quiet it is up here. The persistent aural torpor you’d consigned yourself to enduring below is curiously absent; however, the door refuses to open as obediently as the elevator what brought you to it. Upon inspection of the nearby panel, you are prompted for an authentication code you don’t possess. A dull, mechanically apathetic chirp skreengs when you fail to provide. Whatever’s past here must be valuable to the powers that be...
rows.translation: 这里出乎意料地安静。你原以为自己得忍受下层持续不断的听觉麻木，此处却离奇地没有；然而，把你送来的电梯倒很听话，门却拒绝同样顺从地打开。检查附近面板后，系统要求输入你并不拥有的认证码。你没能提供时，机器冷漠地发出一声沉闷刺耳鸣响。这里后面的东西，对掌权者而言一定很有价值...
rows.raw: "\n\tIt takes you by surprise just how quiet it is up here. The persistent aural torpor you’d consigned yourself to enduring below is curiously absent; however, the door refuses to open as obediently as the elevator what brought you to it. Upon inspection of the nearby panel, you are prompted for an authentication code you don’t possess. A dull, mechanically apathetic chirp skreengs when you fail to provide. Whatever’s past here must be valuable to the powers that be...\n\t"

rows.original: A sizzle of static draws your eyes upward just in time to see the colossal maw of a shark bearing down upon. Teeth as big as an infantryman’s rifle race toward your face with bowel-loosening speed, and on pure instinct, you roll aside a split-second before it crashes into the floor, its jaw scissoring shut with a staticy ‘snap.’ Nearby pirates burst into laughter as the imposing beast fizzles away into shimmering lettering, revealing itself to be nothing more than a hologram. “Beware the Suula menace!” it proudly declares. You spot the hologram emitter nestled into a seam in the wall next to a glowing Cyber Punks logo.
rows.translation: 一阵静电嘶响吸引你抬头，正好看见一张巨鲨血盆大口从上方猛扑而来。步枪般巨大的牙齿以令人失禁的速度冲向你的脸；你全凭本能，在它撞上地面、巨颚伴随静电‘啪’声剪合前一刹翻滚避开。附近海盗哄堂大笑；威猛巨兽闪烁着消散成发光字样，显露出它不过是全息影像。“当心苏拉威胁！”它骄傲地宣告。 你发现全息发射器藏在墙缝里，旁边亮着赛博朋克的标志。
rows.raw: "A sizzle of static draws your eyes upward just in time to see the colossal maw of a shark bearing down upon. Teeth as big as an infantryman’s rifle race toward your face with bowel-loosening speed, and on pure instinct, you roll aside a split-second before it crashes into the floor, its jaw scissoring shut with a staticy ‘snap.’ Nearby pirates burst into laughter as the imposing beast fizzles away into shimmering lettering, revealing itself to be nothing more than a hologram. “Beware the Suula menace!” it proudly declares.\n\nYou spot the hologram emitter nestled into a seam in the wall next to a glowing Cyber Punks logo."

rows.original: It’s a good thing Azra isn’t here.
rows.translation: 幸好阿兹拉不在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a good thing Azra isn’t here."

rows.original:
You’re careful not to trigger the trapped hologram emitter on your way through the area. You have no desire to be jumped by a gigantic holo-shark for these pirates’ amusement, nor do you wish a second look at the inside of its impressively rendered maw. The floor panel with a splotch of red paint never gets stepped on by anyone else, after all. Now that you know to tread carefully here, you won’t have to suffer again.

The yellow-hued pathway winds east and west through a forest of dividers and entertainments.
rows.translation:
再次经过这里时，你小心避开触发全息陷阱。你既不想为了逗海盗开心而被巨大全息鲨鱼扑击，也不想再看一眼它渲染得异常逼真的口腔内部。毕竟，其他人从不会踩那块沾着红色油漆的地板面板。既然知道要谨慎落脚，你以后就不必再次受罪。

泛黄路线穿过隔板与娱乐设施组成的森林，向东西蜿蜒。
rows.raw:
"

You’re careful not to trigger the trapped hologram emitter on your way through the area. You have no desire to be jumped by a gigantic holo-shark for these pirates’ amusement, nor do you wish a second look at the inside of its impressively rendered maw. The floor panel with a splotch of red paint never gets stepped on by anyone else, after all. Now that you know to tread carefully here, you won’t have to suffer again.

The yellow-hued pathway winds east and west through a forest of dividers and entertainments."

rows.original: To the south, you spot an opening that winds through the flash, improvised constructions. The pirates entering seem excited. Those leaving stroll with relaxed, satisfied smiles.
rows.translation: 南边有个入口，穿过华而不实的临时建筑。进去的海盗兴高采烈，出来的人则带着放松满足的微笑闲逛。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo the south, you spot an opening that winds through the flash, improvised constructions. The pirates entering seem excited. Those leaving stroll with relaxed, satisfied smiles."

rows.original: Glasses clink and voices raise in celebration of victories. Astute, fastidious, and utterly professional dealers man tables strikingly traditional but with mechanical flair. Pirates and mercenaries of all walks gamble their life savings in the pursuit of riches
rows.translation: 酒杯相碰，众人高声庆祝胜利。精明、严谨而无比专业的庄家主持着外观传统却带机械风格的赌桌。各路海盗和佣兵拿毕生积蓄赌博，追逐财富
rows.raw: "Glasses clink and voices raise in celebration of victories. Astute, fastidious, and utterly professional dealers man tables strikingly traditional but with mechanical flair. Pirates and mercenaries of all walks gamble their life savings in the pursuit of riches "

rows.original: and bitches
rows.translation: 与婊子
rows.raw: "and bitches "

rows.original: at blackjack, roulette, craps... most known forms of poker even have dedicated tables crammed full of players and witnesses. So much liquor is passing through this exultant atmosphere that the otherwise pleasant aromas are overpowered with signature drinks and the regular cry of Another round!
rows.translation: ，玩着二十一点、轮盘、掷骰子...大多数常见扑克玩法甚至都有专门赌桌，挤满玩家和围观者。大量酒液流淌在这片欢腾氛围中，原本宜人的香气被特色饮品压过，还不断响起再来一轮！的喊声。
rows.raw: "at blackjack, roulette, craps... most known forms of poker even have dedicated tables crammed full of players and witnesses. So much liquor is passing through this exultant atmosphere that the otherwise pleasant aromas are overpowered with signature drinks and the regular cry of Another round!"

rows.original: CASINO_SECURITY
rows.raw: "CASINO_SECURITY"

rows.original: Casino Security
rows.translation: 赌场保安
rows.raw: "Casino Security"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: You’re not entirely sure it’s a smart idea patronizing a pirate-owned-and-managed casino, but up to the flaring neon gates you [pc.walk], sidestepping sore losers and boastful winners. A hulking thraggen man is thrown to the ground in your direction by two well-armed and vertically endowed terran bouncers dressed in silver suits. The viridian-skinned giant storms off in a huff while they dust their gloved hands of the trash.
rows.translation: 你不太确定光顾海盗经营管理的赌场是否明智，但还是一路[pc.walk]到霓虹闪烁的大门前，绕过输急眼的人和自吹自擂的赢家。两个身材高大的泰伦保镖穿着银色西装、全副武装，把一名魁梧特拉根男子朝你这边摔在地上。绿皮巨汉气冲冲地离开，两人则掸掸手套，像清理完垃圾一样。
rows.raw: "You’re not entirely sure it’s a smart idea patronizing a pirate-owned-and-managed casino, but up to the flaring neon gates you [pc.walk], sidestepping sore losers and boastful winners. A hulking thraggen man is thrown to the ground in your direction by two well-armed and vertically endowed terran bouncers dressed in silver suits. The viridian-skinned giant storms off in a huff while they dust their gloved hands of the trash."

rows.original: Both bruisers sport obvious augmentation. On the sides of their oval-shaped heads sit square-shaped implants that summon visors of simmering green light across their field of vision. You don’t need to see their eyes to know that they are staring at you, one intently and the other aggressively.
rows.translation: 两名打手都有明显改造。椭圆脑袋两侧嵌着方形植入体，在视野前召出翻涌的绿色光幕。你无需看见他们的眼睛，也知道两人都在盯着你，一个目光专注，另一个充满敌意。
rows.raw: "\n\nBoth bruisers sport obvious augmentation. On the sides of their oval-shaped heads sit square-shaped implants that summon visors of simmering green light across their field of vision. You don’t need to see their eyes to know that they are staring at you, one intently and the other aggressively."

rows.original: “A newbie,” the red-haired one says apathetically, folding his trunk-like arms.
rows.translation: “新来的，”红发男人漠然说道，抱起树干般的双臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A newbie,” the red-haired one says apathetically, folding his trunk-like arms."

rows.original: “Right, I’ll handle this,” the black-haired one responds brusquely, upturning his muscle-rippled palm and beckoning you to the side - can’t hold up traffic, after all.
rows.translation: “好，我来处理，”黑发男人生硬回应，翻起肌肉起伏的手掌，示意你到一旁，毕竟不能堵住人流。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, I’ll handle this,” the black-haired one responds brusquely, upturning his muscle-rippled palm and beckoning you to the side - can’t hold up traffic, after all."

rows.original: “Welcome to Treasure Nova,” he begins in a professional oboe voice, interlocking his fingers behind his back. The same movement reveals the gun at his hip under the fancy jacket he wears. “First, no weapons.”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到新星宝藏，”他用专业而低沉的双簧管般嗓音开口，双手十指交扣在背后。同一个动作露出华丽夹克下腰间的枪。“第一，不准携带武器。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to Treasure Nova,” he begins in a professional oboe voice, interlocking his fingers behind his back. The same movement reveals the gun at his hip under the fancy jacket he wears. “First, no weapons.” "

rows.original: He looks down at you hard enough that his scrunched eyes are visible behind the mask, making it clear that was not an innocuous statement.
rows.translation: 他狠狠低头瞪着你，眯起的双眼甚至透过面罩清晰可见，明白表示这绝非随口一说。
rows.raw: "He looks down at you hard enough that his scrunched eyes are visible behind the mask, making it clear that was not an innocuous statement."

rows.original: He looks across at you hard enough and with tense body language, his firm warning crystal clear.
rows.translation: 他神情严厉地看向你，身体紧绷，坚定警告表达得再清楚不过。
rows.raw: "He looks across at you hard enough and with tense body language, his firm warning crystal clear."

rows.original: He stares up at you unintimidated, his rock-solid body language supporting his terse warning.
rows.translation: 他毫不畏惧地仰头盯着你，钢铁般稳固的肢体语言支撑着简短警告。
rows.raw: "He stares up at you unintimidated, his rock-solid body language supporting his terse warning."

rows.original: “You will check your equipment before passing the gates and submit them to storage, and you will reclaim them when you leave. If it makes you feel better, nobody else will handle your gear.”
rows.translation: “通过大门前必须卸下装备并交由仓储保管，离开时再取回。如果这样能让你好受些，没人会碰你的装备。”
rows.raw: " “You will check your equipment before passing the gates and submit them to storage, and you will reclaim them when you leave. If it makes you feel better, nobody else will handle your gear.”"

rows.original: Nodding, you make ready to disarm. Agitating local security is the last thing you want on a crowded station.
rows.translation: 你点点头，准备解除武装。在这座拥挤的空间站激怒当地保安，是你最不想做的事。
rows.raw: "Nodding, you make ready to disarm. Agitating local security is the last thing you want on a crowded station."

rows.original: You scowl and prep your gear for apprehension. If someone tries anything, it’ll be a race between you and the help to make it their last mistake.
rows.translation: 你皱起眉，准备交出装备。如果有人敢耍花样，你和帮手就会比赛谁先让他们犯下最后一个错误。
rows.raw: "You scowl and prep your gear for apprehension. If someone tries anything, it’ll be a race between you and the help to make it their last mistake."

rows.original: “Lastly, you will respect the Dealers and adhere to the rules of the game. Credits are to be presented up front. Bets will not be forfeited or surrendered. Take it from me, you would do well not to spend beyond your means.” A light smirk crosses his olive features. “Everything else should be self-explanatory.”
rows.translation: “最后，你必须尊重庄家，遵守游戏规则。点数必须预先支付。下注后不得放弃或撤回。听我一句，你最好不要花掉超出自身承受能力的钱。”他橄榄色的脸上浮现淡淡坏笑。“其他事情应该不用解释。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lastly, you will respect the Dealers and adhere to the rules of the game. Credits are to be presented up front. Bets will not be forfeited or surrendered. Take it from me, you would do well not to spend beyond your means.” A light smirk crosses his olive features. “Everything else should be self-explanatory.”"

rows.original: He nods once, cracking his neck in the stiff motion, before returning to his post and quashing a sprouted argument.
rows.translation: 他点了一下头，以僵硬动作扭响脖子，随后回到岗位，平息一场刚冒头的争执。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe nods once, cracking his neck in the stiff motion, before returning to his post and quashing a sprouted argument."

rows.original: In the nearby alcoves, not too unlike a set of keyed lockers, you claim an unused rack and stash your [pc.rangedNoun] and whatever else on your personage that could be construed as a weapon, sealing them under magnetic clamps that will only open for the cardkey you take. You then [pc.move] unmolested through the cerulean forcefield, feeling the scanner bristle along your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun].
rows.translation: 附近凹室形似一排带钥匙的储物柜。你占用一个空架，把[pc.rangedNoun]和身上其他可能被视作武器的东西存进去，再用磁力夹封住；只有你拿走的钥匙卡能将它们打开。随后你[pc.move]穿过蔚蓝力场，毫无阻碍，只感觉扫描器沿[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]掠过。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the nearby alcoves, not too unlike a set of keyed lockers, you claim an unused rack and stash your [pc.rangedNoun] and whatever else on your personage that could be construed as a weapon, sealing them under magnetic clamps that will only open for the cardkey you take. You then [pc.move] unmolested through the cerulean forcefield, feeling the scanner bristle along your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: CASINO_SECURITY
rows.raw: "CASINO_SECURITY"

rows.original: Casino Security
rows.translation: 赌场保安
rows.raw: "Casino Security"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Weaponized glamor that could topple old Terran religions decorates the Treasure Nova interior - the opulence on display stabs you right in the eye. Behind the idolatry are hardlight walls tuned to exhibit an accurate representation of atmospheric auroras. Soothing magenta rays fade into chilling emerald gradients, dimming until a chromatic pulse revivifies them, changing the color and the mood as it travels.
rows.translation: 足以推翻古老泰伦宗教的武装华美装饰着新星宝藏内部，眼前奢华几乎刺痛双眼。偶像崇拜般装饰背后是硬光墙，经过调校，能准确呈现大气极光。舒缓的洋红光线渐变为冰冷翠绿，暗淡下去，直到一道彩色脉冲重新激活它们，沿途改变色彩与情绪。
rows.raw: "Weaponized glamor that could topple old Terran religions decorates the Treasure Nova interior - the opulence on display stabs you right in the eye. Behind the idolatry are hardlight walls tuned to exhibit an accurate representation of atmospheric auroras. Soothing magenta rays fade into chilling emerald gradients, dimming until a chromatic pulse revivifies them, changing the color and the mood as it travels."

rows.original: You can practically see the aurelian strings being pulled from this grand space, attached tightly to the money moving through here at rapid rates. Obnoxiously loud slot machines jingle all around, shrill noises and psychologically exploitative lights persuading retries from lightened wallets. Dealers bellow at the nadir of the casino, in an area devoted to high-stakes gambling. Platinum-white carpets are laid at the center of every walkway, pathing through wealthy thoroughfares.
rows.translation: 你几乎能看见从这座宏伟空间中抽出的金色丝线，紧紧连着在此高速流动的金钱。聒噪的老虎机在四周叮当作响，刺耳噪声和利用心理弱点的灯光诱使钱包变轻的人继续尝试。庄家在赌场最低处高声吆喝，那里专供高额赌博。每条走道中央都铺着铂白地毯，贯穿富贵通衢。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can practically see the aurelian strings being pulled from this grand space, attached tightly to the money moving through here at rapid rates. Obnoxiously loud slot machines jingle all around, shrill noises and psychologically exploitative lights persuading retries from lightened wallets. Dealers bellow at the nadir of the casino, in an area devoted to high-stakes gambling. Platinum-white carpets are laid at the center of every walkway, pathing through wealthy thoroughfares."

rows.original: Dominating the center of this hall is a massive bar that can be described as the very core of this den of iniquity. It may in fact be a giant power core with its eye-catching design. There, a battalion of bartenders serve freelancers, Jumpers, Cyber Punks, anyone who seats themselves at the counter. A poppy jazz theme highlighted by a superlative sax emanates from the speakers slotted into its crown.
rows.translation: 大厅中央矗立着一座巨大酒吧，堪称这处罪恶巢穴的核心。以其引人注目的设计来看，它或许本来就是一座巨型动力核心。那里，一大队酒保为自由职业者、跳帮者、赛博朋克以及任何在吧台落座的人服务。顶部嵌入的扬声器中传出活泼爵士主题，顶级萨克斯尤为突出。
rows.raw: "\n\nDominating the center of this hall is a massive bar that can be described as the very core of this den of iniquity. It may in fact be a giant power core with its eye-catching design. There, a battalion of bartenders serve freelancers, Jumpers, Cyber Punks, anyone who seats themselves at the counter. A poppy jazz theme highlighted by a superlative sax emanates from the speakers slotted into its crown."

rows.original: Slaves happy with their lot in life handle platters of steaming food and fizzy, raspberry-colored drinks, delivering condiments where they’re needed most, dressed in fine clothing featuring name tags and the logo of their owner’s business: unsurprisingly, a stylized nova.
rows.translation: 安于自身命运的奴隶端着热气腾腾的食物和覆盆子色气泡饮料，在最需要的地方送上调味品。他们穿着精致服装，佩戴名牌和主人企业的标志，不出所料，那是一颗风格化的新星。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlaves happy with their lot in life handle platters of steaming food and fizzy, raspberry-colored drinks, delivering condiments where they’re needed most, dressed in fine clothing featuring name tags and the logo of their owner’s business: unsurprisingly, a stylized nova."

rows.original: Now that you’ve adjusted to the celestial aesthetic, you wonder where your money would best be spent.
rows.translation: 适应这里的星空美学后，你开始考虑把钱花在哪里最划算。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that you’ve adjusted to the celestial aesthetic, you wonder where your money would best be spent. "

joinAfter.expression:
isSillyModeEnabled()
                      ? "Assuming you don’t disturb the sound of silence, anyway. "
                      : ""

rows.original: Assuming you don’t disturb the sound of silence, anyway.
rows.translation: 当然，前提是你别打破寂静。
rows.raw: "Assuming you don’t disturb the sound of silence, anyway. "

rows.original: Considering everyone checks their weapons at the door, this may just be the safest place on Zhèng Shi.
rows.translation: 考虑到每个人都在门口寄存武器，这里或许是郑石空间站最安全的地方。
rows.raw: "Considering everyone checks their weapons at the door, this may just be the safest place on Zhèng Shi."

rows.original: At least until someone loses hard enough.
rows.translation: 至少在有人输得太惨之前。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least until someone loses hard enough."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You stand square in the center of the station’s foundry level, aptly named, judging by the red-glowing, steam-belching furnaces and auto-smithies to the north. The entire area is one massive cavern - with
rows.translation: 你站在空间站铸造层正中央。北边熔炉泛着红光、喷出蒸汽，还有自动锻造机，这个名字确实贴切。整片区域是一座巨大洞窟，其中
rows.raw: "You stand square in the center of the station’s foundry level, aptly named, judging by the red-glowing, steam-belching furnaces and auto-smithies to the north. The entire area is one massive cavern - with "

joinAfter.expression:
pirateResearchVesselStolen()
                  ? "the skeletal frame of a"
                  : "a gleaming"

rows.original: the skeletal frame of a
rows.translation: 一艘飞船的骨架
rows.raw: "the skeletal frame of a"

rows.original: a gleaming
rows.translation: 一艘闪亮的
rows.raw: "a gleaming"

rows.original: ship dangling high over it, surrounded by heavy scaffolds and the flashing torches of busy work-slaves. Rusty steel beams and geddanium-braid cabling stretch all the way into the craggy ceiling above, marking out just how much higher the cargo elevator can climb. Prefab hallways and white-boxed workrooms sit just to the south, undoubtedly providing a locale for more cerebral talents to be employed, insulated from the cacophonous din. A tunnel in the western wall is tagged with cheap spraypaint: “Shuttle Bay.”
rows.translation: 飞船高悬其上，周围环绕重型脚手架和忙碌奴工闪烁的焊炬。锈蚀钢梁与格达尼姆编织线缆一路延伸进上方崎岖洞顶，显示货运电梯还能爬升多高。南边坐落着预制走廊和白色盒状工作室，无疑让更擅长脑力的人员能在隔绝喧嚣后工作。西墙隧道被廉价喷漆标记为：‘穿梭机湾。’
rows.raw: " ship dangling high over it, surrounded by heavy scaffolds and the flashing torches of busy work-slaves. Rusty steel beams and geddanium-braid cabling stretch all the way into the craggy ceiling above, marking out just how much higher the cargo elevator can climb. Prefab hallways and white-boxed workrooms sit just to the south, undoubtedly providing a locale for more cerebral talents to be employed, insulated from the cacophonous din. A tunnel in the western wall is tagged with cheap spraypaint: “Shuttle Bay.”"

rows.original: The machinery comes to a halt along the eastern edge of the cavern. High above, a suspended scaffold surrounds the shape of an enormous craft.
rows.translation: 机器设备在洞窟东缘停止延伸。高处，一座悬空脚手架环绕着一艘巨型飞船的轮廓。
rows.raw: "The machinery comes to a halt along the eastern edge of the cavern. High above, a suspended scaffold surrounds the shape of an enormous craft. "

joinAfter.expression:
pirateResearchVesselStolen()
                  ? "You may have stolen the original, but a replacement is well on its way."
                  : "It looks complete, any work long since finished."

rows.original: You may have stolen the original, but a replacement is well on its way.
rows.translation: 你或许偷走了原版，但替代品已经建造得有模有样。
rows.raw: "You may have stolen the original, but a replacement is well on its way."

rows.original: It looks complete, any work long since finished.
rows.translation: 它看起来已经完工，所有工作早就结束。
rows.raw: "It looks complete, any work long since finished."

rows.original: To your northwest, the forgefires burn bright, the plasma furnaces glittering with fiery, metal-dissolving energies.
rows.translation: 西北方向炉火熊熊，等离子熔炉闪耀着炽热、足以熔化金属的能量。
rows.raw: " To your northwest, the forgefires burn bright, the plasma furnaces glittering with fiery, metal-dissolving energies."

rows.original: This scaffold hangs from anchors in the cavern’s ceiling. Looking down, you’re at least four stories up from the ground floor and its bevy of automated smelting equipment. A fall from this height could kill you. Fortunately, the pirates eschewed their traditional disregard for safety and sprung for some quality steel railings. Still, you’d rather not lean too hard on any of them. The scaffold stretches off to the east and south around the bulk of a
rows.translation: 这座脚手架从洞顶锚点悬挂下来。向下望去，你至少位于地面及那一大批自动熔炼设备上方四层楼高。从这里坠落可能会死。幸好海盗一反平日漠视安全的作风，花钱装了些优质钢制护栏。不过你仍不想太用力倚靠任何一根。脚手架沿着一艘飞船庞大的主体向东、向南延伸，那是
rows.raw: "This scaffold hangs from anchors in the cavern’s ceiling. Looking down, you’re at least four stories up from the ground floor and its bevy of automated smelting equipment. A fall from this height could kill you. Fortunately, the pirates eschewed their traditional disregard for safety and sprung for some quality steel railings. Still, you’d rather not lean too hard on any of them. The scaffold stretches off to the east and south around the bulk of a "

rows.original: new Sidewinder - one still a long ways from complete.
rows.translation: 一艘全新的响尾蛇号，距离完工还很遥远。
rows.raw: "new Sidewinder - one still a long ways from complete."

rows.original: gleaming, newly constructed ship.
rows.translation: 一艘闪闪发亮的新造飞船。
rows.raw: "gleaming, newly constructed ship."

rows.original: Walking along the scaffold, you pass by one of the ship’s partly-completed engines. Even half built, it’s large for the heavy corvette it’s bolted onto.
rows.translation: 沿脚手架行走时，你经过飞船一台尚未完工的引擎。即便只造了一半，对它所安装的重型护卫舰而言也已经很大。
rows.raw: "Walking along the scaffold, you pass by one of the ship’s partly-completed engines. Even half built, it’s large for the heavy corvette it’s bolted onto."

rows.original: Walking along the scaffold, you pass by one of the ship’s enormous engines. It isn’t just large - it’s large for the heavy corvette it’s bolted onto.
rows.translation: 沿脚手架行走时，你经过飞船一台巨大引擎。它不只是大，对它所安装的重型护卫舰而言都格外庞大。
rows.raw: "Walking along the scaffold, you pass by one of the ship’s enormous engines. It isn’t just large - it’s large for the heavy corvette it’s bolted onto. "

rows.original: Boosters this size are rarely seen on anything smaller than a full-size capital ship, but you suppose the pirates are rigging this ship for speed, the better to avoid Peacekeeper intervention. A little to the west, you can see a ladder. The scaffold also continues east.
rows.translation: 这种尺寸的推进器很少用于完整主力舰以下的船只，但你猜海盗正在把这艘船改造成高速舰，以便躲避维和人员干预。西边不远处能看到一架梯子。脚手架也继续向东延伸。
rows.raw: "Boosters this size are rarely seen on anything smaller than a full-size capital ship, but you suppose the pirates are rigging this ship for speed, the better to avoid Peacekeeper intervention. A little to the west, you can see a ladder. The scaffold also continues east."

rows.original: You stand directly behind and below a wall of awe-inspiring engines, their exhaust cones individually big enough to contain a large house. The ship’s hull is somewhat less complete. Patchworks of armor plating and exposed internal systems show off its masterful engineering like a camwhore shows off her tits. This is what Zhèng Shi was built for - you’re sure of it. The station exists purely to produce this ship in secret, constructed bespoke for some oh-so-specific job. The scaffold around the engines runs east and west from here.
rows.translation: 你站在一堵令人敬畏的引擎墙正后下方，每个排气锥都大到足以容纳一栋大房子。飞船船体完成度稍低。拼凑的装甲板与裸露内部系统，如同卖弄风骚的女人展示乳房般，展示着精湛工程技术。你确信，这正是郑石空间站的建造目的。整座空间站纯粹是为了秘密生产这艘飞船，专门为某项极其特定的工作量身打造。环绕引擎的脚手架从这里向东西延伸。
rows.raw: "You stand directly behind and below a wall of awe-inspiring engines, their exhaust cones individually big enough to contain a large house. The ship’s hull is somewhat less complete. Patchworks of armor plating and exposed internal systems show off its masterful engineering like a camwhore shows off her tits. This is what Zhèng Shi was built for - you’re sure of it. The station exists purely to produce this ship in secret, constructed bespoke for some oh-so-specific job. The scaffold around the engines runs east and west from here."

rows.original: You stand directly behind and below a wall of awe-inspiring engines, their exhaust cones individually big enough to contain a large house. The ship’s hull gleams with fresh paint and a variety of pirate insignias (along with some flashy graffiti). This is what Zhèng Shi was built for - you’re sure of it. The station exists purely to produce this ship in secret, constructed bespoke for some oh-so-specific job. The scaffold around the engines runs east and west from here.
rows.translation: 你站在一堵令人敬畏的引擎墙正后下方，每个排气锥都大到足以容纳一栋大房子。飞船船体闪耀着新漆和各种海盗徽记，还有些花哨涂鸦。你确信，这正是郑石空间站的建造目的。整座空间站纯粹是为了秘密生产这艘飞船，专门为某项极其特定的工作量身打造。环绕引擎的脚手架从这里向东西延伸。
rows.raw: "You stand directly behind and below a wall of awe-inspiring engines, their exhaust cones individually big enough to contain a large house. The ship’s hull gleams with fresh paint and a variety of pirate insignias (along with some flashy graffiti). This is what Zhèng Shi was built for - you’re sure of it. The station exists purely to produce this ship in secret, constructed bespoke for some oh-so-specific job. The scaffold around the engines runs east and west from here."

rows.original: To your south lies the Zhèng Shi’s newest crown jewel: a second heavy corvette with engines befitting a capital ship.
rows.translation: 南边是郑石空间站最新的镇站之宝：第二艘配备主力舰级引擎的重型护卫舰。
rows.raw: "To your south lies the Zhèng Shi’s newest crown jewel: a second heavy corvette with engines befitting a capital ship. "

rows.original: To your south lies the Zhèng Shi’s crown jewel: a heavy corvette with engines befitting a capital ship.
rows.translation: 南边是郑石空间站的镇站之宝：一艘配备主力舰级引擎的重型护卫舰。
rows.raw: "To your south lies the Zhèng Shi’s crown jewel: a heavy corvette with engines befitting a capital ship. "

rows.original: One of them is close by - so close you could reach out and touch the flare of its cone, caress the super-high durability alloy. A ladder to the east descends along the cavern’s southern wall back to the foundry level and its heat belching machines. Alternatively, this suspended platform strolls west behind the ship’s thruster bank.
rows.translation: 其中一台近在咫尺，近到你可以伸手触碰排气锥外沿，抚摸那超高耐久合金。东边一架梯子沿洞窟南墙下降，通回铸造层及其喷吐热浪的机器。或者，你也可以沿这座悬空平台向西，从飞船推进器组后方经过。
rows.raw: "One of them is close by - so close you could reach out and touch the flare of its cone, caress the super-high durability alloy. A ladder to the east descends along the cavern’s southern wall back to the foundry level and its heat belching machines. Alternatively, this suspended platform strolls west behind the ship’s thruster bank."

rows.original: You stand at the corner of an enormous, suspended scaffold. One fork trails west along a bank of colossal engines. The other follows south along the bottom of the
rows.translation: 你站在巨大悬空脚手架的转角。一条岔路沿巨型引擎组向西延伸，另一条则向南沿着
rows.raw: "You stand at the corner of an enormous, suspended scaffold. One fork trails west along a bank of colossal engines. The other follows south along the bottom of the "

rows.original: replacement
rows.translation: 替代
rows.raw: "replacement "

rows.original: craft’s fuselage. The ladder itself, bolted into the northern wall, descends through plumes of smoke and air thick with the tang of aerosolized metals, back to the foundry that produced this triumph of lawless engineering.
rows.translation: 飞船的机身底部延伸。这架梯子固定在北墙上，穿过浓烟与弥漫雾化金属气味的空气，下降到打造这项无法无天工程杰作的铸造层。
rows.raw: "craft’s fuselage. The ladder itself, bolted into the northern wall, descends through plumes of smoke and air thick with the tang of aerosolized metals, back to the foundry that produced this triumph of lawless engineering."

rows.original: Following along the underside of a corvette, the scaffold allows you to admire its every swell and curve, marred by huge gaps that remain to be filled in. Even half-finished, the second Sidewinder is a sight to behold.
rows.translation: 沿护卫舰下方前进，脚手架让你能欣赏它的每一道隆起和曲线，只是巨大的缺口仍有待填补。即使只完成一半，第二艘响尾蛇号也令人叹为观止。
rows.raw: "Following along the underside of a corvette, the scaffold allows you to admire its every swell and curve, marred by huge gaps that remain to be filled in. Even half-finished, the second Sidewinder is a sight to behold. "

rows.original: Following along the underside of a corvette, the scaffold allows you to admire its every swell and curve, the size and reflective sheen of its sensor dishes, the girth of its steam-belching barrels.
rows.translation: 沿护卫舰下方前进，脚手架让你能欣赏它的每一道隆起与曲线、传感器碟片的尺寸与反光光泽，以及喷吐蒸汽的炮管粗度。
rows.raw: "Following along the underside of a corvette, the scaffold allows you to admire its every swell and curve, the size and reflective sheen of its sensor dishes, the girth of its steam-belching barrels. "

rows.original: Unfortunately the scaffold itself is not so glorious, but it tracks north and south, giving you ample opportunity to take a closer look at the custom-built vessel.
rows.translation: 可惜脚手架本身没那么壮观，不过它向南北延伸，让你有充分机会近距离观察这艘定制飞船。
rows.raw: "Unfortunately the scaffold itself is not so glorious, but it tracks north and south, giving you ample opportunity to take a closer look at the custom-built vessel."

rows.original: Part of the scaffold’s railing is broken and dangles precariously over the forge below, nearly four stories down. You move carefully past it and back to the safer path beyond, briefly wondering why nobody has bothered to fix it.
rows.translation: 脚手架一段护栏断裂，危险地悬在下方近四层楼深的熔炉上方。你小心绕过它，回到前方更安全的路径，短暂纳闷为何没人修理。
rows.raw: "Part of the scaffold’s railing is broken and dangles precariously over the forge below, nearly four stories down. You move carefully past it and back to the safer path beyond, briefly wondering why nobody has bothered to fix it. "

rows.original: Then you look up at the ship’s side, where half-welded panels sway dangerously. After your theft, safety appears to be an even lower priority.
rows.translation: 随后你抬头看向船身，焊了一半的板材危险地晃荡。自从你偷走飞船后，安全似乎变得更加无关紧要。
rows.raw: "Then you look up at the ship’s side, where half-welded panels sway dangerously. After your theft, safety appears to be an even lower priority. "

rows.original: Then you look up at the ship’s side, every panel polished and in position. Work here is done.
rows.translation: 随后你抬头看向船身，每一块板材都已抛光并安装到位。这里的工作结束了。
rows.raw: " Then you look up at the ship’s side, every panel polished and in position. Work here is done. "

rows.original: The scaffold continues to the north and south.
rows.translation: 脚手架继续向南北延伸。
rows.raw: "The scaffold continues to the north and south."

rows.original: Following the
rows.translation: 悬空平台像迷路小狗般沿着
rows.raw: "Following the "

rows.original: new ship’s partial
rows.translation: 新船尚未完工的
rows.raw: "new ship’s partial"

rows.original: ship’s
rows.translation: 飞船的
rows.raw: "ship’s"

rows.original: hull like a lost puppy, these hanging platforms bend along in a generally north-south path. Heavy cables as thick as your arm hold them aloft, able to support the weight of dozens of workers, armor plates, and a small army of tools.
rows.translation: 船体，以大致南北方向弯曲延伸。手臂般粗的重型线缆将它们悬吊起来，足以承载几十名工人、装甲板和一小支工具大军的重量。
rows.raw: " hull like a lost puppy, these hanging platforms bend along in a generally north-south path. Heavy cables as thick as your arm hold them aloft, able to support the weight of dozens of workers, armor plates, and a small army of tools."

rows.original: Ten feet across and hemmed in by sturdy safety rails, the metallic scaffold continues its north-south journey in the shadow of the pirate’s corvette, providing an awesome view of the assembled industry below and the
rows.translation: 金属脚手架宽十英尺，两侧有坚固安全护栏，在海盗护卫舰阴影下继续向南北延伸，让人能饱览下方成套工业设施和上方
rows.raw: "Ten feet across and hemmed in by sturdy safety rails, the metallic scaffold continues its north-south journey in the shadow of the pirate’s corvette, providing an awesome view of the assembled industry below and the "

rows.original: second Zhèng Shi-crafted
rows.translation: 郑石制造的第二艘
rows.raw: "second Zhèng Shi-crafted "

rows.original: spacecraft above.
rows.translation: 飞船。
rows.raw: "spacecraft above."

rows.original: The bare metal vessel’s framework hints at the rounded curves of a sporty hover-car. You know all too well how well those smooth arcs will fill out. Recessed turret ports will allow it to maintain a sleek profile for maneuverability in atmospheres of all types while still carrying enough weaponry to come out ahead in a dogfight. The longer you walk around it, the more surprised you are that these rag-tag groups of degenerates managed to come together to build two incredible spacecraft. The walkway continues to the north and south.
rows.translation: 裸露金属飞船的框架隐约呈现运动型悬浮车般的圆润曲线。你非常清楚这些平滑弧线最终会有多饱满。内凹炮塔口让它能在各种大气中维持适合机动的流线轮廓，同时携带足够武器在空战中占据上风。你绕得越久，就越惊讶这群乌合之众般的堕落者竟能齐心建造出两艘不可思议的飞船。走道继续向南北延伸。
rows.raw: "The bare metal vessel’s framework hints at the rounded curves of a sporty hover-car. You know all too well how well those smooth arcs will fill out. Recessed turret ports will allow it to maintain a sleek profile for maneuverability in atmospheres of all types while still carrying enough weaponry to come out ahead in a dogfight. The longer you walk around it, the more surprised you are that these rag-tag groups of degenerates managed to come together to build two incredible spacecraft. The walkway continues to the north and south."

rows.original: The crimson vessel’s smooth bulges and rounded curves evoke memories of sporty hover-cars. Its recessed turret ports allow it to maintain a sleek profile for maneuverability in atmospheres of all types while still carrying enough weaponry to come out ahead in a dogfight. The longer you walk around it, the more surprised you are that these rag-tag groups of degenerates managed to come together to build something so beautiful. The walkway continues to the north and south.
rows.translation: 深红飞船平滑的隆起与圆润曲线让人想起运动型悬浮车。内凹炮塔口让它能在各种大气中维持适合机动的流线轮廓，同时携带足够武器在空战中占据上风。你绕得越久，就越惊讶这群乌合之众般的堕落者竟能齐心造出如此美丽的东西。走道继续向南北延伸。
rows.raw: "The crimson vessel’s smooth bulges and rounded curves evoke memories of sporty hover-cars. Its recessed turret ports allow it to maintain a sleek profile for maneuverability in atmospheres of all types while still carrying enough weaponry to come out ahead in a dogfight. The longer you walk around it, the more surprised you are that these rag-tag groups of degenerates managed to come together to build something so beautiful. The walkway continues to the north and south."

rows.original: The scaffold doesn’t so much as sway when you walk. The heavy cables the bolt it to the foundry’s ceiling should allow some amount of motion, but it hangs rock solid. The secret, you realize, is the black boxes positioned at several of the intersections between panels. They occasionally flare with repulsive energy, pushing back in opposition to the inertial load it is subjected to. Brilliant.
rows.translation: 你行走时脚手架纹丝不动。将它固定到铸造层洞顶的重型线缆本应允许一定幅度摆动，但它稳如磐石。你发现秘密在于面板交界处放置的黑色盒子。它们偶尔迸发排斥能量，反向抵消承受的惯性负载。真高明。
rows.raw: "The scaffold doesn’t so much as sway when you walk. The heavy cables the bolt it to the foundry’s ceiling should allow some amount of motion, but it hangs rock solid. The secret, you realize, is the black boxes positioned at several of the intersections between panels. They occasionally flare with repulsive energy, pushing back in opposition to the inertial load it is subjected to. Brilliant."

rows.original: Bending 90 degrees to follow the
rows.translation: 为了跟随海盗珍爱飞船上
rows.raw: "Bending 90 degrees to follow the "

rows.original: hurried re-construction
rows.translation: 仓促进行的重建工作
rows.raw: "hurried re-construction"

rows.original: last bits of construction
rows.translation: 最后一点建造工作
rows.raw: "last bits of construction"

rows.original: on the pirate’s prized ship, the hanging catwalk stretches away to the north and west. Flecks of red paint adorn places of the deck. Bored-looking workers and slaves sometimes pass you by without a second thought, taking the long walk to their next job. Now if you could get the sharper-eyed scalawags to ignore you as easily.
rows.translation: ，悬空走道转过九十度，向北和向西延伸。甲板多处点缀着红色漆屑。神情无聊的工人与奴隶偶尔从身旁经过，走很长一段路前往下一处岗位，对你毫不在意。要是那些眼神更敏锐的恶棍也这么容易忽略你就好了。
rows.raw: " on the pirate’s prized ship, the hanging catwalk stretches away to the north and west. Flecks of red paint adorn places of the deck. Bored-looking workers and slaves sometimes pass you by without a second thought, taking the long walk to their next job. Now if you could get the sharper-eyed scalawags to ignore you as easily."

rows.original: You stand under the fore portions of the enormous attempt to replace your pilfered vessel. Its body swells wider and wider to the north, fattening to a huge bank of engine cones in the distance. She’s no capital ship, but you know firsthand that she’ll have it where it counts.
rows.translation: 你站在试图取代被你窃走飞船的巨大船只前段下方。船身向北越来越宽，在远处膨大为一大片引擎锥。她不是主力舰，但你亲身知道，她会在关键之处拥有足够实力。
rows.raw: "You stand under the fore portions of the enormous attempt to replace your pilfered vessel. Its body swells wider and wider to the north, fattening to a huge bank of engine cones in the distance. She’s no capital ship, but you know firsthand that she’ll have it where it counts. "

rows.original: You stand under the fore portions of an enormous, red-painted vessel. Its body swells wider and wider to the north, fattening to a huge bank of engine cones in the distance. She’s no capital ship, but she sure makes the Casstech Z14 you started with look like small potatoes.
rows.translation: 你站在一艘巨大红漆飞船前段下方。船身向北越来越宽，在远处膨大为一大片引擎锥。她不是主力舰，却让你最初驾驶的卡斯泰克Z14显得微不足道。
rows.raw: "You stand under the fore portions of an enormous, red-painted vessel. Its body swells wider and wider to the north, fattening to a huge bank of engine cones in the distance. She’s no capital ship, but she sure makes the Casstech Z14 you started with look like small potatoes. "

rows.original: The scaffold leads east and west. A few steps in the former direction and you’ll hit a right angle bend to the north.
rows.translation: 脚手架向东西延伸。朝前一个方向走几步，就会遇到一处向北的直角转弯。
rows.raw: "The scaffold leads east and west. A few steps in the former direction and you’ll hit a right angle bend to the north."

rows.original: You flick your gaze back and forth along the hanging scaffold. It races east and west from here,
rows.translation: 你来回扫视悬空脚手架。它从这里向东西延伸，
rows.raw: "You flick your gaze back and forth along the hanging scaffold. It races east and west from here, "

rows.original: under the nose of the privateer’s second attempt at a star-faring vessel. This ship is still a long way from complete.
rows.translation: 位于私掠者第二次尝试建造的星际飞船船首下方。这艘船离完工还很遥远。
rows.raw: "under the nose of the privateer’s second attempt at a star-faring vessel. This ship is still a long way from complete. "

rows.original: under the nose of the privateer’s star-faring vessel. That ship is complete now - or mostly complete.
rows.translation: 位于私掠者星际飞船船首下方。那艘船如今已经完工，或者基本完工。
rows.raw: "under the nose of the privateer’s star-faring vessel. That ship is complete now - or mostly complete. "

rows.original: More abandoned tools can be found lingering in disuse than workmen to crew them. The craftspeople who pass by do so with the casual smiles of men and women on the cusp of completing a long-time labor, and you don’t see them often.
rows.translation: 闲置的废弃工具比操作它们的工人还多。偶尔经过的工匠面带轻松笑容，仿佛多年劳作即将完成，而且人数很少。
rows.raw: "More abandoned tools can be found lingering in disuse than workmen to crew them. The craftspeople who pass by do so with the casual smiles of men and women on the cusp of completing a long-time labor, and you don’t see them often."

rows.original: A smaller scaffold breaks north from the bigger, better-supported cat-walk to strike out toward
rows.translation: 一条较小的脚手架从支撑更牢固的大走道向北分出，通往
rows.raw: "A smaller scaffold breaks north from the bigger, better-supported cat-walk to strike out toward "

rows.original: an incomplete
rows.translation: 一个尚未完工的
rows.raw: "an incomplete"

rows.original: a
rows.translation: 一个

rows.original: boarding hatch in the suspended ship. The larger path continues east and west, while the view over the southern railing presents you with a bird’s-eye view of the manufacturing complex below.
rows.translation: 悬空飞船登舰舱门。较大路径继续向东西延伸，而南侧护栏外能俯瞰下方制造设施。
rows.raw: " boarding hatch in the suspended ship. The larger path continues east and west, while the view over the southern railing presents you with a bird’s-eye view of the manufacturing complex below."

rows.original: The hanging metal catwalk jerks north and east at a perfect right angle, flanking around all sides of the stand-in for your crimson ship. The north path hugs along its starboard side. The eastern one dangles beneath its nose, providing a head-on view of its soon to be armored curves.
rows.translation: 悬空金属走道以完美直角向北和向东急转，从各个方向环绕那艘用来替代你深红飞船的船只。北侧路径紧贴其右舷，东侧路径则悬在船首下方，可从正面观看即将覆上装甲的曲线。
rows.raw: "The hanging metal catwalk jerks north and east at a perfect right angle, flanking around all sides of the stand-in for your crimson ship. The north path hugs along its starboard side. The eastern one dangles beneath its nose, providing a head-on view of its soon to be armored curves. "

rows.original: The hanging metal catwalk jerks north and east at a perfect right angle, flanking around all sides of the crimson ship. The north path hugs along its starboard side. The eastern one dangles beneath its nose, providing a beautiful head-on view of its sporty curves.
rows.translation: 悬空金属走道以完美直角向北和向东急转，从各个方向环绕深红飞船。北侧路径紧贴其右舷，东侧路径则悬在船首下方，让人能从正面欣赏运动感十足的曲线。
rows.raw: "The hanging metal catwalk jerks north and east at a perfect right angle, flanking around all sides of the crimson ship. The north path hugs along its starboard side. The eastern one dangles beneath its nose, providing a beautiful head-on view of its sporty curves. "

rows.original: There, a smaller scaffold breaks toward a hatch - the only entrance you’ve seen on your suspended jaunt.
rows.translation: 那里，一条较小脚手架朝一扇舱门分出，这是你在悬空行程中见过的唯一入口。
rows.raw: "There, a smaller scaffold breaks toward a hatch - the only entrance you’ve seen on your suspended jaunt."

rows.original: Walking into this section of scaffold is like stepping into a cool mountainside morning, except the mist here is rolling off a ceiling-mounted coolant pipe.
rows.translation: 走进这段脚手架，就像踏入清凉的山间清晨，只是这里的雾气来自洞顶安装的冷却剂管。
rows.raw: "Walking into this section of scaffold is like stepping into a cool mountainside morning, except the mist here is rolling off a ceiling-mounted coolant pipe. "

rows.original: It dangles limp, unconnected to anything. The port at its terminus only closes halfway, causing it to spill out an avalanche of aerosolized chill. You recognize it as the same coolant your ship uses, and you suppose once the Sidewinder II is complete enough to plug it in, you won’t have to deal with this leak any longer. You could head north or wander off in the other direction, though it’ll be tough to see anything until you escape this bank of artificial fog.
rows.translation: 它软绵绵地垂下，没有连接任何设备。末端接口只能关闭一半，喷涌出雪崩般的雾化寒气。你认出这是飞船使用的同种冷却剂；你猜等响尾蛇二号建造到足以接上它时，就不必再忍受这处泄漏。你可以向北走，也可以朝另一个方向闲逛，不过在逃离这片人工浓雾前，很难看清任何东西。
rows.raw: "It dangles limp, unconnected to anything. The port at its terminus only closes halfway, causing it to spill out an avalanche of aerosolized chill. You recognize it as the same coolant your ship uses, and you suppose once the Sidewinder II is complete enough to plug it in, you won’t have to deal with this leak any longer. You could head north or wander off in the other direction, though it’ll be tough to see anything until you escape this bank of artificial fog."

rows.original: It cuts a dogleg east and plugs into a frost-rimmed port in the corvette’s flank. A lingering worker leans against the railing, savoring the chill, but a warning beep stirs him into action. He steps away with a respectful nod, heading back toward some unknown post to the north. You could follow or wander off in the other direction, though it’ll be tough to see anything until you escape this bank of artificial fog.
rows.translation: 它向东折成折线，插入护卫舰侧面结霜接口。一个逗留的工人靠着护栏享受凉意，但警报哔声让他行动起来。他礼貌点头后离开，向北方某个未知岗位走去。你可以跟上，也可以朝另一个方向闲逛，不过在逃离这片人工浓雾前，很难看清任何东西。
rows.raw: "It cuts a dogleg east and plugs into a frost-rimmed port in the corvette’s flank. A lingering worker leans against the railing, savoring the chill, but a warning beep stirs him into action. He steps away with a respectful nod, heading back toward some unknown post to the north. You could follow or wander off in the other direction, though it’ll be tough to see anything until you escape this bank of artificial fog."

rows.original: From this T-intersection, the catwalk splits three ways. The north and south branches combine to form a solid avenue for bustling workmen (or workslaves) to move around every side of the
rows.translation: 从这个丁字路口，走道分成三个方向。南北分支构成一条坚固大道，让忙碌工人或奴工能绕着
rows.raw: "From this T-intersection, the catwalk splits three ways. The north and south branches combine to form a solid avenue for bustling workmen (or workslaves) to move around every side of the "

joinAfter.expression:
pirateResearchVesselStolen()
                  ? "hanging corvette’s exposed skeleton"
                  : "hanging, heavy corvette"

rows.original: hanging corvette’s exposed skeleton
rows.translation: 悬空护卫舰裸露的骨架
rows.raw: "hanging corvette’s exposed skeleton"

rows.original: hanging, heavy corvette
rows.translation: 悬空的重型护卫舰
rows.raw: "hanging, heavy corvette"

rows.original: . The east fork more heavily reinforced and over twenty feet across. It races up to the side of the cargo elevator, itself narrowly threading narrowly alongside the tremendous craft.
rows.translation: 各个侧面移动。东侧岔路加固得更加坚实，宽度超过二十英尺，径直通向货运电梯侧面，而电梯本身则勉强从巨大飞船旁穿过。
rows.raw: ". The east fork more heavily reinforced and over twenty feet across. It races up to the side of the cargo elevator, itself narrowly threading narrowly alongside the tremendous craft."

rows.original: An unhappy-looking slave dangles above second Sidewinder’s exposed frame. In her hand, the sputtering plasma welder carefully traces the connection between metallic skeleton and sensor dish mounting bracket, merging two pieces of metal into one. Such equipment went out of style decades ago, but the reality of long distance detection has made them a practical necessity for dealing with pirates - and skirting the long arm of the law. This particular dish is quite large for a vessel of this size.
rows.translation: 一个神情不快的奴隶悬在第二艘响尾蛇号裸露框架上方。她手中噼啪作响的等离子焊枪小心沿着金属骨架与传感器碟片安装支架的连接处划过，将两块金属熔为一体。这类设备几十年前便已过时，但远距离探测的现实需求使它们成为对付海盗与躲避法律长臂的实际必需品。这块碟片对这种尺寸的飞船而言相当巨大。
rows.raw: "An unhappy-looking slave dangles above second Sidewinder’s exposed frame. In her hand, the sputtering plasma welder carefully traces the connection between metallic skeleton and sensor dish mounting bracket, merging two pieces of metal into one. Such equipment went out of style decades ago, but the reality of long distance detection has made them a practical necessity for dealing with pirates - and skirting the long arm of the law. This particular dish is quite large for a vessel of this size.\n\n"

rows.original: Sensor dishes went out of style decades ago, but the reality of long distance detection has made them a practical necessity for dealing with pirates - and skirting the long arm of the law. The one shading the top of the ship is quite large for a vessel of this size, and workmen with magsuits slowly crawl around the struts and folded metal of the bay of its hidden storage bay.
rows.translation: 传感器碟片几十年前便已过时，但远距离探测的现实需求使它们成为对付海盗与躲避法律长臂的实际必需品。遮蔽船顶的那块对这种尺寸的飞船而言相当巨大，穿磁力服的工人缓慢爬过支柱与折叠金属，检查其隐藏收纳舱。
rows.raw: "Sensor dishes went out of style decades ago, but the reality of long distance detection has made them a practical necessity for dealing with pirates - and skirting the long arm of the law. The one shading the top of the ship is quite large for a vessel of this size, and workmen with magsuits slowly crawl around the struts and folded metal of the bay of its hidden storage bay. "

rows.original: The scaffold continues north and south.
rows.translation: 脚手架继续向南北延伸。
rows.raw: "The scaffold continues north and south."

rows.original: A bit of the second Sidewinder’s exposed frame almost within arm’s reach, and the pirates have taken the opportunity to paint “Fuck [pc.name]!” on the side.
rows.translation: 第二艘响尾蛇号的一截裸露框架几乎伸到触手可及处，海盗趁机在侧面喷上“操你，[pc.name]！”。
rows.raw: "A bit of the second Sidewinder’s exposed frame almost within arm’s reach, and the pirates have taken the opportunity to paint “Fuck [pc.name]!” on the side. "

rows.original: A patch of unpainted armor flares out to within arm’s reach of the catwalk, seated by concealed fastening mechanisms on the underside so as not to present any weaknesses to hostile fire.
rows.translation: 一块未上漆装甲向外展开到走道旁触手可及的位置，底面用隐藏紧固机构安装，以免向敌火暴露任何弱点。
rows.raw: "A patch of unpainted armor flares out to within arm’s reach of the catwalk, seated by concealed fastening mechanisms on the underside so as not to present any weaknesses to hostile fire. "

rows.original: A few tools hang from a bucket on the rail, left behind by some workers on break. Such basic implements are hardly worth the effort it would take to steal them. Your path along the suspended catwalk traverses in a straight north-south line.
rows.translation: 几件工具挂在护栏桶里，是休息工人留下的。这些基础工具根本不值得费力偷走。你沿悬空走道的路径呈南北直线延伸。
rows.raw: "A few tools hang from a bucket on the rail, left behind by some workers on break. Such basic implements are hardly worth the effort it would take to steal them. Your path along the suspended catwalk traverses in a straight north-south line."

rows.original: From this high up you’re able to casually follow the foundry’s every connection. Ore rises on conveyors below to be carried into crucibles for smelting and pouring, then fed into automatic smelters to the east that hammer and the ingots into chunks of modular armor plating. It’s a miniaturized take on the processes occurring in the mega-corps’ orbital shipyards, doubtless assembled with the help of stolen manufacturing data schematics. The scaffold stretches north and south along the
rows.translation: 站在如此高处，你能随意看清铸造层的每一道工序连接。矿石从下方传送带升起，送入坩埚熔化浇铸，再进入东边自动锻造机，把锭块锤打成模块化装甲板。这是巨型企业轨道船坞工序的微缩版，无疑借助了偷来的制造数据图纸组装而成。脚手架沿着
rows.raw: "From this high up you’re able to casually follow the foundry’s every connection. Ore rises on conveyors below to be carried into crucibles for smelting and pouring, then fed into automatic smelters to the east that hammer and the ingots into chunks of modular armor plating. It’s a miniaturized take on the processes occurring in the mega-corps’ orbital shipyards, doubtless assembled with the help of stolen manufacturing data schematics. The scaffold stretches north and south along the "

rows.original: skeletal
rows.translation: 骨架般的
rows.raw: "skeletal "

rows.original: ship’s starboard side.
rows.translation: 飞船右舷向南北延伸。
rows.raw: "ship’s starboard side."

rows.original: This suspended boarding ramp hangs a sharp, 90 degree turn to the east and south from here.
rows.translation: 这条悬空登舰坡道从这里向东和向南急转九十度。
rows.raw: "This suspended boarding ramp hangs a sharp, 90 degree turn to the east and south from here. "

rows.original: You remember the first time you came here, looking up at the majestic, gleaming curves of your ship. Now there’s nothing but the sharp, angled metal of support beams and half-completed armor plating. The ship lies east, though there’s nothing to climb inside of... yet.
rows.translation: 你记得第一次来到这里时，仰望自己飞船那威严闪亮的曲线。现在只剩支撑梁尖锐倾斜的金属和半成品装甲板。飞船位于东边，不过还没有任何能爬进去的地方...暂时如此。
rows.raw: "You remember the first time you came here, looking up at the majestic, gleaming curves of your ship. Now there’s nothing but the sharp, angled metal of support beams and half-completed armor plating. The ship lies east, though there’s nothing to climb inside of... yet. "

rows.original: The ship itself lies in the former direction, majestic and gleaming, its aerodynamic curves suggesting equal ease among stars or cloudy skies.
rows.translation: 飞船本身位于前一个方向，威严而闪亮，符合空气动力学的曲线似乎在群星与云层中都能同样自如。
rows.raw: " The ship itself lies in the former direction, majestic and gleaming, its aerodynamic curves suggesting equal ease among stars or cloudy skies. "

rows.original: The other direction leads back to the wider catwalks above Zhèng Shi’s foundry.
rows.translation: 另一个方向通回郑石铸造层上方更宽的走道。
rows.raw: "The other direction leads back to the wider catwalks above Zhèng Shi’s foundry."

rows.original: The catwalk terminates at a large gap between you and the new Sidewinder’s frame. When it’s complete, the gleaming hull will connect nicely with the catwalk’s six inches of rubberized padding. There’s nothing to do but go back.
rows.translation: 走道终止于你与新响尾蛇号框架之间的一道巨大缺口。完工后，闪亮船体会与走道六英寸厚的橡胶缓冲垫完美接合。 你只能原路返回。
rows.raw: "The catwalk terminates at a large gap between you and the new Sidewinder’s frame. When it’s complete, the gleaming hull will connect nicely with the catwalk’s six inches of rubberized padding.\n\nThere’s nothing to do but go back."

rows.original: The catwalk terminates at the Sidewinder’s side, buffered by the six inches of rubberized padding, squished tight against the gleaming hull. A squarish seam, roughly eight feet high, provides graciously accommodating entry to the craft, assuming you can work the transparent aluminum touchscreen and card reader to get inside.
rows.translation: 走道终止于响尾蛇号侧面，六英寸厚的橡胶缓冲垫被紧紧压在闪亮船体上。一道约八英尺高的方形接缝提供了宽敞入口，前提是你能操作透明铝触摸屏和读卡器进入。
rows.raw: "The catwalk terminates at the Sidewinder’s side, buffered by the six inches of rubberized padding, squished tight against the gleaming hull. A squarish seam, roughly eight feet high, provides graciously accommodating entry to the craft, assuming you can work the transparent aluminum touchscreen and card reader to get inside."

rows.original:
A large corridor connects the hangar bay to the deeper sections of the base. It looks like part of one of the old Steele Tech foundries that Dad used to make you tour: there are pipes and cables bolted up against the wall, leaking oil and hot water down the metal walls.

To the west is a door labeled “Chief Mechanic’s Office,” though somebody long ago spray painted “Artificer” over “Mechanic”.
rows.translation:
一条宽阔走廊连接机库与基地深处。这里看起来像父亲以前强迫你参观的斯蒂尔科技铸造厂一部分：管道和线缆固定在墙上，向金属墙面泄漏机油与热水。

西边一扇门标着‘首席机械师办公室’，不过很久以前有人用喷漆在‘机械师’上覆盖了‘巧匠’。

rows.original: Surprisingly, this office is unlocked. You can see why after a few seconds inside: everything is locked down. Tools hang from a mag-wall with the power locked at its maximum setting. You’d need power armor to pry one off without the pass-code. Dozens of safes are stacked in the corner. Some bear the typical height and heft of a gun locker, while others are clearly meant to secure small valuables like jewelry. A beat-up looking computer terminal with a classical, mechanical keyboard hums quietly on the desk, bolted in place.
rows.translation: 出人意料的是，这间办公室没有上锁。进去几秒后你便明白原因：所有东西都锁得严严实实。工具挂在磁力墙上，功率锁定在最大值。没有密码，哪怕穿动力装甲也很难撬下一件。几十个保险箱堆在角落，有些具备枪柜常见的高度和重量，有些显然用于保存珠宝等小件贵重物品。桌上放着一台外观破旧、配有传统机械键盘的电脑终端，低声嗡鸣，并被固定在原位。

rows.original: It’s clear that you’ve left the part of the station meant for its pirate patrons, and entered something darker. To the east is a solid, heavy door that can only be bolted from the outside - there’s no locking mechanism on this side, and the solid walls have been replaced by bare rock that’s hot to the touch. There are iron rings bolted into the wall at every 10-yard interval, presumably for emergency ropes to hook on, but you see heavy iron chains hanging from several of them as well...
rows.translation: 很明显，你已经离开空间站供海盗顾客使用的区域，进入更黑暗的地方。东边是一扇厚重坚固的门，只能从外侧闩上，这一边没有锁定机构；坚实墙壁也被触手发烫的裸岩取代。墙上每隔十码就固定着一个铁环，想必供紧急绳索挂接，可其中几个还垂着沉重铁链...

The mineshaft continues in straight lines to the north and east for as far as you can see.
rows.translation: 前方的大弯道让本就昏暗的隧道能见度变得更差。快速查看终端后，你确认开凿岩石的人非常注重细节，这几乎是个完美的九十度转弯。矿道从此处向北和向东笔直延伸，一眼望不到尽头。
rows.raw: "The sweeping bend ahead reduces visibility within the already poorly lit tunnel even further. A quick look at your Codex confirms that whoever carved out the stone did it with an eye for detail; it’s a nearly perfect 90 degree bend. The mineshaft continues in straight lines to the north and east for as far as you can see."

rows.original: Writhing through the stone like some kind of subterranean snake, the mines of Zhèng Shi bend east and south from this point. There are fewer reinforcements and slave restraints in this segment than elsewhere, and the walls are less marked by hand tools. A single, swaying overhead electro-lamp is the only source of illumination, when it isn’t flickering like a flame in the wind.
rows.translation: 郑石的矿井像某种地下巨蛇般穿行岩层，在这里向东、向南弯曲。这一段的支架与奴隶束具比别处少，墙上也较少留下手工具痕迹。唯一的照明来自一盏摇摆的顶部电灯——前提是它没有像风中火焰般闪烁。

rows.original: You stand in a cocoon of rigid, unfeeling darkness. There is nothing to light up this dank, fetid corner of the mine, nothing to brighten your mood in the slightest. There are only walls of solid shadow and the palpable sense that nothing good ever happened in this place. Your Codex confirms: there aren’t any valuable resources to be had either. No wonder they stopped digging this way.
rows.translation: 你站在僵硬、冷漠的黑暗茧壳中。这里没有任何东西照亮矿井阴湿恶臭的角落，也没有什么能稍稍提振心情。只有凝固阴影般的墙壁，以及一种清晰得仿佛可触的感觉：这里从未发生过好事。宝典还确认，这里同样没有值得开采的资源。难怪他们不再往这个方向挖。

rows.original: Twisting 90 degrees on an east-south bend, this tunnel follows an eerily programmatic path through the asteroid core of Zhèng Shi. Metal braces are anchored deep in the walls keep the cracked stone in place. The striated black-on-black walls glitter here and there with hidden treasures yet to be extracted. Elsewhere, crude holes reveal where valuable seams have already been carved out.
rows.translation: 隧道沿东西至南面的九十度弯角转折，以诡异而程式化的路线穿过郑石的小行星核心。金属支架深深锚入墙内，固定住开裂岩石。层叠的黑中带黑墙面偶尔闪出尚待开采的隐秘珍宝，别处的粗陋洞孔则暴露出贵重矿脉已被掏走的位置。

rows.translation: 你小心迈步。地板有些地方比别处更热，热到无法忍受；汗水滴下去都会冒出蒸汽。石料中隐约闪着贵重矿物，不过从碎石与墙上的大洞判断，许多已经被采走。

rows.original: Unearthly groans reverberate from the jagged onyx walls as this chunk of floating once-planet struggles to stay together after being blasted in space. Doubtless the tunnels the pirates are carving through it aren’t exactly contributing to its structural stability. Fortunately there are metal bands encircling the shaft, bracing it on all sides. There probably ought to be more of them, but they seem stable enough... for now.
rows.translation: 诡异呻吟在锯齿状缟玛瑙墙间回荡。这块漂浮的昔日行星在太空中遭到炸裂后，正艰难维持整体，海盗挖出的隧道无疑也无助于结构稳定。好在金属带环绕矿道，从各面加以支撑。这里本该再多装一些，但目前看来还算稳固...暂时如此。

rows.original: Foul-smelling gouts of steam issue forth from tiny fissures in the wall. They burst out in fits and starts without any rhythm, the result of geological processes run amok. Rich veins of glittering minerals remain unmined, protected by the boiling-hot bursts. No wonder the shaft bends south and west from here, away from the worst eruptions.
rows.translation: 恶臭蒸汽从墙上的细小裂隙喷出，毫无规律地时断时续，是失控地质过程的产物。闪亮矿物的富集矿脉尚未开采，受沸腾热浪保护。难怪矿道从这里向南、向西弯去，避开最猛烈的喷发区。

rows.original: Uncomfortable heat and bleak surroundings are the rule of the day. Flickering lights in the ceiling do a less than adequate job of illuminating the craggy surroundings. The walls hurt to touch, so hot remaining in contact for more than a handful of seconds would leave you with a handful of first degree burns. Bits of broken rock litter the floor, leftover from the efforts of slave miners and robots. Twinkling spots mark minute deposits of ores and gemstones too small to be worth harvesting.
rows.translation: 令人难受的热度和阴郁环境成了这里的常态。天花板上的闪烁灯光根本不足以照亮嶙峋四周。墙壁烫得无法触碰，接触超过几秒就会留下一把一级灼伤。地上散落着奴隶矿工与机器人留下的碎石，点点微光则标出小到不值得收集的矿石和宝石沉积。

rows.original: The radiation detector in your Codex buzzes with alerts. This tunnel isn’t just warm - it’s radioactive! What you’re seeing onscreen isn’t anywhere near lethal. Apparently your immune system can keep up with most of it, so long as you don’t linger overlong. Hanging around in a place like this for a while would undoubtedly leave a little taint in your system. You’re lucky to have blood swimming with prototype-tier medical technology. The radiation fades to the west.
rows.translation: 宝典中的辐射探测器不断报警。这条隧道不只温暖，还带有放射性！屏幕显示剂量远未致命，只要不逗留过久，你的免疫系统就能应付大部分辐射。但在这种地方待上一阵，无疑会让体内增加些许污化。幸好你的血液中流淌着原型级医疗科技。向西走，辐射会减弱。

rows.original: Buzzing, blaring alerts from your Codex scream out that you’re standing in a radioactive area. The screen relays that you’re not in immediate danger - unless you hang out here for quite a while. Your augmented immune system is actively defending you from the worst radioactive depredations. Still, sticking around is a guaranteed way to wind up hobbled by genetic taint. If you’re going to frag up your genome as badly as Dad did, you might as well have fun doing it. There’s less radiation to the east.
rows.translation: 宝典发出嗡鸣和刺耳警报，宣告你正站在放射区。屏幕显示你并无即时危险，除非在这里待上很久。强化免疫系统正主动抵御最严重的辐射侵害，但继续逗留必然会让基因组受污化拖累。既然要像老爸一样把基因搞得一团糟，至少也该用好玩的方式。东边的辐射较弱。

rows.original: Three shafts bore through the sable stone of Zhèng Shi Station: one to the east, into mineral rich tunnels. The air seems cooler there. Another leads south along a square-hewn passage. The last stretches west. Acrid, too-warm currents blow in from that directions. It’s bound to be an uncomfortable path.
rows.translation: 三条矿道钻过郑石空间站的乌黑岩石：一条向东通往矿藏丰富的隧道，那边空气似乎更凉；另一条沿方正开凿的通道向南；最后一条向西延伸，刺鼻而过热的气流正从那里吹来，注定是一条难受的路。

rows.original: Carved from the ebon stone of Zhèng Shi, or what’s left of it at any rate, this tunnel is bored in a completely square shape. Extra braces line the walls for stability; an arching roof would’ve been a far more structurally sound choice. Chains and restraints hang from some of them as an afterthought. Barely any holes have been dug into the walls, though you don’t see much worth digging for either.
rows.translation: 这条隧道开凿于郑石的乌黑岩体——至少是它剩下的部分——并被完全钻成方形。墙壁排着额外支架以求稳定，尽管拱顶在结构上显然更合理。有些支架后来又挂上锁链和束具。墙上几乎没有挖孔，不过你也看不出有什么值得挖。

rows.original: The sharp-cornered mineshaft takes an even sharper corner to the east and north. The floor is clean of debris and detritus. Rigid metal supports post every few feet to brace the ceiling, lest it all come tumbling down on your head. Scans report that this region is relatively low in high-value metals and gems, though the ink-black rock itself is quite dense and prized for construction and ornamentation.
rows.translation: 棱角分明的矿道在此更加急剧地转向东、北。地面没有碎屑与垃圾，坚固金属支柱每隔几英尺便撑住洞顶，以免一切砸落头上。扫描显示，这片区域的高价值金属与宝石较少，不过墨黑岩石本身密度很高，在建筑和装饰领域颇受珍视。

The floor seems clear of debris, and the walls are smooth and straight enough to track without issue. Lucky you.

rows.original: An autonomous robot stands next to an enormous pile of rubble, sorting pieces out and placing them into differently colored hoppers. When one is full, it places it on a track in the ceiling to be whisked away toward the refinery. For better or worse, it displays no response to your presence. A square tunnel burrows north through the rock, while the western passage follows the whirring carts toward their destination. The south mineshaft is something different. You can hear heavy equipment in active use, and the number of available restraints seems much greater than elsewhere.
rows.translation: 一台自动机器人站在巨大的瓦砾堆旁，将碎块分拣进不同颜色的料斗。某个料斗装满后，它便挂上天花板轨道，送往精炼厂。无论好坏，它对你的出现毫无反应。一条方形隧道向北钻入岩层，西侧通道则随嗡鸣料车通往目的地。南边矿道有所不同：那里传来重型设备运转声，束具数量也远多于其他地方。

rows.original: The ground cracks and crumbles with your every movement. The porous stone reveals itself as the reason; every surface is made of it - walls, floors, and ceilings. It vaguely resembles pumice save for its slightly more reflective sheen. You’re thankful that the ceiling braces are stacked three times thicker than elsewhere, though they fail to keep the occasional pebble from dropping on your head.
rows.translation: 你每走一步，地面都会开裂崩碎。原因在于多孔岩石，墙、地板、天花板全由它构成。它隐约像浮石，只是光泽更强。你很庆幸天花板支架比别处厚了三倍，尽管仍挡不住偶尔有小石子掉到头上。

In one place, a blackened version of yourself seems half as tall and twice as fat. In another, your head is larger than the rest of your body. Fortunately the ceiling-bound track continues straight and true on its east-west path.
rows.translation: 暗色岩石在几英尺范围内变成玻璃般的黑曜石。矿道笔直穿过火山材料，将其震碎成锯齿状哈哈镜阵列。一个倒影里的你只有一半高、两倍胖；另一个倒影中，你的头比身体其他部分还大。好在顶置轨道仍笔直沿东西方向延伸。

rows.original: Just above your head, a ceiling mounted track bends upward to climb through a narrow tunnel in the stone. Fast moving hoppers, packed with stone, zip along the mechanized path before vanishing into the hole, presumably on their way to the refinery. You briefly entertain the idea of grabbing hold of one to ride up, but that hole is awfully small (and those carts are moving devilishly fast). Besides, the last thing you want to experience is being dumped face-first into an industrial blast-furnace.
rows.translation: 头顶不远处，顶置轨道向上弯入岩石中的狭窄隧道。装满石料的高速料斗沿机械路径飞驰，随后消失在洞中，大概正送往精炼厂。你短暂考虑抓住一辆搭便车，但洞口实在太小，料车也快得要命。况且你最不想体验的就是脸朝下被倒进工业高炉。
rows.raw: "Just above your head, a ceiling mounted track bends upward to climb through a narrow tunnel in the stone. Fast moving hoppers, packed with stone, zip along the mechanized path before vanishing into the hole, presumably on their way to the refinery. You briefly entertain the idea of grabbing hold of one to ride up, but that hole is awfully small (and those carts are moving devilishly fast). Besides, the last thing you want to experience is being dumped face-first into an industrial blast-furnace."

rows.original: Untapped riches of every type and color cast a disco-like rainbow of dancing luminance over this section of the mine. Not yet mined out, Zhèng Shi’s mineral wealth is laid bare. A skilled mining crew could make a tidy profit with a few days in this locale. No doubt the pirates are intent on doing the same. West of here, the mineshaft is far more thoroughly excavated. More precious stones lie to the east.
rows.translation: 各种颜色、各种类型的未开发财富在矿井中投下迪斯科般跃动的彩虹光。这片区域尚未采尽，郑石的矿产财富一览无遗。熟练矿队在这里干上几天就能赚得盆满钵满，海盗无疑也有此打算。西侧矿道挖掘得更彻底，东面则还有更多宝石。

rows.original: The tunnel takes a sharp corner to the north and west, blazing a trail through hot black stone and shining gems alike. Buzzing fluorescent lamps set the half-buried gemstones into blazing, multicolored coronas. It’d be a hell of a place for a rave.

You kick aside a bit of loose gravel and consider your options: a bend to the north or chasing this red-hued shaft south.

You bat away a dangling chain, glad you won’t be tied to the end of it any time soon (you hope!) and consider your options. The tunnel works north through heavy geddanium deposits and east toward the firm, comforting metal of an airlock.

A transparent aluminum window offers a look inside, but it’s mostly empty. There are some old spacesuits hanging from racks, and the outer door is currently sealed. You should be able to walk right in, if you wish.

rows.original: You’re standing in the body of a large, all-metal airlock. It looks like it’s hundreds of years old -- probably salvaged from an old free trader ship, if you had to guess -- but the doors are solid enough, and only seal and open from the inside. No chance of getting trapped in here, at least. Out the small window set into the east door, you can see the endless expanse of space dotted white by stars without number; you can also just make out a metal walkway bolted onto the side of the asteroid, hugging the craggy rock face.
rows.translation: 你站在一座大型全金属气闸中。它看起来已有数百年历史——若要猜测，大概是从某艘旧自由贸易船上回收的——不过舱门足够结实，而且只能从内部密封和开启，至少不会把人困住。东门的小窗外是点缀无数白色星光的无垠太空；你还依稀看见一条金属栈道固定在小行星侧面，紧贴嶙峋岩壁。

rows.original: The tunnel twists and curves irregularly around solid geddanium obstructions, too hard for most tools and too large to be dug out without significant effort. To the north, you can make out the smooth metal and gleaming, rubberized seal of an embedded airlock. To the west, the mine continues straight for a bit, weaving through restraints and more red-lined stone.

The choices pieces have already been extracted, leaving huge gaps in every direction. You can follow the mine east and west.

Five metal braces have been erected just to keep it from collapsing, yet the dribbles of dust that routinely trickle down from the ceiling leave you feeling less than confident. It might be best to strike off to the north or east in a hurry. No wonder the walls are untouched by pick and torch alike!
rows.translation: 隧道转弯尖锐，更重要的是，它穿过不稳定岩层。五根金属支架仅为防止这里塌陷而竖起，但天花板经常淌落的细尘仍让你缺乏信心。最好赶紧向北或向东离开。难怪镐子和火炬都没在墙上留下痕迹！

rows.original: Burrowing deep into the shattered planetoid that comprises Zhèng Shi, the mineshaft reveals a treasure of mineral wealth. The walls are thick with it. Gleaming gemstones, oxidized iron, and even the yellowish shine of naturally occurring copper are all present. Scarlet lines of geddanium deposits promise an even greater wealth, if you came back with the tools and times to slowly extract it. The mineshaft hits a corner to the south but continues north in a straight line.
rows.translation: 矿道深深钻入组成郑石的破碎微行星，显露出丰厚矿产。墙上到处都是矿物：闪耀宝石、氧化铁，甚至还有天然铜的黄光。猩红格达尼姆矿线预示更大财富，只要你带着工具并花时间慢慢开采。矿道向南遇到拐角，向北则笔直延伸。

rows.original: A reflection on the surface of a puddle catches your eye just before you can step into it, and with a single glance you identify it for what it is: puddled, liquid sex. More than one sexual tryst has occurred here, and the results collected into the chamber’s lowest point. Whether slaves were sneaking off to blow off steam or cruel overseers taking advantage, you aren’t sure. One thing you do know is that there’s active mining to the north and quite a few glittering gems to the south.
rows.translation: 水洼表面的倒影在你踩进去前吸引了注意。只看一眼，你就认出那是什么：积成水洼的性爱体液。这里发生过不止一次性事，结果全汇入洞室最低处。你不确定是奴隶偷偷来释放压力，还是残酷监工趁机占便宜。你只知道北面正在采矿，南面则闪着不少宝石。

rows.original: You stand at the sharp edge between two styles of construction. One is all smooth white walls. It’s the sort of prefabricated hallway you’d expect to see in any quick-deployed colony or auto-assembled station. The other is all stone and powdered gravel, covered with cheap steel grating. The sharp scent of ionized metal and crude industry drifts in from that direction, to the north. A little ways into the civilized southern segment, you spot a T-intersection. Things open up a bit in the opposite direction.
rows.translation: 你站在两种建筑风格的明确分界线上。一边全是光滑白墙，属于任何快速部署殖民地或自动组装空间站都会采用的预制走廊；另一边尽是岩石和碎砾，覆盖廉价钢格板。离子化金属与粗陋工业的刺鼻气味从北边吹来。较文明的南段不远处有一个T字路口，反方向则稍微开阔一些。

rows.original: Nearly identical tunnels stretch north, east, and west from here. The north one is the most distinct: it ends sharply, giving way to a natural cavern and the smoky glow of primitive industrial smelters. The other two passages are trickier. Both are lined with mass produced doorways into various research chambers and breakrooms,the only difference in the pattern of their positioning. Either direction seems equally fine.
rows.translation: 几乎一模一样的隧道从这里向北、东、西延伸。北边最有特色：它突然终止，接上一座天然洞窟和原始工业熔炉的烟火光。另两条通道更难区分，都排列着通往研究室和休息室的量产门框，仅位置模式有所不同。走哪边似乎都可以。

rows.original: A clean, well-maintained doorway presents you with the opportunity to explore the pirate’s circuit lab. You know this because it’s written plainly on a designation plate. The lock is disabled at a hardware label such that anyone could stride right in. It speaks to the level of discipline - or fear - in the station that electronic equipment would be left so brazenly unguarded. You could check it out, if you’re quick. The hallway goes a bit farther east but much farther west.
rows.translation: 一扇干净、保养良好的门让你有机会探索海盗的电路实验室——铭牌上就清楚写着。门锁从硬件层面被禁用，任何人都能直接走入。电子设备竟如此明目张胆地无人看守，足见空间站纪律严明，或人人心怀恐惧。动作够快的话，你可以进去看看。走廊向东延伸一小段，向西则长得多。

rows.original: After landing in the chaotic industrial hangar and making your way up from the mining levels, this part of Zhèng Shi delightfully civilized. The hallway is clean and well lit, if a bit antiseptic. Air scrubbers in the ceiling purge the worst industrial contaminants from your awareness, and the floor has a freshly-waxed feel to it. In either direction, there are doorways to different labs. The southwestern one says something about circuits, and you’re pretty sure you see “robot” on the northeastern placard.
rows.translation: 从混乱的工业机库着陆并穿过采矿层后，郑石的这一部分显得文明得令人欣喜。走廊干净明亮，只是略显无菌。天花板空气洗涤器清除了大部分工业污染物，地板也像刚打过蜡。两边都有通往不同实验室的门。西南门牌似乎写着电路，东北门牌上则大概有“机器人”几个字。

rows.original: The inside of the robotics lab is an engineer’s wet dream. Everywhere you look, there’s innumerable high-tech robotics treasures. Diagnostic stations, sim rigs - you name it, and you can find it somewhere in this sprawling lab. The closest piece of mechanical gear is a high-grade assembly frame. Made from modularized titanium with adjustable armatures, it’s exactly what you would want handy if you were welding together a six-armed, four legged industrial mining machine. The lab stretches north and west, but you can duck out the door to the south.
rows.translation: 机器人实验室内部堪称工程师的春梦。放眼皆是数不尽的高科技机器人宝藏：诊断站、模拟装置，应有尽有。最近的机械设备是一台高级装配架，由模块化钛金属和可调支臂制成，正适合焊接六臂四足的工业采矿机。实验室向北、向西延伸，南边的门可以离开。

rows.original: An L-shaped desk supports four holo-screens linked up to a hardlight keypad. The information displays all seem to be diagnostic in nature: V.I. core crash dumps, maintenance logs, and the like. A spiderweb of cables dangles from the bottom. Every possible type of physical connector is represented: coaxial universal connection cables, flash umbilical cords, and hundreds of others. If there’s a robot built in the last century, this workstation could connect to it. The robotics lab extends to the south and west.
rows.translation: 一张L形桌支撑着四块连接硬光键盘的全息屏。显示内容似乎都是诊断信息：虚拟智能核心崩溃转储、维护日志等等。蛛网般的电缆从桌底垂下，各种实体接头一应俱全，包括同轴通用连接线、闪存脐带线以及数百种其他规格。过去一百年制造的任何机器人，这座工作站大概都能连接。机器人实验室向南、向西延伸。

You could probably put together your own little mining ‘bot with everything here, if you had time to waste and a willingness to do so. Plasma torches and millimeter-specific self-adjusting wrenches dangle on cables overhead for easy access during work. The lab continues to the east and south.

rows.original: This mess of cables and cobbled together workstations confuses you at first, but after a few minutes scanning the hardware, you manage to put together its purpose. This is a simulation rig. Cables can be jacked into a robot’s various inputs and outputs, replacing things like vision with computer-simulated falsities while locomotion is hijacked to route a into virtual control input. It’s the perfect way to test a robot’s programming without giving it a chance to damage anyone or anything. The lab continues to the north and east.
rows.translation: 这团电缆和拼凑工作站起初令你困惑，但扫描硬件几分钟后，你弄清了用途：这是一套模拟装置。线缆可接入机器人的各种输入输出，用电脑模拟假象取代视觉，并劫持运动系统，将动作送入虚拟控制输入。这样便能测试机器人程序，而不给它破坏人或物的机会。实验室继续向北、向东。

rows.original: This circuit lab is an absolute hodgepodge of high technology and placed with almost intentional randomness. A Steele Tech laboratory would be arranged to provide an optimal workflow for the scientists it employed, but the poor saps stuck working here are saddled with narrow gaps between equipment and wide-open clearings of empty flooring. One of the brighter scallywags must have had the idea to put the control software near the door at least. A wide desk with a dozen different monitors offers minute control over the fabs manufacturing machinery, though at the moment a hardware error has the 3D nanoprinter shuttered.
rows.translation: 这间电路实验室是高科技设备的大杂烩，摆放得近乎故意杂乱。斯蒂尔科技实验室会按最佳工作流程布置，但困在这里的可怜虫却只能在设备间狭窄缝隙和空旷地面间工作。至少某个聪明海盗想到把控制软件放在门边。宽桌上的十几块显示器可精细控制制造机械，不过硬件故障目前让3D纳米打印机停机。

rows.original: A top of the line 3D nanoprinter rests at a cockeyed angle relative to everything else in the room, like it was too heavy to bother straightening once it was put down. A small hardlight diagnostic panel informs you that it’s currently shut down for maintenance due to a jam, and you can’t actually see the output tray from here to get a look at problem. One thing is for sure - this is a top-of-the-line piece of tech that shouldn’t be crammed into a place like this. Somebody must have had a delivery go missing. The printer’s bulk stretches south, if you want to circle that way for a look at the issue.
rows.translation: 一台顶级3D纳米打印机歪斜地摆在房间里，仿佛放下后太重，没人愿意扶正。小型硬光诊断面板显示设备因卡住而停机维护，从这里又看不到输出托盘，无法查看问题。可以肯定，这是不该挤在这种地方的顶尖科技，某人的货运大概“失踪”了。打印机机身向南延伸，你可以绕过去看看故障。

rows.original:
Crates of various print-feeding materials sit upon one another in a concentrated pile of unstable potential energy. A box of lead is perched on the very top of the thing, ready to add a crushed skull to what is undoubtedly a long list of workplace injuries. Others aren’t even labeled, but you’re pretty sure you see lithium, gold, silicon, and more plastics than you can count. One such box is popped open to reveal a looping coil of raw material, connected to a port on the side of the box. Apparently they plug right into the printer.

You could steal one if you felt like lugging a heavy box the whole way back to your ship for a pittance of credits. It would be a total waste of time. You’d be better off digging in the mines.
rows.translation:
各种打印原料箱层层堆成一座蕴含不稳定势能的小山，最顶端甚至放着一箱铅，随时可能给漫长的工伤记录再添一颗压扁的脑袋。其他箱子连标签都没有，不过你认得锂、黄金、硅，以及多得数不清的塑料。其中一箱敞开，露出成卷原料，并接到箱侧端口上，看来可以直接插入打印机。

如果愿意为少量信用点一路把沉重箱子拖回飞船，你可以偷走一箱，但这完全浪费时间，还不如去矿井挖矿。

rows.original:
A set of cheap plastoboard walls make a poor attempt at isolating this secluded corner from the rest of the circuit lab. If they were another two feet tall it might work. You look back to the heavy, concrete-topped workbench. It’s carbon scored in dozens of places. Robotic arms hang limply above it, tipped with plasma torches, soldering irons, and six different kinds of illumination bulbs. The precision these tools offer would be nothing without the eight-lensed magnification rig that stands to the side, waiting to pulled over for a closer look... at the empty workbench.

Maybe the pirates have finished whatever they were doing here.
rows.translation:
一组廉价塑料板墙徒劳地试图将这个角落与电路实验室其他区域隔开；如果再高两英尺，或许真能奏效。你回头看向沉重的混凝土台面工作台，上面有几十处碳化痕迹。机器人手臂无力地垂在上方，末端装着等离子焊枪、烙铁和六种照明灯泡。若没有旁边待命的八镜片放大装置，这些工具的精度也毫无意义；它可以拉过来仔细观察...空荡荡的工作台。

也许海盗已经完成了他们在这里的工作。

You look back to the heavy, concrete-topped workbench. It’s carbon scored in dozens of places. Robotic arms hang limply above it, tipped with plasma torches, soldering irons, and six different kinds of illumination bulbs. The precision these tools offer would be nothing without the eight-lensed magnification rig that stands to the side, waiting to pulled over for a closer look... at the empty workbench.\n\nMaybe the pirates have finished whatever they were doing here."
