rows.original: A small bench, all of 18 inches off the floor, houses the discarded remains of a once-expensive A.I. core. Now rendered into a hundred laser-cut slices, it’s been tossed down like garbage. It looks smooth, shiny metal interspersed with a thick gel layer, but the density on display is here is unlike anything you remember from the textbooks in school. Whole, it would be worth a fortune - maybe even able to support multiple A.I.s at once. Now it’s little more than a sacrifice to the gods of reverse engineering.
rows.translation: 离地仅十八英寸的小工作台上放着一枚曾经昂贵的人工智能核心残骸，如今已被激光切成上百片，像垃圾般丢下。它看起来由光滑亮泽的金属与厚凝胶层交错构成，密度却远超你在学校教科书里见过的任何东西。完整时必定价值连城，甚至能同时承载多个强人工智能；现在却只是一件献给逆向工程诸神的祭品。

rows.original: Software Development is a maze of bolted-together plastoboard made filthy by coffee stains nobody could be bothered to clean up. To the south there is a bit of a crossroads, complete with a cargo lift.
rows.translation: 重型机械、烟灰和震耳欲聋的喧嚣是这里的常态。工业设备从东西两侧围住你，把原矿锤成易于筛分的粉尘。上方，沉重陶瓷桶在前往或离开顶部熔炉的路上缓慢碰响，灼热得白炽发光。南边有个小十字路口，还有一台货运升降机。

A glance at the source is enough to make your eyes sizzle like fried eggs on the griddle, and you look away before you do some permanent damage."

rows.original: Climbing up the cave wall like an enormous worm, a metal ladder reaches for the suspended scaffold above. Bolts the size of baseballs anchor it into the stone such that it doesn’t budge in the slightest when you give a rung a tug. You’re confident it would support your weight. Clanging forgehammers and the simmering heat of the smelter’s plasma torches compete to annoy you as you consider your more ground-bound options: paths around the machines to the south and west.
rows.translation: 一架金属梯如巨虫般爬上洞壁，伸向上方悬空脚手架。棒球大小的螺栓把它固定在岩石中，你拉了拉横档，它纹丝不动。你相信它能承受自己的重量。锻锤的铿锵和熔炼炉等离子焊枪的闷热争相折磨你，同时你考虑更贴地的选择：绕机器向南或向西。

rows.original: Stifling heat washes your way from the machinery to the south, and you briefly find yourself wondering if there’s any part of this station that comes with air conditioning. The orange glow of molten metal bathes the northern wall, interrupted with bursts of staccato blue from the nearby precision-welders. The metal-shod path continues east and west. You spy an enormous ladder a little further east that could be used to climb out of here and into the scaffolds high above - perhaps even to the ship suspended there.
rows.translation: 南边机械送来的窒息热浪扑面而来，你短暂怀疑这座空间站是否有任何区域配备空调。熔融金属的橙光照亮北墙，又被附近精密焊机迸发的断续蓝光打断。金属覆盖的路径继续向东、向西。更东边有一架巨梯，可爬到高处脚手架，甚至抵达悬挂在那里的飞船。

rows.original: Rising out of the pit to is an enormous sorting engine, there to separate the hardest to isolate materials - the stuff the mining elevators and their various funnels and hoppers couldn’t split into pure streams. It rumbles and whirs. From time to time, it belches a loaded hopper out of its top into the overhead rail system for purification. To the east, things a get a bit hotter; the smelters, forges, and automated fabricators are that way. To the west is a ladder and a bend around the pit.
rows.translation: 一台巨大分拣机从坑中升起，负责分离最难提纯的材料，也就是采矿升降机及其漏斗、料斗无法拆分成纯净物流的东西。它隆隆作响，偶尔从顶部吐出装满的料斗，送入高架轨道系统净化。东边更热，是熔炼炉、锻炉和自动制造机所在；西边则有梯子和绕过地坑的弯路。

rows.original:
Overhead rails obstruct your view of the ship above like rusty metal window blinds, and from time to time, containers full of raw ore or liquid metal slide along on one of them, casting you in shade. Everything is automated. No pirates man control stations. If you didn’t see the occasional security-minded patrol or Corona Lord overseer, you could almost mistake this pirate base for an AI-controlled factory.

All this, just to build one ship...
rows.translation:
高架轨道像生锈金属百叶窗般遮挡你看向上方飞船的视线，装满原矿或液态金属的容器不时从其中一条轨道滑过，在你身上投下阴影。一切都已自动化，没有海盗值守控制站。若不是偶尔看见重视安保的巡逻队或电晕领主监工，你几乎会把这座海盗基地误认为人工智能控制的工厂。

这一切，只为建造一艘船...

rows.original: Conveyor belts full of crushed rocks and glittering gems rise from the pit to the east, but they do more than that. Their shuddering motion is actually sifting apart the assembled ores as they rise upward. At their peaks, they funnel into other machines to be further sorted. Some are dumped into enormous crucibles. Others spill into waiting bins of sparkling treasure. You can’t reach any of it, but the path you’re on continues north and south.
rows.translation: 装满碎石和闪耀宝石的传送带从东侧地坑升起，但它们不只负责运输；抖动本身就在上升时筛分混杂矿石。抵达顶端后，矿物会流入其他机器进一步分拣。一些被倒进巨大坩埚，另一些落入盛满闪亮宝藏的容器。你拿不到任何东西，不过脚下路径继续向北、向南。

rows.original:
The rumbling clatter of heavy industry is omnipresent, reverberating through the harsh metal deckplates like the bass at an indoor concert. Ramshackle railings insulate you from a pit to the northeast - the source of much of the noise. Walls of stone hem you in to the west and south, but those same rattling deckplates that you stand upon trail north and east. Of course, a ship hangs high above, surrounded by scaffolds.

There look to be ladders leading up to it to the distant north.
rows.translation:
重工业的轰鸣碰撞声无处不在，像室内演唱会的低音般在粗糙金属甲板中回荡。简陋栏杆把你与东北面的地坑隔开，那里正是大部分噪音的来源。西面和南面受石墙限制，不过脚下同样震动的甲板向北、向东延伸。高处当然还悬着一艘被脚手架包围的飞船。

远处北面似乎有梯子可以爬上去。

rows.original: Bristling from the heat, you stride between the carbon-charred machinery to the east and the whirring, churning mining transport to the west. Above, a system of rails shifts the raw ores, smelted metals, and fabricated pieces to their various destinations with robotic efficiency. A T-intersection lies south.
rows.translation: 热气令你汗毛竖起。你走在东侧碳化机械与西侧嗡鸣翻搅的矿运设备之间。上方轨道系统以机器人般的效率，把原矿、熔炼金属和制成部件送往各自目的地。南面有一个T字路口。

rows.original: Bits of once-molten metal are splattered all over the diamond-patterned deckplates, rendering them nearly as spotty as a Dalmatian’s hide. Though long cooled, you move with caution, scanning your eyes back and forth until you spot the source: a cracked cauldron. Rather than repairing or replacing it, it’s burners have simply been shut off. At least it’s no longer a danger. This path continues north to the edge of the cavernous forge deck and south back toward the cargo elevator at its center.
rows.translation: 曾经熔融的金属碎块溅满菱形纹甲板，让它斑驳得几乎像达尔马提亚犬皮毛。尽管早已冷却，你仍谨慎前进，来回扫视直到发现源头：一口开裂的大锅。他们没有维修或更换，只是关掉了燃烧器。至少它不再危险。这条路向北通往洞窟般锻造层边缘，向南则返回中央货运升降机。

rows.original: Small spacecraft flit in and out of this modest shuttle bay with alarming regularity, disgorging slaves, raw materials, and pirates who would rather fly than rely on something as old-fashioned as an elevator. No independent ships break up the steady flow. Everyone is affiliated with one of the major gangs: Jumpers, Cyber Punks, Corona Lords, Rat’s Raiders, or Star Vipers. You see them all in force. You doubt you’ll be able to land here or secure your own transport without belonging to one.
rows.translation: 小型飞船以惊人频率进出这座普通穿梭机库，卸下奴隶、原料和宁愿飞行也不坐老式升降机的海盗。没有独立飞船打断稳定流量，所有人都隶属五大帮派之一：跳帮者、赛博朋克、电晕领主、鼠帮劫匪或星蝰。五帮人马齐聚于此。若不属于其中之一，你大概无法在这里降落或取得交通工具。

rows.original: A warm pillar of acrid exhaust billows through the catwalk’s grating, diffuse enough so as not to sting the eyes but not nearly enough to be ignored. This place may taste like metal, but it is that very metal that built the craft you now walk around. Manufacturing is rarely clean. Pirate manufacturing never is.
rows.translation: 刺鼻废气形成温热气柱，从栈道格栅间升起。它已稀薄到不会刺痛眼睛，却远未淡到可以忽略。这里尝起来像金属，而正是这种金属造就了你正绕行的飞船。制造业很少干净，海盗制造业更从不干净。
rows.raw: "A warm pillar of acrid exhaust billows through the catwalk’s grating, diffuse enough so as not to sting the eyes but not nearly enough to be ignored. This place may taste like metal, but it is that very metal that built the craft you now walk around. Manufacturing is rarely clean. Pirate manufacturing never is."

rows.original: Creaking alarmingly, the metal catwalk momentarily spooks you into stepping back in a hurry. You gingerly test the suspended grating with a careful prod of your [pc.foot], then bust out laughing when you spot a sensor and discretely placed noisebox along the western edge. The local practical joker must be extremely proud of this little prank.
rows.translation: 金属栈道发出吓人嘎吱声，惊得你匆忙退后。你小心用[pc.foot]试探悬空格栅，随后看到西缘隐蔽布置的传感器与噪声盒，顿时大笑。本地恶作剧者一定为这个小把戏无比自豪。

rows.original: A short offshoot of scaffolding stretches east to the cavern wall to join a small white door, embedded into the rock itself. It’s of nicer make and design than much of the rest of the station. Whatever is on the other side must be important. Alternatively, you could prowl north and south on the catwalk beneath the shadow of this impressive ship.
rows.translation: 一小段脚手架向东伸到洞壁，与嵌入岩石的小白门相接。它的工艺设计优于空间站其他大部分区域，门后之物想必很重要。你也可以在这艘宏伟飞船的阴影下沿栈道向北或向南探查。

rows.original: Flitting drones fill the air with the chattering hums of old-style microjets and the off-tempo thrumming of poorly-maintained hovertech. They cluster and whir over the ship as luminous beams of energy sweep back and forth across it, scanning for the smallest, most minute defect. It’s quieter as you move along to either the north or south.
rows.translation: 飞舞无人机让空气充满老式微喷口的喋喋嗡鸣和保养不良悬浮科技的失拍震响。它们聚在飞船上方盘旋，明亮能量束来回扫过，寻找最细微的瑕疵。向北或向南走都会安静一些。

rows.original: A chunk of plastiboard hangs from one of the railings. On it is a picture of a cartoon cat of elaborate, eye-blinding design. A crudely painted word bubble next to it reads: “Let’s make this baby purr! I’m not kitten around!” Military-grade adhesive has it stuck in place. The scaffold is cleaner to the north and south.
rows.translation: 一块塑料板挂在栏杆上，上面画着设计繁复、刺眼的卡通猫。旁边粗糙气泡字写道：“让这宝贝呼噜起来！我可不是在说猫笑！”军用级黏合剂将其牢牢固定。南北两侧的脚手架更干净。

rows.original: Glossy red paint frosts a seven foot wide patch of the scaffold. The spill pattern seems indicative of a dropped paint bucket, but another appears a little further along. Beyond that is another small spot of crimson-coated metal. Either somebody on station bleeds the same color as the corvette, or a few rebellious workers had a paint fight. Less stained catwalks flee into the distance to the north and south.
rows.translation: 亮红油漆覆盖脚手架上七英尺宽的一片。泼洒形状像是有人摔了漆桶，但前方又出现一处，再往后还有一小块猩红金属。要么空间站某人流着和护卫舰同色的血，要么几个叛逆工人打过油漆仗。污渍较少的栈道向南北远处延伸。

rows.original:
This east-west pathway would shine like pure, luminous gold if it wasn’t dirtied and scuffed by hundreds of pirate feet or littered with wrappers for everything from candy to drugs to condoms. Crude graffiti decorates the wall to the north, depicting the words “Star Vipers” in bombastic neon lettering. Underneath are crude likenesses of mice and bunnies with ‘x’s for eyes, something passing Jumpers and Rat’s Raiders don’t seem to appreciate very much.

The bottom of the cargo elevator’s shaft lies a short distance to the west, should you wish to travel to another deck.
rows.translation:
若非数百双海盗脚踩出的污痕，以及糖果、毒品、避孕套等各种包装垃圾，这条东西通道本会像纯金般发光。北墙的粗陋涂鸦以夸张霓虹字写着“星蝰”，下方画着眼睛打叉的老鼠和兔子，路过的跳帮者与鼠帮劫匪显然很不喜欢。

货运升降机井底部就在西边不远处，想换层可以前往。

rows.original: As you traverse this sloping amber thoroughfare through the pirate’s mind-bending recreation deck, you spy a rather strange sight: an ornate helmet of ancient design, affixed with enormous mouse ears, flipped upside down. The inside is absolutely stuffed with cheeses of a hundred different varieties - even purple and green ones whose obvious alien origins make you doubt they’re fit for terran consumption. A sign beneath reads, “Raiders Only,” but you suspect the freewheeling freebooters that inhabit this area pay it little mind.
rows.translation: 沿海盗令人迷乱的娱乐层斜坡琥珀大道前行，你看见奇景：一顶古老华丽、装着巨大鼠耳的头盔倒扣在地，内部塞满上百种奶酪，甚至有紫色和绿色的外星品种，令人怀疑是否适合人类食用。下面牌子写着“仅限劫匪”，不过这里放荡不羁的海盗大概不会在意。

rows.original: Glittering lights draw your eyes to a nearby hardlight kiosk, it’s holographic screens flickering with a hundred promises of get rich quick schemes, easy bounties, and hot singles in your area. Most of the pirates don’t pay it any more mind than they do you, likely for good reason. Gold light shimmers through the dingy patina that coats the floor on its east-west circuit.
rows.translation: 闪光把视线引向附近硬光终端，全息屏不停承诺快速致富、轻松赏金以及附近的火辣单身者。大多数海盗和忽略你一样忽略它，多半事出有因。金光透过覆盖地板东西环路的肮脏薄层闪耀。

rows.original:
While strolling through this supposed pirates’ paradise, with all its greasy stains and lack of proper janitorial staff, you’re shocked to see a clean spot in the nearby plastiboard wall - and not just clean but immaculately painted. A sprawling mural depicts heroic-looking Jumpers in progressively more stylish jumpsuits leaping across the crooked, ill-fitting helmets of novice Peacekeepers and Galactic Guards. The downtrodden cops are portrayed as dopey fools, completely unaware of the sprightly lapines leaping by with their bags of loot.

This amber path runs an east-west circuit around the spherical pleasure deck, looping back down to the elevator’s base so long as you follow it long enough in either direction.
rows.translation:
走在这个所谓海盗天堂里，面对油腻污渍与缺失的清洁人员，你惊讶地发现塑料板墙上竟有一块洁净区域，而且涂装无比精美。巨幅壁画描绘英雄般的跳帮者，穿着愈发时髦的连身服，从新手维和人员与银河卫兵歪斜不合身的头盔上跃过。落魄警察被画成迟钝傻瓜，完全没注意灵巧拉奎因提着战利品从旁跳走。

琥珀道路沿球形娱乐层东西环绕，无论朝哪边走够远都会回到升降机底部。

rows.raw: "While strolling through this supposed pirates’ paradise, with all its greasy stains and lack of proper janitorial staff, you’re shocked to see a clean spot in the nearby plastiboard wall - and not just clean but immaculately painted. A sprawling mural depicts heroic-looking Jumpers in progressively more stylish jumpsuits leaping across the crooked, ill-fitting helmets of novice Peacekeepers and Galactic Guards. The downtrodden cops are portrayed as dopey fools, completely unaware of the sprightly lapines leaping by with their bags of loot.\\n\\nThis amber path runs an east-west circuit around the spherical pleasure deck, looping back down to the elevator’s base so long as you follow it long enough in either direction."

There isn’t much to see in the space around the cargo elevator unless you’re looking up or have a real penchant for advertising. There’s even a stand with pamphlets for KihaCorp Class 8 Companion droids. They’re pretty damn pricey, but the amount of customization crammed into that chassis is amazing. Male, female, herm... it can shift to almost any configuration imaginable with enough raw materials and the right plug-ins. The options for the internal AI’s are just as diverse. Dominant intelligences, submissive ones, and even ones with no greater desire than kinky petplay are all listed right there.

You wonder if any of the pirates have bought one with their ill-gotten gains.
rows.translation:
货运升降机周围没什么可看，除非抬头或特别喜欢广告。甚至还有基哈公司8级伴侣机器人宣传册。价格高得要命，但机体内的定制能力惊人：男性、女性、双性...只要原料和插件合适，几乎能变成任何构型。内部人工智能选择同样多样，包括支配型、服从型，甚至只渴望变态宠物扮演的类型。

你想知道是否有海盗用不义之财买过一台。

rows.original:
You stand next to the cargo elevator’s enormous shaft as it disappears into the ceiling (though now your floor). It’s ringed by solid walls covered in warring swaths of graffiti and posters, one overlapping the other until the whole is a blaze of color and picture with mismatched letters peeking out from in between.

To the south, a green path winds through the walls back toward the elevator’s entrance. The apex ring whirls east and west on its circuitous path.
rows.translation:
你站在货运升降机巨大井道旁，它没入如今位于你脚下的“天花板”。四周实墙覆满彼此争斗的涂鸦与海报，层层重叠成色彩图像的火焰，错乱字母从缝隙探出。

南边绿色路径穿过墙体返回升降机入口，顶环则沿迂回路线向东、西旋转。

While circling the elevator, you spare a glance upward to the dances above. They float in the zero-G pocket at the very center of the recreation deck, twirling and spinning. Their glossy nude bodies are some of the most perfect examples of biological beauty on the entire station, be they male, female, or somewhere in between. One sees you looking and bends her legs into a perfect split, flashing you a view straight into her winking pink slit.

You turn your gaze back down before you walk into a wall.
rows.translation:
绕升降机行走时，你抬头看向上方舞者。他们漂浮在娱乐层中心的零重力区，翻腾旋转，无论男女或介于两者之间，光滑裸体都是整座空间站最完美的生物之美。一名舞者发现你在看，双腿劈出完美一字马，让你直视她眨动的粉色裂缝。

你赶紧低头，以免撞墙。

rows.original:
“Join the Rat Pack!” exclaims a poster glued to the side of the elevator atop a mountain of older ones. It features a picture of a tastefully dressed rodenian with armored ears and slicked back hair. Two mouse-eared girls cling to his legs while he spins a plasma pistol around a finger with casual ease. “Friends Never Fail.” It’s then that you notice the girls’ ankle holsters, discrete shield belts, and fistfuls of microgrenades.

Persuasive.
rows.translation:
“加入鼠帮！”贴在升降机侧面海报山顶端的海报高呼。画面是一名衣着考究、装甲鼠耳、头发后梳的罗德尼安人，两名鼠耳女孩抱着他的腿，他则轻松用一根手指旋转等离子手枪。“朋友永不失手。”这时你才发现女孩们的脚踝枪套、隐蔽护盾腰带与成把微型手雷。

很有说服力。

rows.original:
The hoppy aroma of spilled beer and other less recognizable (but still alcoholic) beverages flavors the air with its uniquely acrid scent, and no more than a few steps further you discover why. A gigantic tower of empty beer cans and bottles has been erected, stretching up high enough that the topmost bottles must be flirting with the limits of the artificial gravity. You wonder how it was built so high without being knocked over by the station’s chaotically-inclined inhabitants right up until you’re close enough to see the layer of ultrahard epoxy coating the first ten feet or so, painted on thicker than a New Texan cow-girl’s lipstick.

The yellow-lit path you’re walking connects to the cargo elevator to the east and stretches west through the innumerable distractions this station has to offer.
rows.translation:
泼洒啤酒花和其他难辨酒饮的气味以独特辛辣弥漫空气。几步后，你发现原因：一座由空啤酒罐和酒瓶堆成的巨塔高到顶端酒瓶几乎触及人工重力边界。你正疑惑它如何没被混乱居民撞倒，便发现底部约十英尺涂着厚得胜过新德州奶牛姑娘口红的超硬环氧树脂。

脚下黄光道路向东连接货运升降机，向西则穿过空间站无数娱乐。

rows.translation: 泼洒啤酒花和其他难辨酒饮的气味以独特辛辣弥漫空气。几步后，你发现原因：一座由空啤酒罐和酒瓶堆成的巨塔高到顶端酒瓶几乎触及人工重力边界。你正疑惑它如何没被混乱居民撞倒，便发现底部约十英尺涂着厚得胜过新德州奶牛姑娘口红的超硬环氧树脂。\n\n脚下黄光道路向东连接货运升降机，向西则穿过空间站无数娱乐。

rows.original: Diving into chamber’s substrate, the golden trail’s route dips beneath another walled-off route as it makes its loop around the edges of the recreation deck’s sphere. Dim blue lights are the only source of illumination for a few paces, and then you’re back out into the glare and din once more. A statue of Jumper is there to welcome you, built from scrap parts and then wrapped in their signature jumpsuit with only a dozen ripped holes to show for it. Its fingers (built from emptied medipens) are locked in a perpetual double thumbs-up.
rows.translation: 金色道路沉入舱体基底，在绕娱乐层球体边缘循环时从另一条围墙路径下穿过。几步间只有昏暗蓝灯照明，随后你又回到刺眼光线与喧嚣中。一座跳帮者雕像迎接你：废料拼成身体，再裹上标志性连身服，只破了十几个洞。由空医疗注射笔制成的手指永远竖着双拇指。

rows.original:
Underfoot, the path glitters with bars of flaring green that jump and dance to the thumps of distant music and the hoots and hollers of excited pirates. The fickle luminance reflects off a graffiti-covered security barrier to the west. From behind it, you can hear laughter and the clinking of casino chips. Bells ding out a discordant tone when someone loses in spectacular fashion, only to jump up an octave in pitch when a lucky winner scores a king’s ransom in credit chits.

The cargo elevator’s entrance lies just to your south.
rows.translation:
脚下道路闪着喷发般绿色光条，随远处音乐重音和海盗欢呼跳动。无常光线映在西侧涂鸦安保屏障上，后方传来笑声与筹码碰响。有人惨败时铃铛发出不和谐声，幸运赢家赢得巨额信用点时音调又高八度。

货运升降机入口就在南边。

rows.original: “GREETINGS!” blares the monotone voice of an enormous mining robot. It waves one creaking arm in greeting, oblivious to the just how loud its joint’s screeching protest becomes. The motion finished, it returns to a neutral position just in time to pivot toward a pirate and begin its greeting all over again. The poor thing doesn’t even have a second arm, just a socket with a tangle of sparking wires, nor does it have the thick armor you’ve seen elsewhere. The chassis is bare enough for you to see every bit of ransacked internals - and the VI micro-controller jacked into its systems.
rows.translation: “欢迎！”巨型采矿机器人用单调声音轰鸣。它挥动嘎吱作响的手臂，全然不知关节抗议有多刺耳，随后刚恢复中立姿势便转向一名海盗重新问候。可怜机器连另一条手臂都没有，只剩冒火花的线缆插座，也没有别处那种厚重装甲。外壳裸露到能看清被洗劫的内部，以及接入系统的虚拟智能微控制器。

rows.original:
You raise your hand to shield your face from the blistering heat of an arch of pure, burning plasma. Suspended in a magnetic beam, its ring straddles the dancing green path such that you have to walk through beneath its unearthly fury to go on your way. The pirates all but ignore it, save for a small contingent of Corona Lords who spend most of their time scowling at a pack of sweat-soaked Jumpers with dark-tinted shades. The latex-suited laquines are too busy gossiping and admiring the slick sheen their collective fur is acquiring to care.

To the west, a flashing hologram bridges a gap in the wall with cool gold and pink light. Flickering letters in the center read, ‘Treasure Nova, Entrance.’ Beyond the semi-transparent gate lies the biggest collection of gambling paraphernalia you’ve ever seen - and a bar besides.
rows.translation:
你抬手遮挡纯净燃烧等离子弧的灼热。圆环悬在磁束中横跨绿色道路，继续前进就必须从非凡烈焰下穿过。海盗几乎不理会它，只有一小群电晕领主戴深色眼镜怒视满身汗水的跳帮者；乳胶装拉奎因忙着闲聊并欣赏毛皮日渐油亮，毫不在意。

西边闪烁全息图以凉爽金粉光跨越墙隙，中央文字写着“宝藏新星入口”。半透明门后是你见过最大的赌博器具集合，还有一间酒吧。

rows.original:
[pc.Walking] along this crimson avenue, you’re startled to see a platform ahead, bridging the plastiboard walls like some kind of improvised stage. Velvet carpet dangles off the sides, cut into long fringes with embedded micro-lights. Four figures prance around up there, bedecked in slave collars and silk fabrics that highlight attributes rather than conceal. Their voices rise in perfect harmony, belting out an uptempo acapella tune with surprising enthusiasm for slaves. Most of the pirates pay them no mind, more intent on getting to their destination, but it’s nice to listen to, if only for a minute.

The cargo elevator lies a short distance to the north.
rows.translation:
[pc.Walking]沿猩红大道前行，前方一座平台像临时舞台般横跨塑料板墙。天鹅绒地毯垂下，两侧剪成长流苏并嵌着微型灯。四个戴奴隶项圈、身披突出而非遮掩身体的丝绸之人跳舞，他们以完美和声热情唱着快节奏无伴奏曲。多数海盗忙着赶路，毫不理会，但哪怕只听一分钟也很悦耳。

货运升降机就在北面不远处。

rows.original: A kiosk sits propped against the eastern wall, filled with strange-looking headphones. Its signage declares them to be “hedon-guard” headphones, and the price is listed as “free for Rat’s Raiders, via DNA-scan.” There’s a spot to place a thumb for testing, and a slot for the strange devices to dispense into, assuming the user’s packing suitably rodenian DNA. Half the racks still hold headphones, the rest already dispensed to mouse-folk in need of a bit of aural protection - or in need of the few credits they can make flipping them elsewhere. You notice what appears to be a... storefront? Albeit a rather shady looking one. It’s just a door with a sign that says “SELL HERE”...
rows.translation: 一座终端靠在东墙，装满外形古怪的耳机。标牌称其为“享乐防护”耳机，价格是“鼠帮劫匪凭DNA扫描免费”。上面有拇指检测位和设备出口，前提是用户携带合适的罗德尼安DNA。半数架子仍有耳机，其余已发给需要听觉保护，或想转卖赚几枚信用点的鼠人。 你发现一处似乎是...店面？尽管相当可疑。只有一扇门，牌子写着“在此出售”...

rows.original: Kept dim by close walls, this area’s light is almost entirely provided by neon light - or simulated projections of it. There are male and female symbols interlocked, flickering and buzzing as they splay out blue and pink radiance. A tube of eye-watering green bends around itself to spell out “DRUGS” atop an east-facing arrow while a more mundane advertisement for “Cherry’s Tap-Hall” suggests you head south.

rows.original: No self-respecting Casino is unequipped of slot machines. In this labyrinthian wing of the building you find that not all slot machines are the same. Some are beaten up and look to be hastily fixed, while others shine with their mechanic’s love. A lot of them look to be straight up stolen, as indicated by scratch patterns where logos or serial numbers may have once boldly presented. Although you’re pretty sure these are rigged in the Nova’s favor, that doesn’t stop dozens of people from trying their luck. To the north is the main game room where your personal aptitude will be properly tested; to the west is the main entrance.
rows.translation: 任何体面赌场都少不了老虎机。在这迷宫般侧厅里，每台都不相同：有些破旧、仓促修补，另一些则因技师爱护而闪亮。许多显然是偷来的，原本标志或序列号处只留刮痕。尽管你确信机器偏向新星，仍有几十人碰运气。 北边主游戏室会真正考验个人本领，西边是正门。

rows.original: The Treasure Nova bar is as much a model of efficiency as it is a monument to affluent aestheticism. Like the walls of the casino, its entire makeup is hardlight in nature with a mostly solid countertop. Glasses and platters are exchanged between server and customer at record levels, perhaps faster than money at the tables. The bar is designed in the shape of a quasar, complete with the borderline gross amounts of lights channeling through its translucent surfaces. The outfits the staff are wearing behind the counter are made to complement the astral shape, too. You could take a seat at Aquarius, or head in any number of directions to find recreation.
rows.translation: 宝藏新星酒吧既是效率典范，也是富裕美学的纪念碑。和赌场墙壁一样，整体由硬光构成，台面近乎实体。服务员与客人以创纪录速度交换杯盘，或许比赌桌金钱流转还快。酒吧呈类星体形，近乎过量的光线穿过半透明表面，柜台后员工服饰也配合天体造型。 你可在水瓶座入座，或朝任意方向寻找娱乐。

rows.original: Glamorous colors invite you through the gaudiest side entrance you’ve ever seen past two well-dressed bouncers who usher the crowds expertly. The owners of the aptly named Treasure Nova flaunt their conspicuous wealth in colors of fortune so bright they leave spotty marks in your sightlessness. After storing your weaponry and butting a few shoulders you’re past the flickery gates, standing in the aurora-themed interior of Treasure Nova. To your south is the gambling floor, large as a mall cafeteria; cards are being dealt at eye-crossing speeds. To your west is a comfortable lounge, everyone in attendance entertained by sweaty strippers dancing and grinding for their audiences.
rows.translation: 华丽色彩引你穿过所见最花哨的侧门，两名衣着考究的保镖熟练疏导人群。名副其实的宝藏新星老板以刺眼幸运色炫耀财富，在视野中留下斑点。寄存武器并挤过人群后，你越过闪烁门扉，进入极光主题的宝藏新星。 南边赌场大厅大如商场餐区，发牌速度令人眼花；西边是舒适休息厅，汗湿脱衣舞者为观众扭动取乐。

rows.original: Treasure Nova’s lounge is a smokier part of the casino, muggy with the scent of sex. Ceiling-bound hardlight walls help muffle the outside while all lighting within is directed to stages centered among couches, chairs, and half-private booths. Dancers grace poles with gradual descent into depravity, accepting thrown money and invitations for one-on-one time. Every offer is eagerly reciprocated. Rhapsodizing light shows accompany their inhumanly graceful movements, and it seems that for every man or woman that departs the stage, there’s always another to take their place. Heading south, you could make your way to Treasure Nova’s galaxy-class bar, or move on to more attractions in the east and west.
rows.translation: 宝藏新星休息厅是赌场里烟雾更重、性爱气味闷热的区域。顶置硬光墙隔绝外界，内部照明全指向沙发、椅子和半私密隔间中央的舞台。舞者沿钢管逐步堕入淫荡，接受抛来的金钱和单独相处邀请，每项邀约都热情回应。迷幻灯光伴随非人般优雅动作，每当一个男女离台，总有另一个接替。 向南可去宝藏新星的银河级酒吧，东西还有更多娱乐。

rows.original:
Electronics hum all around as you ascend the slope to two different entrances. A broad, red and gold flag hangs over the head of a less-secure door bearing the lapine-themed logo of the Jumper pirate gang. A tinted control panel sits near that windowless door. In the other direction is the prominent blast-door marked ‘BRIDGE’. Two black, insect-like shapes jut out from the corners around it - gun turrets, and their long barrels are pointed at you. Cautiously looking over the yellow panel nearby, you find that a key card is required to gain entry.
		
		You do not currently have access to this bridge, and you’re not about to attempt to force entry so long as those ballistic proboscises are swiveling to follow your movements. Best to back off.
		
		On the other hand, to the north is the headquarters of the Jumper gang on the Ops Deck, and back to the east is the checkpoint and the central loop.
rows.translation:
电子设备在四周嗡鸣，你沿斜坡抵达两个入口。一面红金大旗悬在较不安全的门上，印着跳帮者帮派的拉奎因标志，旁边是深色控制面板。另一边是标有“舰桥”的显眼防爆门，四角伸出两座黑色虫状炮塔，长炮管正对着你。附近黄色面板显示必须使用钥匙卡。
		
		你目前无权进入舰桥，只要这些弹道口器仍追随动作旋转，你便不打算强闯。最好退开。
		
		北面是行动层跳帮者总部，向东返回检查站和中央环路。

rows.original:
You raise your hand to block an array of needling LIDAR rays. Ass-clenching fear crawls through your neck a split-second before the slicing beams flicker off. You expect the klaxons to blare any second. Instead, the pin-headed device merely retracts into the ceiling. It will pop its odd, tiny self out on occasion to poke and prod at others passing through. You wonder if the thing is actually designed to catch an intruder at all. Watching it analyze another, you note that the lasers track the necks of their target. Its intended purpose becomes all too clear, and you shudder to think what might have happened otherwise.

The sounds of heavy breathing fill your ears, as though someone were looming in your blind spot — nothing. Occasionally, collared pets will stride to and from the adjacent rooms, clean, or slathered. Yet when they pass, that sound is back. Every time you try to listen for it, find it, it stops... and when you gather your thoughts, it’s there to interrupt. No matter how hard you wince, squint, or shake your head, it lingers in the periphery.
		
		Before you start hearing words and voices, you could head north or south up and down into the central loop, west to the lounge, or perhaps east into the slave’s quarters. The door does seem unlocked.
		"

A neon-illuminated flag overhead bears the visage of a cobra with broad-white fangs dripping with what you presume to be poison. A gang hideout: observe the access panel, the nearness of cylirians, zel’rahn, and slyveren, each one dressed minimally to maximize their raw animal magnetism. Instead of kinetic firepower or energy-based weapons, they carry chem-grenades, hypoderm injectors, and some even have rows of stacked metal collars dangling from their belts like top-credit whores carrying dozens of unopened condoms in their garters.[var0| These are the Star Vipers, the most unpredictable and dangerous of the five gangs, responsible for the plurality of slaves brought into Zhèng Shi.]

Zhèng Shi has as many slaves as pirates and freebooters wandering around, and this room houses the most supremely sensual of the mentally broken, selected to cater for the five large crews running this base on their obedience, initiative, and genuine enthusiasm. You don’t have much time to think about the sticky, whirling design of this muggy room before a number of naked, cooing figures descend on you, assuming you to be their [pc.master] for the hour. Unbidden kisses pepper your [pc.arms]; fingers fall along your [pc.ass], [pc.thighs], and [pc.footOrFeet]; each one gently rocks you, desperate to guide you into mind-melting comfort and make the stresses of the greater universe disappear.

		They say there’s no rest for the wicked. ‘They’ haven’t been here yet.
		
		Before you get dragged into one of the many fluffy beds cloaked in sultry gloom, you could head back where you came from before things get too sloppy.
rows.translation:
郑石游荡的奴隶和海盗几乎一样多，这间房收容精神崩溃者中最性感的一批，依据服从、主动与真诚热情，为统治基地的五大帮派服务。你还来不及端详闷热房间黏腻旋转的设计，一群裸体柔声身影便把你当成这一小时的[pc.master]围上来。吻无请落在[pc.arms]，手指滑过[pc.ass]、[pc.thighs]与[pc.footOrFeet]；每个人温柔摇动你，急于引你进入融化心智的舒适，抹去宇宙压力。

		人说恶人不得休息；说这话的人没来过这里。
		
		在被拖进昏暗诱惑中的蓬松床铺前，你可以沿原路离开，以免越来越黏。

rows.original: You kind of have to bask in the unique comfort at the top of Zhèng Shi. It’s quiet; not too cold, not too warm, and well-lit. You feel like a cat under a bed surrounded by all these crates. When your out-of-place tranquility passes, you wonder if you have any business on the Operations Deck that would spare you an immediate return to the incessant clang of mining and construction or the hustle and glamor of an outlaw’s recreation.

The central loop of the Operations Deck wraps around a wide communal area stuffed to capacity with pirates and slaves. Underfoot, a few liquor stains and thrown food trails into a roomy cafeteria adjoined by a lounge. Holo-screens projected between support columns proudly display the flashy emblems of all five gangs. Peeking into the clamor of the cafeteria shows you a number of laquines, thraggen, kaithrit, ausar, and other deplorables chowing down on stacked plates of food while naked pretty boys and apple-bottomed girls happily gorge themselves on whatever might be between their owners’ shuddering legs.
		
		To the south is the cargo elevator that brought you here. North and east will take you further into the Ops Loop.

行动层中央环路围绕塞满海盗奴隶的宽阔公共区。脚下酒渍和食物残渣通往宽敞餐厅与休息室。支柱间全息屏骄傲展示五帮华丽徽记。餐厅里拉奎因、特拉根、凯斯里特、奥萨等败类吞食满盘食物，裸体美少年与翘臀女孩则快乐吞食主人颤抖双腿间的东西。
		
		南面是来时货运升降机，向北或向东深入行动环路。

A yellow-white galotian of immense size draws your attention in this corridor, her shifting goo sliding across the ceiling, the walls, and the floor, giggling as she slurps up the messes left by others. A fat, chrome collar closes around her neck and rests on her shoulders, as thick as her comically oversized bimbo lips. She pays you no mind, carrying out her endless task with a happy hum. What catches your eye are the objects floating within her bloated torso. You make out weapons, tools, and other mundane items twisting inside. Guess she’s also the mobile lost and found.
		
		Heading east will take you into the cafeteria room, while heading north or south will take you to the T-junctions and further into the secure areas.
rows.translation:
走廊里一名巨大黄白加洛提安人吸引注意，流动黏液滑过天花板、墙壁与地面，咯咯笑着吸走他人留下的污物。肥厚铬项圈圈住脖颈搭在肩上，和夸张花瓶嘴唇一样粗。她快乐哼唱着执行无尽任务，并不理你。真正醒目的是臃肿躯干内漂浮的武器、工具等物品。看来她也是移动失物招领处。
		
		向东进入餐厅，向北或南去T字路口和安全区域。

There are more Jumpers sashaying to and from this neck of the deck than you’ve seen elsewhere. Most of the latex-wrapped pirates are hopping in tight formation. None of them cast so much as a mean stare in your direction, and, even more incredulously, they seem in control of their lusts. It should be obvious these laquines are Jumpers, but part of you is struggling to cope with it. They wear the uniform, the red lettering on their wide-flared thighs says it all... it’s difficult to believe these focused patrol-buns could be one and the same as the dopey, sweaty sluts you encountered in the mines.
		
		Down the west corridor is a yellow and blue-lit access passage through a security checkpoint of some alien schema, at the terminus of which is a large, high-security door. Just off to the side of that door is an entrance marked clearly with the Jumper’s emblems - a flag hangs overhead. To the east is the rest of the central loop. Up north is a lone door without any access panels.

这片甲板出入的跳帮者比别处多，多数乳胶海盗紧密列队跳行，既不恶瞪你，甚至还能控制欲望。她们显然是跳帮者，但你仍难以接受：制服和宽阔大腿上的红字说明一切，可这些专注巡逻兔竟与矿井里呆傻汗湿的荡妇是同一群体。
		
		西走廊是黄蓝光安全检查通道，尽头有高安全门，旁边入口清楚标着跳帮者徽记和旗帜。东面是中央环路，北面是一扇无控制面板的门。

It seems that even pirates sometimes bother to keep their homes clean. Nothing in here is out of the ordinary: mundane chemicals, fancy brand-name varnishes, thick mops, rows and rows of air freshener and more cram the metal shelves.
		
		South will take you back to the central loop.

看起来像储物间，它就是。虽不意外，却空间宽敞、颇安静，并塞满昂贵清洁用品。看来海盗偶尔也会保持家园整洁。这里没有异常：普通化学品、名牌清漆、厚拖把、成排空气清新剂等挤满金属架。
		
		向南返回中央环路。

rows.original:
The Sidewinder’s airlocks look much like its exterior: shiny, new, and engineered with a surprising degree of precision. Large square buttons operate the airlock’s settings, flanked by the sort of heavy duty, no-nonsense lever you’d expect to find on a military vessel. Automatic docking controls are positioned just below. The reverse wall houses manual linkages. Finally, a small panel on the outer door displays the airlock’s overall status - primarily that it is more or less wide-open, owing to compatible atmospherics on the outside. Handy.

Inside the inner door, to the east, lies an access corridor. You may exit the ship to the south.
rows.translation:
响尾蛇号气闸与外观相似：崭新闪亮，工程精度惊人。大方形按键控制设置，旁边是军舰式重型实用拉杆。自动对接控制位于下方，反面墙装着手动连杆。外门小面板显示整体状态，主要是因外界大气兼容，气闸几乎完全敞开。很方便。

内门东面是通道，向南可离船。

This north-south access corridor looks like it might run the whole length of the Sidewinder, and while it may be glitzy and brand-new, it’s also been decorated in typical garish, Jumper fashion. A promotion poster hangs from the east wall, framed in glowing neon. It depicts a buxom Jumper in a bright yellow jumpsuit and old-style bubble helmet, rocketing through an asteroid field with nothing but a hand blaster and the jets on her belt. Bold text at the bottom commands, “Jump into the fray... TODAY!”

To the north, the corridor widens into some kind of mess hall. It also stretches south, presumably toward the cockpit.
rows.translation:
这条南北通道似乎贯穿响尾蛇号。它虽华丽崭新，却以典型跳帮者俗艳风格装饰。东墙促销海报配霓虹边框，丰满跳帮者穿亮黄连身服与老式泡泡头盔，只靠手枪和腰带喷口冲过小行星带。底部粗体命令：“跃入战局...就在今天！”

北面通道拓宽成食堂，向南大概通往驾驶舱。

rows.original:
The Sidewinder’s cockpit looks even flashier than the rest of the ship. Banks of programmable hardlight displays report on the conditions of dozens of subsystems. Black varmint-leather cushions lend the comfy bucket seats an air of luxury, ensuring that this magnificent beast’s crew can truly enjoy themselves while plundering the galaxy’s riches. The captain’s chair is the largest by far, sat behind an array of triple holodisplays, twin flightsticks, and two full keyboards. Judging by the setup, this vessel can be operated by a single pilot if need be, though a good crew would undoubtedly make it more effective.

As you’re looking it over, a twelve-inch hardlight horse-cock springs out of the chair, wobbling with simulated weight. Of course the Jumpers designed a ship with a dildo in the chair! How else would they take it for pervy joyrides? At least there appears to be a button to turn it off. You don’t, of course. The idea of a bunny squirming on that thing while she tries to navigate an asteroid field is simply too amusing.

The cockpit’s access hatch leads north.
rows.translation:
响尾蛇号驾驶舱比船上其他地方更花哨。可编程硬光显示阵列汇报几十个子系统，黑色害兽皮软垫让桶椅尽显奢华，确保船员掠夺银河财富时尽情享受。舰长椅最大，前方有三重全息屏、双操纵杆和两套完整键盘。必要时一名驾驶员即可操纵，但完整船员无疑效率更高。

查看时，一根十二英寸硬光马鸡巴从椅中弹出，以模拟重量摇晃。跳帮者果然设计了带假阳具的座椅！否则怎能淫荡兜风？至少有关闭按钮，你当然不按。兔子坐着它在小行星带导航的画面实在太有趣。

驾驶舱舱口向北。

rows.original:
The ship’s mess hall is a combination kitchen and dining room, complete with tables capable of seating up to twenty. The kitchen is everything you’d expect from hedonistic pirates. Gold trimmed protein synthesizers are neatly packed next to an ornate las-oven and a half-dozen other esoteric food preparation devices. A simple robotic servant trundles around with a touchscreen on its blank face listing suggested foods. At some point, its narrow, servile frame was modified to carry around a set of heavy sexbot knockers that jiggle dangerously with its every step. It appears oblivious to the fact that someone scrawled “Fill these puppies with whiskey!” across them.

A wide access corridor intersects with the mess, stretching north toward the cargohold and engines and south up to the cockpit. A heavy doorway to the west gives the captain convenient access to food from his or her quarters.
rows.translation:
飞船食堂兼作厨房和餐厅，桌子可坐二十人。厨房完全符合享乐海盗的想象：金边蛋白合成器整齐排列在华丽激光烤箱和六种奇异烹饪设备旁。简易机器人仆从四处移动，空白脸上的触屏列出推荐食物。它狭窄服从的机身曾被改装，装上一对沉重性爱机器人巨乳，每走一步都危险摇晃，似乎没意识到有人在上面写着“把这对宝贝灌满威士忌！”

宽通道穿过食堂，向北通货舱与引擎，向南通驾驶舱。西侧重门让舰长能从住舱方便取餐。

rows.original: Furnished with a heart-shaped bed and more throw pillows than any one planet should be allowed to contain, the captain’s quarters look more like a harem chamber than a place of rest. Discarded bottles of lube lie everywhere. The trashbin looks halfway overflowed with condoms. A pair of frilly panties hangs framed on the wall along with a signed picture of Nivas Oxonef, indicating the ultrapornstar herself once wore them. The nightstand is covered with used TamaniCorp gift cards, already scratched off to get at their valuable codes.
rows.translation: 舰长室摆着心形床和多到任何星球都不该容纳的抱枕，看起来更像后宫而非休息处。废弃润滑液瓶遍地都是，垃圾桶被避孕套塞到半满。墙上装框挂着一条花边内裤和尼瓦斯·奥克索内夫签名照，说明这位超级色情明星曾亲自穿过。床头柜铺满已刮出珍贵代码的塔玛妮公司礼品卡。

rows.original: The corridor stretches north and south past quite a few rooms for crew members, every single one of them locked down for the time being. You suppose that once a proper crew manifest is loaded into the console, you’d be able to get inside, but right now, you have bigger fish to fry. The used condom on the floor gives one suggestion as to why these chambers were sealed off while the ship is in drydock, not that the pirates on this station seem to give one whit about finding somewhere private to bang.

rows.original: A lone chair sits against this passage’s northern terminus, next to a stack of magazines. Doors flank it to either side, offering access to “Engine Room A” and “Engine Room B.” The latter is presently sealed for testing, according to the message on its terminal. The former is closed but unguarded. This single seat must be where the head mechanic comes to take a break from his job, judging by the hot-rodded spaceships and burly beefcakes his (or her?) chosen literature displays. You spot the following headlines at a glance: Ion Engine Tuning Made Easy! Cum Like Tank Kannon With This One Simple Trick! Pecs: The Milky Manjugs of the Future! Anal: How Big Is Too Big? Light Drive Showdown: Which Model Covers the Most Parsecs in a Sec?
rows.translation: 通道北端靠墙放着一把椅子，旁边是一叠杂志，两侧分别通往“引擎室A”和“引擎室B”。终端显示后者因测试封闭，前者关着但无人守卫。这座单椅大概供首席技师休息，从其读物上的改装飞船和壮汉来看便知。 你一眼看到标题： 离子引擎调校轻松学！ 一个简单技巧，让你像坦克·卡农一样狂射！ 胸肌：未来的奶油男乳！ 肛交：多大才算太大？ 光驱动对决：哪款每秒跨越最多秒差距？

rows.original:
This chamber has no walls that you can see - only heavy machinery. Churning coolant pipes and gurgling pumps surround you. Whirring boxes radiate palpable heat, their purpose as unknown as their contents. Banks of winking green indicator lights report on hundreds of sensors scattered throughout the mechanical maze. Even the floor isn’t quite a floor: it’s made of modular metal gratings that can be pried open to allow you access to the components below. You aren’t sure if this place is a mechanic’s idea of hell or a wet dream. Maybe it’s both, to the right person.

The main access corridor lies east.
rows.translation:
这间舱室看不到墙，只有重型机械。翻滚冷却管和咕噜泵体环绕你，嗡鸣箱体散发可感热量，用途和内容都未知。成排绿色指示灯汇报机械迷宫中数百传感器。就连地板也只是可撬开的模块化金属格栅，以便接触下方部件。你不确定这里是技师的地狱还是春梦，也许对合适的人而言两者都是。

主通道在东面。

rows.original: As easy on the eyes as the plump girl is, there’s no getting around the strangeness of her collar. The huge, disc-shaped device rests heavily on her shoulders yet never seems to sink into her body. It produces a low humming that increases in pitch whenever she’s digesting a meal (which is almost constantly). A bead on its front projects a flickering, holographic lock, though you see no physical method of unlocking, much less removing the thing. According to Cherry, the collar keeps Molli from dividing, but it’s still an odd adornment for the hostess’ closest partner to be wearing.
