rows.translation: “所以你自己不经营任何隔间？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you don’t operate any of the booths yourself?”"

rows.original: “Goodness no. Cherry was very particular about that. We’re management and those are for employees only. Even if it seems like ever so much fun to climb into one of those holes and let anybody just step up and have at you...” she trails off, daydreaming wistfully. “But! I supposed it wouldn’t make much sense anyway. I could just slip out and being bound in there is half the point of the thing.”
rows.translation: “天哪，当然不。切莉对此非常坚持。我们是管理人员，隔间只供员工使用。尽管爬进那些洞里，让任何人走上来随意享用，听起来确实好玩得不得了...”她的声音渐渐消失，怀念地做起白日梦。“不过！反正也不太实际。我随时都能溜出去，而被束缚在里面正是它一半的意义。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Goodness no. Cherry was very particular about that. We’re management and those are for employees only. Even if it seems like ever so much fun to climb into one of those holes and let anybody just step up and have at you...” she trails off, daydreaming wistfully. “But! I supposed it wouldn’t make much sense anyway. I could just slip out and being bound in there is half the point of the thing.”"

rows.original: “A lot of my time goes into cleaning up, but I don’t mind. If things are really messy, it just means that everybody enjoyed themselves that much more.” You can hear a gurgle from her stomach as she talks, and the big girl blushes petitely. “Messes also make for a more filling clean-up,” she admits.
rows.translation: “我的很多时间都花在清理上，不过我不介意。越是混乱，就说明大家享受得越尽兴。”她说话时肚子发出咕噜声，巨女娇羞地红了脸。“而且越乱，清理时也越能填饱肚子，”她承认道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A lot of my time goes into cleaning up, but I don’t mind. If things are really messy, it just means that everybody enjoyed themselves that much more.” You can hear a gurgle from her stomach as she talks, and the big girl blushes petitely. “Messes also make for a more filling clean-up,” she admits."

rows.original: You point out the drains under each station and ask if things usually get that crazy.
rows.translation: 你指着每个工作位下面的排水口，问事情通常是否会如此疯狂。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou point out the drains under each station and ask if things usually get that crazy."

rows.original: “Well, some of our guests are very generous.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，有些客人非常慷慨。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, some of our guests are very generous.” "

rows.original: Pursing her lips, Molli gives you a conspiratorial wink. “Very generous indeed,” she adds, booping your nose.
rows.translation: 莫莉噘起嘴，心照不宣地向你眨眼。“确实非常慷慨，”她补充道，轻点你的鼻子。
rows.raw: "Pursing her lips, Molli gives you a conspiratorial wink. “Very generous indeed,” she adds, booping your nose. "

rows.original: Gesturing broadly at the station, the galotian sighs. “The others insisted on emergency drainage. Not everyone shares our enthusiasm for cum. Oh, except for the Star Vipers! Those ladies are women after my own heart, despite being pirates.”
rows.translation: 加洛提安人朝工作位宽泛比划，叹了口气。“其他人坚持要有紧急排水。并非每个人都像我们这样热爱精液。哦，星蝰除外！尽管她们是海盗，那些姑娘却和我志趣相投。”
rows.raw: "Gesturing broadly at the station, the galotian sighs. “The others insisted on emergency drainage. Not everyone shares our enthusiasm for cum. Oh, except for the Star Vipers! Those ladies are women after my own heart, despite being pirates.”"

rows.original: Despite? You ask if she doesn’t consider herself a pirate.
rows.translation: 尽管？你问她是否不把自己当作海盗。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite? You ask if she doesn’t consider herself a pirate."

rows.original: “I should say not,” she murmurs, a little offended. “A pirate! Me! The very thought! Why, I used to...” she stops herself, an unexpected look of worry on her face. Looking around, she frowns and lowers her voice. “Well, never mind what I used to do. Anyway, no. We’re not pirates.”
rows.translation: “当然不是，”她低声说，略感冒犯。“我？海盗！居然会有这种想法！我以前可是...”她突然住口，脸上浮现意外的担忧。她环顾四周，皱眉压低声音。“算了，别管我以前做什么。总之不是，我们不是海盗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I should say not,” she murmurs, a little offended. “A pirate! Me! The very thought! Why, I used to...” she stops herself, an unexpected look of worry on her face. Looking around, she frowns and lowers her voice. “Well, never mind what I used to do. Anyway, no. We’re not pirates.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Cherry seemed pretty guarded about herself - a trait Molli apparently lacks - so you probe the hefty goo for a little more about the zel’rahn.
rows.translation: 切莉对自己的事似乎戒心很重——而莫莉显然没有这种特质——因此你向丰满黏液打听更多泽尔·拉恩人的事。
rows.raw: "Cherry seemed pretty guarded about herself - a trait Molli apparently lacks - so you probe the hefty goo for a little more about the zel’rahn."

rows.original: “She’s such a sweetie,” Molli assures you with a bright smile. “And tastes great too,” she adds with a wink.
rows.translation: “她是个大甜心，”莫莉灿烂微笑着保证。“味道也很棒，”她眨眼补充。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s such a sweetie,” Molli assures you with a bright smile. “And tastes great too,” she adds with a wink."

rows.original: You’ll take her word for it, but you push for some history on the gelatinous outlaw. You take it that Molli’s known her employer for some time now, but you’re curious if they met here on Zhèng Shi or if they both showed up together.
rows.translation: 你姑且相信，但继续追问这名胶质法外之徒的过去。你推测莫莉认识雇主已有一段时间，却好奇她们是在郑石相遇，还是一起来到这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll take her word for it, but you push for some history on the gelatinous outlaw. You take it that Molli’s known her employer for some time now, but you’re curious if they met here on Zhèng Shi or if they both showed up together."

rows.original: “We’ve been the best of friends for quite a while now,” the giant jelly coos. “I even knew her before she retired from pirating. Quite a notorious character, back in those days. Neurotoxin isn’t just a defensive tool, you know.” She wiggles a warning finger of matronly caution.
rows.translation: “我们当最好的朋友已经很久了，”巨型果冻柔声说道。“她从海盗生涯退休前我就认识她。那时候她可是臭名昭著。要知道，神经毒素可不只是一种防御工具。”她像慈母般警告地摇摇手指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ve been the best of friends for quite a while now,” the giant jelly coos. “I even knew her before she retired from pirating. Quite a notorious character, back in those days. Neurotoxin isn’t just a defensive tool, you know.” She wiggles a warning finger of matronly caution."

rows.original: Raising an eyebrow, you point at the Cherry bomb floating in Molli’s ample midsection. “But you’re not affected?”
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛，指向漂浮在莫莉宽阔腹部里的切莉炸弹。“但你不受影响？”
rows.raw: "\n\nRaising an eyebrow, you point at the Cherry bomb floating in Molli’s ample midsection. “But you’re not affected?”"

rows.original: “Oh goodness no. Cherry’s flavor works on people with, ah, nervous systems. As you can see,” she pokes the side of her head, dimpling the pink surface, “no brain.” Molli laughs mildly, rolling waves of mirth rippling through her body.
rows.translation: “天哪，当然不会。切莉的风味只对拥有神经系统的人起效。你也看得见，”她戳了戳脑袋侧面，在粉色表面压出凹陷，“没有大脑。”莫莉温和笑着，欢乐波浪滚过全身。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh goodness no. Cherry’s flavor works on people with, ah, nervous systems. As you can see,” she pokes the side of her head, dimpling the pink surface, “no brain.” Molli laughs mildly, rolling waves of mirth rippling through her body."

rows.original: You guess that it must be nice when nobody else can touch her safely to have a partner who’s immune.
rows.translation: 你猜，当其他人都无法安全碰触她时，拥有一个免疫的伴侣一定很好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou guess that it must be nice when nobody else can touch her safely to have a partner who’s immune."

rows.original: The gentle giantess perches a finger at the rim of her weighty lips and blinks. “Oh, I suppose so. After all, everyone wants to be touched sometimes. And there’s nobody better at warm hugs than a galotian,” she muses, jiggling in pride.
rows.translation: 温柔巨女把一根手指抵在沉重唇缘，眨眨眼。“哦，大概是吧。毕竟每个人偶尔都想被触碰，而论温暖拥抱，没有谁比加洛提安人更擅长，”她沉吟着，自豪地颤动身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gentle giantess perches a finger at the rim of her weighty lips and blinks. “Oh, I suppose so. After all, everyone wants to be touched sometimes. And there’s nobody better at warm hugs than a galotian,” she muses, jiggling in pride."

rows.original: Giving the nearest metallic wall a rap, you wonder how they came to end up here.
rows.translation: 你敲了敲附近的金属墙，好奇她们如何来到这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nGiving the nearest metallic wall a rap, you wonder how they came to end up here."

rows.original: “Well, Cherry built this little section of the station. Uh, kind of. Actually, it was parts of her old ship they took apart and installed here. That’s why it’s called Cherry’s Tap-Hall, after all. What a funny coincidence it would have been if it was named that before she came along.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，切莉建造了空间站这一小片区域。呃，算是吧。其实是他们拆下她旧飞船的一部分，安装在这里。所以它才叫切莉的龙头大厅。要是在她到来前就叫这个名字，那可真是奇妙巧合。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, Cherry built this little section of the station. Uh, kind of. Actually, it was parts of her old ship they took apart and installed here. That’s why it’s called Cherry’s Tap-Hall, after all. What a funny coincidence it would have been if it was named that before she came along.”"

rows.original: Her ship? You look up and down the rows of individual booths. It looks more like a stockade than a vessel.
rows.translation: 她的飞船？你沿一排排独立隔间上下打量。这里看起来更像囚栏，而非飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ship? You look up and down the rows of individual booths. It looks more like a stockade than a vessel."

rows.original: “Oh yes! One of her favorite things to do as a pirate was to disable any security forces who showed up during one of her raids and take them with her. Gotta have somewhere to put all the cops you’re making off with.”
rows.translation: “哦，没错！她当海盗时最喜欢做的事之一，就是让抢劫中赶来的安保人员失去行动能力，再把他们带走。毕竟得找个地方安置所有被你掳走的警察。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yes! One of her favorite things to do as a pirate was to disable any security forces who showed up during one of her raids and take them with her. Gotta have somewhere to put all the cops you’re making off with.”"

rows.original: That’s certainly one way to make off with ill-gotten booty. So she’s been doing this, you gesture at the Tap-Hall, kind of thing for awhile?
rows.translation: 这当然也是带走不义之“臀”的一种方法。所以她从很久以前就在做龙头大厅这种事？你朝大厅比划。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s certainly one way to make off with ill-gotten booty. So she’s been doing this, you gesture at the Tap-Hall, kind of thing for awhile?"

rows.original: “Well, back in those days, it was just the law enforcement. I believe she said it wasn’t very sporting if you’re grabbing people who aren’t trying to stop you.” Molli shrugs. “Eventually her reputation got around and the owners started hiring bounty hunters. Easier than trying to track down employees on whatever planet Cherry eventually dropped them off at.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，那时候只有执法人员。我记得她说，抓走并未试图阻止你的人就不够有竞技精神。”莫莉耸耸肩。“后来她名声传开，老板们开始雇赏金猎人。总比去切莉最终丢下员工的某颗星球上追踪他们容易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, back in those days, it was just the law enforcement. I believe she said it wasn’t very sporting if you’re grabbing people who aren’t trying to stop you.” Molli shrugs. “Eventually her reputation got around and the owners started hiring bounty hunters. Easier than trying to track down employees on whatever planet Cherry eventually dropped them off at.”"

rows.original: You can believe she must’ve been a terror for the unprepared. But what about robotic security?
rows.translation: 你相信她对毫无准备的人一定十分可怕。但机器人安保呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can believe she must’ve been a terror for the unprepared. But what about robotic security?"

rows.original: “She always worked with a partner back then. She’d handle the humanoids and they’d handle the machines. Never worked with the same person for very long, though. Well, up until the last one.”
rows.translation: “她那时候总会和搭档一起行动。她处理类人生物，搭档负责机器。不过她从不和同一个人合作太久。嗯，直到最后那位。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She always worked with a partner back then. She’d handle the humanoids and they’d handle the machines. Never worked with the same person for very long, though. Well, up until the last one.”"

rows.original: A flushed look passes over the normally cheerful woman’s expression, darkening her round cheeks. Seems you’ve hit a touchy subject. Might be best to save that for another time.
rows.translation: 一抹红晕掠过这名平常开朗女子的脸，让圆润双颊变得更暗。看来你碰到了敏感话题，最好改天再问。
rows.raw: "\n\nA flushed look passes over the normally cheerful woman’s expression, darkening her round cheeks. Seems you’ve hit a touchy subject. Might be best to save that for another time."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: So how does Molli feel about all the pirates on Zhèng Shi? She doesn’t seem the type to swash any buckles.
rows.translation: 那么莫莉怎么看郑石上的所有海盗？她看起来不像会挥剑劫掠的类型。
rows.raw: "So how does Molli feel about all the pirates on Zhèng Shi? She doesn’t seem the type to swash any buckles."

rows.original: “They are a... colorful sort, aren’t they? I am normally against piracy, but I admit there are some good folk in there. It’s a bit complicated, I guess.” The gargantuan galotian flops down onto her colossal ass with a wet splat and crosses her arms in thought.
rows.translation: “他们是...一群很有特色的人，对吧？我通常反对海盗行为，不过得承认里面也有好人。我想事情有点复杂。”巨型加洛提安人湿漉漉地啪嗒一声坐上硕大屁股，抱臂沉思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They are a... colorful sort, aren’t they? I am normally against piracy, but I admit there are some good folk in there. It’s a bit complicated, I guess.” The gargantuan galotian flops down onto her colossal ass with a wet splat and crosses her arms in thought."

rows.original: “Well, the Cyberpunks are nice, at least. They helped us set up the Tap-Hall, you see.” Cherry points out the thrumming lust engines, as if you needed a reminder of the throbbing urges pounding away at the back of your head. “And, of course, Cherry’s new legs. Really quite sweet of them. We don’t see them as often as we’d like, though. Probably spending too much time in their VR simulations,” she chides lightly.
rows.translation: “至少赛博朋克们很友善。你看，他们帮我们建起龙头大厅。”切莉指出嗡鸣的欲望引擎，仿佛你还需要提醒脑后不断搏动的强烈冲动。“当然还有切莉的新腿，真是体贴。只是我们没法像希望的那样常见到他们，大概在虚拟现实模拟里待得太久了，”她轻声责备。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, the Cyberpunks are nice, at least. They helped us set up the Tap-Hall, you see.” Cherry points out the thrumming lust engines, as if you needed a reminder of the throbbing urges pounding away at the back of your head. “And, of course, Cherry’s new legs. Really quite sweet of them. We don’t see them as often as we’d like, though. Probably spending too much time in their VR simulations,” she chides lightly."

rows.original: Or too much time putting other people in VR simulations, you mentally add. Little surprise the security ops gang don’t spend much time on the recreation deck.
rows.translation: 或者花太多时间把别人塞进虚拟现实模拟，你在心里补充。安保行动帮派不常来娱乐层也毫不奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nOr too much time putting other people in VR simulations, you mentally add. Little surprise the security ops gang don’t spend much time on the recreation deck."

rows.original: “Come to think of it, we don’t see the Jumpers very much except for that sweet little LDC boy. Such a little gentleman, always dropping off huge bouquets of cum bubbles.” Molli lowers her volume and leans in conspiratorially. “Cherry’s quite fond of him, you know.”
rows.translation: “仔细想想，除了那个可爱的小LDC男孩，我们也不常见到跳帮者。他真是个小绅士，总会送来大束精液泡泡。”莫莉压低声音，神秘兮兮地凑近。“你知道，切莉很喜欢他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come to think of it, we don’t see the Jumpers very much except for that sweet little LDC boy. Such a little gentleman, always dropping off huge bouquets of cum bubbles.” Molli lowers her volume and leans in conspiratorially. “Cherry’s quite fond of him, you know.”"

rows.original: “The others... well they’re cute bunnies, but I think most of them enjoy the thrill of the hunt too much to come around too often. They are the biggest gang, though, so we’ll see one come through every so often. Usually to drop a member of one of the other gangs in a booth for a while. I think they just do that to show that they’re on top.”
rows.translation: “其他人...嗯，她们是可爱的兔子，但我想大部分人太享受狩猎刺激，不会经常过来。不过她们是最大的帮派，所以偶尔还是会来一个，通常是把其他帮派成员塞进隔间待一阵。我觉得她们只是想展示自己居于上位。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The others... well they’re cute bunnies, but I think most of them enjoy the thrill of the hunt too much to come around too often. They are the biggest gang, though, so we’ll see one come through every so often. Usually to drop a member of one of the other gangs in a booth for a while. I think they just do that to show that they’re on top.”"

rows.original: Molli purses her lips and effects as much of a frown as her cherubic expression permits. “The Corona Lords are a different story altogether. That gang is officially not welcome at the Tap-Hall anymore.” The galotian jiggles the Cherry bomb floating inside her meaningfully. “They got way too rough with the staff and Cherry had to take them down more than once. We tried putting them in the wall to cool down for a bit, but that just seemed to rile them up even more.” She tuts disapprovingly. “They’re very bad girls.”
rows.translation: 莫莉噘嘴，在天使般的表情允许范围内尽力皱眉。“电晕领主就完全不同了。那个帮派现已被正式禁止进入龙头大厅。”加洛提安人意味深长地晃动体内漂浮的切莉炸弹。“她们对员工粗暴得过头，切莉不止一次不得不放倒她们。我们试过把她们塞进墙里冷静一下，结果似乎只让她们更兴奋。”她不赞同地咂嘴。“她们都是坏姑娘。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMolli purses her lips and effects as much of a frown as her cherubic expression permits. “The Corona Lords are a different story altogether. That gang is officially not welcome at the Tap-Hall anymore.” The galotian jiggles the Cherry bomb floating inside her meaningfully. “They got way too rough with the staff and Cherry had to take them down more than once. We tried putting them in the wall to cool down for a bit, but that just seemed to rile them up even more.” She tuts disapprovingly. “They’re very bad girls.”"

rows.original: The chubby giantess gasps, holding a hand to her mouth. “Oh, but I must be painting a dire picture of the Tap-Hall! We do get lots of visitors, you know. Freelancers come through regularly, not to mention the Rat’s Raiders. They love popping by in twos and threes, often sharing the same booth. Also,” the goo girl points out the rodenians in a pair of booths, “they’re some of our most eager employees.”
rows.translation: 胖巨女倒吸一口气，用手掩住嘴。“哦，但我一定把龙头大厅描绘得太可怕了！我们确实有很多访客。自由职业者经常来，更别提鼠帮劫匪。他们喜欢两三个人一起光顾，还经常共用同一隔间。另外，”黏液女孩指向一对隔间里的罗德尼安人，“他们也是我们最热情的员工之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chubby giantess gasps, holding a hand to her mouth. “Oh, but I must be painting a dire picture of the Tap-Hall! We do get lots of visitors, you know. Freelancers come through regularly, not to mention the Rat’s Raiders. They love popping by in twos and threes, often sharing the same booth. Also,” the goo girl points out the rodenians in a pair of booths, “they’re some of our most eager employees.”"

rows.original: “Still, there’s ever so many of Raiders and they get into so much trouble, I can’t imagine how they’re not constantly at odds with the Jumpers. I do know that the Star Vipers like to bully them, though they’re not allowed to do that in the Tap-Hall. But they seem okay with it. The Vipers are regulars around here, even! You’ve never seen a girl as thirsty as a Star Viper coming off a dry shift.” You give the sumptuous slime a doubting look and she blushes. “Present company excepted.”
rows.translation: “不过鼠帮劫匪人数那么多，又总惹麻烦，我真不明白他们怎会没有一直和跳帮者冲突。我知道星蝰喜欢欺负他们，不过龙头大厅不允许这么做。但他们似乎并不介意。星蝰甚至是这里的常客！你从没见过刚结束禁欲轮班的星蝰姑娘有多饥渴。”你怀疑地看向丰腴黏液，她红了脸。“当然，在场的你除外。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still, there’s ever so many of Raiders and they get into so much trouble, I can’t imagine how they’re not constantly at odds with the Jumpers. I do know that the Star Vipers like to bully them, though they’re not allowed to do that in the Tap-Hall. But they seem okay with it. The Vipers are regulars around here, even! You’ve never seen a girl as thirsty as a Star Viper coming off a dry shift.” You give the sumptuous slime a doubting look and she blushes. “Present company excepted.”"

rows.original: “Ah, anyway. We do get solo pirates coming through here too, and some who just don’t want UGC scrutiny. Never the Black Void, though. I think if there’s anything that could get every gang on the station to work together, it would be the threat of the Black Void. Even Cherry would trade her condom carrier for her old shield belt.”
rows.translation: “啊，总之。独行海盗也会来，还有些人只是不想受银河联合邦联审查。不过黑暗虚空从不会来。我想若有什么能让空间站所有帮派合作，那一定是黑暗虚空的威胁。就连切莉也会把安全套携带器换回旧护盾腰带。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, anyway. We do get solo pirates coming through here too, and some who just don’t want UGC scrutiny. Never the Black Void, though. I think if there’s anything that could get every gang on the station to work together, it would be the threat of the Black Void. Even Cherry would trade her condom carrier for her old shield belt.”"

rows.original: You ask what Molli would do if the Black Void rolled up to Zhèng Shi.
rows.translation: 你问如果黑暗虚空进攻郑石，莫莉会怎么做。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what Molli would do if the Black Void rolled up to Zhèng Shi."

rows.original: “I’d give ‘em the biggest hug they’d ever seen,” she teases, booping your nose. Considering her size, you suspect that would be more than enough to take down a whole squad.
rows.translation: “我会给他们一个前所未见的大拥抱，”她戏谑着轻点你的鼻子。考虑到她的体型，你怀疑这足以解决整支小队。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d give ‘em the biggest hug they’d ever seen,” she teases, booping your nose. Considering her size, you suspect that would be more than enough to take down a whole squad."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Keeping your voice low, you ask Molli about the old job she mentioned.
rows.translation: 你压低声音，询问莫莉提到的旧工作。
rows.raw: "Keeping your voice low, you ask Molli about the old job she mentioned."

rows.original: The galotian’s look of worry returns and she scans the Hall for any evesdroppers. “I really shouldn’t talk about it, you know. It was a lifetime ago. Still...” the goo girl’s full-cheeked face blushes, then lowers to whisper in your ear. “I was a bounty hunter.”
rows.translation: 加洛提安人再次露出担忧神情，扫视大厅寻找窃听者。“我真的不该谈这个，你知道。那是上辈子的事了。不过...”黏液女孩丰满双颊泛红，随后凑到你耳边低语。“我以前是赏金猎人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe galotian’s look of worry returns and she scans the Hall for any evesdroppers. “I really shouldn’t talk about it, you know. It was a lifetime ago. Still...” the goo girl’s full-cheeked face blushes, then lowers to whisper in your ear. “I was a bounty hunter.”"

rows.original: She smiles broadly at the look of surprise on your face. “Well, I wasn’t always the full-figured woman I am today, you know!” She tries to suck in her breath and make herself slender, but there’s just too much of the galotian to keep it up for long.
rows.translation: 看见你惊讶的表情，她咧嘴大笑。“这个嘛，我可不总是今天这样丰满的女人！”她试图收腹让自己变苗条，但加洛提安人的身体实在太多，根本无法维持太久。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles broadly at the look of surprise on your face. “Well, I wasn’t always the full-figured woman I am today, you know!” She tries to suck in her breath and make herself slender, but there’s just too much of the galotian to keep it up for long."

rows.original: You’re not sure you’ve heard of a galotian bounty hunter before.
rows.translation: 你不确定自己以前听说过加洛提安赏金猎人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure you’ve heard of a galotian bounty hunter before."

rows.original: “Well, I can’t imagine why not. We have quite a few advantages over you solid folk, you know. Most weapons can’t hurt us, we can squeeze through any crack, and our sense of taste is so good we can pick out the flavors in the air.”
rows.translation: “我真不明白为什么没听过。和你们这些实体人相比，我们有不少优势。大多数武器伤不到我们，任何缝隙都能挤过，而且味觉好到能分辨空气中的风味。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I can’t imagine why not. We have quite a few advantages over you solid folk, you know. Most weapons can’t hurt us, we can squeeze through any crack, and our sense of taste is so good we can pick out the flavors in the air.”"

rows.original: You diplomatically point out the famous galotian hunger. “Wouldn’t that get in the way?”
rows.translation: 你委婉指出加洛提安人著名的饥饿。“那不会妨碍工作吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou diplomatically point out the famous galotian hunger. “Wouldn’t that get in the way?”"

rows.original: “Well, only if you forget why you tracked someone down in the first place.” She checks again for anyone listening in. “My trick was to just engulf them. Slows you down, but you’ve got a steady supply of fluids to keep your wits sharp and bring them back safely. Drained, but safe.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，只有忘记最初为何追踪目标时才会。”她再次确认没人偷听。“我的诀窍就是把他们整个吞进去。这样行动会变慢，不过能持续获得体液，让头脑保持清醒并安全带回目标。被榨干了，但很安全。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, only if you forget why you tracked someone down in the first place.” She checks again for anyone listening in. “My trick was to just engulf them. Slows you down, but you’ve got a steady supply of fluids to keep your wits sharp and bring them back safely. Drained, but safe.”"

rows.original: “Sounds like a fun job.”
rows.translation: “听起来是份有趣的工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds like a fun job.”"

rows.original: “Oh, it was! The toughest ones were when I couldn’t just glomp ‘em. One time, I had to bring in a thraggen arms dealer bigger than I am now! He tried every last gun he had but I just kept cumming.” She blushes. “The, uh, vibrations were pretty exciting. Anyway, he eventually thought to try the whole ‘seduction’ route, but the joke was on him: I’d secretly starved myself for a week before confronting him. It took days before he finally passed out from exhaustion and nearly as long to drag him back to my ship, but what a capture!”
rows.translation: “哦，确实！最难的是那些不能直接扑抱的目标。有一次，我得抓一个比现在的我还大的特拉根军火商！他试遍了所有枪，可我只是不停高潮。”她红了脸。“呃，那些震动相当刺激。总之，他最后想到了‘色诱’路线，却不知道我早有准备：对峙前我偷偷饿了自己一周。他几天后才精疲力竭昏倒，我又花了差不多同样久才把他拖回飞船，但那真是精彩的抓捕！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it was! The toughest ones were when I couldn’t just glomp ‘em. One time, I had to bring in a thraggen arms dealer bigger than I am now! He tried every last gun he had but I just kept cumming.” She blushes. “The, uh, vibrations were pretty exciting. Anyway, he eventually thought to try the whole ‘seduction’ route, but the joke was on him: I’d secretly starved myself for a week before confronting him. It took days before he finally passed out from exhaustion and nearly as long to drag him back to my ship, but what a capture!”"

rows.original: “That’s pretty impressive. Thraggen are-”
rows.translation: “那确实厉害。特拉根人——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s pretty impressive. Thraggen are-”"

rows.original: “This other time, I brought in a whole gang of raskvel tech thieves. The girls had been scavenging the best stuff from smaller colonies and were flying under the radar till they accidentally nabbed some big ticket items bound for a Pyrite shipyard. Any time one of them got caught, the others would bust her out by scavenging the security systems right out of the holding cells! I had to bring ‘em all in at once, so I gave myself a dozen hands and fingered them senseless while leading them into my brig. Those rasks never stood a chance: when you’re dealing with a galo, every finger’s like a tongue,” she brags, getting heated up from memories of her past life.
rows.translation: “还有一次，我抓了一整帮拉斯克维尔科技窃贼。那些女孩一直从小殖民地搜刮最好的东西，直到无意间抢走一批运往黄铁矿工业船坞的高价货物，才暴露行踪。每当一个被抓，其他人就从拘留室里直接拆走安保系统，把她救出来！我必须一次抓齐，于是给自己变出十二只手，一边把她们指交到失去理智，一边带进禁闭舱。那些拉斯克毫无机会：对加洛提安人来说，每根手指都像舌头，”她自夸道，回忆过去让她越来越兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This other time, I brought in a whole gang of raskvel tech thieves. The girls had been scavenging the best stuff from smaller colonies and were flying under the radar till they accidentally nabbed some big ticket items bound for a Pyrite shipyard. Any time one of them got caught, the others would bust her out by scavenging the security systems right out of the holding cells! I had to bring ‘em all in at once, so I gave myself a dozen hands and fingered them senseless while leading them into my brig. Those rasks never stood a chance: when you’re dealing with a galo, every finger’s like a tongue,” she brags, getting heated up from memories of her past life."

rows.original: “I think-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think-”"

rows.original: “Oh!” she interrupts, her volume getting worryingly loud. “That reminds me of this vildarii who’d escaped capture again and again thanks to her shapeshifting. I set a honeytrap for her by getting an ovir friend to fly in to her last known location. She was an escort and pretty famous for her hemipenis, so it wasn’t long before the vildarii showed up and made herself a second pussy on the spot. Afterwards, I got her flavor from my friend, and ended up tracking her down to a maglev train. I had to lick just about everybody on that train, but eventually I found her,” Molli chirps in fond remembrance.
rows.translation: “哦！”她打断你，声音大得令人担忧。“这让我想起一个维尔达里人，她靠变形一次又一次逃脱。我让一位奥维尔朋友飞到她最后出现的地点，设下美人计。朋友是名护送员，又以半阴茎闻名，因此那个维尔达里人很快现身，当场给自己变出第二个小穴。事后我从朋友身上取得她的味道，一路追踪到磁悬浮列车。我几乎舔遍列车上所有人，最终还是找到了她，”莫莉怀念地欢快说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh!” she interrupts, her volume getting worryingly loud. “That reminds me of this vildarii who’d escaped capture again and again thanks to her shapeshifting. I set a honeytrap for her by getting an ovir friend to fly in to her last known location. She was an escort and pretty famous for her hemipenis, so it wasn’t long before the vildarii showed up and made herself a second pussy on the spot. Afterwards, I got her flavor from my friend, and ended up tracking her down to a maglev train. I had to lick just about everybody on that train, but eventually I found her,” Molli chirps in fond remembrance."

rows.original: You suspect that she’d go on at length, given the chance. You reach out and put a finger to the goo girl’s DSLs, hushing her before everyone on the station finds out.
rows.translation: 你怀疑只要给机会，她能一直说下去。你伸手用一根手指抵住黏液女孩厚实的香肠唇，在空间站所有人发现之前让她安静。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suspect that she’d go on at length, given the chance. You reach out and put a finger to the goo girl’s DSLs, hushing her before everyone on the station finds out."

rows.original: As if shaken from a dream, Molli blinks and smiles weakly. “Anyway, you can imagine why I’m not supposed to bring it up around here. Pirates and bounty hunters don’t get along super great, even when one’s retired.” She leans in and clasps your hands in her wam palms. “So, please promise never to tell anyone, okay? And please don’t tell Cherry I told you. She worries what would happen if the gangs found out.”
rows.translation: 莫莉像从梦中惊醒般眨眨眼，勉强微笑。“总之，你能理解我为什么不该在这里提起这些。海盗和赏金猎人相处得不太好，即便其中一方已经退休。”她凑近，用温暖手掌握住你的双手。“所以请答应绝不告诉任何人，好吗？也别告诉切莉是我说的。她担心帮派知道后会发生什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs if shaken from a dream, Molli blinks and smiles weakly. “Anyway, you can imagine why I’m not supposed to bring it up around here. Pirates and bounty hunters don’t get along super great, even when one’s retired.” She leans in and clasps your hands in her wam palms. “So, please promise never to tell anyone, okay? And please don’t tell Cherry I told you. She worries what would happen if the gangs found out.”"

rows.original: But wasn’t Cherry a pirate? How did a bounty hunter and a space pirate end up working together?
rows.translation: 可切莉以前不是海盗吗？赏金猎人和太空海盗怎么会一起工作？
rows.raw: "\n\nBut wasn’t Cherry a pirate? How did a bounty hunter and a space pirate end up working together?"

rows.original: “Well, that was kind of thanks to Cherry’s last partner in crime. But, um, I should get back to cleaning.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，多少要归功于切莉上一位犯罪搭档。不过，呃，我该回去清理了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, that was kind of thanks to Cherry’s last partner in crime. But, um, I should get back to cleaning.”"

rows.original: She scoots away to tend to the wall-sluts, leaving you with more questions than you started with. You never would’ve guessed the rolly polly giant goo was involved in such things! Considering how eager she was to share it with someone, though, it’s no wonder Cherry didn’t want anybody getting too familiar with her sidekick. Probably best to keep this to yourself.
rows.translation: 她滑走去照顾墙上的荡妇，留下比开始时更多的问题。你从没猜到这个圆滚滚的巨型黏液竟参与过这种事！不过考虑到她如此迫不及待想和人分享，也难怪切莉不希望别人和自己的助手太熟。最好把这事藏在心里。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe scoots away to tend to the wall-sluts, leaving you with more questions than you started with. You never would’ve guessed the rolly polly giant goo was involved in such things! Considering how eager she was to share it with someone, though, it’s no wonder Cherry didn’t want anybody getting too familiar with her sidekick. Probably best to keep this to yourself."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Though the Tap-Hall’s resident slime mom has been more than forthcoming, there’s still one thing neither she nor Cherry have explained and you just have to get to the bottom of it. Speaking softly, you ask Molli about Cherry’s last partner.
rows.translation: 龙头大厅的黏液妈妈虽然几乎知无不言，但有一件事她和切莉都没解释，而你非得弄清真相。你轻声询问莫莉有关切莉上一位搭档的事。
rows.raw: "Though the Tap-Hall’s resident slime mom has been more than forthcoming, there’s still one thing neither she nor Cherry have explained and you just have to get to the bottom of it. Speaking softly, you ask Molli about Cherry’s last partner."

rows.original: “Oh dear, I was afraid you were going to bring her up. But, you HAVE been very nice to the two of us. Just...” she reaches out and puts her hands on your shoulders, the massive woman’s form looming over you like a tidal wave, “you must promise to mention this to no one, okay? Cherry makes up stories about it, but the truth really hurt her.”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的，我就怕你会提起她。不过你对我们两个确实非常友善。只是...”她伸手按住你的肩膀，巨大的身形如海啸般笼罩你，“你必须答应绝不向任何人提起，好吗？切莉会编故事掩饰，但真相真的伤透了她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh dear, I was afraid you were going to bring her up. But, you HAVE been very nice to the two of us. Just...” she reaches out and puts her hands on your shoulders, the massive woman’s form looming over you like a tidal wave, “you must promise to mention this to no one, okay? Cherry makes up stories about it, but the truth really hurt her.”"

rows.original: You nod and Molli leads you to an empty booth at the far end of the hall. Lowering her voice to a soft whisper, you have to lean in to catch all the details.
rows.translation: 你点点头，莫莉带你来到大厅尽头一间空隔间。她把声音压成轻柔耳语，你不得不靠近才能听清所有细节。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and Molli leads you to an empty booth at the far end of the hall. Lowering her voice to a soft whisper, you have to lean in to catch all the details."

rows.original: “Cherry used to work with a bunch of different partners, but never for very long. Until she met a go’rahn girl, that is. She called herself Vanilla, sort of as a joke, because she had a very unremarkable appearance. Small bust size, cute but plain face, very unassuming. In fact, she was a pretty infamous conwoman and hacker, wanted for any number of white-collar crimes. Most people like to think amorphs like us are sex-crazed all the time, but that little rahn was sharper than anybody I ever met.”
rows.translation: “切莉以前和许多不同搭档合作，但从不长久，直到她遇见一个戈·拉恩女孩。对方自称香草，算是一种玩笑，因为外表非常普通：胸部很小，脸蛋可爱却平凡，看起来毫不起眼。其实她是臭名昭著的骗子与黑客，因无数白领犯罪而遭通缉。大多数人喜欢以为我们这种无定形生物永远性欲旺盛，但那个小拉恩比我见过的任何人都精明。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cherry used to work with a bunch of different partners, but never for very long. Until she met a go’rahn girl, that is. She called herself Vanilla, sort of as a joke, because she had a very unremarkable appearance. Small bust size, cute but plain face, very unassuming. In fact, she was a pretty infamous conwoman and hacker, wanted for any number of white-collar crimes. Most people like to think amorphs like us are sex-crazed all the time, but that little rahn was sharper than anybody I ever met.”"

rows.original: “Remember I told you I used to be a bounty hunter? Well, between Vanilla’s wits and Cherry’s toxin, the pair were nearly uncatchable. By the time I took their contract, they’d knocked out a half dozen of the finest hunters out there.”
rows.translation: “还记得我说以前是赏金猎人吗？凭借香草的机智与切莉的毒素，两人几乎无法捕获。我接下她们的合同时，她们已经放倒了六名最优秀的猎人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Remember I told you I used to be a bounty hunter? Well, between Vanilla’s wits and Cherry’s toxin, the pair were nearly uncatchable. By the time I took their contract, they’d knocked out a half dozen of the finest hunters out there.”"

rows.original: Wait, wait wait. Did Molli start out hunting Cherry?
rows.translation: 等等，等等。莫莉最初是在追捕切莉？
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, wait wait. Did Molli start out hunting Cherry?"

rows.original: The galotian’s pale pink blushes darker in embarrassment. She smiles weakly and nods. “It feels strange to say, but yes. She was just another pirate to me. And I thought I was the only one who could take them down. The recklessness of youth!”
rows.translation: 加洛提安人的淡粉肤色因尴尬变深。她勉强微笑着点头。“现在说来很奇怪，但没错。对我而言，她只是另一个海盗。而我以为只有自己能放倒她们。年轻时真是鲁莽！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe galotian’s pale pink blushes darker in embarrassment. She smiles weakly and nods. “It feels strange to say, but yes. She was just another pirate to me. And I thought I was the only one who could take them down. The recklessness of youth!”"

rows.original: If she knew they’d evaded or captured everyone who went after them, you suppose she must’ve had a plan.
rows.translation: 既然她知道两人躲过或抓住了所有追捕者，你猜她一定有个计划。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf she knew they’d evaded or captured everyone who went after them, you suppose she must’ve had a plan."

rows.original: “Yes indeed! I’d gathered how Cherry’s toxin worked from talking with some of her former captives and figured she wouldn’t be able to modify it quickly enough to work on galotians if I caught her by surprise. Vanilla always had security systems twisted around her little finger whenever they were on a job, so I figured the easier solution would be to ambush them the one place they felt most safe: on their own ship.” She sighs and pats the walls of the Tap-Hall. “I knew their captivity systems wouldn’t work on an amorph, so I figured I could just grab Cherry and drain Vanilla at the same time. They wouldn’t be able to run if we were all cooped up with nothing but void to run to. Too smart for my own good.”
rows.translation: “没错！我跟切莉以前抓过的一些俘虏聊过，大致弄清了她的毒素如何运作，觉得只要打她个措手不及，她就来不及把毒素调整到能对付加洛蒂安人的程度。香草每次行动时都能把安保系统玩弄于股掌之间，所以我认为更容易的办法，是在她们觉得最安全的地方伏击她们：她们自己的飞船上。”她叹了口气，拍了拍龙头大厅的墙壁。“我知道她们的囚禁系统困不住无定形体，因此盘算着抓住切莉的同时把香草榨干。大家都被关在船里，外面只有虚空，她们根本无处可逃。结果是聪明反被聪明误。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes indeed! I’d gathered how Cherry’s toxin worked from talking with some of her former captives and figured she wouldn’t be able to modify it quickly enough to work on galotians if I caught her by surprise. Vanilla always had security systems twisted around her little finger whenever they were on a job, so I figured the easier solution would be to ambush them the one place they felt most safe: on their own ship.” She sighs and pats the walls of the Tap-Hall. “I knew their captivity systems wouldn’t work on an amorph, so I figured I could just grab Cherry and drain Vanilla at the same time. They wouldn’t be able to run if we were all cooped up with nothing but void to run to. Too smart for my own good.”"

rows.original: Molli’s normally heavily lidded eyes open wider as she recounts the mission. “It took a few attempts to track them down, but eventually I was able to find their ship while they were both away on a heist. I snuck aboard and laid low in one of the holding cells until they got back and took off.”
rows.translation: 莫莉讲述这次任务时，平常半眯着的眼睛睁大了一些。“我尝试了几次才追踪到她们，最后趁她们俩外出抢劫时找到了她们的飞船。我偷偷登船，藏进一间拘留室，等她们回来起飞。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMolli’s normally heavily lidded eyes open wider as she recounts the mission. “It took a few attempts to track them down, but eventually I was able to find their ship while they were both away on a heist. I snuck aboard and laid low in one of the holding cells until they got back and took off.”"

rows.original: “While I was waiting for them to let down their guard and go to sleep, I couldn’t help but listen in on the two.” The hefty ex-hunter furrows her expression into a look of deep disapproval. “They were arguing about the heist. Apparently some of the guards had been supplied with heavy environmental suits that Cherry wasn’t able to penetrate. Vanilla had turned the security drones on them and pumped a few rounds through them to let Cherry get inside.”
rows.translation: “我等着她们放松警惕、上床睡觉时，忍不住偷听了两人的谈话。”这位壮硕的前赏金猎人皱起眉头，露出极不赞同的神情。“她们在为那次抢劫争吵。似乎有些守卫配备了切莉无法穿透的重型环境防护服。香草便操纵安保无人机朝他们开了几枪，好让切莉钻进去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“While I was waiting for them to let down their guard and go to sleep, I couldn’t help but listen in on the two.” The hefty ex-hunter furrows her expression into a look of deep disapproval. “They were arguing about the heist. Apparently some of the guards had been supplied with heavy environmental suits that Cherry wasn’t able to penetrate. Vanilla had turned the security drones on them and pumped a few rounds through them to let Cherry get inside.”"

rows.original: “You have to understand, Cherry never used lethal force in any of her jobs. She would NEVER. Vanilla went off-script and put those guards’ lives at risk. rows.raw: "\n\nThe sumptuous slime’s body clenches down on you, arcing spasms of blissful chemistry crackling across your [pc.skinFurScales]. The semi-translucent giantess’s belly swirls with pink bubbles, like she were a carbonated drink. Rather than merely rising, the fizz spirals in on itself, whorling froth spinning into a thickening, egg-like vortex. First one, then another and another. Gradually, the effervescent bubble clusters thicken and solidify into something very nearly resembling humanoid shapes. They swell and expand until the wobbly, bubbly forms are nearly as large as you are."

rows.original: You blink. You’d been so caught up in a first-hand view of galotian reproduction, you’d entirely forgotten about breathing! You gasp and Molli’s liquid body fills your throat like strawberry champagne, sending a moment of panic through you. Panic becomes confusion as your breathing comes as normally as if you weren’t floating deep inside an alien slime.
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼。你太过沉浸于亲眼见证加洛提亚人的繁殖过程，竟完全忘了呼吸！你猛吸一口气，莫莉的液态身体像草莓香槟般灌进喉咙，让你一瞬间陷入恐慌。当你发现自己呼吸得就像没有漂浮在外星黏液深处一样正常时，恐慌又化为了困惑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. You’d been so caught up in a first-hand view of galotian reproduction, you’d entirely forgotten about breathing! You gasp and Molli’s liquid body fills your throat like strawberry champagne, sending a moment of panic through you. Panic becomes confusion as your breathing comes as normally as if you weren’t floating deep inside an alien slime."

rows.original: Judging by Molli’s climactic panting, she must need a ton of oxygen to divide and its left her fluid frame as oxygenated as a liquid ventilator!
rows.translation: 从莫莉高潮般的喘息判断，她分裂时一定需要大量氧气，这让她的液态躯体充满了氧，宛如液体呼吸机！
rows.raw: " Judging by Molli’s climactic panting, she must need a ton of oxygen to divide and its left her fluid frame as oxygenated as a liquid ventilator!"

rows.original: You don’t know the science responsible, but you’re just grateful not to be drowning!
rows.translation: 你不了解其中的科学原理，只庆幸自己没有溺水！
rows.raw: "You don’t know the science responsible, but you’re just grateful not to be drowning!"

rows.original: A heaving suction surges through the galo girl, her internal division sending contractions around you and all your rapidly-solidifying daughters. The room-filling goo mommy moans in a maelstrom of birthing bliss. The proto-goos slip from their natal infancy in seconds, their blobby bodies forming into grown women before your pink-tinted eyes. Most resemble Molli, though more than a few of your own features are reflected in the newborn goo girls.
rows.translation: 一股剧烈吸力涌过胶质姑娘，她体内的分裂过程令一阵阵收缩包围着你和所有正在迅速凝固成形的女儿。填满房间的胶质妈妈在分娩快感的漩涡中呻吟。原生胶质体在几秒内便脱离初生阶段，团块般的身体在你染成粉色的视野中化为成年女性。她们大多长得像莫莉，不过其中也有不少新生胶质姑娘映照着你自己的特征。
rows.raw: "\n\nA heaving suction surges through the galo girl, her internal division sending contractions around you and all your rapidly-solidifying daughters. The room-filling goo mommy moans in a maelstrom of birthing bliss. The proto-goos slip from their natal infancy in seconds, their blobby bodies forming into grown women before your pink-tinted eyes. Most resemble Molli, though more than a few of your own features are reflected in the newborn goo girls."

rows.original: Invisible eddies in Molli’s expansive ooze pull her fully-formed offspring to her stretching, gelatinous threshold. One by one, your daughters slip from Molli’s womb-like interior, taking a portion of her untenable mass with them. Fully formed and birthed into adulthood, the young women giggle as they spill out onto the floor. Though your ears are filled with the rush of Molli’s roiling childbirth, you can make out the new goos chatting with one another in giddy, eager voices. Your girls pull themselves up to their full heights to give their mother (and mommy-encased father) a big hug.
rows.translation: 莫莉广阔黏液中无形的涡流，把已经完全成形的后代拉向她不断扩张的胶质出口。你的女儿们一个接一个从莫莉宛如子宫的内部滑出，同时各自带走她难以维持的一部分质量。年轻女人们以完整形态降生，出生便已成年，一边咯咯轻笑，一边流淌到地板上。尽管耳朵里满是莫莉翻涌分娩的声响，你仍能听出新生胶质姑娘们正用兴奋雀跃的声音相互交谈。你的女儿们直起身子，舒展到全部高度，给她们的母亲以及被妈妈包裹在体内的父亲一个大大的拥抱。
rows.raw: "\n\nInvisible eddies in Molli’s expansive ooze pull her fully-formed offspring to her stretching, gelatinous threshold. One by one, your daughters slip from Molli’s womb-like interior, taking a portion of her untenable mass with them. Fully formed and birthed into adulthood, the young women giggle as they spill out onto the floor. Though your ears are filled with the rush of Molli’s roiling childbirth, you can make out the new goos chatting with one another in giddy, eager voices. Your girls pull themselves up to their full heights to give their mother (and mommy-encased father) a big hug."

rows.original: Despite the welling paternal pride, the rolling waves of birthing heat flowing through you dims your senses. Floating freely inside your lover’s amorphous womb, a deep, soporific peace settles down on you. Every muscle in your body relaxes, amniotic serenity soothing the thousand aches you’d built up over the course of your adventure. Your vision swims, but you can still make out more shapes forming around you as Molli begins to birth more daughters. Before sleep overtakes you, you idly wonder just how many children a galotian this large can have.
rows.translation: 尽管父亲般的自豪感不断涌上心头，流遍全身的一波波生产热潮却令你的感官逐渐昏沉。你自由漂浮在爱人不定形的子宫内，一股深沉而催人入睡的安宁笼罩着你。全身每一块肌肉都松弛下来，羊水般的宁静抚平了冒险途中积累的无数酸痛。你的视野游移不定，但随着莫莉开始产下更多女儿，你仍能辨认出身边逐渐成形的更多轮廓。沉睡将你吞没之前，你漫不经心地想着，这么庞大的加洛提安究竟能生下多少孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite the welling paternal pride, the rolling waves of birthing heat flowing through you dims your senses. Floating freely inside your lover’s amorphous womb, a deep, soporific peace settles down on you. Every muscle in your body relaxes, amniotic serenity soothing the thousand aches you’d built up over the course of your adventure. Your vision swims, but you can still make out more shapes forming around you as Molli begins to birth more daughters. Before sleep overtakes you, you idly wonder just how many children a galotian this large can have."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Cherry
rows.translation: 切莉
rows.raw: "Cherry"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: The sound of a blaring klaxon. The rush of cold air. The feeling of a hard floor. The faint, lingering taste of strawberries.
rows.translation: 刺耳警报的鸣响。冷空气的冲击。坚硬地板的触感。草莓味淡淡残留在口中。
rows.raw: "The sound of a blaring klaxon. The rush of cold air. The feeling of a hard floor. The faint, lingering taste of strawberries."

rows.original: “STEELE!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“STEELE!”"

rows.original: Your reverie is cut short by Cherry’s shrill cry. “What the FUCK, Steele?!? I leave you alone for a few hours and you... Molli! Molli, are you alright?”
rows.translation: 切莉尖锐的喊声打断了你的美梦。“这他妈是怎么回事，斯蒂尔？！我才把你单独留下几个小时，你就...莫莉！莫莉，你还好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour reverie is cut short by Cherry’s shrill cry. “What the FUCK, Steele?!? I leave you alone for a few hours and you... Molli! Molli, are you alright?”"

rows.original: You blink, eyes slowly adjusting to light once more and try to rise from the floor. Your muscles are sluggish, like they have to relearn how to move, but you manage to turn to the panicked zel’rahn. She’s abandoned her robotic legs at the doorway, and is stooped over a pink figure weakly reclined on the floor as you had been. Is that Molli?
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼，双眼慢慢重新适应光线，并试着从地板上起身。肌肉迟钝无力，仿佛必须重新学习如何活动，不过你还是成功转向了惊慌失措的泽尔·拉恩。她把机械腿丢在门口，俯身查看一个粉红色身影；那人和刚才的你一样，虚弱地斜躺在地板上。那是莫莉吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink, eyes slowly adjusting to light once more and try to rise from the floor. Your muscles are sluggish, like they have to relearn how to move, but you manage to turn to the panicked zel’rahn. She’s abandoned her robotic legs at the doorway, and is stooped over a pink figure weakly reclined on the floor as you had been. Is that Molli?"

rows.original: Even at half-height, Cherry’s not that much smaller than the now vastly diminished galotian. Where she once towered over nearly anyone else on Zhèng Shi, the matronly goo girl has shrunk down to a slim puddle and an even slimmer body! Formerly rubenesque curves have given way to a svelte, younger shape. Even her gooey hair is shorter, now trim enough to make out both of her sleepy, heavily-lidded eyes.The double-hearted barrette normally resting on her head now floats in her chest like an onyx core.
rows.translation: 即使只剩一半身高，切莉也没比此刻大幅缩水的加洛提安矮多少。曾经在郑石空间站几乎比任何人都高大的母性胶女，如今缩成了一摊纤薄的黏液，以及一具更加纤细的身体！原本丰腴的曲线已变成年轻苗条的体形。就连她的胶质头发也短了，如今修剪得足以看清那双睡意蒙眬、眼皮沉重的眼睛。平常戴在头上的双心发夹，此刻像一枚黑玛瑙核心般漂浮在她胸腔里。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven at half-height, Cherry’s not that much smaller than the now vastly diminished galotian. Where she once towered over nearly anyone else on Zhèng Shi, the matronly goo girl has shrunk down to a slim puddle and an even slimmer body! Formerly rubenesque curves have given way to a svelte, younger shape. Even her gooey hair is shorter, now trim enough to make out both of her sleepy, heavily-lidded eyes.The double-hearted barrette normally resting on her head now floats in her chest like an onyx core."

rows.original: “Oh my,” she sighs, swaying uncertainly. “Cherry, dear, have you grown?”
rows.translation: “哎呀，”她摇摇晃晃地叹道。“亲爱的切莉，你长高了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my,” she sighs, swaying uncertainly. “Cherry, dear, have you grown?”"

rows.original: The crimson pirate shakes her deflated bounty hunter in disbelief. “Molli! Your collar! What-” The gel girl’s ponytail brushes across the floor, scattering shards of scrapped cybernetics. Her eyes widen. “Oh no. The alarms.” Cherry hooks her ponytail around one of her mechanical legs and swings herself onto them with well practiced - but no less desperate - haste. “You two! With me!”
rows.translation: 绯红海盗难以置信地摇晃着缩水的赏金猎人。“莫莉！你的项圈！怎么...”胶女的马尾扫过地板，将报废义体的碎片拨得到处都是。她睁大双眼。“糟了。是警报。”切莉用马尾勾住一条机械腿，以熟练却丝毫不失急切的动作荡回双腿上。“你们两个！跟我来！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe crimson pirate shakes her deflated bounty hunter in disbelief. “Molli! Your collar! What-” The gel girl’s ponytail brushes across the floor, scattering shards of scrapped cybernetics. Her eyes widen. “Oh no. The alarms.” Cherry hooks her ponytail around one of her mechanical legs and swings herself onto them with well practiced - but no less desperate - haste. “You two! With me!”"

rows.original: Memories start coming back to you. You cast about for any sign of your daughters, there’s only the three of you. And if Molli is THIS small, that means... You fight through the post-coital haze and manage to stand up. You try to help Molli, but your hands just gush right through the formerly-firm goo. She giggles at your efforts. “That tickles!” She tries to tickle you back, but just manages to cover you with pink slime. “Ooh, I like that color on you,” she coos, completely failing to process her partner’s urgency.
rows.translation: 记忆开始回到脑海。你环顾四周，寻找女儿们的任何踪迹，但这里只有你们三个。而且如果莫莉变得这么小，那就意味着...你奋力摆脱性交后的迷糊，总算站起身来。你试着扶起莫莉，可双手直接从这团不再坚实的胶体中喷涌穿过。她被你的努力逗得咯咯直笑。“好痒呀！”她试图挠你痒痒作为回敬，却只把粉红黏液涂了你一身。“哦，这颜色在你身上真好看，”她轻声娇叹，完全没能理解伴侣的急迫。
rows.raw: "\n\nMemories start coming back to you. You cast about for any sign of your daughters, there’s only the three of you. And if Molli is THIS small, that means... You fight through the post-coital haze and manage to stand up. You try to help Molli, but your hands just gush right through the formerly-firm goo. She giggles at your efforts. “That tickles!” She tries to tickle you back, but just manages to cover you with pink slime. “Ooh, I like that color on you,” she coos, completely failing to process her partner’s urgency."

rows.original: With her size reduced so much, the diminished galotian’s cognitive processing power has gone from a swimming pool to thimble. Helping her gather what wits remain, you lead the unreasonably slim galotian after her employer. The door to Cherry’s quarters is open and you can see the flickers of monitors reflecting off her shiny body. “Oh... noooo...” she moans. Without turning away, she waves you in and points, wordlessly, at the live surveillance feeds coming in from all over the station.
rows.translation: 随着体形大幅缩小，这名缩水加洛提安的认知处理能力也从游泳池变成了顶针。你帮她集中仅存的神智，领着瘦得不合常理的加洛提安追赶她的雇主。切莉房间的门敞开着，你能看见监视器闪烁的光芒映在她亮泽的身体上。“哦...不——...”她呻吟道。她没有回头，只挥手示意你们进来，并默默指向从空间站各处传来的实时监控画面。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith her size reduced so much, the diminished galotian’s cognitive processing power has gone from a swimming pool to thimble. Helping her gather what wits remain, you lead the unreasonably slim galotian after her employer. The door to Cherry’s quarters is open and you can see the flickers of monitors reflecting off her shiny body. “Oh... noooo...” she moans. Without turning away, she waves you in and points, wordlessly, at the live surveillance feeds coming in from all over the station."

rows.original: Mollis. Mollis everywhere.
rows.translation: 莫莉。到处都是莫莉。
rows.raw: "\n\nMollis. Mollis everywhere."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 迷你莫莉
rows.raw: "Mini-Mollis"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: On one screen, a pair of busty pink slimes with [pc.hips] have a Jumper pinned between them, eagerly tongue-bathing the moaning laquine. Lapping up the musky bunny’s juices, the station’s spontaneous janitors don’t even bother unzipping her jumpsuit. The galotians flow into the girl’s latex to reach every nook and cranny, bulging the shiny black suit as she drops to her knees, futilely trying to squish down the bulging lumps that threaten to tear her uniform from within. Her bulging erection throbs and floods her rubber clothes with cleaning galotians’ favorite form of repayment.
rows.translation: 一个屏幕上，两个长着[pc.hips]的丰满粉红史莱姆把一名跳帮者夹在中间，正热切地用舌头给呻吟的拉奎因洗澡。她们舔食着这只麝香兔子的体液，空间站里自发上岗的清洁工甚至懒得拉开她的连体衣拉链。加洛提安们流进女孩的乳胶衣物，触及每一个角落，把亮黑色制服撑得鼓胀起来；她跪倒在地，徒劳地试图压下那些几乎要从内部撕裂制服的凸起。她鼓胀的勃起物不断抽动，把清洁中的加洛提安最喜欢的报酬灌满她的橡胶衣物。
rows.raw: "On one screen, a pair of busty pink slimes with [pc.hips] have a Jumper pinned between them, eagerly tongue-bathing the moaning laquine. Lapping up the musky bunny’s juices, the station’s spontaneous janitors don’t even bother unzipping her jumpsuit. The galotians flow into the girl’s latex to reach every nook and cranny, bulging the shiny black suit as she drops to her knees, futilely trying to squish down the bulging lumps that threaten to tear her uniform from within. Her bulging erection throbs and floods her rubber clothes with cleaning galotians’ favorite form of repayment."

rows.original: Your heart leaps in panic when the orange-clad Shock Hopper shows up and lets loose with her lightning gun, shocking her underling and the mini-Mollis alike. The junior laquine spasms and drops in a twitching swoon, but the galotians ooze out of her suit with no more injury than dizzy smiles on their faces. One pokes the other, giggling as a spark jumping between the two. The Shock Hopper drops the gun and rolls her head across her shoulders to limber up. Plucking the cigar from her mouth and tossing it to one side, she squares up. “Where’s L.D.C. when you need him,” she mutters, cracking her knuckles as she advances on the rogue custodians.
rows.translation: 当身穿橙色制服的电击跳虫现身并用闪电枪开火，同时电击下属和迷你莫莉时，你的心脏惊慌地猛跳起来。年轻拉奎因痉挛着倒下，在抽搐中陷入昏迷，但加洛提安们从她的制服中渗出，除了脸上带着晕乎乎的笑容，丝毫没有受伤。其中一个戳了戳另一个，看着一道火花在两者间跃过，咯咯笑了起来。电击跳虫扔下枪，转动脑袋和肩膀舒展身体。她从嘴里取出雪茄扔到一旁，摆好架势。“这种时候L.D.C.跑哪儿去了，”她一边咕哝，一边捏响指节，向失控的清洁工们逼近。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour heart leaps in panic when the orange-clad Shock Hopper shows up and lets loose with her lightning gun, shocking her underling and the mini-Mollis alike. The junior laquine spasms and drops in a twitching swoon, but the galotians ooze out of her suit with no more injury than dizzy smiles on their faces. One pokes the other, giggling as a spark jumping between the two. The Shock Hopper drops the gun and rolls her head across her shoulders to limber up. Plucking the cigar from her mouth and tossing it to one side, she squares up. “Where’s L.D.C. when you need him,” she mutters, cracking her knuckles as she advances on the rogue custodians."

rows.original: Elsewhere, the thraggen foundry chief is already locked in battle with another pink galotian. This more serious-looking daughter dismissively jiggles the jelly of her [pc.hair] and levels an accusatory finger at the snarling beefcake. “Space Pirate scum, you’re under arrest. We can do this the easy way or the fun way.”
rows.translation: 另一处，特拉根铸造厂主管已经与另一个粉红加洛提安陷入战斗。这个看起来更加严肃的女儿轻蔑地抖了抖自己的[pc.hair]胶质物，随后用指责的手指指向怒吼的肌肉壮汉。“太空海盗渣滓，你被捕了。我们可以用简单的方式解决，也可以用有趣的方式解决。”
rows.raw: "\n\nElsewhere, the thraggen foundry chief is already locked in battle with another pink galotian. This more serious-looking daughter dismissively jiggles the jelly of her [pc.hair] and levels an accusatory finger at the snarling beefcake. “Space Pirate scum, you’re under arrest. We can do this the easy way or the fun way.”"

rows.original: Agrosh doesn’t dignify the demand with a response, instead hauling back and swinging his mattock of a fist right at the center of the young bounty hunter’s mass. The bone-shattering blow hits the amorph like a needle popping a water balloon, splattering the slime in every direction. Before he can finish his follow-through, however, the goo girl’s puddles flow together around him. The pink lawbringer reappears, uninjured and grappling the roaring berserker. “Aw, you chose the easy way? Well, we can do the fun way afterwards, I guess,” she taunts, sticking to her thrashing foe like glue.
rows.translation: 阿格罗什根本不屑于回应这项要求，只是把手臂向后拉，挥动那只宛如鹤嘴锄的拳头，直击年轻赏金猎人的身体中央。足以碎骨的重击刺入不定形生物，就像针扎破水球一样，将史莱姆溅向四面八方。然而他还没来得及完成挥拳后的动作，胶女散落的一滩滩身体就从周围汇聚到他身上。粉红执法者毫发无伤地重新现身，紧抱住咆哮的狂战士。“哎呀，你选了简单的方式？那之后我们再试试有趣的方式好了，”她挑衅道，像胶水一样黏在拼命挣扎的对手身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nAgrosh doesn’t dignify the demand with a response, instead hauling back and swinging his mattock of a fist right at the center of the young bounty hunter’s mass. The bone-shattering blow hits the amorph like a needle popping a water balloon, splattering the slime in every direction. Before he can finish his follow-through, however, the goo girl’s puddles flow together around him. The pink lawbringer reappears, uninjured and grappling the roaring berserker. “Aw, you chose the easy way? Well, we can do the fun way afterwards, I guess,” she taunts, sticking to her thrashing foe like glue."

rows.original: Another feed shows one lucky goo girl amid the slave pens.
rows.translation: 另一路画面显示，一名幸运的胶女正身处奴隶围栏之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother feed shows one lucky goo girl amid the slave pens. "

rows.original: It seems the pirates of Zhèng Shi have been busy! They’ve managed to nearly refill the pens you’d liberated with a fresh crop of victims.
rows.translation: 看来郑石空间站的海盗们一直没闲着！他们已经用一批新受害者，几乎重新填满了你曾解放的围栏。

rows.original: It doesn’t look like any of the mini-Mollis have reached the docking bay, but Urbolg appears to be packing up all the same. The korgonne artificer swiftly disassembles his current project and has his ship secured in minutes. He turns back to look down the corridor leading into the chaos-crippled base and shrugs. Perhaps wisely, the stout pirate climbs into his ship and bugs out.

Buzzing and hissing drowns out the sounds of the guns outside and even the klaxon alarms still shrieking all through the station. You’re not sure what’s happening until a pink hand gently rests on your shoulder.
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼。她是在对你说老套的搭讪台词吗？现在？过了好一会儿你才反应过来。你跑回控制台，输入“Me-N-U。”周围的机器开始嗡鸣着启动。电流嗡鸣与蒸汽嘶声淹没了外面的枪响，甚至盖过仍响彻整座空间站的尖锐警报。你还没弄清发生了什么，一只粉红色的手便轻轻落在你的肩上。

rows.original: An explosion in the outer room pulls your attention away from the swelling goo girl just as Cherry dives into the room, minus her legs. “I had to blow the cybernetics to drive ‘em back,” she pants hitting the sealing hatch with her hair-tendril. You vaguely recall that Cherry had converted her spaceship into the Tap-Hall, but you never would’ve guessed that part of it would be able to go back. You and the two amorphs blast into space, as far and fast from Zhèng Shi as the pod-ship’s thrusters can manage.

Put up a ‘Do Not’ sign and that’s all they want to do. So I kept it simple. Pay what you owe, don’t damage the employees, and,” the wrothful rahn stops pacing and stares into your eyes with a cold anger, “leave Molli alone.”
